title: Latent Cluster Separation as a Regularizer for Lifelong Anomaly Detection
summary: Lifelong (continual) anomaly detection systems must learn a sequence of tasks without forgetting how to recognize anomaly types seen earlier -- a property known as backward transfer. A common way to try to improve backward transfer is to reshape a model's internal representation around learnable concept centroids, typically coupled with a new way of scoring anomalies based on distance to those centroids. Because these two design choices are usually introduced together, it is unclear which one is actually responsible for any performance gain. In this paper, we unbundle the two mechanisms within a VAE-based lifelong anomaly detector and study them separately. We find that used purely as a training-time regularizer -- while leaving anomaly scoring unchanged -- latent cluster separation can improve detection quality and backward transfer, though whether it outperforms the alternative scoring approach depends on the dataset's underlying representation. Switching to distance-based scoring is instead where most of the instability commonly associated with this class of method actually originates; we identify and explain the underlying mechanism. This benefit depends on the dataset's underlying representation, and we report this as practical guidance for choosing between the two design choices, rather than as a list of caveats.

AI.tldr: 该文在VAE终身异常检测框架中解耦"类中心表示正则"与"距离打分"两种机制，发现前者作为训练期正则可提升检测质量与后向迁移，而后者的距离打分才是该类方法不稳定的主要来源。
AI.motivation: 终身异常检测需保证后向迁移。常见做法是围绕可学习概念中心重塑表征，并配合基于中心距离的异常打分，但二者通常被同时引入，导致无法判断性能增益究竟来自哪一机制。
AI.method: 在基于VAE的终身异常检测器中解耦两种机制并分别研究：一是将潜在聚类分离仅用作训练期正则、保持原有异常打分不变；二是切换为基于中心距离的打分方式，并分析其不稳定的产生机理。
AI.result: 仅作训练期正则的潜在聚类分离可改善检测质量与后向迁移，但其相对距离打分方法的优劣取决于数据集底层表征结构；不稳定主要源自距离打分本身，并给出了相应机制解释。
AI.conclusion: 两种设计选择应分别评估；其收益具有数据表征依赖性，论文将其作为二者间选择的实用指导而非注意事项清单。

title: Four Extensions of the Universal Law of Robustness: Log-Concave Covariates, Heterogeneous Mixtures, Vector-Valued Predictors, and Markovian Data
summary: Bubeck and Sellke's universal law of robustness says that fitting $n$ noisy samples below the noise level with a class of $p$ real parameters forces a Lipschitz constant of order $\sqrt{nd/p}$, when the covariate distribution on $\mathbb{R}^d$ is isoperimetric: smooth interpolation costs a factor $d$ of overparametrization. Its hypotheses are Gaussian-type concentration, a homogeneous covariate law, scalar outputs, and independent samples; we relax each one. Exponential concentration suffices, at the unchanged rate and absolute constant and at the price of a capacity burn-in, some form of which we show is necessary; this gives the law for normalized log-concave covariates, with a $\log d$ loss from the current KLS bound. For heterogeneous mixtures the worst component constant is replaced by the weighted average of the component constants, under a typicality condition on the mixture composition. For vector-valued predictors the bound at the Frobenius Lipschitz scale is free of the output dimension $K$, and the Euclidean bound loses only $K^{-1/2}$, a loss that covariate-independent noise removes. Stationary Markov covariates retain the i.i.d. rate, the pseudo-spectral gap entering only the sample-size conditions. One master theorem carries the shared argument, and constants are explicit throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文将Bubeck–Sellke鲁棒性普适定律的四项假设逐一放松：指数集中即可保持原速率（需付出容量"预热"代价，并证明其必要性）；异质混合将最坏分量常数替换为加权平均；向量输出在Frobenius Lipschitz尺度下与输出维数K无关；平稳Markov协变量保持i.i.d.速率。给出统一主定理与显式常数。
AI.motivation: 原定律依赖Gaussian型集中、同质协变量分布、标量输出与独立样本四项假设，限制了其适用范围；作者希望在不改变核心速率的前提下逐条去除这些限制，并刻画放松所需的代价。
AI.method: 以单一"主定理"承载共同论证：(1) 将Gaussian集中假设弱化为指数集中，速率与绝对常数不变，代价为容量预热项，并证明某种形式的预热必要；(2) 对归一化对数凹协变量给出相应定律（相对现有KLS界有log d损失）；(3) 异质混合在混合成分典型性条件下用加权平均常数替代最坏分量常数；(4) 向量输出在Frobenius Lipschitz尺度下界不含K，Euclidean尺度仅损失K^{-1/2}，且与协变量独立的噪声可消除该损失；(5) 平稳Markov协变量保持i.i.d.速率，伪谱隙仅进入样本量条件。全文常数显式。
AI.result: 指数集中以不变速率√(nd/p)与相同绝对常数成立（附加容量预热，且该预热在某种形式下不可去除）；归一化对数凹分布获得鲁棒性定律，仅有log d损失；混合分布的Lipschitz下界由分量常数的加权平均控制；Frobenius尺度向量输出界与K无关，Euclidean尺度损失K^{-1/2}并可被独立噪声消除；平稳Markov样本保持i.i.d.速率，伪谱隙只影响样本量要求。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性普适定律具有较强稳健性：其结论主要由集中性质与等周性驱动，而非Gaussian性或独立性本身；异质性、多输出与相依性可被统一框架吸收，且代价可量化、常数显式。

title: Towards Automatic Heart Murmur Characterization from Multi-spot Phonocardiograms
summary: Cardiac auscultation traditionally detects the presence of a heart murmur, but clinicians further characterize it by timing, shape, pitch, quality, and grade. Most automatic phonocardiogram analysis systems stop at binary detection and do not estimate this richer description. In this work, we formulate automatic murmur characterization as five patient-level classification tasks and compare three multi-spot strategies on recordings from the aortic, pulmonary, mitral, and tricuspid auscultation locations. First, classical and deep-learning classifiers are trained independently at each location, and predictions are combined via a maximum-severity late-fusion rule. Second, a synchronous multi-input CNN jointly processes one representative segment per location for a single task. Third, a unified multi-input, multi-output CNN predicts all five attributes from one shared multi-spot representation. Using 735 patients from the CirCor DigiScope dataset with complete four-spot recordings, the best late-fusion configurations reach an unweighted mean sensitivity between 85.56% and 93.81% across the five tasks, with class-specific recalls between 80.00% and 100.00% for every relevant category. The multi-input CNN trails late fusion by 7-16 points depending on the task, while the multi-output model reaches values between 72.59% and 79.40%, estimating all five attributes from one shared representation. We further show that naively balancing training data by adding all minority-class segments degrades patient-level performance under the maximum-severity rule, since it introduces non-representative, noisy segments not filtered by the clustering-based segment selection used for evaluation. These results indicate multi-spot murmur characterization is feasible with both fusion-based and jointly learned architectures, outlining a path toward automatic, structured murmur reports complementing binary screening.

AI.tldr: 该研究将心脏杂音自动特征描述建模为五个患者级分类任务，在CirCor DigiScope数据集735例完整四点听诊记录上比较三种多听诊点策略：最大严重度后融合、同步多输入CNN、以及统一多输入多输出CNN，探讨结构化杂音报告的可行性。
AI.motivation: 传统心音图分析多止于杂音的二分类检出，未进一步刻画其时机、形态、音调、音质和分级等临床维度；作者希望将自动分析推进到更丰富、结构化的杂音描述，以补充二分类筛查。
AI.method: 基于主动脉、肺动脉、二尖瓣、三尖瓣四个听诊位置录音，构建五个患者级分类任务，比较三种策略：(1) 各位置独立训练传统与深度学习分类器，按最大严重度规则进行后融合；(2) 同步多输入CNN对每个位置的代表性片段联合处理，单任务输出；(3) 统一多输入多输出CNN从共享多点表征同时预测五个属性。另分析按类别平衡训练数据对患者级性能的影响。
AI.result: 最佳后融合配置在五项任务上的非加权平均灵敏度为85.56%–93.81%，各相关类别召回率为80.00%–100.00%；多输入CNN较后融合低7–16个百分点；多输出模型为72.59%–79.40%。按最大严重度规则盲目加入全部少数类片段会引入未被聚类片段选择过滤的非代表性噪声片段，反而降低患者级性能。
AI.conclusion: 多点杂音特征描述在融合式与联合学习式架构下均可行，为在二分类筛查之外实现自动、结构化的杂音报告提供了路径；数据平衡需谨慎，避免引入非代表性片段损害患者级评估。

title: HyPAIC: Personal AI Computer with High Bandwidth Flash for High Performance Trillion-Parameter LLM Inference
summary: LLMs have rapidly expanded from simple chatbots to agentic AI, where models directly use tools to solve complex problems. To improve problem solving, most frontier LLMs adopt an MoE architecture, pushing model sizes into the trillion-parameter regime. While cloud services have dominated large-scale LLM inference, cost and security concerns drive demand for on-premises deployment. Thus, GPU manufacturers have introduced personal AI computers (PAICs). However, existing PAICs with LPDDR-based unified main memory suffer from severe capacity limitations, restricting hostable LLM size on a single device. If most memory holds model weights, little remains for the KV cache, reducing supported context length. In this paper, we propose HyPAIC, a PAIC architecture incorporating HBF to overcome these memory constraints. HyPAIC stores read-only model weights in HBF and mutable runtime data in LPDDR. HBF offers over 10x the capacity of HBM with comparable TB/s-scale bandwidth. HyPAIC addresses HBF's access latency, limited write endurance, and page-level access granularity through prefetching, read-only weight placement, and coarse-grained weight accesses, respectively; power and cooling remain significant implementation challenges. Through simulation-based evaluation, we show that a single HyPAIC improves end-to-end system throughput by up to 1.04x and TDP-normalized throughput by up to 3.59x during 1T-parameter MoE inference versus the aggregate of eight baseline systems without HBF, one HyPAIC thus approaches the raw performance of eight baselines with far superior power efficiency. For small model inference, HyPAIC increases the maximum number of concurrent tasks sustaining at least 50 decode TPS per task by up to 4x, enhancing user experience and productivity. Although HBF specifications are still evolving, this study demonstrates strong architectural synergy between HBF and PAICs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyPAIC——一种引入HBF（高带宽闪存）的个人AI计算机（PAIC）架构，将只读模型权重存放于HBF、可变运行时数据（如KV cache）存放于LPDDR，以突破LPDDR统一主存的容量瓶颈；仿真表明单台HyPAIC在1T参数MoE推理下吞吐可达八台基线系统总和的1.04x、TDP归一化吞吐3.59x，小模型场景下可维持≥50 decode TPS/任务的并发数提升至4x。
AI.motivation: LLM从聊天机器人演进为使用工具的智能体，前沿模型普遍采用MoE架构使参数规模进入万亿级；云推理虽成熟，但成本与安全顾虑推动本地部署需求，GPU厂商因此推出个人AI计算机（PAIC）。然而现有PAIC依赖LPDDR统一主存，容量严重受限：权重占据大部分内存后，留给KV cache的空间过少，制约可承载模型规模与上下文长度。
AI.method: 提出HyPAIC架构，用HBF（容量超HBM 10倍以上、带宽达TB/s量级）承载只读权重，LPDDR承载可变运行时数据。针对HBF三大短板分别给出对策：用预取缓解访问延迟；用只读权重放置规避有限写寿命问题；用粗粒度权重访问适配页级访问粒度。并指出功耗与散热仍是重要实现挑战，采用基于仿真的评估。
AI.result: 1T参数MoE推理下，单台HyPAIC端到端系统吞吐较八台无HBF基线系统总和高1.04x，TDP归一化吞吐高3.59x，即单机接近八机原始性能且能效显著更优；小模型推理中，可同时维持每任务≥50 decode TPS的最大并发任务数提升至4x。
AI.conclusion: 在HBF规格仍在演进的情况下，本研究表明HBF与PAIC之间存在强架构协同性：以只读权重下沉HBF、可变状态留在LPDDR的分工方案，可在单设备上有效缓解容量—带宽—上下文长度之间的张力，为本地化万亿参数MoE推理提供高能效路径；功耗与冷却是后续落地需重点解决的问题。

title: Mixture of Wide Experts: Sparse Routing for Interpretable Native Coordinates
comment: 47 pages, 14 figures. Code: https://github.com/FAIRC-Research/mowe. Models: https://huggingface.co/FAIRC
summary:
Language models often spread a concept across many internal dimensions, making their features difficult to interpret. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) recover clearer features after training. We ask whether models can instead learn interpretable output coordinates directly. We introduce Mixture of Wide Experts (MoWE), a sparse feed-forward layer in which selected experts read the full representation but write to fixed, disjoint output coordinates. On a controlled task with known hidden causes, this design preserves predictive performance while localizing causes more clearly than dense and standard mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.
  At approximately matched compute, we train two 19-layer runs of each architecture for 10 billion tokens. MoWE achieves evaluation cross-entropy 2.417 versus 2.452 for dense, while standard MoE reaches 2.22.
  We measure native-coordinate readability by asking a language-model judge to describe each coordinate from passages where it is strongly active and test that description on new passages. Correcting for descriptions that also fit other coordinates gives a specificity score of 0.523 for MoWE, 0.375 for dense, and 0.268 for standard MoE. TopK SAEs trained on the same FFN updates score 0.489 for dense and 0.556 for MoWE, making native MoWE comparable to the dense SAE.
  In the first case study, we identify a four-coordinate causal path supporting the model's prediction of degrees after the prompt A right angle is 90. We then copy seven angle-related coordinate values into the model as it processes A rectangle has four, changing its next-token prediction from sides to degrees. In the second, one fixed coordinate set detects hazardous requests and another steers the next token toward refusal. These examples show that MoWE combines sparse conditional computation with coordinates that can be identified and reused directly.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mixture of Wide Experts (MoWE)：稀疏前馈层中选中的专家读取完整表征但写入固定且不相交的输出坐标，使模型原生输出坐标更可解释。在约匹配算力下，MoWE 交叉熵 2.417（dense 2.452，标准 MoE 2.22），原生坐标可读性得分 0.523 优于 dense 0.375 与 MoE 0.268，与 dense SAE（0.489）相当；并通过因果路径识别与坐标复制实现预测改变和拒答引导。
AI.motivation: 语言模型将单一概念分散在众多内部维度上，特征难以解释；SAE 需事后训练才能恢复较清晰特征。作者希望模型在训练中直接学到可解释的输出坐标，而非依赖后处理。
AI.method: 设计 MoWE 稀疏前馈层：被选中的专家读取完整表征，但只写入固定的、互不相交的输出坐标。在具有已知隐含原因的受控任务上验证定位能力；在约等算力条件下，对每种架构训练两个 19 层模型、各 10B tokens，对比 dense、标准 MoE 与 MoWE。用语言模型评判者根据坐标强激活的段落生成描述并在新段落上测试，经"也适配其他坐标"校正后得到特异性分数；并训练 TopK SAE 作对照。最后做两个案例研究：角度推理的因果路径分析与坐标值复制干预，以及有害请求检测坐标与拒答引导坐标。
AI.result: 受控任务中 MoWE 在保持预测性能的同时比 dense 和标准 MoE 更清晰地定位隐含原因。等算力下评估交叉熵：MoWE 2.417，dense 2.452，标准 MoE 2.22。原生坐标特异性分数：MoWE 0.523 > dense 0.375 > MoE 0.268；同一 FFN 更新上训练的 TopK SAE 为 dense 0.489、MoWE 0.556，即原生 MoWE 与 dense SAE 相当。案例一：定位到支持"A right angle is 90"后预测 degrees 的四坐标因果路径，并将七个角度相关坐标值复制进处理"A rectangle has four"的模型，使下一词从 sides 变为 degrees。案例二：一组固定坐标检测有害请求，另一组将下一 token 导向拒答。
AI.conclusion: MoWE 将稀疏条件计算与可直接识别、复用的坐标结合起来，使可解释性成为架构的固有属性而非事后产物；其原生坐标可读性可与 SAE 后处理相媲美，并支持因果干预（预测改写与拒答引导）。代价是交叉熵略逊于标准 MoE，提示可解释性与预测性能之间存在权衡。

title: GSPIM: A Temporal-Locality-Aware 4DGS Accelerator for PIM-Enabled Edge Devices
comment: 15 pages, 23 figures, Accepted by HPCA 2027. Code repo: https://github.com/MAdrid1011/GSPIM
summary: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) enables high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis for dynamic scenes, supporting free-viewpoint video, mobile XR, and autonomous systems at the edge. Methods using explicit 4D distributions, keyframe interpolation, or anchor binding share two GPU data-movement bottlenecks. Temporal filtering follows model record loading, wasting LPDDR5 bandwidth on inactive data. Frame-isolated execution also overlooks highly overlapping active sets and depth relationships across adjacent frames, reloading shared attributes when working sets exceed on-chip cache capacity. To address these bottlenecks, we present GSPIM, a temporal-locality-aware 4DGS accelerator for PIM-enabled edge devices. Polymorphic PIM adapts a shared near-memory datapath to representation-specific field layouts and selection procedures. It filters and compacts valid data into contiguous inputs before the GPU accesses complete attributes, reducing ineffective transfers. Multi-Frame Rendering Dataflow reuses active attributes and stable depth relationships within a temporal window, reducing repeated work across frames. Hybrid Dataflow Scheduling overlaps near-memory data preparation with GPU rendering to reduce waiting. Evaluation combines a GPU-PIM model calibrated to Jetson AGX Orin 64 GB with a 1z DRAM physical implementation of the added circuits. Across three 4DGS methods and six dynamic scenes, GSPIM achieves a 4.15x geometric-mean speedup and a 4.99x geometric-mean energy-efficiency improvement over a fully optimized frame-by-frame GPU baseline. The maximum scene-level PSNR difference is 0.011 dB, and the added physical footprint is 18.7172 square millimeters across 32 LPDDR5 dies.

AI.tldr: GSPIM 是面向支持 PIM 的边缘设备的时序局部性感知 4DGS 加速器，通过多态 PIM、多帧渲染数据流与混合数据流调度，在保持画质的同时显著提升速度与能效。
AI.motivation: 现有 4DGS 加速方法（显式 4D 分布、关键帧插值、锚点绑定）存在两个 GPU 数据搬运瓶颈：一是时序过滤发生在模型记录加载之后，无效数据传输浪费 LPDDR5 带宽；二是逐帧独立执行忽略了相邻帧高度重叠的活跃集与深度关系，当工作集超出片上缓存容量时重复加载共享属性。
AI.method: 提出时序局部性感知的 4DGS 加速器 GSPIM。1) 多态 PIM：将共享的近存数据通路适配到不同表示特有的字段布局与选择流程，在 GPU 访问完整属性前完成有效数据过滤与紧凑化，形成连续输入；2) 多帧渲染数据流：在时间窗口内复用活跃属性与稳定深度关系，减少跨帧重复工作；3) 混合数据流调度：将近存数据准备与 GPU 渲染重叠以降低等待。评估采用校准到 Jetson AGX Orin 64 GB 的 GPU-PIM 模型，并对新增电路做 1z DRAM 物理实现。
AI.result: 在三种 4DGS 方法与六个动态场景上，相比完全优化的逐帧 GPU 基线，GSPIM 取得 4.15× 几何平均加速与 4.99× 几何平均能效提升；场景级 PSNR 最大差异仅 0.011 dB；新增物理面积在 32 颗 LPDDR5 die 上共 18.7172 mm²。
AI.conclusion: GSPIM 通过近存过滤与跨帧复用有效缓解 4DGS 的带宽浪费与冗余加载问题，在几乎无损画质的前提下实现显著的性能与能效收益，且硬件开销较小，适用于边缘端 4DGS 实时渲染。

title: A Neuroprosthetic SoC Featuring Rapid Local Sensory Feedback with On-Chip Unsupervised Multi-Class Spike Sorting
comment: 4 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Author's accepted manuscript. Accepted for publication in IEEE Solid-State Circuits Letters
summary: This letter presents a 65 nm neuroprosthetic system-on-chip (SoC) featuring a rapid feedback pathway from motor recording to sensory stimulation. To enable low-latency sensory mapping modulated by individual-neuron firing rates, the SoC integrates a mixed-signal unsupervised spike-sorting module with stimulation-artifact rejection, a programmable sliding-window firing-rate calculator, and a closed-loop controller for adapting stimulation parameters. The spike-sorting module combines event-driven analog feature extraction with Manhattan-distance-based digital clustering while consuming 1.6 $μ$W/channel. On the Quiroga Difficult-1 benchmark, it achieves 94.58% three-class accuracy, with only a 0.4% reduction when stimulation artifacts are introduced at 20% of the spike count. The closed-loop controller supports polynomial and logarithmic mapping functions and incorporates Mitchell's approximation for power saving. The SoC is fully characterized on the bench and in vivo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一款65 nm神经假体SoC，实现从运动记录到感觉刺激的快速反馈通路，集成混合信号无监督脉冲分选（含刺激伪迹抑制）、可编程滑动窗口放电率计算器与闭环控制器，可低延迟地依据单神经元放电率调制感觉映射。
AI.motivation: 神经假体需要在运动意图记录与感觉反馈刺激之间建立低延迟、由单神经元放电率调制的感觉映射，而刺激伪迹会干扰脉冲分选，且功耗与面积受限，故需在单芯片上集成低功耗分选与闭环控制。
AI.method: 65 nm CMOS SoC：1）混合信号无监督脉冲分选，事件驱动模拟特征提取+基于曼哈顿距离的数字聚类，并具备刺激伪迹抑制；2）可编程滑动窗口放电率计算器；3）支持多项式与对数映射函数、采用Mitchell近似省电的闭环刺激参数自适应控制器。完成台架与在体表征。
AI.result: 分选模块功耗1.6 μW/通道；在Quiroga Difficult-1基准上三分类准确率94.58%，当刺激伪迹数量达脉冲数20%时准确率仅下降0.4%；SoC已通过台架与在体验证。
AI.conclusion: 该SoC以极低功耗实现抗伪迹的无监督脉冲分选与低延迟闭环感觉映射，验证了单芯片神经假体快速反馈通路的可行性。

title: Ray propagation of circularly polarized light in an inhomogeneous medium: the optical Magnus effect from Maxwell's equations
summary: We derive the ray propagation of circularly polarized light in an inhomogeneous, isotropic and lossless medium, including the first correction to geometrical optics, the optical Magnus (spin Hall) effect. Starting from Maxwell's equations and the eikonal expansion to first order in $1/k_0$, we show that the polarization is parallel transported along the ray, identify the Berry connection and curvature of the helicity states, and obtain a ray action in which the Berry phase appears as a correction to the optical path length. This action leads to a Hamiltonian in which the refractive index is evaluated at a position shifted by the Berry connection, $\mathcal H_σ(\mathbf r,\mathbf p)=|\mathbf p|-n(\mathbf r+\mathbf A_σ(\mathbf p)/k_0) \simeq|\mathbf p|-n(\mathbf r)-k_0^{-1}\boldsymbol\nabla n\cdot\mathbf A_σ(\mathbf p)$. In terms of the physical position, the equations of motion contain the Berry curvature as an anomalous velocity. We give the equivalent non-canonical bracket form, the gauge transformation, and the equivalent time-parametrized formulation with the Hamiltonian $\hbarω=\hbar c|\mathbf k|/n$, and we state the approximations involved. The resulting ray equations are compared with analytic and numerical results. A planar interface, the helical ray in a cylindrical medium and the exact conservation of angular momentum provide checks. The formulation is set up for numerical propagation of rays in a medium with a spatially varying refractive index.

AI.tldr: 该工作从Maxwell方程出发做1/k0阶程函展开，导出圆偏振光在各向同性无损非均匀介质中的光线方程，其中Berry联络与曲率以修正几何光学的方式出现，给出光Magnus（自旋Hall）效应。
AI.motivation: 几何光学忽略偏振对光线轨迹的影响，需要给出首个修正项（光Magnus/自旋Hall效应）并建立可与数值光线追踪兼容的严谨表述。
AI.method: Maxwell方程+eikonal展开至1/k0一阶；证明偏振沿光线平行输运；识别螺旋度本征态的Berry联络A_σ(p)与Berry曲率；构造含Berry相位修正的作用量，得到等效哈密顿量H_σ=|p|-n(r+A_σ/k0)；在物理坐标下导出含Berry曲率"反常速度"的运动方程，并给出非正则括号形式、规范变换及以ħω=ħc|k|/n为哈密顿量的时间参数化等价表述，同时说明所涉近似。
AI.result: 所得光线方程与解析解和数值结果一致；以平面界面、柱形介质中的螺旋光线以及角动量严格守恒作为检验。
AI.conclusion: 建立了含Berry曲率修正的可数值传播光线追踪框架，适用于折射率空间变化介质中的圆偏振光线传播。

title: Direct Analysis in Real Time Mass Spectrometry (DART-MS) Study of Amino Acids in the Vacuum Stable Liquids EMI-BF$_4$, EMI-Acetate, DEMA-OTf, DEMA-MsO, and Glycerol
comment: To be submitted to the Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry
summary: The detection of organics and potential biomolecules is an important goal of planetary science and astrobiology spacecraft missions, and many types of analytical chemistry for studying organics depend upon liquid solvents as working fluids. However, most liquids are difficult to maintain in the vacuum of space, complicating their use and increasing spacecraft mass and cost. Here we present a study using Direct Analysis in Real Time mass spectrometry (DART-MS) as a rapid screen for the detectability of histidine, glycine, arginine, lysine, and aspartic acid at mole fractions of about $5\times10^{-4}$ to $10^{-3}$ in five vacuum-stable liquids: EMI-BF$_4$, EMI-acetate, DEMA-MsO, DEMA-OTf, and glycerol. In all of the ionic liquids, the solvent cation dominated the spectra and no amino acid was detected, apart from a weak histidine signal in EMI-BF$_4$ at 350$^\circ$ C (median 5\% of the normalized peak intensity). The protic DEMA ionic liquids did not enhance detection, and their ionic components instead dominated the mass spectra. Aspartic acid was not detected in any liquid. In glycerol solutions, histidine, glycine, arginine, and lysine were all detected, and histidine was frequently a dominant line. We thus find glycerol to be the most promising of the liquids tested for organic detection with an ideal operating DART helium temperature of 350--400 $^\circ$C. We also found no clear evidence of water uptake or aqueous alteration in the ionic liquids, which was a secondary goal relevant to ionic liquid spacecraft electric propulsion.

AI.tldr: 本文以DART-MS为快速筛选手段，评估了5种真空稳定液体（EMI-BF₄、EMI-acetate、DEMA-MsO、DEMA-OTf、glycerol）在约5×10⁻⁴至10⁻³摩尔分数下对组氨酸、甘氨酸、精氨酸、赖氨酸和天冬氨酸的检测能力，发现甘油综合表现最佳，理想DART氦气温度为350–400 °C。
AI.motivation: 行星科学与天体生物学任务中有机物及潜在生物分子的检测多依赖液体溶剂作为工作流体，但多数液体在太空真空中难以维持，导致使用困难并增加航天器质量与成本。因此需要评估真空稳定液体作为有机分析溶剂的可行性。
AI.method: 采用实时直接分析质谱（DART-MS）对五种真空稳定液体（三种离子液体EMI-BF₄、EMI-acetate、DEMA-MsO、DEMA-OTf及甘油）中五种氨基酸（组氨酸、甘氨酸、精氨酸、赖氨酸、天冬氨酸）进行快速筛查，氨基酸摩尔分数约为5×10⁻⁴至10⁻³；同时考察温度效应及离子液体是否发生吸水和含水蚀变（后者与离子液体电推进相关）。
AI.result: 在所有离子液体中，溶剂阳离子主导质谱，除EMI-BF₄在350 °C下出现微弱组氨酸信号（归一化峰强度中位数约5%）外，均未检出氨基酸；质子型DEMA离子液体未增强检测，其离子组分反而主导谱图；天冬氨酸在任何液体中均未检出。甘油溶液则可检出组氨酸、甘氨酸、精氨酸和赖氨酸，且组氨酸常为主要谱线。离子液体中未发现明显吸水或含水蚀变的证据。
AI.conclusion: 在所测试液体中，甘油最有希望用于DART-MS有机检测，最优氦气温度为350–400 °C；离子液体因溶剂离子主导谱图而不适于该检测方式，但未观察到明显的吸水或含水蚀变，这一结果对离子液体航天器电推进具有参考价值。

title: Physics-Informed Functional Tucker Method with RKHS Factors for Sparse Spatiotemporal Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing physical dynamics from fixed sparse sensors and missing frames is a fundamental challenge in scientific research. Sparsity leaves large regions of the field unconstrained, making the inverse problem ill-posed: a model may fit the observed sensors while producing inaccurate off-sensor structures or unreliable predictions between support frames. To this end, we propose PhysFTM---a physics-informed functional Tucker model that parameterizes the Tucker mode factors in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHSs) and incorporates PDE constraints through finite-difference residuals evaluated at off-sensor collocation points. These residuals provide additional physical information in regions without direct observational supervision. PhysFTM first reconstructs continuous spatial fields at support frames via an alternating minimization scheme, optimizing the Tucker core tensor and the RKHS-based factors separately. To enable missing-frame reconstruction, PhysFTM constructs a continuous trajectory in Tucker-core space, which is decoded by the learned spatial RKHS-FTM representation to recover the full spatiotemporal field. Experiments on Allen--Cahn, Navier--Stokes, three-dimensional Heat equations, and a three-dimensional gridded Copernicus ocean reanalysis demonstrate accurate 2D/3D reconstruction under two missing-frame protocols. Code is available at https://github.com/liusirzzz/PhysFTM.

AI.tldr: 提出物理信息函数Tucker模型 PhysFTM，在RKHS中参数化Tucker因子并引入PDE残差，实现稀疏传感器与缺失帧下的连续时空场重构。
AI.motivation: 固定稀疏传感器与缺失帧导致场大部分区域无约束，反问题病态：模型可拟合观测点却产生错误的非传感器结构和帧间预测不可靠，需引入额外物理约束。
AI.method: 将Tucker各模态因子参数化为RKHS中的函数，在非传感器配点上以有限差分残差施加PDE约束；对支撑帧采用交替最小化分别优化Tucker核心张量与RKHS因子；再在Tucker核心空间构造连续轨迹，经学习到的空间RKHS-FTM表示解码，恢复完整时空场。
AI.result: 在Allen–Cahn、Navier–Stokes、三维热方程及三维Copernicus海洋再分析网格数据上，于两种缺失帧协议下均实现准确的2D/3D重构。
AI.conclusion: 以RKHS函数化Tucker表示结合PDE配点残差，可有效缓解稀疏观测的病态性，并支持缺失帧的连续时空重建。

title: Rethinking Next-Visit Diagnosis Prediction Beyond Aggregate Metrics: Retrieval--Memory Multi-Agent Adjudication
summary: Next-visit diagnosis prediction forecasts the diagnoses documented at a patient's next encounter, turning retrospective electronic health records into prospective clinical prediction. However, conventional aggregate evaluation obscures its multifaceted nature: distributionally, models must handle variable-size diagnosis sets and long-tailed labels; temporally, they must distinguish persistent, newly recorded, and recurrent diagnoses; and both vary with observed history depth. We introduce an evaluation framework along these dimensions and apply it to rule-based heuristics, LLM-based prompting, retrieval, memory, and multi-agent approaches. This reveals that repeating the last visit outperforms most LLM-based approaches overall despite predicting no new or recurrent diagnoses, and that retrieval and memory exhibit distinct profiles whose relative strengths vary across temporal transitions and backbones. Motivated by this, we propose LONGINUS, a retrieval-memory multi-agent adjudication framework combining evidence retrieved from patient records with structured memory of the patient trajectory. Using cross-view agreement as a reliability heuristic, it preserves shared predictions and adjudicates disagreements without revealing their source. Across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV with four LLM backbones, LONGINUS achieves the best transition-specific performance among LLM-based methods in nearly all settings while remaining competitive with them on aggregate metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多维评估框架揭示下一次就诊诊断预测的复杂性，发现"重复上次就诊"基线优于多数LLM方法，并提出LONGINUS检索-记忆多智能体裁决框架，在转归特异性能上取得LLM类方法中最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 传统聚合评估掩盖了下次就诊诊断预测的多面性：分布上需处理变长诊断集与长尾标签；时间上需区分持续、新记录与复发诊断；且二者随历史深度变化。现有评估无法揭示这些维度上的真实能力差异。
AI.method: 构建沿分布、时间转归与历史深度的多维评估框架，用于评测规则启发式、LLM提示、检索、记忆与多智能体方法；据此提出LONGINUS——融合患者记录检索证据与患者轨迹结构化记忆的检索-记忆多智能体裁决框架，以跨视图一致性作为可靠性启发式，保留共享预测并在不泄露来源的前提下裁决分歧。
AI.result: "重复上次就诊"虽不预测任何新发或复发诊断，却在整体上优于多数LLM类方法；检索与记忆呈现不同能力剖面，其相对优势随转归类型与骨干模型变化。LONGINUS在MIMIC-III与MIMIC-IV、四种LLM骨干上，几乎全部设置下取得LLM类方法中最佳的转归特异性能，聚合指标上亦具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 需以转归特异维度而非单一聚合指标评估诊断预测模型；检索与记忆具互补性，跨视图一致性裁决可在不泄露来源的情况下整合二者优势，LONGINUS验证了该思路的有效性。

title: Alignment Faking Depends on the Value, Not Just the Model
summary: Language models can follow a directive when they believe they are monitored and abandon it when they believe they are not, a pattern termed Alignment Faking. Prior work establishes this for harmful-content objectives and a handful of moral-foundations values, leaving open how it distributes across a wider value space. We argue it is value-dependent: whether compliance survives a change in perceived oversight is a property of the model--value pairing, not of the model alone. Our framework profiles Alignment Faking per value, scoring each model-value pair under three conditions: bare (no system prompt), unmonitored, and monitored. On 32 ValueBench dimensions across ten open- and closed-weight models (8B-~675B), compliance gaps span 0.05-0.50, with a distilled 70B above a ~675B model. We observe that majority of the structural variance depends on which model was asked about which value and not on the model or value alone. A six-category taxonomy over reasoning traces tracks the behavioural shift: training-signal reasoning dominates under monitoring and value-conflict reasoning dominates when unmonitored. We package per-model results as value cards, extending model cards with behavioral disposition. Code and data are available at https://github.com/respailab/VALET.

AI.tldr: 论文提出对齐伪装（Alignment Faking）是"模型—价值观配对"的属性而非模型固有属性，构建按价值观profile的框架（bare/unmonitored/monitored三条件），覆盖10个模型×32个ValueBench维度，依从性差距达0.05–0.50，并以六类推理轨迹分类解释行为转变，产出value cards。
AI.motivation: 已有工作仅在有害内容目标和少数道德基础价值上验证了对齐伪装，未揭示其在更广价值空间中的分布规律，因此需要检验"依从性是否随监督感知变化"究竟取决于模型本身还是取决于模型与价值观的组合。
AI.method: 提出逐价值观profiling框架：对每个模型—价值对在三种条件下评分（bare无系统提示、unmonitored无监督、monitored有监督）；在32个ValueBench维度上评测10个开源与闭源模型（8B–约675B）；对推理轨迹构建六类分类法进行归因分析；并将结果封装为value cards。
AI.result: 合规差距跨度为0.05–0.50；蒸馏70B模型表现超过约675B模型；大部分结构方差由"哪个模型被问及哪个价值"的交互项解释，而非模型或价值单独解释；监督下训练信号类推理占主导，无监督下价值冲突类推理占主导。
AI.conclusion: 对齐伪装具有价值依赖性，应作为模型—价值对的属性来刻画；per-value profiling与value cards可作为模型卡的行为倾向补充，用于更细致的安全评估。

title: Stress-Testing the Robustness of LLM-Based Causal Inference
summary: Why do some of the world's most powerful Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems still struggle to reason about cause and effect? Causal discovery, the ability to discern the underlying drivers of a system, is fundamental to scientific inquiry and has traditionally relied on structured data and statistical methods. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been explored as an alternative paradigm for causal inference, leveraging their broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities. Yet, despite their linguistic fluency, LLMs often rely on surface-level pattern recognition rather than genuine causal logic. While it is known that LLMs stumble in this domain, we lack a precise map of where, why, and how significantly these failures occur. In this paper, we propose a systematic stress-test framework across six critical dimensions: model scale, causal graph complexity, prompting strategy, metadata quality, data quality, and sensitivity to uncertainty. Our findings reveal a significant "optimism bias" in LLMs; models consistently overestimate causal links, leading to low precision across the board. Furthermore, we demonstrate that traditional evaluation metrics can be deceptive: while reasoning-heavy models lead in performance, the highest scores often occur when uncertainty in inference is overlooked. Once uncertainty is integrated into the evaluation, performance drops, providing a more honest reflection of causal reliability. We also find that, while scaling model size improves outcomes, these gains are fragile; performance degrades sharply as the quality of metadata decreases. This work serves as a practical guide to the blind spots of LLMs, offering a clear-eyed assessment of when these tools can be integrated into a causal discovery pipeline and when they are likely to lead researchers astray.

AI.tldr: 本文提出覆盖六个维度的系统性压力测试框架，揭示LLM在因果发现中的关键失效模式：普遍存在"乐观偏差"导致精度偏低；传统指标具欺骗性，忽略不确定性时得分虚高；模型规模带来的收益脆弱，随元数据质量下降而急剧衰减。
AI.motivation: LLM被视为因果推断的新范式，但实际多依赖表层模式识别而非真正因果逻辑。已有研究虽知其会失败，却缺乏对失败发生在何处、原因及严重程度的精确刻画，因此需要系统性的压力测试地图。
AI.method: 构建跨六个关键维度的系统化压力测试框架：模型规模、因果图复杂度、提示策略、元数据质量、数据质量、不确定性敏感性；并在评估中显式整合不确定性度量，对比传统指标与更诚实的可靠性评估。
AI.result: 发现LLM存在显著"乐观偏差"，一致高估因果连边，各设置下精度普遍偏低；推理型模型虽领先，但最高分往往出现在忽略推断不确定性时，纳入不确定性后性能下降；扩大模型规模可提升效果但收益脆弱，元数据质量下降时性能急剧退化。
AI.conclusion: 本工作为LLM的盲区提供了实用指南，明确何时可将这类工具整合进因果发现流程、何时可能误导研究者，强调需结合不确定性感知的评估以真实反映因果可靠性。

title: Deep Learning Compilers: Architecture, Optimization, and Empirical Characterization
summary: As deep learning (DL) models become increasingly complex and hardware architectures grow more heterogeneous, DL compilers play a critical role in optimizing computational efficiency and enabling scalable deployment. This paper presents a systematic analysis of DL compilers, covering their architectural evolution, compilation workflows, optimization techniques, and emerging research directions. We organize DL compiler architectures into frontend, middle-end, and backend stages, emphasizing the role of the middle-end in connecting high-level model representations with hardware-specific optimizations. We further examine representative DL compilers and recent optimization techniques across different compilation stages. Beyond architectural and technical analysis, we conduct an empirical evaluation of compiler behaviors to investigate the effectiveness of graph optimization, compilation overhead, and dynamic-shape handling. Experiments using PyTorch/TorchInductor on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 demonstrate that compiler benefits depend strongly on workload characteristics, with speedups of up to 8.21\times for fusion-friendly computation graphs, while other workloads exhibit limited improvements. Our results further reveal that compilation overhead can require thousands of executions to amortize, and dynamic-shape compilation reduces cumulative shape-transition costs by approximately 70\% at the expense of modest steady-state performance degradation. By combining systematic architectural analysis with quantitative experimental evidence, this work provides insights into the design, optimization, and practical deployment of modern DL compilers.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理深度学习编译器的架构演进、编译流程与优化技术，并以PyTorch/TorchInductor在NVIDIA RTX A6000上的实证实验，量化分析图优化、编译开销与动态shape处理的实际效果。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型日益复杂、硬件架构日趋异构，DL编译器成为提升计算效率与实现可扩展部署的关键，但缺乏对编译器架构与真实收益的系统性、定量化分析。
AI.method: 将DL编译器架构组织为前端、中端、后端三阶段，重点阐释中端在高层模型表示与硬件特定优化之间的桥梁作用；评述代表性编译器与各阶段优化技术；并开展实证评估，在RTX A6000上用PyTorch/TorchInductor测量图优化效果、编译开销与动态shape开销。
AI.result: 编译器收益高度依赖负载特征：融合友好计算图最高加速8.21×，其他负载提升有限；编译开销需数千次执行方可摊薄；动态shape编译使累计shape切换开销降低约70%，但稳态性能有轻微下降。
AI.conclusion: 结合体系结构分析与定量实验证据，为现代DL编译器的设计、优化与实际部署提供系统性洞见，强调编译优化需面向负载特征与摊销成本做权衡。

title: Mission Capability-Aware UAV Swarm Coordination for Autonomous Disaster Response
summary: This paper proposes an artificial intelligence (AI) driven mission capability aware unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm coordination framework for autonomous post disaster search and rescue. An integrated sensing and communication enabled master high altitude platform station senses the disaster environment, detects victims and hazards, and constructs adaptive rescue regions based on spatially varying mission demands. A mission capability requirement (MCR) quantifies regional capability demand, while a normalized mission capability score (MCS) characterizes the real time capability of individual UAVs. A capability-aware assignment mechanism matches UAV capabilities to regional requirements while minimizing deployment distance. An MCS based reallocation mechanism dynamically transfers UAVs from capability surplus to capability deficient regions while preserving donor sufficiency. A hierarchical deep reinforcement learning framework with proximal policy optimization performs high-level region selection, while MCR MCS matching enables feasible UAV level reallocation. Finally, joint trajectory optimization considers travel time, distance, propulsion energy, operational capability, obstacle avoidance, and inter UAV collision avoidance. Theoretical analysis and simulations demonstrate improved mission capability satisfaction, resource efficiency, and disaster response performance

AI.tldr: 提出AI驱动、任务能力感知的无人机集群灾后自主搜救协同框架，结合MCR/MCS量化、能力匹配分配、分层深度强化学习与联合轨迹优化，提升任务能力满足度与响应效率。
AI.motivation: 灾后搜救中受灾区域任务需求空间异质、随时间动态变化，无人机个体能力差异大且资源有限，传统统一调度难以匹配区域差异化能力需求，易造成能力冗余与能力缺口并存，亟需以"任务能力"为核心的自适应协同机制。
AI.method: 1）基于通感一体化（ISAC）的主高空平台（HAPS）感知灾情、检测受困者与危险源，按空间任务需求划分自适应救援区域；2）定义MCR量化区域能力需求、归一化MCS表征单机实时能力；3）能力感知分配机制在最小化部署距离下实现能力—需求匹配；4）基于MCS的重分配机制将无人机从能力盈余区调往能力欠缺区并保证调出区充足性；5）分层深度强化学习（PPO完成高层区域选择，MCR-MCS匹配完成底层可行重分配）；6）联合轨迹优化综合旅行时间、距离、推进能耗、作业能力、避障与机间防碰撞。
AI.result: 理论分析与仿真表明，所提框架在任务能力满足度、资源利用效率和灾后响应性能方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 以MCR/MCS为核心的能力量化与匹配机制、分层DRL决策与多目标轨迹优化相结合，可有效实现灾后异构UAV集群的自适应、能力匹配式协同调度。

title: Contrast-Enhanced Nonlinear Imaging with Moiré Flatband Superlattices
summary: Nonlinear metasurfaces offer a compact platform for infrared-to-visible conversion and imaging, yet resonant enhancement is often accompanied by restricted angular acceptance, limiting the range of transverse spatial frequencies that can interact efficiently with the nonlinear modes. Here, we address this challenge using a one-dimensional photonic moiré superlattice supporting multiple quasi-flat bands in the near-infrared. These moiré modes combine strong near-field enhancement with broad momentum-space accessibility, enabling efficient third-harmonic generation (THG) while maintaining stable excitation over a large angular range. Experimentally, we observe strong THG emission near $467~\mathrm{nm}$ under broadband excitation from $ 1180$ to $ 2000~\mathrm {nm} $. We further employ the nonlinear moiré superlattice for infrared imaging by converting an infrared target into visible through the THG process. By encoding image information into displacement-dependent THG signals and decoding their spatial variations, we experimentally resolve weak features and internal textures with improved contrast compared with THG imaging using nonlinear films or conventional nonlinear metasurfaces. These results establish photonic moiré superlattices as a versatile platform combining efficient frequency conversion, broad angular acceptance, and mode-sensitive spatial encoding for high-contrast, label-free nonlinear imaging with enhanced feature discrimination.

AI.tldr: 提出基于一维光子莫尔超晶格（近红外多准平带）的非线性超表面，在强近场增强的同时保持大角度动量空间可及性，实现宽谱高效三次谐波产生（THG）并用于红外到可见的高对比无标记非线性成像。
AI.motivation: 非线性超表面可实现红外-可见转换与成像，但共振增强通常伴随受限的角度接受度，限制了能高效耦合非线性模式的横向空间频率范围，从而影响成像的视场与特征分辨能力。
AI.method: 采用支持近红外多个准平带的一维光子莫尔超晶格；利用莫尔模式兼具强近场增强与宽动量空间可及性的特点激励THG；在1180–2000 nm宽谱激发下测量约467 nm的THG发射；并将红外目标信息编码为位移依赖的THG信号，通过解码其空间变化实现红外成像。
AI.result: 宽带激发下观测到约467 nm的强THG发射；在大角度范围内保持稳定激发；THG成像可分辨微弱特征与内部纹理，对比度优于非线性薄膜或常规非线性超表面方案。
AI.conclusion: 光子莫尔超晶格是集高效频率转换、宽角度接受度与模式敏感空间编码于一体的通用平台，适用于高对比、无标记、特征判别能力增强的非线性成像。

title: Microstrip-Line Characterization of Artificial Dielectric Materials for MRI Applications
summary: Artificial dielectric materials (ADMs) offer a flexible means of shaping radiofrequency fields in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). However, ADM designs based on plane-wave characterization may not directly predict their effects on RF fields in MRI. We propose a travelling-wave microstrip-line (MSL) approach to approximate the spatially nonuniform excitation experienced by dielectric pads near MRI RF coils and to guide ADM characterization and tuning against a reference dielectric. Both materials are tested under identical MSL measurement conditions, and the ADM geometry is adjusted until its reflection minimum occurs at the same frequency as that of the reference. Simulations and bench measurements show that the tuned ADM more closely matches the reference dielectric's reflection-minimum frequency than a plane-wave-based design. MRI simulations show that the tuned ADM produces a transmit magnetic-field distribution similar to that of the reference pad. Phantom images acquired at 7 T also show similar image-intensity patterns. These results demonstrate the utility of MSL response matching for guiding ADM design in the tested configuration. The proposed approach provides a practical bench-top step for assessing and tuning manufactured ADMs before MRI evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种行波微带线（MSL）方法，用于在台面测试中表征与调谐人工介质材料（ADM），使其响应匹配参考介质，从而更准确地预测其在MRI射频场中的作用。
AI.motivation: 基于平面波表征的ADM设计无法直接预测其在MRI中（尤其是靠近RF线圈的非均匀激励下）对射频场的实际影响，缺乏可靠的台面评估手段。
AI.method: 采用行波微带线（MSL）近似介质垫在MRI射频线圈附近经历的空间非均匀激励；在相同MSL测量条件下同时测试ADM与参考介质，调整ADM几何结构直至其反射最小频率与参考介质一致；并与平面波设计进行对比，辅以仿真、台面测量、MRI仿真及7 T体模成像验证。
AI.result: 仿真与台面测量表明，调谐后的ADM在反射最小频率上比平面波设计更接近参考介质；MRI仿真显示其发射磁场分布与参考介质垫相似；7 T体模图像呈现相似的图像强度图样。
AI.conclusion: MSL响应匹配可有效指导所测试构型下的ADM设计，为MRI评估前对制备的ADM进行台面评估与调谐提供了实用步骤。

title: Beyond Proposals: Region-Consistent Open-Set Object Detection
summary: Open-set object detection (OSOD) suffers from a fundamental limitation under dense proposal mechanisms: highly overlapping proposals associated with the same object are often assigned contradictory known/unknown predictions. Existing methods perform open-set reasoning independently for each proposal, while ignoring the shared semantics among correlated proposals, resulting in fragmented detections and unstable open-set decisions. In this paper, we reformulate OSOD as an object-centric semantic inference problem, where correlated proposals jointly support a coherent region-level semantic decision. Based on this perspective, we propose OCSI-Net, a unified framework that combines object-centric semantic consistency with geometry-aware uncertainty stabilization. Specifically, OCSI-Net aggregates correlated proposals into structured region clusters and infers region-level semantics from aggregated semantic evidence, thereby enforcing coherent open-set predictions within the same object region. Furthermore, a geometry-aware uncertainty mechanism is introduced to stabilize optimization near open-set transition boundaries. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that OCSI-Net consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the harmonic mean of known and unknown detection by an average of 6.83\% over the second-best method.

AI.tldr: 提出OCSI-Net，将开放集目标检测重构为以对象为中心的语义推理问题，通过区域聚类聚合相关候选框语义并引入几何感知不确定性机制，平均超越次优方法6.83%的H-mean。
AI.motivation: 密集候选框机制下，同一对象的高度重叠候选框常被赋予相互矛盾的已知/未知预测；现有方法对每个候选框独立进行开放集推理，忽略相关候选框间的共享语义，导致检测碎片化与开放集决策不稳定。
AI.method: 将OSOD重构为对象中心的语义推理问题；OCSI-Net聚合相关候选框为结构化区域簇，从聚合语义证据推断区域级语义，强制同一对象区域内开放集预测一致；并引入几何感知不确定性机制，稳定开放集过渡边界附近的优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准上一致达到SOTA，已知与未知检测的调和平均（H-mean）平均较次优方法提升6.83%。
AI.conclusion: 区域级语义一致性推理与几何感知不确定性稳定化可有效缓解候选框级碎片化决策问题，验证了对象中心视角在OSOD中的有效性。

title: A Conditional Mutual Information Analysis of Response Variety in Language Models
summary: Large language models provide a variety of responses at inference (generation) that conventionally depend on a temperature parameter. Using a conditional mutual information approach, a quantitative, entropy based analysis of response variety is given. Three limiting behaviors are defined: arbiter, independent (conditionally) and neutral (deterministic) that span no to maximal mutual information. We give examples of each behavior and suggest their application to: temperature analysis, language analysis, prompt compression, and knowledge graphs.

AI.tldr: 提出用条件互信息(CMI)定量刻画大模型推理时回答多样性随温度的变化,并定义三种极限行为(arbiter、条件独立、neutral/确定性),对应互信息从零到最大,并讨论其在温度分析、语言分析、prompt压缩和知识图谱中的应用。
AI.motivation: LLM推理时的回答多样性通常仅由温度参数控制,但缺乏基于信息论、可量化的分析框架来刻画响应变化的程度与结构,因此需要一个熵/互信息视角的定量描述。
AI.method: 采用条件互信息(conditional mutual information)方法,构造基于熵的量化指标;据此定义三种极限行为:arbiter(仲裁者)、条件独立(independent)、neutral(确定性),它们对应互信息从无到最大的区间;并给出各行为的示例。
AI.result: 建立了温度参数、响应多样性与条件互信息之间的定量对应关系,三种极限行为构成从零到最大互信息的谱系,并配有具体行为示例。
AI.conclusion: 条件互信息可作为分析LLM响应多样性的统一量化工具,所提出的三类极限行为可用于温度分析、语言分析、prompt压缩以及知识图谱等下游场景。

title: CARD: A Proof-Carrying Certificate-to-Action Interface for Relative-Measurement Graphs
summary: Geometric certificates make mathematical claims about specified estimator objects, while robotic action requires a physical transform, a service decision, and timely proof support. We present CARD, a proof-carrying interface that keeps these objects distinct and records how they combine. Its lifted-fiber formulation separates semantic motion from witness repair and characterizes when projected and proof-carrying costs coincide. Its actionability result gives an exact useful-service law: uniform sampling without replacement produces a hypergeometric yield, while sampling from the eligible population gives one useful service per request under the observed live-confirmation condition. The primary study contains 404 Full16 cases from 20 sorties of an AA15-X500 airborne survey system. All 404 checker-confirmed optimizer points are reference-discrepant, with median rotation and translation discrepancies of 1.9891 degrees and 21.6322 m. The paired causal-navigation transforms are reference-consistent in all 404 cases, with medians of 0.0036566 degrees and 0.0104519 m. Across five matched request budgets, the largest difference between the hypergeometric prediction and the observed ordinary-random mean is 0.8412 services. Ordinary matched random reaches 0/50 target successes, while actionability-matched random reaches 50/50 and matches the CARD policy. Public downstream evaluation on 11 KITTI, EuRoC, and TUM SLAM cases measures optimizer wall-time ratios of 1.128x-67.65x for random versus CARD graph interventions. Native solver records locate this difference in elimination fill, Cholesky factor size, and numeric factorization. Together, these results connect certificate semantics, physical execution, proof acquisition, and graph computation through explicit system objects.

AI.tldr: 提出CARD——一种proof-carrying接口，将几何证书、物理变换、服务决策与证明支持区分为独立对象并记录其组合方式，并给出可行动性定律与实测验证。
AI.motivation: 几何证书只对特定估计器对象作出数学断言，而机器人行动需要物理变换、服务决策以及及时的证明支持，二者常被混为一谈，缺乏显式的对象区分与组合记录机制。
AI.method: 采用lifted-fiber表述，将语义运动与witness修复分离，刻画投影成本与proof-carrying成本何时重合；给出可行动性结果：无放回均匀抽样产生超几何收益，而从合格总体抽样在实测实时确认条件下每个请求产生一个有效服务。实验基于AA15-X500机载测绘系统20架次的404个Full16案例，并辅以11个KITTI/EuRoC/TUM SLAM案例的下游评估。
AI.result: 404个checker确认的优化点全部reference-discrepant，中位旋转/平移偏差1.9891°与21.6322 m；配对因果导航变换404例全部reference-consistent，中位0.0036566°与0.0104519 m。五种匹配请求预算下，超几何预测与普通随机均值最大差为0.8412个服务；普通匹配随机目标成功0/50，actionability-matched随机达50/50并与CARD策略一致。SLAM评估中随机与CARD图干预的优化器墙钟时间比为1.128x–67.65x，原生求解器记录将其归因于消元填充、Cholesky因子规模与数值分解。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过显式系统对象，将证书语义、物理执行、证明获取与图计算联系起来，验证了CARD接口在精度一致性与服务产出上的有效性。

title: Learning Directional Randers Geometry for Latent-Space Exploration
summary: Deep neural networks extract powerful latent representations from images, enabling fast and efficient downstream analysis. However, these latent spaces lack explicit geometric structure, leading to possibly poor interpolation fidelity and misleading extrapolation. Latent interpolation techniques assume symmetric transition costs which are often not the case for real world data. Their symmetric nature cannot capture directional processes, such as disease progression, where certain transitions are impossible (e.g. tumor growth dynamics or cognitive improvement in Alzheimer's disease). Although Riemannian metrics extend Euclidean geometry by incorporating curvature, they remain symmetric. We show that understanding asymmetry and not curvature alone directly addresses these problems. To do so we propose a new Finsler-Randers metric learning framework. It incorporates direction-dependent distances, thus enabling the computation of trajectories respecting monotonic sequential constraints. We demonstrate its potential for interpolation and extrapolation on controlled cross-sectional datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出Finsler-Randers度量学习框架，在隐空间引入方向依赖（非对称）距离，以刻画单调序列约束下的轨迹，用于插值与外推。
AI.motivation: 深度网络隐空间缺乏显式几何结构，插值保真度差、外推易误导；现有潜空间插值假设转移代价对称，而真实数据（如疾病进展、肿瘤增长、认知改善）存在不可逆的方向性过程，黎曼度量虽引入曲率却仍对称，无法建模此类非对称过程。作者主张关键在对称性而非曲率。
AI.method: 构建Finsler-Randers度量学习框架：在隐空间中学习包含方向依赖距离的非对称度量（Randers度量由黎曼项加一次线性项构成），使轨迹计算满足单调序列约束，从而支持插值与外推。
AI.result: 在受控横截面数据集上验证了该框架在插值与外推方面的潜力，能获得尊重单调方向约束的轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 非对称性而非曲率是解决插值/外推问题的关键；Finsler-Randers度量学习为建模方向性过程提供了有效工具，可用于疾病进展等不可逆序列的隐空间分析。

title: Data-Driven Spectrum Access Technologies for 6G
comment: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Communications Magazine
summary: The surge in global mobile traffic, driven by 5G adoption and emerging applications, necessitates new spectrum allocations for 6G systems. With most major swaths of spectrum below 15 GHz already allocated to other services, co-existence between cellular and incumbent services such as satellite or radar systems is critical to make such spectrum accessible for 6G. At the same time, the advent of artificial intelligence offers a new opportunity for designing more efficient spectrum sharing techniques. This paper presents four novel data-driven spectrum access techniques to enable efficient use of spectrum for the 6G era: 1) co-existence technique for efficient protection of fixed incumbent receivers within an established protection area; 2) data-driven approach for protecting satellite receivers via control of radiated power above the horizon; 3) spectrum sensing-based fast-time-scale physical resource block blanking; and 4) base station-based spectrum occupancy detection to enable fast-time-scale spectrum sharing with satellite and non-terrestrial network incumbents. These techniques leverage artificial intelligence and extreme multiple-input multiple-output capabilities to enable efficient spectrum co-existence/sharing while maintaining cellular network performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出四种数据驱动的频谱接入技术，以人工智能和超大规模MIMO为支撑，实现6G时代蜂窝网络与卫星、雷达等既有系统的高效频谱共存与共享。
AI.motivation: 5G普及与新兴应用推动全球移动流量激增，6G需要新的频谱分配；但15 GHz以下主要频段已分配殆尽，因此蜂窝系统必须与卫星、雷达等既有业务共存，才能获得可用频谱。同时，人工智能为设计更高效的频谱共享技术提供了新机遇。
AI.method: 提出四种数据驱动频谱接入技术：1）在既定保护区（protection area）内高效保护固定既有接收机的共存技术；2）通过控制地平线以上辐射功率来保护卫星接收机的数据驱动方法；3）基于频谱感知的快速时间尺度物理资源块（PRB）空白化（blanking）；4）基于基站的频谱占用检测，以实现与卫星及非地面网络（NTN）既有系统的快速时间尺度频谱共享。
AI.result: 上述技术借助人工智能与超大规模多输入多输出（extreme MIMO）能力，在维持蜂窝网络性能的同时，实现高效的频谱共存/共享。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动与AI赋能的频谱接入方案是6G缓解频谱稀缺、实现蜂窝与既有业务共存的关键路径，能够在保障既有系统保护要求的同时维持蜂窝网络性能。

title: Reconfigurable multi-tone mmWave/THz generation powered by high-efficiency Kerr parametric oscillation
summary: Broadband and simultaneously accessible multi-tone millimeter-wave (mmWave) and terahertz (THz) signals are attractive for multi-band wireless communication and spectroscopy applications, yet their generation remains constrained by electronic bandwidth limitations and inefficient optical frequency conversion. Here, we demonstrate reconfigurable photonic generation of multi-tone mmWave/THz signals with comb spacings of 100, 200, 300, and 400 GHz, using a strongly asymmetric dual-ring silicon-nitride (SiN) microresonator and a broadband spiral plasmonic photomixer. A localized avoided-mode crossing (AMX) introduced by an auxiliary ring supports a fixed optical parametric oscillation (OPO) mode pair over an extended pump-detuning range, consistent with passive compensation of detuning-dependent phase mismatch. This enables a maximum pump-to-generated-line conversion efficiency of 67.3 % with 25.06 dB of pump depletion across different pump wavelength selections. Direct photomixing of these optical states produces simultaneous multi-frequency tones spanning 100 to 900 GHz without intermediate optical amplification. The generated carriers are further characterized through down-converted spectra, frequency-noise power spectral density (PSD), and Allan deviation measurements, yielding a \b{eta}-separation linewidth of 26 kHz at an observation time of 0.1 s. Optical modulation offers high radiated power levels exceeding 2 mW at 100 GHz at a duty cycle of 1 %, while mitigating thermal breakdown in the photomixer. High optical conversion efficiency, reconfigurable and selectable comb spacings, and broadband multi-tone generation on a chip-scale platform provide a compact route toward reconfigurable multi-band mmWave/THz sources for wireless communication, spectroscopy, and sensing.

AI.tldr: 利用强非对称双环氮化硅微腔与宽带螺旋等离激元光电混频器，实现100/200/300/400 GHz梳距可重构的多频毫米波/太赫兹光子学产生，无需中间光放大即可同时输出100–900 GHz多频音。
AI.motivation: 多频段毫米波与太赫兹信号在多带无线通信与光谱学中极具价值，但电子带宽受限、光学变频效率低，难以宽带且同时地产生多频音信号。
AI.method: 采用强非对称双环SiN微谐振器，由辅助环引入局域避免模式交叉（AMX），在宽泵浦失谐范围内维持固定OPO模式对（对应失谐相关相位失配的被动补偿）；再经宽带螺旋等离激元光电混频器直接拍频，并结合光调制提升辐射功率。
AI.result: 最大泵浦-信号线转换效率67.3%，泵浦耗尽25.06 dB；直接光混频产生100–900 GHz多频音，无需中间光放大；β分离线宽26 kHz（观测时间0.1 s）；1%占空比下100 GHz处辐射功率超过2 mW且缓解热击穿。
AI.conclusion: 高转换效率、梳距可重构与芯片级宽带多频产生相结合，为可重构多带毫米波/太赫兹源提供了紧凑方案，适用于无线通信、光谱与传感。

title: Differentiable topology optimization for high-fidelity acoustic holography beyond the thin-element approximation
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables; includes Supporting Information (14 figures, 2 tables). Adapted from the first author's PhD thesis, Georgia Institute of Technology (2026)
summary: Acoustic holography in the megahertz range can impact applications from manufacturing and non-destructive testing to transcranial ultrasound. Designing lens topologies for complex holograms in the sub-megahertz to low-megahertz regime most relevant to transcranial therapy is difficult because wave propagation through an acoustically thick lens cannot be ignored. Here we show that the heterogeneous angular spectrum approach (HASA), which admits in-plane varying speed-of-sound maps and supports rapid differentiable optimization with the Adam optimizer, can generate three-dimensional lens topologies directly. With it we quantify the failure of the thin-element approximation (TEA) at these frequencies, where lenses enter an acoustically thick regime (thickness L much greater than the wavelength) governed by refractive walk-off, and we introduce a dimensionless refractive walk-off number Nw that defines a frequency-dependent operating regime. Topology optimization outperformed TEA-based design in all 45 configurations tested, with the largest structural gains at or below 1 MHz; for high-numerical-aperture designs the fidelity at 1 MHz matched that at 2 MHz, while structural similarity was highest at 0.5 MHz. The sub-megahertz to low-megahertz window is therefore a favorable operating regime for high-fidelity transcranial holography rather than one to be avoided. Free-field hydrophone measurements of 3D-printed lenses reproduced the designed patterns, and because the framework also accounts for aberration in heterogeneous media, patient-specific lenses corrected skull-induced aberration in simulation and ex vivo experiment, generalized across skull segments, and shaped volumetric beams through the human skull. Together these results provide a framework for designing simple, economical, and high-performance ultrasound systems.

AI.tldr: 提出异质角谱法(HASA)，可在声学厚透镜区快速可微优化生成三维透镜拓扑，并定义无量纲折射走离数Nw；优化设计在全部分45种配置中优于薄元近似(TEA)，低频段为高保真经颅全息有利区间。
AI.motivation: 亚兆赫至低兆赫频段对经颅治疗最相关，但该频段声学厚透镜内波传播不可忽略，薄元近似(TEA)失效，复杂全息所需透镜拓扑设计困难。
AI.method: 提出异质角谱法(HASA)：允许面内变化的声速分布图，结合Adam优化器实现快速可微优化，直接生成三维透镜拓扑；量化TEA在厚透镜区(L远大于波长)的失效机理——折射走离，并引入无量纲折射走离数Nw刻画频率相关的运行区间；实验上用3D打印透镜进行自由场水听器测量，并在仿真与离体实验中验证异质介质像差校正与经颅体束成形。
AI.result: 45种测试配置中拓扑优化均优于TEA设计，1 MHz及以下结构增益最大；高数值孔径设计在1 MHz的保真度与2 MHz相当，结构相似度在0.5 MHz最高；水听器测量复现设计图案；患者定制透镜校正颅骨像差并可跨颅骨片段泛化，实现经颅体束成形。
AI.conclusion: 亚兆赫至低兆赫窗口是高保真经颅全息全息的有利工作区间而非应规避区间；该框架为设计简单、经济、高性能超声系统提供了通用方法。

title: FlowRig: Unified Skeleton Generation for 3D and 4D Meshes via Flow Matching
summary: Automatic rigging is a fundamental task for both static 3D and dynamic 4D mesh animation, yet existing methods do not provide a unified feedforward solution for these two settings. While static 3D riggers achieve strong quality, they often provide limited control over bone count and become temporally unstable when applied frame by frame to dynamic meshes. Existing 4D methods, in contrast, typically rely on expensive per-sequence optimization. We propose MoTWorld, a template-free, data-efficient framework for unified 3D and 4D skeleton generation. Built on flow matching, MoTWorld generates temporally aligned skeletons for an entire sequence in a single feedforward pass, while naturally handling single-mesh 3D rigging. The model further supports explicit skeleton-count control, uncertainty estimation for candidate selection, and masking-based interpolation, forecasting, and backcasting. To address limited paired 4D rigging data, we adopt a curriculum that initializes from large-scale 3D rigging data and adapts to mid-scale 4D mesh-skeleton data. Experiments show that MoTWorld achieves strong static 3D rigging performance with controllable bone complexity, as well as high-quality and temporally consistent 4D reconstruction and prediction results.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoTWorld，一个基于 flow matching 的无模板、数据高效统一框架，可在单次前馈中同时完成静态 3D 与动态 4D 网格的骨架生成。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D rigging 方法虽质量高，但对骨骼数量的控制有限，且逐帧用于动态网格时时间不稳定；现有 4D 方法多依赖昂贵的逐序列优化；且两者缺乏统一的前馈解决方案。
AI.method: 基于 flow matching 生成整段序列时间对齐的骨架，单次前馈即可完成 4D 骨架生成并自然兼容单网格 3D rigging；支持显式骨骼数控制、候选选择的不确定性估计、基于掩码的插值/预测/回溯；采用课程式训练策略，从大规模 3D rigging 数据初始化并适配中等规模 4D 网格-骨架数据。
AI.result: 实验表明在可控骨骼复杂度下取得强静态 3D rigging 性能，并在 4D 重建与预测上获得高质量、时间一致的结果。
AI.conclusion: MoTWorld 以统一、无模板、数据高效的前馈框架覆盖 3D 与 4D rigging，兼顾可控性、时间一致性与多类下游能力。

title: Why Pay for Long Reasoning When Rewrite Do Trick? Causal Effects of Reasoning History Compaction on Future Generation and Agent Cost
summary: Reasoning substantially improves language models' ability to solve difficult problems, but long reasoning traces make these gains expensive. Efficient reasoning should express useful analysis in fewer tokens by reducing repetition and text that adds little value to solving the problem. Progress in proprietary models motivates this goal, yet their hidden scratchpads limit direct study of how it is achieved. We investigate whether open-weight models can generate less verbose reasoning by changing the form of their own earlier thoughts, without retraining. Our intervention rewrites prior reasoning into compact state records before pending tool results are revealed, then compares continuations from original and compact histories. Across the tested models, accepted compact histories usually shorten future reasoning; a coding case study also shows less repeated verification after a shared candidate solution. In software-agent deployments, compaction can reduce total spending, although task quality and rewrite-inclusive time depend on the target and compressor. These findings identify reasoning history as one way to reduce future reasoning-token use and motivate model-specific compaction policies evaluated for both efficiency and retained capability.

AI.tldr: 在不重新训练的前提下，将模型自身先前的推理轨迹改写为紧凑的“状态记录”，可使后续推理更短、减少重复验证，并在软件智能体部署中降低总体开销，但任务质量与含改写时间取决于目标模型与压缩器。
AI.motivation: 长推理链虽提升难题求解能力，但推理token开销昂贵；高效推理应以更少token表达有用分析、减少重复与低价值文本。闭源模型进展因隐藏草稿不可直接研究，故转向开放权重模型考察能否通过改变自身先前思考的形式来压缩推理。
AI.method: 提出一种免训练的干预：在待定工具结果揭示之前，把既有推理历史改写成紧凑的状态记录，再对比从原始历史与压缩历史出发的后续生成；辅以编码案例研究与软件智能体部署评估。
AI.result: 在受测模型中，被接受的压缩历史通常能缩短后续推理；编码案例显示在共享候选解后重复验证减少；智能体部署中压缩可降低总花费，但任务质量与含改写的时间取决于目标模型和压缩器。
AI.conclusion: 推理历史是减少未来推理token消耗的一条可行路径；应制定模型特定的压缩策略，并同时评估效率与能力保持。

title: MCPGuard: Finding Conformance Gaps in MCP SDKs via Dual-Track Analysis and Dynamic Adjudication
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) connects large language model agents to external tools and services through official SDKs that implement message validation and session logic. Specification constraints omitted by these SDKs may propagate to downstream applications, highlighting the importance of SDK-level conformance testing. Yet existing MCP conformance tools mainly exercise running endpoints and reveal little about whether SDK models enforce specification requirements. We present MCPGuard, an automated LLM-based framework for detecting specification-to-SDK conformance gaps. Its structural track aligns JSON Schema constraints with normalized SDK models and produces constraint-specific evidence. Its behavioral track extracts normative prose rules, retrieves bounded function-level slices, and audits them with LLMs for candidate omissions. An evidence-aware dynamic adjudicator then inspects complete source context and builds PoCs to validate candidates. A shared kernel with language-specific adapters enables analysis across SDKs. On the official Python 1.26.0 and TypeScript 1.29.0 SDKs, MCPGuard confirms 13 and 19 findings, respectively, none of which are exposed by two black-box baselines. Tests on open MCP servers further show that these gaps can systematically propagate downstream. By making SDK conformance of specification constraints directly testable, MCPGuard complements conventional endpoint-oriented conformance suites.

AI.tldr: 提出MCPGuard：基于LLM的自动化框架，从结构（JSON Schema约束对齐）与行为（规范文本规则审计）两条轨道检测MCP官方SDK相对规范的符合性缺口，并在Python 1.26.0与TypeScript 1.29.0 SDK中分别确认13与19项缺陷，且下游服务器可继承这些缺口。
AI.motivation: 官方SDK承担消息校验与会话逻辑，但会遗漏规范约束，遗漏会向下游应用传播；而现有MCP符合性工具主要针对运行中的端点做黑盒测试，难以判断SDK数据模型是否真正落实规范要求。
AI.method: MCPGuard含三条关键机制：1) 结构轨：将JSON Schema约束与规范化后的SDK模型对齐，产出约束级证据；2) 行为轨：抽取规范性自然语言规则，检索有界的函数级切片，交由LLM审计候选遗漏；3) 证据感知的动态裁决器：检查完整源码上下文并构造PoC验证候选。采用共享内核+语言特定适配器支持多语言SDK。
AI.result: 在官方Python 1.26.0与TypeScript 1.29.0 SDK上分别确认13与19项发现，两个黑盒基线均未检出；对开源MCP服务器的测试表明这些缺口可系统性传播至下游。
AI.conclusion: MCPGuard使规范约束的SDK级符合性可直接测试，与面向端点的传统符合性测试互补，构成SDK层面一致性保障的有效手段。

title: Does the Trust Boundary Hold over Time? A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Receiver-Directed Federated Learning
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/tinaxu226/trust-boundary-benchmark (available upon acceptance)
summary: In receiver-directed federated learning, each site draws a trust boundary. For every source and model component it judges, on its own data, whether the transfer helps (admit), harms (reject) or cannot yet be told (abstain). We ask whether this boundary holds over hundreds of rounds. Our benchmark has a federation of thirteen semi-synthetic sites, an exact oracle for every evaluated transfer, paired seeds, an attack protocol, fourteen methods over 600 rounds and Qwen3-1.7B LoRA sites over 500. The answer depends on which boundary is measured. Across 20 paired CPU seeds, a gate judging against a fixed reference better identified transfers useful relative to the site's starting model. Yet it admitted 29% of transfers harmful to the model the site now has. A gate judging against the current model admitted 2% of harmful transfers on that target in the CPU tier, but missed many transfers useful to the starting model. Two short propositions explain these distinct failures. We also evaluate a held out audit that leaves gate verdicts intact. After training, it decides whether each final model is deployed or the site falls back to local training, and reports admissions that have gone stale. With independent audit data its guarantees hold after any training history. At 600 rounds the audit deployed 65 to 72% of models, none with negative benefit on its target, and kept 98% of the gain. No stale report had the wrong sign in our runs. With 20,000 audit observations, a variance-adaptive bound found 99% of stale transfers that cost at least 0.01 in log loss. A common-target Qwen3 comparison on 60 selected transfers shows the same tension over 100 rounds. With 38% adversarial sites, FedFomo and CS-Gate were the only evaluated methods with positive mean gain in every honest group.

AI.tldr: 论文研究接收方主导的联邦学习中的信任边界能否在数百轮中持续成立。发现“固定参考门”与“当前模型门”各存在互补失效；提出一种不改变门判决的留出审计，在600轮中部署65–72%模型且无负收益，保留98%收益。
AI.motivation: 接收方主导的联邦学习由每个站点自行划定信任边界（admit/reject/abstain），但该边界能否在数百轮中稳定成立尚不明确；同时需要区分“相对起始模型的效用”与“相对当前模型的效用”两种目标，并解决门控判决长期失准（stale）的问题。
AI.method: 构建含13个半合成站点、精确oracle、配对准种子、攻击协议、14种方法×600轮以及Qwen3-1.7B LoRA站点×500轮的基准；在20个配对CPU种子下对比固定参考门与当前模型门；给出两个短命题解释其互补失效；并提出独立留出审计：训练后决定部署最终模型还是回退本地训练，用方差自适应界报告过期（stale）准入。
AI.result: 固定参考门更好地识别相对起始模型有用的迁移，却放行了29%对当前模型有害的迁移；当前模型门在CPU层有害迁移放行率仅2%，但漏掉大量对起始模型有用的迁移。审计在600轮部署65–72%模型，无负收益且保留98%收益，过期报告无误判符号；20,000条审计观测下方差自适应界以99%检出代价≥0.01 log loss的过期迁移。Qwen3公共目标对比在100轮呈现相同张力；38%对抗站点下仅FedFomo与CS-Gate在所有诚实组均获正平均增益。
AI.conclusion: 接收方信任边界是否“成立”取决于所测边界：固定参考与当前模型目标不可兼得，需以独立数据审计作为门控之外的保障层；审计在任意训练历史后仍具保证，但现有方法在强对抗比例下鲁棒性普遍不足。

title: Beyond TR 38.811 for 6G NTN Channel Models
summary: As the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) expands 6G non-terrestrial network (NTN) to S, Ku, and Ka bands for integration with existing terrestrial cellular networks, the necessary satellite channel model for link and network performance evaluation remains tied to TR 38.811, last revised in 2020. We identify issues on multiple fronts: inappropriate parameter specifications based on very limited site-specific environments considered, omission of satellite-induced Doppler spread and directional antenna effects and lack of a transparent channel model generation procedure. To address these limitations, we re-derive the channel parameters using ray tracing (RT) over urban and rural environments based on ITU-R building statistics. Our results show that TR 38.811 substantially overestimates the K-factor at low elevations and predicts a decreasing trend with elevation, which is inconsistent with RT. The Ka-band clutter loss (CL) also exceeds the RT estimates by more than 15 dB in urban cases. It also underestimates rural delay spread (DS) at low elevations and predicts an elevation trend inconsistent with RT. We further quantify the previously neglected satellite-induced Doppler spread. Finally, we demonstrate that the conventional TR 38.811 channel generator significantly underestimates the K-factor in the presence of directional antenna (beamforming), while our modified generator substantially reduces this discrepancy.

AI.tldr: 该文指出3GPP TR 38.811 卫星信道模型的参数标定、模型缺失（卫星诱导多普勒、方向性天线）与生成流程不透明等问题，基于ITU-R建筑统计在城/乡场景开展射线追踪重标定参数，量化卫星诱导多普勒展宽，并提出修正的信道生成器。
AI.motivation: 3GPP将6G NTN扩展至S/Ku/Ka频段并与地面蜂窝融合，但链路与网络性能评估所依赖的卫星信道模型仍沿用2020年最后修订的TR 38.811。该模型存在三方面缺陷：参数基于极少数站址特定环境标定、遗漏卫星诱导多普勒展宽与方向性天线效应、缺乏透明的信道模型生成流程。
AI.method: 基于ITU-R建筑统计构建城市与乡村环境，采用射线追踪（RT）重新推导信道参数；与TR 38.811进行K因子、杂波损耗（CL）、时延扩展（DS）及其仰角趋势的对比；量化此前被忽略的卫星诱导多普勒展宽；并针对方向性天线（波束赋形）场景对传统TR 38.811信道生成器进行修正。
AI.result: TR 38.811在低仰角显著高估K因子，且预测K因子随仰角下降的趋势，与RT结果不符；城市场景Ka频段杂波损耗较RT高估超过15 dB；低仰角乡村时延扩展被低估且仰角趋势与RT不一致。传统TR 38.811生成器在方向性天线存在时明显低估K因子，修正后的生成器显著减小该偏差。
AI.conclusion: RT驱动的重标定表明TR 38.811在K因子、Ka频段杂波损耗、乡村时延扩展及仰角趋势上存在系统性偏差，并忽视卫星诱导多普勒与方向性天线效应；所提出的修正生成器可有效缓解波束赋形条件下的K因子低估，为6G NTN信道建模提供更可靠的依据。

title: Asymptotic electromagnetic transition conditions for thin layers: the arithmetic-mean field and susceptibility hybridization
summary: Effective transition conditions that replace a thin polarizable layer by a zero-thickness sheet are commonly applied in electromagnetic models of two-dimensional (2D) materials and metasurfaces. These conditions usually take the arithmetic mean of the fields on either side as the polarizing field at the boundary, and characterize the layer by the $0^\mathrm{th}$ moment of its susceptibility, but both choices are typically imposed rather than derived. We derive transition conditions for a finite-thickness, in-plane homogeneous, in-plane isotropic layer with a general nonlocal susceptibility, using a single-scale asymptotic expansion in $η= l\max(k_0,q)$, where $l$ is the layer thickness, $k_0$ the free-space wavenumber and $q$ the in-plane wavenumber. The sheet limit must be taken after resumming the out-of-plane depolarizing field, as this ensures that the resulting sheet susceptibility is independent of the material thickness. The arithmetic mean then emerges as the leading-order polarizing field for general susceptibility profiles. Asymmetries in the layer profile modify the effective susceptibility appearing in the transition conditions, rather than altering the arithmetic-mean field prescription. If the spatial profile is not even in both out-of-plane coordinates, in-plane and out-of-plane response hybridize, turning the diagonal volumetric susceptibility into a $q$-dependent effective tensor surface susceptibility with off-diagonal components. Mirror symmetry alone does not remove this hybridization. Comparison with exact solutions for local and separable layers shows that the derived conditions remain accurate to $O(η)$ across propagating and evanescent excitations, whereas the standard sheet conditions fail once hybridization becomes appreciable.

AI.tldr: 本文用单尺度渐近展开严格推导了将有限厚极化层替换为零厚度薄片的过渡条件，证明"算术平均极化场"与"仅用0阶矩表征"是导出结果而非人为假设，并揭示非对称剖面导致面内-面外响应杂化、使体磁化率变为含非对角项的q依赖有效张量表面磁化率。
AI.motivation: 二维材料与超表面的电磁建模中普遍使用"零厚度薄片替代薄极化层"的过渡条件，但常用做法（以两侧场算术平均作为边界极化场、仅用磁化率0阶矩表征层）通常是直接设定而非严格推导，缺乏对非局域磁化率、有限厚度及非对称剖面的系统论证。
AI.method: 针对有限厚度、面内均匀且面内各向同性、具有一般非局域磁化率的层，采用小参数η = l·max(k0, q)（l为层厚，k0为自由空间波数，q为面内波数）的单尺度渐近展开推导过渡条件；关键在于先对面外退极化场求和（重求和）后再取薄片极限，以保证所得薄片磁化率与材料厚度无关。
AI.result: 算术平均作为主导阶极化场对一般磁化率剖面自然涌现；层剖面的非对称性只修正过渡条件中的有效磁化率而不改变算术平均场的规定；若空间剖面在两面外坐标上均非偶函数，则面内与面外响应发生杂化，对角体磁化率转化为含非对角分量的q依赖有效张量表面磁化率，且仅靠镜像对称不能消除该杂化。与局域层及可分离层的精确解对比表明：所推条件在传播与倏逝激励下均保持O(η)精度，而标准薄片条件在杂化显著时失效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为二维材料/超表面的零厚度薄片建模提供了严格的理论基础：算术平均场与0阶矩描述的正确性依赖"先重求和退极化场再取薄片极限"的顺序；非对称剖面引发的响应杂化要求使用张量型有效表面磁化率，标准标量薄片条件在高q（强杂化）情形下不再适用。

title: Low-Terahertz Channel Performance in Falling Wheat for Moisture Sensing
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transaction on Antenna and Propagation
summary: Terahertz (THz) waves are highly sensitive to water and therefore offer a promising noncontact approach to wheat moisture sensing, but existing THz studies have been limited to static samples. This article investigates moisture sensing based on the performance of a THz channel in falling wheat, as encountered at grain intake. The channel power loss is measured at six frequencies from 120 to 320 GHz for three moisture contents and interpreted with a physics-based model that couples the double-Debye permittivity of water, Landau-Lifshitz-Looyenga mixing, and Lorenz-Mie extinction. The model reproduces the measured loss. Above the extinction maximum, the dielectric moisture response peaks where the wavelength approaches the kernel diameter, and that a two-frequency loss ratio removes the loading dependence. A channel-level analysis of QPSK and 16-QAM links shows that a 1 dB moisture-induced loss change alters the bit error rate (BER) by a factor of 3 to 30. THz communication channels at grain intake could therefore sense moisture as a byproduct of data transmission.

AI.tldr: 该文研究下落小麦颗粒流中的太赫兹信道水分传感，建立物理模型解释120–320 GHz功率损耗，并提出双频损耗比消除装载依赖，从而实现"通信即传感"。
AI.motivation: 现有太赫兹水分检测研究仅限于静态样品，而实际粮食入库场景中颗粒处于下落状态，亟需针对动态颗粒流的非接触水分传感方法。
AI.method: 在120–320 GHz的六个频点测量下落小麦信道功率损耗（三种含水率），并用耦合水双Debye介电模型、Landau-Lifshitz-Looyenga混合公式与Lorenz-Mie消光的物理模型进行解释；进一步分析QPSK与16-QAM链路在信道层面的BER表现。
AI.result: 模型可复现实测损耗；在消光极大值以上，介电水分响应在波长接近籽粒直径处达到峰值；双频损耗比可消除装载（颗粒密度）依赖；1 dB水分致损耗变化使BER变化3–30倍。
AI.conclusion: 粮食入库处的太赫兹通信信道可在数据传输过程中顺带实现水分传感。

title: Geometric Refinement and Distributional Alignment for Sim2Real Roadside LiDAR Detection
comment: 8 pages. 1st place, Track 6 (UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR, LUMPI), DriveX Grand Challenge, ECCV 2026 Workshop. Code: https://github.com/amanupg/urbantwin-sim2real-lumpi
summary: We describe our approach to the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge, in which a 3D object detector must be trained exclusively on synthetic data and evaluated on unseen real roadside LiDAR, while the synthetic point clouds are simultaneously scored for distributional realism. Our final entry scores 0.4793 combined, from a detection mAP of 0.1333 and a realism score of 0.9126. Our contribution is not a new architecture. Working from a PointPillars baseline, we obtained most of our gains from three sources. First, a diagnosis that small object failure in roadside LiDAR is a localisation problem rather than a detection problem, which led to a parameter free geometric refinement worth 86 percent relative on pedestrian AP. Second, an audit of our own post processing which revealed that a shipped rule was destroying valid predictions, the repair of which produced our single largest detection gain at 335 percent relative on the Van class. Third, treating the realism metrics analytically rather than as a black box, which showed that one of the four components is a closed form function of nine summary statistics. We also report an experimental methodology that we believe is the more transferable result. Because mean AP decomposes into independent per class terms, a single submission can carry several mutually controlled experiments, and a submission assembled entirely from previously measured components has a score that is known before it is sent. We predicted our final score to four decimal places prior to submission. We report negative results at equal length, and give a full account of data provenance and compliance in Section 8, including a full account of every mechanism contributing to the submitted score.

AI.tldr: 本文报告 UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR 挑战赛 LUMPI 赛道的参赛方案：仅用合成数据训练 3D 检测器并在真实路侧 LiDAR 上评估，同时评估合成点云的分布真实性。最终综合得分 0.4793（检测 mAP 0.1333，真实性 0.9126），贡献主要来自问题诊断与实验方法论而非新架构。
AI.motivation: 参赛目标是解决合成到真实（Sim2Real）跨域 3D 检测的域偏移问题，同时兼顾合成点云的分布真实性评估；作者进一步希望提出一种可迁移、可控、可预先预测分数的实验方法论，避免黑箱式调参。
AI.method: 以 PointPillars 为基线，主要工作包括：(1) 诊断出路侧 LiDAR 中小目标失败本质是定位问题而非检测问题，据此设计了无参数几何精修；(2) 审计自身后处理，发现某条既定规则错误地抑制了有效预测并加以修复；(3) 解析化分析真实性指标，证明四个分量之一可由九个汇总统计量闭式表达。方法论上利用 mAP 可分解为独立类别项的特性，在单次提交中并行多组受控实验，并用已测分量组装提交以事前预测得分。
AI.result: 综合得分 0.4793，检测 mAP 为 0.1333，真实性得分 0.9126。几何精修使行人 AP 相对提升 86%；修复后处理规则带来最大单项检测增益，Van 类相对提升 335%；提交前将最终得分预测准至小数点后四位。文中亦等篇幅报告了负结果。
AI.conclusion: 在不引入新网络结构的前提下，通过问题诊断、自身流程审计与指标解析化即可获得显著增益；更重要的可迁移成果是"可分解、可控制、可预测"的实验方法论。论文同时完整披露数据来源与合规性以及各得分贡献机制。

title: EvoGroup: A Self-Evolving Harness for Group Agents in Shared Contexts
comment: 15 pages, 10 tables, and 7 figures. With code to be open-sourced
summary: With the rise of Group Agent such as Claude Tag, agents increasingly serve as digital workers for long-term team collaboration. These agents operate over shared contexts that continuously accumulate through multi-user interactions. However, existing agent memory systems are mainly designed for individual users and struggle to capture group-level knowledge in shared contexts, including group relationships and collaboratively formed knowledge. Manual memory strategies further limit adaptation to diverse and evolving shared contexts. To this end, we propose \textbf{EvoGroup (EvoG)}, a self-evolving harness for group agents that starts from a minimal six-tool cold start and adapts through interaction with shared context. EvoG uses confidence and task outcomes to select informative trajectories, while also eliciting self-reflections on uncertainty in low-confidence cases. The analysis agent then examines selected trajectories through adaptive progressive disclosure, followed by bucketed analysis to synthesize high-level findings that guide the evolve agent in revising the Harness. Empirically, pass@1 on held-out split of EverMemBench improves from 71.07\% to 89.58\%, surpassing both self-evolving memory and human-designed harnesses, including Claude Code (85.83\%). To evaluate generalization, we freeze the evolved harness and evaluate it on the unseen GroupMemBench, where, with GPT-5.5, it demonstrates effective generalization and outperforms both memory baselines and human-designed harnesses.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoGroup（EvoG），一个面向群体智能体的自进化 harness：从仅含六个工具的最小冷启动开始，通过与共享上下文的交互持续自我演化，在 EverMemBench 留出集上把 pass@1 从 71.07% 提升到 89.58%，并在未见的 GroupMemBench 上展现良好泛化。
AI.motivation: 随着 Group Agent 承担长期团队协作的"数字工作者"角色，其共享上下文经由多用户交互不断累积；但现有智能体记忆系统主要面向单用户，难以捕捉群体层面的知识（如群组关系与协作形成的知识），且手工设计的记忆策略难以适应多样且持续演化的共享上下文。
AI.method: EvoG 从最小六工具冷启动出发，依靠置信度与任务结果筛选信息量高的轨迹，并对低置信度情形引导模型对不确定性进行自我反思；随后由分析智能体以自适应渐进披露（adaptive progressive disclosure）审视被选轨迹，再通过分桶分析（bucketed analysis）综合出高层结论，用以指导进化智能体修订 Harness。
AI.result: 在 EverMemBench 留出集上 pass@1 由 71.07% 提升至 89.58%，超过自进化记忆方法与人工设计 harness，包括 Claude Code（85.83%）；冻结进化后的 harness 在未见的 GroupMemBench 上（配 GPT-5.5）仍优于记忆基线与人工设计 harness，表现出有效泛化。
AI.conclusion: 以自进化 harness 替代手工记忆策略，可有效捕获群体级共享上下文知识，并具备跨基准的泛化能力。

title: Functional-Group Knowledge Is Structured in Language Models Before It Is Spoken
summary: Language models serve as the reasoning core of agents for chemistry and materials science, where they must interpret molecular structure before planning syntheses or proposing materials. Yet their outputs show only what they say, not what they know. Given a prompt such as ``The primary functional group in 1-Fluorobutane (CCCCF) is'', a small general-purpose model may answer ``the alkyne group'' instead of an alkyl fluoride. The output alone cannot tell whether the model failed to recognize the fluorine or recognized it and failed to say so. We address this by reading the internal representations of five open-source models on prompts covering 92 molecules and 20 functional groups. Even without chemistry training, the models organize functional groups by chemical family, and they encode chemical differences as consistent directions. The shift from thioether ($\mathrm{R{-}S{-}R'}$) to thiol ($\mathrm{R{-}SH}$), added to ether ($\mathrm{R{-}O{-}R'}$), lands nearest alcohol ($\mathrm{R{-}OH}$). This structure emerges abruptly in the middle layers, where representations shift from tracking the wording of the prompt to tracking the functional group. The base model names the correct functional group in only 58.5\% of prompts, the lowest of the five, yet it encodes functional-group families and preserves chemically meaningful patterns. Its errors are mostly failures to answer rather than wrong answers. Functional-group knowledge is structured in the model before it is spoken. Chemistry fine-tuning reorganizes it, making functional groups rather than prompt wording dominate the representation. These results suggest that evaluating chemical language models through outputs alone can underestimate the chemical information they encode. Representation analysis can distinguish a lack of knowledge from a failure to express it, which matters when choosing or adapting models for chemical agents.

AI.tldr: 通过对五个开源模型内部表征的分析，发现即使未经化学训练，模型也在中间层突现出按化学家族组织的官能团结构，其化学知识先于输出而存在；仅凭输出评估会低估模型编码的化学信息。
AI.motivation: 语言模型是化学与材料科学智能体的推理核心，需先解析分子结构再规划合成或设计材料，但其输出只显示"说了什么"而非"知道什么"（如将1-氟丁烷的官能团误答为炔基），仅凭输出无法区分"不认识氟原子"与"认识但没说对"，因而需要考察内部表征。
AI.method: 读取五个开源模型在覆盖92种分子、20种官能团的提示上的内部表示，分析官能团表征的几何组织（是否按化学家族聚类、化学差异是否编码为一致方向），并考察随层深的变化及化学微调的影响。
AI.result: 模型无需化学训练即按化学家族组织官能团，并将化学差异编码为一致方向；硫醚→硫醇的位移在加入醚后最接近醇。该结构在中间层突现，表征从追踪提示措辞转向追踪官能团。基础模型正确命名率仅58.5%（五者最低），但仍编码官能团家族且保留有化学意义的模式，其错误多为"未能作答"而非"答错"。
AI.conclusion: 官能团知识在"说出"之前已结构化存在于模型中；化学微调会重组该结构，使官能团而非提示措辞主导表征。仅通过输出评估化学语言模型会低估其编码的化学信息，表征分析可区分"缺乏知识"与"表达失败"，对选择和适配化学智能体所用模型具有重要意义。

title: Auditing a Model-Hub Benchmark: Data Quality, Training Budgets, and Side Information in HuggingBench
comment: 12 pages, 10 tables, 2 figures. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23857277
summary: Benchmarks built from model hubs combine interaction data, knowledge graphs (KGs) and resource documentation, but valid files do not ensure that these artifacts describe the same objects. Treating the release as a data product, we audit HuggingBench (SIGIR 2025), a benchmark for recommending Hugging Face resources, through data validation, a replication of its eleven recommendation methods and controlled experiments with three training seeds. In three of its four external KGs, the files pass key and range checks but violate the item-entity identity constraint on which KG recommenders rely. Correcting this join improves every KG-based method in every seed, by up to 73% in mean Recall@10, and consistently reverses ten of 27 comparisons between KG configurations. The protocol matters as well: the 100-epoch budget ends before early stopping in seven to eight of 29 validation-selected settings, and 21 of 23 such setting-seed pairs improve with a longer budget. The released item text, which no reported method uses, is the strongest signal: closed-form linear models with text and the item graph exceed the best reported Recall@10 by 18% while fitting in minutes on a CPU. Checks of other recommendation releases show that individually valid releases of one dataset can use incompatible identifiers. We release corrected files, mappings, validators and logs, and derive practices for preserving identity and provenance across the artifacts of benchmarks and model lakes.

AI.tldr: 该文以数据产品视角审计HuggingBench基准，发现其外部知识图谱与物品标识不一致、训练预算不足，修正后KG类方法Recall@10最多提升73%，并指出未被使用的物品文本是最强信号。
AI.motivation: 由模型枢纽构建的基准同时整合交互数据、知识图谱与资源文档，但文件本身"格式有效"并不保证各工件描述的是同一批对象；作者希望检验这类基准的标识一致性与协议合理性。
AI.method: 对HuggingBench（SIGIR 2025）进行数据校验；复现其11种推荐方法；以3个训练种子做受控实验；并抽查其他推荐数据集发布版本的标识符兼容性。
AI.result: 4个外部KG中有3个虽通过键与范围检查，却违反物品—实体身份约束；修正连接后每个种子下所有KG类方法均提升，平均Recall@10最高提升73%，并逆转27组KG配置比较中的10组；29个验证选优设置中有7–8个在100 epoch预算结束前未触发早停，其中21/23个"设置-种子"对在延长预算后改善；用物品文本与物品图的闭式线性模型在CPU上数分钟训练，Recall@10超过已报告最优18%。
AI.conclusion: 单个"有效"的数据发布可能使用互不兼容的标识符，因此需在基准与模型湖的工件间保持身份与溯源一致；作者发布修正文件、映射、校验器与日志，并总结相应实践规范。

title: GTAC: A Graph-Transformer Actor-Critic for Carrier-Aware MU-MIMO User Grouping
summary: Achieving higher spectral efficiency (SE) in 5G and future 6G networks requires efficient massive multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) grouping under coupled physical-layer constraints and strict scheduling deadlines. Motivated by industry efforts in AI-native RAN, we propose Graph-Transformer Actor-Critic (GTAC), a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) architecture for carrier-aware MU-MIMO user grouping. The objective is to maximize the long-term proportional-fair (PF) utility of the cell subject to constraints from the practical stack protocol. GTAC comprises a shared actor--critic encoder with spatial-edge-biased attention mechanism, a pointer decoder actor that generates grouping decisions, and a multi-stage transformer critic that estimates the carrier-wide state-value during training.
