Training begins by cloning a teacher policy that cannot meet real-time deployment deadlines, followed by critic warmup and two-stage reinforcement learning using proximal policy optimization (PPO), first on a narrow, power-matched carrier and then on the full carrier with a Kullback--Leibler (KL) policy anchor. After two-stage PPO, the best GTAC policy outperforms the non-real-time teacher by 11.6% in carrier SE, while exceeding its PF utility and preserving the cell-edge throughput. A CUDA implementation of GTAC achieves a 69.6 us inference latency on an RTX PRO 4500 GPU, below the targeted 100 us inference budget in practical systems.

AI.tldr: 提出Graph-Transformer Actor-Critic (GTAC)深度强化学习架构，在耦合物理层约束与严格调度时限下实现载波感知的MU-MIMO用户分组，最大化长期比例公平效用。
AI.motivation: 在5G及未来6G中提升频谱效率需要在物理层约束与实际协议栈约束、实时调度截止时间下进行高效的大规模MU-MIMO用户分组；同时受AI原生RAN的产业趋势驱动，需要可实时部署的分组策略。
AI.method: GTAC采用共享actor-critic编码器（含空间边偏置注意力机制）、生成分组决策的指针解码器actor，以及训练时估计载波级状态价值的多级Transformer critic。训练先克隆无法满足实时时限的教师策略，再进行critic预热，并采用两阶段PPO强化学习：先在窄带、功率匹配的载波上训练，再在完整载波上以KL策略锚约束训练。
AI.result: 两阶段PPO后的最优GTAC策略在载波频谱效率上超过非实时教师11.6%，同时比例公平效用更高并保持小区边缘吞吐；CUDA实现在RTX PRO 4500 GPU上推理时延为69.6微秒，低于实际系统100微秒的推理预算。
AI.conclusion: GTAC在满足实时推理预算的同时，实现了优于非实时教师策略的SE与PF效用权衡，验证了图-Transformer DRL架构用于在线MU-MIMO用户分组的可行性与部署价值。

title: Reference-Beam-Assisted Perturbation-Resistant Imaging Through A Single Multimode Fiber
summary: Multimode fiber (MMF) imaging is highly sensitive to mechanical perturbations, which alter modal coupling and disrupt the speckle-to-target mapping. Here, we propose a reference-beam-assisted method for image reconstruction across multiple fiber configurations. An independent reference beam propagates through the same MMF as the imaging signal without target modulation, providing target-independent transmission-state information through its speckle patterns without requiring a separate configuration-sensing structure. A neural network jointly processes the signal and reference speckles to reconstruct target images. Experiments with MNIST and Fashion-MNIST across 10 fiber configurations demonstrate improved reconstruction quality, faster training convergence, and more accurate configuration identification. Further evaluation across 40 configurations confirms the reconstruction benefit of reference-beam assistance over a larger set of perturbed fiber states. These results provide a foundation for developing perturbation-adaptive MMF imaging systems for flexible endoscopy and minimally invasive optical diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种参考光辅助方法，利用同一多模光纤中传输的、未经目标调制的独立参考光束及其散斑提供与目标无关的传输状态信息，结合神经网络联合处理信号与参考散斑，实现跨多种光纤构型的目标图像重建。
AI.motivation: 多模光纤成像对机械扰动高度敏感，扰动会改变模式耦合、破坏散斑到目标的映射关系，导致单一构型下训练的重建模型失效。
AI.method: 参考光束与成像信号共享同一多模光纤但不经目标调制，其散斑编码目标无关的传输状态；无需额外的构型传感结构，由神经网络联合处理信号散斑与参考散斑完成图像重建。
AI.result: 在MNIST与Fashion-MNIST数据集、10种光纤构型下，重建质量提升、训练收敛更快且构型识别更准确；在40种构型的扩展评估中，进一步验证了参考光辅助在更多扰动状态下的重建增益。
AI.conclusion: 参考光辅助为扰动自适应多模光纤成像奠定基础，有望用于柔性内窥镜与微创光学诊断。

title: Periodically poled lithium niobate with submicrometer periodicity using electric-field poling technique
summary: A series of monocrystalline lithium niobate (LN) thin films on low-resistivity silicon (LNOS) substrates, with thicknesses ranging from micrometers down to tens of nanometers, were prepared through chemical-mechanical polishing of pristine crystal films. By employing the electric-field poling technique, high-quality periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) structures with submicrometer periodicity were fabricated in these LNOSs, and full-thickness polarization reversal beneath the poling electrodes with a well-defined depth profile was achieved. The coercive field was found to follow the Kay-Dunn scaling law, while the lateral domain broadening generally increased with increasing film thickness, and it remained approximately constant across different electrode linewidths at a given film thickness. PPLN structures with periods ranging from 6 $μ$m down to 200 nm were demonstrated. These findings provide guidance for poling electrode design and lateral domain broadening pre-compensation, offering a practical route toward scalable domain engineering in LN thin films with promising potential for compact and highly integrated nonlinear photonic devices.

AI.tldr: 通过化学机械抛光制备微米至数十纳米的单晶铌酸锂薄膜/低阻硅衬底(LNOS)，并利用电场极化实现亚微米周期PPLN，周期覆盖6 μm至200 nm。
AI.motivation: 铌酸锂薄膜的规模化畴工程（尤其亚微米周期极化）缺乏厚度依赖的极化行为规律与电极设计依据，制约紧凑高集成非线性光子器件的发展。
AI.method: 对原始单晶薄膜进行化学机械抛光，制得一系列不同厚度的LNOS；采用电场极化技术制备周期性畴结构；系统考察矫顽场随厚度的标度关系、横向畴展宽随膜厚与电极线宽的变化，并实现全厚度反转。
AI.result: 矫顽场符合Kay-Dunn标度律；横向畴展宽随膜厚增大而增大，但在给定膜厚下对电极线宽基本不敏感；成功制备周期6 μm至200 nm的PPLN，电极下实现深度剖面清晰的全厚度极化反转。
AI.conclusion: 结果可为极化电极设计与横向畴展宽预补偿提供指导，给出铌酸锂薄膜可规模化畴工程的实用路径，面向紧凑高集成非线性光子器件。

title: FlowBench: Counterfactual Imagination Training for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Humans imagine scene changes under hypothetical motions, an ability central to spatial reasoning and robotic planning. However, this capability remains underexplored in vision-language models and world models. We formalize this capability as Counterfactual Spatial Imagination (CSI) and introduce FlowBench, a resource for training and evaluating both, with 428K training examples spanning simulated and real-world scenes, household environments and tabletop manipulation, and diverse question types. A scalable, fully automatic pipeline pairs each hypothetical motion with spatial questions and, in simulation, exact outcome frames and optical flow. For VLMs, proprietary models exhibit an imagination gap, performing worse when motion outcomes must be inferred than when observed, and open-source models perform near chance; fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B on FlowBench-Sim-Train raises its accuracy by 29.5 percentage points in simulation and 16.9 on real images, a strong sim-to-real transfer. For world models, training on FlowBench-Sim improves text-to-flow prediction for all four model families we test, raising the accuracy of Psi-0.6 from 52.1% to 61.7%. FlowBench thus serves as a training and evaluation resource for both. Code and datasets are released at https://github.com/liuyifan22/FlowBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出反事实空间想象（CSI）任务并构建FlowBench数据集，用于训练与评测VLM与世界模型对假设运动下场景变化的想象能力。
AI.motivation: 人类能在假设运动下想象场景变化，这对空间推理与机器人规划至关重要，但该能力在视觉语言模型与世界模型中尚未被充分探索，且缺乏相应评测与训练资源。
AI.method: 形式化定义CSI任务；构建FlowBench，含428K训练样例，覆盖仿真与真实场景、家居环境与桌面操作及多类问题；采用可扩展的全自动流水线，将每个假设运动与空间问题配对，并在仿真中给出精确结果帧与光流；在VLM上评测并微调Qwen3-VL-8B，在四个世界模型家族上训练文本到光流预测。
AI.result: 专有VLM存在"想象鸿沟"，推理运动结果时表现不如观察时；开源模型接近随机；Qwen3-VL-8B在FlowBench-Sim-Train上微调后仿真精度提升29.5个百分点、真实图像提升16.9，sim-to-real迁移良好；世界模型在FlowBench-Sim上训练后四个家族均提升，Psi-0.6准确率由52.1%升至61.7%。
AI.conclusion: FlowBench可作为VLM与世界模型在反事实空间想象方面的统一训练与评测资源，揭示现有模型的想象能力缺陷并证明数据驱动的改进有效；代码与数据已开源。

title: Balancing Chain-of-Thought and Answer Supervision for Small Language Models on Medical Question Answering
summary: Small language models (<=9B parameters) can support local medical question answering (QA) while reducing privacy and latency concerns, but effective fine-tuning remains challenging. This paper compares two chain-of-thought (CoT) supervised fine-tuning methods: Uniform-across-Sequence (UaS), which applies equal loss weighting to the full CoT-and-answer sequence, and Segment-weighted (SwS), which separately weights CoT and answer losses. We evaluate six general- and medical-domain models on multiple-choice QA (MedQA and EMS-MCQA) and free-text QA (Med-O1). Results show that neither method is universally best: on multiple-choice QA (MedQA and EMS-MCQA), SwS generally performs better, with general-purpose models benefiting most; notably, Qwen3.5-4B improves by up to 44.8% over its zero-shot baseline on MedQA. In contrast, medical-domain models show smaller or even negative gains on MCQs. On free-text QA (Med-O1), UaS performs best for nearly all models and provides consistent improvements across both model types, with the 3B Llama-3.2 model approaching the performance of much larger 7B medical-domain models. We also find that excessively long CoT generation is associated with lower performance in some models on either multiple-choice or free-text QA tasks, suggesting that limiting the CoT length during training may benefit selected models. Overall, the results show that CoT loss weighting should be matched to the task format and the knowledge already encoded in the base model, rather than using a single fine-tuning strategy for all clinical QA tasks.

AI.tldr: 该文比较两种CoT监督微调损失加权策略（全序列等权UaS与CoT/答案分段加权SwS）在6个小规模（≤9B）通用及医疗模型上的效果，发现最优策略需依任务格式与基座模型已有知识而定。
AI.motivation: 小模型（≤9B）适合本地医疗问答以降低隐私与延迟风险，但其高效微调方法尚不明确，尤其缺乏对CoT监督信号如何加权分配的实证比较。
AI.method: 提出并对比两种CoT监督微调损失加权方式：UaS对完整CoT+答案序列施加统一损失权重；SwS分别对CoT损失与答案损失加权。在6个通用与医疗领域模型上，于多项选择QA（MedQA、EMS-MCQA）与自由文本QA（Med-O1）两类任务上评估。
AI.result: 无普适最优方法。多项选择QA上SwS总体更优，通用模型受益最大（Qwen3.5-4B在MedQA上较zero-shot提升至多44.8%），医疗领域模型增益较小甚至为负；自由文本QA上UaS对几乎所有模型最佳且两类模型均稳定提升，3B Llama-3.2接近7B医疗领域模型水平。过长的CoT生成与部分模型性能下降相关。
AI.conclusion: CoT损失加权应与任务格式及基座模型已编码的知识相匹配，而非对所有临床QA任务采用单一微调策略；训练时限制CoT长度或对特定模型有益。

title: LOLPlay: Benchmarking Real-Time Visual Agents in League of Legends
summary: Visual agents need to coordinate reasoning and action while their environment evolves during inference. We introduce LOLPlay, a benchmark in native \emph{League of Legends} with 36 champion-specific tasks spanning resource management, combat, cooperation, and objectives. Agents interact through screenshots and mouse--keyboard actions; automated initialization and 82 executable subgoal checks distinguish partial progress from completion. Across 324 task evaluations of three models at three reasoning-effort settings, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate of 25.0\% at low and medium effort, and the highest subgoal success rate of 40.3\% at medium effort. However, high effort improves neither metric over low effort for any model. For Astra, longer requests leave fewer interaction rounds, suggesting a cost to additional reasoning in real-time control. Trajectories reveal incomplete subgoal composition and actions executing after the observed scene changes, motivating agents that combine visual reasoning with timely action.

AI.tldr: 提出LOLPlay基准，在《英雄联盟》原生环境中评测视觉智能体的推理—行动协同能力，发现高推理投入并未提升表现。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体需在推理过程中面对动态变化的环境协调推理与行动，现有基准缺乏真实实时环境与细粒度进度评估。
AI.method: 构建LOLPlay基准，包含36个英雄特定任务，覆盖资源管理、战斗、协作与目标四类；智能体仅通过截图观察、以鼠标键盘操作，采用自动化初始化和82个可执行子目标检查来区分部分进度与完成；对三个模型在三种推理投入设置下进行324次任务评测。
AI.result: GPT-6 Astra在低、中推理投入下取得最高任务成功率25.0%，中投入下最高子目标成功率40.3%；但所有模型的高投入均未在两个指标上优于低投入；对Astra而言，更长请求导致交互轮次减少，表明实时控制中额外推理存在代价。轨迹显示子目标组合不完整、动作在场景变化后才执行。
AI.conclusion: 现有视觉智能体在实时动态环境中推理与行动协同不足，亟需能兼顾视觉推理与及时行动的智能体设计。

title: Minimal Superior Penalties: Characterising and Calibrating Decision-Aware Proper Scoring Rules
summary: Training a classifier means letting a validation metric decide which model is kept and when training stops. A natural requirement on that metric is superiority: every correctly classified forecast should score better than every incorrectly classified one, however close the underlying probabilities are. Neither the Brier score nor the logarithmic score satisfies this on its own. We show that superiority is governed by the separation between two endpoints -- the supremum of the score on correct predictions and the infimum on incorrect predictions -- and derive both in closed form for each score. Their difference is the infimal penalty, the greatest lower bound on the penalty needed to restore superiority. Prior work restores superiority with a penalty calibrated from the first endpoint alone; for the Brier base, our infimal penalty is smaller than that published penalty by a factor ranging from 4.00 at three classes to 2.11 at twenty. We further embed the published and infimal penalties in a one-parameter family and show that, under a single-valued tie convention, every member of the family is strictly proper. In a pre-specified two-dataset case study, mean selected-model macro-F1 rises with the penalty in the reported ten-class regimes, though not distinguishably from noise once seed/selection-mode nesting is accounted for; a fifth regime at forty-seven classes does not reproduce even this descriptive pattern. The intended no-superiority baseline is algebraically a rescaling of the family under test, so the experiment cannot attribute the observed pattern specifically to superiority. When superiority itself is the objective, any penalty strictly above the infimal value suffices; choosing a larger penalty is a separate calibration trade-off rather than a requirement for the guarantee.

AI.tldr: 该文从理论上刻画了评分规则的"优越性"（正确分类的最低得分须高于错误分类的最高得分），给出Brier与对数评分的闭式端点与"最小惩罚"（infimal penalty），证明其小于现有惩罚（3类时小4.00倍，20类时小2.11倍），并将二者嵌入单参数严格适当评分族；实证中惩罚增大伴随宏F1上升但不显著，且基线是测试族的代数重标定，无法归因于优越性本身。
AI.motivation: 训练分类器时，验证指标决定了保留哪个模型及何时停止训练，因此一个自然要求是"优越性"：任何被正确分类的预测都应比任何错误分类的预测得分更高，无论底层概率多么接近。但Brier评分与对数评分单独均不满足该性质，而现有补救办法的惩罚仅由"正确预测得分上确界"这一端点标定，可能过大。作者希望精确刻画优越性的充要条件并给出最小必要惩罚。
AI.method: 1）指出优越性由两个端点决定：正确预测得分的上确界与错误预测得分的下确界，并为Brier与对数评分分别推导闭式表达式；2）两者之差定义为"最小惩罚"（infimal penalty），即恢复优越性所需惩罚的最大下界；3）将已发表惩罚与最小惩罚嵌入一个单参数族，并在单值平局约定下证明族中每个成员都是严格适当评分（strictly proper）；4）在预先设定的双数据集案例研究中，将不同惩罚用于十类（及一个四十七类）情形下的模型选择，比较所选模型的宏F1。
AI.result: 理论上，最小惩罚显著小于已发表惩罚：以Brier为基时，三类情形小4.00倍，二十类情形小2.11倍。实证上，在报告的两个十类情形中，平均所选模型宏F1随惩罚增大而上升，但在考虑种子/选择模式嵌套后无法与噪声区分；四十七类的第五个情形连这一描述性趋势也未复现。此外，所设计的"无优越性"基线在代数上只是被测族的重标定，故实验无法将观察到的模式专门归因于优越性。
AI.conclusion: 当目标就是优越性本身时，任何严格大于最小惩罚的惩罚都已充分；选择更大的惩罚属于独立的校准权衡，而非保证优越性的必要条件。该工作给出了端点与最小惩罚的精确闭式刻画，并揭示现有惩罚偏保守及其实证证据的局限性。

title: RFShape: An IQ-Pretrained Wireless Foundation Model for Heterogeneous IQ & CIR Representations
summary: In wireless systems, foundation models have been proposed as alternative artificial intelligence models to replace task-specific models with a shared pretrained model that can be reused across many downstream applications (source separation, interference detection, localization, etc.). These wireless foundation models promise to reuse learned representations across diverse tasks, but choosing a foundation model also means choosing its input representation. For example, a model pretrained on spectrograms expects spectrograms, while one pretrained on in-phase/quadrature (IQ) samples expects IQ, limiting which pretrained model can be used for a given downstream problem. To remedy this, we present RFShape, a 7.4 M-parameter foundation model that breaks this coupling by adapting how a signal is presented to a shared pretrained encoder. RFShape is pretrained solely on synthetic IQ waveforms, without real captures, labels, or channel impulse responses (CIRs), and uses deterministic representation operators to support heterogeneous downstream inputs. Across ten tasks and nine datasets unseen during pretraining, the same encoder supports classification, ranging-error regression, and two-dimensional positioning. Representation selection alone increases 23-class radar recognition from 23.0% to 69.5% and short-range technology recognition from 70.8% to 97.1%. RFShape also outperforms CIR-pretrained ultra-wideband baselines by up to 12.7 percentage points for (N)LOS classification despite never observing CIRs during pretraining. These results show that foundation-model reuse need not be limited by the representation or modality seen during pretraining, and adapting how a signal is presented can extend a single pretrained encoder across heterogeneous wireless tasks.

AI.tldr: RFShape 是一个仅用合成 IQ 波形预训练、通过可适配的表示算子解耦“输入表示”与“预训练编码器”的无线基座模型（7.4M 参数），在十个未见任务上支持分类、测距误差回归与二维定位。
AI.motivation: 无线基座模型旨在以单一共享预训练模型替代任务专用模型，但选择基座模型即锁定其输入表示（频谱图或 IQ），使同一编码器难以服务不同表示形式的下游问题。作者希望打破表示与模型之间的强耦合。
AI.method: 提出 RFShape：共享预训练编码器 + 确定性表示算子，将异质输入（IQ、频谱图、CIR 等）变换为编码器可接受的呈现方式。预训练仅依赖合成 IQ 波形，不使用真实采集、标签或 CIR。
AI.result: 10 个任务、9 个预训练未见数据集：同一编码器完成分类、测距误差回归与二维定位。仅更换表示即把 23 类雷达识别从 23.0% 提升至 69.5%，短距制式识别从 70.8% 提升至 97.1%；在 (N)LOS 分类上超过 CIR 预训练的 UWB 基线最多 12.7 个百分点，尽管预训练从未见过 CIR。
AI.conclusion: 基座模型的可复用性不必受预训练时表示或模态限制；通过适配信号的呈现方式，可将单一预训练编码器推广至异质无线任务。

title: Impedance-controlled Laser Dynamics in Near-Zero Index Media
summary: Near-zero-index (NZI) media have been explored for controlling spontaneous emission, but their impact on stimulated emission and lasing properties remains unexplored within their different classes, i.e., epsilon-near-zero (ENZ), mu-near-zero (MNZ), or epsilon-and-mu-near-zero (EMNZ). Here, we show theoretically that lasing emission depends on the class of NZI medium and can be controlled through its impedance. The major difference, as compared to conventional laser media, arises from the incorporation of dispersive electric and magnetic properties in the derivation of the Maxwell Boch equations. In this framework, the analysis of laser rate equation reveals that the ENZ class, with high impedance, can reduce the lasing threshold through enhanced electric-field interaction. Numerical simulations further show that the NZI class also governs the spectral response: whereas ENZ and MNZ classes suffer from multimode emission, the EMNZ class preserves single-mode emission.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究不同类别的近零折射率（NZI）介质对受激发射与激光特性的影响，表明激射行为取决于NZI类别并可通过其阻抗进行调控：高阻抗的ENZ类可降低激光阈值，而EMNZ类能保持单模发射。
AI.motivation: 近零折射率介质已被用于调控自发辐射，但其对受激发射及激光特性的影响，尤其是不同类别（ENZ、MNZ、EMNZ）之间的差异尚未被探索，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 将色散的电学与磁学性质纳入Maxwell-Bloch方程的推导中，在此框架下分析激光速率方程，并结合数值模拟考察不同NZI类别（ENZ、MNZ、EMNZ）的激射阈值与光谱响应。
AI.result: 高阻抗的ENZ类可通过增强电场相互作用降低激光阈值；NZI类别还决定光谱响应——ENZ与MNZ类出现多模发射，而EMNZ类保持单模发射。
AI.conclusion: 激射发射依赖于NZI介质的类别，并可通过其阻抗加以控制；与传统激光介质的主要差异源于色散的电、磁性质的引入。ENZ类利于降低阈值，EMNZ类利于维持单模工作。

title: Analog signal processing, storage, and demultiplexing via in-materia wave-based computing
summary: The ability of mechanical systems to perform basic computations has gained traction in recent years, providing a robust supplement to digital computing in off-grid, low-power, and extreme environments where electronics are inaccessible or risk failure. However, prior work has focused on Boolean logic applied via bistable structures, snap-through mechanisms, or origami lattices. Digital signal processing (DSP) underpins a wide range of computational tasks, providing the foundation for information encoding, manipulation, and analysis. In contrast to conventional DSP approaches, we present a new paradigm for analog information processing, where an elastic substrate houses a spatial wave-based platform for mechanical signal manipulation in the temporal domain. The proposed metasurface-based system exploits temperature-dependent phase transitions of shape memory alloys (SMAs) to realize key signal-processing functionalities, including gating, retention, and programmable delay of impinging mechanical loads. In doing so, we address a new set of challenges by manipulating transient mechanical waves through dispersive and lossy media. Building on this capability, we introduce the concept of mechanical wave-based memory, in which a locally resonant metamaterial's dispersion characteristics are actively reconfigured to achieve programmable delays while preserving spatial waveform integrity, and demonstrate its utility in the context of input shaping and frequency demultiplexing of superimposed waves. More broadly, the modular and scalable nature of the demonstrated framework paves the way for advanced mechanical computing architectures, enabling higher-order operations such as signal classification, parallel processing, and reservoir computing through the controlled sequencing and temporal alignment of mechanical signals.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于弹性基底与形状记忆合金（SMA）温控相变的超表面平台，以空间波形式对机械信号进行时域操控，实现门控、保持与可编程延迟，并构建机械波存储器概念，演示输入整形与频率解复用。
AI.motivation: 现有机械计算多局限于双稳态结构、跳跃机制或折纸点阵实现的布尔逻辑；而数字信号处理（DSP）所涵盖的信息编码、操作与分析功能，在机械域仍缺乏对应范式，尤其缺少在色散、有耗介质中操控瞬态机械波的手段。
AI.method: 以弹性基底承载空间波导式平台，利用形状记忆合金随温度变化的相变来主动重构局部共振超材料的色散特性，从而对入射机械载荷实施门控、信号保持与可编程延迟；通过调制色散与损耗实现瞬态波的时序操控，同时保持空间波形完整性。
AI.result: 实现了门控、保持与可编程延迟等关键信号处理功能；提出"机械波存储器"概念，可在可编程延迟下保持波形完整性，并成功应用于叠加波的输入整形与频率解复用。
AI.conclusion: 该框架模块化、可扩展，为高级机械计算架构奠定基础，有望通过机械信号的受控时序与时间对齐实现信号分类、并行处理与储备池计算等更高阶运算。

title: Coordinate Frame Recovery, Per Class NMS and Null Return Modelling for Sim2Real V2X LiDAR Detection
comment: 8 pages. 1st place, Track 7 (UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR, V2X-Real), DriveX Grand Challenge, ECCV 2026 Workshop. Code: https://github.com/amanupg/urbantwin-sim2real-v2x
summary: We describe our approach to the V2X-Real track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge, in which a 3D object detector must be trained exclusively on synthetic data and evaluated on unseen real roadside LiDAR from an Ouster OS1-64 unit, while the synthetic point clouds are simultaneously scored for distributional realism. Our final entry scores 0.7457 combined, from a detection mAP of 0.4382 and a realism score of 0.9251. Three findings account for most of our result, and all three were diagnostic rather than architectural. First, a coordinate frame mismatch between our predictions and the evaluation ground truth was suppressing detection AP entirely; recovering it took our score from 0.3520 to 0.5147 in a single submission. Second, a single global non maximum suppression threshold was destroying genuine pedestrian detections, because pedestrians occur in groups and a 0.3 IoU threshold applied to a 0.7 m box suppresses distinct neighbouring people; correcting this per class raised overall mAP from 0.0751 to 0.4295. Third, approximately 31 percent of the real reference point cloud consists of null returns encoded as the literal point (0, 0, 0), a format feature entirely absent from our synthetic clouds, which pinned Earth Mover's Distance near its floor until we modelled it. Negative results are reported at equal length, and Section 9 gives a full account of data provenance and compliance. That section also accounts for every mechanism contributing to the submitted score.

AI.tldr: 本文报告 UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR 挑战赛 V2X-Real 赛道的参赛方案：仅用合成数据训练 3D 检测器，在未见过的真实路侧 Ouster OS1-64 点云上评测，同时评估合成点云的分布真实性。最终综合得分 0.7457（检测 mAP 0.4382，真实性 0.9251）。
AI.motivation: Sim2Real 场景下合成数据训练的检测器迁移到真实路侧 LiDAR 存在域差异，且评测同时要求分布真实性，需要找出真正制约得分的瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者强调提分主要来自诊断性修正而非网络结构改动，共三项：一是修正预测与评测真值之间的坐标系不一致；二是按类别设置 NMS 阈值（原全局 0.3 IoU 在 0.7 m 行人框上会抑制相邻行人）；三是在合成点云中显式建模以 (0,0,0) 表示的无效回波（真实参考点云中约占 31%）。此外还报告了同等篇幅的负结果，并在第 9 节给出数据来源与合规性说明。
AI.result: 综合得分 0.7457。修正坐标系使得分由 0.3520 升至 0.5147；按类 NMS 使总体 mAP 由 0.0751 升至 0.4295；建模 (0,0,0) 无效点后 EMD 脱离下限。最终 mAP 0.4382、真实性得分 0.9251。
AI.conclusion: Sim2Real LiDAR 检测中，评测协议与数据表示层面的对齐（坐标系、按类 NMS、无效回波建模）比架构改动更能显著提升分数；论文同时完整报告负结果并说明数据合规性。

title: SLATE: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Long-Horizon API Selection in E-commerce Tool Use
comment: 20 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Camera-ready version for the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET). Project page: https://geshijoker.github.io/slate/
summary: Enterprises increasingly want LLM agents to automate standard operating procedures over their software stacks -- mapping each step of a procedure to the right call among thousands of internal APIs, without hand-authored step-to-API mappings. The core difficulty is API selection at scale: choosing and composing the correct tools over a long horizon, judged only by whether the overall task succeeds. Current tool-use benchmarks do not test this regime -- they expose only a handful of tools, evaluate single-step invocation, or grade multi-step behavior with subjective LLM-as-a-judge scores that penalize valid alternative trajectories. We introduce SLATE (Synthetic Large-scale API Toolkit for E-commerce), a large-scale benchmark that tests large-toolset, long-horizon API selection in a realistic enterprise domain. SLATE couples (i) queries decomposed into hierarchical, tool-grounded procedures over a ~1,000-tool e-commerce library, (ii) a deterministic, context-aware simulator that returns recorded outputs for matching calls and default responses otherwise, and (iii) an end-to-end task-success metric -- a task succeeds when it reaches every reference outcome -- that credits diverse-but-valid trajectories while remaining fully automatic and reproducible. Experiments with six open decision models and the language models they are built on, from 3B to 12B parameters, show that even the best model completes only 5.0% of the tasks, establishing SLATE as a challenging testbed for reliable enterprise tool use. We release SLATE, its simulator, and the evaluation harness at https://geshijoker.github.io/slate/

AI.tldr: 提出SLATE基准，用于测试约1000个工具规模下、多步长程的企业级API选择能力，最佳模型仅完成5.0%的任务。
AI.motivation: 企业希望LLM智能体无需手工编写步骤到API的映射即可自动化SOP，核心难点在于大规模工具集下的长程API选择与组合；现有基准仅暴露少量工具、评估单步调用，或用主观LLM-as-a-judge评分而惩罚有效的替代轨迹，无法覆盖该场景。
AI.method: 构建SLATE（面向电商的大规模合成API工具集）：（i）将查询分解为基于工具的分层过程，覆盖约1000个工具的电商库；（ii）确定性、上下文感知的模拟器，对匹配调用返回录制输出、否则返回默认响应；（iii）端到端任务成功指标——达到全部参考结果即成功，从而认可多样但有效的轨迹并保持自动、可复现。
AI.result: 在6个开源决策模型及其3B–12B基座模型上进行实验，表现最好的模型也仅完成5.0%的任务。
AI.conclusion: SLATE确立了大规模企业工具使用的高难度测试平台，并开源基准、模拟器与评估框架。

title: Training LLM Agents to Automate LLM Post-Training with RSI-Dojo
summary: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) aims to enable AI systems to autonomously build and improve AI systems themselves, including models, harnesses, and underlying infrastructure. Within this broader agenda, a central capability is enabling agents to train and improve base models. However, existing studies on automated model training primarily focused on workflow- or harness-level optimizations, rather than internalizing the ability to conduct post-training into the model itself. Developing this capability requires executable model training environments that can produce high-quality trajectories demonstrating how to select data, train models, diagnose failures, and iteratively improve results. In this paper, we introduce RSI-Dojo, a collection of executable model training environments designed to teach LLM agents to conduct post-training. To construct RSI-Dojo, we develop RSI-Craft, an automatic pipeline that converts human research artifacts into executable model training environments. RSI-Craft automatically collects research papers from top venues, instantiates datasets and metrics into a unified interface, and reproduces evaluation dependencies. It then filters tasks by data size, execution reliability, and discriminability, yielding RSI-Dojo with 281 seed model training tasks. Building on RSI-Dojo, we employ a trajectory collection method with an improved harness to collect high-quality model-training trajectories from frontier models, then retain examples through rubric-based and outcome-based filtering. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories. The resulting RSI-Dojo-9B and RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B improve over their base models by 8.74 and 16.87 PostTrainBench points, respectively. RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B reaches 29.95 on PostTrainBench and 53.29 on PostTrainBench-Lite, matching the performance of frontier models such as GLM-5.2 and GPT 5.5.

AI.tldr: 提出RSI-Dojo：一套可执行的模型训练环境集合，用于教会LLM智能体自主进行后训练；并给出自动构建流水线RSI-Craft，微调得到的RSI-Dojo-9B/35B-A3B在PostTrainBench上分别提升8.74和16.87分。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）需要智能体具备训练并改进基模型的能力，但现有自动化模型训练研究多停留在workflow/harness层面的优化，未将后训练能力内化到模型本身。培养该能力又缺乏可执行、高质量轨迹的训练环境。
AI.method: 构建RSI-Craft自动流水线：从顶会采集论文，将数据集与指标实例化到统一接口，复现评估依赖，再按数据规模、执行可靠性与可区分性过滤任务，得到含281个种子训练任务的RSI-Dojo。随后用改进harness的轨迹采集方法从前沿模型收集高质量训练轨迹，经基于评分准则与结果的双重过滤，微调Qwen3.5-9B与Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。
AI.result: RSI-Dojo-9B与RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B较基座分别提升8.74与16.87个PostTrainBench点；RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B达到PostTrainBench 29.95、PostTrainBench-Lite 53.29，与GLM-5.2、GPT 5.5等前沿模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 将后训练能力通过可执行环境与轨迹蒸馏内化到中小规模模型中，可获得媲美前沿模型的自动化模型训练能力，为RSI提供可扩展的数据与环境基础。

title: SSPE: Robust Sequential Staypoint Extraction in Degraded Trajectory Data
summary: Extracting semantically meaningful staypoints from raw trajectory streams is a foundational prerequisite for mobility analytics. However, real-world trajectory data is frequently degraded by severe spatial noise and protracted temporal dropouts. Classic threshold-based extraction methods, such as the widely adopted sliding-window algorithm, are highly sensitive to these anomalies, routinely fracturing continuous stationary episodes into disjointed fragments. To overcome this limitation, we propose the Sequential Staypoint Extraction (SSPE) algorithm. SSPE employs a resilient, state-driven architecture that replaces static spatial anchors with a dynamic centroid and introduces an $n$-step lookahead heuristic to structurally tolerate transient coordinate drift. Concurrently, it utilizes temporal bridging mechanisms to prevent artificial fragmentation during prolonged signal loss. Since optimal extraction parameters vary significantly across datasets, we further introduce a fully unsupervised, consensus-based parameter estimation framework. This framework derives baseline statistical scales directly from the raw trajectory data and identifies the optimal parameter configuration by maximizing structural agreement, thereby eliminating the reliance on annotated ground truth. We evaluate SSPE on the ExtraSensory dataset, a real-world mobility corpus with manually verified ground-truth staypoints, against the sliding-window implementation of Trackintel, one of the most widely adopted extraction baselines in the field. Empirical results demonstrate that SSPE achieves superior accuracy, yielding higher F1-scores while simultaneously improving computational efficiency over this standard.

AI.tldr: 提出顺序停留点提取算法SSPE，以状态驱动的动态质心替代静态空间锚点，结合n步前瞻与时间桥接机制容忍坐标漂移和信号中断，并配以无监督共识式参数估计框架，在ExtraSensory数据集上相较Trackintel滑窗基线取得更高F1与更高计算效率。
AI.motivation: 原始轨迹流常受严重空间噪声与长时间信号丢失影响，经典阈值类方法（如滑动窗口）对此高度敏感，会将连续停留事件切割为碎片，导致停留点（staypoint）提取不完整；同时最优参数随数据集差异显著，且难以依赖标注真值调参。
AI.method: 1）SSPE算法：采用状态驱动架构，以动态质心替代静态空间锚点，引入n步前瞻（n-step lookahead）启发式容忍瞬时坐标漂移，并用时间桥接机制防止长时间信号缺失造成的人为断裂；2）无监督共识式参数估计框架：从原始轨迹中导出基线统计尺度，通过最大化结构一致性选取最优参数配置，无需标注真值。
AI.result: 在具有人工核验停留点真值的ExtraSensory真实移动数据上，与Trackintel的滑动窗口实现对比，SSPE取得更高的F1分数，同时计算效率更高。
AI.conclusion: 状态驱动的顺序提取策略比静态阈值的滑窗方法对噪声与信号丢失更具鲁棒性，配合无监督共识参数估计可免除真值依赖，兼顾精度与效率，适合作为轨迹停留点提取的通用方案。

title: Positioning and Radiation Efficiency Degrees of Freedom in Cascaded Pinching-Antenna Arrays
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to the IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications
summary: In a pinching-antenna system (PASS), a single source feeds multiple pinches, resulting in a cascade that couples their radiated powers. A shared radiated-power limit, such as the interference power constraint in an underlay cognitive radio network, couples them again. We study such a network where PASS serves the secondary users. First, we formulate the joint optimization problem of the two degrees of freedom (DoF), pinch positions and radiation efficiencies, and characterize the single-link optimum analytically. Then, rather than proposing one method, we present the results for a grid of schemes whose two axes are the two DoF. Under an order-free attribution, positioning is worth 1.34 times radiation efficiency, and the two are near-perfect substitutes. We also show that substitutability is due to the constraint and not the cascade, since relaxing the constraint by 20 dB removes 97% of their interaction. At the joint reference, not knowing the primary receiver (PR) location costs 6.23 bit/s/Hz, more than twice the 2.87 that optimizing both DoF is worth. Instantaneous fading information adds a further 0.29 bit/s/Hz. Allocating efficiencies at equally spaced positions reaches 98% of the joint reference at about three orders of magnitude less computation.

AI.tldr: 研究PASS辅助的次用户网络，联合优化pinch位置与辐射效率两个自由度，刻画单链路最优解，并在由两自由度构成的方案网格上量化两者的价值与替代关系。
AI.motivation: PASS中单一源经级联向多个pinch馈电，使辐射功率相互耦合；共享辐射功率上限（如underlay认知无线电的干扰功率约束）又造成第二次耦合。需要厘清在此条件下pinch位置与辐射效率两个自由度各自的贡献及其可替代性。
AI.method: 建立pinch位置与辐射效率的联合优化问题并解析刻画单链路最优；不提出单一算法，而是在以两自由度为两轴的方案网格上给出结果；采用order-free归因量化两自由度贡献，并测试松弛约束（20 dB）以分离约束与级联的作用；比较PR位置信息、瞬时衰落信息带来的增益，以及等间距位置分配效率的低复杂度方案。
AI.result: order-free归因下定位价值约为辐射效率的1.34倍，二者近似完美替代；替代性源于功率约束而非级联，约束松弛20 dB后交互作用减少97%；联合参考点处，未知PR位置造成6.23 bit/s/Hz损失，超过同时优化两自由度所值的2.87；瞬时衰落信息额外带来0.29 bit/s/Hz；等间距位置分配效率以约低三个数量级的计算量达到联合参考的98%。
AI.conclusion: 在PASS次用户网络中，pinch位置与辐射效率高度可替代，其替代性由共享辐射功率约束驱动；PR位置信息是最主要的价值来源，而等间距效率分配可在极低计算量下逼近联合最优，为实际设计提供低成本方案。

title: LIPS-PC: Learning Illumination Patterns for Single-Pixel Classification
summary: In single-pixel (ghost) imaging, known illumination patterns probe an object and a detector with no spatial resolution returns one number per pattern. Each measurement costs acquisition time and photons and, for ionizing probes, contributes to delivered dose. Motivated by automated radiographic defect screening, where a class label suffices, we introduce Learning Illumination Patterns for Single-Pixel Classification (LIPS-PC). The patterns are learned end-to-end while the measurement operator remains one fixed linear matrix, identical for every input. We parameterize it as a residual correction to a two-dimensional discrete cosine transform (2D-DCT), $D=D_{\mathrm{base}}+Δ$, and jointly train the correction and a compact classifier using cross-entropy, without a reconstruction objective. This yields a task-driven linear embedding through optimization. We evaluate LIPS-PC numerically on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST under a controlled protocol, then on RIAWELC, a real industrial X-ray weld-radiograph dataset. Across five budgets, $M\in{8,16,32,64,128}$, corresponding to sampling ratios from below 1% to 12.5%, the learned operator outperforms the best tested fixed transform by 9-15 percentage points at $M=8$ on all three datasets. Its eight-measurement accuracy requires roughly 16-32 measurements with the best fixed transform, indicating a $2\times$ to $4\times$ saving at comparable accuracy. The advantage generally shrinks as $M$ increases, with a small reversal on RIAWELC at higher budgets. These results show that learning what to measure is especially valuable when measurements are scarce.

AI.tldr: 提出LIPS-PC：将单像素测量的固定线性算子参数化为2D-DCT的残差修正与紧凑分类器联合端到端训练（仅交叉熵，无重建损失），在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST与工业X射线焊缝片RIAWELC上，极低采样预算下显著优于最优固定变换。
AI.motivation: 单像素（鬼）成像中每次测量都消耗采集时间与光子，对电离探针还贡献辐照剂量；面向自动化射线缺陷筛检只需类标签而非图像，因此应"学该测什么"以减少测量数。
AI.method: 测量算子保持为对所有输入相同的单一固定线性矩阵，参数化为对2D-DCT的残差修正 D=D_base+Δ；用交叉熵联合训练Δ与紧凑分类器，不含重建目标，从而通过优化得到任务驱动的线性嵌入。在受控协议下于MNIST、Fashion-MNIST评估，并在真实工业X射线焊缝片RIAWELC上验证，预算 M∈{8,16,32,64,128}（采样率<1%至12.5%）。
AI.result: M=8 时在三数据集上比最佳固定变换高9–15个百分点；其8次测量精度需固定变换16–32次测量才能达到，等效2×–4×节省；优势随M增大而收窄，RIAWELC在高预算下出现小幅反转。
AI.conclusion: "学习测什么"在测量稀缺时价值最大；单一固定线性算子+任务驱动训练即可支撑低成本单像素分类，为免重建的缺陷筛检提供可行路径。

title: Camera Radar LiDAR Fusion via Point-Cloud Projection for Multi-Task Learning
comment: IEEE International Workshop on Signal Processing Systems 2026
summary: Autonomous vehicles require robust perception systems to operate safely under diverse environmental conditions. While cameras provide high-resolution visual data, their performance significantly degrades in low-light and adverse weather. High Definition (HD) radar offers superior reliability and angular resolution under such conditions but lacks rich visual feature recognition. LiDAR, though expensive, delivers highly precise distance measurements and dense point clouds. Each sensor exhibits unique trade-offs, necessitating the development of advanced sensor fusion algorithms to harness complementary strengths while minimizing computational complexity and maintaining accuracy. In this study, the proposed fusion architecture performs early fusion by combining camera images with perspective-view point cloud data from HD radar and LiDAR sensors. The proposed model is trained to detect vehicles and segment free drivable space simultaneously. Experiments are performed on the RADIal dataset where we demonstrate that fusing point cloud data with camera images in front-view surpasses the performances of the most recent standalone and fusion models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种前视图早期融合架构，将相机图像与HD雷达、LiDAR的透视图点云结合，同时完成车辆检测与可行驶空间分割。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶感知需在低光、恶劣天气等条件下保持鲁棒。相机分辨率高但鲁棒性差，HD雷达可靠且角分辨率好但缺乏视觉特征，LiDAR精度高但昂贵，各传感器存在独特权衡，需通过融合算法互补优势并控制计算复杂度。
AI.method: 采用早期融合策略（early fusion），将相机图像与HD雷达及LiDAR的透视图（perspective-view）点云数据在前视图空间直接融合，构建统一融合架构；模型以多任务方式训练，同时进行车辆检测与自由可行驶空间分割，并在RADIal数据集上验证。
AI.result: 在RADIal数据集上，将点云数据与相机图像在前视图融合的性能超过当前最新的单模态模型与融合模型。
AI.conclusion: 相机+HD雷达/LiDAR前视图早期融合可有效提升感知精度，兼顾鲁棒性与实用性，是多传感器融合感知的可行方案。

title: FlagRot: Selective Rotation for Low-Bit KV Caches
summary: Long-context inference is bound by the KV cache, which 2-bit codes could shrink about sixfold if their error stays in check. The usual remedy rotates keys before quantizing, assuming rotation always helps. However, we observe that it does not: rotation flattens a spiky piece of a key but can give a flat one a new peak, and both coexist within one key. We therefore propose FlagRot, which stores each 32-channel piece rotated or as is, whichever has the smaller calibrated attention error, and rotates the query instead when reading. We further show that how often to decide follows the quantization axis: per-channel caches such as KIVI need one decision per head, at no write cost, while per-token caches decide per key, with the choice stored in existing sign bits. At 2.5 bits per value, FlagRot lowers the twelve-model KL divergence of KIVI from 18.7 to 12.4 x 10^-3, below RotateKV on 9 of 12 models. Served as a vLLM plugin, it raises RULER at 128k tokens by +2.9 points and the LongBench v1 mean by +0.4 to +1.9 points on the three of four models where 2-bit KIVI loses accuracy. It also lowers the error of 4-bit integer and FP4 caches.

AI.tldr: 提出FlagRot：对每个32通道分段自适应决定是否旋转（或原样存储），读时改旋转query，缓解2-bit KV cache量化误差。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理受KV cache瓶颈限制，2-bit量化可压缩约6倍，但前提是误差可控。常规做法在量化前对key做旋转并默认"旋转总是有益"，作者观察到该假设不成立：旋转会把尖峰段变平，却也可能给原本平坦的段制造新峰，且两种情形可共存于同一key内。
AI.method: FlagRot将每个key按32通道分段，依据标定的注意力误差，决定该段存储旋转后版本还是原样版本；读取时改为对query做相应旋转。并给出决策粒度与量化轴一致的规则：per-channel缓存（如KIVI）每头一次决策、无额外写入开销；per-token缓存则逐key决策，标志位复用现有符号位存储。
AI.result: 2.5 bit/值下，12个模型上KIVI的平均KL散度由18.7降至12.4×10^-3，在9/12个模型上优于RotateKV。作为vLLM插件部署后，128k token下RULER提升+2.9点；在2-bit KIVI掉点的4个模型中的3个上，LongBench v1均值提升+0.4至+1.9点。同时降低4-bit整型与FP4缓存的误差。
AI.conclusion: 旋转并非普遍有益，按分段自适应选择旋转与否可获得更低的量化误差，且决策粒度应与量化轴匹配、标志位可零开销复用；该方法对多种低位格式（2-bit、4-bit整型、FP4）均有效。

title: Unsatz: Evaluating Scientific Discovery Without a Given Ansatz
summary: Before a scientist fits any parameter, they must decide what the model contains: which quantities exist, which are hidden, how they interact, and how they are measured. Physicists call such a trial form an ansatz. Benchmarks for automated equation discovery mostly supply it, by fixing the variables, a library of candidate terms, or a law to be modified. We introduce Unsatz, a benchmark in which an LLM agent must construct the ansatz itself. Each task is a simulated system, generated from a private seed as a program in a small modeling language: ordinary, delay, or partial differential equations, discrete maps, static and causal models, or stochastic processes, possibly with hidden states, distorted sensors, and uninformative measurement channels. The agent buys experiments within a budget, writes candidate programs in the same language, obtains their coefficients from the benchmark's fitter, and is scored only on how its final program predicts experiments it never saw: conditions outside the range it could explore, interventions, and longer runs. Across 80 systems in 20 domains, nine language models solve between 21% and 60%. On 44 of these systems, classical equation-discovery methods almost never succeed, although the same data usually suffice once the true equations are given with unknown coefficients; the difficulty lies in finding the structure, not in estimating it. Because mechanisms recur across systems, we also give agents the program they discovered for a related system; it helped only when the new system shared the mechanism and the first investigation had succeeded. Stronger agents make fewer unscientific errors; beyond these, agents find which variables a system has but not how they act, and prefer revisions that lower the training error to revisions that predict better.

AI.tldr: 提出 Unsatz 基准，要求 LLM 智能体在无预设变量/候选项库的条件下自行构造模型 ansatz，并以对未见实验的预测性能作为唯一评分标准。
AI.motivation: 现有自动方程发现基准大多直接给定 ansatz（固定变量、候选项库或待修改的定律），把最困难的"模型结构选择"环节替研究者做完了；而真实科学发现中，决定模型包含哪些量、哪些是隐变量、如何相互作用与测量，才是核心难点。
AI.method: 每个任务是由私有种子生成的小型建模语言程序所描述的仿真系统，涵盖常微分/时滞/偏微分方程、离散映射、静态与因果模型、随机过程，并可含隐状态、失真传感器与无信息测量通道。智能体在预算内购买实验，用同一语言写出候选程序，由基准提供的拟合器求解系数，最终仅以其程序对未见过实验（超出可探索范围的条件、干预、更长时程）的预测表现评分。共 80 个系统、20 个领域，评测九个语言模型，并与经典方程发现方法对比，另设"给定相关系统已发现程序"的迁移设置。
AI.result: 九个语言模型解出 21%–60% 的任务；在 44 个系统上经典方程发现方法几乎从不成功，而一旦给定真实方程、仅系数未知，同样的数据通常足以完成任务，说明难度在结构搜索而非参数估计。跨系统迁移仅在机制相同且前次探索成功时才有帮助。更强智能体能少犯不科学的错误，但仍能识别系统有哪些变量、却无法确定其作用方式，并倾向于选择降低训练误差而非提升预测的修改。
AI.conclusion: 将 ansatz 构造本身作为评测对象，揭示了当前 LLM 智能体在科学建模中的真实瓶颈：结构假设生成与外推预测导向的模型修正能力，而非系数拟合。

title: RATSIFT: Resolution-Adaptive Transformer for Solar Irradiance Forecasting and Temporal Downscaling
summary: Accurate forecasting and temporal downscaling of solar irradiance is critical for reliable renewable energy integration and grid management. Traditional methods often struggle to capture rapid irradiance variability. In this work, we develop a Transformer-based architecture for simultaneous forecasting and temporal downscaling. The model takes input data at arbitrary resolutions and generates outputs at any resolutions represented within the training data, leveraging both global and local contextual information. To improve training efficiency, a genetic algorithm-based optimization framework is implemented to identify suitable model hyperparameters, while reducing the computational cost of exhaustive grid search. The effectiveness of the proposed model is shown by analyzing real data in Dallas, Texas. The proposed model achieved root mean square error (RMSE) values of 28.785, 29.544, 30.157, 32.132~W/m\(^2\) for 15-, 30-, 60-minute, and irregularly spaced global input and producing forecast at 5-minutes resolution, respectively. Furthermore, this model produced reliable uncertainty estimates, exhibiting wider prediction intervals for high-resolution inputs during volatile solar conditions, whereas coarser-resolution inputs result in narrower intervals and significantly lower training time and computational cost. Our approach provides a scalable and efficient framework for multi-resolution solar irradiance forecasting and temporal downscaling, suitable for practical energy forecasting and grid management applications.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种基于Transformer的架构，可同时进行太阳辐照度预测与时间下采样（downscaling），输入可为任意分辨率，输出为训练数据中出现的任意分辨率；并用遗传算法优化超参数以降低搜索成本。在德州达拉斯实测数据上，5分钟分辨率预测的RMSE分别为28.785、29.544、30.157、32.132 W/m²（对应15/30/60分钟及不规则间隔输入），并给出可靠的不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 太阳辐照度的精确预测与时间下采样对可再生能源并网与电网调度至关重要；传统方法难以刻画辐照度的快速波动，且缺乏跨分辨率建模的灵活性与训练效率。
AI.method: 构建Transformer架构统一完成预测与时间下采样，同时利用全局与局部上下文信息，支持任意分辨率输入并输出训练数据涵盖的任意分辨率；采用遗传算法优化框架挑选超参数，替代计算代价高的网格搜索。
AI.result: 在德州达拉斯实测数据上，由15、30、60分钟及不规则间隔全局输入预测5分钟分辨率时，RMSE分别为28.785、29.544、30.157、32.132 W/m²；模型给出可靠的不确定性估计，辐照波动剧烈时高分辨率输入的预测区间更宽，粗分辨率输入区间更窄且训练时间与计算成本显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为多分辨率太阳辐照度预测与时间下采样提供了可扩展、高效的框架，适用于实际能源预测与电网管理应用。

title: Reconfigurable Antenna-Enhanced ISAC: A Unified Perspective on Electromagnetic Adaptation
summary: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables sensing and communication (S&C) functions to share time, frequency, and hardware resources, offering an efficient paradigm for next-generation wireless systems. However, conventional fixed-configuration antenna (FCA) architectures provide limited flexibility in adapting the physical electromagnetic (EM) response of the end-to-end wireless link. This article develops a unified EM-adaptation perspective on reconfigurable antenna (RA)-enhanced ISAC systems. We distinguish transceiver-side (TSc-side) and environment-side (Env-side) RA deployments and identify five fundamental EM reconfiguration dimensions: position, orientation, radiation pattern, polarization, and frequency response. Building on this framework, we examine how these dimensions customize communication channels, actively control target information mapping for sensing, and reshape the interplay between S&C, particularly by improving compatibility between S&C requirements under shared resources. Two case studies illustrate how TSc-side and Env-side EM reconfiguration can improve spatial selectivity and the achievable S&C performance tradeoff. Finally, we discuss several promising directions for advancing RA-enhanced ISAC systems, including fundamental performance limits, low-overhead black-box optimization, and artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled semantic ISAC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的电磁适配视角，用于分析可重构天线（RA）增强的通感一体化（ISAC）系统，区分收发射机侧与环境侧部署，归纳位置、朝向、辐射方向图、极化与频率响应五个基本电磁重构维度。
AI.motivation: 传统固定构型天线（FCA）架构无法灵活调节端到端无线链路的物理电磁响应，限制了ISAC在共享时频与硬件资源下同时满足感知与通信需求的能力。
AI.method: 综述/框架性研究：区分收发端（TSc-side）与环境端（Env-side）RA部署，建立五维电磁重构分类框架，分析各维度如何定制通信信道、主动控制感知目标信息映射并重塑S&C交互关系，并结合两个案例研究加以说明。
AI.result: 两个案例研究表明，TSc侧与Env侧电磁重构均可提升空间选择性，并改善可达的S&C性能折中。
AI.conclusion: RA增强ISAC具有显著潜力；未来方向包括基础性能极限、低开销黑盒优化以及AI赋能的语义ISAC。

title: Observation of pseudospin-locked chiral edge transport in gyromagnetic photonic crystals
summary: Photonic pseudospins enable selective excitation and routing of light, but perturbations that mix opposite pseudospins can induce backscattering in helical edge channels. Here, we experimentally demonstrate pseudospin-locked chiral edge transport in gyromagnetic photonic crystals, combining pseudospin selectivity with nonreciprocal unidirectional propagation. By jointly engineering lattice deformation and magnetic bias, we control dipolar-quadrupolar band inversions and construct interfaces supporting pseudospin-selective chiral channels. Microwave near-field and transmission measurements reveal a single chiral edge branch that is selectively excited by only one source handedness and exhibits pronounced nonreciprocal transport. Extending this mechanism to multidomain structures, we combine two pseudospin channels into a common waveguide, separate them into distinct outputs, and route them through intersecting interfaces. These configurations realize a nonreciprocal photonic pseudospin multiplexer and demultiplexer, together with a waveguide crossing exhibiting average measured crosstalk of -14.1 and -15.8 dB for its two input channels. Our results present an experimental route to integrating pseudospin-selective channel control with chiral edge transport, providing a foundation for nonreciprocal photonic networks that use pseudospin to organize and route multiple wave channels.

AI.tldr: 在旋磁光子晶体中实验实现"赝自旋锁定的手征边缘输运"，将赝自旋选择性与非互易单向传播结合，并构建非互易赝自旋复用/解复用器与波导交叉。
AI.motivation: 光子赝自旋可实现光的选择性激发与路由，但混合相反赝自旋的微扰会在螺旋边缘通道中引起背散射，限制传输鲁棒性；需要把赝自旋选择性与手征（非互易、单向）边缘输运统一起来。
AI.method: 采用旋磁光子晶体，通过晶格形变与磁偏置的协同设计调控偶极—四极能带反转，构建支持赝自旋选择性手征通道的界面；利用微波近场扫描与透射测量表征；并推广到多畴结构，实现双通道合波、分波与交叉路由。
AI.result: 观测到单一手征边缘支，仅由一种源手性选择性激发，并表现出显著非互易输运；多畴结构实现非互易光子赝自旋复用器与解复用器，以及波导交叉，两输入通道平均实测串扰为−14.1 dB和−15.8 dB。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果给出了将赝自旋选择性通道调控与手征边缘输运相集成的可行途径，为以赝自旋组织与路由多波信道的非互易光子网络奠定基础。

title: Do We Still Need Rotation-Invariant Architectures? A Statistical Robustness Benchmark for Point Cloud Classification
comment: Accepted to 2nd Round of WACV 2027, 24 pages (8 main + appendix). Website: https://abdullah-nasir-chowdhury.github.io/projects/wacv2027/
summary: A substantial line of work builds rotation invariance directly into point cloud architectures. We benchmark 10 architectures (PointNet, PointNet++, DGCNN, RIConv, RIConv++, RISurConv, PointMLP, PointTransformer, and the equivariant VN-PointNet and VN-DGCNN) across 5 domains under pose, noise, and occlusion, and analyze the results with confirmatory hypothesis tests rather than point estimates. The three rotation-invariant (RI) architectures achieve the best pose robustness but rank among the lowest on noise robustness in 4 of 5 domains. We ask whether this cost is intrinsic to invariance or specific to how invariance is obtained. We retrain all 10 architectures unchanged, with a simple invariance loss on the embedding and three training seeds each, and evaluate all models on the independently designed ModelNet40-C. Invariance training transfers narrowly but reliably. It improves exactly the corruption families its perturbations target wherever the baseline has headroom (mean occlusion +10.5, lidar +13.4 percentage points of accuracy). At matched training budget the best standard backbone and the best RI architecture end on par on unseen corruptions (within 2.5 percentage points in every seed), and invariance-trained RIConv++ is the most seed-stable top model. Once rotation augmentation is widened, standard backbones concede only a flat, angle-independent accuracy offset under full-sphere rotation. We release the benchmark along with a package for analyzing point cloud robustness and reproducing our results.

AI.tldr: 对10种点云架构在5个域、姿态/噪声/遮挡扰动下做基准测试并用确认性假设检验分析，发现旋转不变性（RI）与噪声鲁棒性存在权衡；通过在embedding上加简单不变性损失重训，证明该代价来源而非不变性本身，并给出可复现的基准与分析包。
AI.motivation: 大量工作将旋转不变性直接嵌入点云架构，但缺乏系统性、统计学严谨的跨架构对比，且"不变性是否以牺牲其他鲁棒性为代价"这一关键问题尚未被澄清。
AI.method: 在5个域、姿态/噪声/遮挡三类扰动下基准测试10种架构（含RI与非RI、等变VN-PointNet/VN-DGCNN），用确认性假设检验替代点估计；随后在embedding上加简单不变性损失、三种随机种子、不改架构重训全部模型，并在独立设计的ModelNet40-C上评估；另考察加宽旋转增强后标准骨干在全球旋转下的表现。
AI.result: 3种RI架构姿态鲁棒性最佳，但在5个域中的4个上噪声鲁棒性排名靠后；不变性训练迁移"窄而稳"，在其扰动所针对的corruption族上有提升（遮挡+10.5、lidar+13.4个百分点）；同训练预算下最佳标准骨干与最佳RI架构在未见corruption上持平（每seed差距≤2.5个百分点），不变性训练后的RIConv++种子稳定性最好；加宽旋转增强后标准骨干在全球旋转下仅呈平坦、与角度无关的精度偏移。
AI.conclusion: 旋转不变性的鲁棒性代价并非内生于不变性，而取决于不变性的获取方式；不变性训练可作为窄域但可靠的提升手段，且旋转增强可缩小标准骨干与RI架构差距。释放基准与分析包以支持复现。

title: Whose startup does the AI back? An algorithm audit of reputation and demographic signals in LLM-assisted crowdfunding
comment: 36 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables; includes online appendix. Accepted manuscript of the article published in Journal of Business Venturing Insights 26 (2026) e00682. Data, design files and code: https://github.com/Mirza-Samad-Ahmed-Baig/Whose-startup-does-the-AI-back-
summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly advise backers on which crowdfunding campaigns to support. LLMs have known race and gender problems, and it is unsettled whether they reproduce, erase, or reverse the discrimination documented in entrepreneurial finance. We ask when, and through which decision process, LLM assistants use founders' gender and ethnicity. In a pre-specified choice-based conjoint experiment, seven LLMs chose among five synthetic campaigns with independently randomized quality signals and founder names, under three backer personas and a persona-free control (40,248 responses). By default, founder names barely matter: under budget-conscious and delivery-focused personas, gender and Black-name effects are statistically equivalent to zero. When the backer wants to support underrepresented creators, the models favor Black-signaled (+8.1 percentage points; positive in all seven models) and female-signaled (+5.1) founders. They do so most strongly among near-tied campaigns and for the founder who alone carries the signal, and they almost never name gender or ethnicity in their reasons. The results fit an agency account of algorithmic discrimination: an aligned assistant takes its demographic preferences from its user rather than from its training data.

AI.tldr: 通过预注册的基于选择的联合实验（40,248次响应）检验七个LLM助手何时、经由何种决策过程使用创始人的性别与族裔信息。默认情况下创始人姓名几乎不影响选择；仅当用户表露"支持代表性不足创作者"的意图时，模型才偏好族裔与性别信号（+8.1pp、+5.1pp），且在理由中几乎不提及性别或族裔。结果支持"代理式算法歧视"解释：对齐助手从用户而非训练数据中获取人口学偏好。
AI.motivation: LLM助手日益为众筹支持者提供投资建议，而LLM存在已知的种族与性别问题；创业融资文献中的歧视究竟是会被LLM复制、抹除还是反转尚无定论，故需明确LLM在何时、通过何种决策机制使用创始人的性别与族裔信息。
AI.method: 预注册的基于选择的联合实验（choice-based conjoint）。构造五个合成众筹项目，质量信号与创始人姓名独立随机化；七种LLM在三种支持者人格设定及一个无人格对照下进行选择，共40,248次响应，用以估计性别与族裔主效应、边际效应及决策过程的异质性。
AI.result: 默认条件下创始人姓名几乎无影响：在"预算敏感"与"重交付"人格下，性别与"黑人姓名"效应统计上等同于零。当支持者希望支持代表性不足的创作者时，模型偏好族裔信号（+8.1个百分点，七模型全为正）与女性信号（+5.1个百分点）创始人；该效应在项目质量接近持平时最强，且集中于唯一携带该信号的创始人；模型在解释理由中几乎从不提及性别或族裔。
AI.conclusion: LLM的人口学偏好主要源自用户意图而非训练数据，符合"代理式算法歧视"（agency account）解释：对齐的助手以用户为偏好来源。启示是歧视评估需以用户意图为条件，并关注模型"隐性使用、显性沉默"的决策过程。

title: Counterexample-driven autonomous research with application to excess radiated energy in a Z-pinch
comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables; code at https://github.com/tomzhu0225/simjecture
summary: Recent breakthroughs in artificial-intelligence-assisted mathematics show that open-ended machine search can outperform human mathematicians, yet transferring this paradigm to physics requires refactoring the research workflow. We introduce Simjecture, an open-source framework in which language-model agents pursue human-defined physical conjectures. The framework tackles two central challenges in this transfer: first, because physics is empirical and no model is final, it structures inquiry around counterexample-driven falsification and prospective hypothesis repair; second, because physical theories must interact with the real world, it uses computational physics as an executable testbed while separating the qualification of numerical instruments from scientific claim review so solvers and diagnostics can be adapted within a recorded investigation. We apply the framework in an 82.6 h investigation to tackle the long-standing problem of radiated energy exceeding the imploding-shell kinetic energy in a Z-pinch. The investigation reveals competing effects of energy conversion, retention, and release timing. Stronger coherent helical deformation increases resistive conversion while reducing radiation and increasing retained energy. A broader trailing-plasma profile delays the later radiation maximum and recovers much of its early bolometric deficit, with a spectral response that changes during the pulse. These results provide new insight into energy conversion in high-energy-density plasma physics and demonstrate a new paradigm for physics research.

AI.tldr: 提出开源框架Simjecture，让语言模型智能体围绕人类设定的物理猜想开展研究，以"反例驱动证伪+前瞻性假设修复"组织探究，并以计算物理作为可执行测试台；在82.6小时针对Z箍缩"辐射能超过内爆壳动能"难题的研究中发现能量转换、滞留与释放时序的竞争效应。
AI.motivation: AI辅助数学已证明开放式机器搜索可超越人类数学家，但将该范式迁移到物理学存在结构性障碍：物理是经验性的、没有终极模型；物理理论必须与现实世界交互。因此需要重构物理研究流程。
AI.method: 提出Simjecture开源框架：由语言模型智能体围绕人定义的物理猜想自主探究；以反例驱动的证伪与前瞻性假设修复构建研究循环；以计算物理为可执行测试台，并将"数值工具资格认定"与"科学主张评审"分离，使求解器与诊断工具可在被记录的研究过程中迭代适配。应用于Z箍缩内爆壳能量收支问题，历时82.6小时。
AI.result: 揭示能量转换、滞留与释放时序之间的竞争效应：更强的相干螺旋形变提高电阻性转换，同时降低辐射并增加滞留能量；更宽的拖尾等离子体剖面使后期辐射峰值推迟，并弥补早期量热测量的大部分亏缺，且谱响应在脉冲期间发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 结果为高能量密度等离子体物理中的能量转换提供了新认识，并展示了AI智能体驱动、计算物理为测试台的物理学研究新范式。

title: CaRe-KT: Continuity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Knowledge Tracing
summary: Knowledge tracing (KT) estimates learners' evolving knowledge states from interaction histories to support adaptive learning. Retrieval-augmented KT improves these estimates using cross-learner behavioral evidence, but existing approaches typically separate evidence retrieval from downstream prediction. This creates a retrieval-inference alignment gap because evidence relevance varies with the learner's evolving state and prediction context. We propose CaRe-KT, a query-adaptive framework that maintains relevance continuity between evidence acquisition and inference without equating retrieval relevance with predictive utility. CaRe-KT introduces an Evidence-Graph Cache (EGC) that combines persistent question-level relational compatibility with interaction-level temporal validity to construct query-specific evidence subgraphs. Historical learning trajectories retrieved through these subgraphs are encoded alongside the target learner's history in a shared representation space using outcome-supervised contrastive learning. An attention mechanism combines acquisition relevance with learned query-evidence compatibility, allowing relevance to inform, rather than determine, each trajectory's predictive influence. Experiments across five benchmarks show that CaRe-KT outperforms strong KT baselines and remains robust under sparse-history and cold-start conditions. These findings support relevance continuity as a design principle for retrieval-augmented knowledge tracing.

AI.tldr: 提出CaRe-KT，一个查询自适应的检索增强知识追踪框架，通过证据图缓存与对比学习维持"相关性连续性"，弥合证据检索与预测推断之间的对齐鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强知识追踪将证据检索与下游预测分离，导致"检索-推断对齐鸿沟"：证据相关性随学习者知识状态的演化和预测上下文而变化，静态检索到的证据未必对预测有用。
AI.method: 1) 证据图缓存（EGC）：结合持久的题目级关系兼容性与交互级时序有效性，为每个查询构建特定的证据子图；2) 通过子图检索的历史学习轨迹与目标学习者历史在共享表示空间中以结果监督的对比学习进行编码；3) 注意力机制将获取相关性与学习到的查询-证据兼容性结合，使相关性"引导"而非"决定"每条轨迹的预测影响。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上优于强知识追踪基线，并在稀疏历史与冷启动条件下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持将"相关性连续性"作为检索增强知识追踪的设计原则，即检索相关性与预测效用不应等同，需在证据获取与推断间保持连续性。

title: Toward Generalized LEO Channel Prediction: A Rapid Adaptation Time-Frequency Mamba Framework
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM) 2026
summary: Accurate channel state information (CSI) prediction is pivotal for enhancing system capacity in low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite-terrestrial communications within the sixth-generation vision of global ubiquitous connectivity. However, the extreme mobility of LEO satellites, coupled with significant propagation delays, induces severe channel aging. Existing deep learning (DL) methods often struggle with non-stationary dynamics or generalize poorly across diverse global geographies. To address these challenges, we design the Evo-TFMamba, which is an evolutionary framework integrating time-frequency selective Mamba blocks with meta-learning for generalized CSI prediction. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed Evo-TFMamba performs adaptive prediction according to the geographic coverage of LEO satellites. Meanwhile, it significantly enhances the model's generalization ability, particularly when faced with unseen channel environments in LEO satellite communication.

AI.tldr: 提出Evo-TFMamba，将时频选择性Mamba块与元学习融合为进化式框架，用于LEO星地通信中泛化性强的CSI预测。
AI.motivation: LEO卫星高速移动与大传播时延导致严重信道老化；现有深度学习CSI预测方法难以应对非平稳动态，且在全球不同地理区域上泛化能力差。
AI.method: 设计Evo-TFMamba框架：以时频选择性Mamba块（time-frequency selective Mamba blocks）建模信道序列，并结合元学习（meta-learning）实现跨地理环境的广义CSI预测与快速自适应。
AI.result: 实验表明Evo-TFMamba能依据LEO卫星的地理覆盖范围进行自适应预测，并显著提升模型泛化能力，尤其在面对未见过的LEO卫星通信信道环境时表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 时频选择性Mamba与元学习的结合可有效缓解信道老化与非平稳性问题，为全球覆盖场景下LEO星地通信提供具备强泛化性的CSI预测方案。

title: Generalized Lorentz Framework for Active Semiconductor Quantum Surface Plasmonics
summary: Nanostructured semiconductors provide an actively tunable platform for light-matter interactions across a broad spectral range. As feature sizes shrink to the deep nanoscale (~10 nm scale), nonclassical carrier dynamics and surface plasmonic responses become prominent, creating substantial challenges for a rigorous and efficient theoretical treatment. Here we develop a generalized Lorentz framework for quantum surface plasmonics in nanostructured semiconductors with arbitrary energymomentum dispersion relations. The framework enables efficient quantitative treatment of carrier nonlocality, carrier surface accumulation and depletion, and nonlocal damping in three-dimensional semiconductor nanostructures, under electrical tuning and across a wide range of doping densities. Building on this framework, we further establish a rigorous quasinormal-mode analysis that provides transparent physical insight into complex surface plasmonic responses of multiscale semiconductor structures. We demonstrate electrically controlled deep-nanoscale carrier accumulation and depletion in a semiconductor nanoantenna, leading to pronounced plasmonic-response modulation that can be interpreted in terms of eigenmode shifts, creation, and annihilation. By quantifying and linking complex nonclassical carrier dynamics with plasmonic eigenmodes, our work establishes a comprehensive quantitative framework for active semiconductor quantum surface plasmonics and will foster the convergence of electronics and photonics at the deep nanoscale.

AI.tldr: 提出广义Lorentz框架，可高效定量处理半导体纳米结构中的载流子非局域性、表面积累/耗尽与非局域阻尼，并结合准正规模分析揭示电调控等离激元的本征模移动、产生与湮灭。
AI.motivation: 特征尺寸缩小至约10 nm时，非经典载流子动力学与表面等离激元响应凸显，亟需兼具严格性与高效性的理论方法，用于任意能带色散下三维半导体纳米结构的量子表面等离激元描述。
AI.method: 构建适用于任意能量-动量色散关系的广义Lorentz理论框架，将载流子非局域性、表面累积与耗尽、非局域阻尼纳入统一处理；在此框架上建立严格的准正规模（quasinormal-mode）分析，用于多尺度结构的复等离激元响应解析。
AI.result: 在半导体纳米天线中实现电控深纳米尺度载流子累积与耗尽，获得显著的等离激元响应调制，并可用本征模的移动、产生与湮灭加以解释；框架在宽掺杂浓度范围与电调谐条件下均有效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将复杂非经典载流子动力学与等离激元本征模定量关联，建立了主动半导体量子表面等离激元的综合理论框架，有望推动深纳米尺度上电子学与光子学的融合。

title: SurgEye: Instruction Tuning-Free Perception-Reasoning Framework for Surgical Scene Understanding
summary: Surgical scene understanding is pivotal for computer-assisted intervention, yet demands compositional reasoning across instruments, anatomy, and workflow. Existing surgical vision-language models rely on instruction tuning with large-scale question-answer pairs, entailing laborious data curation and costly retraining. To bridge this gap, we propose SurgEye, a perception-reasoning framework that grounds reasoning in a vision foundation model without instruction tuning. Specifically, we devise Routed Multi-Task Perception (RMP) that routes the vision foundation model through task-specific pathways learned from public perception labels, producing spatial and temporal evidence. We further introduce Agentic Compositional Reasoning (ACR) that employs a frozen large language model to coordinate RMP specialists and temporal memory as callable tools, composing evidence across tasks and time into grounded answers. Moreover, we construct SurgEye-Bench spanning eight surgical procedures, pairing each question with perception labels for verifiable evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SurgEye outperforms state-of-the-arts in surgical reasoning. The source code will be available.

AI.tldr: SurgEye：免指令微调的感知-推理框架，通过路由多任务感知（RMP）与智能体式组合推理（ACR）实现手术场景的可组合理解，并构建 SurgEye-Bench 基准。
AI.motivation: 手术场景理解需要跨器械、解剖结构与工作流的组合式推理。现有手术视觉-语言模型依赖大规模问答对进行指令微调，数据标注成本高、重训练代价大。
AI.method: 提出 RMP，利用公开感知标签学习任务特定路径，将视觉基础模型路由为空间与时间证据生成器；引入 ACR，用冻结的大语言模型将 RMP 专家与时间记忆作为可调用工具进行协调，跨任务、跨时间组合证据并给出有依据的答案；构建覆盖八类手术流程、每题配感知标签可验证评估的 SurgEye-Bench。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SurgEye 在手术推理任务上优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 以感知标签驱动的多任务路由加冻结大模型工具编排，可替代指令微调范式，实现可验证、免重训练的手术视觉-语言推理。

title: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
summary: We introduce Dory1.0-4B, a 4-billion-parameter looped (latent-recurrent) language model with elastic depth: a single checkpoint serves different inference compute budgets. Dory1.0-4B is built on a normalized Transformer (nGPT) backbone with interleaved sliding-window and full-attention layers, organized into an input block, a shared recurrent block, and an output block. At inference, the recurrent block can be applied a variable number of times. We pre-trained Dory1.0-4B on 6 trillion tokens. The first 4.5 trillion tokens were trained in NVFP4, and additional pre-training then extended the context length to 256K tokens. Next, we post-trained the model using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), with a difficulty-aware loop curriculum that routes harder prompts to deeper loops. Increasing the loop count improves accuracy, with the largest gains on coding, agentic, and long-context benchmarks. With two or more loops, Dory1.0-4B outperforms larger models such as Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma 4 12B, and Gemma 4 26B-A4B on average across 12 benchmarks. Looping also makes Dory1.0-4B more token-efficient on agentic benchmarks: with four loops, it generates 1.3-2.5x fewer tokens than with one loop, as the extra computation is spent in latent space rather than on longer outputs. To reduce memory during looping, Dory1.0-4B caches keys and values only from the last loop, keeping its KV-cache footprint equal to that of a non-looped model at any loop count while retaining most of the accuracy gains. We open-source the BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4, and GGUF quantized checkpoints.

AI.tldr: Dory1.0-4B 是一个 4B 参数的循环（隐状态递归）语言模型，具有弹性深度——单一检查点可通过改变循环次数适配不同推理算力预算；两圈以上即在 12 项基准上平均超越更大的 Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma 4 12B 与 Gemma 4 26B-A4B。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型推理算力固定于参数量，难以用单一检查点在"小成本快速响应"与"高算力高质量"之间灵活取舍；同时测试时扩展往往以更长输出（更多 token）为代价。作者希望用隐空间内的额外计算（循环）替代更长的显式生成，实现弹性深度与更高 token 效率。
AI.method: 架构基于归一化 Transformer（nGPT）主干，交错滑动窗口与全注意力层，划分为输入块、共享循环块与输出块；推理时循环块可重复执行任意次数。预训练 6T token，其中前 4.5T 采用 NVFP4，随后扩展上下文至 256K。后训练采用 SFT 与 RLVR，并设计难度感知循环课程，将更难提示路由到更深循环。为降低显存，循环时仅缓存最后一次循环的 key/value，使 KV-cache 占用与非循环模型在任何循环数下相同。
AI.result: 循环次数增加带来准确率提升，在编码、agentic 与长上下文基准上增益最大；两圈及以上在 12 项基准平均上超过 Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma 4 12B、Gemma 4 26B-A4B。在 agentic 基准上更 token 高效：四圈相比一圈生成 token 减少 1.3–2.5 倍。仅缓存最后一圈 KV 时保留大部分精度增益且显存不变。已开源 BF16、MXFP8、NVFP4 与 GGUF 量化检查点。
AI.conclusion: 弹性深度的隐循环架构能以单一检查点覆盖多档推理预算，用隐空间计算换取 token 效率提升，并在参数量劣势下取得竞争力性能；KV-cache 仅保留末圈的设计使循环的显存代价可忽略，配合多精度开源发布具备较强实用与部署价值。

title: EMBERS: Empirically Motivated Robustness Testing of Deep Research Systems via Defect-Guided Fuzzing
summary: Deep Research (DR) systems extend large language models into autonomous agents that decompose complex information needs, iteratively search the web, and synthesize evidence to answer challenging questions. However, their multi-stage execution may introduce robustness risks, as variations in user questions or intermediate search inputs may propagate across research stages and lead to incorrect answers. Existing evaluations focus on task-solving capabilities or robustness against external evidence disturbances, leaving intrinsic weaknesses in DR execution insufficiently explored. Thus, we conduct an empirical study of 1,932 execution trajectories from three representative DR systems and identify nine recurring defect categories across subquestion formulation, online search, and final reasoning. Guided by these findings, we propose EMBERS, an empirically motivated, defect-guided fuzzing framework for robustness testing of DR systems. Starting from correctly answered seed questions, EMBERS generates stage-targeted test inputs using defect-guided mutation, web-search-assisted fidelity assurance, and diversity-aware seed maintenance. Experiments across 16 framework--model--dataset settings show that EMBERS achieves 3.21 times the failure-discovery throughput of the strongest baseline under identical testing budgets. Human and LLM-assisted evaluations demonstrate that most generated inputs preserve the original information need and necessary contextual constraints. Moreover, model fine-tuning experiments show consistent-answer performance improvement, highlighting their value for robustness testing and model improvement.

AI.tldr: 该论文对深度研究（DR）系统进行了执行轨迹的实证分析，归纳出九类缺陷，并提出缺陷引导的模糊测试框架 EMBERS 用于鲁棒性测试。
AI.motivation: DR 系统将 LLM 扩展为多阶段自主智能体（分解问题、迭代搜索、证据综合），其多阶段执行可能带来鲁棒性风险：用户问题或中间搜索输入的微小变化会跨阶段传播并导致错误答案。现有评测仅关注任务求解能力或对外部证据扰动的鲁棒性，对 DR 执行过程的内在弱点探索不足。
AI.method: 1) 对三个代表性 DR 系统的 1,932 条执行轨迹进行实证研究，在子问题构建、在线搜索、最终推理三个阶段归纳出九类反复出现的缺陷；2) 提出 EMBERS 框架：从正确回答的种子问题出发，采用缺陷引导的变异、网络搜索辅助的保真度保证、以及多样性感知的种子维护，生成阶段针对性的测试输入。
AI.result: 在 16 种"框架—模型—数据集"设置下，EMBERS 在相同测试预算下的失败发现吞吐量达到最强基线的 3.21 倍；人工与 LLM 辅助评估表明多数生成输入保留了原始信息需求与必要上下文约束；模型微调实验显示一致的答案性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于执行轨迹缺陷的引导式模糊测试能有效暴露 DR 系统的内在鲁棒性弱点，且生成的测试输入既具有保真度又可用于模型改进，兼具鲁棒性测试与模型提升价值。

title: Honest Small Decision Models for Finance: Scale, Specialization Collapse, and Mixed-Corpus Remediation
comment: ICAIF 2026: The 3rd Workshop on LLMs and Generative AI for Finance
summary: Financial workflows need fast, calibrated, auditable decisions, not just generated text. We train System-1 decision models, small language models fine-tuned to answer typed questions (choice/score/noul) with a probability in a single forward pass, across two model families (K2-Horizon and Qwen3.5/3.8) and nine rungs from 0.8B to 32B parameters, using one frozen LoRA recipe on a public decision benchmark and two new finance corpora: a programmatic-gold policy corpus (rule-reading with exact labels) and a reality-labeled outcome corpus (19,640 realized forward-return questions in walk-forward splits, plus a sealed 2026 test of 1,360 questions). Narrow fine-tuning costs general decision competence 9-45 percentage points, a data-mixture effect that shrinks with model scale and is associated with narrow-gradient volume. On reality-labeled questions, every trained rung from 0.8B to 32B lands at the horizon-conditioned prior baseline (accuracy 0.37-0.38, no detectable conditional edge under our controls); the models respond with flat, well-calibrated probabilities that track per-horizon base rates: naturally honest uncertainty, with a mid-scale calibration sweet spot (ECE 0.026 at 2B, degrading to 0.043-0.044 at 9-32B under prior drift). A mixed-corpus remediation carries all competencies in one adapter at modest cost: it matches or slightly exceeds the generalist specialist on the public benchmark while holding the policy ceiling and near-specialist outcome calibration, yielding a deployable artifact with per-domain temperature regimes and a band-dispatch escalation analysis: sharp, dispatchable bands where rules determine answers; flat, review-routing bands where reality does not.

AI.tldr: 训练0.8B–32B小语言模型作为"系统1"决策模型，单次前向输出类型化答案概率；窄域微调会损失9–45个百分点通用决策能力，但模型在真实标注金融问题上表现出"天然的诚实不确定性"，通过混合语料补救得到可部署的多能力适配器。
AI.motivation: 金融工作流需要快速、校准良好且可审计的决策，而非单纯生成文本；需探究小模型能否在单次前向中给出带概率的类型化决策，以及窄域微调对通用决策能力与校准性的影响。
AI.method: 在两个模型家族（K2-Horizon、Qwen3.5/3.8）共九个规模档（0.8B–32B）上使用同一冻结LoRA配方训练；数据包括公开决策基准、程序化金标准政策语料（规则读取、精确标签）与真实结果语料（19,640条前向收益问题，walk-forward划分，另加2026年1,360题密封测试）；采用horizon条件化先验基线对照、ECE校准评估及混合语料补救实验。
AI.result: 窄域微调导致通用决策能力下降9–45个百分点（随规模缩小，与窄梯度体量相关）；真实标注问题上所有档位均退化为先验基线（准确率0.37–0.38，无显著条件优势），但概率平坦且校准良好，ECE在2B达0.026，9–32B退化至0.043–0.044。混合语料补救在单一适配器中保留全部能力，公开基准持平或略超专家模型，同时保持政策上限与接近专家级的校准。
AI.conclusion: 小模型在真实金融问题上表现出天然的诚实不确定性；混合语料训练可产出按域设置温度的可部署工件，并支持带状调度升级：规则决定答案处用锐利可调度带，现实无信号处用平坦复核路由带。

title: Movable Antenna Aided Robust Wireless Transmission: From Model-Based Optimization to Scalable Reinforcement Learning
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: This paper investigates robust joint antenna positioning and precoding for multiuser movable antenna (MA) systems under imperfect channel state information (CSI). First, we identify the mismatch between the spatial statistics of densely sampled MA channels and the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) basis used for conventional robust precoding. To address this, we develop a novel discrete prolate spheroidal sequence (DPSS)-based a posteriori channel model. By exploiting the spatial covariance structure of MA channels, this model is better suited to modeling MA channel uncertainty. Building on this model, we develop an efficient iterative algorithm for robust joint antenna positioning and precoding to maximize the expected sum rate. By transforming the coupled optimization of antenna positioning and precoding at each iteration into direct comparisons of closed-form scores, we design a low-complexity position replacement scheme that effectively reuses matrix computations across candidate sets. To further improve efficiency and scalability, we exploit the inherent tensor equivariance (TE) of the problem to develop a reinforcement learning framework. To explicitly account for channel uncertainty, we develop novel pairwise user-interaction and CSI-conditioned equivariant attention mechanisms to encode channel statistics and adaptively fuse them with the available CSI. We further introduce distance-biased spatial attention to incorporate the geometry of candidate positions into attention weighting, thereby enhancing spatial feature learning. Simulation results show that the proposed methods improve sum-rate performance while reducing online runtime under imperfect CSI. These methods also achieve near-optimal performance under perfect CSI, closely matching the exhaustive-search method. Moreover, the learning framework generalizes across different numbers of users and MAs without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不完美CSI下多用户可移动天线(MA)系统的鲁棒联合天线定位与预编码问题，提出DPSS后验信道模型、低复杂度位置替换算法及张量等变强化学习框架。
AI.motivation: 密集采样MA信道的空间统计特性与鲁棒预编码常用的DFT基不匹配，导致信道不确定性建模不准确，且天线定位与预编码联合优化复杂度高、难以扩展。
AI.method: 1) 基于信道空间协方差结构提出DPSS后验信道模型；2) 迭代算法最大化期望和速率，将耦合优化转化为闭式分数比较，设计复用矩阵计算的低复杂度位置替换方案；3) 利用问题的张量等变性构建强化学习框架，设计成对用户交互与CSI条件等变注意力机制，并引入距离偏置空间注意力。
AI.result: 仿真表明，所提方法在不完美CSI下提升和速率并降低在线运行时间；在完美CSI下逼近穷举搜索的近最优性能；学习框架无需重训练即可泛化到不同用户数与MA数。
AI.conclusion: DPSS建模与等变学习框架为MA系统提供了高效、可扩展且鲁棒的联合定位与预编码方案。

title: Compression Forcing: Hierarchical History Tokenization Enables Flexible World Models
summary: Effective world modeling requires compressing salient history information that facilitates future prediction. However, most existing approaches inherit tokenization and conditioning mechanisms from video generation, where objectives are centered around perceptual realism rather than predictive utility. This discrepancy limits the world model's effectiveness, especially in environments dominated by visual nuisances or task-irrelevant background details. To this end, we introduce Compression Forcing (CF), a general framework that aligns history compression with the predictive objective of world modeling. Compression Forcing features Dynamics-Aware Tokenization (DAT), a novel tokenization method that compresses history observations into a sequence ordered by decreasing dynamics saliency. Built on a diffusion backbone, this structure enables Hierarchical History Guidance (HG-H), allowing selective amplification of dynamics-salient information during inference. Extensive experiments across various environments demonstrate improved prediction fidelity, physical realism, and downstream decision-making performance, establishing Compression Forcing as a highly flexible and effective approach for world modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 Compression Forcing (CF) 框架，通过 Dynamics-Aware Tokenization (DAT) 将历史观测压缩为按动态显著性递减排序的序列，并配合 Hierarchical History Guidance (HG-H) 在推理时选择性放大动态显著信息，使历史压缩与世界模型的预测目标对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型沿用视频生成的 tokenization 与条件机制，其目标偏向感知真实感而非预测效用；当环境被视觉干扰或任务无关背景主导时，这种不一致会削弱世界模型的有效性。因此需要让历史压缩与预测目标保持一致。
AI.method: CF 框架包含两部分：(1) DAT——一种新的 tokenization 方法，将历史观测压缩为按动态显著性递减排序的 token 序列；(2) 基于扩散骨干网络，该有序结构支持 HG-H，在推理阶段对动态显著信息进行选择性放大。
AI.result: 在多种环境上的大量实验表明，预测保真度、物理真实感以及下游决策性能均得到提升。
AI.conclusion: Compression Forcing 是一种高度灵活且有效的世界建模方法，验证了将历史压缩与预测目标对齐的价值。

title: Language Model Augmented Decision Transformer for Multi-Task Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline multi-task reinforcement learning (MTRL) aims to learn a unified policy from heterogeneous offline datasets that generalizes across tasks. However, existing offline MTRL methods often struggle with two fundamental issues: severe per-task data scarcity and limited cross-task generalization. In this paper, we propose Language-Model Augmented Decision Transformer (LaMA-DT), a unified sequence-modeling framework that leverages a single large language model (LLM) for both trajectory augmentation and multi-task policy learning. LaMA-DT uses natural-language task descriptions to guide task-aligned trajectory augmentation through a set of supervised generation and alignment objectives, and incorporates a scoring-and-filtering mechanism to retain high-quality augmented trajectories. The same LLM is then repurposed as a language-conditioned Decision Transformer and fine-tuned on a mixture of real and augmented data. Experiments on Meta-World and MuJoCo multi-task benchmarks demonstrate that LaMA-DT consistently outperforms competitive baselines, particularly in low-data regimes, showing that language-guided data augmentation substantially improves cross-task generalization.

AI.tldr: LaMA-DT 用单一 LLM 同时完成语言引导的轨迹增广与语言条件化多任务策略学习，缓解离线多任务强化学习中的数据稀缺与跨任务泛化问题。
AI.motivation: 离线多任务强化学习存在两个核心问题：每个任务的离线数据严重稀缺，且跨任务泛化能力有限；现有方法未能同时解决这两点。
AI.method: 提出统一的序列建模框架：以任务的自然语言描述为条件，通过一组监督生成与对齐目标进行任务对齐的轨迹增广，并引入打分-过滤机制保留高质量增广轨迹；随后将同一 LLM 复用为语言条件化的 Decision Transformer，在真实数据与增广数据的混合集上微调。
AI.result: 在 Meta-World 与 MuJoCo 多任务基准上稳定优于竞争基线，且在低数据情境下优势尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 语言引导的数据增广可显著提升跨任务泛化能力，且单一 LLM 兼作增广器与策略模型的统一范式是可行且有效的。

title: From Logs to Faults: Reference-Free Fault Localization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Pipelines
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines are widely used for domain-specific question answering, yet locating faults remains manual and time-consuming. Fault localization is challenging because RAG pipelines consist of interdependent stages, where faults can propagate downstream, masking their origin, or remain undetected even when the final answer is correct. Existing evaluation approaches often focus on individual stages and rely on reference answers or code instrumentation. We present RAGLog, which detects and localizes faults across RAG stages using execution logs, without requiring reference answers or code instrumentation. RAGLog transforms heterogeneous API logs into a common RAG schema and combines rule-based, embedding-based, and LLM-based checks to identify faulty stages. We introduce a live fault injector and RAGLog Faults, a dataset of 3,134 runs from five RAG pipelines with stage-level fault labels. With Claude Haiku 5.5, RAGLog achieves a pooled F1 score of 0.73 on runs with naturally occurring faults, outperforming Claude Code (0.58) and Codex (0.52), and comparable effectiveness on runs with injected faults (0.84 versus 0.80 and 0.82, respectively). It analyzes runs in approximately five seconds at US\$0.005 each, with overall lower cost and latency than agent baselines. RAGLog is available as an open-source tool for debugging, evaluating, and monitoring RAG pipelines.

AI.tldr: RAGLog 利用执行日志对 RAG 流水线进行故障检测与定位，无需参考答案或代码插桩，以约5秒、$0.005/次的开销取得优于编码智能体的定位效果。
AI.motivation: RAG 流水线各阶段相互依赖，故障会向下游传播而被掩盖，或即使最终答案正确也未被发现；现有评估多聚焦单一阶段，且依赖参考答案或代码插桩，导致故障定位仍靠人工、耗时费力。
AI.method: 将异构 API 日志统一转换为通用 RAG schema，并融合基于规则、基于嵌入和基于 LLM 的三类检查来识别故障阶段；同时提出实时故障注入器并构建 RAGLog Faults 数据集（5 条流水线、3,134 次运行、含阶段级故障标注）。
AI.result: 在 Claude Haiku 5.5 下，自然发生故障运行上的 pooled F1 为 0.73，优于 Claude Code（0.58）与 Codex（0.52）；注入故障运行上为 0.84，与二者（0.80、0.82）相当；单次分析约5秒、成本约 US$0.005，整体成本与延迟均低于智能体基线。
AI.conclusion: RAGLog 是一种无需参考答案与代码插桩、低成本低延迟的 RAG 阶段级故障定位方法，可作为开源工具用于 RAG 流水线的调试、评估与监控。

title: Language Models Can Benefit from Domain-Specific Inductive Biases
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Position Paper Track
summary: Language models are typically trained with a single choice of architecture on diverse domains and data sources. Modern transformers have been extensively refined for such general-purpose learning, but are they equally effective across different subsets of the pretraining data? We investigate this question by training small language models from scratch on representative subsets of pretraining data such as web text, code, and mathematics. We introduce variants of transformers in which standard activation functions are replaced with learned splines tuned on specific datasets, providing a simple way to modify their inductive biases. Using a mix-and-match of architectures and datasets, we evaluate cross-domain transfer, i.e. how well does an architecture tuned for one domain perform on data from another? We find that the tuned transformer variants improve training efficiency or generalization on all seven of our tested datasets, but the gains are often domain-specific. For example, architectures tuned on a natural language dataset such as FineWeb perform well on TinyStories, whereas those tuned on mathematics perform poorly on natural language. We identify several mechanisms underlying these improvements, including wider loss basins and more abundant "lottery tickets". Our results show that different subsets of pretraining data can benefit from different learning mechanisms, highlighting a limitation of the prevailing trend towards a small set of general-purpose architectures and optimizers. This points to an opportunity to improve data efficiency by developing domain-specific learning strategies that retain the ability to train general-purpose models.

AI.tldr: 作者通过在Web文本、代码、数学等预训练数据子集上从头训练小型语言模型，并引入将标准激活函数替换为可学习样条（splines）的Transformer变体，系统研究架构与数据的交叉迁移。结果表明：领域定制架构能提升全部7个数据集的训练效率或泛化，但收益常具领域特异性（如自然语言上调优的架构在TinyStories上表现好，数学上调优的架构在自然语言上表现差）；机制包括更宽的损失盆地与更丰富的"彩票票据"。这提示通用架构趋势的局限，并指出在保持通用训练能力前提下发展领域特定学习策略的提升数据效率的机会。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型普遍采用单一架构在多样领域和数据源上训练，现代Transformer已针对这种通用学习做了大量优化，但其在不同预训练数据子集上是否同样有效尚不清楚。作者希望检验架构归纳偏置与数据领域之间的匹配关系，并探究不同数据子集是否受益于不同的学习机制。
AI.method: 1）在代表性预训练数据子集（Web文本、代码、数学等，共7个数据集，含FineWeb、TinyStories）上从头训练小型语言模型；2）提出Transformer变体，将标准激活函数替换为在特定数据集上调优的可学习样条，作为修改归纳偏置的简便手段；3）采用架构与数据集的"混搭"（mix-and-match）设计，评估跨域迁移，即为一域调优的架构在另一域数据上的表现。
