AI.result: 调优后的Transformer变体在全部7个测试数据集上均提升了训练效率或泛化能力，但增益往往具有领域特异性：在自然语言数据集（如FineWeb）上调优的架构在TinyStories上表现良好，而在数学上调优的架构在自然语言上表现较差。作者识别出若干机制，包括更宽的损失盆地（wider loss basins）和更丰富的"彩票票据"（lottery tickets）。
AI.conclusion: 不同预训练数据子集可从不同的学习机制中获益，这凸显了当前追求少量通用架构与优化器这一主流趋势的局限性。研究指出，通过发展既能提升数据效率、又能保留通用模型训练能力的领域特定学习策略，存在改进空间。

title: Directional Statistics in Signal Processing: A Geometry Driven Overview of Models, Learning, and Applications
summary: Many signal-processing objects are defined by periodicity, normalization, sign or global-phase ambiguity, basis invariance, or positive-semidefinite constraints and therefore cannot be modeled faithfully in ordinary Euclidean space. This paper develops a geometry driven framework for directional statistics in signal processing, connecting signal representations to their natural manifolds or quotient spaces and to probability models compatible with their invariances. After reviewing instances of directional statistics in the signal processing literature, we review circular, toroidal, spherical, projective, Stiefel, Grassmann, and covariance-valued distributions, emphasizing their statistical assumptions, computational requirements, and dimensional limitations relevant to signal processing. We describe various modeling and estimation strategies, including analytical and gradient-based maximum likelihood, structured low-rank parameterizations, mixtures and hidden Markov models (HMMs), score-based and contrastive estimation, and geometry-aware K-means. To exemplify the consequences of geometry-aware modeling, we study multivariate phase coherence in synthetic data and functional neuroimaging, comparing toroidal phase vectors to projective, Grassmann, and positive-semidefinite representations. We also study speaker separation in a car environment, showing that directional representations outperform a standard Euclidean model. These examples demonstrate that when the geometric representation, statistical distribution, inference method, and computational regime are considered together, they have the potential to lead to improved models across a broad range of signal processing applications.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个几何驱动的方向统计框架，将信号表示映射到其自然流形或商空间，并匹配相应的概率模型，以处理周期性、归一化、符号/全局相位模糊、基不变性和半正定等约束。
AI.motivation: 许多信号处理对象具有周期性、归一化、符号或全局相位模糊、基不变性、半正定约束，无法在普通欧氏空间中被忠实建模，需要与其不变性相容的几何与概率表示。
AI.method: 综述圆周、环面、球面、投影、Stiefel、Grassmann 及协方差值分布，分析其统计假设、计算需求与维度局限；并介绍解析与梯度极大似然、结构化低秩参数化、混合模型与HMM、基于得分与对比估计、几何感知K-means等建模与估计策略。实验上研究多变量相位相干性（合成数据与功能神经影像，比较环面相量同投影、Grassmann、半正定表示），以及车内说话人分离。
AI.result: 在相位相干性分析中对比了不同几何表示；在车内说话人分离任务上，方向性表示优于标准欧氏模型。
AI.conclusion: 当几何表示、统计分布、推断方法与计算模式综合考虑时，有望在广泛的信号处理应用中带来更优模型。

title: Do Pretrained Backbones Transfer to Physical Sensors? A Systematic Study of Multimodal Initialization Across the Sensor Stack
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 22 pages (10 main, including references, and 12 supplementary), 4 figures, 13 tables
summary: Transfer learning from pretrained backbones has become standard practice in multi-sensor computer vision---yet two questions remain open: which pretrained weights transfer best to multi-sensor setups, and can in-domain pretraining outperform off-the-shelf solutions? Frameworks like MultiMAE demonstrate the utility of masked autoencoding in a multi-modal context, but rely entirely on dense, model-derived modalities. It is unclear how robustly these methods translate to real-world applications that use physical sensors, where the aggregation of diverse public datasets for large-scale pretraining inherently introduces modality sparsity. To investigate this systematically, we curate a multi-sensor autonomous driving collection of $2.82M$ images from 16 publicly available datasets, incorporating both physical hardware modalities (RGB, LWIR, NIR, Event) and model-derived modalities (Stereo Depth, Segmentation). We use this collection for in-domain pretraining based on the MultiMAE approach. We adapt MultiMAE's loss formulation to accommodate sparse samples, and study the effect of an enforced encoder bottleneck for modality alignment and of additional losses specific to dense reconstruction (SSIM and FFT). We then systematically compare against common pretrained backbones (ViT, MAE, DINO and MultiMAE) across downstream sensor fusion tasks. We find that MultiMAE is a surprisingly strong out-of-the-box baseline, transferring effectively even to modalities it has never seen, while our targeted modifications yield incremental but consistent improvements on multi-sensor transfer and overall robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含16个公开数据集、282万张图像的多传感器自动驾驶预训练数据集，研究多传感器场景下预训练权重的迁移效果，并对MultiMAE进行适配稀疏模态的改进，系统比较ViT、MAE、DINO与MultiMAE在下游传感器融合任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 多传感器计算机视觉中，预训练骨干网络的迁移已成为标准做法，但仍有两个问题未解决：哪种预训练权重最适合迁移到多传感器设置，以及域内预训练能否超越现成的通用预训练方案。MultiMAE等方法虽展示了多模态掩码自编码的潜力，但完全依赖稠密的模型生成模态，而真实物理传感器应用中公开数据集聚合会天然引入模态稀疏性，其有效性尚不明确。
AI.method: 整理跨16个公开数据集的282万张图像构成多传感器自动驾驶数据集，涵盖物理硬件模态（RGB、LWIR、NIR、Event）与模型生成模态（立体深度、分割）；基于MultiMAE进行域内预训练，修改其损失公式以适配稀疏样本，并研究强制编码器瓶颈用于模态对齐的效果，以及面向稠密重建的额外损失（SSIM与FFT）；随后在下游传感器融合任务上系统对比ViT、MAE、DINO、MultiMAE等常用预训练骨干。
AI.result: MultiMAE作为即用型基线表现意外强劲，甚至能有效迁移到从未见过的模态；本文的针对性改进在多传感器迁移与整体鲁棒性上带来增量但一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: 在真实物理传感器、模态稀疏的多传感器场景中，现成的MultiMAE具备很强的零样本迁移能力；针对稀疏样本的损失适配、编码器瓶颈对齐与稠密重建辅助损失可进一步提升迁移性能与鲁棒性，为多传感器预训练提供了实用参考。

title: Swapping the Judge Changes the Ranking: A Preregistered Study of Cross-Provider Replication in LLM-Judged System Comparisons
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Code and judge verdicts are provided as ancillary files
summary: Practitioners who compare systems with an LLM judge and have no human labels often check a conclusion by repeating it with a judge from another provider. We test how far that check can be trusted. In a preregistered study (with a disclosed post-registration reduction of the judge set), five judge models from three providers re-judged 4,000 Chatbot Arena battles (nine systems, 33 system pairs) that carry human votes, each in both response orders. Agreement with the human vote was low at the verdict level (median Cohen's kappa = 0.22), and system rankings did not survive a change of judge: Kendall's tau with the human ranking ranged from 0.17 to 0.89 (median 0.67), so the preregistered hypothesis that rankings remain stable was not supported. Conclusions replicated by two low-cost judges from different providers matched the human conclusion more often than single-judge conclusions (+0.10 precision), but the gain came from filtering out one poorly aligned judge, and replication involving that judge left a conclusion for only 35% of comparisons. Judges that agreed with humans reached a stable conclusion with no more verdicts than human votes required; the others failed to converge on 26-70% of system pairs at the sample sizes tested (up to 100 verdicts per pair). Disagreements with the human vote co-occurred across judges far more often than independence predicts, although a single human vote per battle cannot separate shared judge bias from voter noise.

AI.tldr: 预注册研究用5个来自3家提供商的LLM评判模型重判4,000场Chatbot Arena对战（双向顺序），发现跨提供商复现结论的做法可靠性有限：判定层与人投票一致性低（kappa中位数0.22），系统排名不稳健（Kendall's tau 0.17–0.89，中位0.67），预注册的排名稳定假设不成立。
AI.motivation: 实践中，无人工标注的从业者常用"换一家提供商的LLM评判复现同一结论"作为可靠性检验，但这种交叉提供商复现是否可信缺乏系统检验，本文旨在量化其可信度边界。
AI.method: 预注册实验（披露了注册后缩减评判模型集），5个评判模型、3家提供商，对4,000场带人工投票的Chatbot Arena对战（9个系统、33个系统对）在两种响应顺序下重判；以Cohen's kappa衡量判定层一致性，以Kendall's tau衡量系统排名与人类排名的关系，比较单评判与双低本评判复现结论的精确率与覆盖率，并分析收敛所需判定数及评判间分歧的共现结构。
AI.result: 判定层与人投票一致性低（kappa中位数0.22）；换评判后系统排名与人类排名Kendall's tau为0.17–0.89（中位0.67），排名稳定性假设未被支持。双评判复现比单评判结论精确率高0.10，但增益主要来自剔除一个对齐差的评判；涉及该评判的复现仅在35%的比较上留下结论。与人类一致的评判在不超过人工投票所需判定数下即可稳定收敛；其余评判在26–70%的系统对上至多100次判定仍不收敛。与人类投票的分歧在评判间共现的频率远高于独立性预测，但每场仅一次人工投票无法区分评判共享偏差与投票者噪声。
AI.conclusion: 跨提供商重判作为结论校验并不可靠：一致性低、排名不稳健，双评判复现的增益主要源自过滤掉差评判而非独立性红利，且评判误差高度相关。建议报告判定层一致性与收敛性、避免以单一换供应商复现作为稳健性证据；受限处在于单次人工投票无法分离共享评判偏差与投票噪声。

title: Reasoning is topologically simple
summary: We formulate and investigate the hypothesis that reasoning text has simpler co-occurrence topology than non-reasoning text, and that higher-quality reasoning has simpler co-occurrence topology than lower-quality reasoning. We discuss and test applications to AI safety and AI evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并检验一个假设：推理文本的共现拓扑比非推理文本更简单，且高质量推理的共现拓扑比低质量推理更简单，并讨论其在AI安全与AI评估中的应用。
AI.motivation: 作者试图寻找一个可量化、低成本的文本结构指标（共现拓扑复杂度），用以区分"是否在推理"以及"推理质量高低"，从而服务于AI安全监测与模型评估。
AI.method: 以共现拓扑（词/概念共现网络的复杂度）作为文本结构表征，形式化"推理文本更简单"的假设，并设计实验对比推理文本与非推理文本、以及不同质量推理文本的拓扑复杂度差异。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅声明对该假设进行了提出、讨论与检验，并探讨其在AI安全与AI评估中的潜在应用。
AI.conclusion: 共现拓扑复杂度可能作为推理存在性与推理质量的判别信号，具备用于AI安全与AI评估的应用潜力。

title: The role of injected noise in diffusion model generalization
comment: 10 pages, 11 figures, published at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: 2nd Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM)
summary: Diffusion models trained on distinct datasets can produce highly similar samples when prompted with the same noise input, suggesting that they learn a generalized data distribution. We investigate the role of noise injected during the sampling process, and show that it plays an important role in making or breaking this strong generalization effect. Based on this finding we investigate the robustness of sample similarity to changes in the injected noise, and find that its impact is largest in the sampling regime where broad structure already exists but the precise identity of the sample is not yet determined.

AI.tldr: 不同数据集训练的扩散模型在同一初始噪声下会产生高度相似样本，说明其学习了泛化的数据分布；采样中注入的噪声对这一泛化效应的成立与否起关键作用，且其影响在"结构已成形但样本身份未定"的阶段最大。
AI.motivation: 观察到跨数据集训练的扩散模型在相同噪声输入下生成高度相似样本这一现象，作者希望解释该强泛化效应背后的机制，特别是采样过程中随机噪声的作用。
AI.method: 以受控方式改变采样过程中注入的噪声，考察样本相似性对该噪声变化的敏感程度（鲁棒性分析），并定位噪声影响最大的采样阶段。
AI.result: 注入噪声能够增强或破坏跨模型样本相似性；样本相似性对噪声扰动敏感，且扰动影响在"粗略结构已出现、具体样本身份尚未确定"的采样区间内最显著。
AI.conclusion: 采样噪声是决定扩散模型泛化相似性效应的关键因素，该效应主要形成于采样的中间阶段，为理解与调控扩散模型的泛化行为提供了实证依据。

title: Current-Future Rate Tradeoffs in ISAC Under Random Path Changes
summary: In mobile wireless links, motion changes path directions and visibility, and blockage can shift communication to a different propagation path. Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) allows a base station (BS) to use echoes of data transmissions to monitor these changes and guide subsequent beam selection. Illuminating objects that govern future path availability may reduce the beamforming gain on the current communication route. Existing sensing-communication tradeoffs and dynamic beam-control frameworks do not directly quantify the future communication gain from this current-rate sacrifice. We quantify sensing value by the future-rate gain enabled by echo-adaptive beam selection. We derive explicit expressions for the future communication gain and the net gain after accounting for the current-rate loss. The analysis uses a coupled communication-echo channel with binary-state Markov motion over a finite burst informed by one processed echo. We show that monitoring is worthwhile when its future-rate gain exceeds the current loss, while more informative observations yield zero additional future rate if they cannot change any future optimal beam. We derive interpretable gain bounds exposing the roles of improved scene discrimination, motion memory and future beam-rate differences. Reciprocal-channel tests demonstrate positive net accumulated-rate gains from monitoring a moving blocker during reflected-path service, including continuous position uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该文用未来速率增益量化ISAC中"感知价值"：在通信-回波耦合信道与二状态马尔可夫运动模型下，推导了监测遮挡物带来的未来通信增益及扣除当前速率损失后的净增益解析式。
AI.motivation: 移动无线链路中运动改变路径方向与可见性，遮挡可使通信切换到另一传播路径。ISAC可利用数据发射回波监测这些变化并指导后续波束选择，但照射决定未来路径可用性的目标会降低当前通信路由的波束成形增益。既有感知-通信折中与动态波束控制框架未直接量化这种"以当前速率换取未来通信增益"的价值。
AI.method: 建立通信-回波耦合信道模型，采用有限突发长度上的二状态马尔可夫运动，且仅基于一次处理后的回波进行推断；推导未来通信增益与净增益（未来增益减当前损失）的显式表达式，并给出可解释的增益界，刻画场景区分度提升、运动记忆与未来波束速率差三者的作用。
AI.result: 监测值得进行的条件是未来速率增益超过当前损失；若额外观测信息无法改变任何未来最优波束，则其带来的未来速率增量为零。增益界显示收益来源于改进的场景区分、运动记忆效应和未来波束间速率差。互易信道测试表明，在反射路径服务期间监测移动遮挡物可取得正的净累积速率增益，且在连续位置不确定性下仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为ISAC中"感知是否值得"提供了可量化的判据与解析边界，明确了信息量、可行动性与增益之间的关系，并通过互易信道验证了监测移动遮挡物的净速率收益。

title: Spatial and Temporal Super-Resolution and Denoising of Intracardiac 4D Flow MRI
summary: Intracardiac flow is driven by complex, and time-varying cardiac motion and interaction with the heart valves, producing complex flow features that may provide valuable information for disease diagnosis and treatment planning. 4D Flow MRI enables non-invasive, time-resolved measurement of three-dimensional cardiovascular velocity fields. However, substantial noise and limited spatial and temporal resolution limit its ability to accurately resolve flow features. We propose 4D-MRAR (4D Magnetic Resonance Augmented Reconstruction), a deep learning (DL) method to super-resolve and denoise 4D Flow MRI data. Unlike prior DL methods that train and infer on static vascular regions, our method predicts intracardiac flow within hearts undergoing large deformation. Moreover, it uniquely allows for simultaneous super-resolution in 3D space and time. The method combines a residual convolutional neural network, a recurrent neural network, and an implicit neural field to predict high-resolution velocity and pressure fields while efficiently enforcing the governing equations of fluid flow during training. Trained on a synthetic dataset obtained from computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations of left ventricle (LV) flow, our method generalizes to synthetic whole-heart 4D flow MRI data, and demonstrated promising performance on real 4D Flow MRI. The produced super-resolved flow fields exhibit significantly improved accuracy and greater consistency with the governing equations of blood flow compared with prior methods.

AI.tldr: 提出4D-MRAR深度学习方法，对4D Flow MRI数据同时进行空间与时间超分辨及去噪，在心脏大幅形变条件下重建心内速度场与压力场，并显式约束流体控制方程。
AI.motivation: 心内血流由复杂、时变的心脏运动与瓣膜相互作用驱动，蕴含疾病诊断与治疗规划信息；但4D Flow MRI受噪声大、空间与时间分辨率有限制约，难以准确解析血流特征。已有深度学习重建方法多针对静态血管区域训练与推理，无法处理心脏大幅形变，且难以同时实现时空超分辨。
AI.method: 构建4D-MRAR框架，融合残差卷积网络（提取空间特征）、循环神经网络（建模时间动态）与隐式神经场（连续时空表示），联合预测高分辨率速度场与压力场；训练中通过物理损失高效施加流体控制方程约束。使用左心室血流CFD仿真生成的合成数据集训练。
AI.result: 方法可泛化至合成全心4D Flow MRI数据，并在真实4D Flow MRI上表现良好；相比现有方法，超分辨重建的流场精度显著提升，与血流控制方程的一致性更强。
AI.conclusion: 4D-MRAR验证了在运动心脏上结合深度学习与物理约束进行时空联合超分辨与去噪的可行性，为4D Flow MRI心内血流的高保真重建提供了有效途径。

title: Same Rule, Different Verdicts: Rubric Language and Clause Structure in LLM Judges for Korean Support Dialogues
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures. Data and code are included as ancillary files
summary: Services that operate in Korean often write their evaluation rubrics in Korean and hand them to an LLM judge. We test whether a judge's verdict depends on the language of the rubric and on how a rubric item is phrased. We write 12 criteria for support dialogues in four clause structures (affirmative, negated, conditional, exception) such that two pairs of structures have the same meaning, and we give each item in Korean and in English. Six low-cost models from three providers, plus one reference model, judge 60 translated ESConv dialogues and 144 constructed boundary cases under every combination (51,744 requests across the seven models). The analysis plan was fixed and committed before data collection. Cross-provider agreement is lower with Korean rubrics than with English rubrics (Cohen's kappa 0.687 vs. 0.745; difference -0.058, 95% CI [-0.072,-0.045]). Disagreement concentrates in negated, conditional, and exception items (odds ratio 5.6 relative to affirmative items). A single model changes its verdict between two items with the same meaning in 11-15% of cases. Two hypotheses are not supported: models from the same provider do not agree more than models from different providers, and adding paired examples does not reduce the language gap. We measure consistency only; no human labels are used, and all materials were drafted by an LLM.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验 LLM 评判者（judge）的判定是否受评分细则（rubric）语言（韩语 vs. 英语）与评分条款句法结构的影响。预先注册的分析显示：韩语细则下的跨提供方一致性显著低于英语细则，分歧集中于否定、条件与例外类条款，且同一模型在两个语义等价条款间会改变判定。
AI.motivation: 韩国语服务常由人工撰写韩语评分细则交给 LLM 评判，但细则语言与措辞是否系统性影响评判结果缺乏受控证据；作者希望量化这种"细则侧"偏差来源。
AI.method: 为支持对话撰写 12 条准则，采用四种从句结构（肯定、否定、条件、例外），其中两对结构语义等价；每条均提供韩语与英语版本。使用来自 3 个提供方的 6 个低成本模型加 1 个参考模型，对 60 个译自 ESConv 的对话和 144 个构造的边界案例在全部组合下评判，共 51,744 次请求。分析计划在数据采集前固定并提交。仅测量一致性，不使用人工标注，材料由 LLM 起草。
AI.result: 韩语细则下跨提供方一致性低于英语细则（Cohen's kappa 0.687 vs. 0.745；差值 −0.058，95% CI [−0.072, −0.045]）。分歧集中于否定、条件与例外条款（相对肯定条款的比值比 5.6）。单一模型在语义等价的两条款间改变判定的比例为 11–15%。两个假设未获支持：同提供方模型并不比跨提供方模型更一致；加入成对示例未能缩小语言差距。
AI.conclusion: LLM judge 的判定对评分细则的语言与句法结构敏感，韩语细则与复杂从句（否定、条件、例外）会显著放大评判分歧；提示层面加入示例无法缓解该差距。实践上应采用语义明确、结构一致的细则并做跨语言/跨结构稳健性检验。

title: VagueBench: Benchmarking the Robustness of Embodied Agents on Ambient Context Illusions
summary: Embodied agents are increasingly deployed in open-world environments, yet current robustness evaluations remain biased toward hazardous instructions and jailbreak vulnerabilities. A more fundamental issue is largely overlooked: agents are rarely tested under semantically sufficient but contextually minimal instructions (i.e., common in real-world human communication), where auxiliary contextual cues are absent. For the first, we identify a novel phenomenon termed Ambient Context Illusion, where agents fail to execute tasks correctly when non-essential contextual details are omitted, despite unchanged task semantics. To systematically study this, we establish VagueBench, a benchmark built upon the AI2-THOR interactive simulation environment for the evaluation of context dependency in embodied agents. We systematically consider key semantic components of instructions (entities, procedures, constraints, and prior knowledge) and derive a unified taxonomy with four categories and nine subtypes to reduce auxiliary information. VagueBench contains 1,303 instruction pairs across diverse indoor environments, constructed via a human-agent co-generation framework that integrates semantic redundancy estimation, taxonomy-guided transformation, and rigorous semantic-invariance verification. Through extensive evaluation on 6 state-of-the-art embodied agents, we observe significant degradation on VagueBench in both task performance and executability (relatively -19.65% in task success rate and relatively +54.10% in empty plan rate) revealing a strong reliance on auxiliary linguistic signals rather than core task semantics. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this phenomenon persists in real-world robotic systems, where it can lead to incorrect decisions and potential safety risks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Ambient Context Illusion"现象：当指令语义不变但省略非必要的语境线索时，具身智能体执行失败；作者构建VagueBench基准（1303条指令对、4类9子类分类法）进行系统评测，发现6个SOTA智能体成功率相对下降19.65%、空计划率相对上升54.10%，并在真实机器人系统中复现该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能体鲁棒性评测集中于危险指令与越狱攻击，而忽视了更基础的问题：真实人类交流中常出现"语义充分但语境极简"的指令（缺少辅助语境线索），智能体在此类指令下的表现缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 提出并定义Ambient Context Illusion现象；基于AI2-THOR构建VagueBench基准，围绕实体、流程、约束、先验知识四类语义组件建立4类9子类的缩减分类法；通过人类-智能体协同生成框架（含语义冗余估计、分类法引导变换、严格语义不变性验证）构造1303条指令对；对6个SOTA具身智能体进行评测，并迁移至真实机器人系统验证。
AI.result: 在VagueBench上，6个SOTA具身智能体任务成功率相对下降19.65%，空计划率相对上升54.10%，表明其依赖辅助语言信号而非核心任务语义；该现象在真实机器人系统中同样存在，可导致错误决策与潜在安全风险。
AI.conclusion: 具身智能体存在对辅助语境线索的系统性依赖，语境内隐这一评测维度应纳入鲁棒性评估；VagueBench为诊断此类失败提供了标准化工具，并揭示其现实安全意义。

title: Quantifying out-of-distribution data severity with Wasserstein distances: benchmarking large language models for alloy property prediction
summary: As general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs), such as Gemini and DeepSeek, exhibit increasingly advanced reasoning capabilities, a critical question arises: how do their property prediction abilities compare to those of domain-specific pretrained materials models? In this study, we evaluate predictions for Ti, steels, high-entropy alloy (HEA) and Al, demonstrating that general-purpose LLMs surprisingly outperform SteelBERT, MatSciBERT, and SciBERT. To further enhance performance, we introduce a hybrid approach that utilizes numerical priors from a prior model, such as CatBoost or SteelBERT, to guide the general LLMs (Deepseek V3.1, Gemini-2.5-Flash). By inputting these initial estimates from a prior model as prompts, the LLM acts as a reasoning corrector, achieving accuracy superior to the prior model and "unguided mode". Furthermore, we investigate the impact of data strategy using a similarity-based metric, revealing that data quality dominates quantity; using merely 5% of high-similarity reference data of training set as input yields performance similar to the results of using 100% of training set. Additionally, the LLMs demonstrate excellent uncertainty calibration, where self-reported "high" confidence strongly correlates with minimal deviation from ground truth. Our findings suggest that synergizing general-purpose LLMs with prior model numerical baselines and high-quality data curation creates a cost-effective and accurate paradigm for materials discovery, reducing the need for expensive domain-specific pretraining.

AI.tldr: 通用大语言模型在Ti、钢、高熵合金和Al的性能预测上优于SteelBERT、MatSciBERT、SciBERT；以先验模型数值估计为提示的混合方法使LLM充当"推理校正器"，进一步提升精度；基于相似性的数据策略表明数据质量主导数量（仅用5%高相似参考数据即可媲美100%训练集）；LLM还表现出良好的不确定性校准。
AI.motivation: 通用LLM（如Gemini、DeepSeek）推理能力日益增强，但其材料性能预测能力与领域专用预训练材料模型相比如何尚不清楚；同时领域专用预训练成本高昂，需要探索更经济的替代范式。
AI.method: 在Ti、钢、高熵合金（HEA）和Al上对比通用LLM与SteelBERT、MatSciBERT、SciBERT；提出混合方法，将先验模型（CatBoost或SteelBERT）的数值估计作为提示输入通用LLM（DeepSeek V3.1、Gemini-2.5-Flash），由LLM进行推理校正；并基于相似性度量考察数据策略（5% vs 100%训练集参考数据）及置信度校准。
AI.result: 通用LLM预测精度超过三个领域专用BERT模型；混合方法优于先验模型与"无引导模式"；仅用5%高相似参考数据即可达到与使用100%训练集相近的性能；LLM自报"高"置信度与最小真值偏差强相关，显示出优秀的不确定性校准。
AI.conclusion: 通用LLM结合先验模型数值基线与高质量数据筛选，可构成低成本、高精度的材料发现范式，减少对昂贵领域专用预训练的依赖。

title: Joint Channel Scanning and Geometry-Aware Codebook Design for Movable Antenna Arrays
summary: Multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems rely on spatial degrees of freedom, but fixed antenna geometries cannot adapt to propagation environments. Movable antenna (MA) systems address this by adapting antenna positions to the channel. In discrete MA architectures, active antennas are selected from candidate positions, requiring channel state information (CSI) at those positions. With limited radio-frequency (RF) chains, CSI is acquired through successive pilot rounds, or antenna scanning, whose overhead can offset reconfiguration gains. This paper studies discrete MA geometry optimization when only a fraction of candidate positions is scanned. We show that a geometry-aware (GA) steering-vector codebook, constructed from the actual antenna coordinates, reconstructs channels more accurately than a conventional discrete Fourier transform (DFT) codebook when the optimized array departs from a uniform grid. We then show that the scanning fraction required to approach full-scan sum-rate performance depends on the CSI acquisition method: least-squares (LS) estimation degrades sharply under sparse scanning, while codebook-based acquisition remains robust. We also propose an adaptive scanning procedure that probes candidates in batches and stops automatically using the acquired pilots, avoiding a preset scanning budget. Finally, we quantify sum-rate losses as users move from their initial positions and evaluate recovery through re-scanning and geometry re-selection, relative to fixed-aperture operation with outdated or fresh CSI. Numerical results show that adaptive scanning achieves about 99.5% of the full-scan sum rate while scanning only 11% of candidate positions.

AI.tldr: 研究部分扫描离散可移动天线几何优化：几何感知导引矢量码本优于DFT码本，码本式CSI获取在稀疏扫描下稳健；提出自适应分批扫描停止准则，仅扫描11%候选位置即达全扫描99.5%和速率。
AI.motivation: MIMO依赖空间自由度，但固定天线几何无法适应传播环境；离散MA需在候选位置获取CSI，而有限RF链路只能逐轮导频扫描，开销可能抵消重构增益，故需研究部分扫描下的几何优化与CSI获取方法。
AI.method: 构建基于实际天线坐标的几何感知（GA）导引矢量码本；对比LS估计与码本式获取在稀疏扫描下的表现；提出批量探测候选位置、利用已获导频自动终止的自适应扫描流程；并量化用户移动引起的和速率损失及重扫描/几何重选恢复效果。
AI.result: GA码本在阵列偏离均匀栅格时重构精度优于DFT码本；LS估计在稀疏扫描下性能急剧下降，码本式获取保持稳健；自适应扫描仅扫描11%候选位置即达全扫描约99.5%的和速率。
AI.conclusion: 部分扫描下应采用几何感知码本进行CSI获取并配合自适应分批扫描，可在大幅降低导频开销的同时逼近全扫描性能。

title: From Visual Matching to Textual Conditioning: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation via Reference Inversion
summary: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation (CD-FSS) aims to segment objects from unseen domains using only a few annotated references. Recent Segment Anything Model (SAM)-based methods have advanced CD-FSS, yet their reference-target visual matching is highly sensitive to target appearance variations. SAM3 introduces text-conditioned segmentation, enabling natural-language descriptions to guide segmentation across target images, but directly using the category name as the condition still yields unstable performance under severe domain shifts. We propose Reference Inversion for SAM3 (RI-SAM3) that leverages SAM3's large-scale vision-language pre-training to learn suitable textual tokens for each target category. RI-SAM3 comprises three core designs: (i) Bi-level Reference Inversion that learns complementary tokens before and after the frozen text encoder: the former remain anchored in SAM3's text space while the latter represent the category more flexibly; (ii) Layer-adaptive Textual Conditioning combines these tokens differently as object queries evolve across decoder layers; and (iii) Presence-aware Confidence Supervision that jointly supervises query confidence and target presence for reliable predictions. With SAM3 frozen, RI-SAM3 optimizes around 12K parameters only per category and it efficiently segments each target in a single forward pass with reusable textual conditioning without per-sample reference-target visual matching. Extensive experiments over multiple widely adopted benchmarks show that RI-SAM3 achieves superior performance consistently in CD-FSS tasks, together with strong robustness, efficiency, and generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出 RI-SAM3，利用 SAM3 的视觉-语言预训练，通过为每个目标类别学习合适的文本 token 实现跨域少样本分割，仅训练约 12K 参数即可获得优越且鲁棒的 CD-FSS 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 SAM 的 CD-FSS 方法依赖参考-目标视觉匹配，对目标外观变化高度敏感；SAM3 支持文本条件分割，但直接用类别名作为条件在严重域偏移下表现不稳定。
AI.method: RI-SAM3 在冻结 SAM3 的前提下，包含三项设计：(i) 双层参考反演，在冻结文本编码器前后分别学习互补 token（前者锚定 SAM3 文本空间，后者更灵活地表征类别）；(ii) 层级自适应文本条件，随解码器各层对象查询演化以不同方式组合这些 token；(iii) 存在性感知置信监督，联合监督查询置信度与目标存在性。
AI.result: 在多个广泛采用的基准上，RI-SAM3 在 CD-FSS 任务中持续取得优越性能，并具备强鲁棒性、高效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 以可复用的文本条件替代逐样本的参考-目标视觉匹配，使 RI-SAM3 每类仅优化约 12K 参数、单次前向即可高效分割目标，为 CD-FSS 提供了简洁有效的新范式。

title: Evaluation Contracts and Evaluation Leverage: Sliced-Gap Readings in Structured Prediction Can Move Without Model Change
summary: NLP evaluation reports routinely cite sliced performance differences, most prominently the intra-inter gap in document-level relation extraction, as capability evidence. We show that such gap readings are joint properties of models and evaluation contracts: scoring function, gold version, threshold, output format, and prompt language. With predictions frozen, a method ordering reverses under a gold-standard exchange (+0.0363, CI excluding zero; tie-level after), movement localizing where gold re-partitions: renames are gauge transformations (Delta=0; re-annotation +0.862). We formalize this as an evaluation leverage account centered on the rank-flip condition. Constructively, the audited evaluation reading (AER) is a contract-marginalized, tie-declared, seed-prescribed, gate-filtered procedure whose tie declarations cover every contract-induced flip on the declared WMT19 grids (14/14; held-out 73% vs. union-of-ties 89%), matching the best single metric contract at epsilon=0.10 equivalence. Evidence spans DocRE, HacRED, a UD probe, and released gold revisions; an alternative-reference-set replication extends it beyond our testbeds. Failed predictions retained as boundaries; a 5% violation gate flags unverifiable settings and bounds survivor-selection bias. We release EvalLever, a preregistered workflow with an amendment trail; on LLM-as-judge grids, the audited ensemble stabilizes every unstable pair (13-15 to zero; generic ensemble shrinkage: the preregistered correlation criterion failed, the companion stabilization criterion passed).

AI.tldr: 论文表明，文档级关系抽取等服务中的"切片性能差异"（尤以 intra-inter gap 为代表）并非纯粹能力证据，而是模型与评测契约（打分函数、gold 版本、阈值、输出格式、提示语言）的联合性质；作者提出以 rank-flip 条件为核心的 evaluation leverage 理论，并给出契约边缘化的 AER 评测流程与 EvalLever 工具。
AI.motivation: NLP 评测报告常把切片性能差（特别是 DocRE 的 intra-inter gap）当作能力差异证据，忽视评测契约本身对读数的影响，可能造成方法排序反转与结论误读。
AI.method: 冻结预测后系统变动评测契约，并做 gold 标准互换实验以定位变动来源；将重命名视为 gauge 变换、重标注视为实质扰动；形式化为以 rank-flip 条件为中心的 evaluation leverage 框架；提出 AER（audited evaluation reading）——契约边缘化、显式声明平局、固定随机种子、gate 过滤的评测流程；引入 5% 违规 gate 标记不可验证设置并约束幸存者选择偏差；发布含预注册与修订记录的 EvalLever 工作流。
AI.result: gold 互换下方法排序反转（+0.0363，置信区间不含零，平局层面后消失）；重命名不改变结果（Δ=0），重标注带来 +0.862；AER 的平局声明覆盖 WMT19 网格上全部 14/14 契约引发的翻转（held-out 73% vs 并集平局 89%），在 ε=0.10 等价下匹配最佳单指标契约；在 LLM-as-judge 网格上使所有不稳定配对稳定（13–15 降至 0）。
AI.conclusion: 切片差距读数是模型与评测契约的联合产物，应通过契约边缘化、平局声明与审计流程来报告；AER/EvalLever 提供了可复现、带修订轨迹的评测范式，并能稳定 LLM-as-judge 排序。

title: El Agente Fármaco: A Scalable AI Scientist for Drug Discovery
summary: Computational drug discovery offers a growing range of tools for proposing and evaluating molecules, but combining them and deciding what to do next still requires substantial expert effort. Here, we introduce El Agente Fármaco, an AI scientist that uses modern large language model (LLM) technology to turn discovery goals expressed in everyday language into complex, scalable computational screening workflows. The agentic harness selects scientific tools, reviews their results, and adjusts subsequent steps to the target and the user's objectives. Our approach centers on a shared scientific memory: Fármaco Atlas, which stores molecules, structures, and results together with their provenance -- a record of how they were obtained. The agent uses targeted database queries to retrieve the evidence needed for each decision. A single request can launch calculations for an entire collection of molecules, without requiring a separate LLM decision for every compound. This design limits the information the model must process as screening collections grow, while keeping the underlying results available for inspection and further analysis. The integrated tools support molecule generation, prediction of binding and molecular properties, and searches for compounds available for purchase. In a retrospective comparison with an expert-led campaign, the agent proposed chemically distinct candidates with competitive docking scores and higher calculated drug-likeness under explicitly imposed selection criteria. In a 22-task benchmark against plain tool calls and Codex, the agent achieved the highest observed mean model-judged score, with lower median cumulative token use and peak context. Fármaco provides a foundation for flexible, scalable drug discovery workflows that connect scientific reasoning with an enduring, traceable record of computational work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 El Agente Fármaco，一个基于大语言模型的 AI 科学家，可将自然语言描述的药物发现目标转化为可扩展的计算筛选工作流，并以"科学记忆"系统 Fármaco Atlas 持久保存分子、结构与结果的来源信息。
AI.motivation: 计算药物发现工具繁多，但将多工具组合使用、解读结果并决定下一步仍需大量专家投入，缺乏可扩展、可追溯的自动化决策框架。
AI.method: 构建智能体框架：由 LLM 驱动的 harness 自动选择科学工具、审阅结果并依据目标与用户意图调整后续步骤；核心是共享科学记忆 Fármaco Atlas，将分子、结构、结果及其来源（provenance）统一存储，智能体通过定向数据库查询检索决策所需证据；支持单次请求对整批分子启动计算，避免逐化合物调用 LLM。
AI.result: 在专家主导的回顾性对照中，智能体提出化学结构差异化的候选分子，对接评分具竞争力，且在明确选择标准下计算得到的类药性更优；在 22 项任务基准测试中，相对纯工具调用与 Codex 取得最高平均模型评判分数，同时累计 token 用量中位数与峰值上下文更低。
AI.conclusion: Fármaco 为灵活、可扩展的药物发现工作流奠定基础，将科学推理与持久、可追溯的计算记录相连接。

title: Multi-layer Indexer: Overlapping Selection and Attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention
comment: 20 pages (8 pages main text), 4 figures, 11 tables. Accepted to the Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026, Atlanta, December 12, 2026. Code: https://github.com/ArjunKrishnak/dsa-multi-layer-indexer
summary: Sparse attention cuts the cost of long-context inference by making the attention matrix sparse: each query attends only a subset of the sequence, chosen by a fixed pattern or, in recent production LLMs, learned per query. In DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), the attention of DeepSeek-V3.2 and the GLM-5 family, every layer is preceded by a lightning indexer that scores the whole cache and keeps the k=2048 highest-scoring tokens for the layer to attend. At long context this indexer scan, not the sparse attention it feeds, is where the decode time goes. But adjacent layers select nearly the same tokens, so a layer can attend the selection of the previous indexer layer instead of its own. This removes the dependency: each indexer then runs concurrently with the attention of its layer. The resulting Multi-layer Indexer (MLI) needs no retraining and no new weights. Its default realization changes no kernel, running inside SGLang's production decode graph; an optional fused decode kernel accelerates it further on DeepSeek-V3.2. MLI composes with IndexCache (the cross-layer reuse GLM-5.2 ships as IndexShare): IndexCache drops the indexer from some layers, and MLI hides the scan on the rest. We serve DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5 under IndexCache's protocol at retentions 1/2 to 1/32 (the fraction of layers that keep an indexer) and contexts 10K to 195K. At equal retention the composition decodes faster than IndexCache: up to 14.5% faster on DeepSeek-V3.2 and 9.8% on GLM-5 at 1/2, and 7.9% and 5.1% at 1/4, largest where IndexCache keeps the most indexers and growing with context. At retention 1/r it is faster still than IndexCache at 1/(2r) while keeping twice the fresh selections: at 128K it reaches 1.32x the unmodified model's decode throughput at 1/4, above IndexCache's 1.28x at 1/8. Its LongBench, RULER and LongBench v2 accuracy stays within a few percentage points of IndexCache's.

AI.tldr: 提出 Multi-layer Indexer (MLI)：让每层注意力复用上一层 indexer 的 token 选择，从而解除 indexer 扫描与注意力的串行依赖、实现并行执行，无需重训即可加速 DSA 类长上下文解码。
AI.motivation: DSA（DeepSeek Sparse Attention）中每层前都有 lightning indexer 扫描全 KV cache 并保留 top-k=2048 token；长上下文下解码瓶颈已从稀疏注意力转移到该 indexer 扫描。而相邻层选出的 token 高度相似，因此逐层独立扫描存在冗余。
AI.method: MLI：第 l 层注意力直接使用第 l−1 层 indexer 的选择结果，切断层内 indexer→attention 的依赖链，使 indexer 与本层注意力并发执行。无需重训、无需新权重；默认实现不改 kernel，嵌入 SGLang 生产 decode 图；可选 fused decode kernel 在 DeepSeek-V3.2 上进一步加速。可与 IndexCache（GLM-5.2 的 IndexShare）组合：IndexCache 在部分层去掉 indexer，MLI 隐藏剩余层的扫描开销。
AI.result: 在 IndexCache 协议、retention 1/2–1/32、上下文 10K–195K 下测试 DeepSeek-V3.2 与 GLM-5：同 retention 下比 IndexCache 解码更快，1/2 时分别提升 14.5%/9.8%，1/4 时 7.9%/5.1%，增益随上下文增长；retention 1/r 时比 IndexCache 1/(2r) 更快且保留两倍新选择，128K 下达未改模型吞吐的 1.32x（1/4），超过 IndexCache 1/8 的 1.28x。LongBench、RULER、LongBench v2 精度与 IndexCache 相差仅数个百分点。
AI.conclusion: MLI 以"跨层复用选择 + 解除串行依赖"的低成本手段将长上下文解码瓶颈从 indexer 扫描中移除，与 IndexCache 正交可组合，在保持精度的同时获得显著吞吐提升。

title: Interpretability Analysis of End-to-End Learned CSI Feedback for Precoding-Oriented Massive MIMO
summary: Recent end-to-end learning frameworks jointly optimize pilot design, channel state information (CSI) feedback, and downlink precoding, achieving strong performance under limited feedback overhead in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) networks. However, the internal representations and decision-making strategies learned by these architectures remain largely unexplored. This paper presents an interpretability analysis of a precoding-oriented end-to-end CSI feedback framework using explainable artificial intelligence (xAI) techniques. Building on a validated learned architecture, we investigate the structure of the learned pilots, latent feedback representations, and precoding vectors through low-dimensional visualization, density-based clustering, and cross-block representation analysis. The results reveal that the learned system undergoes a transition as the feedback constraint is relaxed. Under stringent feedback budgets, the encoder develops clustered latent representations and quantized precoding behavior. As additional feedback resources become available, the learned representations evolve into smooth geometry-preserving manifolds that retain physically meaningful channel characteristics such as dominant angular information, while enabling more adaptive precoding decisions. Furthermore, the learned pilot signals naturally form complementary sensing patterns aligned with the underlying channel statistics. The analysis also reveals a shift from gain-driven beamforming strategies under severe compression to increasingly interference-aware precoding as the feedback budget increases. These findings provide new insight into how end-to-end learned CSI feedback systems balance compression efficiency and communication performance and establish a general framework for interpreting learned communication architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文用可解释人工智能（xAI）技术分析面向预编码的端到端CSI反馈框架，揭示学习到的导频、隐层反馈表示与预编码向量的结构及其随反馈预算变化的演化规律。
AI.motivation: 端到端联合优化导频设计、CSI反馈与下行预编码的框架在有限反馈开销下性能优异，但其内部表示与决策策略基本未被探索，缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 基于已验证的学习架构，采用低维可视化、基于密度的聚类与跨模块表示分析，考察学习到的导频结构、隐层反馈表示与预编码向量。
AI.result: 反馈约束放宽时系统呈现阶段性转变：严格反馈预算下编码器形成成簇隐表示与量化预编码行为；资源增加后表示演化为平滑的保几何流形，保留主角度等物理意义信道特征，并支持更自适应的预编码。学习导频自然形成与信道统计对齐的互补感知图样；预编码策略由压缩严重时的增益驱动波束成形转向反馈预算增大时愈发干扰感知的预编码。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了端到端学习CSI反馈系统如何在压缩效率与通信性能间权衡，并建立了用于解释学习式通信架构的通用分析框架。

title: ScienceVision: Can AI Observe and Reason Like a Scientist?
summary: Scientific discovery builds on accurate observations interpreted through domain knowledge and reasoning. For scientific 3D data, this requires understanding structures and spatial relationships, from protein contacts to anatomical organization. Existing multimodal benchmarks largely evaluate text and 2D images, while scientific 3D evaluations vary in representations and protocols across disciplines, limiting cross-disciplinary comparison. To assess these foundational capabilities, we introduce ScienceVision, a cross-domain benchmark for scientific 3D understanding and reasoning through expert-level visual question answering (VQA). We construct 250 questions, with 50 each from Biology, Chemistry, Medical Imaging, Mechanical CAD, and Architecture, through a pipeline combining synthetic question generation with domain-expert review and annotation. Each task pairs a native 3D artifact with a scientific question, a specified response format, and a task-specific reference answer, requiring domain knowledge to be applied to geometric or topological evidence. We evaluate 12 models on the same questions in three settings: visual question answering with native 3D artifacts accessed through an agent harness's file and code-execution tools; the same workflow augmented with expert-inspired viewer inspection and measurement tools exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP); and visual question answering from prescribed rendered 2D images using an agent harness. All settings use the same task-specific deterministic final-answer scoring. The inspection environment supports view changes, target isolation, and slice inspection. In this main comparison, the best mean answer score is 0.53 out of 1. Mean scores in the native-artifact workflow without additional MCP tools exceed those in the rendered-image workflow for every model, by 17.2 percentage points on average.

AI.tldr: 提出跨学科科学3D理解与推理基准ScienceVision，含5领域共250道专家级VQA题，评测12个模型在原生3D工件、MCP检查工具与渲染2D图像三种设置下的表现，最佳均分0.53。
AI.motivation: 现有科学多模态基准多聚焦文本与2D图像，科学3D评测在表示形式与协议上跨学科不统一，难以进行跨学科比较，也缺乏对结构理解与空间关系推理能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建ScienceVision基准：从生物学、化学、医学影像、机械CAD、建筑各取50题，共250题，采用合成问题生成加领域专家审核标注的流程；每题配原生3D工件、科学问题、指定回答格式与任务特定参考答案。在统一问题上评测12个模型，设置三种条件：通过智能体框架文件与代码执行工具访问原生3D工件；在此基础上叠加经MCP暴露的专家式查看与测量工具（支持视角变换、目标隔离、切片检查）；以及基于规定渲染2D图像作答。三种设置均采用同一任务特定的确定性最终答案评分。
AI.result: 主对比中最佳平均答案得分为0.53（满分1）。对每个模型而言，无额外MCP工具的原生3D工件流程得分均高于渲染2D图像流程，平均高出17.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 科研3D理解对现有模型仍具挑战，得分整体偏低；原生3D工件访问相较渲染图像具有稳定优势，说明保留3D几何与拓扑证据及配套检查工具对科学推理至关重要。

title: Say Less, Mean Better: Training-Free Verbosity Control for Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often generate responses longer than necessary, increasing inference latency and computational cost. While prompting can encourage conciseness, controlling output length without compromising response completeness remains challenging. Aggressive early stopping can reduce generation costs but risks terminating responses prematurely. We introduce MinimalLM, a training-free framework for reliable verbosity control that combines uncertainty-aware, length-dependent stop-token adjustment with structural completeness guardrails. MinimalLM separates the decision of when to stop from whether stopping is structurally appropriate, coordinating response-level instructions, decoding-time intervention, and completion checks without modifying model parameters or requiring auxiliary models. We evaluate MinimalLM across three open-source LLMs and 330 questions, producing 5,940 responses across baseline and ablation configurations. MinimalLM reduces generated tokens by 47.6%, accelerates individual responses by 19-68%, and eliminates structurally truncated outputs in the primary evaluation. Despite substantial token savings, it achieves an average quality score of 8.04/10, compared with 8.42/10 for unmodified models and 6.46/10 for length-matched truncation. Evaluations across diverse subject domains (such as healthcare, programming, law, and science) demonstrate robust efficiency gains, while ablations establish the complementary roles of decoding control and completeness constraints. Our findings highlight that efficient generation requires more than producing fewer tokens: it requires controlling when generation ends while preserving response integrity. MinimalLM offers a lightweight, training-free approach toward this goal.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 MinimalLM 框架，通过"不确定性感知的长度相关停止符调节 + 结构完整性护栏"实现对大模型输出冗长度的可靠控制，在保持质量的前提下显著减少 token 生成量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常生成超出必要长度的回复，导致推理延迟与计算成本上升。提示工程虽可鼓励简洁，但难以在不损害完整性的情况下控制长度；而激进的早停虽降本却可能截断回复，因此需要兼顾效率与完整性的长度控制方法。
AI.method: MinimalLM 为免训练框架，将"何时停止"的决策与"停止是否结构上合适"的判断解耦：结合不确定性感知、随长度变化的停止令牌（stop-token）调节，以及结构完整性护栏（guardrails）；协同响应级指令、解码时干预与完成度检查，不修改模型参数、不依赖辅助模型。实验覆盖 3 个开源 LLM、330 个问题，在基线及消融配置下共生成 5,940 条回复。
AI.result: 生成 token 减少 47.6%，单条回复加速 19–68%，主评测中消除了结构性截断输出；平均质量得分 8.04/10，对比未修改模型的 8.42/10 与等长截断的 6.46/10。在医疗、编程、法律、科学等多领域均展现稳健的效率增益，消融实验验证了解码控制与完整性约束的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 高效生成不止是"少产出 token"，关键在于控制生成何时结束同时保持回复完整性。MinimalLM 为这一目标提供了轻量、免训练的可行方案。

title: Low-Rank Hierarchical Merging for Efficient Long-to-Short Reasoning
summary: Long-to-Short (L2S) model merging seeks to combine the strong reasoning capability of long chain-of-thought models with the concise style of base models, but existing methods that rely on linear interpolation and first-order activation statistics fail to capture how the loss landscape responds to parameter displacement, leading to degraded accuracy on hard tasks. We propose Low-Rank Hierarchical Merging (LHM), a training-free framework that replaces heuristic statistics with lightweight second-order curvature information. LHM consists of three components: (1) a low-rank Hessian approximation that efficiently estimates per-layer Hessian traces via Hutchinson's estimator on random inputs, eliminating the need for task-specific data; (2) a Layer Second-Order Sensitivity (LSOS) index that combines Hessian trace with task-vector norm to quantify per-layer fusion difficulty; and (3) a Dual-Constraint Coefficient Mapping (DCCM) that converts LSOS scores into layer-adaptive merge coefficients while jointly satisfying a fusion-error bound and a global length-reduction target. Experiments across six mathematical benchmarks on 1.5B and 7B models show that LHM outperforms state-of-the-art methods such as ACM-TIES and ORCA, achieving over 4\% accuracy gain and up to 93.1\% reduction in output length relative to the long-CoT model.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的低秩分层合并框架 LHM，用二阶曲率信息替代一阶激活统计，指导长链模型与基座模型的融合，实现精度与输出长度的双重优化。
AI.motivation: 现有 L2S 合并方法依赖线性插值与一阶激活统计，无法刻画损失地形对参数位移的响应，导致困难任务精度下降。
AI.method: 三部分组成：(1) 基于 Hutchinson 估计器在随机输入上高效估计逐层 Hessian 迹的低秩二阶近似，无需任务数据；(2) 层二阶敏感度指标 LSOS，将 Hessian 迹与任务向量范数结合以量化逐层融合难度；(3) 双约束系数映射 DCCM，将 LSOS 分数转为层自适应合并系数，同时满足融合误差上界与全局长度压缩目标。整个过程无需训练。
AI.result: 在 1.5B 与 7B 模型的六个数学基准上，优于 ACM-TIES、ORCA 等 SOTA 方法，精度提升超 4%，输出长度相对长链模型最多压缩 93.1%。
AI.conclusion: 以二阶曲率替代启发式统计进行层自适应合并系数分配是提升 L2S 合并效果的有效途径，可在保持推理能力的同时显著缩短输出。

title: Probabilistic Steering of Generative Priors for Lab-in-the-Loop Antibody Optimization
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS `26 GEM and NeurIPS `26 AI4DD
summary: Therapeutic antibody development is often framed as comprising two discrete stages: initial discovery of novel binders followed by iterative optimization to refine these hits into therapeutic-grade molecules. Models and methods often reflect these stages, with generative structure models applied to discovery and probabilistic black-box optimization methods applied to refinement. Here we propose to unify these stages by smoothly transitioning a generative discovery model into iterative optimization, allowing the handoff between the structure-based prior and supervision from wet lab data to be guided by the posterior uncertainty of a probabilistic surrogate. We show that this yields improvements in optimization efficiency in the low-N regime, as well as improved diversity amongst the optimized molecules.

AI.tldr: 提出将生成式发现模型平滑过渡为迭代优化，以后验不确定性指导结构先验与湿实验监督的交接，从而统一抗体发现的发现与优化两阶段。
AI.motivation: 治疗性抗体开发通常被分为"新结合体发现"与"迭代优化至治疗级分子"两个离散阶段，模型与方法也分别对应生成式结构模型和概率黑盒优化，阶段割裂导致流程不统一、低数据条件下效率受限。
AI.method: 将生成式发现模型平滑过渡为迭代优化：利用概率代理模型的后验不确定性来指导结构先验与湿实验数据监督之间的交接权重/时机。
AI.result: 在低N（少量湿实验数据）情形下提升了优化效率，同时优化后分子之间的多样性有所改善。
AI.conclusion: 通过不确定性引导的连续过渡，可将生成式发现与迭代优化统一为单一流程，在小样本场景下兼顾效率与多样性。

title: Noise Parameter Identification in Ensemble of Atomic Clocks
comment: Submitted to IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON ULTRASONICS, FERROELECTRICS, AND FREQUENCY CONTROL
summary: The paper introduces a parameter identification framework for atomic clock ensembles, where individual clocks are represented by second-order linear stochastic state-space model. The proposed procedure relies exclusively on differential measurements, namely the pairwise phase differences between a designated pivot clock and the remaining ensemble members. The identification targets key parameters for each clock: white and random-walk frequency noise variances, constant frequency drift, and (co)variance of the measurement noise. To identify these parameters, two distinct identification methods are proposed. Their estimation accuracy is rigorously demonstrated via numerical simulations and validated using empirical data from atomic hydrogen maser (AHM) clocks at ESTEC Timing Laboratory.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种原子钟钟组的参数辨识框架：单台钟用二阶线性随机状态空间模型描述，仅利用差分（枢轴钟与其余钟的两两相位差）测量，辨识白频噪声与随机游走频率噪声方差、恒定频率漂移及测量噪声（协）方差，并用两种方法与仿真、ESTEC氢脉泽实测数据验证。
AI.motivation: 钟组中各台原子钟的噪声与漂移参数是钟组算法与时间尺度生成的基础，但实际中难以获得单钟的绝对相位参考，只能得到钟间差分相位数据；因此需要一种仅依赖差分测量即可辨识各钟关键参数的框架。
AI.method: 将每台钟建模为二阶线性随机状态空间模型；以指定枢轴钟为参考，仅使用其与其余钟成员的成对相位差作为输入；辨识对象为白频噪声方差、随机游走频率噪声方差、恒定频率漂移及测量噪声（协）方差；提出两种不同的辨识方法（如基于协方差/ Allan类统计量与基于状态空间滤波/似然的两类途径）。
AI.result: 通过数值仿真严格演示了两种方法的估计精度，并利用ESTEC授时实验室的原子氢脉泽（AHM）实测数据完成验证，表明所提方法可有效估计目标参数。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭枢轴钟差分相位测量即可辨识钟组中各原子钟的噪声方差、频率漂移与测量噪声参数；方法经仿真与实测双重验证，适用于氢脉泽钟组的实际参数标定与时尺度应用。

title: CHROMA-MILL: Joint Low-Light Enhancement and White Balance under Colored Illumination
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 16 pages (main paper + supplementary material), 7 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://color.cvc.uab.cat/chromamill/
summary: Capturing an image in a low-light environment produces a weak, noisy sensor signal. Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to restore it. Auto white balance (AWB) is also required for every image, and the same noisy signal degrades its ability to infer the scene illuminant. LLIE is typically performed first, followed by AWB, but this strategy remains largely unexamined because existing low-light datasets span a narrow range of illuminants and lack illuminant ground truth for evaluating AWB. We address this with CHROMA-MILL, a RAW dataset of 50 scenes captured with a DSLR and smartphone under four calibrated illuminants at eleven intensity levels. Because light is additive, we blend these captures in the linear RAW domain to synthesize physically valid illuminant mixtures with exact chromaticity ground truth. Benchmarking on this data, we find joint correction is best, and introduce CTI-Retinexformer, which supervises an illumination map, a chromaticity prediction, and an illumination-invariant scene embedding, outperforming the best cascade by 0.7 dB PSNR$_L$ and 1.1 $ΔE_{00}$.

AI.tldr: 提出 CHROMA-MILL 数据集并证明 LLIE 与 AWB 应联合处理，给出 CTI-Retinexformer 方法。
AI.motivation: 低光图像增强（LLIE）与自动白平衡（AWB）共享同一含噪弱信号，传统"先 LLIE 后 AWB"的级联策略缺乏检验；已有低光数据集光源范围窄、且缺少 AWB 评估所需的光源真值。
AI.method: 构建 CHROMA-MILL：用单反与手机在四种标定光源、十一个强度级别下拍摄 50 个场景的 RAW 数据；利用光的加性在在线性 RAW 域混合，合成物理有效的混合光源并提供精确色度真值。在此基础上基准测试，并提出 CTI-Retinexformer，联合监督光照图、色度预测与光照不变场景嵌入。
AI.result: 基准测试表明联合校正最优；CTI-Retinexformer 相比最佳级联方案在 PSNR$_L$ 上提升 0.7 dB，ΔE$_{00}$ 改善 1.1。
AI.conclusion: LLIE 与 AWB 应联合求解而非级联；所提数据集与方法为低光下的联合增强与颜色恒常性研究提供了可靠基准与有效方案。

title: Where Do Distilled Students Store Thinking?
summary: Small students degrade on large reasoning models' (LRMs') long solutions, so recent work shortens them by interpolating an LRM with a short-answer model at ratio $λ$. We ask what student weights retain when this teacher stops thinking, comparing LoRA adapters of three students from three teacher pairs at each $λ$. In each pair, the adapters' update subspace shifts most where the teacher stops thinking and solutions shorten most, locating the change without attributing it. We identify a shared adapter subspace tied to thinking-like behavior (reflective markers, monologue format and long solutions). Shared by adapters before that point, it keeps about half (post hoc) while one pair's teacher halves its solutions but keeps its think tag, and largely empties after thinking stops. Removing it largely turns this behavior off for every pair, student and benchmark. Only in that pair and one other student does it leave clearly fewer markers than removing the update's top components; elsewhere, same-energy random directions often nearly match it. Grafted into a short-answer student at twice its weight, it turns early markers (a post hoc count) on, like the whole update, but the student rarely finishes. Our work identifies a weight subspace tied to distilled thinking-like behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文通过LoRA适配器分析"蒸馏思考式行为"的权重子空间：找出一个与反思标记、独白格式和长解答相关的共享子空间，其移除可大体关闭该行为，但该子空间大多可由同能量随机方向近似，因果归属证据有限。
AI.motivation: 小模型在大推理模型（LRM）的长解答上表现下降，近期工作通过与短答案模型按比例λ插值来缩短解答。作者追问：当"停止思考"时，学生权重究竟保留了什么，以及该变化能否被归属到具体的权重子空间。
AI.method: 对三组教师对、每组三个学生在各λ下比较LoRA适配器，定位更新子空间漂移位置（不归因）；识别与思考式行为相关的共享适配器子空间；进行消融（移除子空间、移除更新top成分、同能量随机方向对照）与嫁接实验（以两倍权重注入短答案学生）。
AI.result: 共享子空间在思考停止前被各适配器共同拥有，停止后（事后估计）保留约一半、多数情况下大幅清空；移除它可大体关闭该行为。但仅在一组教师对和另一个学生上，其标记减少明显多于移除top成分；其他情形下同能量随机方向几乎可匹敌。嫁接到短答案学生可使早期标记出现（类完整更新），但学生很少完成输出。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出一个与蒸馏所得"思考式行为"相关的权重子空间；其消融有效但因果特异性有限，随机方向对照提示效应并非该子空间独有，行为层面的定位强于机制层面的归因。

title: LaplaceDiag: Fault Diagnosis through Changes in Learned Actuator Effects
summary: Identifying faulty components from sensor anomalies is difficult because fault effects can propagate through a plant and different faults can produce similar observations. Detailed component models and labeled fault examples may also be unavailable. We introduce LaplaceDiag, a data-driven method that uses changes in actuator effects to narrow the search for faulty equipment. Actuators act on specific devices and mechanisms, so their changed effects can provide clues to root causes. LaplaceDiag learns a healthy plant model with LaplaceNet, a neural network that operates in Laplace space. It separates nonlinear prediction based on measured history from an explicit matrix that describes how actuator values affect sensor values. Keeping the history predictor fixed allows current actuator effects to be estimated by linear regression without retraining the neural network. Comparison with a healthy reference accounts for estimation uncertainty and normal variation to detect changes and generate actuator-related diagnostic hypotheses. The method supports online and offline diagnosis, providing an intermediate step between anomaly detection and identifying faulty components. We successfully evaluate LaplaceDiag on two datasets.

AI.tldr: LaplaceDiag是一种数据驱动方法，通过检测执行器作用效果的变化来缩小故障设备搜索范围，无需详细组件模型或标注故障样本。
AI.motivation: 传感器异常难以直接定位故障部件：故障效应会通过系统传播，不同故障也可能产生相似观测；同时详细组件模型与带标签的故障样本往往不可得。
AI.method: 提出LaplaceNet，在Laplace空间中学习健康系统模型，将基于实测历史的非线性预测与描述执行器值如何影响传感器值的显式矩阵分离。固定历史预测器后，可通过线性回归估计当前执行器作用效果而无需重训神经网络；再与健康参考比较，计入估计不确定性与正常波动，检测变化并生成与执行器相关的诊断假设。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上成功验证了LaplaceDiag的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法支持在线与离线诊断，可作为异常检测与故障部件定位之间的中间步骤。

title: Dr. No: Feature Steering for Abstention in Vision-Language Models
summary:
Large foundation models often answer even when the available visual or textual evidence is insufficient to support a reliable conclusion. This failure to abstain makes them hard to trust in high-stakes or information-seeking settings, where a confident but unsupported answer can be worse than no answer at all. It also raises a natural question: can the internal mechanisms behind this behaviour be identified and controlled at inference time? We present Dr. No, a feature-steering approach that mines sparse autoencoder (SAE) features associated with abstention and commitment, then modulates a small set of them during the prefill pass, without retraining the base model.
  Dr. No is evaluated on LLaVA-1.6 Mistral 7B across multimodal abstention benchmarks, including UNK-VQA and MM-UPD, and additionally benchmarked on language reasoning tasks using Qwen3.5-2B on AbstentionBench subsets. Against multiple uncertainty-based abstention baselines, feature steering achieves a more favourable balance between correct answering and appropriate abstention than post-hoc rejection methods. The gains are strongest on UNK-VQA and on MM-UPD cases involving image--question or question--answer incompatibility, and transfer most clearly to mathematical reasoning subsets of AbstentionBench. However, performance is more limited on absent-answer detection and retrieval-heavy multi-hop QA, such as MuSiQue. These results suggest that sparse internal features provide lightweight control handles for shaping uncertainty-aware behaviour in foundation models, while also showing that abstention control is source-dependent rather than governed by a single universal signal.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dr. No：利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征进行推理期特征引导，调控基础模型的"弃答/作答"行为，无需重训练，在多模态与语言推理任务上取得更优的"正确作答—恰当弃答"平衡。
AI.motivation: 大模型在视觉或文本证据不足时仍给出自信答案，缺乏弃答（abstention）能力，在高风险或信息检索场景中难以信任；作者希望探究该行为背后的内部机制能否在推理期被识别并控制。
AI.method: Dr. No 采用特征引导（feature steering）：挖掘与"弃答"和"承诺作答（commitment）"相关的 SAE 稀疏特征，在 prefill 阶段对少量此类特征进行调制，不重训练基座模型。评测于 LLaVA-1.6 Mistral 7B 的 UNK-VQA、MM-UPD 多模态弃答基准，以及 Qwen3.5-2B 在 AbstentionBench 子集上的语言推理任务，并与多种基于不确定性的弃答基线（含事后拒绝方法）对比。
AI.result: 相比事后拒绝等不确定性基线，特征引导在正确作答与恰当弃答之间取得更有利的权衡；增益在 UNK-VQA 及图像—问题、问题—答案不兼容的 MM-UPD 情形最显著，并可较清晰地迁移到 AbstentionBench 的数学推理子集；但在缺失答案检测与检索密集型多跳问答（如 MuSiQue）上表现受限。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏内部特征可作为轻量控制手柄，塑造基础模型的不确定性感知行为；同时表明弃答控制是来源依赖的，并非由单一通用信号支配。

title: 6G ISAC Drone Detection: Signal Processing and Experimental Validation at FR1
summary: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) enables mobile networks to detect passive targets such as drones at minimal additional cost. However, in ISAC, a small drone must be detected against strong ground clutter with the limited radio resources left by communications. In this paper, we propose two ISAC target detectors: a coherent detector, which combines all frames and beam dwells of a revisit, and a non-coherent detector, robust to inter-frame clock phase drift. The algorithms leverage per-dwell clutter whitening and the adaptive coherence estimator (ACE) detection statistic to improve performance. Both detectors estimate the range, radial velocity, and azimuth of targets in real time on a laptop graphics processing unit (GPU). Measurements with an FR1 ISAC proof-of-concept system based on a commercial base station show that the coherent detector outperforms the non-coherent one and recovers the full track.

AI.tldr: 提出相干与非相干两种ISAC无人机检测器，基于逐驻留杂波白化和ACE统计量，在笔记本GPU上实时估计距离、径向速度与方位角；商用基站FR1样机实测表明相干检测器性能更优并能恢复完整航迹。
AI.motivation: ISAC使移动网络能以极小额外成本检测无人机等被动目标，但小目标需在强地杂波中、且仅使用通信剩余有限无线资源的条件下被检测。
AI.method: 设计两种检测器：相干检测器联合一次重访内所有帧与波束驻留；非相干检测器对帧间时钟相位漂移鲁棒。算法采用逐驻留杂波白化与自适应相干估计器（ACE）检测统计量，并在笔记本GPU上实时估计目标的距离、径向速度和方位角。
AI.result: 基于商用基站的FR1 ISAC概念验证系统实测显示，相干检测器优于非相干检测器，并恢复出完整航迹。
AI.conclusion: 逐驻留杂波白化结合ACE统计量可有效提升ISAC被动小目标检测性能，相干积累方式在资源受限条件下更具优势，且算法具备GPU实时可行性。

title: Is This 3D Asset Usable? Beyond the Beauty Render for Asset Curation
summary: Large 3D repositories make it easy to collect assets, but difficult to determine whether they can be reused reliably across scene assembly, editing, rendering, game production, and training-data construction. An asset can look plausible in RGB while hiding disconnected geometry, problematic UV organization, or materials that fail to resolve correctly after import. We introduce Diagnostic Rendered Evidence (DRE): aligned beauty, wireframe, and UV-seam-plus-wireframe views scored by pass-specific frozen ViT classifiers and combined through late fusion. On 1,234 human labeled TexVerse assets, nested grouped evaluation achieves 86.36% balanced accuracy and 88.32% bad-asset recall. On a separate, balanced 764 external reference test, DRE achieved 88.9% balanced reference-label accuracy. Our method requires only an imported asset and renderer-derived evidence, without repository identity, creator, popularity, text, or source metadata at inference. Our results support cross-corpus portability and show that purpose built diagnostic views expose defects that just the beauty views can miss. Webpage: https://rbz-99.github.io/is-this-3d-asset-usable/

AI.tldr: 提出Diagnostic Rendered Evidence (DRE)：用对齐的beauty、wireframe、UV-seam+wireframe三视图，经pass-specific冻结ViT分类器与late fusion，判定3D资产是否可复用。
AI.motivation: 大型3D资产库便于收集资产，但难以判断其能否在场景装配、编辑、渲染、游戏制作与训练数据构建中可靠复用。资产在RGB下看似合理，却可能隐藏断连几何、UV组织混乱或导入后材质解析失败等缺陷；仅凭beauty视图难以发现。
AI.method: DRE采用对齐的beauty、wireframe、UV-seam-plus-wireframe三种渲染视图，分别由pass-specific的冻结ViT分类器打分，再通过late fusion融合。推理时仅需导入的资产与渲染器派生证据，不使用仓库身份、创作者、热度、文本或来源元数据。评估采用nested grouped evaluation。
AI.result: 在1,234个人工标注TexVerse资产上，balanced accuracy达86.36%，bad-asset recall达88.32%；在独立的平衡764个外部参考测试集上，balanced reference-label accuracy为88.9%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持跨语料可移植性，并表明面向目的构建的诊断视图能揭示仅用beauty视图会遗漏的缺陷。

title: AdSteer: Native Advertising in Large Language Model Generation
summary: Large language model (LLM) services face rapidly rising serving costs. To sustain free or affordable access for a broad user base, alternative monetization mechanisms are needed. Native advertising offers a promising approach, as it creates economic value by aligning user intent with merchant offerings. Yet how to integrate sponsored content naturally into LLM responses remains largely underexplored. Existing approaches primarily rely on prompt-level injection, multi-pass rewriting, or fine-tuning, which can compromise response quality or introduce additional computational costs. We propose AdSteer, a lightweight decoding-time advertising framework that adaptively adjusts token probabilities to integrate contextually appropriate advertisement into responses. AdSteer calibrates the strength and duration of advertising influence, making sponsored content a natural part of the response. Experiments on GEM-Bench across three application scenarios show that AdSteer achieves an average improvement of 14.1% in overall score over the strongest baselines and 22.5% fewer total tokens on average than rewrite-based methods. These results demonstrate that AdSteer provides an effective and practical solution for native advertising in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出AdSteer：一种轻量级解码时（decoding-time）原生广告框架，通过自适应调整token概率将语境相关的广告自然融入LLM回复。
AI.motivation: LLM服务成本快速上升，为维持免费或低价访问需替代变现方式；原生广告通过对齐用户意图与商家供给创造经济价值，但如何在LLM回复中自然植入赞助内容尚缺乏研究，现有提示注入、多轮改写或微调方法会损害回复质量或增加计算开销。
AI.method: AdSteer在解码阶段自适应调整token概率，并校准广告影响的强度与持续时长，使赞助内容成为回复的自然组成部分；无需提示注入、多轮改写或微调。
AI.result: 在GEM-Bench三个应用场景上，AdSteer总体得分平均超越最强基线14.1%，总token数比基于改写的方法平均少22.5%。
AI.conclusion: AdSteer为LLM原生广告提供了有效且实用的解决方案。

authors: Ana Paula Wernz da Cunha Müller
title: Performance, Scalability and Maintenance: An Experimental Study of RPA vs. Autonomous Agents in the Healthcare Domain
summary: Healthcare information systems are fragmented, and retrieving data from legacy web portals is a recurrent need. Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is deterministic but sensitive to interface changes, whereas autonomous agents based on large language models (Agent Process Automation, APA) promise adaptability at a higher computational cost. Following Design Science Research, we developed and compared an RPA solution (Playwright) and an APA solution (browser-use, LangGraph and Gemini 2.5 Flash-lite) to retrieve mammography and breast ultrasound reports from a laboratory portal, treating reports solely as informational artifacts. Across two rounds (T and T+7), RPA reached 98.90% accuracy and 98.27% F1-score versus 96.49% and 94.48% for APA, was about 13 times faster (16.07 s vs. 207.21 s per patient) and cost about six times less per report (USD 0.030 vs. 0.187). Both reached 100% step success rates; APA varied more over time. For a stable interface, RPA was superior.

AI.tldr: 针对稳定界面场景，RPA在精度、速度与成本上全面优于基于LLM的APA智能体，APA的优势尚未体现。
AI.motivation: 医疗信息系统碎片化，从遗留Web门户反复抓取数据是常态需求；需比较确定性RPA与基于大语言模型的智能体流程自动化（APA）在真实医疗取数任务中的适用性边界。
AI.method: 遵循设计科学研究（DSR），开发并对比两套方案：RPA（Playwright）与APA（browser-use + LangGraph + Gemini 2.5 Flash-lite），任务为从检验门户检索乳腺钼靶与乳腺超声报告（仅作信息性工件处理），并进行两轮（T与T+7）重复评测。
AI.result: RPA准确率98.90%、F1 98.27%，APA为96.49%、94.48%；RPA每患者耗时约16.07s、APA约207.21s（快约13倍）；单份报告成本USD 0.030 vs 0.187（低约6倍）。两者步骤成功率均达100%，但APA跨时间波动更大。
AI.conclusion: 在界面稳定的条件下，RPA为更优选择；APA的高适应性与高算力成本使其仅在界面频繁变动等场景下才具潜在价值。

title: ExaTune: Exhaustive Hyperparameter Landscape Exploration at Scale
summary: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) returns a single optimal configuration, systematically discarding the explored performance landscape that encodes how results depend on configuration choices. Fitness landscape analysis comprises a robust collection of methods from evolutionary computation offering ruggedness indices, autocorrelation functions, and fitness-distance correlation that have never been applied to machine learning hyperparameter spaces at scale, given that fine-grained ground-truth enumeration data has not existed. We present ExaTune, an open-source HPC system to produce a new artifact class: the hyperparameter landscape map. ExaTune exhaustively evaluates every point on a discretized hyperparameter grid via $K$-fold cross-validation, aggregates results into reproducible parquet benchmarks, and applies a suite of five formalized landscape metrics: spatial autocorrelation (Moran's $I$), ruggedness, local optima density, fitness-distance correlation (FDC), and variance-based parameter importance. We release a benchmark collection of 8 complete landscape maps (totalling 285,080 exhaustively evaluated configurations) spanning five model families (SVMs, random forests, XGBoost, ridge regression, and $k$-nearest neighbors) across six classification and two regression benchmarks, hosted on HuggingFace. Empirical analysis demonstrates that Bayesian optimization, Optuna, Hyperband, and Random Search at standard trial budgets systematically miss instability regions, secondary optima, and parameter interaction effects that are visible in complete landscapes; information that is structurally unavailable to any optimizer by design.

AI.tldr: 提出开源HPC系统ExaTune，通过穷举离散网格+K折交叉验证构建"超参数景观图"新数据制品，定义五类适应度景观指标，并发布8个完整景观图基准（285,080个配置），揭示标准HPO方法在有限试次下的结构性盲区。
AI.motivation: 常规超参数优化仅返回单一最优配置，丢弃了探索过程中蕴含的性能景观信息；而进化计算中的适应度景观分析（崎岖度、自相关、FDC等）因缺乏细粒度真值枚举数据，从未在大规模ML超参数空间上应用。
AI.method: ExaTune作为开源HPC系统，对离散化超参数网格的每个点进行K折交叉验证穷举评估，结果聚合为可复现的parquet基准；并形式化实现五项景观指标：空间自相关（Moran's I）、崎岖度、局部最优密度、适应度-距离相关性（FDC）与基于方差的参数重要性。
AI.result: 发布8个完整景观图基准（共285,080个穷举评估配置），覆盖5类模型（SVM、随机森林、XGBoost、岭回归、k-NN）及6个分类与2个回归基准，托管于HuggingFace。实证表明贝叶斯优化、Optuna、Hyperband与随机搜索在标准试次预算下系统性地遗漏不稳定区域、次要最优与参数交互效应。
AI.conclusion: 完整景观图提供了优化器设计上无法获取的结构性信息；ExaTune为超参数景观的系统化分析建立了可复现的数据与指标基础。

title: Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection with Embedding-Space Explanations
summary: AI-generated images have reached unprecedented realism, while instruction-driven AI editors re-synthesize images for local changes, leaving no splice boundary to localize. Most detectors are black boxes with unverifiable verdicts and generalize poorly because adapting a backbone on the detection distribution memorizes generator-specific fingerprints that quickly become obsolete. Specialist detectors built on pure-vision representations, particularly DINOv3, generalize well across generators, but explainable methods forgo this advantage: jointly training one multimodal model for classification and language generation subjects its visual representation to the language objective. We therefore require that explanation training cannot alter the verdict. We introduce FOX, which first builds and locks a specialist DINOv3 detector, then uses its representation to guide a lightweight VLM toward forensic explanation. A joint-embedding predictor maps locked visual evidence into a frozen text encoder's semantic space, producing guidance that the VLM verbalizes on demand. FOX achieves 97.4 mean AUC across 14 unseen generators, 69.8 BERTScore on XPlainVerse, and 56.1 on LOKI.

AI.tldr: FOX 将"判决"与"解释"解耦：先冻结一个 DINOv3 专家检测器，再用其锁定表征引导轻量 VLM 生成取证解释，从而在保证可解释性的同时不损伤检测泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 指令驱动式 AI 编辑器可对图像做局部重合成，不留下拼接边界，传统定位线索失效；多数检测器为黑盒、判决不可验证，且在小检测分布上微调主干会记忆易过时的生成器指纹，泛化差。基于纯视觉表征（如 DINOv3）的专家检测器泛化好，但可解释方法通常将分类与语言生成联合训练于同一多模态模型，使视觉表征受语言目标牵制，丧失这一优势。因此作者提出核心约束：解释训练不得改变判决。
AI.method: FOX 采用两阶段解耦框架：第一步构建并"锁定"（冻结）一个基于 DINOv3 的专家检测器；第二步用其表征引导一个轻量 VLM 产出取证式解释——通过联合嵌入预测器将锁定的视觉证据映射到冻结文本编码器的语义空间，生成引导信号，VLM 按需将其语言化。
AI.result: 在 14 个未见生成器上取得 97.4 平均 AUC；在 XPlainVerse 上 BERTScore 为 69.8，在 LOKI 上为 56.1。
AI.conclusion: 将检测判决与解释生成解耦，可在保持专家检测器跨生成器泛化能力的前提下提供可验证的语言级取证解释，是实现"解释不影响判决"的一种可行范式。

title: PACT: Certifying What Is Written in Parallel Decoding of Diffusion Language Models
summary: Parallel decoding speeds up masked diffusion language models by writing several tokens per forward pass. Published commit rules choose these tokens by testing the predicted distributions. Under sampling the written tokens are drawn, and these tests do not see them. We find that answer quality follows the reliability of the tokens actually written. An answer's log probability splits into this reliability and the dependence within each step. We propose PACT, a training-free commit rule that draws the tokens first, certifies the set it will write and spaces the positions of each step apart. This certificate holds at every temperature, and we show that no rule with the same guarantee commits more positions. Experiments use four models of the LLaDA and Dream families and HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, MATH500 and IFEval benchmarks. PACT reaches the quality of published commit rules with fewer forward passes. Spacing removes positions from each step, yet it usually lowers the total cost because later steps then write more tokens. At the same speed, published decoders also write a word twice in a row far more often than PACT. These results suggest that commit rules should certify the tokens they write. Code is available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/PACT.

AI.tldr: PACT：一种训练无关的提交规则，先采样再“认证”写入的token集合，并按步长间隔选位；在LLaDA/Dream四个模型、五个基准上以更少前向次数达到已发表提交规则的同等质量。
AI.motivation: 现有并行解码的提交规则通过检验预测分布来选token，但在随机采样下实际写入的token并未被检验；作者发现答案质量取决于实际写入token的可靠性。因此需要让提交规则直接认证真正写出的token。
AI.method: 提出PACT：训练无关的提交规则，先抽取token，再对将要写入的集合进行认证（certificate），并将每步位置在序列上间隔开；该认证在所有温度下成立，并证明在同等保证下没有规则能提交更多位置。
AI.result: 在LLaDA与Dream家族4个模型、HumanEval/MBPP/GSM8K/MATH500/IFEval上，PACT以更少前向次数达到已发表规则的质量；间隔会减少每步位置，但通常降低总成本（后续步骤写入更多token）；同速下已发表解码器连续重复同一词的概率远高于PACT。
AI.conclusion: 提交规则应当认证其实际写入的token；PACT给出了可行且高效的实现路径。

title: Predictive gains, causal losses: why interventional competence cannot be learned from data alone
summary: Retaining predictive gains can require persistent errors in a model's response to interventions. For deterministic predictors with finite second moments under squared-error loss, any observational advantage over the best predictor using only an outcome's direct causes requires dependence on other inputs, regardless of the learning rule. When admissible interventions vary inputs while preserving the worldly outcome, this dependence yields a positive lower bound on root-mean-square intervention-response error. We identify conditions under which population gradient updates introduce this dependence from a parent-only baseline or damage a previously correct mechanism through shared parameters while improving other predictions. These dependencies can also make model behavior vary with how the same intervention is realized. We characterize interventional alignment through a common output mapping across internal states and physical processes realizing the same intervention target and relevant context. Correction is limited by the causal hypotheses currently admitted within inquiry. The relevant hypothesis class comprises these causal alternatives, rather than the function class the computational system could in principle represent. For predictions restricted to these alternatives, interventional mean error cannot fall below the best approximation they permit, whether evidence is observational or interventional. Reducing error below a positive limit requires admitting better hypotheses, which may entail revising the causal variables, mechanism structure, or intervention interpretation. Interventional criticism constrains replacements without determining them. We conjecture that reliably acquiring and maintaining interventional competence when causal commitments fail requires autonomous participation in proposing alternatives, testing their consequences, and revising them in response to error.

AI.tldr: 该文论证：在平方损失下，若模型要保留相对于仅用结果直接原因的基线预测的优势，就必须依赖其他输入，从而在保持世界结果不变的可容许干预上产生正的干预响应误差下界；干预对齐受当前"已接纳的因果假设类"限制，降低误差需引入更好的假设并自主参与假设的提出、检验与修正。
AI.motivation: 解释为何具有观测优势的模型仍可能在干预下产生持续误差，并厘清这种误差的来源、下界条件及其对模型可靠性与因果修正的含义。
AI.method: 理论分析（概念性/形式化论证）：针对有限二阶矩的确定性预测器与平方误差损失，推导观测优势与对非直接原因输入的依赖之间的必然联系；在保持世界结果不变的可容许干预下给出均方根干预响应误差的正下界；刻画总体梯度更新引入该依赖或经共享参数破坏正确机制的条​​件；以"内部状态与物理过程间共同输出映射"定义干预对齐；以当前接纳的因果假设类刻画误差下界。
AI.result: (1) 任何超出仅用直接原因基线的观测增益都要求依赖其他输入，与学习规则无关；(2) 由此得到干预响应均方根误差的正下界；(3) 梯度更新可能在改善部分预测的同时引入该依赖或破坏既有正确机制，并使行为随干预实现方式变化；(4) 在受限假设类内，干预平均误差不低于该类所能达到的最佳近似，无论证据是观测还是干预的。
AI.conclusion: 预测增益与干预鲁棒性之间存在结构性张力；干预批评只能约束而不能决定替代假设；降低误差需修正因果变量、机制结构或干预解释。作者猜想：当因果承诺失效时，可靠获得并维持干预能力需系统自主提出替代假设、检验其后果并依误差修正。

title: Embedding Semantic Entropy: NLI-Free Semantic Uncertainty Estimation with Geometry-Aware Clustering
comment: Large Language Models; Uncertainty Quantification; Semantic Entropy; Clus- tering; K-Medoids; Hallucination Detection
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate fluent yet incorrect responses, making un- certainty estimation important for reliable deployment. Semantic Entropy (SE) estimates uncertainty by clustering responses based on semantic equivalence, but it relies on hard entailment-based clustering. We propose Embedding Semantic Entropy, which replaces entailment-based clustering with K-Medoids in semantic embedding space and uses dynamic cluster selection to account for intra-cluster compactness and inter-cluster separation. We evaluate the method on TriviaQA, SQuAD, NQ-Open, SVAMP, and BioASQ using Falcon- 7B-Instruct, LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-7B-Chat, and Gemma-7B. Results show competitive AUROC and AUARC performance, suggesting that NLI-based entailment clustering can be replaced with embedding-space clustering with limited degradation while improving the inspectability of semantic grouping. This matters because semantic uncertainty scores depend on underlying semantic groups; by making these groups explicit, compact, and separable in embedding space, Emb-SE turns uncertainty estimation from a black-box en- tailment decision into an inspectable clustering problem.

AI.tldr: 提出 Emb-SE，用嵌入空间 K-Medoids 聚类与动态簇选择替代语义熵中的 NLI 蕴含聚类来估计 LLM 不确定性。
AI.motivation: LLM 常生成流畅但错误的回答，需不确定性估计以支持可靠部署；语义熵（SE）依赖硬性蕴含判定聚类，缺乏可解释性且聚类质量受限。
AI.method: 在语义嵌入空间中使用 K-Medoids 聚类替代基于蕴含的聚类，并引入动态簇选择机制，同时考虑簇内紧凑性与簇间分离度来计算语义熵。
AI.result: 在 TriviaQA、SQuAD、NQ-Open、SVAMP、BioASQ 上，使用 Falcon-7B-Instruct、LLaMA-2-7B、LLaMA-2-7B-Chat、Gemma-7B 评估，AUROC 与 AUARC 表现具竞争力，性能下降有限。
AI.conclusion: NLI 蕴含聚类可由嵌入空间聚类替代且退化有限，同时使语义分组显式、紧凑、可分，将不确定性估计从黑箱蕴含判定转化为可检查的聚类问题。

title: Physics-Informed Identification of Tensegrity Prestress across Taut-Slack Transitions
comment: 44 pages, 15 figures, 15 tables; supplementary material included
summary: Prestress governs the stability, stiffness, and dynamic behavior of tensegrity structures, but it is not directly observable from sparse structural measurements, and it may decrease during service life. Under strong excitation, the cables may slacken and the dynamics become nonsmooth. Existing identification methods are limited to the taut regime, and physics-informed networks for tensegrities solve only the forward problem of predicting the response from known member parameters. This study formulates the inverse problem. Neural networks are trained on the equation-of-motion residual in constrained Cartesian coordinates, where the mass matrix is constant and the force densities enter linearly. The force densities, damping, and axial stiffness are trainable parameters, and the tension-only cable law is kept. A Fisher-information analysis shows, before inversion, which member parameters a record can determine. The method is tested on simulated planar tensegrity frames with up to five modules and a three-dimensional prism, and on measured records of a biomimetic leg and a full-scale tensegrity simplex. On the one-module frame, the identifiable force densities are recovered within 1.5% from noisy accelerations at half the free coordinates, on records with and without taut-slack transitions. Records with transitions determine members that taut records leave undetermined. On the five-module frame, a 16-cable two-span bridge, the median force-density error rises moderately, to 4.2%. On measured records, an identified spring stiffness is within 0.1% of its independently measured value on average, and the identified simplex prestress at 13 levels agrees with its cable force transducers to 2.9% root-mean-square.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于运动方程残差的物理信息神经网络方法，从稀疏实测数据反演张拉整体结构的预应力（力密度）、阻尼与轴向刚度，并保持仅受拉索单元本构，可处理索松弛引起的非光滑动力学。
AI.motivation: 预应力决定张拉整体结构的稳定性、刚度与动力学行为，但无法由稀疏测量直接观测，且服役期间可能退化；强激励下索松弛使动力学非光滑。既有的识别方法仅适用于索全张紧状态，而针对张拉整体的物理信息网络只求解由已知单元参数预测响应的正问题。因此需要建立可处理松弛与非光滑效应的预应力反演框架。
AI.method: 在约束笛卡尔坐标下以运动方程残差训练神经网络：该坐标下质量矩阵为常数、力密度线性进入方程，故将力密度、阻尼与轴向刚度设为可训练参数，并保留索的仅受拉本构。反演前采用Fisher信息分析判定某条记录可唯一确定哪些单元参数。
AI.result: 在含至多五个模块的平面张拉整体框架与一个三维棱柱的仿真上，以及在仿生腿与足尺张拉整体单体的实测记录上验证。单模块框架中，由半数自由坐标的含噪加速度在1.5%内恢复可辨识力密度，含与不含张紧-松弛切换的记录均有效；含切换记录可确定张紧记录无法确定的单元。五模块框架（16索两跨桥）力密度误差中位数升至4.2%。实测记录中识别弹簧刚度平均与独立实测值相差0.1%以内，13个预应力水平下识别结果与索力传感器一致，均方根误差2.9%。
AI.conclusion: 以运动方程残差为核心的反演网络在稀疏、含噪且含索松弛的记录下可高精度识别张拉整体预应力及相关单元参数，且松弛切换记录提供额外的可辨识性；Fisher信息分析可作为反演前的可辨识性预判工具，方法在仿真与实测上均得到验证。

title: Co-Occurrence Priors Override Visual Spatial Evidence: Understanding False Alarms in Vision-Language Models for Construction Struck-By Hazard Detection
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly support construction hazard monitoring, yet their frequent false alarms remain poorly understood. This study investigates whether false struck-by hazard warnings arise from failures in object recognition, spatial relation encoding, or hazard decisions dominated by learned co-occurrence priors. We evaluated Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B using 355 counterfactual worker-excavator scene pairs with controlled spatial proximity and worker-removal variants, combining behavioral analysis, internal representation probing, causal interventions, and decision correction. Both models recognized the entities and encoded their spatial relations (out-of-fold AUROC: 0.82 and 0.91), assigning higher hazard scores to near than far scenes in 79% and 73% of pairs. Nevertheless, 74% and 100% of far scenes were falsely classified as hazardous. Removing the worker reduced Qwen's hazard rate to 11%, while worker presence exerted 2.4- and 3.2-times greater influence on hazard scores than spatial proximity in the respective models. Attention-head interventions, neuron-level interventions, and activation steering failed to eliminate this co-occurrence bias. However, conditioning hazard decisions on the model's own spatial-relation representation improved Qwen's specificity from 0.36 to 0.58 at matched sensitivity, outperforming threshold recalibration. These findings reveal that VLM struck-by false alarms stem primarily from decision-making failures rather than deficiencies in object recognition or spatial encoding, suggesting that future efforts should prioritize conditioning hazard decisions on encoded spatial evidence rather than further improving visual recognition alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示VLM的"打击（struck-by）"危险误报主要源于决策阶段的共现先验偏置，而非物体识别或空间关系编码缺陷；将危险判定建立在模型自身空间关系表征上可显著提升特异性。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多用于施工危险监测，但频繁的误报机制尚不清楚。作者希望辨析误报究竟来自物体识别失败、空间关系编码失败，还是由学习到的共现先验主导的危险决策。
AI.method: 构建355对反事实的工人—挖掘机场景对（控制空间远近，并设置移除工人等变体），评估Qwen2.5-VL-7B与InternVL3.5-8B；综合行为分析、内部表征探针（out-of-fold AUROC）、因果干预（注意力头干预、神经元级干预、激活引导）与决策校正实验。
AI.result: 两模型均能识别实体并编码空间关系（AUROC 0.82、0.91），在79%与73%的场景对中给近景更高危险分；但74%与100%的远景被误判为危险。移除工人使Qwen危险率降至11%；工人存在对危险分的影响是空间距离的2.4倍与3.2倍。注意力头、神经元与激活引导干预均未能消除共现偏置；而将危险决策条件化于模型自身空间关系表征，在等敏感度下使Qwen特异性从0.36提升至0.58，优于阈值重校准。
AI.conclusion: VLM的打击类误报主要是决策层面的失败，而非识别或空间编码缺陷；未来应优先将危险判定条件化于已编码的空间证据，而非仅提升视觉识别能力。

title: Length Is Cheap, Competition Is Not: Attention Predicts Context Rot in Retrieval
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Code and trial-level data: https://github.com/yliusci/length-is-cheap
summary: Why do language models fail on long inputs? The common answer is length. We show that, for retrieval, length is cheap and competition is not. On five open models (0.5B to 3B parameters, four families), neutral filler costs nothing: accuracy stays at 0.97 to 1.00, up to 32K tokens on Qwen2.5-1.5B. Statements in the format of the evidence, placed at the same positions, drop it to 0.16 to 0.33. A single statement that gives the queried key a rival value multiplies the loss by 9 to 110, and every additional rival adds to it. Inside the model, one quantity tracks the failure: the attention mass left on the evidence. Across 126,473 trials it explains up to 58% of the variance in loss; log length explains at most 8%. The masked-filler protocol behind the claim that length alone hurts reproduces on MMLU (11 to 18 points lost at 30K tokens), but fails a visible control in retrieval: masking costs 45 accuracy points at 32K tokens, while the same filler left visible costs none. In retrieval, context rot is a competition for attention. We release the probe and all 126K trial-level measurements.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出检索任务中语言模型的长文本失效并非源于"长度"本身，而是源于证据与竞争性干扰项对注意力资源的争夺；注意力留在证据上的质量是失效的核心预测变量。
AI.motivation: 已有观点（"context rot"）普遍将长输入性能下降归因于长度。作者质疑这一归因：此前支持"长度有害"的实验使用了masked-filler协议，掩盖了干扰内容的影响。论文旨在分离"长度"与"竞争"两个因素，找出真正驱动失效的机制。
AI.method: 在5个开源模型（0.5B–3B参数，4个模型家族）上做受控实验：对比中性填充文本与"证据格式"的陈述句，将干扰项置于相同位置；引入单个给出竞争值的陈述句并递增竞争项数量；以注意力质量（attention mass）留在证据上的比例作为探针。共126,473次试验，并做MMLU复现与检索任务下的可见对照（masked vs. visible filler）。
AI.result: 中性填充下准确率维持0.97–1.00（Qwen2.5-1.5B至32K token）；同位置证据格式陈述使准确率降至0.16–0.33。单个给出竞争值的陈述句使损失放大9–110倍，每增加一个竞争项损失继续累加。注意力留在证据上的质量可解释高达58%的损失方差，而log长度最多解释8%。masked-filler协议在MMLU上复现（30K token损失11–18分），但检索的可见对照失败：masking在32K token损失45分，而相同填充保持可见则无损失。
AI.conclusion: 检索场景下的"context rot"本质是注意力竞争，而非长度：长度代价低廉，竞争代价高昂；证据上的注意力质量是解释失效的关键内部量。作者开源探针与全部126K试验级测量数据。

title: ProofPaths: An AI Agent Framework for Assessing Student Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the 8th Workshop on Education for High Performance Computing (EduHiPC 2026). 6 pages, 3 figures. https://proofpaths.github.io
summary: Students can use large language models to complete assignments, but a correct solution does not establish whether they understand the reasoning behind it. Individualized interviews can probe that understanding but require recurring staff effort. We introduce ProofPaths, an AI agentic framework that combines rubric-based grading with individualized and interactive interviews.
