Multiple grading agents assess a submission against instructor guidance, exchange critiques, and revise their judgments. Their scores determine which review supplies the grade and feedback. An interview agent asks students to justify steps in their submission and uses their answers to guide follow-up questions. Each question is linked to a retrieved submission excerpt, so instructors can compare the student's explanation with the cited passage. The system tracks assessment progress and stores grading reviews and interview transcripts for each submission. Several deterministic tests of the assessment controllers check source handling, score aggregation, and limits on correction attempts. Instructors can inspect all reviews and transcripts and override grades within the assignment workflow.

AI.tldr: 提出 ProofPaths——一个智能体框架，将基于评分标准的阅卷与个性化交互式面试相结合，用于判断学生提交中推理的真实理解程度。
AI.motivation: 学生可用大语言模型完成作业，正确答案并不能证明其理解背后的推理；人工个性化面试虽能探查理解，但需要持续投入人力。
AI.method: 多评分智能体依据教师指引独立评估并交换批评意见、修正判断，得分决定哪份评审提供成绩与反馈；面试智能体要求学生解释提交中的步骤，并据其回答驱动追问，每个问题关联检索到的提交片段以便教师比对；系统跟踪评估进度并存储评分评审与面试记录，配以针对控制器（来源处理、分数聚合、修正次数上限）的确定性测试。
AI.result: 确定性测试验证了评估控制器在来源处理、分数聚合与修正尝试上限方面的行为；系统可保存每份提交的评审与面试转录，并支持教师查看与在作业流程内覆盖成绩。
AI.conclusion: ProofPaths 以智能体化的阅卷+面试组合替代持续的教辅人工投入，提供可追溯、可人工监督的理解性评估流程；摘要未报告实证教学效果。

title: The Information Limits of Neural Controlled Differential Equations Under Sparse Observations
comment: Preliminary version. Further theoretical extensions are under development
summary: Neural controlled differential equations (Neural CDEs) evolve hidden states along continuous paths constructed by interpolating discrete observations. Sparse measurements leave the input between observation times undetermined, and admissible continuous paths consistent with the same data can produce different terminal states. We characterize this ambiguity for planar drivers with bounded speed. The set of compatible terminal states admits a leading-order zonotopic approximation determined by feasible signed areas and transported Lie brackets. Its projection onto a scalar prediction yields a computable, target-specific ambiguity certificate. We also study the number of measurements needed to reduce the remaining uncertainty. For nondegenerate planar CDEs, the optimal worst-case radius over deterministic adaptive sampling policies scales as $N^{-1}$ when speed is bounded and $N^{-2}$ when both speed and acceleration are bounded, where $N$ is the number of observation intervals. Synthetic experiments assess the certificate using admissible continuous completions and examine the role of path regularity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Neural CDE在稀疏离散观测下的输入路径不确定性：对平面驱动、有界速度情形刻画兼容终端状态集合，给出其前导阶zonotope近似与可计算的目标特定歧义证书，并分析降低剩余不确定性的采样数量及其最优最坏情形半径的收敛阶。
AI.motivation: Neural CDE沿由离散观测插值构造的连续路径演化隐状态，但稀疏测量使观测时刻之间的输入无法确定；与同一数据相容的多个连续路径可导致不同的终端状态，因此需要量化这种歧义并研究减少不确定性的采样需求。
AI.method: 针对有界速度的平面驱动，刻画兼容终端状态集合，给出由可行有符号面积与输运Lie括号确定的前导阶zonotope近似；将其投影到标量预测得到可计算、目标特定的歧义证书；分析确定性自适应采样策略下最优最坏情形半径随观测区间数N的标度；并用合成实验以可行的连续补全评估证书并考察路径正则性作用。
AI.result: 兼容终端状态集可被前导阶zonotope近似，其投影给出目标特定的可计算歧义证书；对非退化平面CDE，最优最坏情形半径在有界速度下按N^{-1}缩放，在速度与加速度均有界时按N^{-2}缩放；合成实验验证了证书并考察了路径正则性的影响。
AI.conclusion: Neural CDE在稀疏观测下的终端状态歧义可通过zonotope近似与目标特定证书进行量化，且提高驱动路径正则性（如增加加速度界）可将不确定性衰减速率从N^{-1}提升至N^{-2}；合成实验支持该理论与证书的有效性。

title: On the Learnability of Footwear Robustness: Footstep Recognition Under Unseen Conditions
summary: Footstep patterns, captured using pressure or force-sensitive walkways during natural walking, offer a convenient and passive approach to biometric recognition. However, footwear variability poses a major challenge to practical deployment, as it impacts both the foot-sensor interface and the user's underlying gait mechanics. This study considers the particularly difficult scenario where users enroll under one fixed footwear condition but must later be recognized in arbitrary, unseen footwear. Using the StepUP-P150 dataset, we show that footwear-induced shift, while substantial and heterogeneous across individuals, contains shared structure that can be learned from a training population and transferred, zero-shot, to previously unseen users and footwear styles. We do this using BiStepNet, a novel architecture that decomposes spatial and temporal identity cues into independently trainable streams and outperforms compact 3D spatiotemporal baselines for cross-footwear recognition. We demonstrate that cross-footwear recognition performance scales systematically with the volume and diversity of footwear representation in the training set, with gains transferring to footwear styles not directly observed during training. Moreover, we show that auxiliary gait datasets with only partial modality overlap (incorporated through the architecture's decomposed design) can be leveraged to further improve robustness to unseen footwear conditions.

AI.tldr: 基于StepUP-P150数据集，提出BiStepNet架构，将空间与时间身份线索分解为可独立训练的流，实现"注册固定鞋、识别任意未见鞋"场景下的零样本跨鞋步态识别。
AI.motivation: 压力/力敏步道采集的足迹模式可被动、便捷地用于生物特征识别，但鞋类变化同时影响足-传感器界面与步态力学，是其实际部署的主要障碍，尤其困难的是注册与识别鞋类不一致的场景。
AI.method: 利用StepUP-P150数据集，发现鞋类引起的偏移虽个体间差异大但含可从训练群体学习并零样本迁移的共享结构；据此提出BiStepNet，将空间与时间身份线索分解为独立可训练的流；并通过该分解设计整合仅部分模态重叠的辅助步态数据集。
AI.result: BiStepNet在跨鞋识别上优于紧凑3D时空基线；跨鞋性能随训练集中鞋类表征的数量与多样性系统提升，且增益可迁移至训练中未直接出现的鞋型；辅助数据集可进一步提升对未见鞋条件的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 鞋类偏移具有可学习、可迁移的共享结构，分解式架构设计使零样本跨鞋足迹识别可行，并通过数据规模/多样性与辅助模态数据进一步受益。

title: Improving PI-RADS Prediction and Prostate Cancer Detection from Multiparametric MRI with Anatomical Guidance
summary: Accurate prediction of Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System (PI-RADS) scores from multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) remains challenging, more so than clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) detection. Given the importance of lesion location in PI-RADS scoring, we evaluated whether incorporating prostate zonal masks improves PI-RADS prediction and csPCa detection across multiple architectures (3D ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and ViT) using a large-scale internal dataset. Anatomical guidance generally improved performance across architectures, with the best results achieved by ResNet-18 with 2-zone guidance for PI-RADS prediction (QWK = 0.511) and ResNet-50 with 5-zone guidance for csPCa detection (AUC = 0.809). Fine-tuned results on external datasets further demonstrated the benefits of anatomical guidance. Furthermore, models with anatomical guidance improved the utility of model-predicted PI-RADS scores for PI-RADS-based csPCa detection (positive defined as PI-RADS>=3). Combining model-predicted and expert-assigned PI-RADS scores significantly increased the AUC from 0.711 to 0.756 (p < 0.05), suggesting that AI-derived PI-RADS scores may provide complementary information to expert assessment for csPCa detection. Overall, our findings highlight the value of incorporating prostate zonal anatomy into deep learning-based prostate MRI assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文评估在深度学习模型中加入前列腺分区掩膜（zonal masks）能否提升mpMRI上的PI-RADS评分预测与临床显著前列腺癌检测性能。
AI.motivation: 从mpMRI精确预测PI-RADS评分比检测csPCa更难，而病灶位置对PI-RADS评分至关重要，故作者假设引入前列腺分区解剖信息可带来收益，并检验其跨架构的普适性。
AI.method: 在大规模内部数据集上，对3D ResNet-18、ResNet-50与ViT三种架构，分别比较无解剖引导、2区与5区掩膜引导的建模方式；并在外部数据集上做微调验证；进一步分析模型预测PI-RADS与专家评分结合对csPCa检测的价值。
AI.result: 解剖引导总体提升各架构性能：PI-RADS预测最佳为ResNet-18+2区引导（QWK=0.511），csPCa检测最佳为ResNet-50+5区引导（AUC=0.809）；外部微调同样获益。以PI-RADS≥3判定csPCa时，模型预测与专家评分结合使AUC由0.711升至0.756（p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 将前列腺分区解剖先验融入深度学习可提升PI-RADS预测与csPCa检测，且AI预测的PI-RADS可为专家评估提供互补信息。

title: Tokenizer Myths and Where To Find Them
summary: Tokenization is a fundamental component of modern language models: before a model sees data, its tokenizer has already determined how the data appears. We identify and challenge three myths in the tokenization research literature. Myth #1: Bits-Per-Byte (BPB) is agnostic to the tokenizer and/or the vocabulary size: BPB is tokens per byte times bits per token, and the two factors do not cancel; using untrained models, we show that BPB prefers some tokenizers over others: the model has learned nothing, but the tokenizer--model pair has. Myth #2: lower BPB means a better model: On untrained models, BPB strongly prefers some vocabulary sizes, even though accuracy remains at chance, and on real models trained on the same data, BPB correlates weakly with downstream performance. Myth #3: different "tokenizer-agnostic" metrics yield consistent results: The "unigram-normalized loss" is not tokenizer-agnostic; its reported correlation of 0.989 with BPB comes from a confounder and falls to 0.057 once fixed; from the same data the two metrics select different vocabularies at each model size. We present a tokenizer trilemma: no metric can score only the true distribution best, give the same predictions the same score, and tie all untrained models, so choosing a metric is choosing a research question. We conclude with a caution for reading the tokenization literature and a conjecture for future work.

AI.tldr: 该文质疑分词研究中的三个"神话"：BPB（Bits-Per-Byte）对分词器/词表大小并非无关；更低BPB不代表更好模型；不同"分词器无关"指标结果并不一致。作者提出"分词三难困境"：不存在一个指标能同时满足只给真实分布最优评分、对相同预测给相同分数、并使所有未训练模型并列。
AI.motivation: 分词器在模型看到数据前就决定了数据的呈现方式，是语言模型的基础组件。然而文献中广泛使用的一些评价指标被默认为"分词器无关"或"模型能力代理"，作者认为这些假设存在系统性误解，需加以识别与纠正。
AI.method: (1) 以BPB = 每字节token数 × 每token比特数的分解出发，用未训练模型实验检验BPB对分词器与词表大小的敏感性；(2) 在未训练模型（准确率处于随机水平）及同一数据训练的真实模型上，比较BPB与下游性能的相关性；(3) 检验"unigram归一化损失"的分词器无关性，分析其与BPB的0.989相关是否源于混杂因素，并在校正后重估相关性及不同模型规模下的词表选择结果；(4) 由此提出分词三难困境的理论论证。
AI.result: 未训练模型上BPB即偏好某些分词器（模型未学习，但分词器-模型组合"学"到了东西）；BPB强烈偏好某些词表大小而准确率仍为随机水平；在真实模型上BPB与下游性能仅弱相关；unigram归一化损失并非分词器无关，其与BPB的0.989相关来自混杂因素，校正后降至0.057，且两指标在同一数据上于各模型规模选择的词表不同；三难困境表明三者不可兼得，指标选择即研究问题的选择。
AI.conclusion: 现有分词评价指标均非真正"分词器无关"，BPB不宜作为模型质量或词表选择的无条件依据；选择指标本质上是在选择研究问题。作者给出阅读分词文献的警示与未来工作的猜想，呼吁重新审视以BPB等指标为基础的词表/分词器比较结论。

title: What Is This Memory Useful For? Measuring Task-Conditioned Utility in Long-Term Agent Memory
comment: 18 pages, including supplementary material. Project website: https://chihhsuan-yang.github.io/AAMAS2027-ConditionalMemory/
summary:
A stored experience may answer one future question and offer little help with another. We measure this task-conditioned utility rather than assigning each memory a single importance score. A task-blind writer stores a memory without seeing the later task; a frozen reader then answers that task with and without the memory, using identical filler. A cost ledger records the resources used to form, store and expose the memory.
  On single-call factual-recall tasks built from LongMemEval-V2 web-agent memories, the same memory helps more when it contains information needed for the answer. Its mean paired reward gain on these answer-bearing task pairs exceeds that on matched-control pairs by $+0.33$ (95% interval $+0.21$ to $+0.46$). The tested task-blind summaries and structured records yield smaller gains than Raw, including at fixed total context; a budget sweep is consistent with retention of answer-bearing content contributing to the difference. The bearing--control contrast remains positive in a new session with randomized memory position and under a second reader, although individual memory--task labels change. Generic retrieval performs above chance but misses most screen-defined answer-bearing memories. The factual-recall gains do not extend to the tested software-engineering and scientific-coding benchmarks, where even raw memories have no measurable effect. We provide a public, versioned Conditional Memory Utility Dataset of paired measurements and costs. The practical takeaway is to evaluate memory compression by the task utility it preserves alongside its costs. Task-conditioned measurements make this comparison possible; their stability must also be checked.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“任务条件化记忆效用”度量，用任务盲写者+冻结读者+成本账本量化同一记忆对不同任务的增益，在LongMemEval-V2上验证答案承载记忆增益+0.33，并发布公开数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆/压缩研究通常给每条记忆打单一重要性分数，忽略“同一存储经验对不同未来任务价值不同”这一任务依赖性，也无法兼顾形成、存储、暴露的资源成本。
AI.method: 设计任务条件化效用测量框架：任务盲写者在未见下游任务时写入记忆；冻结读者在相同填充内容下分别带/不带该记忆回答任务，计算配对奖励增益；成本账本记录形成、存储、暴露资源。在LongMemEval-V2 web-agent记忆上构造答案承载任务对与匹配对照对，比较Raw、任务盲摘要与结构化记录，做预算扫描、随机记忆位置、第二读者等稳健性检验，并在软件工程与科学编程基准上外推测试。
AI.result: 答案承载任务对的平均配对奖励增益比匹配对照对高+0.33（95%区间+0.21~+0.46）；任务盲摘要与结构化记录增益小于Raw（固定总上下文时亦然）；预算扫描与答案承载内容保留一致；新会话随机位置与第二读者下对比仍为正，但单条记忆-任务标签会变化；通用检索高于随机但漏掉多数屏幕定义的答案承载记忆；在软件工程与科学编程基准上无显著效果。
AI.conclusion: 应以任务效用与成本共同评价记忆压缩，任务条件化测量使该比较可行，但其稳定性需额外检验；同时发布版本化Conditional Memory Utility Dataset。

title: When Latent Dynamics Meet Data Assimilation: A Benchmark of Koopman-Type Representations
summary: Koopman representations describe nonlinear dynamics through linear evolution in a transformed space, offering an attractive framework for their linear simplicity and generality. Yet these advantages do not necessarily translate into improved performance in deep latent data assimilation (LDA). We systematically compare seven representative methods and structural baselines across five systems spanning approximately periodic to strongly chaotic dynamics and a broad range of state dimensions. We evaluate forecast and assimilation accuracy, physical state recovery, latent-trajectory behavior, and dynamical consistency, and assess Gaussian error assumptions, objective convexity, and uniqueness of analysis solutions. Our results reveal a trade-off between representational flexibility and optimization tractability. Linear evolution of the latent state can stabilize short-term forecasts but restrict expressiveness in strongly chaotic and high-dimensional systems, without consistently improving assimilation accuracy. Parameterized linear operators offer greater flexibility, yet their joint optimization with the encoder--decoder remains nonconvex. Methods with closed-form analysis updates generally perform better and exhibit greater robustness in our experiments, although matrix inversion remains a computational bottleneck. These findings show that the practical benefits of Koopman structure depend on both sufficient observational information and the choice of assimilation procedure.

AI.tldr: 系统比较七种Koopman表示方法在潜空间数据同化中的表现，发现Koopman结构的实际收益取决于观测信息充分性与同化过程的选择，而非其线性简洁性本身。
AI.motivation: Koopman表示以线性演化刻画非线性动力学，具备简洁性与通用性，但该优势在深度潜数据同化（LDA）中未必转化为性能提升；本文旨在厘清Koopman结构在LDA中的真实效用与适用边界。
AI.method: 对七种代表性方法与结构基线进行系统对比，覆盖五个系统（从近似周期到强混沌）及广泛状态维度；评估预测与同化精度、物理状态恢复、潜轨迹行为与动力学一致性，并考察高斯误差假设、目标函数凸性与分析解唯一性。
AI.result: 存在表示灵活性与优化可解性之间的权衡：潜状态线性演化可稳定短期预测，但限制强混沌与高维系统的表达能力，且未持续提升同化精度；参数化线性算子更灵活，但与编码器-解码器联合优化仍非凸；具备闭式分析更新的方法总体更优、更稳健，但矩阵求逆是计算瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: Koopman结构的实际收益取决于观测信息是否充分以及同化流程的选择，而非线性简洁性本身；设计LDA时应权衡表示表达能力与优化可解性。

title: Characterizing the vertical continuity of fuel strata based on TLS point clouds Gaussian decomposition and overlap metrics
comment: 45 pages, 15 figures Author affiliations and ORCID: Jesús Torralba https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8644-8604 , Luis Á. Ruiz https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0073-7259 , Pablo Crespo-Peremarch https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2241-4493 , Marina Simó-Martí https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9605-9645 , Juan Pedro Carbonell-Rivera https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6724-6780
summary: Vertical forest structure influences fire behavior by regulating understory-to-canopy fuel connectivity, yet operational fuel-type models represent this complexity through discrete classes that only indirectly capture vertical continuity. High-density point clouds offer an opportunity to characterize vertical fuel connectivity in a more explicit and continuous manner, but specific methodological approaches are still required. We applied Gaussian decomposition to vertical height profiles derived from terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) point clouds across 25 permanent forest plots to characterize geometric vertical fuel continuity. A multiscale analysis spanning from the plot scale to ~0.5 $m^2$ units was used to evaluate geometric, probabilistic, and overlap metrics for characterizing fuel strata. The method reproduced the vertical transition between shrub and tree strata, with median Pearson correlations ranging from 0.83 to 0.96 across analysis levels. Probability density overlap metrics and separability indicators, such as the Jeffries-Matusita distance, provided complementary descriptors of vertical continuity. Intermediate spatial scales (3-6 m cells) provided a useful compromise between spatial detail and the consistent representation of shrub-canopy interaction patterns. Finer scales increased variability due to point density reduction and profile irregularity, and low mean squared error values were found insufficient as sole performance indicators. Gaussian decomposition applied to TLS point clouds enables explicit quantification of vertical fuel continuity, a limitation of current discrete classification systems. Continuous vertical connectivity metrics derived from this approach offer a pathway for improving ladder fuel characterization and strengthening decision-making support in wildfire risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 应用高斯分解处理TLS点云垂直高度剖面，实现森林垂直可燃物连续性的显式、连续量化。
AI.motivation: 垂直森林结构通过调控林下—林冠可燃物的垂直连通性影响火行为，但业务化可燃物类型模型仅以离散类别间接表征垂直连续性。高密度点云为显式刻画垂直可燃物连通性提供可能，但尚缺具体方法。
AI.method: 在25个永久样地上，对地基激光扫描（TLS）点云的垂直高度剖面施加高斯分解，并开展从样地尺度到约0.5 m²单元的多尺度分析，评价几何、概率与重叠三类可燃物层指标。
AI.result: 方法重现了灌木层与乔木层之间的垂直过渡，各分析层级中位Pearson相关为0.83–0.96；概率密度重叠与可分性指标（如Jeffries-Matusita距离）提供互补的连续性描述；3–6 m单元在空间细节与灌木—林冠交互格局稳定性之间取得折中，更细尺度因点密度下降与剖面不规则而变异性增大，且低MSE不足以单独作为性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 高斯分解可由TLS点云显式量化垂直可燃物连续性，弥补离散分类体系的不足，为梯状可燃物刻画与野火风险评估决策支持提供途径。

title: What Remains in Sight? Autoregressive Video Decoding as Representation-Guided Context Rewriting
summary: Long-horizon video generation is increasingly moving toward autoregressive rollout, where each newly generated segment becomes part of the evidence used for future prediction. Recent causal decoders, long-context training, and KV-cache mechanisms have extended feasible duration, but most inference pipelines still decide the visible past implicitly through recent windows, compressed caches, or external memory. This raises a direct question: \textbf{can the choice of which past frames or segments to show to the decoder be treated as an explicit test-time decision?} We answer this question with \textsc{ReCR}, a training-free method that formulates autoregressive video decoding as representation-guided context rewriting. At each step, \textsc{ReCR} builds a selected visible context from the generated history by using internal decoder representations to favor context units that match the global rollout state, avoid redundancy with the recent continuation, preserve temporal boundary coverage, and widen the range of spatial layouts in view. The selected units are then mapped onto a compact causal axis before decoding the next block. Across long-horizon text-to-video benchmarks, \textsc{ReCR} consistently improves multiple autoregressive backbones under matched visible-token budgets. Empirical analyses such as representation-space diagnostics and transition-count prompt switching further show that improving what remains visible is an effective path toward more stable long-video decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 ReCR，将自回归视频解码中的"可见历史选择"显式化为表示引导的上下文重写，在固定可见 token 预算下提升长视频生成稳定性。
AI.motivation: 长时程视频生成趋向自回归 rollout，但现有推理管线多通过近期窗口、压缩缓存或外部记忆隐式决定可见过去，未把"选择哪些历史帧/片段呈现给解码器"本身作为可优化的测试时决策。
AI.method: ReCR 在每个解码步利用解码器内部表示对生成的历​​史进行上下文单元选择，准则包括：与全局 rollout 状态匹配、避免与近期延续冗余、保持时间边界覆盖、扩大空间布局多样性；随后将选中单元映射到紧凑的因果轴上，再解码下一个块。全过程无需训练。
AI.result: 在多个长时程文本到视频基准上，于匹配可见 token 预算条件下对多种自回归骨干均取得一致提升；表示空间诊断与基于转移计数的提示切换分析进一步验证其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 改善"仍可见什么"是通往更稳定长视频解码的有效路径；可见上下文的选择可作为显式、可控制的测试时决策。

title: Shared Context Candidate Scoring with Jointly Adapted Readout Networks
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Jingyang Du and Yiben Fu contributed equally to this work and share first authorship. Corresponding author: Yang Shen
summary: Repeated decisions over a shared document create two distinct opportunities: reusing document computation and adapting how question representations score candidate answers. We present Q64, a candidate-scoring system that preserves a frozen 64-layer Qwen3.8-27B text backbone, reuses its hybrid prefix state and intermediate document representations, and jointly trains a residual adapter with a four-layer decoder and candidate-conditioned readout. We used ZiYor, a self-evolving AI system, to explore and refine the Q64 design. We specified the scoring method, implemented the system, and evaluated its accuracy and latency. The final adaptation stage updates 88.66 million parameters using 8,192 selected training views. On a fixed 5,112-item evaluation combining ARC-Challenge, ANLI-R3, and stratified subsets of MMLU-Pro and CMMLU, joint adaptation improves four-benchmark macro accuracy from 66.46% to 74.32%. It remains below the native 27B baseline at 75.68% and AnyJev Qwen3-32B L0 at 76.68%. On a separate synthetic workload with 4,096 document tokens and 50 questions, median cold-request latency is 2.237 seconds, compared with 5.383 seconds for the native baseline and 56.872 seconds for the measured batched AnyJev configuration. Short single-question requests do not share this advantage. The evidence supports an accuracy-latency tradeoff in the evaluated systems, rather than a backbone reduction or an isolated component advantage. Public benchmarks informed earlier development, and real-document multi-question validation remains open.

AI.tldr: 提出Q64候选打分系统：冻结64层Qwen3.8-27B骨干，复用混合前缀状态与中间文档表示，联合训练残差适配器、四层解码器与候选条件读出；在固定基准上宏观准确率66.46%→74.32%，长文档多问负载下中位冷请求延迟2.237s（原生5.383s），体现准确性—延迟折中而非骨干压缩。
AI.motivation: 针对同一共享文档上的重复提问，存在两类机会：复用文档侧计算，以及适配问题表示对候选答案的打分方式。现有原生大模型逐次重算文档开销高，而纯批处理配置延迟仍大，故需在冻结骨干上构建可复用文档状态的高效候选打分系统。
AI.method: Q64保留冻结的64层Qwen3.8-27B文本骨干，复用其混合前缀状态与中间文档表示；联合训练残差适配器、四层解码器与候选条件读出（candidate-conditioned readout）。最终适配阶段仅更新88.66M参数，使用8,192个筛选训练视图。设计探索与细化由自演化系统ZiYor完成。评测：5,112题固定集合（ARC-Challenge、ANLI-R3及MMLU-Pro/CMMLU分层子集）测准确率；另设合成负载（4,096文档token×50问题）测中位冷请求延迟。
AI.result: 联合适配将四基准宏观准确率由66.46%提升至74.32%，但仍低于原生27B基线75.68%与AnyJev Qwen3-32B L0的76.68%。4,096文档token、50问题的合成负载下，中位冷请求延迟2.237s，优于原生基线5.383s及批处理AnyJev配置56.872s；但单问题短请求不具备该延迟优势。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持的结论是所评测系统间存在准确性—延迟折中，而非骨干压缩或单一组件带来的孤立优势。公开基准仅指导早期开发，真实文档多问题场景的验证仍待完成。

title: We Ran a Research Sprint With AI. The AI Worked. The Research Didn't
summary: Generative AI tools for research are widely deployed, yet individual productivity gains do not guarantee better team research. We argue that how AI use is structured matters alongside access. Personal AI tools may amplify two failures under deadline pressure: a consumption bottleneck, in which generation outpaces team-visible evaluation, and AI-induced research silos, in which private human-AI loops displace shared decision-making. We motivate this position with a mechanism-generating pilot: a 100-minute research sprint with twelve researchers in three independently operating teams, within a seventeen-person session. Both patterns recurred across teams and evidence sources. Of 33 logged AI interactions, one was accepted outright and 27 lacked a recorded disposition; missing records alone do not establish absent evaluation. A parallel autonomous pipeline produced a complete draft without in-session human evaluation, illustrating production capacity rather than comparative quality. We propose Human-AI-Human collaboration: an interaction topology in which AI connects researchers' contexts and supports inspectable collective evaluation and decision-making. The pilot does not isolate AI-specific effects from time pressure or workflow practices. We close with seven modular, falsifiable design hypotheses, prioritizing shared context and team-visible evaluation checkpoints for controlled follow-up.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场/观点论文：主张生成式AI对科研团队的影响关键在于"使用结构"而非仅"可及性"，个人AI工具在截止期压力下会放大"消费瓶颈"与"AI诱导的研究孤岛"两类失效，倡议以"人-AI-人"协作拓扑替代私人人-AI闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有研究与部署关注个体生产力增益，但个体增益不保证团队科研质量提升；缺少对AI使用结构（交互拓扑）如何影响团队共享评估与决策的讨论。
AI.method: 立场论证+机制生成型小规模试点：100分钟科研冲刺，17人会议中3个独立运作团队共12名研究者；记录33次AI交互并进行证据源三角验证；另设并行自主流水线生成完整草稿作为对照性演示。
AI.result: 两类失效模式在跨团队、跨证据源中重复出现：33次交互中仅1次被直接采纳，27次无记录的处置结果（但缺失记录不等于评估缺失）；自主流水线在无会中人工评估的情况下产出完整草稿，体现的是产能而非质量优势。
AI.conclusion: 提出"人-AI-人"协作拓扑（AI连接研究者语境、支持可检视的集体评估与决策），并给出七条模块化、可证伪的设计假设，优先检验共享语境与团队可见的评估检查点；作者承认试点无法将AI特异效应与时间压力、工作流惯例分离，需受控后续研究。

title: Sequential auditing of connected forecast errors under partial observations
summary: Graph forecasting systems often rely on prediction intervals to quantify uncertainty across connected locations, but the true outcomes needed for evaluation may be only partially observed. We study how an auditor can selectively retrieve missing outcomes to determine whether there exists a connected group whose outcomes violate the same side of their respective forecast intervals. The audit stops when the observed labels determine the event or the query budget is exhausted. On three public graph time series, MOMS reduces mean queries by 19.6% to 38.5% relative to screened random acquisition when 30% of labels are hidden. Under localized masking on METR-LA, shortest witness finds more positive cases within ten queries, although the difference depends on node ordering. Direct component traversal reproduces all 9,696 screened random traces without enumerating connected subsets. The experiments show that reducing queries to a decision does not necessarily improve early event discovery or reduce local computation.

AI.tldr: 研究图预测区间的审计问题：如何在标签部分缺失时用尽量少的查询判定是否存在一个连通节点组，其真实结果同时落在各自预测区间的同一侧。
AI.motivation: 图时间序列预测系统常用预测区间刻画连通位置上的不确定性，但评估所需的真实结果往往只被部分观测；需要一种可按需检索缺失标签的审计方法，以判定"同侧违规连通组"这一事件是否成立。
AI.method: 将审计形式化为停止规则：当观测标签足以确定事件或查询预算耗尽时终止；提出MOMS查询策略，并与筛选式随机采集（screened random acquisition）、最短见证（shortest witness）和直接的连通分量遍历进行比较。
AI.result: 在三个公开图时间序列上、30%标签隐藏时，MOMS相对筛选式随机采集将平均查询数减少19.6%–38.5%；在METR-LA的局部掩码下，最短见证在十次查询内发现更多正例，但差异依赖节点顺序；直接分量遍历复现了全部9,696条筛选随机轨迹，且无需枚举连通子集。
AI.conclusion: 减少作出判定所需的查询数，并不必然带来更早的事件发现，也不必然降低局部计算开销；查询效率与发现速度、计算成本是相互分离的评价维度。

title: Do Ray-Traced Cities Make a Better Channel Prior for an Unseen Site? A Pre-Registered Study in Simulation, and a Test on Measured Channels that Reverses It
summary: Channel estimators at a newly deployed base station usually start from 3GPP stochastic channel models, which describe no particular street. We ask whether a channel prior pooled from many ray-traced cities serves an unseen site better than the 3GPP CDL models, and whether learned estimators make the difference. With Sionna RT on 14 city scenes, LMMSE estimation from covariance priors, leave-one-city-out evaluation, and pass/fail bars written down before each main experiment, we find in simulation that the pooled prior sits about 0.6 dB from a site-trained estimator with no site measurements, about what CDL reaches after 50 measurements. Learned models added little: at most 0.65 dB in estimation, and in channel prediction a simple classical method beat CNN predictors by 1.8-12 dB from 2 ms ahead. On measured channels from the DICHASUS outdoor dataset (1.272 GHz, three 2x8 arrays on one building) the result reversed: the pooled ray-traced prior was 3.2-4.1 dB worse than CDL. The simulated channels were too clean; with users at the real distances, even a scattering level tuned from 50 site measurements left the prior about 2 dB behind CDL. A pre-registered follow-on on two more measured environments found the generic CDL prior 2.1-4.7 dB from a site-trained one: no further in a factory hall than on the street, furthest in a small lab room. Finally, a hallway model calibrated to measurements by differentiable ray tracing reproduced delay spread, but as a prior in an unmeasured part of the hallway it was 4.5 dB worse than CDL on the full array. All measured results come from one sounder.

AI.tldr: 在留一城市评估与新场景实测验证下，汇聚多城市射线追踪得到的信道先验并不优于3GPP CDL模型，学习型估计器增益有限，实测结果甚至反转。
AI.motivation: 新部署基站的信道估计通常从3GPP随机信道模型起步，而该类模型不描述任何具体街道。作者希望检验：由大量射线追踪城市汇聚得到的信道先验，能否比CDL模型更好地服务于未见站点，以及学习型估计器是否能带来实质差异。
AI.method: 使用Sionna RT在14个城市场景生成信道，基于协方差先验做LMMSE估计，采用留一城市评估；每个主实验前预注册通过/失败判定标准。进一步在DICHASUS室外实测数据集（1.272 GHz，单栋建筑上三个2x8阵列）上验证，并开展两项预注册后续实验（工厂大厅、小实验室），以及基于可微射线追踪校准的走廊模型实验。
AI.result: 仿真中，汇聚先验在无站点实测时距站点训练估计器约0.6 dB，大致相当于CDL在50次测量后的水平；学习模型增益有限，估计最多提升0.65 dB，信道预测中简单经典方法在2 ms前导下优于CNN预测器1.8–12 dB。DICHASUS实测结果反转：汇聚射线追踪先验比CDL差3.2–4.1 dB；仿真信道过于理想，即使按50次站点测量调校散射强度，先验仍落后CDL约2 dB。预注册后续实验中，通用CDL先验距站点训练估计器2.1–4.7 dB，工厂大厅与街道差距相近，小型实验室差距最大。走廊可微射线追踪校准模型可复现时延扩展，但在未测量区域作为先验时，全阵列上比CDL差4.5 dB。
AI.conclusion: 射线追踪汇聚先验在仿真中表现尚可，但在真实信道中系统性地落后于通用CDL先验，学习型估计器与预测器增益有限。结果提示仿真数据的"过干净"会夸大汇聚先验优势，且所有实测结论均来自单一探测器，需谨慎推广。

title: ReconDreamer#: Self-Evolving Closed-Loop Synergy of Reconstruction and Generation for Dynamic Driving Scenes
summary: Dynamic driving scene reconstruction has made remarkable strides in recent years by leveraging generative priors, particularly in the quality of novel trajectory rendering. Nevertheless, a significant gap remains between the generated data and real-world sensor observations, severely hindering further improvements in reconstruction fidelity. In this paper, we present ReconDreamer#, a self-evolving framework that synergizes reconstruction and generation for dynamic driving scenes, which substantially bridges the gap between synthesized novel trajectory data and recorded real-world observations. Within this self-evolving closed-loop framework, the generative and reconstruction models mutually reinforce each other through iterative refinement, ultimately yielding a significant enhancement in the 3D representation capability of the reconstruction model. Additionally, we introduce a geometry-prior-based adaptive ground model to further enhance the rendering quality of the reconstruction model. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, we conduct comprehensive evaluations on Waymo, nuScenes, PandaSet, and EUVS benchmarks. Specifically on Waymo, at a 6-m lateral shift, ReconDreamer# improves NTA-IoU and NTL-IoU by 8.8% and 3.0%, respectively, and reduces FID by 15.1% relative to ReconDreamer++.

AI.tldr: ReconDreamer#：自进化闭环框架，联合重建与生成，缩小新轨迹合成数据与真实观测的差距，并引入几何先验自适应地面模型提升动态驾驶场景重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 动态驾驶场景重建借助生成先验在新轨迹渲染质量上进展显著，但生成数据与真实传感器观测之间仍存在明显差距，严重制约重建保真度的进一步提升。
AI.method: 提出自进化（self-evolving）闭环框架，使生成模型与重建模型通过迭代精炼相互增强；并引入基于几何先验的自适应地面模型（geometry-prior-based adaptive ground model）以提升重建模型的渲染质量。
AI.result: 在Waymo、nuScenes、PandaSet、EUVS基准上全面评测；Waymo 6米横移条件下，NTA-IoU、NTL-IoU分别提升8.8%和3.0%，FID相较ReconDreamer++降低15.1%。
AI.conclusion: 该闭环自进化机制有效弥合合成新轨迹数据与真实观测的鸿沟，显著增强重建模型的3D表征能力与渲染保真度。

title: Constructing a Regional Slang Lexicon for Electricity Demands via Soft-Label Bidirectional Anchoring and Active Learning
summary: Power-grid customer service increasingly relies on community social media, where customers describe outages, billing, and equipment faults in informal regional dialect. Such messages exhibit non-standard morphology, semantic drift, and out-of-vocabulary expressions that make manual lexicon construction costly and degrade conventional NLP tools. We propose a weak-supervision framework constructing a regional slang lexicon from curated dialect anchors and power-domain seed terms. Candidates are generated via Pointwise Mutual Information with soft-label bidirectional anchoring, retaining dialect-anchored terms while recording power-domain relevance as separate metadata, and are scored by combining Sentence-BERT semantic similarity with a jieba-based wordhood measure. Uncertainty-aware active learning with rule-based and retrieval-augmented LLM oracles is applied under three query strategies, and the resulting lexicon is evaluated by a higher-capability LLM calibrated against human expert annotations via Cohen's $κ$. On 11,177 real WeChat messages from Yuxi (Yunnan, China), the framework achieves an evaluator-estimated dialect precision of DP~$=$~1.0 with zero false positives. An ablation shows that soft-label layering retains 751\% more candidates than strict power-gating at identical precision, expanding the candidate pool from 41 to 349 terms. Human calibration ($n=46$) yields $κ_{\text{dialect}}=1.0$ and $κ_{\text{power}}=0.85$. The resulting 25--33-term lexicon, 4--5 of which are power-relevant, provides a preliminary resource for dialect-aware power-grid service NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个弱监督框架，从精选方言锚点与电力领域种子词出发自动构建区域俚语词典，通过PMI+软标签双向锚定生成候选，SBERT语义相似度+jieba词感度打分，并结合不确定性感知主动学习（规则与检索增强LLM oracle）筛选；在云南玉溪11,177条真实微信消息上实现方言精度1.0、零误报，软标签分层比严格电力门控多保留751%候选，人工校准κ_dialect=1.0、κ_power=0.85。
AI.motivation: 电网客服日益依赖社区社交媒体，客户以非正式方言描述停电、计费和设备故障，这类文本存在非标准词形、语义漂移和未登录表达，人工构建词典成本高且会削弱常规NLP工具性能。因此需要一个低成本、可扩展的方言感知词典构建方法。
AI.method: 提出弱监督框架：以人工精选的方言锚点和电力领域种子词为起点；用PMI结合软标签双向锚定生成候选，保留方言锚定词并将电力领域相关性作为独立元数据记录；用Sentence-BERT语义相似度与jieba词感度组合打分；采用不确定性感知主动学习，配合规则与检索增强的LLM oracle，比较三种查询策略；最终词典由更强LLM评估，并以人类专家标注通过Cohen's κ做校准。
AI.result: 在云南玉溪11,177条真实微信消息上，评估器估计的方言精度DP=1.0，零误报。消融显示软标签分层在同等精度下比严格电力门控多保留751%的候选，候选池从41词扩展到349词。人工校准（n=46）得到κ_dialect=1.0、κ_power=0.85。最终词典规模25–33词，其中4–5个与电力相关。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以低成本弱监督方式构建高精度方言俚语词典，并为方言感知的电网客服NLP提供初步资源；软标签分层是可扩展性的关键设计。当前词典规模较小，定位为初步资源，尚需在更大规模与更多地域上验证。

title: Measuring Model-Specific Alignment Drift in LLM-Based Opinion Dynamics
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as synthetic participants in opinion-dynamics experiments, often assuming that an agent's behaviour is fully determined by its prompt. We test this assumption with a framework in which LLM agents discuss a contested policy issue over repeated rounds while their stance is quantified by a fixed psychometric instrument independent of any dynamics model. Across six LLMs, committed personas are intrinsically stable: in each of the five models tested without peer input, every agent keeps its assigned side for 20 rounds. The observed loss of alignment under discussion is therefore interaction-induced, we call it alignment drift, and model-specific: gpt-4.1 keeps opinion clusters apart, claude-sonnet-5 holds them partially, and gpt-5.6-sol and claude-opus-5 abandon them. Under selective attention, one LLM maintains separated opinion clusters under stance-homophilous attention. Qualitative profiles persist at doubled population and horizon and on a second issue. Such heterogeneity makes the LLM choice a first-class validity variable for social simulation.

AI.tldr: 该研究用独立心理测量工具测量多轮讨论中LLM智能体的立场，发现无同伴输入时人格立场完全稳定，讨论中的立场漂移是交互诱发且模型特异的，因此LLM选型应被视为社会仿真的核心效度变量。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体正被广泛用作观点动力学实验的合成被试，但现有研究普遍默认智能体行为完全由提示词决定，这一假设缺乏检验；若交互本身会改变立场，则仿真结论的效度将依赖模型选择。
AI.method: 构建讨论框架：LLM智能体就一个争议性政策议题进行多轮讨论，立场由固定、独立于任何动力学模型的心理测量工具量化。测试6个LLM，其中5个在无同伴输入条件下运行20轮以检验内在稳定性；随后在讨论条件下比较各模型的立场聚集变化，并考察选择性注意（立场同质性注意）的作用，以及种群规模与时长加倍、更换第二议题后的稳健性。
AI.result: 设定人格的智能体内在稳定：5个无同伴输入测试的模型均20轮保持既定立场。讨论中的一致性丧失由交互诱发（称为“对齐漂移”）且具模型特异性：gpt-4.1维持观点簇分离，claude-sonnet-5部分维持，gpt-5.6-sol与claude-opus-5则放弃原立场。在选择性注意下，有一个模型在立场同质性注意中保持分离的观点簇。定性结论在种群与时长加倍以及第二议题上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 提示词并不唯一决定智能体行为，交互诱发的对齐漂移具有模型特异性且难以通过设定人格消除；模型异质性使LLM选型成为社会仿真中首要的效度变量，仿真研究应报告并检验模型选择的影响。

title: Accelerating FastDEC Clustering Algorithm with GPUs
summary: Fast Dominance Estimation Clustering (FastDEC) is an efficient variant of Density Peak Clustering (DPC) that achieves high clustering quality through dominance-based density estimation, but remains constrained by the computational cost of exact k-nearest-neighbor (k-NN) construction and dominance component (DC) processing. We present SymWarp-FastDEC, a GPU-accelerated implementation of FastDEC. At its core is SymTrikNN, an exact self-k-NN kernel that exploits search symmetry using upper-triangular traversal and warp-cooperative top-k selection. We also introduce WP-DC, a warp-parallel DC reduction algorithm designed for modern GPUs. Combined with memory-adaptive execution planning and stream scheduling, WP-DC eliminates DC reduction as a runtime bottleneck. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that SymWarp-FastDEC produces clustering outputs identical to the original FastDEC on all evaluated equivalence benchmarks. Compared with a FastDEC variant using FAISS GpuIndexFlatL2 for exact k-NN search, our approach achieves approximately 1.7x to 4.9x higher end-to-end performance, with the advantage generally increasing with dimensionality. Compared with the original single-threaded Python FastDEC implementation, speedups reach approximately 2.5 x 10^4 in a very high-dimensional case where its k-d-tree-based search degrades; this extreme result is not representative of typical acceleration.

AI.tldr: 提出SymWarp-FastDEC，是FastDEC的GPU加速实现；核心包括利用搜索对称性的精确自k近邻核SymTrikNN和warp并行DC归约算法WP-DC，配合内存自适应执行规划与流调度。在保持与原FastDEC聚类结果完全一致的前提下，端到端性能较FAISS GPU精确k-NN版本提升约1.7x–4.9x，高维时优势更明显。
AI.motivation: FastDEC虽通过基于支配的密度估计获得高质量聚类，但精确k-NN构建与支配分量（DC）处理的计算开销限制了其可扩展性；因此需要高效的GPU并行实现。
AI.method: 1) SymTrikNN：精确自k-NN核，利用搜索对称性，采用上三角遍历与warp协作top-k选择；2) WP-DC：面向现代GPU的warp并行DC归约算法；3) 内存自适应执行规划与流调度，消除DC归约的运行时瓶颈。
AI.result: 在所有等价性基准上聚类输出与原FastDEC完全一致；相比使用FAISS GpuIndexFlatL2做精确k-NN的FastDEC变体，端到端性能提升约1.7x–4.9x，且优势随维度增加而扩大；相比单线程Python FastDEC，在k-d树搜索退化的极高维案例中加速约2.5×10^4（作者声明该极端结果不具代表性）。
AI.conclusion: 通过精确k-NN对称性利用与warp级并行DC归约的系统协同设计，可在不损失聚类正确性的前提下显著加速FastDEC，为高维大规模聚类提供可扩展的GPU方案。

title: Statistical Machine Learning for Medicinal Plant Leaves Classification
summary: Medicinal plants are usually identified using practitioners' experience, but reproducible, image based methods can complement this knowledge. We present MEDIPI (MEDIcinal Plant Identification), a statistical machine learning approach that classifies medicinal plant leaves from photographs. From each leaf image we extract 52 interpretable features covering shape, texture, color, and a new scagnostics category. We then classify leaves using a three level hierarchy: shape, then edge type, then species. We also release MedLEA, an open R package with 1,099 leaf images of 31 Sri Lankan medicinal plant species. On this dataset, a hierarchical Random Forest achieved the best overall accuracy (100%) in our comparison of hierarchical and non-hierarchical approaches and eight algorithms: Random Forest, XGBoost, Gradient Boosting, linear discriminant analysis, k-nearest neighbor, support vector machine, probabilistic neural network, and artificial neural network. Adding texture, color, and scagnostic features to shape features raised shape level accuracy from 90% to 97%. Linear discriminant analysis plots show how the trained model separates leaf shapes. Accuracy dropped sharply (23-50%) when training and test data came from different datasets, so generalization across datasets remains a challenge.

AI.tldr: 提出MEDIPI——一种基于52个可解释特征（形状、纹理、颜色及新的scagnostics类）与三级层次结构（形状→边缘类型→物种）的药用植物叶片图像识别方法，并发布含31种斯里兰卡药用植物、1099张叶片图像的R包MedLEA；层次随机森林在该数据集上达到100%准确率。
AI.motivation: 药用植物鉴定通常依赖从业者经验，缺乏可复现性；因此需要可重复的、基于图像的方法作为补充，实现自动化叶片物种识别。
AI.method: 从每张叶片图像提取52个可解释特征，涵盖形状、纹理、颜色，并引入新的scagnostics特征类别；采用三级层次分类（先形状、再边缘类型、最后物种）。在自建MedLEA数据集（1099张图像、31个物种）上，比较层次与非层次方法以及8种算法：随机森林、XGBoost、梯度提升、线性判别分析、k近邻、支持向量机、概率神经网络和人工神经网络。
AI.result: 层次随机森林取得最佳总体准确率100%；在形状特征基础上加入纹理、颜色和scagnostic特征后，形状层准确率由90%提升至97%；LDA图可视化显示训练模型对叶形的分离能力；但当训练与测试数据来自不同数据集时，准确率骤降至23%–50%。
AI.conclusion: MEDIPI与MedLEA为药用植物叶片识别提供了可解释、可复现的基准方案，层次随机森林结合多类特征表现最优；但跨数据集的泛化能力仍是主要挑战，未来需提升模型在异源数据上的鲁棒性。

title: COMPREHEND: Ultra-Fine-Grained Benchmark Understanding by Entailment Hierarchy
summary: Understanding what kind of prompts users typically ask and how well an LLM performs on these prompt categories is crucial for LLM practitioners. The existing methods satisfy the demand by hierarchically clustering the user prompts and synthesizing the cluster names using an LLM to build a taxonomy. However, the cluster names from these methods are usually too general for humans to understand the detailed prompt distributions and identify the exact strengths and weaknesses of LLMs. In this study, we propose COMPREHEND, which automatically constructs an ultra-fine-grained entailment hierarchy for the prompts. The entailment hierarchy replaces the cluster names in the taxonomy with sentences to provide more precise cluster descriptions for more fine-grained categorization. Compared with EvalTree, a state-of-the-art taxonomy construction method, COMPREHEND improves an entailment/faithfulness metric from 22.6 to 41.7 and an informative metric from 16.3 to 39.1 in WildBench. Our experiments also show that the weakness report generated based on our entailment hierarchy is much more informative than EvalTree in terms of predicting the response scores in the benchmark. All the code is released in https://github.com/JackNapier20/COMPREHEND_public.

AI.tldr: 提出 COMPREHEND，用句子级蕴含层次替代粗粒度簇名构建超细粒度提示分类体系，在 WildBench 上显著提升蕴含度与信息量指标，并生成更有信息量的模型弱项报告。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过层次聚类用户提示并用 LLM 合成簇名来构建分类体系，但生成的簇名过于笼统，人类难以据此理解提示的细粒度分布，也难以准确定位 LLM 的具体强项与弱项。
AI.method: COMPREHEND 自动为提示构建超细粒度蕴含（entailment）层次：以句子而非簇名作为节点描述，替代传统分类体系中的簇名，从而提供更精确的簇描述并支持更细粒度归类。
AI.result: 在与 SOTA 方法 EvalTree 的对比中，WildBench 上蕴含/忠实度指标从 22.6 提升至 41.7，信息量指标从 16.3 提升至 39.1；基于该蕴含层次生成的弱项报告在预测基准响应分数方面信息量明显更强。
AI.conclusion: 以句子级蕴含层次替代簇名可有效提升提示分类体系的细粒度与可解释性，并更准确地刻画 LLM 的强弱项，代码已开源。

title: A Guideline-Grounded Multi-Agent Framework for Personalized Exercise Prescription from Clinical and Wearable Data
comment: 45 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables; includes Supplementary Information with 2 supplementary figures and 3 supplementary tables
summary: Translating population-level exercise guidance into individualized prescriptions requires integrating clinical and wearable data, including diagnoses, medications, functional limitations, and baseline activity, with condition-specific recommendations, a process difficult to scale beyond specialist rehabilitation settings. We developed FITTER, a multi-agent framework that integrates these data with condition-specific guidance to generate personalized FITT-VP prescriptions and applies deterministic safety audit and repair to correct rule-checkable violations. We evaluated FITTER using data from 400 All of Us participants (300 cancer, 100 stroke) against five LLM comparators through computational evaluation, ablation, and structured clinician review. FITTER achieved 98.5% safety-constraint compliance versus 75.8-85.8% for comparators and showed greater quantitative dosing precision and guideline alignment. Cancer-cohort ablation identified safety audit and repair as the largest contributor to safety-constraint compliance. Clinicians reviewed 80 prescriptions across safety, personalization, instruction concreteness, anticipated effectiveness, and clinical acceptability. FITTER provides a clinician-facing approach integrating clinical and wearable data, guidance, and explicit safety constraints.

AI.tldr: FITTER是一个多智能体框架，整合临床与可穿戴数据及疾病特异性指南，生成个性化FITT-VP运动处方，并通过确定性安全审计与修复纠正可规则校验的违规；在400名All of Us参与者数据上安全约束合规率达98.5%，显著优于五个LLM基线（75.8–85.8%）。
AI.motivation: 将人群层面的运动指导转化为个体化处方，需整合诊断、用药、功能限制、基线活动量等临床与可穿戴数据，并结合疾病特异性建议；该过程依赖专科康复环境，难以规模化推广。
AI.method: 提出FITTER多智能体框架：融合临床与可穿戴数据及疾病特异性指导生成FITT-VP处方，并施加确定性安全审计与修复以纠正可规则校验的违规。基于400名All of Us参与者（300例癌症、100例卒中）数据，与五个LLM对照方法进行比较，采用计算评估、消融实验与结构化临床医生评审。
AI.result: FITTER安全约束合规率98.5%，对照方法为75.8–85.8%；在剂量精确性与指南一致性上更优。癌症队列消融显示安全审计与修复对安全约束合规贡献最大。临床医生评审80份处方，覆盖安全性、个性化、指令具体性、预期有效性与临床可接受性五个维度。
AI.conclusion: FITTER提供了一种面向临床医生的方法，统一整合临床与可穿戴数据、指南建议及显式安全约束，实现可扩展的个体化运动处方生成。

title: P$^2$-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidates expert capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories, whereas task arithmetic offers a training-free alternative through linear parameter combinations. We view the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model and propose P$^2$-MOPD, which jointly optimizes the mixing coefficients and the student weights under the same on-policy distillation objective. Unlike task arithmetic, which stays within the span of the frozen student and expert parameters for any choice of merging coefficients, P$^2$-MOPD keeps the student trainable, so the experts act as parameter priors without confining it to this span. Across four domains at 1.7B and 4B scales, P$^2$-MOPD achieves faster and more balanced recovery than MOPD from the same initialization, surpassing its final average recovery in half the training steps. At the end of training, our 1.7B model reaches 94.7% average recovery, versus 80.9% for MOPD.

AI.tldr: 提出 P$^2$-MOPD，将学生与专家参数的线性组合视为单一可微模型，在统一 on-policy 蒸馏目标下联合优化混合系数与学生权重；1.7B 规模平均恢复率 94.7%（MOPD 为 80.9%），且以一半步数超越 MOPD 最终效果。
AI.motivation: 多教师 on-policy 蒸馏需监督学生自生成轨迹以整合专家能力，但训练成本高；任务算术提供免训练的参数线性组合方案，却受限于冻结学生与专家参数张成的子空间，表达能力受限。作者希望兼得二者：既保留蒸馏的灵活性，又利用任务算术的参数先验。
AI.method: 将学生参数与专家参数的线性组合整体视为单一可微模型，在相同的 on-policy 蒸馏目标下联合优化混合系数与学生权重；学生保持可训练，专家仅作为参数先验而非硬性约束子空间。
AI.result: 在 1.7B 与 4B 两个规模、四个领域上，从相同初始化出发，P$^2$-MOPD 比 MOPD 恢复更快、更均衡，用一半训练步数即超过 MOPD 的最终平均恢复率；训练结束时 1.7B 模型平均恢复率达 94.7%，MOPD 为 80.9%。
AI.conclusion: 将任务算术的参数组合与 on-policy 蒸馏目标统一为端到端可微优化，可在不牺牲表达能力的前提下显著提升多教师能力整合的效率与最终性能。

title: SettleSplat: Monocular Gaussian Mapping under In-View Scene Changes
summary: Online 3D Gaussian mapping enables fast and high-fidelity novel view synthesis, with broad applications in augmented reality, robotics, and autonomous systems. However, many current methods assume static scenes or filter out dynamics as outliers. In this paper, we study in-view scene changes where objects are manipulated in front of the camera within a single online sequence, unlike prior works that detect changes outside the camera view or between separate captures. This setting entangles transient and persistent dynamics, as objects can be distractors while moving and persistent once they settle. While recent studies start to address distractors by removing them for clean static background, in-view scene changes remain underexplored. To resolve this, we present SettleSplat, a monocular mapping system that maintains up-to-date 3D Gaussian maps under such changes. Specifically, we lift coarse per-pixel uncertainty into Gaussian dynamicity field, then prune transient ones. For persistent changes, we derive geometric contradictions weighted by parameter-free rendered depth uncertainty to separate true changes from under-optimized regions. On Bonn and Co-Fusion, SettleSplat achieves consistent 3D Gaussian maps, outperforming current baselines on both full images and change regions while maintaining comparable speed.

AI.tldr: SettleSplat 是一个单目在线 3D 高斯建图系统，用于在"视角内场景变化"（物体在相机前被移动）条件下维护最新的 3D 高斯地图，通过不确定性驱动的动态性场与几何矛盾检测区分瞬态与持久变化，并在 Bonn 与 Co-Fusion 数据集上取得更一致的建图效果。
AI.motivation: 现有在线 3D 高斯建图方法大多假设静态场景或将动态物体当作离群点滤除；已有工作多关注相机视野之外或多次独立拍摄之间的变化检测，而"单次在线序列中相机前方物体被移动"的视角内变化仍缺乏研究。该设定中瞬态动态（移动中的干扰物）与持久变化（物体静止后成为场景一部分）相互纠缠，难以区分。
AI.method: 提出 SettleSplat 单目建图系统：1）将粗粒度逐像素不确定性提升为高斯动态性场（dynamicity field），据此剪除瞬态高斯；2）针对持久变化，计算几何矛盾（geometric contradictions），并用无需参数的渲染深度不确定性加权，从而将真实变化与欠优化区域区分开。
AI.result: 在 Bonn 和 Co-Fusion 数据集上，SettleSplat 生成一致的 3D 高斯地图，在全图与变化区域上均优于现有基线，同时保持相当的速度。
AI.conclusion: SettleSplat 有效解决了视角内场景变化的在线单目建图问题，能够同时处理瞬态干扰与持久变化，实现一致、最新的 3D 高斯表示，为动态环境下的在线重建提供了可行方案。

title: Sparse Internal Control of Language Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 45 pages, 5 figures. Code and experimental records: https://github.com/zxzok/sparse-internal-control
summary: Language models are increasingly used in text generation, decision support, and automated interaction, creating a need for localized, reversible, and selective control of their behavior. Activation steering demonstrates that internal interventions can alter the behavior of frozen models, but how to select and evaluate compact, multi-site control interfaces remains an open question. I introduce sparse internal control, a framework for steering target behavior by applying inference-time interventions to a small set of internal model nodes. A local target-controllability formulation characterizes candidate site--direction pairs by their behavioral effects and specifies constraints on target recovery, off-target preservation, and intervention energy. Two complementary selectors instantiate this formulation: Driver-OMP selects nodes for sparse reconstruction of a desired behavioral displacement, while Coverage-Driver favors stable coverage across prompts. I propose a six-axis control-evaluation protocol measuring reachability, signed reversal, dose response, feedback controllability, off-target preservation, and held-out reuse. Exploratory experiments on indirect object identification, MMLU multiple-choice question answering, sentiment steering, and refusal steering provide evidence for the feasibility of steering task-defined behavior through sparse internal interventions. The six-axis evaluation characterizes these interventions beyond target movement, revealing distinct control properties that depend on the task and available direction information. Together, the formulation, reference algorithms, and evaluation protocol provide a foundation for the systematic study and development of internal control methods for language models.

AI.tldr: 提出“稀疏内部控制”框架，用推理时干预少量内部节点实现语言模型行为的局部、可逆、选择性调控，并给出两类节点选择算法与六维控制评估协议。
AI.motivation: 激活引导（activation steering）虽能改变冻结模型行为，但如何选择并评估紧凑、多站点的控制接口仍属开放问题；需要兼顾目标行为达成、非目标行为保持与干预代价。
AI.method: 提出局部目标可控性形式化，用行为效应刻画候选“站点—方向”对，并对目标可恢复性、离靶保持与干预能量施加约束；实例化两种选择器：Driver-OMP（稀疏重构期望行为位移）与 Coverage-Driver（偏好跨提示的稳定覆盖）；配套六轴评估协议：可达性、带符号反转、剂量响应、反馈可控性、离靶保持、留出复用。
AI.result: 在间接宾语识别、MMLU 多选题问答、情感引导与拒答引导上的探索性实验显示，稀疏内部干预可有效引导任务定义行为；六轴评估揭示出依赖任务与方向信息可得性的差异化控制特性，超越单纯目标位移的度量。
AI.conclusion: 该形式化、参考算法与评估协议为语言模型内部控制方法的系统研究和开发奠定基础；实验为探索性证据，尚非全面验证。

title: Thinking Fast, Trading Late: System One Decision Models vs the Market
comment: 40 pages, 12 figures, 12 tables; pre-registered (analysis plan frozen by hash before the test period was unblinded); code at https://github.com/AmirDehkordi/NewsAction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) read company news at scale, and backtests suggest that their readings predict stock returns. We ask how much of that predictability survives a test that rules out look-ahead, memorization and selection. We propose OLIVIA, a protocol for such tests: point-in-time inputs with company identities masked, selection on validation data only, an analysis plan frozen by cryptographic hash, and a test period unblinded once through a logged lock. We apply it to AI decision models, non-generative language models that return probabilities for typed questions, reading news about S&P 500 stocks: an open-weights model we fine-tuned on 2024-2025 data, three commercial models and standard baselines. The fine-tuned model's signal replicated on two validation quarters (daily information coefficients 0.055 and 0.065) but fell to 0.020 (t = 1.7) on the blinded January-July 2026 test. The commercial models' readings line up with the overnight move to the open (information coefficient 0.074 to 0.077) but not with the move after it, so the news is priced by the time a trader can act on it at the open. No model can tell over- from under-reaction, and no pre-registered strategy survives costs and a deflated Sharpe ratio. Commercial models identify masked companies in 62% to 74% of cases against a 28% baseline: masking hides names, not companies. The market reads the news first.

AI.tldr: 提出OLIVIA协议（时点输入、公司身份遮蔽、仅用验证集选择、哈希冻结分析计划、单次解锁的盲测），用于严格检验LLM读新闻预测股票收益的能力；结果显示预训练的强信号在盲测中衰减至不显著，商业模型的信息在开盘前已被定价，且任何预注册策略无法在成本与紧缩夏普比下存活。
AI.motivation: 已有研究用LLM大规模阅读公司新闻并报告可预测股票收益，但这些结论可能受前视偏差、记忆化（训练数据泄漏）与选择性报告污染。作者希望量化在排除前视、记忆与选择后，仍有Predictability多少真正保留。
AI.method: 提出OLIVIA测试协议：point-in-time输入、公司身份掩码、仅在验证数据上做选择、用密码学哈希冻结分析计划、通过有记录的锁定机制仅解锁一次的测试期。应用于AI决策模型（返回类型化问题概率的非生成式语言模型）读取标普500成分股新闻：一个在2024–2025数据上微调的开源权重模型、三个商业模型及标准基线。
AI.result: 微调模型信号在两个验证季度可复现（日度信息系数0.055和0.065），但在2026年1–7月盲测期降至0.020（t=1.7，不显著）。商业模型的读数与隔夜至开盘的变动一致（IC 0.074–0.077），但与开盘后变动无关，说明开盘时信息已被定价。无模型能区分过度/不足反应；无预注册策略在交易成本与紧缩夏普比下存活。商业模型在62%–74%情况下能识别被遮蔽公司（基线28%），表明掩码隐藏名称而非公司身份。
AI.conclusion: 在严格协议下，LLM新闻读数的可预测性大幅衰减且不显著；市场在散户可交易前已将新闻定价（"市场先读新闻"）。身份掩码不足以防止公司识别，需更强的匿名化设计。

title: Forget What Comes Next: LLM Unlearning via Statistical Independence
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can memorize and reproduce fragments of their training data, raising privacy and legal concerns that motivate machine unlearning. Yet poisoned training examples can remain statistically detectable after unlearning, which raises the question of whether current unlearning objectives remove what the model has memorized at all. In this work, we introduce PINT, a novel algorithm for machine unlearning that uses the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) to reduce the statistical dependence between tokens to be forgotten and the internal representations used to predict them. We formally relate our HSIC-based objective to Exact Memorization through a computable upper bound, connecting the training objective directly to the model's ability to reproduce the forgotten tokens. In extensive experiments, we compare forgetting-utility trade-offs across eight settings with models up to 7B parameters and demonstrate scalability to 70B parameter models. Our evaluations cover unlearning Gaussian poisons, personal information, hazardous knowledge in biology and cybersecurity, and copyrighted books and news articles. PINT achieves the strongest forgetting-utility trade-off on average and is the only method to make Gaussian poisons undetectable while maintaining near-original model utility. Code is available at: https://github.com/shkabrii/PINT

AI.tldr: 提出 PINT：用 HSIC 降低待遗忘 token 与其内部表示之间的统计依赖，实现机器遗忘；理论上将目标与 Exact Memorization 通过可计算上界联系起来，在 8 种设定（最大 7B，可扩展至 70B）上取得最优遗忘-效用权衡，并唯一能让高斯毒化样本不可检测。
AI.motivation: LLM 会记忆并复现训练数据片段，引发隐私与法律风险，因而需要机器遗忘；但现有遗忘目标在遗忘后仍可统计检测出被投毒样本，说明其未必真正移除模型已记忆的内容。因此需要一种直接针对记忆机制的遗忘目标。
AI.method: PINT 基于 Hilbert-Schmidt 独立性准则（HSIC），最小化待遗忘 token 与用于预测它们的内部表示之间的统计依赖性；并从理论上把 HSIC 目标与 Exact Memorization 通过一个可计算的紧上界关联，使训练目标直接对应模型复现遗忘 token 的能力。
AI.result: 在 8 种设定、模型规模至 7B 并扩展至 70B 的实验中，覆盖高斯毒化、个人信息、生物与网络安全危险知识、受版权保护的书籍与新闻文章；PINT 平均取得最佳遗忘-效用权衡，且是唯一在保持接近原始效用的同时使高斯毒化样本不可检测的方法。
AI.conclusion: 以 HSIC 抑制 token 与内部表示的统计依赖，可将遗忘目标与可计算记忆上界对应，实证上优于现有方法，表明面向记忆机制的遗忘目标能同时实现强遗忘与效用保持。

title: Impact of Input Resolution in Mammographic Mass Detection: A Controlled Multi-Architecture Study
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Deep-learning-based mass detectors usually downsample mammograms, trading fine image detail for lower computational cost. However, published studies cannot reveal how much accuracy this trade-off sacrifices, since they also differ in architecture, preprocessing, and evaluation protocol. In this work, we isolated the effect of input resolution in a controlled study on the VinDr-Mammo dataset, training 18 detectors at six input resolutions ranging from 512 x 416 to 1600 x 1280 pixels, for 108 model-resolution combinations. Whole mammograms were resized without cropping or tiling. For each model, preprocessing, model initialization, augmentation, and evaluation procedures were kept fixed across resolutions. Detection accuracy was evaluated by mAP50 on the 219 mass-positive images of the official test split, and 57 combinations with test mAP50 of at least 0.60 were analyzed. From the lowest to the highest resolution, median mAP50 rose from 0.626 to 0.660 and the best mAP50 from 0.670 to 0.709. The best result, achieved by DINO with a ConvNeXt-S backbone, is the highest mAP50 reported to date on mass-positive VinDr-Mammo images. Gains were concentrated in small masses: for the smallest third of lesions, median mAP50 rose by 0.074 (from 0.367 to 0.441), compared with 0.007 and 0.032 for medium and large masses. Median training time increased from 0.45 to 1.40 h, and median inference time from 23.6 to 113.7 ms per image. Therefore, higher input resolution mainly benefits the small masses that are hardest to detect, at a computational cost that remains practical.

AI.tldr: 通过控制变量实验分离输入分辨率对乳腺X线肿块检测精度的影响：18个检测器×6种分辨率（512×416至1600×1280）共108组组合，高分辨率主要提升小肿块检测性能，计算代价仍可接受。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习肿块检测器常对乳腺X线图像降采样以降低计算成本，但已发表研究因网络结构、预处理与评估协议不同，无法揭示该权衡究竟损失多少精度。
AI.method: 在VinDr-Mammo数据集上开展受控研究，训练18个检测器、6种输入分辨率（512×416至1600×1280），共108个模型-分辨率组合；整幅乳腺图像仅缩放、不裁剪、不平铺；对每个模型固定预处理、初始化、增强与评估流程；在官方测试集219张肿块阳性图像上以mAP50评估，并分析测试mAP50≥0.60的57个组合。
AI.result: 分辨率由低到高，中位mAP50由0.626升至0.660，最优mAP50由0.670升至0.709；最佳结果为DINO+ConvNeXt-S骨干，为目前肿块阳性VinDr-Mammo图像上报道的最高mAP50。增益集中于小肿块：最小三分之一病灶的中位mAP50提升0.074（0.367→0.441），中、大肿块仅提升0.007与0.032。中位训练时间由0.45 h增至1.40 h，中位推理时间由23.6 ms/幅增至113.7 ms/幅。
AI.conclusion: 提高输入分辨率主要惠及最难检测的小肿块，且其计算代价仍处于实用范围，提示在肿块检测中不应盲目降采样。

title: Do Multi-Turn Conversational Capabilities Carry Over from Text to Speech? A Parallel Multilingual Benchmark
summary: Successful multi-turn voice interaction requires models to retain information from earlier turns, follow persistent instructions, and track revisions to conversational state. These abilities are usually evaluated from transcripts, leaving open whether successes demonstrated from text carry over when the same turns are spoken, and whether this transfer is consistent across languages. We introduce Omnilingua-AudioMC, a strictly parallel multilingual extension of Audio MultiChallenge, to study this question. The benchmark contains 354 conversations and 1,404 rubric items across ten languages, with content, turn structure, cross-turn dependencies, and evaluation criteria aligned across transcript and speech conditions. Across six speech-language models, the shift from reference transcripts to direct speech input is strongly model- and language-dependent: models with similar transcript performance can diverge substantially under speech, and their relative strengths across languages can change. Paired rubric-level analysis shows that aggregate transcript-speech gaps can obscure which conversational requirements are preserved, because losses of transcript-demonstrated successes can be offset by gains on other items. Replacing preceding user turns, the current turn, or both with model-generated transcripts localizes recoverable degradation: for the two models with the largest gaps, history substitution yields a larger macro-level improvement than current-turn substitution in all ten languages, while the strongest direct-speech model gains little from either. These results show that transcript performance is an unreliable proxy for multilingual spoken conversational ability and identify the representation of preceding spoken context as an important source of recoverable degradation. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/QwenLM/Omnilingua-Bench/tree/main/Omnilingua-AudioMC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Omnilingua-AudioMC，一个严格平行的十语种多轮语音对话基准，用于检验文本转录上的成功能否迁移到语音输入，并揭示该迁移高度依赖模型与语言，认为转录表现是多语种口语对话能力的不可靠代理。
AI.motivation: 多轮语音交互需保留历史信息、遵循持续指令并跟踪对话状态修订，但现有评估多基于文本转录，无法判断文本上表现出的能力在同样对话以语音形式输入时是否保持，也无法判断这种迁移在不同语言间是否一致。
AI.method: 构建 Audio MultiChallenge 的严格平行多语种扩展 Omnilingua-AudioMC：354 段对话、1,404 条评分项、十种语言，内容、轮次结构、跨轮依赖与评分标准在文本与语音条件下对齐；在六个语音语言模型上比较参考转录与直接语音输入，并进行配对评分项级分析，以及将前序用户轮、当前轮或两者替换为模型生成转录的消融实验，以定位可恢复的退化来源。
AI.result: 转录到语音的迁移强依赖模型与语言：转录表现相近的模型在语音下可能显著分化，跨语言的相对优势也可能改变；聚合的转录-语音差距会掩盖具体哪类对话要求被保留，因为已证成功的丢失可被其他项的增益抵消；对差距最大的两个模型，替换历史轮在全部十种语言中的宏观提升大于替换当前轮，而最强直接语音模型从两种替换中获益均很小。
AI.conclusion: 转录表现不能作为多语种口语对话能力的可靠代理，前序语音上下文的表征是可恢复退化的重要来源；应以平行的语音-文本多语种基准进行细粒度评估。

title: WASP-Mem: Let Agent Organize Procedural Memory. Human Spend Effort on Diagnosis
comment: 24 pages (10 main + references and appendix), 6 figures, 14 tables. Peizhi Niu and Ge Shi contributed equally
summary: LLM agents struggle to automate complex enterprise procedures because static, pre-built harness cannot capture proprietary policies, undocumented behaviors, or state-dependent recovery paths that surface only during execution. Procedural memory accrued from agent experience offers a training-free path to closing this gap -- yet unlike episodic records or semantic facts, it must consolidate repeated successes and diagnosed failures into reusable actions and recovery strategies. We introduce WASP-Mem (Wiki-based Agent-Synthesized Procedural Memory), a nimble but effective method that distills execution traces and feedback into persistent, interlinked wiki pages, enabling continual agent learning. On TheAgentCompany benchmark, WASP-Mem raises the checkpoint pass rate by 4.6-6.1% over the strongest baseline we compared across three models while requiring 57-61% less storage. We further present a systematic controlled study spanning consolidation method, feedback type, trace ingestion scope, and refinement rounds. Our results reveal that prescriptive knowledge organization such as human defined schemas and explicit deduplication rules hurts performance rather than closing the procedural-knowledge gap. In contrast, human diagnosis converts failed traces into corrective knowledge and drives sustained improvement: a single round of human diagnosis outperforms four rounds of self-judgment by 7.0-10.9%. These findings point to a simple division of labor: let agents organize procedural memory, and invest human effort where it matters most -- diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出WASP-Mem：将执行轨迹与反馈蒸馏为持久、互联的wiki页面以构建程序性记忆；在TheAgentCompany上checkpoint通过率提升4.6-6.1%，存储降低57-61%；对照研究表明人类诊断而非严格知识组织是持续改进的关键。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体难以自动化复杂企业流程，因为静态预置的harness无法捕捉专有策略、未文档化行为以及仅在执行中暴露的状态依赖恢复路径。程序性记忆（区别于情节记忆和语义事实）提供了免训练路径，但需要把重复成功与已诊断失败整合为可复用动作与恢复策略。
AI.method: WASP-Mem（基于Wiki的智能体合成程序性记忆）：把执行轨迹与反馈蒸馏为持久、相互链接的wiki页面，实现持续学习；并设计覆盖整合方法、反馈类型、轨迹摄入范围与精炼轮次的系统性对照研究。
AI.result: 在TheAgentCompany基准上，跨三个模型相比最强基线checkpoint通过率提升4.6-6.1%，存储需求减少57-61%。规定性知识组织（人工定义schema、显式去重规则）反而损害性能；人类诊断将失败轨迹转化为纠正性知识，单轮人类诊断比四轮自我判断高出7.0-10.9%。
AI.conclusion: 应实行简单分工：由智能体自行组织程序性记忆，把人类投入集中在最有价值的环节——诊断。

title: Sampling Interventional Distributions with Orthogonal MMD Flow
summary: Many causal inference problems require sampling from interventional outcome distributions rather than estimating low-dimensional summaries. Existing approaches often rely on fitting generative models of the target distribution together with additional nuisance components, which can be computationally demanding for high-dimensional outcomes. We propose Interventional Maximum Mean Discrepancy Flow (IMMD-Flow), a particle-based method that instead represents the target interventional distribution through its kernel mean embedding. This kernel embedding admits a doubly robust, Neyman-orthogonal estimator with finite-sample guarantees and can be efficiently reused to sample from the interventional distribution via MMD gradient flow. IMMD-Flow accommodates both hard and soft interventions, admits theoretical guarantees for estimation and particle approximation, and extends to high-dimensional image outcomes through frozen encoders. Across image-based benchmarks, IMMD-Flow matches or improves upon state-of-the-art generative approaches while showing significant speed advantages.

AI.tldr: 提出 IMMD-Flow，用核均值嵌入表示干预后结果分布，并借 MMD 梯度流从中采样，避免拟合生成模型的高昂成本。
AI.motivation: 因果推断中常需从干预后结果分布中采样而非仅估计低维摘要；现有方法需拟合目标分布生成模型及额外 nuisance 组件，对高维结果计算昂贵。
AI.method: 基于粒子的方法：以核均值嵌入表示目标干预分布，构造双重稳健、Neyman 正交且具有限样本保证的估计量，并复用该嵌入通过 MMD 梯度流采样；结合冻结编码器扩展到高维图像结果，支持硬干预与软干预。
AI.result: 在基于图像的基准上，性能匹配或优于最先进生成式方法，同时具有显著速度优势；并给出估计与粒子近似的理论保证。
AI.conclusion: IMMD-Flow 为从干预分布采样提供了高效、具理论保障的粒子式替代方案，兼顾精度与计算效率，并可推广至高维图像结果。

title: LiSA: Linear Stochastic Attention for Long-Range Visual Modeling
summary: Self-attention has become the standard for modern sequence modeling, enabling Transformers to model long-range dependencies across a wide range of modalities. Despite these advances, its quadratic cost with respect to sequence length remains a significant computational bottleneck. Recent work addresses this limitation by introducing linear variants of self-attention, namely with kernel approximations of the softmax operator. However, their first-order aggregation restricts expressivity and struggles to capture higher-order structure. We propose Linear Stochastic Attention (LiSA), a linear attention plug-in module that enables higher-order token interactions via a stochastic diffusion process based on truncated random walks. LiSA incorporates adaptive locality, favoring semantically similar neighbors to preserve fine-grained structures, while maintaining stable and efficient training. We conduct extensive experiments on classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection tasks and show improved results over state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: LiSA：基于截断随机游走随机扩散过程的线性注意力插件，实现高阶token交互，兼顾效率与表达力。
AI.motivation: 自注意力对序列长度呈二次复杂度，是计算瓶颈；现有线性注意力（softmax的核近似）仅做一阶聚合，表达力受限，难以捕捉高阶结构。
AI.method: 提出线性随机注意力（LiSA）插件模块：以截断随机游走构造随机扩散过程，使token间产生高阶交互；引入自适应局部性，偏向语义相似的邻居以保留细粒度结构，并保持训练稳定高效。
AI.result: 在分类、语义分割与目标检测任务上开展大量实验，结果优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: LiSA以线性复杂度实现高阶token交互，突破一阶线性注意力的表达力瓶颈，可作为即插即用模块在多类视觉任务上取得一致提升。

title: The Min-Max theory of language behavior
summary: The "Min-Max" theory of language behavior proposes that humans engage simultaneously in minimization of processing effort and maximization of information content, and that this is a primary driver in language evolution (Ring, 2025). This claim seeks to unify observations from language processing (Mahowald et al., 2013; Futrell et al., 2015; Yadav et al., 2020; Hawkins, 2014), interaction (Hörberg and Sjons, 2023; Tucker et al., 2025; Jaeger and Tily, 2011; Smith and Culbertson, 2025), and corpora (Levshina and Moran, 2021; Levshina, 2023; Newmeyer, 2017), which suggest that considerations of processing efficiency and information content are both implicated in human communication. The interaction between these two processes provides an explanation for human linguistic behavior at various levels (Linders and Louwerse, 2023) and predicts historical developments in language, i.e. related to word order (Ring, 2025). Given that the original formulation of the Min-Max theory is based on observational data, the current paper seeks to validate the theory mathematically. Through a series of experiments that use computational models to investigate the theory's predictions, pretrained and iterated learning models are queried with synthetic data. The experiments show that manipulating the variables of token length and the weight of information content in a tabula rasa model results in word order change, as predicted by the theory. The experiments also identify important differences between computational models and observations of human language data, suggesting that current transformer-based language models may not accurately represent psycholinguistic processes. The overall findings indicate that evolutionary trajectories in language are highly susceptible to minimization of processing and maximization of information content.

AI.tldr: 该文用计算模型对"Min-Max"语言行为理论进行数学验证，表明操纵词元长度与信息内容权重可导致语序变化，符合理论预测，但发现transformer模型可能与心理语言过程不符。
AI.motivation: Min-Max理论认为人类同时最小化加工努力并最大化信息内容，是语言演化的主要驱动力，能统一解释语言加工、互动与语料库层面的观察并预测语序的历史发展。但该理论原始表述基于观察数据，缺乏数学层面的验证，因此本文旨在以计算实验对其进行检验。
AI.method: 采用一系列计算模型实验，用合成数据查询预训练模型与迭代学习模型（iterated learning models）；在tabula rasa模型中操纵词元长度（token length）和信息内容权重两个变量，考察其对语序变化的影响。
AI.result: 实验显示，操纵词元长度与信息内容权重会使tabula rasa模型出现语序变化，与理论预测一致；同时发现计算模型与人类语言观察数据之间存在重要差异，提示当前基于transformer的语言模型可能无法准确表征心理语言过程。
AI.conclusion: 语言的演化轨迹高度敏感于加工最小化与信息内容最大化的权衡，Min-Max理论的核心预测在计算层面得到支持；但模型与人类数据的差异表明需谨慎将transformer模型作为心理语言过程的代理。

title: Controlling Action-Head Co-Adaptation to VLM Representation Anisotropy
summary: Modern learning systems increasingly combine pretrained models with downstream heads. Despite the growing importance of such modular designs, how the downstream model co-adapts to the geometry of pretrained representations remains relatively underexplored. We study this problem through vision-language-action models (VLAs), where a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) conditions an action model for control. We find that the action model progressively concentrates its sensitivity on high-variance dimensions of the VLM outputs. Through controlled experiments across different backbone-head models, we further show that counteracting this sensitivity concentration can be beneficial under representation--task mismatch settings. Motivated by these observations, we introduce \emph{Adaptive Interface Equalizer} (AdaIE), a parameter-free mechanism that reweights pretrained representations according to the evolving downstream sensitivity during training. AdaIE improves VLA success rates on simulation benchmarks, with gains of up to $+5.28$ percentage points (pp) on RoboCasa-GR1 and $+1.68$ pp on RoboTwin 2.0, and achieves an average gain of $+19$ pp across five real-world manipulation tasks. It further generalizes to diffusion policies and world models, improving downstream performance in both settings. Our results highlight interface co-adaptation as an important optimization problem when coupling pretrained representations with downstream models.

AI.tldr: 研究VLA中下游动作模型与预训练表示几何的协同适应问题，发现动作模型敏感度逐渐集中于VLM输出的高方差维度，提出无参数机制AdaIE对表示进行重加权。
AI.motivation: 模块化设计中预训练模型与下游头如何协同适应（共适应）预训练表示的几何结构尚缺乏研究；作者以VLA为切入点揭示敏感度集中的现象，并寻求在表示—任务不匹配时缓解其负面影响。
AI.method: 以预训练VLM条件化动作模型的VLA为研究对象，通过跨不同骨干—头模型的受控实验分析动作模型敏感度分布演化；据此提出AdaIE：依据训练中不断变化的下游敏感度对预训练表示进行无参数重加权，以抵消敏感度集中。
AI.result: 仿真基准上VLA成功率提升最高+5.28pp（RoboCasa-GR1）与+1.68pp（RoboTwin 2.0）；五个真实世界操作任务平均提升+19pp；并可推广至扩散策略与世界模型，均提升下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 接口共适应是将预训练表示与下游模型耦合时的重要优化问题；AdaIE作为一种简单、无参数的重加权机制可有效改善下游性能并具通用性。

title: Ermakov--Based embeddings as a parameter-free layer for physics-informed neural networks
summary: Evolution equations with time-dependent coefficients force a neural solver to spend capacity on a scale that the equation already determines. We show that a single classical object, the Ermakov-Pinney scale function $ρ$, can be written into the input layer of a physics-informed neural network as a parameter-free embedding. One construction covers three problem families through the two signs of the Pinney constant $c$: linear diffusion ($c=-1$, $ω\equiv0$), diffusion in a time-dependent confining trap ($c=-1$, $ω\neq0$), and the quantum oscillator with time-dependent frequency ($c=+1$). An exact moment identity gives $ρ$ in closed form from the initial data alone, so no auxiliary network or knowledge of the solution is needed. Our central finding is comparative: each family requires a different component of the construction and has a different honest control. In family I, the diffusive-time reparametrisation alone reproduces most of the gain, so that family is a poor test of the idea and shows why an ablation is mandatory. In family II no time reparametrisation exists, the control degrades accuracy, and the amplitude prefactor becomes essential (40.8x). In family III the adiabatic approximation also fails, and the quadratic phase factor is what matters (5.7x). The method does not help when the reduced solution does not converge to a fixed point: its extrapolation advantage then disappears. The reduction itself is the classical scaling-variable change of the self-similar-asymptotics literature; what is new is the moment identity that makes it architectural for time-dependent coefficients, and the comparative anatomy above.

AI.tldr: 将Ermakov–Pinney尺度函数ρ作为无参数嵌入写入PINN输入层，用Pinney常数c的两种符号统一处理三类含时系数演化方程；核心贡献是比较性分析：三族问题各自依赖构造中的不同组件，并给出各自"诚实的"对照实验。
AI.motivation: 含时系数的演化方程会使神经求解器把容量浪费在方程本身已确定的尺度上。作者希望把这一尺度显式地编码进网络结构，从而不必由网络学习，同时避免依赖辅助网络或已知解。
AI.method: 以Ermakov–Pinney尺度函数ρ作为无参数嵌入，写入PINN输入层；通过Pinney常数c的符号（c=-1、c=+1）以及ω是否为0，统一覆盖三个问题族：线性扩散、含时势阱中的扩散、含时频率量子振子。利用精确矩恒等式从初始数据直接得到ρ的闭式解。逐族做消融：族I仅做扩散时间重参数化、族II检验时间重参数化与非存在性及振幅前因子、族III检验绝热近似与二次相位因子。理论定位上，该归约即自相似渐近文献中的经典标度变量变换。
AI.result: 族I：单独的时间重参数化已能复现大部分增益，故该族对本文思想检验力弱，说明消融是必要的。族II：不存在时间重参数化，该对照反而降低精度，振幅前因子成为关键（40.8倍）。族III：绝热近似同样失效，二次相位因子起决定作用（5.7倍）。当约化后解不收敛到不动点时，该方法的优势（外推）消失。
AI.conclusion: 本文的实际新意不是归约本身（那是经典标度变换），而是使归约对含时系数在架构层面可行的矩恒等式，以及"比较解剖学"式分析：不同问题族需要构造中的不同组件，并对应不同对照，因而单一benchmark不足以评价此类嵌入，消融必不可少。

title: Reliability-Role Collaborative Learning for Semi-Supervised Cardiac Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted at IEEE BIBM 2026. 7 pages, 4 figures
summary:
Semi-supervised cardiac image segmentation aims to exploit abundant unlabeled images together with limited annotations, but the reliability of pseudo-label supervision is highly uneven across spatial regions.
  In a dual-network setting, interior regions are usually more stable, whereas boundary regions, low-confidence areas, and disagreements between networks can introduce noisy supervision.
  However, existing methods typically impose uniform supervision on all unlabeled pixels, overlooking reliability differences and limiting discriminative learning in challenging areas.
  To address this issue, we propose R2CL (Reliability-Role Collaborative Learning), a framework for semi-supervised cardiac image segmentation.
  R2CL models confidence relationships between two networks to assign roles to unlabeled regions: mutually uncertain regions are used for entropy regularization, confidence-discrepant regions for directional knowledge transfer, and mutually confident regions as reliable supervision anchors.
  Reliability-Role Mixed Cross Learning (RR-MCL) implements these roles through region-mixed training, directional cross-network supervision, and entropy regularization over mutually uncertain regions.
  Reliability-Transition Prototype Contrastive Learning (RT-PCL) constructs query features from foreground-adjacent reliability-transition regions and learns network-specific class prototypes from mutually confident regions, improving feature discrimination around ambiguous boundaries.
  High-confidence Context Refinement (HCR) exploits reliable interior pixels and trusted dense blocks within mutually confident regions to complement stable contextual supervision.
  R2CL achieves stable improvements in region-overlap and boundary-related metrics across multiple datasets, with more evident advantages on the foreground-sparse MVAA-CT dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R2CL框架，依据双网络间置信关系为无标注区域分配角色（互不确定/置信不一致/互置信），并配合混合交叉学习、过渡原型对比学习和高置信上下文精炼，实现半监督心脏图像分割中非均匀可靠性的差异化监督。
AI.motivation: 半监督分割中伪标签监督的空间可靠性极不均匀：内部区域稳定，而边界区、低置信区及双网络分歧区噪声较大。现有方法对所有无标注像素施加统一监督，忽略可靠性差异，削弱了困难区域的判别性学习。
AI.method: R2CL基于双网络置信关系为无标注区域分配三种角色：互不确定区→熵正则化；置信不一致区→定向知识迁移；互置信区→可靠监督锚点。RR-MCL通过区域混合训练、定向跨网络监督与互不确定区熵正则实现上述角色；RT-PCL以前景邻接的可靠性过渡区构造查询特征、从互置信区学习网络特定类原型以增强边界判别；HCR利用互置信区内可靠内部像素与可信稠密块补充稳定上下文监督。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，区域重叠类与边界相关指标均取得稳定提升，且在前景稀疏的MVAA-CT数据集上优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 按可靠性差异对无标注区域进行角色划分与差异化监督，可有效利用伪标签、提升困难区域判别力；R2CL为半监督心脏图像分割提供了一种有效的协同学习范式。

title: Typological Feature Induction as a Benchmark for Inductive Metalinguistic Reasoning
summary: Existing metalinguistic reasoning benchmarks require both inference of rules and their application, making failures hard to diagnose. We introduce typological feature induction (TFI) which targets the former step. Given sentences in an unnamed language paired with translations in a known pivot language, models must predict a typological feature of the unnamed language. From Grambank and multi-parallel corpora, we automatically build evaluation questions over 195 languages. We find that LLMs identify 59--80% of these languages from only 16 sentence pairs; and misaligning the translations barely affects their accuracy, suggesting reliance on prior knowledge of the language. Enciphering text to prevent recognition increases the corpus' utility, but mainly for features where target and pivot languages agree. On languages which models cannot identify, neither open model outperforms a majority-value baseline. Since induction from raw text aligns with field linguists' use-case, this work indicates the models tested are not yet ready for this role. TFI offers a scalable path to track progress in this direction.

AI.tldr: 提出类型学特征归纳(TFI)任务,将规则推断与规则应用解耦,发现LLM主要依赖语言识别的先验知识而非数据驱动归纳。
AI.motivation: 现有元语言推理基准同时要求推断规则与应用规则,导致失败原因难以诊断;需单独隔离"规则推断"这一环节进行评估。
AI.method: 给定未命名语言的句子及已知枢轴语言译文,要求模型预测该语言的某一类型学特征。基于Grambank与多平行语料自动构建覆盖195种语言的评测题;并设置译文错配、文本加密等对照实验以检验模型依赖。
AI.result: LLM仅凭16个句对即可识别59–80%的语言;译文错配几乎不影响准确率;加密文本可提升语料效用,但主要体现在目标语言与枢轴语言特征一致的子集上;在无法识别语言的样本上,两个开源模型均未超过多数值基线。
AI.conclusion: 模型表现主要由对语言的先验知识驱动而非从原始文本归纳;鉴于该设定契合田野语言学家的实际用途,现有模型尚不胜任此角色;TFI提供了可扩展的进展追踪路径。

title: ROCm InferaSim: Cut LLM Serving Trial Costs and Deploy the Best Configuration
summary: Serving an LLM efficiently depends on the engine, how the model is split across GPUs, precision, scheduler settings, speculative decoding, KV-cache management, and prefill-decode disaggregation. The best configuration depends on the model, hardware, workload, and objective. Operators usually find it by trial and error. Exhaustively measuring the candidates in our study would take about 25,000 GPU-hours. ROCm InferaSim predicts serving performance from a few short measurements. Choices such as batch size, prompt length, and GPU count change the amount of work per GPU without changing the kernels. ROCm InferaSim benchmarks each distinct set of kernels once, on at most one node. We call this measurement an anchor. Analytical laws carry that anchor to other deployments that run the same kernels. For multi-node deployments, ROCm InferaSim reduces the configuration to a single-node equivalent, measures it, and scales the result analytically. A simulator replays multi-turn traffic, and a tuning agent searches configurations using the predictions. On AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs with vLLM, SGLang, and ATOM, 11 anchors took 9.1 GPU-hours, against 204 GPU-hours to measure the 226 fixed-length configurations they cover. On 172 configurations, time per output token has 8.1% median error. On a multi-turn coding workload, throughput is within 8%. For 159 disaggregated deployments, none used as an anchor, throughput is within 5.5%. A five-candidate short list contains a deployment within 12% of the best feasible pairing of model and latency target.

AI.tldr: ROCm InferaSim 用少量单节点“锚点”测量结合解析规律与模拟器，预测 LLM 服务性能，把 25000 GPU-hours 的穷举评测压缩到 9.1 GPU-hours。
AI.motivation: LLM 服务性能取决于引擎、多 GPU 切分、精度、调度参数、投机解码、KV-cache 管理与 PD 分离等多维配置，最优配置随模型、硬件、负载与目标变化，运维者通常只能试错；穷举候选需约 25,000 GPU-hours，代价过高。
AI.method: 关键观察：批大小、提示长度、GPU 数等只改变每 GPU 的工作量而不改变 kernel。据此对每组不同 kernel 集合仅在最多单节点上测量一次（anchor），再用解析规律外推到同 kernel 的其他部署；多节点配置归约为单节点等价后测量并解析缩放；用模拟器回放多轮流量，用调优代理基于预测搜索配置。
AI.result: AMD MI355X + vLLM/SGLang/ATOM 上，11 个 anchor 耗时 9.1 GPU-hours，对应 226 个定长配置实测需 204 GPU-hours；172 个配置上 TPOT 中位误差 8.1%；多轮编程负载吞吐误差 <8%；159 个未作 anchor 的分离式部署吞吐误差 <5.5%；5 候选短名单内含与最佳可行“模型+延迟目标”配对相差 12% 以内的部署。
AI.conclusion: 少量锚点测量加解析外推大幅降低服务配置调优成本，精度在可接受范围内，可作为配置搜索与容量规划工具。

title: Stacking-Based Weighting for Large Language Bayes in M-Open Settings
summary: Large Language Bayes (LLB) transforms a natural language problem description into a collection of candidate probabilistic programs and performs inference within each model, combining their predictions using Bayesian model averaging. While this provides a flexible framework for probabilistic inference without manual model specification, the resulting candidate model set is often misspecified in practice, and likelihood-based aggregation can concentrate on a single model, under-representing uncertainty across the sampled models. We propose a stacking-based aggregation method for LLB that selects model weights by optimizing predictive performance rather than marginal likelihood, while preserving the original language-model-driven model generation and within-model inference pipeline. Because leave-one-out predictive quantities are intractable in latent-variable models, we derive a variational lower bound that yields a tractable ELBO-based stacking objective. Across real-world probabilistic inference tasks, our method achieves comparable predictive performance to Bayesian model averaging while yielding more dispersed model weights, reducing concentration on a single candidate model under misspecification.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLB中的贝叶斯模型平均替换为基于优化的stacking聚合，利用变分下界构造可处理的ELBO-stacking目标，在预测性能与BMA相当的同时使模型权重更分散。
AI.motivation: LLB由大模型生成候选概率程序并做事内推断，再以贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）按边际似然聚合；但候选模型集常存在误设定，似然型聚合会过度集中于单一模型，低估跨模型不确定性。
AI.method: 提出stacking聚合：以预测性能而非边际似然优化模型权重，保留原有LM驱动的模型生成与事内推断流程；因潜变量模型下留一法预测量不可解析，推导变分下界，得到可处理的ELBO-based stacking目标。
AI.result: 在真实概率推断任务上，预测性能与BMA相当，但权重更分散，在误设定情形下降低了对单一候选模型的集中。
AI.conclusion: 以预测导向的stacking替代似然聚合，可在不改动生成与推断管线的前提下缓解误设定下的权重集中问题，更合理地表达模型不确定性。

title: Mamba3R: Fixed-Capacity Selective State Memory for Long-Sequence 3D Reconstruction
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. The supplementary material referenced in the text is not included in this version
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction must maintain geometric quality over long inputs within a fixed GPU budget.
