A pretrained recurrent model provides bounded state, but freezing its backbone also fixes its learned state-observation interactions. We introduce Mamba3R, a jointly designed state-memory adapter that provides a trainable adaptation path without updating the backbone or task heads. A selective state-space mixer jointly transforms native state features and a fixed-capacity auxiliary memory, explicit read and write paths carry information across frames, and a decomposed feedback path regulates what the added memory feeds back. Only 1.28 million adapter parameters are trained. Under a shared periodic-reset protocol, it lowers trajectory error and improves accumulated surface and depth accuracy over recurrent baselines on public indoor and outdoor datasets and robot-recorded traversals, gaining up to 40 percent on one metric. Matched comparisons support both the choice of the mixing operator and the utility of carrying the auxiliary memory across frames. Allocated memory remains unchanged and throughput moves by at most 1.4 percent from one to two thousand frames. Replaying its recorded traversals offline, the platform's RTX 4060 averages 11.7 frames per second within 5.1 GiB with the same checkpoint, a mean throughput covering the 10 Hz sensor rate.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mamba3R——一种与冻结骨干网络联合设计的状态记忆适配器，仅训练 128 万参数即可在固定 GPU 预算下提升流式三维重建的长期几何质量。
AI.motivation: 流式 3D 重建需在固定 GPU 预算下对长序列保持几何质量。预训练循环模型虽有有界状态，但冻结骨干会固化其已学习的状态-观测交互，缺乏可训练适配路径。
AI.method: 在不更新骨干与任务头的前提下引入可训练适配路径：选择性状态空间混合器联合变换原生状态特征与固定容量辅助记忆；显式读写路径跨帧传递信息；分解式反馈路径调节辅助记忆的回馈内容。仅训练 1.28M 适配器参数。
AI.result: 在共享周期重置协议下，相较循环基线在公开室内外数据集及机器人采集轨迹上降低轨迹误差、提升累积表面与深度精度，单项指标最高提升 40%；消融对比支持混合算子选择与跨帧辅助记忆的有效性；内存分配不变，1k→2k 帧吞吐变化≤1.4%。RTX 4060 上同检查点离线回放平均 11.7 FPS、占用 5.1 GiB，满足 10 Hz 传感器速率。
AI.conclusion: 以极小参数量的适配器实现冻结循环骨干的可训练状态记忆增强，在不增加内存开销且几乎不损失吞吐的条件下显著改善长序列流式重建的几何与轨迹精度。

title: ReListen: Training-Free Evidence Localization in Hour-Long Audio with Frozen Audio Language Models
summary: Audio language models are meant to answer questions from the audio itself, but an hour-long recording rarely fits in their context, and the answer often depends on a few seconds of it. Transcribing the recording first makes it fit but discards sounds and voices, while systems that return to the audio must be trained for this behavior. We propose ReListen, a training-free method in which a frozen audio language model finds its own evidence before answering. In a Jev-style scan, the model scores each 20-second window by the probability that it helps answer the question, and it then answers from the highest-scoring minute. This minute overlaps the annotated evidence far more often than transcript retrieval, for 88.5% of VoiceGiraffe questions. Without any change, the same scan also grounds events on LAT-Bench as well as a model trained for temporal grounding. Answering from it matches or exceeds hearing the whole recording with a small fraction of the audio, and on VoiceGiraffe it exceeds a transcript of the whole recording by 9.2 points. The selected evidence is also worth hearing rather than reading. Given the same excerpts, reading their transcript matches listening on speech content, but listening is clearly more accurate on questions about sounds and voices. Moreover, ReListen answers faster than every transcript-based system, and its memory stays constant even for recordings too long to hear whole on one GPU. Therefore, a frozen audio language model can search hour-long recordings by itself, without a transcript or additional training.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 ReListen 方法，让冻结的音频语言模型通过 Jev 式扫描自行在小时级录音中定位证据片段再作答，无需转写或额外训练。
AI.motivation: 小时级音频超出模型上下文，而答案往往只依赖其中数秒；先转写虽能压缩长度却丢失声音与说话人信息，而能回看音频的系统通常需专门训练。
AI.method: 冻结的音频语言模型先以 Jev 式扫描对每个 20 秒窗口打分，估计其对回答问题的帮助概率，再从得分最高的 1 分钟片段中作答；全程不需转写、不需训练，内存恒定。
AI.result: 所选 1 分钟片段与标注证据的重叠率显著高于转写检索，在 88.5% 的 VoiceGiraffe 问题上命中；无需改动即在 LAT-Bench 上达到与专门训练的时间定位模型相当的水平；仅听选定片段即可匹敌或超过听整段录音，在 VoiceGiraffe 上比全文转写高 9.2 分；相同片段下朗读转写在语音内容上与收听相当，但收听在声音与说话人问题上明显更准；速度优于所有基于转写的系统。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的音频语言模型可自行检索小时级录音，无需转写或额外训练，且所选证据值得直接收听而非阅读。

title: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
summary: Foundation models in changing environments can encounter unfamiliar domain knowledge that their original training did not cover. However, new domains rarely provide large amounts of expert-created training data or reliable supervisory signals for further training. We introduce Recursa, a foundation model system that adapts to new domains by learning from its own experience without human experts or a stronger teacher model. Recursa uses a knowledge repository to store what it learns: domain-specific skills and instructions on when to apply them, along with memories of past task experiences and reflections on what to improve. Recursa bootstraps the repository from domain materials and then refines it through recursive self-improvement. It uses parallel learners to execute tasks and synthesize local improvements, then validates and merges the improvements into the knowledge repository. On Harvey LAB's Firm Knowledge benchmark, Recursa raises the all-pass rate on held-out test tasks from 30.0% to 55.0% with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and from 35.0% to 46.0% with Qwen3.8-Flash.

AI.tldr: 提出 Recursa——一个无需人类专家或更强教师模型、通过递归自我改进适应新领域的基础模型系统，在 Harvey LAB Firm Knowledge 上显著提升了全通过率。
AI.motivation: 基础模型进入新环境时会遇到训练未覆盖的陌生领域知识，而新领域通常缺乏大量专家标注数据和可靠监督信号，因此难以进行额外训练。
AI.method: 构建知识库存储领域技能、技能适用指令、过往任务经验记忆及改进反思；先从领域材料中自举（bootstrap）该知识库，再通过递归自我改进迭代精炼：用并行学习器执行任务并合成局部改进，随后对改进进行验证并合并入知识库。
AI.result: 在 Harvey LAB 的 Firm Knowledge 基准的留出测试任务上，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的全通过率由 30.0% 提升至 55.0%，Qwen3.8-Flash 由 35.0% 提升至 46.0%。
AI.conclusion: 模型可通过基于自身经验与反思的递归自我改进实现领域自适应，无需人工专家或更强教师模型，并能获得显著性能增益。

title: One Mistake, Three Layers: Persistence Rules Under Depth Correlation
summary:
Probing frozen representations layer by layer is now standard practice, but reporting when a signal first becomes decodable requires a rule for reading a depth curve, and the obvious rule is wrong. On synthetic curves with known ground truth, requiring a probe score to exceed a null-calibrated threshold for three consecutive stages reports an onset nineteen stages early under transformer-like depth correlation, with every resample returning an onset. The failure follows from correlation between neighboring layers, a hazard known in neuroimaging but not, to our knowledge, checked for depth curves.
  We give an estimator whose error rate is calibrated rather than assumed. Null trajectories are built by permuting labels within each evaluation unit and holding each permutation fixed across depth, preserving the correlation structure the rule must survive; thresholds are per-layer order statistics; and the persistence requirement is calibrated rather than chosen.
  Applied to pocket information in a frozen co-folding trunk, stratifying 1,820 post-cutoff targets by protein-family and pocket familiarity, the five-stage rule fires on 4 to 7 per cent of null trajectories against a nominal 5 per cent and the three-stage rule on 12 to 17: the synthetic failure reproduces on real data. Pocket membership is decodable above threshold at all 48 blocks in all four regimes, so the onset cannot discriminate them; the pre-declared accumulation depth does, and is latest for familiar families with structurally novel pockets in every feature set. That regime is also the weakest, by a margin surviving controls for length, pocket measure and alignment depth.
  Separately, a widely used public co-folding checkpoint loads against its own code with 128 trunk parameters missing; those would be randomly initialized, and every representation extracted would be partly noise while appearing normal.

AI.tldr: 用置换构建零轨迹来校准深度曲线上的"起点"判定阈值与持续性要求，发现"连续三阶段超阈"规则在层间相关下过早报出起点（合成提前19层，真实数据12–17%假阳性），并以校准后的累积深度而非起点区分口袋信息可解码性的四种情形。
AI.motivation: 逐层探测冻结表示已成惯例，但"信号何时首次可解码"依赖一条读取深度曲线的规则，而最常用的规则（连续若干阶段超零校准阈值）在层间相关的深度曲线上未被检验过；这一风险在神经影像中已知，却未见用于深度曲线。
AI.method: 在真值已知的合成曲线上检验该规则；提出误差率被校准（而非假定）的估计量：在每个评估单元内置换标签且每个置换跨深度固定，以保留相关结构生成零轨迹；阈值取逐层次序统计量；持续性要求也做校准而非人为选取。应用于冻结共折叠主干的口袋信息，按蛋白家族与口袋熟悉度分层1,820个截止后靶点。
AI.result: 合成数据上三阶段规则在类Transformer深度相关下提前19个阶段报告起点，且每次重采样都报出起点；真实数据上五阶段规则在4–7%的零轨迹上触发（名义5%），三阶段规则12–17%，复现了合成失败。口袋归属在全部48个块、四种情形下均高于阈值，起点无法区分情形；预先声明的累积深度可以区分，且在每个特征集中都以"熟悉家族+结构新颖口袋"最晚，该情形也最弱，且该差距在控制长度、口袋度量与比对深度后仍成立。另发现一常用公开共折叠检查点加载时缺失128个主干参数，将以随机初始化加载，使提取的表示部分是噪声而外观正常。
AI.conclusion: "首次可解码"的朴素持续性规则在层间相关下系统性误报，必须用保留相关结构的置换零分布来校准阈值与持续性；校准后的累积深度比起点更具判别力；同时应审计检查点加载完整性，避免部分噪声表示被当作正常表示报告。

title: LINDA: Low Resource Foot Ulcer Segmentation using Local Similarity and Iterative Neural Dynamics
summary: Foot ulcers are a leading cause of lower limb amputation, and the highest burden often falls on low and middle income regions where specialists and computing hardware are both scarce. Wound monitoring tools are most useful there when they are accurate yet small enough to run on ordinary devices, but accuracy usually comes from heavy networks. We present LINDA, a compact model that grounds segmentation in an explicit structural prior instead of raw intensity. A Local Self-Similarity (LSS) map, computed directly from the image and stable under local lighting changes, is fused into a ResNet-34 encoder, and a small Liquid Time-Constant module refines the boundary over four iterative steps. With every model trained under one protocol on the FUSeg 2021 dataset, LINDA obtains the best Dice (86.68\%), IoU (79.67\%), and boundary accuracy (HD95 6.37 pixels) in our comparison while using only 25.70M parameters, fewer than the U-Net and transformer baselines. As the LSS map is a fixed function of the input, it exposes the structural cues the model follows in a readable form. Together this makes LINDA an accurate, inspectable, and lightweight option for wound assessment in resource-constrained care.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量分割模型LINDA，以局部自相似性(LSS)结构先验替代原始强度作为编码输入，在FUSeg 2021上取得最佳Dice/IoU/HD95，参数量仅25.70M。
AI.motivation: 足部溃疡是截肢主因，负担集中在专家与算力均匮乏的中低收入地区；当地需要可在普通设备上运行的高精度伤口监测工具，但精度通常依赖重型网络，精度与轻量化之间存在矛盾。
AI.method: 将分割建立在显式结构先验而非原始灰度强度上：由图像直接计算局部自相似性(LSS)图（对局部光照变化稳定），融合进ResNet-34编码器；再用小型液体时间常数(LTC)模块经四次迭代精修边界。所有模型在FUSeg 2021上按统一协议训练，公平对比。
AI.result: Dice 86.68%、IoU 79.67%、HD95 6.37像素，均为对比中最佳；参数量25.70M，少于U-Net与Transformer基线。
AI.conclusion: LSS图为输入的固定函数，可读地呈现模型所依赖的结构线索，使LINDA兼具准确性、可解释性与轻量化，适用于资源受限场景下的伤口评估。

title: TEMPO: Time Series Understanding via Discrete Tokenization
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Presented at the 2nd ICML Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (FMSD), 2026
summary: Time-series interpretation often requires both numerical observations and textual context. Integrating these inputs into a pretrained language model raises a representation question: how should a signal enter the model's token sequence? We present TEMPO, which extends an LLM's vocabulary with discrete codes from a context-aware Transformer tokenizer using finite scalar quantization. A frozen tokenizer maps four-step patches to a 625-code vocabulary; signal tokens, scale statistics, and text are then processed by the LLM's existing self-attention layers. Adaptation updates the new token embeddings and DoRA adapters. With a Qwen3-4B backbone and task-specific fine-tuning, TEMPO achieves macro-F1 scores of 89.0% on activity recognition, 85.0% on sleep staging, and 86.0% on bearing-fault diagnosis. Time-series question answering and qualitative bearing-diagnosis examples further illustrate how this interface combines signal representations with textual context. Together, these results demonstrate the utility of discrete vocabulary extension for time-series understanding.

AI.tldr: TEMPO 通过有限标量量化把时序信号离散为 token 加入 LLM 词表，仅训练新嵌入与 DoRA 适配器，在活动识别、睡眠分期、轴承故障诊断上取得 89.0%/85.0%/86.0% 的 macro-F1。
AI.motivation: 时序理解常需数值观测与文本语境结合，而将信号输入预训练语言模型存在核心表征问题：信号应以何种形式进入模型的 token 序列。
AI.method: 采用上下文感知的 Transformer tokenizer，通过有限标量量化（FSQ）将四步长 patch 映射到 625 码的离散码本；冻结 tokenizer，扩展 LLM 词表加入离散码与尺度统计量，与文本一同由原自注意力层处理；适配阶段仅更新新 token 嵌入与 DoRA 适配器，骨干为 Qwen3-4B 并进行任务特定微调。
AI.result: 宏观 F1 达 89.0%（活动识别）、85.0%（睡眠分期）、86.0%（轴承故障诊断）；时序问答与定性轴承诊断示例显示该接口能结合信号表征与文本语境。
AI.conclusion: 离散词表扩展是连接时序信号与 LLM 的有效接口，验证了其用于时序理解的价值。

title: Exploit or conform? How norm utility prompting changes the way LLMs use community beliefs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) serve both as tools for aiding human decision-making in everyday life and as models of human agents in experimental simulation studies. Alignment on prototypical social decisions -- such as whether to cooperate on a collective action -- therefore has immediate practical consequences for researchers and for society at large. Here we systematically explore the impact of ``norm utility'' -- the non-material components of utility that account for an individual's desire to conform to social norms and to be internally consistent -- on the strategic decision-making of three open-weight LLMs in one-shot, two-player social dilemmas. We find that when a social dilemma is presented together with information about community beliefs -- but without any indication of how those beliefs should matter -- models tend to treat community belief as strategic information, so that in the Snowdrift game cooperation falls as community belief in cooperation increases. When we explicitly prompt the components of norm utility this relationship inverts, and cooperation increases with community belief, in broad agreement with the predictions of a simple norm utility model. We then show that prompting norm utility reduces the volatility of strategic decisions with respect to changes in the underlying social context, and generates more consistent reasoning habits across models. Taken together, our results suggest that prompting norm utility can help generate more human-like and consistent behavior across models and lower volatility within models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统考察"规范效用"（norm utility，即个体遵从社会规范与保持内在一致性的非物质效用成分）对三个开放权重LLM在一局制两人社会困境中策略决策的影响，发现：仅提供社群信念信息时模型将其视为策略信息（Snowdrift博弈中合作随社群合作信念上升而下降）；显式提示规范效用各成分后该关系反转，合作随社群信念上升，且决策波动性降低、推理习惯更一致。
AI.motivation: LLM既作为辅助人类日常决策的工具，又被用作实验模拟研究中人类主体的模型，因此其在原型社会决策（如集体行动中的合作）上的对齐具有直接的实践意义。现有研究对"规范效用"这一非物质效用成分如何影响LLM策略决策缺乏系统探索。
AI.method: 在一次性、两人社会困境中，对三个开放权重LLM进行系统实验：对比两类条件——（1）仅给出社会困境与社群信念信息、不说明该信念应如何起作用；（2）显式提示规范效用的各组成部分。并将结果与一个简单的规范效用模型预测进行对照，进一步评估决策对社会情境变化的波动性及跨模型推理一致性。
AI.result: 无提示时，模型将社群信念当作策略信息，Snowdrift博弈中合作率随社群合作信念升高而下降；显式提示规范效用后关系反转，合作率随社群信念升高而上升，与简单规范效用模型预测大体一致。同时，提示规范效用降低了策略决策对底层社会情境变化的波动性，并使不同模型间的推理习惯更为一致。
AI.conclusion: 提示规范效用有助于生成更类人、更一致的跨模型行为，并降低模型内部决策波动性，对将LLM用作人类决策代理模型的研究具有方法学启示。

title: Rapid Mean-Field Formation Transport with a Shared-Representation Neural Fokker-Planck Controller
comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
summary: This paper develops a mean-field formation transport method with low online computational cost for large-scale multi-agent systems. Classical mean-field planners often require repeated solutions of coupled forward and backward partial differential equations, making online replanning computationally demanding. Density and control are therefore approximated by a common parameterized nonlinear map with separate scalar density and vector control outputs. Parameters are optimized using Fokker--Planck and initial-condition residuals, formation-matching costs on numerically simulated closed-loop particle trajectories, and control effort. Numerical computations are restricted to a bounded region of the state space, with an additional penalty on probability flux across its boundary. For the periodic-domain model, we establish well-posedness of the induced density evolution and bound the density-approximation error in terms of the dynamics and initial-condition residuals. Parameter optimization precedes online operation, during which controller coefficients remain fixed. Experiments quantify the accuracy--runtime trade-off relative to a mean-field planner, show lower transport error than classical feedback baselines, and demonstrate the benefits of the common parameterization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种低在线计算成本的均值场编队输运方法：用共享参数化非线性映射同时输出密度与控制，离线优化参数、在线仅固定系数执行，从而避免重复求解耦合PDE。
AI.motivation: 经典均值场规划需反复求解耦合的前向-后向偏微分方程，在线重规划计算负担大，难以用于大规模多智能体系统。
AI.method: 以同一参数化非线性映射近似密度与控制（分别输出标量密度与向量控制）；参数通过Fokker–Planck残差、初始条件残差、数值仿真闭环粒子轨迹上的编队匹配代价及控制代价联合优化；计算限制在状态空间有界区域内并加边界概率通量惩罚；对周期域模型证明诱导密度演化的适定性，并以动力学与初值残差界定密度近似误差；参数离线优化，在线阶段控制器系数固定。
AI.result: 实验量化了相对均值场规划器的精度—运行时间权衡，输运误差低于经典反馈基线，并验证了共享参数化设计的优势。
AI.conclusion: 该离线优化、在线固定系数的共享参数化框架可在保证密度近似误差可控的前提下显著降低大规模多智能体编队输运的在线计算成本。

title: TCINet: Tissue-Conditioned Adaptive Cross-Branch Interaction Network for Nuclei Instance Segmentation
comment: Accepted by IEEE BIBM 2026 as a short paper
summary: Separating touching nuclei requires local boundary detail, while cell type classification requires broader morphological context. These requirements also vary with the surrounding tissue environment. We propose the Tissue-Conditioned Adaptive Cross-Branch Interaction Network (TCINet), a single-stage model with Task-Specific Feature Adapters (TSFA) and Tissue-Conditioned Task-Aware Cross-Branch Interaction (TC-TACBI). TSFA produces branch-specific features at skip connections, and TC-TACBI controls three asymmetric paths among nucleus-presence (NP), horizontal-vertical (HV), and nucleus-type (NT) branches using predicted tissue probabilities. On PanNuke under standard three-fold cross-validation, TCINet achieves multiclass and binary panoptic quality scores of 0.519 and 0.692, respectively. Zero-shot tests on MoNuSeg yield a detection F1 score of 0.876. On PanNuke fold 0, adding TC-TACBI increases mPQ from 0.505 to 0.525. Code is available at https://github.com/celestial1321/TCINet.

AI.tldr: 提出TCINet单阶段模型，通过任务特定特征适配器与组织条件化跨分支交互，统一处理细胞核分割与类型分类。
AI.motivation: 分离粘连细胞核需要局部边界细节，而细胞类型分类需要更广的形态学上下文，且这些需求随周围组织环境而变化，单一特征难以兼顾。
AI.method: TCINet为单阶段架构，包含Task-Specific Feature Adapters（TSFA）与Tissue-Conditioned Task-Aware Cross-Branch Interaction（TC-TACBI）。TSFA在跳跃连接处生成分支特定特征；TC-TACBI利用预测的组织概率，控制核存在（NP）、水平-垂直（HV）与核类型（NT）三个分支间的三条非对称交互路径。
AI.result: PanNuke标准三折交叉验证下多类与二类PQ分别为0.519与0.692；MoNuSeg零样本检测F1为0.876；PanNuke fold 0上加入TC-TACBI使mPQ由0.505提升至0.525。
AI.conclusion: 以组织条件驱动的跨分支交互可有效协调多个任务的特征需求，显著提升泛化与全景分割性能，代码已开源。

title: Evaluating LLMs as Judges of Counterspeech Quality Against Online Hate Speech
summary: Prolonged exposure to hate speech on social media can cause lasting psychological distress among users. Counterspeech has emerged as an effective, non-censorial mitigation strategy, but its deployment requires rigorous quality assessment. Manual assessment is unscalable due to the large volume of content on the Web and imposes severe emotional strain on human annotators. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a scalable alternative, yet concerns remain regarding their reliability. In this paper, we investigate the extent to which LLMs can effectively perform this task. We test 12 open-weight LLMs of different sizes and families under zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting, to approximate pointwise and pairwise human expert assessment of counterspeech quality across four dimensions: relevance, coherence, aggressiveness, and suitableness. We find that (i) LLMs show low agreement and moderate rank correlations with human experts: our best configuration, Qwen 2.5 72B on coherence, achieves up to a linear-weighted Cohen's $κ_l = 0.19$ and Spearman's $ρ= 0.42$ in pointwise evaluation and an unweighted Cohen's $κ= 0.25$ in pairwise evaluation. (ii) Converting pointwise scores into pairwise labels substantially improves human--LLM agreement for selected configurations. For same-instance coherence, Qwen 2.5 72B under zero-shot prompting achieves $κ= 0.35$ with converted labels, compared with $κ= 0.25$ when judging pairs directly, and Mixtral 8$\times$7B under few-shot prompting improves from $κ= 0.07$ to $κ= 0.34$. (iii) LLMs agree more with one another than with human experts, particularly in pairwise evaluation, where the strongest model pair, OLMo 2 32B and Llama 3.3 70B on coherence, reaches substantial agreement with $κ= 0.76$, whereas their agreement with the experts in the same configuration does not exceed $κ= 0.21$.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用12个开源LLM在零样本、少样本与思维链提示下评估反仇恨言论（counterspeech）质量，发现LLM与人类专家的一致性偏低（最佳κ_l=0.19、ρ=0.42），但将逐点打分转为成对标签可显著提升人机一致性，且LLM之间的一致性明显高于其与人类专家的一致性。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体仇恨言论对用户造成心理伤害，counterspeech是有效的非审查式缓解手段，但其大规模部署需要严格的质量评估。人工评估难以扩展且给标注者带来情绪负担，LLM虽可扩展但可靠性存疑，因此需系统检验LLM能否胜任该评估任务。
AI.method: 选取12个不同规模与家族的开放权重LLM，在零样本、少样本与思维链提示下，围绕相关性、连贯性、攻击性与适宜性四个维度，同时进行逐点（pointwise）和成对（pairwise）的counterspeech质量评估，并与人类专家标注对比，采用线性加权Cohen's κ与Spearman ρ衡量一致性。
AI.result: (i) LLM与专家一致性低、排序相关性中等：最佳配置Qwen 2.5 72B在连贯性上逐点评估达κ_l=0.19、ρ=0.42，成对评估无加权κ=0.25。(ii) 将逐点评分转换为成对标签可显著提升人机一致性，如同一实例连贯性任务中Qwen 2.5 72B零样本由κ=0.25升至0.35，Mixtral 8×7B少样本由0.07升至0.34。(iii) LLM彼此一致性高于与人类的一致性，成对评估中OLMo 2 32B与Llama 3.3 70B在连贯性上κ=0.76，而二者与专家一致性不超过κ=0.21。
AI.conclusion: LLM目前尚不能可靠替代人类专家进行counterspeech质量评估；逐点转成对的标签转换能改善部分配置的一致性，但LLM间的"共同偏差"可能导致自洽却偏离人类判断，实际应用中需谨慎并辅以人类监督。

title: Forgetting to Improve: Principled Data Removal in Active Learning
summary: The uncertainty of a statistical model is most commonly factorized into an aleatoric and an epistemic part. This factorization changes how predictions are interpreted in downstream decision tasks. Importantly, except for the idealistic scenario with no model mismatch, the quantification is a characteristic of the model and not the data generating process. In this paper, we propose Forgetting to Improve a method that reduces this discrepancy by incorporating the task into the modeling framework. Our key insight is to acknowledge that in scenarios of model mismatch, data can have a detrimental effect on the modeling for a specific task. Based on this insight, we propose an influence function for Gaussian process models that allows for principled removal of detrimental data samples. We showcase the flexibility of this approach by demonstrating significant improvements across a range of tasks, including Bayesian optimization, model-based reinforcement learning, and transductive learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Forgetting to Improve"方法，针对模型失配下不确定度量化偏离数据生成过程的问题，引入面向任务的影响函数从高斯过程模型中删除对特定任务有害的数据样本，从而提升下游决策任务表现。
AI.motivation: 统计模型的不确定度常被分解为偶然（aleatoric）与认知（epistemic）两部分，但这种分解会改变下游决策任务中预测的解释方式。关键问题在于：除无模型失配的理想情形外，不确定度量化反映的是模型特性而非数据生成过程本身，二者存在偏差。作者希望缩小这一偏差，并将任务信息纳入建模框架。
AI.method: 作者的核心洞察是：在模型失配情形下，数据对特定任务的建模可能产生负面影响。据此，论文将任务纳入建模框架，为高斯过程模型推导出一种面向任务的影响函数（influence function），从而以有原则的方式识别并移除对任务有害的数据样本。
AI.result: 该方法在多个任务上展示了灵活性并取得显著改进，包括贝叶斯优化、基于模型的强化学习以及直推式学习（transductive learning）。
AI.conclusion: 在模型失配条件下，不确定度是模型属性而非数据属性；通过面向任务的影响函数剔除有害样本可有效缓解这种不一致。所提方法为高斯过程建模提供了任务感知的数据筛选机制，并在多类下游决策任务中验证了有效性。

title: Improving Diffusion-Based Augmentation for Data-Scarce Image Classification via Mask-Guided Reference Attention and Repulsive Noise Optimization
summary: Diffusion-based data augmentation has emerged as a powerful strategy for addressing data-scarce image classification. Recent pipelines typically adapt a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model to a limited number of class examples and subsequently sample synthetic images using diverse textual prompts. However, in extreme data-scarce regimes such as long-tailed single-sample settings, this approach suffers from a dual failure mode: the generated samples often lack discriminative foreground details crucial for classifier training, and the adapted class prior can bias the early denoising process, causing output images to exhibit similar patterns despite varying text prompts. To overcome these limitations, we propose a sampling-side framework of two complementary components that simultaneously enhance fine details and diversity. First, Mask-Guided Reference (MGR) Attention updates only foreground value tokens with reference features via zero-shot segmentation, limiting reference influence to the target object and mitigating excessive global feature injection. Second, Repulsive Noise Optimization (RNO) encourages initial noise trajectories to diverge from dominant generative modes of the adapted model, enabling target prompts to express broader contextual variation. Extensive evaluations show consistent improvements, with the largest gains in long-tailed single-sample settings of up to 2.50 and 2.94 points on CUB-LT IF100, and further robustness across few-shot and background-shift evaluations.

AI.tldr: 针对极端数据稀缺（长尾单样本）下扩散数据增强的双重失效问题，提出采样侧框架：Mask-Guided Reference Attention 仅用参考特征更新前景 value token，Repulsive Noise Optimization 使初始噪声轨迹偏离模型主导生成模式，从而同时提升细节与多样性。
AI.motivation: 预训练文生图扩散模型经少样本适配后用于数据稀缺图像分类时，在长尾单样本等极端场景存在双重失效：生成样本缺乏对分类器训练关键的判别性前景细节；适配后的类先验会偏置早期去噪过程，导致不同文本提示下输出模式趋同、多样性不足。
AI.method: 提出由两个互补组件构成的采样侧框架。其一为 Mask-Guided Reference (MGR) Attention：借助零样本分割，仅以前景 value token 更新参考特征，将参考影响限制在目标物体上，避免过度的全局特征注入。其二为 Repulsive Noise Optimization (RNO)：促使初始噪声轨迹偏离适配模型的主导生成模式，使目标提示能够表达更广泛的上下文变化。
AI.result: 在多项评测中取得一致提升；在长尾单样本设置下增益最大，CUB-LT IF100 上分别提升 2.50 与 2.94 个点；在少样本与背景偏移评测中亦表现出稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 在采样阶段同时增强细节与多样性即可有效缓解扩散增强在极端数据稀缺下的失效，且无需改变模型适配流程，具备跨场景的泛化鲁棒性。

title: MIMIC-Note-Extract: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset Extracted from MIMIC-IV-Note Discharge Summaries
comment: Accepted at ML4H 2026, Proceedings Track. Dataset: https://physionet.org/content/mimic-iv-ext-note-extract/1.0/
summary: MIMIC is one of the most widely used public hospital datasets for machine learning on electronic health records, yet clinically important information, such as past medical history, allergies, and diagnostic findings, remains confined to free-text discharge summaries. Studies requiring this information must therefore build their own extraction pipelines, duplicating substantial effort across projects. We release MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE), a large-scale dataset that uses a hybrid extraction pipeline combining deterministic parsing with schema-guided large language model generation to transform 16 sections from 300,720 discharge summaries into structured tables. MNE adds information that has no structured MIMIC counterpart and enriches related tables with broader coverage and greater clinical detail, including 10 times more patient-history entries and medication histories for more than twice as many admissions. Validation by medical doctors confirms extraction accuracy above 92% across sections. Using MNE, we construct a clinical decision-making benchmark for LLM agents, demonstrating how reusable structured representations of clinical narratives reduce data curation effort.

AI.tldr: 提出 MIMIC-Note-Extract（MNE）大规模数据集，用确定性解析与模式引导的 LLM 生成相结合的混合流水线，将 300,720 份出院小结的 16 个章节转为结构化表格，并基于此构建 LLM 智能体临床决策基准。
AI.motivation: MIMIC 中病史、过敏史、诊断发现等关键临床信息仅存在于自由文本出院小结中，缺乏结构化对应；相关研究各自重复搭建抽取流水线，造成大量重复劳动与口径不一致。
AI.method: 混合抽取流水线：确定性规则解析 + schema 引导的大语言模型生成，对 300,720 份出院小结的 16 个章节统一抽取为结构化表；由医生进行人工验证；并据此构建面向 LLM 智能体的临床决策基准。
AI.result: 各章节抽取准确率经医生验证均超过 92%；新增 MIMIC 原本无结构化对应的信息，并提升相关表覆盖度与临床细节，患者病史条目数达 10 倍，含用药史的住院记录超过 2 倍。
AI.conclusion: 可复用的结构化临床叙事表示能够显著降低数据整理成本，为 EHR 机器学习与智能体临床决策研究提供可直接使用的基础数据资源。

title: HybridSpec: Throughput-Aware Speculative Decoding for Hybrid GDN-MoE Models
summary: In speculative decoding, parallel drafters such as DFlash make drafting cheap, so target verification dominates each round. A central choice is the verification length, the number of tokens that the target processes in each round. Verifying more draft tokens can accept more of them, but work after the first rejection is wasted. For hybrid target models that combine Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers, verification time grows much faster with this length than for dense models. In a single-request profile of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B with DFlash, it grew by 71% from length 4 to 16, almost entirely in GDN and MoE layers, compared with 4%-6% for a dense Qwen3-4B target. Each GDN layer must update a recurrent state at every token and recover it at the end of the accepted prefix. The MoE cost depends on the experts that the tokens activate, which are known only once verification runs. We present HybridSpec, which selects the verification length on the GPU from draft-side acceptance estimates and measured target latency. Verification then runs this length plus one extra token up to the first MoE router, before any expert runs. There, a lightweight routing correction uses the observed expert assignments to decide whether to keep that token. The rest of verification runs only on the selected tokens. Block-parallel GDN kernels avoid storing a state after every token and reconstruct the accepted state of every GDN layer in one launch. In isolated benchmarks at verification lengths 4 to 16 with every draft token accepted, these kernels, including accepted-state reconstruction, are $1.54\times$-$4.04\times$ faster than the default kernels. With three GDN-MoE target models in single-request greedy decoding, HybridSpec is $1.75\times$-$1.88\times$ faster than autoregressive decoding and $1.30\times$-$1.33\times$ faster than DFlash.

AI.tldr: HybridSpec 在 GPU 上根据草稿侧接受估计与实测目标延迟自适应选择验证长度，并结合 MoE 路由校正与块并行 GDN 核，使 GDN-MoE 混合目标模型上的推测解码显著加速。
AI.motivation: 并行草稿器（如 DFlash）使起草成本降低，目标模型验证成为每轮瓶颈；而验证长度是核心权衡：更长可接受更多草稿 token，但首次拒绝后的计算全被浪费。对 GDN+MoE 混合目标模型，验证耗时随长度增长远快于稠密模型（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上长度 4→16 增长 71%，几乎全在 GDN 与 MoE 层，稠密 Qwen3-4B 仅 4%–6%）。原因是 GDN 每层需逐 token 更新循环状态并在接受前缀末尾恢复，MoE 代价取决于验证运行后才知的专家激活。
AI.method: ① 基于 GPU 的验证长度选择：结合草稿侧接受率估计与实测目标延迟；② 验证先多跑一个 token 至首个 MoE router 之前，用轻量路由校正依据观测到的专家指派对决定是否保留该 token，其余验证仅在被选 token 上运行；③ 块并行 GDN kernel，避免逐 token 存储状态，单次启动即重建各 GDN 层的接受状态。
AI.result: 验证长度 4–16、全部草稿 token 被接受的孤立基准中，含接受状态重建的 kernel 比默认 kernel 快 1.54×–4.04×；三个 GDN-MoE 目标模型单请求贪心解码下，HybridSpec 比自回归解码快 1.75×–1.88×，比 DFlash 快 1.30×–1.33×。
AI.conclusion: 针对 GDN-MoE 混合目标模型验证代价非线性增长的瓶颈，验证长度自适应选择、早期 MoE 路由校正与块并行 GDN 状态重建三者协同，可在不损失输出的前提下获得稳定的端到端加速。

title: Decision Transformer with Task-Aware Representations for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning
summary: To enable effective generalization in offline meta-RL, it is essential to accurately infer the underlying task through latent task representations, which provide a compact and transferable summary of task-specific characteristics for guiding policy generation. In this paper, we propose Contrastive Task-Aware Decision Transformer (CoTA-DT), a DT-based offline meta-RL framework that learns task representations by jointly integrating four complementary components: (i) contrastive learning from offline trajectories, (ii) alignment with natural-language task descriptions, (iii) one-step supervision via a task-conditioned world model, and (iv) long-term supervision via a task-conditioned Q function. The learned task representations are used as conditioning signals for a DT-based policy, enabling task-aware meta-policy learning. To further support generalization in both zero-shot and few-shot settings, we design a language-grounded, self-adaptive strategy that enables effective and reliable adaptation to unseen tasks. Notably, in CoTA-DT, the pretrained LLM serves as a shared backbone for language encoding, world modeling, Q-function estimation, and policy learning. This unified design facilitates parameter sharing, improving both efficiency and generalization. Extensive experiments across diverse offline meta-RL benchmarks demonstrate that CoTA-DT consistently outperforms prior methods, particularly in challenging zero-shot generalization scenarios.

AI.tldr: CoTA-DT：基于Decision Transformer的离线元强化学习框架，通过四个互补目标联合学习潜在任务表示，并以LLM为共享主干统一语言编码、世界模型、Q函数与策略学习，实现零样本/少样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 离线元RL泛化的关键在于准确推断潜在任务表示，以获得紧凑且可迁移的任务特征摘要来指导策略生成；现有方法在任务表示学习与零样本泛化上仍不足。
AI.method: 四个互补组件联合学习任务表示：(i)离线轨迹的对比学习；(ii)与自然语言任务描述的对齐；(iii)任务条件世界模型的一步监督；(iv)任务条件Q函数的长期监督。所学表示作为DT策略的条件信号，实现任务感知元策略；并设计语言驱动的自适应策略支持零样本与少样本适应。预训练LLM作为共享主干，统一承担语言编码、世界建模、Q值估计与策略学习，实现参数共享。
AI.result: 在多个离线元RL基准上持续优于先前方法，尤其在具有挑战性的零样本泛化场景中优势明显。
AI.conclusion: 多源监督（对比、语言对齐、一步与长期监督）联合塑造的任务表示有效提升离线元RL泛化；LLM共享主干的统一设计兼顾效率与泛化能力。

title: CounterSketch: Physics-Grounded Counterfactual Reasoning for Sketch-to-Video Generation
summary: Counterfactual sketch animation explores how a static sketch evolves under a hypothetical intervention. We present CounterSketch, a physics-grounded framework that transforms natural-language ``What if...?'' queries into physically plausible sketch animations. The framework integrates VLM-guided scene grounding, causal event-chain reasoning, constraint-based trajectory generation, and verification. It models physical transitions to update the scene graph, computes continuous object trajectories, and validates them against physical, geometric, and semantic constraints. The verified trajectories are then projected into object-level motion bounding boxes to guide downstream sketch-video synthesis. Experiments on CounterSketchBench (80 questions) demonstrate that physics-grounded trajectories provide stronger motion guidance than direct VLM predictions.

AI.tldr: CounterSketch：将自然语言“What if...?”反事实提问转化为物理合理的草图动画，通过VLM场景接地、因果事件链推理、约束轨迹生成与验证，并以轨迹引导草图视频合成。
AI.motivation: 静态草图无法表达假设性干预下的场景演化，而现有VLM直接预测运动的方式缺乏物理与几何一致性。
AI.method: VLM引导的场景接地；因果事件链推理；基于约束的连续轨迹生成（物理转移更新场景图）；物理、几何、语义三重约束验证；将验证后轨迹投影为对象级运动包围盒，引导下游草图视频合成。
AI.result: 在CounterSketchBench（80个问题）上，物理接地轨迹比VLM直接预测提供更强的运动引导。
AI.conclusion: 物理约束驱动的显式轨迹建模是反事实草图动画的有效引导信号，优于端到端VLM预测。

title: CardioVascBench:Prioritized Diagnosis Generation from Real-World Chinese Cardiovascular Records
summary: Identifying the primary diagnosis alone does not fully characterize a model's diagnosis-generation performance. We introduce CardioVascBench, a retrospective benchmark for prioritized diagnosis generation from real-world Chinese cardiovascular inpatient records. It contains 3,262 de-identified cases, with 2,174 for training and 1,088 for evaluation, linking clinical narratives and textual ECG reports to expert-verified, ordered discharge diagnoses standardized to ICD-10. An English translation of the evaluation set supports aligned cross-lingual comparison. Our evaluation protocol combines terminology normalization and rank-aware scoring to separately assess primary-diagnosis identification, reference-diagnosis coverage, and list precision. Evaluation across 36 systems shows that higher primary-diagnosis accuracy does not necessarily imply higher list precision against discharge references. We also provide CardioKG-Agent, a knowledge-enhanced baseline combining entity normalization, constrained graph retrieval, and guideline evidence. In a staged comparison of three baseline models, supervised fine-tuning plus the agent achieves a 73.5% higher mean composite score than fine-tuning alone, representing a system-level gain. These results measure retrospective agreement with recorded diagnoses; agreement between metric rankings and physician judgments remains to be validated. CardioVascBench supports research on diagnosis prioritization and knowledge-enhanced generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CardioVascBench——一个基于真实中文心血管住院病历、面向"优先级诊断生成"的回顾性基准（3262例，2174训练/1088评测，含ICD-10标准化的有序出院诊断与英文评测集），并给出术语归一化与排序敏感评分协议，以及知识增强基线CardioKG-Agent。
AI.motivation: 仅以"首要诊断是否命中"评价诊断生成性能不足以刻画模型能力：真实临床诊断是多标签、有优先级的列表，需分别考察首要诊断识别、参考诊断覆盖度与列表精确率。同时缺乏面向中文心血管病历、且与文本心电图报告关联的公开评测资源。
AI.method: 构建回顾性基准：收集真实中文心血管住院记录，脱敏后共3262例（2174训练、1088评测），将临床叙述与文本化心电图报告关联到专家核验、按优先级排序并标准化至ICD-10的出院诊断；提供评测集英译版本以支持跨语言对齐比较。评测协议结合术语归一化与rank-aware（排序敏感）打分，分别度量首要诊断识别、参考诊断覆盖与列表精确率。另提出CardioKG-Agent：融合实体归一化、受限图检索与指南证据的知识增强基线，并在三种基线模型上做分阶段对比。
AI.result: 在36个系统上的评测显示，首要诊断准确率更高并不必然意味着相对出院诊断参考的列表精确率更高。分阶段对比中，"监督微调+Agent"较"仅监督微调"的平均综合得分提升73.5%，体现为系统级增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果度量的是与病历记载诊断的回顾性一致性；指标排序与医师判断之间的一致性尚待验证。CardioVascBench为诊断优先级排序与知识增强生成研究提供支持。

title: Look Before You Launch: Learned Throughput Prediction for Hardware Selection in a Production Training Fleet
summary: In mixed-vendor accelerator fleets, many training jobs can run on several hardware types, and the best choice depends on each job's throughput on each type. Routing a job needs a throughput estimate for every candidate type before the job runs. We present LEAP, a machine learning performance prediction service that predicts each training job's throughput on every candidate hardware type at submission time and ranks the candidates by predicted throughput per unit cost. It routes tens of thousands of training job attempts a day across hundreds of different model types and more than 20 hardware types in a production fleet. LEAP predicts throughput from submission-time training configuration, including each job's prior throughput. LEAP reaches an accuracy of 77% over 30 nightly retrains, higher than the lookup table it replaced and at least as high as every alternative model we tested, including fine-tuned language models. Over six months, the share of eligible training GPU-hours that received a ranking by LEAP grew from 58% to 95%, and we estimate that it saves about 3% of training computational cost. In this paper, we identify the drivers that actually move accuracy and those that do not. We offer these as lessons for teams building performance predictors at fleet scale.

AI.tldr: LEAP：面向混合厂商加速器集群的机器学习吞吐预测服务，在作业提交时预测其在各候选硬件上的吞吐并按单位成本吞吐排序，服务生产集群每日数万次训练作业尝试，准确率77%，估计节省约3%训练算力成本。
AI.motivation: 混合厂商加速器集群中，同一训练作业可在多种硬件上运行，最优选择取决于作业在各硬件上的吞吐；而路由决策需在作业运行前获得每个候选硬件的吞吐估计，现有替代方案（如查表）精度不足。
AI.method: 构建提交时性能预测服务：以作业提交时的训练配置（含该作业历史吞吐）为特征，预测其在各候选硬件类型上的吞吐，并按预测的单位成本吞吐对候选排序；覆盖数百种模型类型、20余种硬件，支持每日数万次作业尝试，并进行30次夜间重训练以评估稳定性，同时与查表法及包括微调语言模型在内的多种替代模型对比。
AI.result: 在30次夜间重训练上达到77%准确率，高于被其取代的查表方法，且不低于所有测试的替代模型（含微调语言模型）；六个月内获得LEAP排序的合格训练GPU时占比由58%提升至95%，估计节省约3%训练计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 论文识别出真正影响精度与不影响精度的因素，并将其作为面向集群规模性能预测器建设团队的经验教训。

title: Denoising Is Stein: Moment Access and a Resource Hierarchy for Learning Hidden Structure in Diffusion Models
summary:
We study score learning from denoising pairs when the data contain a hidden non-Gaussian component. If covariance reveals the component, its subspace can be recovered directly. If covariance is isotropic, the first distinguishing moment has order $k^\ast$, and the learner must extract that moment from clean points and their noisy views.
  Correlations in the denoising loss are Stein discrepancies against a baseline; for polynomial fields they determine exactly the corresponding moment differences. Averaging fresh noisy views conditional on a clean point gives an exact moment query on the clean distribution. In the covariance-matched regime, orientation-independent dictionaries satisfying an $L^4/L^2$ condition need order $d^{k^\ast-1}$ features, and the stated dot-product kernel ridge models need the same power in samples. Small-step online SGD on one unit has this exponent up to logarithms. A two-stage learner uses the curvature of a smoothed denoising loss to recover the hidden direction, then sharpens it and fits a scalar readout. For every even $k^\ast$, it obtains a fixed score gain over the Gaussian baseline from $O(d^{k^\ast/2}\log d)$ clean points. In the covariance-visible regime, the frozen-feature threshold occurs at $d^J/J!$, while projection onto principal components makes the fitted-model, score-risk and generated-law distributions independent of ambient dimension.
  In the covariance-matched experiments, the measured partial-trace overlaps are consistent with the proposed spectral transition. A width-8 network trained with clean-point reuse shows a $d^2$-like training-set threshold over $d=64$--$192$, with fixed validation and calibration overhead.

AI.tldr: 研究含隐藏非高斯成分的数据下，从去噪对（clean-noisy）中学习 score 的统计与计算规律；证明所需的矩阶数 k*、样本复杂度（O(d^{k*/2} log d)）以及两阶段学习器的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有 score learning / 扩散模型理论多假设高斯数据，对存在隐藏非高斯结构时"score 学习究竟需要多高阶矩、多少样本、能否被高效估计"缺乏刻画。作者希望区分"协方差可见"与"协方差各向同性（matched）"两种情形，给出可学习的阈值与下界。
AI.method: 1) 将去噪损失中的相关项解释为相对基线分布的 Stein discrepancy，对多项式场精确对应矩差；2) 对 clean 点条件于新鲜噪声视图取平均，得到对 clean 分布的精确矩查询；3) 协方差匹配情形下，分析满足 L^4/L^2 条件的与方向无关的字典需 d^{k*-1} 个特征，点积核岭回归需同样幂次的样本，小步长在线 SGD 达到该指数（差对数项）；4) 提出两阶段学习器：先用平滑去噪损失的曲率恢复隐藏方向，再锐化并拟合标量读出。
AI.result: 对任意偶数 k*，两阶段学习器用 O(d^{k*/2} log d) 个 clean 点即可相对高斯基线获得固定 score 增益；协方差可见情形下冻结特征阈值出现在 d^J/J!，而投影到主成分可使拟合模型、score 风险与生成分布不依赖环境维度。实验上部分迹重叠与谱相变一致；width-8 网络在 d=64–192 上呈 d^2 型训练集阈值。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏非高斯成分的可学习性由辨识矩阶 k* 决定：协方差匹配时需要 k*/2 阶的多项式时间样本量，两阶段曲率恢复 + 标量读出达到该速率；协方差可见时维度可通过 PCA 投影消除。理论与实验共同支持所提出的谱相变图景。

title: P-SER: Physical Consistency-Constrained Scattering Expandable Representation for Class-Incremental HRRP Target Recognition
summary: High-resolution range profiles (HRRPs) provide compact radar target representations but exhibit strong aspect sensitivity, complicating class-incremental recognition when historical data are unavailable. Changes in viewing aspect shift scattering-peak locations and amplitudes, while reflector groups may produce responses resembling ships. Existing dynamic expansion methods can also incur substantial parameter and memory overhead. To address these challenges, we propose P-SER, a Physical Consistency-Constrained Scattering Expandable Representation framework for exemplar-free class-incremental HRRP recognition. P-SER reconstructs dominant scattering points from complex-valued sum- and azimuth-difference-channel HRRPs and observation geometry. The reconstructed spatial structure, target extent, and energy distribution are used to derive class-level scattering prototypes and sample-level saliency priors, providing physically grounded constraints for feature learning and old-class knowledge retention. A primitive scatterer dictionary further characterizes local strong-scattering mechanisms and calibrates uncertain ship--reflector predictions at inference. Meanwhile, lightweight residual adapters are incrementally introduced into a shared HRRP backbone to learn new classes with limited model growth. Experiments on simulated and measured HRRP datasets show that P-SER delivers competitive recognition performance without retaining old-class exemplars, while maintaining physical consistency, interference robustness, knowledge retention, and model scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出P-SER框架，用物理一致性约束的散射原型与残差适配器实现无样本类增量HRRP识别。
AI.motivation: HRRP具有强方位敏感性：视角变化导致散射峰位置与幅度漂移，反射体组响应易与舰船混淆；且历史数据不可得，现有动态扩展方法参数与内存开销大。
AI.method: 由复数域和通道与方位差通道HRRP及观测几何重建主导散射点；据重构的空间结构、目标尺寸与能量分布导出类级散射原型和样本级显著性先验，作为物理约束用于特征学习与旧类知识保持；构建基元散射体字典刻画局部强散射机理并在推理时校准舰船—反射体不确定预测；在共享HRRP骨干上增量引入轻量残差适配器。
AI.result: 在仿真与实测HRRP数据集上，无旧类样本条件下取得有竞争力的识别性能，并保持物理一致性、干扰鲁棒性、知识保留能力与模型可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 物理一致性约束可有效缓解方位敏感与无样本遗忘问题，配合轻量残差适配器实现低增长的类增量HRRP识别。

title: When Ground Truth Is Not Ground Truth: Automatic Labeling for Hallucination Detection
summary: Hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) remain a major challenge, as they can produce misleading, factually incorrect, or unverifiable information, thereby undermining their trustworthiness and reliability. However, reliable ground-truth labels remain a key challenge in evaluating hallucination detectors. Recent studies often construct labels automatically by comparing model generations with reference answers using similarity metrics such as BLEURT. This implicitly treats BLEURT similarity as a proxy for hallucination, despite its English-centric supervision, unbounded score range, and design as a similarity metric rather than a factuality measure, making threshold-based ground-truth construction potentially unreliable. Through comprehensive experiments using 15 automatic supervision judges, seven hallucination detection baselines, two generator models, two QA datasets, and five languages, we demonstrate that detector performance varies substantially with the choice of supervision judge. Human validation reveals substantial differences in labeling reliability, with QGen-9B achieving the lowest overall misclassification rate (12.86%), while BLEURT and BLEURT-n exhibit rates of 47.23% and 47.32%, respectively. Our findings highlight the limitations of automatic similarity-based labeling and the need for more reliable judging methods that better capture semantic and factual correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验了"以大模型生成与参考答案的相似度（如BLEURT）自动构造幻觉检测标签"这一做法的可靠性，发现检测器性能强烈依赖所选的监督判官，且相似度类监督的标注错误率接近一半。
AI.motivation: 幻觉是LLM可信度的主要威胁，但评估幻觉检测器缺乏可靠的真值标签；现有工作常用BLEURT等相似度指标自动生成标签，隐含地将"相似度"等同于"幻觉"，而BLEURT具有英文中心、分数无界、本质是相似度而非事实性度量等缺陷，基于阈值的真值构造可能不可靠。
AI.method: 构建大规模对照实验：15种自动监督判官、7个幻觉检测基线、2个生成器模型、2个QA数据集、5种语言；对比不同监督判官下检测器性能差异，并辅以人工校验评估各判官的标注可靠性（以误分类率衡量）。
AI.result: 检测器性能随监督判官选择显著波动；人工校验显示标注可靠性差异巨大：QGen-9B总体误分类率最低（12.86%），而BLEURT与BLEURT-n分别高达47.23%和47.32%。
AI.conclusion: 基于自动相似度的标注存在明显局限，将BLEURT相似度作为幻觉代理标签不可靠，会扭曲幻觉检测器的评估结论；需要能更好刻画语义与事实正确性的判官方法。

title: Query-based Submodular Data Selection for Efficient Instruction Tuning
summary: As large language models are fine-tuned for increasingly specialized tasks, their performance depends more on which training examples are selected than on how many. Given a large heterogeneous training pool and a small target set specifying the desired capability, targeted data selection aims to find a compact subset that maximizes downstream performance. Existing methods score each candidate independently against the target and select the top-ranked examples, yet this point-wise strategy ignores inter-example interactions: at tight budgets the selected subset is dominated by near-redundant points that waste capacity on overlapping information. We propose Query-based Submodular functions with Gradient-guided Synthesis (QSGS), which formulates targeted selection as a submodular graph cut over a gradient similarity graph. A modular relevance term pulls selected examples toward the target task, while a pairwise dispersion penalty suppresses intra-subset redundancy. The resulting objective balances target relevance and intra-subset redundancy using the same formulation across different selection budgets. Empirically, the benefit of diversity-aware selection becomes increasingly pronounced as the data budget decreases. To further close coverage gaps that no selection from existing data can bridge, we introduce a gradient-guided synthesis step that identifies under-covered target directions via residual subspace analysis and generates synthetic examples to fill them. Experiments on MMLU, BBH, and TydiQA across Llama-2, Llama-3, and Mistral, show that QSGS at a 0.5% budget matches or exceeds full-data performance on Mistral-7B, outperforms the strongest baseline across all benchmarks, and yields increasing gains as the budget shrinks.

AI.tldr: QSGS 将定向数据选择建模为梯度相似度图上的次模图割（相关性项+成对分散惩罚），并加入梯度引导合成以填补覆盖缺口；在 0.5% 预算下于 Mistral-7B 上达到或超过全量数据性能，并在各基准上优于最强基线。
AI.motivation: 大模型微调日趋专门化，性能更依赖"选了哪些样本"而非"用了多少样本"。给定大规模异构训练池与刻画目标能力的小目标集，需在紧预算下选出紧凑子集。现有方法对候选样本独立打分取 top-k（point-wise），忽略样本间交互，导致紧预算下子集被近冗余点占据、信息重叠浪费容量。
AI.method: 提出 QSGS（Query-based Submodular functions with Gradient-guided Synthesis）：1）将定向选择形式化为梯度相似度图上的次模图割，含模块化相关性项（将样本拉向目标任务）与成对分散惩罚项（抑制子集内冗余），同一目标式在任意预算下通用；2）进一步引入梯度引导合成步骤，通过残差子空间分析识别目标方向上覆盖不足的区域，并生成合成样本填补现有数据无法弥合的覆盖缺口。
AI.result: 在 MMLU、BBH、TydiQA 上，跨 Llama-2、Llama-3、Mistral 验证：预算越小，多样性感知选择的收益越显著；0.5% 预算下 QSGS 在 Mistral-7B 上匹配或超过全量数据性能，并在全部基准上优于最强基线，预算收缩时增益递增。
AI.conclusion: 定向数据选择应显式建模样本间冗余，而非独立打分；次模图割目标可在统一形式下平衡相关性与多样性，配合梯度引导合成可突破现有数据的覆盖上限，且在极低预算区间收益最大。

title: Structured Priors: Towards an algebra of component priors for prior-data fitted networks
summary: Prior-data fitted networks are typically trained using synthetic data generated by a single, manually constructed generator. In cases where such a generator combines multiple components, e.g., in TabPFN, Mitra, or TabICLv2, this is achieved through a mixture using manually specified weights, the impact of which on the network only becomes apparent after pre-training. Instead of such a hand-built generator, this work proposes a structured prior: a small set of named component priors, linked by operators whose algebraic properties are formally proven and whose influence on the trained network has been validated. Within a measure-theoretic framework, the operators of mixture, convolution, amplitude scaling, local transform, and projection are defined. Their governing laws are proven. These operators are implemented in the macl2l software package. Experiments demonstrate that the implemented generators reproduce the identities within the resolution of a permutation test. Furthermore, it is shown that trained networks obey the distributive law; that a mixed prior composed of small components performs as well as or better than any individual component in seven out of eight open regression benchmarks; and that on two of these tables a structured prior reaches, with a ninth of the data budget, an error that a generic random-function prior does not reach even with the full budget. A theorem on model averaging demonstrates that networks trained on individual components constitute the Bayes predictor for the mixture, provided that the component networks are themselves the Bayes predictors for their respective priors. However, the pre-registered test of this averaged predictor with trained component networks failed, because the networks identify the generating component too rarely. The paper proposes a research program focused on the algebra of structured priors for prior-data fitted networks.

AI.tldr: 提出了由命名组件先验与可证明代数算子构成的"结构化先验"，替代手工混合生成器，并在度量论框架下证明算子律、实现于macl2l软件包，经实验验证其等价性与性能优势。
AI.motivation: 现有先验数据拟合网络（如TabPFN、Mitra、TabICLv2）依赖单一手工构造的生成器；当生成器含多组件时，通过人工指定权重的混合实现，这些权重对网络的影响只有预训练后才能显现，缺乏可控性与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出结构化先验：一组命名的组件先验，通过其代数性质经形式化证明的算子连接。在测度论框架下定义混合、卷积、幅度缩放、局部变换、投影五类算子并证明其支配律；在macl2l软件包中实现这些算子；用置换检验评估生成器是否复现恒等式，并测试训练网络是否服从分配律。另给出模型平均定理：若各组件网络分别是其先验的贝叶斯预测器，则其在混合上的平均即为混合先验的贝叶斯预测器，并进行了预注册检验。
AI.result: 实现的生成器在置换检验分辨率内复现了恒等式；训练网络服从分配律；由小组件构成的混合先验在8个公开回归基准中有7个表现不劣于或优于任一单组件；在其中2个表格上，结构化先验以1/9的数据预算即达到通用随机函数先验用满预算也达不到的误差。但预注册的模型平均预测器检验失败，原因是网络过少地识别出生成组件。
AI.conclusion: 结构化先验可作为手工混合生成器的可行替代，具备形式化代数基础与实证优势；但组件识别能力不足使模型平均定理难以落地，作者据此提出以结构化先验代数为核心的研究纲领。

title: ProGeo-RC: Prototype-guided Semantic Reliability and Geometric Error Calibration for Semi-supervised Cardiac Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted at IEEE BIBM 2026. 7 pages, 3 figures
summary: Semi-supervised medical image segmentation aims to train reliable segmentation models using limited labeled data and abundant unlabeled data. However, existing methods typically rely on prediction confidence or model consistency to estimate pseudo-label reliability, but these criteria are insufficient to characterize both semantic reliability and geometric plausibility. To address this issue, we propose ProGeo-RC, a prototype-guided semantic reliability and geometric error calibration framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. ProGeo-RC consists of two key modules: Prototype-guided Semantic Reliability Estimation (PSRE) and Structured Semantic-Geometric Error Calibration (S-SGEC). PSRE uses probabilistic class prototypes to estimate the semantic reliability of unlabeled predictions and calibrate pixel-wise teacher pseudo labels, while S-SGEC introduces signed-distance-field-based geometric constraints to refine ambiguous boundaries and suppress spurious foreground responses outside target structures. Experiments on the ACDC and MVAA-CT datasets show that ProGeo-RC achieves better performance compared with representative semi-supervised segmentation methods. Under the 10\% labeled setting on ACDC, ProGeo-RC improves DSC and Jaccard by 0.37\% and 0.49\% over the corresponding second-best results, while reducing 95HD and ASD by 0.61 and 0.21, respectively. These results indicate that joint semantic reliability estimation and geometric error calibration can provide more reliable pseudo supervision for semi-supervised medical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出ProGeo-RC框架，通过原型引导的语义可靠性估计（PSRE）与结构化语义-几何误差校准（S-SGEC）联合提升半监督医学图像分割伪标签质量，在ACDC与MVAA-CT上优于代表性方法。
AI.motivation: 现有半监督分割方法仅依赖预测置信度或模型一致性评估伪标签可靠性，难以同时刻画语义可靠性与几何合理性。
AI.method: ProGeo-RC含两模块：PSRE利用概率类别原型估计无标注预测的语义可靠性并校准教师像素级伪标签；S-SGEC引入基于符号距离场（SDF）的几何约束，细化模糊边界并抑制目标结构外的虚假前景响应。
AI.result: 在ACDC与MVAA-CT上优于代表性半监督分割方法；ACDC 10%标注下DSC、Jaccard分别提升0.37%、0.49%，95HD与ASD分别降低0.61和0.21。
AI.conclusion: 联合语义可靠性估计与几何误差校准可为半监督医学图像分割提供更可靠的伪监督信号。

title: ReSI-Math: Exploring Recoverable Capability Frontiers for Efficient Reasoning Improvement
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective approach for improving mathematical reasoning in large language models. However, a fundamental question remains: when a model fails to solve a problem, does it truly lack the underlying capability? In this work, we reveal that direct failure does not necessarily imply inability. Some reasoning failures can be recovered by exploring the model's own trajectories, exposing a recoverable capability frontier: a policy-dependent region where solutions are not reliably generated through direct decoding but can be elicited through trajectory-level search. Based on this observation, we introduce ReSI-Math, a framework that explores recoverable capability frontiers and converts recovered capabilities into data-efficient RLVR supervision. ReSI-Math uses Self-Judge-guided evolutionary search to identify recoverable failures under a fixed policy and adaptively selects frontier problems for sequential RLVR as the policy evolves. On Qwen3-VL-8B, correct-incorrect trajectory crossover produces 272 verifier-confirmed correct offspring from 621 attempts (43.8%). After three sequential one-shot RLVR stages, the MATH500 and WE-MATH average improves from 78.71 to 80.16. Under matched single-problem RLVR, random selection reaches only 53.31 versus 54.16 for frontier-guided Q1.

AI.tldr: 论文提出可恢复能力前沿（recoverable capability frontier）概念，指出模型直接解码失败不代表缺乏能力；据此构建 ReSI-Math 框架，用自评判引导的进化搜索挖掘可恢复失败并转为数据高效的 RLVR 监督，在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上将 MATH500/WE-MATH 平均从 78.71 提升至 80.16。
AI.motivation: RLVR 已成为提升大模型数学推理的重要手段，但"直接解码失败是否等于模型缺乏该能力"这一基本问题未被回答。作者观察到部分失败可通过探索模型自身轨迹恢复，说明存在一个策略相关、直接解码不可靠但轨迹级搜索可激发的区域，即"可恢复能力前沿"，而现有训练未利用这一信号。
AI.method: ReSI-Math 框架：以 Self-Judge 引导的进化搜索，在固定策略下通过正确/错误轨迹交叉改写（trajectory crossover）识别可恢复失败样本；随策略演化自适应筛选前沿问题，用于顺序式（sequential）RLVR 训练，实现数据高效监督。实验在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上进行，采用三阶段 one-shot RLVR，并与随机选题的匹配单题 RLVR 基线对比。
AI.result: 正确-错误轨迹交叉在 621 次尝试中产生 272 条经验证器确认为正确的子代轨迹（43.8%）。三阶段顺序 one-shot RLVR 后，MATH500 与 WE-MATH 平均分由 78.71 升至 80.16。在匹配的单题 RLVR 设置下，随机选题为 53.31，前沿引导的 Q1 为 54.16。
AI.conclusion: 直接失败不等于能力缺失：模型存在可被轨迹级搜索激发的可恢复能力前沿。基于该前沿进行样本选择可显著提升 RLVR 的数据效率与最终性能，为"失败样本"的再利用提供了新视角与可操作框架。

title: On the Primacy Bias in RLVR Training
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has emerged as a promising approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, it still remains unclear whether RLVR can extend reasoning capabilities beyond what is already encoded in the base model. In this paper, we study this question through the lens of primacy bias: the tendency of models to over-rely on already-learned representations, disproportionately improving performance on problems they already handle well while underexploring harder ones that require departing from those representations. Through our controlled experiments and large-scale analysis, we show that RLVR training on mixed data tends to further sharpen performance on easier problems while yielding only marginal gains on harder ones. We find that although hard problems lead to modest gains overall, they are actually the ones that help most in expanding the model's reasoning capabilities and pushing the representations. However, prolonged training on these hard problems may also hurt and lead to forgetting on easy problems. These findings help to better understand some of the prior conflicting observations about RLVR, specifically, why on (OOD) domains where the base model performs poorly, improvements on hard problems can expand reasoning; while on well-trained domains, forgetting can reduce performance and mask genuine gains obtained from hard problems.

AI.tldr: 本文从"首因偏置(primacy bias)"视角研究RLVR能否突破基座模型已有推理能力，发现混合数据训练主要强化易题、对难题增益有限，但难题才是拓展推理能力的关键，且过度训练难题会导致易题遗忘。
AI.motivation: RLVR被广泛用于增强大模型推理，但尚不清楚其能否扩展超出基座模型已编码的推理能力；已有关于RLVR效果的观察存在冲突，需要统一解释。
AI.method: 以首因偏置（模型过度依赖已学表征）为分析框架，通过受控实验与大规模分析，考察RLVR在不同难度数据（易题/难题混合）上的训练动态与表征变化。
AI.result: 混合数据RLVR进一步锐化易题表现，难题仅获边际提升；难题虽总体增益有限，却最能扩展推理能力、推动表征更新；但长时间训练难题会损害易题表现并引发遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 难题驱动能力拓展、易题导致表征固化，二者的权衡可解释先前矛盾观察：在基座表现差的OOD域，难题训练带来扩展；在训练充分的域，遗忘会掩盖并抵减难题带来的真实增益。

title: StreamLTT: Risk Certification for Policy Selection under Stream Dependence
summary: Learn-then-Test (LTT) provides a general framework for certifying deployment policies against a prescribed risk target, but its standard formulation targets a fixed population risk estimated from calibration losses. In sequential deployment, losses may instead be dependent and nonstationary, so the risk of a fixed policy can evolve with the observed history. We introduce StreamLTT, which replaces this fixed population risk with average predictable risk, defined by conditioning each decision's loss on the information available before its outcome is revealed. Conditional centering turns empirical deviations from this target into a martingale sum, enabling both a test that adapts to predictable variance and a finite-sample Hoeffding alternative. Combined with family-wise error rate control, StreamLTT yields a simultaneously certified policy region that supports subsequent deployment selection. Across seven forecasting datasets and seven deployment risks, StreamLTT places the certified frontier substantially closer to the prescribed risk target than IID, robust-variance, block-bootstrap, and concentration-based alternatives, while empirical family-wise error closely follows the prescribed level. A finite-sample ablation further shows that the predictable-risk formulation drives the tighter risk frontier, while adaptation to predictable variance makes more effective use of the available family-wise error budget. StreamLTT therefore extends risk-certified policy selection to dependent deployment streams by addressing both what risk should be certified and how it should be tested.

AI.tldr: StreamLTT 将 LTT 中固定的总体风险替换为"平均可预测风险"（对每次决策的损失按其结果揭示前可得信息取条件期望），通过条件中心化把经验偏差转化为鞅和，从而在相依、非平稳的序列部署流上实现风险认证与策略选择。
AI.motivation: 标准 LTT 假设校准损失来自固定总体，风险可从校准损失估计；但在序列部署中损失可能相依且非平稳，固定策略的风险会随已观测历史演化，因此原有风险目标设定与检验方式不再适用。论文要同时回答"该认证什么风险"与"该怎样检验它"两个问题。
AI.method: 提出 StreamLTT：以条件于决策前信息的平均可预测风险替代固定总体风险；条件中心化使经验偏差成为鞅和，据此构造可自适应可预测方差的检验，并给出有限样本的 Hoeffding 替代方案；再结合族错误率（FWER）控制，得到可同时认证的策略区域以支持后续部署选择。
AI.result: 在 7 个预测数据集、7 种部署风险上，StreamLTT 的认证前沿显著更接近规定风险目标，优于 IID、稳健方差、块自助法与集中不等式类替代方案，经验族错误率贴近预设水平。有限样本消融显示：可预测风险表述带来更紧的风险前沿，而对可预测方差的自适应更有效利用 FWER 预算。
AI.conclusion: StreamLTT 通过重新界定认证对象（平均可预测风险）与检验机制（鞅检验 + 方差自适应 + FWER 控制），把风险认证式策略选择扩展到相依部署流，是 LTT 在序列场景下的自然推广。

title: Sketch-Omni: Instance-Level Sketch-Based Visual Prompting for Perception MLLMs
summary: Promptable perception, from GroundingDINO to Rex-Omni, puts one model behind one prompt interface and returns coordinates for any localisation task. Every model in that line was built for photographs; none has been given a sketch. We present Sketch-Omni, to our knowledge the first perception MLLM built to work on sketches and from them. On a sketch, the sketch is the image, and text prompts detect, point, resolve object and spatial referring expressions, and ground affordances in it. From a sketch, the sketch is the prompt, and a drawing of one object localises that object in a photograph, even among several of the same category, a query that neither a category name nor a photo exemplar can pose. Two obstacles stand in the way. A photo-trained model's attention is tuned to colour and texture, which a sketch does not have, and no dataset pairs a drawing with the one instance it depicts among others of its kind. We build the training data instead of collecting it. An edge detector turns every labelled photograph into a sketch-like drawing that keeps the photograph's labels, and two constructions produce sketch-to-photo instance pairs from existing data. On top of this, photo-guided relation alignment passes each photograph and its edge sketch through the same model and trains the sketch pass to reproduce how the photograph pass relates phrases to patches and patches to each other. Not one training label is drawn by hand. Sketch-Omni reaches 91.4 F1 on sketch-prompted localisation against 81.8 for the strongest general-purpose MLLM, with a lead that doubles when the photograph holds several instances of the queried category, and it is best in 39 of 40 evaluation cells across six tasks. Code, model, and a hand-annotated benchmark of 2754 sketch-to-photo links will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sketch-Omni，首个面向草图并可从草图出发的可提示感知多模态大模型（MLLM）。在草图上以文本提示完成检测、指代与可供性定位；以草图为提示在照片中定位所画实例。训练数据由边缘检测与两种构造自动生成，并采用照片引导的关系对齐，无需人工标注。草图提示定位达91.4 F1（最强通用MLLM为81.8），同类别多实例场景优势翻倍，六任务40个评测单元中39个最优。
AI.motivation: 可提示感知范式（GroundingDINO 至 Rex-Omni）统一了定位任务的提示接口，但均针对照片训练，从未在草图上训练或使用草图。草图缺少颜色与纹理，与照片训练模型的注意力先验不匹配；同时不存在将一幅画与其所指的同类中某一具体实例配对的现成数据集。
AI.method: 不采集而构建训练数据：用边缘检测器将每张有标注照片转为保留原标签的草图；用两种构造从现有数据生成草图—照片实例对。方法上提出照片引导的关系对齐：同一模型分别处理照片及其边缘草图，训练草图通路复现照片通路中短语—图像块、图像块—图像块的关联关系。全程无人工标注。
AI.result: 草图提示定位 91.4 F1，对比最强通用 MLLM 的 81.8；当照片含多个同类实例时领先幅度翻倍；六个任务共40个评测单元中39个取得最优。
AI.conclusion: Sketch-Omni 将可提示感知扩展到草图模态，同时支持“在草图上”与“以草图为提示”的双向使用，证明了自动构造数据加跨模态关系对齐可替代人工标注，并发布代码、模型与含2754条草图—照片链接的人工标注基准。

title: One Assistant, Many Memories: Benchmarking Real-World Group Assistance When Recall Is Not Enough
summary: The value of memory lies not only in recall but in using it to provide appropriate assistance. Recent benchmarks test memory use in personalisation and agentic tasks, but seldom evaluate assistance without fixed answers or integration across multiple participants. Group chats make both challenges more acute: an assistant must integrate information from multiple members, track revisions and conflicts over time, and produce one response for the group. Yet existing group memory benchmarks rely on synthetic conversations and inherit constrained evaluation from general memory benchmarks, focusing on recall against fixed answers or decisions over a closed set. We introduce GroupAssistBench, the first memory benchmark from real-world group conversations with a deployed group assistant, covering 80,299 messages in 50 groups and costing over $53K. Over the same histories, GroupAssistBench evaluates memory recall (L1) with reference answers and memory use (L2) with service requests without fixed answers across single, distributed, and conflicting memories (M1--M3). Requests are verified to require group history, memories are anchored to their sources, and L2 uses tailored rubrics with penalties derived from real user feedback. Across evaluations of frontier models with full context, retrieval methods, and memory systems, the strongest memory system rivals full context on recall but falls far behind on use, especially for distributed and conflicting memories. Together, two additions that relate retrieved memories and bind remembered facts as response constraints bring consistent gains, showing that group memory systems must improve use, not recall alone.

AI.tldr: GroupAssistBench是首个基于真实群聊、配有已部署群聊助手场景的记忆基准，含50个群、80,299条消息（花费超5.3万美元），分L1记忆召回与L2记忆使用两层，并在单点、分散、冲突记忆（M1–M3）上评估；结果显示记忆系统在召回上可媲美全上下文，但在记忆使用上明显落后，尤其分散/冲突记忆场景。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆基准多在个性化与智能体任务上评测，很少评估"无固定答案的辅助"与"跨多参与者信息整合"；群聊场景更放大这两点：需整合多成员信息、跟踪时间上的修订与冲突、并给出面向群体的单一回复。而现有群聊记忆基准依赖合成对话，且沿用通用记忆基准的受限评测（固定答案召回或封闭集决策）。
AI.method: 构建GroupAssistBench：采用真实群聊历史（50群、80,299条消息）与已部署群聊助手，成本超5.3万美元。评测分两层：L1记忆召回（有参考答案）与L2记忆使用（无固定答案的服务请求），并覆盖M1单点、M2分散、M3冲突三类记忆。保证请求确需群聊历史、记忆锚定到来源，L2采用定制化评分量表，惩罚项源自真实用户反馈。对前沿模型的全上下文、检索方法、记忆系统进行对比。
AI.result: 最强的记忆系统在召回上可与全上下文相当，但在记忆使用上明显落后，分散与冲突记忆（M2/M3）差距尤大。此外，两项附加设计——关联检索到的记忆、将记住的事实绑定为回复约束——均带来稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: 群聊记忆系统的关键瓶颈在"用"而非"记"；需提升记忆使用的整合与约束能力，而非仅优化召回。GroupAssistBench为真实场景下的无固定答案辅助评测提供了基准。

title: AlgoPilot: Cross-Paradigm Reasoning in Language Models via Strategy Selection and Guidance
summary: Real-world problems span diverse domains, including program synthesis, symbolic reasoning, planning, and optimization, and often require fundamentally different solution paradigms. A central challenge for LLM-based reasoning is twofold: identifying an appropriate problem-solving approach and formulating it correctly. In this paper, we propose AlgoPilot, a cross-paradigm reasoning framework that enables adaptive selection of the solving approaches and structured problem formulation prior to execution. The AlgoPilot framework contains three components: 1) a SteerLM, trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), that adaptively selects the solving strategy (paradigm and modes) based on input problems, 2) the corresponding expert GuideLM, trained via SFT, that generates structured formulation guidance tailored to the selected strategy, and 3) an ExecutionLM that generates solutions conditioned on both the selected strategy and its formulation. Unlike prompting-based methods that rely on fixed reasoning templates, our approach learns to adaptively choose and structure problem-solving strategies based on the input. We build AlgoPilot on Qwen3-8B and evaluate across 5 problem categories and 13 benchmarks with 66 unique domains, comparing against both the latest similarly scaled small models and large LLMs. AlgoPilot significantly improves average accuracy for the same model from 38.4% to 72.9%, outperforming the best large LLM prompting baseline GLM-5 by 11.7%. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each component. Notably, we show that the learned steering and formulation modules can transfer across execution models, suggesting their potential to improve other LLMs. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/algopilot.

AI.tldr: AlgoPilot是一个跨范式推理框架，通过可学习的三模块（SteerLM选策略、GuideLM生成结构化建模指导、ExecutionLM求解）实现问题的自适应策略选择与结构化建模，将Qwen3-8B平均准确率由38.4%提升至72.9%。
AI.motivation: 真实问题横跨程序合成、符号推理、规划与优化等不同领域，需采用本质不同的求解范式。LLM推理的核心挑战有二：识别合适的问题求解方法，以及正确地形式化该问题。现有prompting方法依赖固定的推理模板，无法按输入自适应选择与组织策略。
AI.method: 框架含三组件：1）SteerLM，经SFT+RL训练，依据输入问题自适应选择求解策略（范式与模式）；2）GuideLM，对应各策略的专家模型，经SFT训练，生成与该策略匹配的结构化形式化指导；3）ExecutionLM，在给定所选策略及其形式化的条件下生成解。整体基于Qwen3-8B构建，与依赖固定模板的提示方法不同，该框架学习根据输入自适应选择并结构化求解策略。
AI.result: 在5类问题、13个基准、66个独特领域上评测，并与同量级小模型及大模型对比：同模型平均准确率从38.4%提升至72.9%，比最佳大模型提示基线GLM-5高11.7%。消融实验验证了各组件的有效性；此外，学到的引导与形式化模块可跨执行模型迁移，表明其有潜力提升其他LLM。
AI.conclusion: 将“策略选择—问题形式化—执行”解耦并以可学习模块实现，是提升LLM跨范式推理的有效途径，且引导与形式化模块具备跨执行模型的通用性与迁移价值。

title: TB-Transolver: Parallelized and Coherent Long-Horizon Rollouts via Temporal Bundling for Time-Dependent PDEs
summary: Transolver has recently gained widespread adoption for solving diverse physical problems on unstructured geometric meshes by leveraging its Physics-Attention mechanism, which seamlessly extends standard softmax attention to handle physical domains at scale. For time-dependent problems, existing literature relies on time-conditioned or autoregressive rollouts to preserve temporal causality while retaining Physics-Attention as the spatial backbone. However, a fundamental limitation of this formulation is its sequential execution model, wherein computational costs scale linearly with the temporal horizon, rendering standard Transolver inefficient for transient problems despite its exceptional spatial efficacy. This bottleneck has historically hindered its broader application in time-dependent physical modeling. To address this limitation, we introduce TB-Transolver (also referred to as Temporally Bundled Transolver), an efficient framework built on temporal bundling that scales Transolver for time-dependent PDEs. Furthermore, we propose \emph{spatiotemporal coherence} (${\rm C(K)}$) as a general metric to systematically quantify snapshot correlation within a temporal bundle, enabling the \emph{a priori} selection of optimal bundle widths using training data alone, thereby avoiding expensive grid searches. We demonstrate the computational efficacy of TB-Transolver across four physically distinct domains, namely, plasticity, fluid dynamics, reaction-diffusion, and global weather forecasting; achieving training speedups of up to $29\times$ over conventional autoregressive and time-conditioned baselines. Finally, these computational gains are further amplified through distributed multi-node and multi-GPU parallelism, yielding aggregated speedups of up to $45.6\times$ at optimal bundle widths for systems exhibiting high spatiotemporal coherence compared to single-GPU implementations.

AI.tldr: 提出 TB-Transolver，基于时间捆绑（temporal bundling）使 Transolver 高效求解瞬态 PDE，并提出时空相干性指标 C(K) 先验选取捆绑宽度，在四个物理领域实现最高 29× 训练加速、多节点多 GPU 下聚合加速达 45.6×。
AI.motivation: Transolver 的 Physics-Attention 在空间上高效，但处理时间依赖问题时依赖时间条件或自回归 rollout，计算成本随时间步线性增长，成为瞬态问题上的根本瓶颈，限制了其应用。
AI.method: 引入 temporal bundling 构建 TB-Transolver 框架，将多个时间步打包为快照束以并行预测；并定义时空相干性 C(K) 量化时间束内快照相关性，用训练数据先验确定最优捆绑宽度，避免网格搜索；结合分布式多节点/多 GPU 并行。
AI.result: 在塑性、流体动力学、反应扩散和全球天气预报四个物理领域验证，较自回归与时间条件基线最高 29× 训练加速；在最优捆绑宽度下，高时空相干性系统多 GPU 聚合加速最高达 45.6×（相对单 GPU）。
AI.conclusion: temporal bundling 可有效消除 Transolver 的顺序执行瓶颈；C(K) 提供了无需昂贵调参的捆绑宽度选取准则；加速收益随时空相干性提升而放大，并可随分布式并行进一步扩展。

title: Weight-Space Programming for Improving Image-Restoration Diffusion Models: Technical Conjectures and a Recursive Improvement Loop
comment: This manuscript is merely conjectural, intended to open a new subtopic within the field of image restoration
summary: Can an LLM directly edit the weights of a diffusion-based image-restoration model to \emph{improve} restoration quality---without gradients, paired data, or fine-tuning? Recent experiments show frontier LLMs can fix structural bugs by modifying as little as \(0.016\%\) of parameters, but cannot instill new capabilities. We ask whether weight-space programming (WSP) can move from \emph{debugging} to \emph{improvement} in the precise-regression setting of image restoration (deblurring, super-resolution, denoising, inpainting). Restoration diffusion UNets present a middle ground: low-level signal-processing layers are concentrated enough for targeted weight-direction edits, while high-level semantic layers remain distributed and resistant to sparse modification. We propose three technical conjectures: (C1) an LLM can localize the layer behind a quality gap (over-smoothing, color shift, hallucinated texture) within a 200 forward-pass budget; (C2) editing a small set of identified weight directions (e.g., scaling high-frequency filter norms, correcting output-bias channels) can measurably improve PSNR and perceptual quality; (C3) a recursive loop---diagnose \(\rightarrow\) edit \(\rightarrow\) evaluate \(\rightarrow\) re-diagnose---can compound gains across rounds, forming a minimal recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop for vision. We analyze the required AI capability (arguing targeted edits need not superintelligence, while general capability generation does) and detail the challenges of precise pixel-level regression. We provide a PyTorch-style deployment pipeline and outline a benchmark. This manuscript is conjectural, intended to open a new subtopic for image restoration.

AI.tldr: 该文（立场/猜想性稿件）探讨LLM能否在不使用梯度、配对数据和微调的情况下，直接编辑扩散式图像复原模型的权重以“提升”复原质量，即把权重空间编程（WSP）从“调试”推进到“改进”，并提出三项技术猜想、能力分析与部署管线及基准设想。
AI.motivation: 已有实验显示前沿LLM可通过修改约0.016%参数修复结构性bug，但无法注入新能力；作者希望在图像复原这一精确回归场景中检验WSP能否超越“调试”。选择复原扩散UNet作为中间地带：低层信号处理层足够集中，适合定向权重方向编辑，而高层语义层分布化、难以稀疏修改。
AI.method: 提出三项技术猜想：(C1) LLM可在200次前向预算内定位导致质量差距（过度平滑、色偏、幻觉纹理）的层；(C2) 编辑少量已识别的权重方向（如缩放高频滤波器范数、校正输出偏置通道）可显著提升PSNR与感知质量；(C3) 通过“诊断→编辑→评估→再诊断”的递归闭环跨轮累积增益，形成面向视觉的最小递归自我改进（RSI）回路。此外分析所需AI能力（定向编辑无需超智能，通用能力生成则需要），讨论像素级精确回归的挑战，给出PyTorch风格部署管线并勾勒基准。
AI.result: 本文为猜想性稿件，未报告实证结果；主要产出为猜想框架、能力需求论证、挑战分析、部署管线设计与基准提案。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张以图像复原为切入点开启WSP“改进”这一新子方向，并呼吁以基准与递归自改进回路来验证三项猜想。

title: TraceRouter++: Causal Semantic Routing Realignment via Optimal Transport
summary: Despite their remarkable capabilities, large foundation models (LFMs) remain susceptible to adversarial manipulation. Current safety intervention methods primarily rely on the \textit{locality hypothesis}, rigidly suppressing isolated neurons or features. However, harmful semantics manifest as distributed, cross-layer circuits, rendering localized ablations both brittle against complex jailbreaks and detrimental to general utility. To bridge this gap, we propose TraceRouter++, a routing-level safety intervention framework that explicitly traces safety-relevant causal routing pathways activated under harmful inputs and realigns their unsafe activation states. Our framework operates in a \textit{Discover-Trace-Realign} paradigm: it first pinpoints a sensitive onset layer via attention divergence and disentangles dense activations into interpretable routing features using sparse autoencoders (SAEs). Subsequently, it maps these features to downstream causal circuits via feature influence scores (FIS). Crucially, departing from rigid suppression paradigms, TraceRouter++ introduces a constrained optimal transport (OT)-based soft routing realignment. By formulating safety intervention as a tractable coordinate-wise marginal optimal transport approximation, our method redirects unsafe activation marginals toward safe-reference marginals within causally identified routing subspaces while preserving non-selected coordinates at the intervention point. This mechanism safely redirects malicious semantic flows while leaving orthogonal computational routes intact. Extensive experiments across representative large language models (LLMs), multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and diffusion models (DMs) show that TraceRouter++ outperforms evaluated baselines, improving adversarial robustness while maintaining a favorable safety-utility trade-off. WARNING: This paper contains unsafe model responses.

AI.tldr: TraceRouter++ 提出路由级安全干预框架，通过 Discover-Trace-Realign 范式定位并软重对齐有害输入激活的因果路由通路，兼顾对抗鲁棒性与模型效用。
AI.motivation: 现有安全干预方法基于"局部性假设"，僵硬抑制孤立神经元或特征；但有害语义表现为分布式、跨层回路，局部消融既对复杂越狱脆弱，又损害通用效用。
AI.method: 三阶段：1) Discover——利用注意力散度定位敏感起始层，并用稀疏自编码器(SAE)将稠密激活解耦为可解释路由特征；2) Trace——通过特征影响分数(FIS)将特征映射到下游因果回路；3) Realign——引入约束最优传输(OT)的软路由重对齐，将安全干预形式化为可处理的逐坐标边际最优传输近似，在因果识别的路由子空间内把不安全激活边际导向安全参考边际，同时保持干预点的非选中坐标不变。
AI.result: 在代表性 LLM、MLLM 与扩散模型上，TraceRouter++ 优于所评估基线，提升对抗鲁棒性的同时保持较优的安全-效用权衡。
AI.conclusion: 相对于刚性抑制范式，基于因果路由追踪的软重对齐可实现更精准、更少副作用的安全干预，并具跨模型类型（语言/多模态/生成）的通用性。

title: The Agent Board: Kanban for Machines; Durable Coordination for Agents That Outlive the Conversation
summary: Harnesses for large language models have converged on a single-threaded shape: one agent, one history, one machine, one sitting. That shape fails work that spans many agents, outlives any one model call, or waits on systems that are not agents. We describe the Agent Board, the coordination substrate in the Corvic harness. The board is a durable, shared table of semi-semantic tasks: a few exact fields the system routes on, and a free-form body that only language models read. Agents post tasks, watch tasks, and block on them, ending their turn and holding no process until a matching post wakes them. A system agent, the Board Keeper, acts as the interrupt handler for the board: it carries events from non-agent parts of the harness onto the board, matches them to waiting tasks by reading their prose, and allocates new agents for tasks that name a kind of agent rather than an instance. Loadable coordination policy kernels give statuses and roles meaning for a given pattern of work, without the board enforcing them. The design mirrors the kanban board a human team puts on a wall. We argue it is what persistent agent products such as Meta Muse, OpenAI dots and SpaceXAI Grok Bot need once an agent must wait, hand off work, or work with agents from another vendor. We view the board as an operating-system scheduler for agents and state where the analogy breaks. We separate what the mechanism guarantees from what it leaves to convention, and report a trace from a live board and three small simulated pilots. In the pilots, the wait cost of the board was flat in wait length while naive polling grew about 165-fold, but a plain external watcher was cheaper than the board. The Board Keeper matched prose waiters with no false wakes but missed 3.6 percent of real wakes.

AI.tldr: 提出 Corvic 框架中的 Agent Board——一种持久、共享的"半语义任务表"协调底座，用阻塞/唤醒机制替代单线程 agent 循环，支持多 agent、跨模型调用、跨厂商的长期协作。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM harness 普遍是单线程形态（一个 agent、一条历史、一台机器、一次会话），无法支撑跨多 agent、超出单次模型调用寿命、或需等待非 agent 系统的工作。持久化 agent 产品在遇到等待、交接、跨厂商协作时缺少合适的协调原语。
AI.method: Agent Board 是持久共享任务表：少量用于路由的精确字段 + 仅供 LLM 阅读的自由文本体。Agent 可发布任务、监视任务、阻塞等待（结束当前轮次、不占进程，直到匹配的发布将其唤醒）。Board Keeper 作为中断处理器，把非 agent 组件的事件搬运到板上，通过阅读 prose 匹配等待任务，并为"仅指名 agent 类型"的任务分配新 agent。可加载的协调策略内核为状态与角色赋予语义，但板本身不强制。设计类比人类团队的看板墙，并将该板视为 agent 的操作系统调度器，同时指出类比失效之处。
AI.result: 明确区分机制保证与约定依赖；给出真实板 trace 与三个小型仿真试验。试验中：板的等待开销随等待时长保持平坦，而朴素轮询增长约 165 倍；但普通外部 watcher 比板更便宜。Board Keeper 匹配 prose 等待者时无误唤醒，但漏掉 3.6% 的真实唤醒。
AI.conclusion: Agent Board 为持久化、多 agent 协作提供了可行的协调基底，显著优于朴素轮询的等待成本，但并非在所有场景最优（外部 watcher 开销更低），且语义匹配存在漏唤醒风险，需依赖约定与策略内核补足。

title: Graph-Localized Coverage for Conformal Prediction on Inductive Graphs
summary: Conformal prediction (CP) provides marginal coverage guarantees, but marginal coverage does not determine where prediction errors occur on a graph. Queries from different graph neighborhoods can exhibit substantially different levels of uncertainty even when aggregate coverage remains near its target. We introduce GLocalCP, an online CP framework for inductive node classification and edge prediction that combines marginal and graph-local calibration with uncertainty-adaptive prediction sets. Specifically, GLocalCP puts forth a novel uncertainty-adaptive nonconformality score that relies on the mutual information obtained from Monte-Carlo (MC) dropout based prediction. Then, it augments a global online threshold with a kernel-based local correction that propagates coverage feedback among similar graph queries. On the theoretical horizon, we establish pathwise $O(N^{-1/2})$ marginal calibration error without exchangeability or stationarity and, for the exact-kernel formulation, an explicit $O(N^{-1/2})$ graph-localized calibration guarantee. Experiments on seven node-classification and seven edge-prediction benchmarks show that similar marginal coverage can conceal substantially different local reliability. Our proposed GLocalCP maintains coverage near the target while consistently reducing graph-local calibration error. Uncertainty scaling in GLocalCP further reduces prediction-set size across all evaluated node and edge datasets while leaving marginal coverage essentially unchanged.

AI.tldr: GLocalCP：面向归纳式节点分类与边预测的在线共形预测框架，结合边际与图局部校准，并采用基于互信息的不确定性自适应非共形分数，在保持目标边际覆盖率的同时降低图局部校准误差与预测集规模。
AI.motivation: 边际覆盖率无法刻画预测误差在图上的分布，不同图邻域的查询不确定性差异显著，即使总体覆盖率接近目标，局部可靠性仍可能严重不足，故需同时兼顾图局部校准的在线CP方法。
AI.method: 提出不确定性自适应非共形分数，基于MC dropout预测得到的互信息构造；以全局在线阈值叠加核函数局部修正，在相似图查询间传播覆盖率反馈；理论分析给出无需可交换性/平稳性的路径式O(N^{-1/2})边际校准误差，以及精确核形式下显式O(N^{-1/2})图局部校准保证。
AI.result: 在7个节点分类与7个边预测基准上，相似的边际覆盖率确实掩盖了差异显著的局部可靠性；GLocalCP维持覆盖率接近目标并持续降低图局部校准误差；不确定性缩放进一步在全部数据集上减小预测集规模且基本不改变边际覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: GLocalCP表明在线共形预测需引入图局部校准反馈，配合不确定性自适应的集合构造，可同时提升局部可靠性与预测效率。

title: GroundSeek-CXR: Retrospective Evaluation-Guided Active Observation Framework for Multi-Label Chest Radiography Diagnosis
summary: Chest radiography (CXR) diagnosis is critical for thoracic disease assessment, yet challenged by the need to identify subtle lesions and co-occurring abnormalities across regions. While recent vision-language models can actively observe local regions, existing preference-based methods supervise each observation by its immediate effect on the current diagnosis, failing to capture how each observation and stopping decision contributes to the final diagnosis. To address this issue, we propose GroundSeek-CXR, an active CXR diagnosis framework that learns observation and stopping decisions by retrospectively evaluating them with the final diagnosis. Specifically, we first devise a Retrospective Diagnostic Evaluation (RDE) that scores observation and stop candidates from offline Monte Carlo tree search through independent continuations. Moreover, we design a Retrospective Gap-weighted Preference Optimization (RGPO) that learns from retrospective-score preferences weighted by their score gaps, prioritizing actions that improve diagnostic accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our GroundSeek-CXR framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and improves abnormal-image sample-F1 by 4.48% over immediate-score preference learning.
