AI.tldr: GroundSeek-CXR 是一个主动式胸片诊断框架，通过以最终诊断为依据回溯性评估“观察”与“停止”决策，并用回溯得分加权的偏好优化进行学习，超越现有方法并将异常图像样本F1提升 4.48%。
AI.motivation: 胸片诊断需识别跨区域的细微病灶与共发病变；现有偏好类方法对每次观察仅以其对当前诊断的即时影响进行监督，无法刻画该观察及停止决策对最终诊断的贡献。
AI.method: 1) Retrospective Diagnostic Evaluation (RDE)：借助离线蒙特卡洛树搜索，通过独立续接（continuation）为观察与停止候选打分；2) Retrospective Gap-weighted Preference Optimization (RGPO)：基于回溯得分之间的差距对偏好进行加权，优先学习能提升诊断准确性的动作。
AI.result: 大量实验显示 GroundSeek-CXR 优于当前最优方法，异常图像样本F1较即时得分偏好学习提升 4.48%。
AI.conclusion: 以最终诊断作为回报、回溯性评估中间观察与停止决策，并结合得分差加权偏好优化，可有效提升主动式胸片诊断的准确性。

title: PROSE: Preservation-Constrained Selective Editing for Guilty Bias in Legal Judgment Prediction
summary: Legal judgment prediction models may retain a guilty verdict after a legally decisive condition has been altered such that the specified charge is no longer established. We study this guilty bias via selective repair over matched charge-established and charge-not-established cases, where the unsupported verdict should change while its supported counterpart remains stable. We construct CAIL-MC, a legally reviewed dataset of 11,478 matched pairs covering 261 Chinese criminal charges. Held-out activation interventions show that contrasts learned from correctly resolved pairs transfer to false-guilty cases, but target-reaching interventions can also damage matched supported-guilty decisions. Motivated by this observation, we introduce PROSE, which reconstructs case-specific targets from a training-derived residual geometry, aligns them with a local margin-descent signal, attenuates supported-guilty-sensitive components, and realizes bounded targets through a preservation-regularized low-rank parameter update. Across Qwen3-8B and GLM4-9B, PROSE achieves stronger pairwise safe repair and evidence sensitivity, while preserving standard single-pass inference.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CAIL-MC配对数据集揭示法律判决预测模型的"有罪偏置"，并提出PROSE方法实现安全的选择性修复。
AI.motivation: 法律判决预测模型在案件的关键法律构成要件被改至罪名不成立后，仍可能保留有罪判决（有罪偏置）。理想的选择性修复应在"罪名成立/不成立"配对案件中改变无依据判决、同时保持有依据判决稳定。
AI.method: 构建经法律审阅的CAIL-MC数据集（11,478对配对样本，覆盖261个中国刑法罪名）；通过留出集激活干预分析发现，从正确判别配对中学到的对比可迁移至假有罪案件，但目标触达式干预会损害配对的有支撑有罪判决。据此提出PROSE：由训练导出的残差几何重建案件特定目标，与局部间隔下降信号对齐，衰减对有支撑有罪判决敏感的组件，并通过保真正则化的低秩参数更新实现有界目标。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B与GLM4-9B上，PROSE取得更强的成对安全修复与证据敏感性，同时保留标准单次推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 选择性修复存在"修复假有罪"与"保持真有罪"之间的张力，PROSE通过残差几何目标重建与保真正则化低秩更新在二者间取得平衡，为法律判决预测的可靠性提供了可行方案。

title: Structured Clinical Memory as Context for Probabilistic Decision Models: A Synthetic Evaluation with Jev
summary: Longitudinal clinical context is often distributed across noisy, repetitive forms and narrative records. We study whether a compact structured memory can improve a probabilistic decision model's answers when the underlying patient vignette is already available. We created 30 fully synthetic cases spanning twelve clinical domains, paired each with synthetically generated structured memory, and evaluated 120 typed questions with Jev. The raw-vignette arm achieved 90.0% accuracy (95% normal-approximation confidence interval: 84.6%-95.4%); adding memory achieved 93.3% (88.9%-97.8%). Five questions changed from incorrect to correct and one changed in the opposite direction (exact McNemar $p=0.219$). Choice log loss decreased from 0.258 to 0.175 and binary Brier score from 0.054 to 0.022. Memory added 310 input tokens per call on average, while observed mean latency was unchanged at approximately 0.5 seconds. These results are directionally positive rather than clinically validating: the cases are synthetic, the labels are single-author judgments, and the memory is an oracle upper bound rather than extracted production output. The pilot supports evaluating structured clinical memory as a reusable state interface for decision models.

AI.tldr: 在已提供原始病历的前提下，本文检验紧凑结构化记忆能否提升概率决策模型的答题表现。30 个合成病例、120 道题型化问题的试点显示：加入记忆后准确率由 90.0% 升至 93.3%（McNemar p=0.219），对数损失由 0.258 降至 0.175，Brier 由 0.054 降至 0.022，延迟基本不变，但结果仅为方向性正向而非临床验证。
AI.motivation: 纵向临床信息常分散于含噪、重复的表格与叙述性记录中，模型需在冗长上下文中反复定位关键状态。作者希望验证：当原始病历（vignette）已完整可用时，额外引入一份紧凑的结构化记忆是否仍能改善概率决策模型的输出质量与校准，并考察其作为可复用"状态接口"的可行性。
AI.method: 构建 30 个完全合成病例，覆盖 12 个临床领域；为每个病例配以合成生成的结构化记忆；设计 120 道带类型标注的问题，使用 Jev 进行对照评测，比较 raw-vignette 组与 raw-vignette+memory 组。统计上采用准确率及正态近似 95% 置信区间、精确 McNemar 检验、choice log loss 与二元 Brier 分数，并记录平均输入 token 增量与观测延迟。
AI.result: raw-vignette 臂准确率 90.0%（95% CI 84.6%–95.4%），加记忆后 93.3%（88.9%–97.8%）；5 题由错转对、1 题反向（精确 McNemar p=0.219，不显著）。校准指标明显改善：choice log loss 0.258→0.175，二元 Brier 0.054→0.022。平均每次调用增加约 310 输入 token，观测平均延迟维持约 0.5 秒基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 结果为方向性正向而非临床有效性证据：病例为合成数据，标签为单一作者判断，记忆为 oracle 上界而非生产环境抽取的输出。试点支持将结构化临床记忆作为决策模型可复用状态接口这一评估方向。

title: Finite-Sample Convergence in Networked Average Reward MARL: Decentralization Pitfalls and Entropy Remedies
summary: We study the problem of average reward Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) where agents interact within a network. Each agent in the network conducts local updates with information within its $k$-hop neighborhood and collaboratively maximizes the overall reward of the entire network. We first provide impossibility results in achieving convergence to the global optimal joint policies in our setting. These impossibility results highlight the challenges of decentralized learning with local information in multi-agent systems, namely the issues of multiagency, where each agent independently optimizes its policy, and partial observability, where agents have limited visibility into the global state. Given these challenges which indicate that decentralized policy optimization can generally be certified only up to stationarity, we provide finite-sample convergence guarantees for a decentralized actor-critic algorithm with linear function approximation that converges to an approximate stationary point with small gradient norm. To overcome such impossibility results, we further show that adding fixed-state entropy regularization reshapes the objective landscape which leads to even stronger global convergence guarantees for our proposed actor-critic algorithm.

AI.tldr: 研究网络化智能体在k-hop邻域信息下进行平均奖励MARL的问题，证明去中心化学习一般无法收敛到全局最优联合策略，提出线性函数近似的去中心化actor-critic算法并给出收敛到近似稳定点的有限样本保证，进一步证明固定状态熵正则可重塑目标景观从而实现更强的全局收敛。
AI.motivation: 网络化多智能体系统中每个智能体仅能利用k-hop邻域信息做局部更新并协作最大化全网平均奖励，但多主体各自独立优化与部分可观测性使去中心化策略优化面临根本性困难，作者希望刻画这些困难的理论边界并给出可达的收敛保证。
AI.method: 首先给出不可能性结果，说明在该设定下收敛到全局最优联合策略不可实现；随后针对去中心化actor-critic算法（采用线性函数近似），在仅能保证稳定性的前提下给出收敛到小梯度范数近似稳定点的有限样本收敛保证；并引入固定状态熵正则项重塑目标函数景观。
AI.result: 得到不可能性结论：多主体独立优化与部分可观测性导致去中心化策略优化一般只能被认证到稳定性；所提去中心化actor-critic算法可在有限样本下收敛到近似稳定点；加入固定状态熵正则后可获得更强的全局收敛保证。
AI.conclusion: 网络化平均奖励MARL中，仅靠k-hop局部信息的去中心化优化在一般情况下无法达到全局最优，稳定性是可证明的上界；固定状态熵正则可以改变优化景观，从而突破该限制并获得全局收敛性。

title: CLOCs-R: Radar-Assisted Camera-LiDAR Fusion for Long-Range Object Detection
summary: Long-range 3D object detection remains difficult for autonomous vehicles because LiDAR returns become sparse and camera evidence weakens with distance, while automotive radar keeps returning measurements far beyond both. We present CLOCs-R, an extension of the CLOCs candidate-level fusion framework that adds radar evidence to camera-LiDAR rescoring. Radar returns are accumulated over several sweeps, compensated for ego-motion, and associated with each pre-NMS 3D candidate through a range-dependent gate. Compact features summarizing support, Doppler speed and spread, range residual, and offset are then appended to every camera-LiDAR pair before a lightweight fusion network rescores the candidates. We first verify that our fusion implementation reproduces CLOCs on KITTI. We then evaluate on the daytime clear-weather subset of the aiMotive dataset, reporting distance-binned metrics out to 200 m with frozen SECOND and Cascade R-CNN detectors. Camera-LiDAR CLOCs improves on SECOND up to 50 m but degrades beyond it. A residual scoring variant, introduced post hoc, corrects SECOND's score instead of replacing it and recovers most of this loss. Radar consistently improves BEV AP at 30-50 m (0.857 to 0.870), but beyond 50 m its gain is small (+0.003 center-distance AP), within seed variation, and CLOCs-R with residual scoring is statistically tied with LiDAR-only SECOND. Our analysis attributes the limited long-range benefit to weak separation of true and false detections by radar features, scarce far-range training positives, poor camera evidence at distance, and missing LiDAR proposals that rescoring cannot recover. We report all as-designed and post hoc results side by side.

AI.tldr: 提出CLOCs-R，在CLOCs候选级融合中加入雷达证据对相机-激光雷达候选重打分，检验远距离3D检测增益；雷达仅在30-50 m提升明显，远距离收益有限，与LiDAR-only SECOND统计持平。
AI.motivation: 远距离3D检测难点在于LiDAR点云随距离稀疏、图像证据随距离衰减，而车载雷达在更远距离仍能返回量测；作者希望在CLOCs候选级融合框架中引入雷达信息以改善远距离检测。
AI.method: CLOCs-R：多帧雷达回波累积并做自车运动补偿，通过距离相关门控与每个pre-NMS 3D候选关联；提取支撑度、Doppler速度及其离散度、距离残差、偏移等紧凑特征，附加到每个相机-激光雷达候选对上，由轻量融合网络重打分。先在KITTI上验证复现CLOCs，再在aiMotive白天晴好子集上以冻结的SECOND与Cascade R-CNN检测器评测，按距离分箱至200 m；并事后引入残差打分变体（修正而非替换SECOND分数）。
AI.result: 相机-激光雷达CLOCs在50 m内优于SECOND、更远处退化；残差打分变体挽回大部分损失。雷达在30-50 m稳定提升BEV AP（0.857→0.870），50 m外增益极小（+0.003 center-distance AP），处于随机种子波动范围内；CLOCs-R（残差打分）与LiDAR-only SECOND统计持平。
AI.conclusion: 雷达对远距离增益受限的原因包括：雷达特征对真伪检测区分度弱、远距离正样本稀少、远处相机证据弱、以及LiDAR缺失的候选无法通过重打分恢复。作者同时并列报告设计与事后结果，结论偏审慎/负面。

title: Residual Attribute Leakage Is an Interface: Auditing Privacy Evaluation After Text De-identification
summary: A privacy evaluation of de-identified text asks a language model (the adversary) to guess a person's protected attribute. We introduce a prior-normalised clipped leakage score of its confidence gain on the true value and audit the conclusions drawn from it. Each verdict depends on an evaluation interface (the queried person, answer options, prior, adversary model and scoring rule), which we vary on fixed releases of three corpora. In a stress test, an editor that writes the opposite-sex form at the same spans a redaction editor would redact misleads the adversary about most people, yet ranks first among editors scored on the same MedQA entries under this score, as under attack accuracy and proper scoring rules read as privacy. A relabelling-invariant reading of AUC ranks that editor sixth of eight, and a rule-aware adversary recovers the attribute from the same text. On ordinary releases most verdict changes are gains or losses of separability; of six choices varied over all pairs, only the adversary reverses comparisons (5 of its 124 changes), and the query can target the wrong person. SACC, a traceable editor we build as the instrument, lets us ablate two editing principles and show where its advantage does not hold.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种"先验归一化裁剪泄露分数"，并系统审计去标识化文本隐私评估结论的稳健性：结论高度依赖评估接口选择，本文构建可追溯编辑器SACC作为分析工具。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私评估用语言模型作为对手猜测受保护属性，并据此对去标识化/编辑方法排名，但这些"判决"隐含依赖评估接口（查询对象、选项、先验、对手模型、评分规则），其稳健性缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 定义基于真实值置信度增益的先验归一化裁剪泄露分数；在三个语料固定发布版本上改变评估接口（人、选项、先验、对手模型、评分规则）并检验排名变化；设计压力测试（同一跨度写入异性形式的"反向编辑"）比较不同评分规则与AUC的重排不变读法；构建可追溯编辑器SACC作为实验仪器，做两项编辑原则的消融。
AI.result: 压力测试中误导对手的反向编辑器在MedQA条目上按泄露分数、攻击准确率及被当作隐私的proper scoring rules均排名第一，而重排不变的AUC读法仅列第八中第六，规则感知对手仍可恢复属性。常规发布上多数判决变化源于可分性增减；六个选项中仅对手模型反转比较（124次变化中5次），且查询可能指向错误的人。SACC消融揭示其优势不成立的场景。
AI.conclusion: 单一致信度分数给出的隐私判决不稳健，需报告接口敏感性与重排不变指标；SACC及消融提供可追溯、可诊断的评估范式。

title: The Evolution Strategies Paradox: Better Models from Worse Perturbations
summary: How is it possible for perturbation-based methods like Evolution Strategies (ES) to optimize billion-parameter large language models (LLMs)? Classical search methods are highly dependent on finding good candidates within generated populations. However, when using ES to fine-tune LLMs, a phenomenon can occur where all offspring models consistently perform worse than the parent model, yet during training, the parent model consistently improves. This paradox occurs across models, tasks, and even modalities. This paper characterizes the paradox, then examines how the local reward landscape and properties of the ES estimator contribute to it: in high-dimensional spaces, exploration leads to worse performance, yet still highlights good directions; aggregating those directions then allows for making local improvements. The result can be seen as a new optimization paradigm where a principled interaction of noise and curvature produces the paradox as a byproduct of effective optimization. These findings provide guidance for taking advantage of perturbation-based methods in LLM fine-tuning and in high-dimensional optimization in general.

AI.tldr: 该论文刻画了用演化策略(ES)微调大语言模型时出现的“所有子代模型持续劣于父代、但父代在训练中持续提升”的悖论，并从局部奖励景观与ES估计器性质两方面给出解释。
AI.motivation: 经典搜索方法依赖在生成种群中找到优质候选，而ES微调LLM时却出现子代普遍变差、父代却持续变好的反直觉现象，这一悖论跨模型、任务乃至模态普遍存在，亟需理解其机制以更好利用扰动类优化方法。
AI.method: 先刻画该悖论现象；再分析局部奖励景观与ES估计器性质的作用机制：在高维空间中，探索导致性能下降，但仍能指示出好的方向；对这些方向进行聚合即可实现局部改进。
AI.result: 提出一种新的优化范式解释：噪声与曲率的原理性交互使悖论作为有效优化的副产物自然产生；即高维探索虽降低单点表现，却通过方向聚合带来实际提升。
AI.conclusion: 为在LLM微调及一般高维优化中发挥扰动类方法的优势提供指导。

title: Computer-Use Agents Gain Little Benefit from a World Model When Conditioned on Tutorials
summary: Recent work has improved computer-use agents (CUAs) by combining retrieved task-relevant tutorials and look-ahead planning using world models with MLLM judges. However, the contribution of each component -- tutorials, the judge, and the world model -- to overall improvement has not been evaluated in isolation. To fill this gap, we first construct OSWorld-Tutorial and ScienceBoard-Tutorial: two datasets for CUAs with curated multimodal tutorials, covering everyday and scientific domains. We then propose RAG-PolicyJudge (RAG-PJ), a policy-judge framework for CUAs conditioned on task-specific tutorials: the policy proposes candidate actions, and the judge selects among them. To isolate the effect of world models given tutorials, we compare RAG-PJ with and without common world models: using either zero-shot text-based descriptions of next states or an oracle that returns ground-truth visual observations. We find that RAG-PJ gains little benefit from these rollouts when tutorials are present, even with perfect visual futures. This suggests prior world-model gains in tutorial-conditioned methods come mainly from tutorial understanding and the judge's ability to select the proposed actions, rather than from predicted rollouts. Error analysis reveals that the bottleneck is not rollout fidelity, but the judge's ability to reason over future states and recognize task completion. This highlights the need to improve not just next-state prediction in world models, but also reasoning over their predicted rollouts. Datasets and code are available at https://github.com/realjoenguyen/RAGPJ-official.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了OSWorld-Tutorial与ScienceBoard-Tutorial两个带多模态教程的CUA数据集，提出RAG-PolicyJudge（RAG-PJ）策略-评判框架，并通过消融实验表明：在教程存在时，世界模型rollout（即使使用真值视觉观测）带来的增益很小；性能提升主要来自教程理解与judge的动作选择能力。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体（CUA）结合检索到的任务教程、世界模型前向推演与MLLM judge取得进展，但各组件（教程、judge、世界模型）的独立贡献未被分别评估，存在归因不清的问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建OSWorld-Tutorial与ScienceBoard-Tutorial，覆盖日常与科学领域的精选多模态教程；2) 提出RAG-PJ：以任务特定教程为条件的policy-judge框架，policy生成候选动作，judge从中选择；3) 控制变量对比世界模型：无rollout、零样本文本式下一状态描述、返回真值视觉观测的oracle。
AI.result: 在教程存在的情况下，RAG-PJ从各类rollout中获益甚微，即便使用完美视觉未来（oracle）也如此。误差分析显示瓶颈不在rollout保真度，而在judge对未来状态的推理与任务完成判定能力。
AI.conclusion: 此前教程条件下世界模型方法报告的增益主要源于教程理解与judge对候选动作的选择，而非预测rollout。未来不应只改进世界模型的下一状态预测，还需提升judge对预测rollout的推理能力。

title: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
summary: In-image machine translation (IIMT) replaces text in an image with its translation while preserving the surrounding visual context. Existing task-specific models achieve convincing performance but require massive paired training images before and after translation. As advanced text-to-image (T2I) models have reached a practically usable level of multilingual text generation, we argue that this capability can be transferred to IIMT and present FlowTranslator. It is a training-free IIMT framework that first employs an OCR model and an LLM to generate the translation prompt, which is injected into the T2I-based diffusion model. To optimize the accurate and natural generation of translated text, we introduce two trajectory controls: Region Coupling Release (RCR) partially decorrelates target-branch noise inside the text region early in the trajectory, while Coupling Expansion (CE) amplifies the emerging edit displacement mid-trajectory. Under the EasyOCR read-back protocol, FlowTranslator achieves average PRIM BLEU and COMET scores of 20.6 and 57.2, respectively, substantially outperforming the strong training-based baseline UniTranslator. On the more challenging and realistic whole-image ScenePair photographs translated into Chinese, it reaches 40.1\% exact-match accuracy and surpasses existing editing systems, some of which only address the text-rendering stage rather than the complete IIMT task. These results establish flow-based editing as a strong, fully training-free baseline for IIMT.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的图像内机器翻译框架FlowTranslator，借助多语言T2I生成能力，通过两种轨迹控制实现准确的译文字形生成，无需成对训练图片。
AI.motivation: 现有IIMT任务专用模型虽效果好，但依赖大量翻译前后的成对训练图像；而先进T2I模型已具备可用的多语言文本生成能力，可将该能力迁移至IIMT以摆脱训练数据依赖。
AI.method: 免训练框架：先用OCR模型与LLM生成翻译提示词，注入基于T2I的扩散模型；并引入两种轨迹控制——区域耦合释放（RCR）在轨迹早期部分解耦文本区域内的目标分支噪声，耦合扩展（CE）在轨迹中段放大新出现的编辑位移。
AI.result: 在EasyOCR回读协议下，PRIM上BLEU 20.6、COMET 57.2，显著优于强训练基线UniTranslator；在更具挑战性的真实整图ScenePair照片译中文场景中达到40.1%的精确匹配准确率，超过现有编辑系统（部分系统仅处理文本渲染阶段）。
AI.conclusion: 流式（flow-based）编辑可作为IIMT的强效、完全免训练基线。

title: HERIT: Enabling Global Access to Hanja-to-English Historical Translation by Mitigating Temporal Bias
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables
summary: Historical archives are invaluable for multidisciplinary research but remain inaccessible globally due to severe language barriers. While manual translation is prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, simply applying existing machine translation models is inadequate due to unique linguistic nuances and the temporal bias inherent in scarce human-labeled corpora. To address these challenges, we propose HERIT, a systematic domain-adaptation pipeline that leverages retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to generate high-quality pseudo-labeled data from abundant Hanja-Korean corpora. This approach substantially expands the training dataset, mitigating both data scarcity and temporal overfitting across different historical periods. Extensive automated and human evaluations demonstrate that HERIT consistently outperforms baselines. Finally, we translate previously untranslated portions of the archives using our model, thereby enabling global access to these resources for researchers.

AI.tldr: HERIT：基于RAG生成伪标注数据的系统性领域自适应流程，用于历史档案（汉韩）翻译，缓解数据稀缺与时间偏差，性能优于基线并完成未译档案的翻译。
AI.motivation: 历史档案对跨学科研究价值极高，但全球范围内因严重语言障碍而难以访问；人工翻译成本高、耗时长，而直接套用现有机器翻译模型效果不佳，原因在于独特的语言细微差异以及稀缺人工标注语料带来的时间偏差（对特定历史时期的过拟合）。
AI.method: 提出HERIT——一套系统性的领域自适应流程：利用检索增强生成（RAG）从丰富的汉韩（Hanja-Korean）语料中生成高质量伪标注数据，从而显著扩充训练集。
AI.result: 大量自动化评估与人工评估表明，HERIT在性能上持续优于各基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该方法同时缓解数据稀缺与跨历史时期的时间过拟合问题；作者进一步用该模型翻译了档案中此前未被翻译的部分，使全球研究者得以访问这些资源。

title: GlucoAgent: Personalized Glucose Forecasting from Multimodal Personal Context
summary: Continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, meal logs, and health profiles form a rich multimodal personal context that can significantly enhance glucose forecasting. However, existing methods struggle to effectively utilize these signals to improve glucose prediction because the relevance of different modalities varies drastically across individuals and time. We present GlucoAgent, an LLM-based agentic system that addresses this challenge through dynamic, case-by-case analysis at inference time. For each forecast, GlucoAgent writes and runs code over an individual's multimodal context and returns predictions with a reason and supporting evidence. The generated programs are highly diverse, ranging from retrieving similar past meals to fitting and back-testing physiological and statistical models. On CGMacros, a multimodal glucose dataset, GlucoAgent outperforms time series foundation models on every forecasting horizon, achieving an average RMSE of 22.5 mg/dL compared to 23.5 mg/dL of Chronos-2, the leading multimodal time series foundation model. Furthermore, GlucoAgent is highly effective at leveraging multimodal data. The addition of multimodal data reduces its average RMSE by 1.4 mg/dL (24.0 mg/dL to 22.5 mg/dL), compared to a marginal 0.3 mg/dL (23.8 mg/dL to 23.5 mg/dL) improvement for Chronos-2. This advantage is most pronounced in challenging post-meal windows, where GlucoAgent uses multimodal context to reduce 60-minute forecast RMSE by 4.6 mg/dL (31.0 mg/dL to 26.5 mg/dL), far exceeding the 0.8 mg/dL (31.9 mg/dL to 31.1 mg/dL) reduction achieved by Chronos-2.

AI.tldr: GlucoAgent：基于LLM智能体系统，在推理时针对每个预测动态编写并执行代码，利用个体多模态上下文提升血糖预测，在各预测时域上超过Chronos-2等时序基础模型。
AI.motivation: 连续血糖监测仪、智能手表、饮食日志与健康档案构成丰富的多模态个人上下文，可显著增强血糖预测。但不同模态在不同个体与时间点上的相关性差异极大，现有方法难以有效利用这些信号。
AI.method: 提出GlucoAgent，一个LLM驱动的智能体系统，通过推理时逐案动态分析应对上述挑战：对每次预测，在其多模态上下文中编写并运行代码，输出预测值及理由和支持证据。生成程序高度多样，从检索相似历史餐食到拟合与回测生理学、统计模型。
AI.result: 在CGMacros多模态血糖数据集上，GlucoAgent在每个预测时域均优于时序基础模型，平均RMSE为22.5 mg/dL，优于Chronos-2的23.5 mg/dL；加入多模态数据使其RMSE降低1.4 mg/dL（24.0→22.5），而Chronos-2仅提升0.3 mg/dL（23.8→23.5）。优势在餐后窗口最显著：60分钟预测RMSE降低4.6 mg/dL（31.0→26.5），远超Chronos-2的0.8 mg/dL（31.9→31.1）。
AI.conclusion: 推理时动态、可编程的LLM智能体范式能有效挖掘个体化多模态上下文，尤其在挑战性餐后时段的血糖预测中展现出显著优势。

title: RAPID: Increasing Efficiency of Internal Distillation via Randomized Methods
summary: Knowledge distillation is a technique used to transfer the expertise of large teacher models into small, efficient student models. Recent advances have integrated the distillation of internal activations, more directly training students to learn similar representations as the teacher. One of the core challenges of internal distillation is the dimensional incompatibility between the student and teacher internal representations. Existing methods add learnable matrices to project the larger teacher activations into the smaller representation space of the student. This is a notable point of inefficiency, as learning additional parameters for the projectors increases training costs, only for them to be discarded immediately after training. We introduce RAPID (RAndomized Projection for Internal Distillation) a novel distillation methodology which eliminates the wasteful projection learning by leveraging randomized methods. RAPID utilizes an efficient transform construction based on the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma to compress the teacher representations into the student embedding space with strong theoretical guarantees of structural preservation. RAPID also employs a combination of exponential moving average (EMA) and homoscedastic uncertainty weighting in a novel multi-objective function designed for internal distillation. Our experiments in post-training for reasoning demonstrate that RAPID increases training efficiency by as much as 21.1% while maintaining performance comparable to existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 RAPID 方法，用基于 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 引理的随机投影替代可学习投影矩阵，实现教师到学生的内部表征蒸馏，避免投影参数的冗余训练开销，并结合 EMA 与同方差不确定性加权的多目标损失，在推理任务后训练中提升训练效率最高 21.1% 且性能与原方法相当。
AI.motivation: 内部激活蒸馏的核心难点是师生表征维度不兼容。现有做法引入可学习投影矩阵将教师高维激活映射到学生低维空间，但这些投影参数需要额外训练成本，且训练后即被丢弃，属于显著的低效设计。
AI.method: RAPID 构造基于 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 引理的高效随机变换，将教师表征压缩到学生嵌入空间，具备结构保持的理论保证；同时采用指数移动平均（EMA）与同方差不确定性加权相结合，设计面向内部蒸馏的多目标函数。
AI.result: 在推理任务的后训练实验中，RAPID 将训练效率最高提升 21.1%，同时保持与现有方法相当的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 随机投影可有效替代可学习投影用于内部蒸馏，在保持表征结构的前提下消除投影学习的浪费性开销，是一种更高效的内部激活蒸馏方案。

title: Weather Adaptive Autonomous Driving
summary: Camera object detectors lose recall in rain, fog, snow and sand, and the confidence threshold at which a detector is deployed decides how many objects it misses and how many false alarms it raises. We study how a frozen detector should make this decision in adverse weather. We first reproduce SeqCRC, a conformal object detector whose first step calibrates the confidence threshold by conformal risk control (CRC), and use that step, calibrated separately in each weather condition, as our baseline. With YOLOv8x it keeps the held-out miss fraction within a 20% budget in every DAWN weather bin, where a single global threshold fails in fog, but the false alarms it needs are an output rather than a choice: from 1.6 to 117 per image across DAWN and BDD100K conditions. We then propose a calibrated trade-off dial. One setting, $λ$, the number of false alarms accepted to avoid one missed object, selects the expected-cost-optimal decision rule: either one score threshold, or a per-detection rule that keeps a box when its calibrated probability of being a real object, estimated by gradient-boosted trees from the detector's own per-box outputs, is at least $1/(1+λ)$. F-score preferences map onto the same dial, and CRC applied to $λ$ itself is planned to restore a per-condition miss guarantee. The dial is fitted once on BDD100K train and graded only on BDD100K val and DAWN.

AI.tldr: 研究冻结检测器在恶劣天气下如何做置信度决策：以SeqCRC为基线复现后，提出用λ（容忍误报换漏检的比率）作为"校准权衡旋钮"选择期望代价最优判定规则，可统一映射F-score偏好。
AI.motivation: 相机检测器在雨、雾、雪、沙尘中召回下降，而部署置信度阈值同时决定漏检与误报。现有做法（如SeqCRC按天气分别做共形风险控制CRC校准）虽能把漏检控制在预算内，但所需的误报数量是"输出"而非"可选"，不同条件下从1.6到117每图不等，缺乏可调的权衡机制。
AI.method: 1）复现SeqCRC：第一步用CRC校准置信度阈值，按天气条件分别校准作为基线；2）提出校准的权衡旋钮λ：λ表示"为避免一个漏检所能接受的误报数"，据此选择期望代价最优决策规则——或单一分数阈值，或逐检测规则（用梯度提升树从检测器自身逐框输出估计"该框为真实物体的校准概率"，当概率≥1/(1+λ)时保留）；3）将F-score偏好映射到同一旋钮；4）计划对λ本身施加CRC以恢复逐条件漏检保证；5）旋钮仅在BDD100K训练集拟合一次，仅在BDD100K验证集与DAWN上评测。
AI.result: 以YOLOv8x为检测器，基线在DAWN各天气分箱中把留出漏检比例维持在20%预算内（单一全局阈值在雾天失效）；但误报量由1.6至117每图（跨DAWN与BDD100K条件）不等，且非可控选择。
AI.conclusion: 通过单一可解释参数λ，可将天气自适应的检测阈值决策转化为期望代价最优的权衡问题，并兼容F-score等偏好；对λ做CRC有望恢复逐天气漏检保证。当前结果仅为初步（λ上CRC尚属计划），验证限于BDD100K val与DAWN。

title: Shuffled OPSD: When Semantic Consistency Hurts On-Policy Self-Distillation?
summary: Knowledge distillation improves a student model's reasoning ability through supervision from a teacher. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the same model as both teacher and student under different contexts: the student generates reasoning trajectories from the question alone, while the teacher additionally receives a complete worked example and provides token-level supervision along those trajectories. Because the problem statement is shared, its content and ordering shape both student generation and teacher feedback. Preserving its semantic structure therefore seems natural, but does it always improve learning? We introduce Shuffled OPSD, which shuffles the words of the shared problem statement while keeping the teacher-only worked example intact. Across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3 model scales, the method improves mean accuracy over both an intact-target control and Standard OPSD under matched training configurations. The largest gain over Standard OPSD is 3.52 percentage points on Qwen3-1.7B. Further controls show that preserving larger word blocks offers no advantage over word-level shuffling at the evaluated scales, whereas shuffling the teacher-only worked example reduces accuracy at every scale. Cross-problem mixing and target-removal experiments further distinguish the roles of problem content, word order, and teacher context. These results show that disrupting the shared problem statement can improve learning, while disrupting the teacher-only reference hurts performance. They challenge semantic coherence as a universally beneficial principle for OPSD and motivate closer study of how input structure shapes student generation and teacher supervision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Shuffled OPSD：在 on-policy self-distillation 中打乱学生与教师共享的题目陈述的词序，而保留仅教师可见的完整解题范例。在三个数学推理基准、三个 Qwen3 规模上，该方法在同等训练配置下优于完整题目对照与标准 OPSD，最大提升 3.52 个百分点（Qwen3-1.7B）。
AI.motivation: OPSD 中学生仅凭题目生成推理轨迹，教师额外获得完整解题范例并给出 token 级监督；由于题目陈述为双方共享，其内容与顺序同时影响学生生成与教师反馈，因此"保持语义结构完整有益"被视为自然假设。作者质疑这一直觉，考察语义连贯性是否总是有利于 OPSD 学习。
AI.method: 构造 Shuffled OPSD：对共享题目陈述做词级打乱，同时保持教师专属的 worked example 不变；与 intact-target 对照和 Standard OPSD 在匹配训练配置下对比。并设置多组控制实验：保留更大词块（block-level）的打乱、打乱教师专属范例、跨问题混合（cross-problem mixing）与目标移除（target-removal），以分离题目内容、词序与教师上下文各自的作用。实验覆盖三个数学推理基准与三个 Qwen3 模型规模。
AI.result: Shuffled OPSD 在全部设置下平均准确率高于 intact-target 对照与 Standard OPSD；相对 Standard OPSD 的最大增益为 Qwen3-1.7B 上的 3.52 个百分点。控制实验显示：在评测规模下保留更大词块相对词级打乱无优势；打乱教师专属范例则在所有规模上降低准确率；跨问题混合与目标移除实验进一步区分了题目内容、词序与教师上下文的作用。
AI.conclusion: 破坏共享题目陈述的结构反而能改善学习，而破坏教师专属参考范例会损害性能，说明二者在 OPSD 中承担不同角色。结果挑战了"语义连贯性是 OPSD 普遍有益原则"的假设，并提示需进一步研究输入结构如何塑造学生生成与教师监督。

title: Interpretable Early Termination of Web Navigation Agents via Closed Sequential Pattern Mining
comment: In online proceedings of AI Agents for Discovery in the Wild (AID-Wild) Workshop at ACM CAIS 2026
summary: Web navigation agents built on open-weight language models fail often and fail late, with most of the tokens spent after the trajectory has become unrecoverable. Recent work has shown that early termination is a viable cost-reduction strategy, but existing approaches produce opaque termination decisions that do not support diagnosis or human oversight. In this work we apply closed sequential pattern mining (BIDE+) to K-step prefixes of agent execution traces to produce a small, human-reviewable failure-signature library that organizes into a four-category failure taxonomy with associated repair recommendations. We use a multi-variant evaluation protocol that explicitly removes contamination artifacts (zero-step crashes and trivially separable single-step successes) so that reported detection accuracy reflects behavioral discrimination rather than trace-length distributions. We evaluate our methodology on 1,544 MiniWoB++ traces collected from three open-weight language models, achieving the best F1 at K=3 on the Exclude-errors configuration across eight methods (0.717), recovering 88% of test-set failures within three steps, and supporting an early-termination policy that saves 26.3% of tokens at 92% precision.

AI.tldr: 该论文用闭合序列模式挖掘（BIDE+）从Web导航智能体的早期执行轨迹中提取可人工审阅的失败签名库，构建四类失败分类法并给出修复建议，在去除污染伪迹的评测协议下实现早期失败检测与token节省。
AI.motivation: 基于开放权重的语言模型构建的Web导航智能体经常失败且"失败得晚"，大部分token消耗在轨迹已不可恢复之后。已有早期终止方法虽能降低成本，但终止决策不透明，无法支持诊断与人工监督。
AI.method: 将闭合序列模式挖掘（BIDE+）应用于智能体执行轨迹的K步前缀，生成小型、可人工审阅的失败签名库，并组织为四类失败分类法及相应修复建议；同时设计多变异评测协议，显式剔除污染伪迹（零步崩溃与可平凡区分的单步成功），使检测精度反映行为判别力而非轨迹长度分布。
AI.result: 在来自三个开放权重模型的1,544条MiniWoB++轨迹上评估：在Exclude-errors配置、K=3时，于八种方法中取得最佳F1（0.717），三步内覆盖88%的测试集失败，并支持早期终止策略以92%的精确率节省26.3%的token。
AI.conclusion: 序列模式挖掘可作为构建透明、可审阅的失败检测机制的有效途径，兼顾可解释性与成本节约，为智能体的人工监督和诊断提供支持。

title: Follow the Features: SAE Feature-Guided Data-Efficient Instruction-Tuning of Large Language Models
summary: Selecting small, effective instruction-tuning datasets requires identifying which aspects of the original data to retain. We introduce Follow the Features (FtF), a data-selection method that uses sparse autoencoder (SAE) features to characterize training data and guide subset construction. FtF ranks features using dataset-level activation statistics, scores samples by their expression of highly ranked features, and incorporates feature resampling to encourage diversity. The LLM-SAE pair used for selection is independent of the model being fine-tuned, enabling reuse across target models. We evaluate FtF on two model-dataset settings at a training budget of 100 samples with a fixed sequence length of 256 tokens. FtF achieves performance competitive with GRAPE and S2L, with relative rankings varying across settings. On Qwen 3 8B trained on Alpaca, FtF exceeds full-dataset training by 1.59 percentage points in the harmonic mean of an AlpacaEval-based win rate and Open LLM Leaderboard performance, although full-dataset training retains a higher Leaderboard score. These results support SAE feature statistics as a useful signal for data-efficient instruction tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Follow the Features (FtF)，一种利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征刻画训练数据并指导指令微调子集构建的数据选择方法，在100样本预算下取得与GRAPE、S2L相当的效果。
AI.motivation: 小规模、高效指令微调数据集的构建需要判断原始数据中哪些方面值得保留；作者希望探索SAE特征统计能否作为数据高效指令微调的有效信号。
AI.method: FtF 用SAE特征刻画训练数据：先用数据集级激活统计对特征排序，再按样本对高排名特征的表达强度打分，并引入特征重采样以鼓励多样性；用于选择的LLM-SAE组合与被微调模型独立，可跨目标模型复用。
AI.result: 在两种模型-数据集设置下（100样本预算、序列长度固定256 tokens），FtF 与 GRAPE、S2L 性能相当，相对排名随设置变化；在 Qwen 3 8B + Alpaca 上，FtF 在 AlpacaEval 胜率与 Open LLM Leaderboard 表现的调和平均上超过全量训练1.59个百分点，但全量训练的 Leaderboard 分数更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将SAE特征统计作为数据高效指令微调的有用信号，但仍需在更多设置下验证其稳健性。

title: SteelHuman: Predicting Operator Estimates of Steel-Scrap Composition from Sparse RGB Views
comment: 10 pages main paper and 6 pages supplementary material
summary: Steel scrap composition estimation is an important part of yield planning and fair supplier compensation. Measuring the composition of a multi-ton pile is an inherently laborious process, so the assessment is often left to trained human operators. Recent works tackle composition-level tasks, but require structured acquisition and multi-stage preprocessing. We study a simpler approach to steel scrap load assessment by aggregating features from sparse, handheld views of the pile. On 600 out-of-fold piles, frozen DINOv2 tokens aggregated uniformly across views reach 13.4% total variation (TV) distance against operator estimates. Most remaining error lies in allocation among four thickness-defined heavy melting scrap (HMS) classes, yet image-dependent allocation reduces within-HMS TV from 25.1% under a training-set split prior to 11.2%. Due to the lack of public datasets and benchmarks for predicting composition, external evaluation relies on the public DOES dataset intended for classification. A classifier using the same frozen features reaches 93.97% accuracy, exceeding the published results we compare against. The composition model also aligns with related DOES categories without adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用稀疏手持视角图像、聚合冻结DINOv2特征来估计废钢堆成分，在600个折外钢堆上对操作员估计的总变差距离为13.4%，并用图像相关分配将HMS类内TV从25.1%降至11.2%。
AI.motivation: 废钢成分估计对产量规划与公平的供应商结算至关重要，但多吨级料堆的测量极为费力，通常依赖训练有素的人工操作员；现有方法虽处理成分级任务，却需要结构化采集与多阶段预处理，流程复杂、成本高，因此需要更简洁的评估途径。
AI.method: 采用简化范式：对料堆进行稀疏、手持视角拍摄，聚合各视角的冻结DINOv2 token特征（均匀聚合）；在600个折外料堆上评估相对操作员估计的总变差（TV）距离；针对厚度定义的四个重熔废钢（HMS）类别，比较训练集划分先验与图像相关分配的效果；并在公开DOES分类数据集上以相同冻结特征训练分类器进行外部评估。
AI.result: 折外600个料堆上，均匀聚合的冻结DINOv2特征达到13.4% TV距离；误差主要集中于四个HMS类别间的分配，图像相关分配将HMS类内TV由先验下的25.1%降至11.2%；在DOES数据集上分类器取得93.97%准确率，超过所对比的已发表结果；成分模型在无适配情况下与DOES相关类别保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 无需结构化采集和多阶段预处理的简单特征聚合方案可有效估计废钢堆成分，剩余误差主要来自HMS类别内部分配而非整体成分水平；冻结基础模型特征兼具强分类性能与跨任务语义一致性，可缓解公开数据与基准缺失带来的评估困难。

title: Who is the Pronoun Pro? Comparing LLMs and Humans at Number-Disambiguation of 'they'
comment: Submitted to journal for publication, will be updated upon publication; figures are greyscale-compatible; raw data, fully reproducible code, and Quarto source in linked repository
summary: This study evaluates whether large language models (LLMs) can reliably replace or complement human research assistants in linguistically complex annotation. In a controlled annotation task, 73 human annotators (local students and crowdworkers with and without a background in linguistics) and more than 40 LLM configurations number-disambiguated 174 authentic uses of 'they' from Reddit, including innovative and context-sensitive cases. The best LLM, Kimi K3, reached 94.5% accuracy, above the human majority vote (86.2%) and the mean of the top half of human annotators (78.5%); only the single best human annotator scored higher (95.7%). LLMs also offer substantial practical advantages in cost and speed. However, qualitative error analysis reveals a crucial complementarity: human reasoning in low-agreement cases exposes inconsistencies in the annotation typology and thereby improves the methodological framework itself. The study contributes (i) a benchmark-style human-LLM comparison for a semantically demanding task, (ii) transparent cost and time evidence, and (iii) a methodological argument against a purely replacement-oriented view of automation. LLMs are viable for large-scale annotation support in linguistics, but their responsible use requires human critical oversight. The dataset with its gold-standard labels, all human and LLM annotations, and the fully reproducible code are openly available as a Quarto-based, public repository.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过受控标注任务比较大语言模型与人类研究助理在语义复杂标注中的表现：最佳模型Kimi K3准确率94.5%，高于人类多数投票（86.2%）与人类前50%均值（78.5%），仅略低于最佳单人标注者（95.7%）；模型在成本与速度上优势明显，但低一致性案例的人类推理揭示标注类型学的不一致，说明人机互补而非替代。
AI.motivation: 评估LLM能否可靠替代或补充人类研究助理，完成语言学上语义复杂的标注任务，并检验"纯替代式自动化"观点的合理性。
AI.method: 受控标注任务：73名人类标注者（本地学生与不同语言学背景的众包工作者）与40余种LLM配置，对Reddit中174个真实"they"用例（含创新性与语境敏感用法）进行数词消歧（number-disambiguation）；并进行定性错误分析与成本、时间对比。
AI.result: 最佳模型Kimi K3达94.5%准确率，超过人类多数投票86.2%与人类前50%均值78.5%，仅单人最优者95.7%更高；LLM在成本与速度上具显著实用优势；低一致性案例中的人类推理暴露出标注类型学内部不一致，进而改进方法框架。
AI.conclusion: LLM可用于语言学大规模标注支持，但负责任的使用需要人类批判性监督；研究贡献包括人机基准式比较、透明的成本与时间证据，以及反对纯替代视角的方法论论证；数据与可复现代码已公开。

title: Palimpsestic Accountability in the US Federal AI Inventories
summary: An AI inventory is a structured, often public record in which a government or organization lists and describes the AI systems it uses or plans to use. Studies of single AI inventory releases describe what systems do but say little about how they are governed over time. We linked entries across three releases of the US Federal AI Use Case Inventory (2023--2025), compared answers only where both releases required them, and analyzed governance accounts through a dual deductive-inductive approach, guided by the Algorithmic Decision-Making Adapted for the Public Sector (ADMAPS) framework. As the inventory grew from 710 to 3,611 entries from 2023 to 2025, fewer required answers were left blank, but accountability was rewritten through three mechanisms. Each release \emph{redrew} the scope of the questions; agency-assigned classifications \emph{gated} what was reported; and answers were also \emph{overwritten}, with gains and losses concentrated in single agencies and little account of human oversight and judgment. These findings show that each release redraws the boundary of accountability and leaves the public to \emph{re-stitch} the records, a condition we term \textbf{palimpsestic accountability}. We recommend versioned records, reasons for every reclassification, public files that distinguish kinds of missing answers, and oversight documented as conditions to improve public sector AI accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过链接美国联邦AI用例清单三个版本（2023–2025）的条目，发现清单扩张过程中问责信息被"重绘、闸控、覆写"，提出"重写羊皮纸式问责"（palimpsestic accountability）概念。
AI.motivation: 既有研究多针对单次AI清单发布，描述系统"做什么"，却很少揭示其治理信息如何随时间演变；本文旨在填补这一纵向治理视角的空白。
AI.method: 跨2023、2024、2025三次发布链接条目；仅在两次发布均强制要求的题目上做可比对；以ADMAPS（Algorithmic Decision-Making Adapted for the Public Sector）框架为指引，采用演绎—归纳双重路径分析治理叙述。
AI.result: 条目数由710增至3,611，必答项留空率下降；但问责信息经三种机制被改写：各版本重新界定问题范围（redrew）、机构自定分类限制可报告内容（gated）、答案被覆盖（overwritten）；增损集中于少数机构，且对人工监督与判断记载甚少。
AI.conclusion: 每次发布都在重新划定问责边界，公众不得不自行"重新拼接"记录，即"重写羊皮纸式问责"。建议采用版本化记录、为每次重新分类提供理由、公开区分缺失答案类型、将监督作为条件予以记录。

title: ScaleTraj: Scale-Decomposed Human Trajectory Generation
summary: Individual-level trajectories are essential for applications that rely on user-level mobility behavior. Existing mobility-generation approaches face a fundamental tension between individual-level and population-level statistical fidelity: top-down models reproduce aggregate mobility statistics but struggle to guarantee realistic individual trajectories, while bottom-up generators synthesize individual trajectories yet often fail to preserve key population-level mobility regularities after aggregation. In particular, many bottom-up generated populations fail to reproduce the displacement distribution, whose heavy tail is well summarized by a truncated power law. We formalize this phenomenon as the \textbf{Population-Level Displacement Gap}. To investigate its prevalence, we conduct a systematic evaluation of representative model-driven and data-driven trajectory generators. Our results provide evidence that the Population-Level Displacement Gap is prevalent across diverse generation paradigms. To diagnose this gap, we introduce the \textbf{Scale Fidelity Profile (SFP)}, a scale-decomposed metric that quantifies discrepancies in trip allocations across spatial scales. SFP indicates that population-level displacement mismatches co-occur with systematic errors in how trips are allocated across spatial scales. Motivated by this observation, we develop \textbf{ScaleTraj}, an autoregressive Transformer that decomposes location prediction into a Scale Selection Head that decides the movement scale and a Scale-Aware Cell Selection Head that predicts the destination conditioned on the selected scale. Experiments on two datasets show that ScaleTraj reduces the Population-Level Displacement Gap versus model-driven and data-driven baselines, while preserving fidelity. Our code is available at https://github.com/SCU-TrustworthyAI/ScaleTraj.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有轨迹生成方法在个体轨迹保真与群体位移分布保真之间存在张力，形式化提出"群体级位移差距"现象，并用尺度分解指标SFP诊断其源于跨空间尺度的出行分配误差，进而提出分解式自回归模型ScaleTraj缩小该差距。
AI.motivation: 个体级轨迹对用户级移动行为应用至关重要，但现有方法存在根本性张力：自顶向下模型能复现群体移动统计却难以保证个体轨迹真实；自底向上生成器能合成个体轨迹，但聚合后往往无法保持关键群体级移动规律。特别是，许多自底向上生成的人群无法复现位移分布，而该分布的重尾特性可用截断幂律很好地刻画。
AI.method: 1) 将上述现象形式化为"群体级位移差距"（Population-Level Displacement Gap），并对代表性模型驱动与数据驱动轨迹生成器进行系统性评估以考察其普遍性；2) 提出尺度保真度剖面（Scale Fidelity Profile, SFP），一种按空间尺度分解的指标，量化不同空间尺度上出行分配的偏差，用于诊断该差距；3) 基于"群体级位移失配与跨尺度出行分配系统性误差共现"的观察，设计ScaleTraj——一种自回归Transformer，将位置预测分解为尺度选择头（决定移动尺度）与尺度感知单元选择头（在选定尺度条件下预测目的地）。
AI.result: 系统性评估结果表明，群体级位移差距在不同生成范式中普遍存在；SFP分析显示群体级位移失配与跨空间尺度的出行分配系统性误差同时出现。在两个数据集上的实验表明，与模型驱动和数据驱动基线相比，ScaleTraj在保持保真度的同时缩小了群体级位移差距。
AI.conclusion: 群体级位移差距是轨迹生成领域的普遍问题，尤其在自底向上生成器的聚合结果中突出；其根源可归因于跨空间尺度的出行分配误差，可通过尺度分解的方式建模加以缓解。ScaleTraj验证了"先选尺度、再定目的地"的分解式生成范式在兼顾个体级与群体级统计保真方面的有效性。代码已开源。

title: Mitigating Spatial Blindness in Multiple Instance Learning for Whole-Slide Image Analysis
summary: Whole-slide multiple instance learning can predict diagnostic and prognostic labels from tissue composition while making limited use of spatial organization. Providing coordinates or a graph does not establish that a trained predictor uses tissue neighborhoods. We examine this gap as spatial blindness and hypothesize that early composition learning can weaken supervision of a spatial pathway. We introduce ResTopoMIL, which freezes a learned composition predictor before training a graph residual with a coordinate-reassignment separation loss. Permutation and information analyses distinguish architectural symmetry, available spatial information and the proposed optimization mechanism. On a controlled spatial task, staged training achieved an AUC of 0.987, compared with 0.684 for the same jointly trained architecture. Performance remained high on a composition-only task. Across four WSI classification and five survival benchmarks, ResTopoMIL improved mean primary performance on eight tasks; four improvements remained significant after Holm-adjusted patient-cluster tests. Coordinate-free residual controls recovered some of the gains, while neighborhood destruction reduced performance close to the composition anchor. Neighborhood-preserving transformations and anatomy-stratified perturbations further characterized this dependence. These results support fixing a composition reference as a practical intervention for learning spatial corrections, while retaining additional appearance capacity as a contributing explanation.

AI.tldr: 提出"空间盲区"概念，通过冻结已学到的成分预测器、再训练带坐标重指派分离损失的图残差路径（ResTopoMIL），使全切片多示例学习真正利用组织空间邻域。
AI.motivation: 现有全切片MIL虽输入坐标或图结构，但无法保证训练后的预测器实际使用空间邻域信息；作者将这一差距定义为"空间盲区"，并假设早期成分学习会削弱空间路径的监督信号。
AI.method: ResTopoMIL：先训练并冻结成分预测器，再以坐标重指派分离损失训练图残差；用置换与信息分析区分架构对称性、可用空间信息与优化机制；配合无坐标残差对照、邻域破坏、邻域保持变换及解剖分层扰动进行消融。
AI.result: 受控空间任务AUC 0.987，同一架构联合训练仅0.684；纯成分任务性能仍高。4个WSI分类与5个生存基准中，8个任务主指标均值提升，其中4项经Holm校正的患者簇检验仍显著；无坐标残差对照挽回部分增益，邻域破坏使性能回落至成分基线附近。
AI.conclusion: 固定成分参考是学习空间修正的可行干预手段；同时外观容量增加也是增益的部分解释，二者共同支撑结果。

title: Whose Effect Is It? How Objectives Inflate Learned Subspace Interventions
summary: Interpretability often locates concepts by copying part of a language model's state from one input into another (activation patching). A larger output change counts as stronger evidence that this part carries the concept. Methods that learn which part to copy often change the output more than the whole state does. By that reading, learned parts isolate the concept more cleanly. Yet the whole contains the part. So whose effect is this excess, the network's or the method's? Copying the whole state learns nothing, so it shows what the network produces. We prove that, to first order, the effects of orthogonal parts add up to that of the whole. A part therefore exceeds the whole exactly when the rest moves the output back, which does not require isolating the concept more cleanly. Objectives that reward a larger effect select such parts. Distributed alignment search with cross-entropy, for example, exceeds the whole-state copy just before the output on almost all tasks, and inside the network at most sites. In both, changing only its objective to target what the network produces removes most of the excess. It therefore comes largely from the objective, so a larger learned effect alone is not stronger evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文论证"学习到的概念部件比整状态拷贝带来更大输出变化即证明其更干净地隔离了概念"这一读法不成立：这种超额效应主要来自目标函数的偏好，而非网络本身。
AI.motivation: 激活修补类可解释性方法通过把部分状态从一个输入拷贝到另一个输入来定位概念，并以输出变化越大作为该部分承载概念越强的证据。但"学习选哪个部分来拷贝"的方法常常比拷贝整个状态引起更大变化，人们据此认为学到的部分更干净地隔离了概念。作者质疑：既然整体包含部分，这种"超额"究竟是网络产生的，还是方法本身造成的？
AI.method: 以"拷贝整个状态"作为不学习任何东西、因而只反映网络自身产出的基线；理论上证明在一阶近似下，相互正交的部分之效应可加并等于整体的效应。由此推出：一个部分的效应超过整体，当且仅当其余部分把输出往回拉，而这并不等价于更干净地隔离概念。再以 DAS（distributed alignment search）配合交叉熵目标为实例，比较其与整状态拷贝在输出前和网络内部各位置的表现，并做目标函数替换的对照实验。
AI.result: DAS+交叉熵在几乎所有任务上、于输出前均超过整状态拷贝，在网络内部也于至多（多数）站点上超过整状态拷贝；仅把其目标改为"对准网络实际产出"后，大部分超额效应消失。
AI.conclusion: 超额效应在很大程度上源自目标函数（奖励更大输出变化的目标会主动挑选"其余部分抵消"的部件），因此仅凭"学习到的效应更大"并不能构成更强的证据，需改用面向网络实际产出的评价目标。

title: Validation-Gated ML Pipeline Synthesis with Expert-Grounded Self-Evolving Skills
summary: Recent advances in large language models have enabled agentic systems that automate machine learning pipeline construction from minimal user input. However, existing agentic AutoML methods either depend on rigid templates that limit adaptability, target narrow task domains, or rely on free-form code generation that lacks reliability guarantees, leaving intermediate errors to propagate silently and degrade the final model. We present EvoML, an agentic framework for end-to-end ML pipeline synthesis built on expert-grounded skills that evolve across runs, executed through a validation-gated harness. The framework decomposes pipeline construction into four phases coordinated by three agents: an Orchestrator that enforces validation gates, advancing each phase only when its outputs pass structural, execution, and semantic checks, which precludes error propagation and keeps every artifact auditable; an Executor that runs expert-grounded skills, grounded in the nnU-Net workflow and pairing reusable templates with online adaptation; and a Curator that performs post-run evolution, consolidating the scripts and guidance recovered during a run into the skill library so it improves across datasets. We evaluate EvoML on eight datasets spanning six sophisticated, real-world ML task types, against agentic AutoML systems and command-line coding tools. EvoML achieves full automation and the best final model quality on all eight, spanning segmentation (up to 0.94 Dice), classification (0.99 accuracy), reconstruction (0.95 SSIM), and denoising (0.79 normalized PSNR), while transferring to broader ML tasks.

AI.tldr: EvoML：基于专家技能演化的智能体端到端ML流水线合成框架，通过验证门控执行与运行后技能库进化，在8个数据集6类任务上实现全自动化并取得最优模型质量。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体AutoML方法存在三类局限：依赖僵化模板导致适应性差、任务域狭窄、自由式代码生成缺乏可靠性保证，中间错误会静默传播并劣化最终模型。
AI.method: 构建专家落地的可演化技能库，并由验证门控执行框架运行；将流水线构建分解为四阶段，由三个智能体协同：Orchestrator执行结构、执行、语义三重校验门控，仅当输出通过才推进至下一阶段，防止错误传播并保证产物可审计；Executor运行以nnU-Net工作流为基础的专家技能，结合可复用模板与在线自适应；Curator执行运行后演化，将本次恢复的脚本与指导整合入技能库以跨数据集持续改进。
AI.result: 在覆盖六类真实复杂ML任务的8个数据集上，对比智能体AutoML系统与命令行编码工具，EvoML在全部8个数据集上实现完全自动化并取得最佳最终模型质量：分割Dice最高0.94、分类准确率0.99、重建SSIM 0.95、去噪归一化PSNR 0.79，并可迁移至更广泛ML任务。
AI.conclusion: 以专家落地技能+验证门控+运行后技能演化的组合，可在保证可靠性与可审计性的同时实现端到端ML流水线全自动合成，并具备跨数据集与跨任务的泛化能力。

title: When Strong Reasoners Join the Pool: Small Union Premiums and Costly Runaway Generations in LLM Routing
comment: Technical report. 10 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Companion to arXiv:2607.03436. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23724735
summary: Routing benchmarks often judge a router against a hindsight oracle that counts a query as solved whenever any model's recorded answer is correct, but under stochastic decoding that oracle mixes two different objects: the clairvoyant ceiling of committing to one model per query and the premium of calling several models and keeping any correct answer. A companion study measured this premium at 3.5 percentage points (pp) for 11 small open models on MATH-500; how large it is once current reasoning models enter the pool was unknown. We measure it with a fixed-protocol, pre-committed generation on a single NVIDIA B300: all 500 MATH-500 problems, 30 seeded samples per problem, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and NVIDIA's Nemotron Nano 9B v2 and Nemotron Super 49B v1.5 (a NAS derivative of the same 70B) under vendor sampling, a 65,536-token cap, a pinned Math-Verify scorer, and an append-only attempt ledger, for 45,000 scored responses. The two reasoning models both reach 96.1% accuracy against 76.2% for the 70B baseline. The empirical product-coupling premium is 0.215-0.588 pp across all two- and three-model pools; the empirical plug-in selection headroom over always calling Nano is 1.27 pp; and resampling Nano three times gives practically the same empirical any-correct rate as calling all three models once. Only 31 responses reached the cap, 25 of them with exactly periodic tails, yet the capped responses account for up to 60.2% of a model's output-length-squared proxy, and long generations made a fourth planned model, Llama-3.1-8B, too slow to finish. The premium is far below the companion's 3.5 pp, but models, pool size and protocol changed together; an oracle gap should therefore be reported with the pool, the protocol, the samples per cell and the decoding budget that produced it.

AI.tldr: 该论文在固定协议下测量"多模型取任一正确"相对单模型选择的经验溢价：仅0.215–0.588 pp，远低于伴随研究报道的3.5 pp。
AI.motivation: 路由基准常用的事后神谕（hindsight oracle）在随机解码下混淆了两个对象：单模型承诺的"天眼上限"与调用多模型取任一正确的"溢价"。伴随研究在11个小开源模型上测得3.5 pp，但引入当前推理模型后该溢价大小未知。
AI.method: 在单张NVIDIA B300上进行固定协议、预承诺式生成：MATH-500全部500题×30个带种子样本，模型为Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct、Nemotron Nano 9B v2与Nemotron Super 49B v1.5（70B的NAS衍生），采用厂商采样配置、65,536 token上限、固定版本Math-Verify评分器与只追加的尝试账本，共45,000条计分响应。
AI.result: 两个推理模型准确率均为96.1%，70B基线为76.2%。所有两模型与三模型池的经验乘积耦合溢价为0.215–0.588 pp；相对"始终调用Nano"的经验插件式选择余量为1.27 pp；对Nano重采样三次与三个模型各调用一次的经验"任一正确"率几乎相同。仅31条响应触及长度上限（其中25条呈精确周期尾），但触顶响应最高占某模型输出长度平方代理量的60.2%，且长生成使原计划的第四模型Llama-3.1-8B过慢而无法完成。
AI.conclusion: 该溢价远低于伴随研究的3.5 pp，但模型、池规模与协议同时改变，故不可直接比较；神谕差距应连同池构成、协议、每格样本数与解码预算一并报告。

title: ReSMap: Recasting Satellite Priors for Robust and Accurate Online HD Map Construction
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 24 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://dehsurc.github.io/resmap-page/ Code: https://github.com/dehsurc/ReSMap
summary: Despite recent advances in camera-based online HD map construction, these systems remain susceptible to sensor failures due to their reliance on onboard cameras. In contrast, satellite images remain available independently of real-time sensing conditions as they are cached offline. Existing methods utilizing satellite images, however, primarily leverage them under nominal conditions, without explicitly addressing them as redundancy when a sensor degrades. To address this gap, we propose ReSMap, a redundancy-aware camera-satellite fusion framework for robust online HD map construction. Our framework explicitly leverages satellite images as a complementary source to improve robustness against camera failures. A Predict-then-Fuse (PTF) module fuses camera and satellite BEV features by using each branch's own prediction confidence as a per-pixel reliability weight, with no learned router. An Object-Centric Cooperative Multi-modal Query (OCMQ) decoder then extends this per-modality separation to the query level: each modality cross-attends only to its own BEV, and per-modality updates are merged through a learned per-token gate. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes across all splits and range settings. More importantly, it also sets the new state-of-the-art under camera-failure scenarios, demonstrating that satellite images serve not only as a strong prior but as practical redundancy for robust online HD mapping.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReSMap——冗余感知的相机-卫星融合框架，将卫星图像作为相机失效时的实用冗余源，实现鲁棒的在线 HD 地图构建。
AI.motivation: 现有相机在线 HD 地图方法依赖车载相机，易受传感器故障影响；卫星图像可离线缓存、不依赖实时感知，但现有卫星融合方法仅在正常工况下利用其作先验，未将其显式建模为传感器退化时的冗余。
AI.method: 1) Predict-then-Fuse (PTF) 模块：以各分支自身预测置信度作为逐像素可靠性权重融合相机与卫星 BEV 特征，无需学习式路由器；2) Object-Centric Cooperative Multi-modal Query (OCMQ) 解码器：将模态分离延伸至 query 层，各模态仅对自身 BEV 交叉注意力，经学习式逐 token 门控合并各模态更新。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 全部 split 与各 range 设置下均达到 SOTA；在相机失效场景下亦取得新的 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 卫星图像不仅是强先验，更是鲁棒在线 HD 建图的实用冗余来源，可有效提升相机失效下的建图鲁棒性。

title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. As a result, tool interfaces may not match real ones, tool compositions are not grounded in execution, and tasks rarely span more than one environment. We propose ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework that reverses this order. ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies from adjacent calls in execution traces of real MCP services and open agent corpora, using deterministic rules rather than LLM judgment, and clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments. Databases are synthesized only for state-mutating environments, while query and stateless tools replay recorded returns. ToolSpace then performs state-aware random walks with rollback and decompiles each chain into a natural-language task with assertion-based checks, keeping only samples that replay successfully from the initial state. Applied to AutomationBench and tau3-Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which 7 frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points. Across seven long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, ToolSpace raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from 23.0 to 41.0 average score (43.2 with RL) and GLM-5.2 from 44.6 to 56.6, on par with Claude Opus 5. Ablations show that execution-witnessed edges clearly outperform LLM-judged ones, and performance keeps improving with data and environment scale.

AI.tldr: ToolSpace 提出以工具为中心（tool-centric）的 MCP 环境构造框架：先从真实执行轨迹中挖掘工具间依赖，聚类成环境，再用状态感知随机游走生成任务，生成更贴近真实执行、可复现且更难的基准，并显著提升多个模型的长期程工具使用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 MCP 环境扩展方法是数据中心的（先合成数据库与场景，再派生工具与任务），导致三个问题：工具接口与真实接口不匹配；工具组合缺乏执行依据；任务很少跨多个环境。作者希望反转该顺序，以真实执行轨迹为根基构建环境与任务。
AI.method: 1) 从真实 MCP 服务与开放 agent 语料的执行轨迹中，对相邻调用用确定性规则（而非 LLM 判断）挖掘数据依赖、状态依赖与重试依赖；2) 将由此得到的加权工具组合图聚类为多个环境；3) 仅对状态可变环境合成数据库，查询类与无状态工具直接回放记录返回值；4) 在环境中执行带回滚的状态感知随机游走，将每条调用链反编译为带断言检查的自然语言任务，仅保留能从初始状态成功回放的样本。
AI.result: 在 AutomationBench 与 tau3-Bench Banking 上产出更难的 Pro 版本，7 个前沿模型最多下降 38.2 分；在 7 个长期程工具使用基准上，Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 从 23.0 提升至 41.0（加 RL 为 43.2），GLM-5.2 从 44.6 提升至 56.6，与 Claude Opus 5 相当。消融显示执行见证（execution-witnessed）边明显优于 LLM 判定边，且随数据与环境规模扩大性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 以执行轨迹为依据、工具先行的环境与任务合成路线，可生成接口真实、依赖有据、可回放验证的跨环境长期程任务，既能作为高难度评测基准，也能作为有效的训练数据来源，并具备良好的规模化特性。

title: Clocks all the way down: does sequence-processing AI need endogenous temporal structure?
summary: Mainstream sequence-processing AI is temporally reactive: each update is driven by input and learned state transitions, rather than by an independently evolving internal temporal reference. Biological brains, by contrast, continuously generate rhythmic activity that structures perception, memory, and cognition, and this rhythmicity reaches all the way to behavior. We ask whether this difference is merely implementational or genuinely computational. Four lines of evidence suggest that endogenous temporal structure supports putative functions that input-driven architectures may not readily replicate: 1) phase-dependent routing of information, 2) delay-structured combinatorial representation, 3) cross-frequency multiplexing of items, and 4) oscillation-gated offline consolidation. A proof-of-concept delay-ablation test dissociates representational capacity from memory retrieval. In recurrent and spatial spiking networks with fixed synaptic weights and connectivity, shuffling delays preserves part of the capacity but substantially impairs the sequence retrieval. The relative contrast is more pronounced for spatial networks and longer propagations. Instantaneous transmission collapses capacity itself. We then outline a cross-frequency multiplexing scheme that combines item identity and serial order with alternative mechanisms for selective memory retrieval. Finally, we state one falsifiable hypothesis, conditions for matched-resource tests, and three research directions: the components already exist; the disciplined comparison does not.

AI.tldr: 论文提出：主流序列处理AI是"时间反应式"的，其更新由输入和学习到的状态转移驱动，缺乏独立演化的内部时间参照；而生物大脑持续产生节律活动。作者论证这一差异不只是实现层面的，而是计算层面的，并给出一条可证伪假设、匹配资源测试条件与三个研究方向。
AI.motivation: 主流序列处理AI的更新完全由输入驱动，没有独立于输入演化的内部时间参照。生物大脑则持续生成节律活动来组织感知、记忆与认知，并延伸至行为。作者要回答：这一差异是单纯的实现差异，还是真正的计算差异——即内生时间结构是否承担了输入驱动架构难以复制的功能。
AI.method: 1）梳理四条证据线索，指认内生时间结构支撑的推定功能：相位依赖的信息路由、延迟结构的组合表征、跨频率的多路复用、振荡门控的离线巩固。2）设计概念验证性的"延迟消融"实验：在突触权重与连接固定的循环网络和空间脉冲网络中打乱传导延迟，比较表征容量与序列提取的受损程度。3）提出跨频率多路复用方案，将项目身份与序列顺序结合，并给出选择性记忆提取的替代机制。
AI.result: 延迟消融结果显示：打乱延迟可保留部分表征容量，但显著损害序列提取；这种相对对比在空间网络和更长的传播路径上更明显；而瞬时传导（延迟归零）则使容量本身崩溃。由此将表征容量与记忆提取解耦。跨频率多路复用方案则可同时编码项目身份与序列顺序，并支持选择性提取。
AI.conclusion: 内生时间结构具有计算意义而非仅实现意义。作者最终给出一个可证伪假设、匹配资源对照实验的条件，以及三个研究方向，并指出现有组件已具备，缺的是严格的对照比较。

title: ModelBlaster: Closing the Performance Gap through Learning-Augmented Agents Across Models, Kernels and Hardware Backends
comment: 10 pages of main content and 23 pages of appendices
summary:
Optimizing accelerator code across hardware architectures is difficult. ML compilers search predefined spaces of schedules and micro-kernels, while LLM-guided optimization can explore alternative algorithms, operator decompositions, and hardware-specific techniques. However, existing LLM agents typically target a single programming interface, toolchain, or accelerator family, focus on kernel-level optimization without model-level transforms, and offer limited reuse of experience across hardware targets.
  We present ModelBlaster, a Memory-Augmented In-Context Reinforcement Learning (MAIC-RL) framework for optimizing data-parallel kernels and whole models across heterogeneous SIMD and SIMT accelerators. Its mutable policy is a persistent knowledge base updated at inference time by Actor-Critic Textual Gradient Descent (AC-TGD). The knowledge base maps performance states to actions, outcomes, and constraints, enabling experience reuse across kernels, models, and hardware targets. A model-level optimizer uses kernel-level knowledge to inform whole-model decisions. The same optimization loop and knowledge schema support CUDA on NVIDIA GPUs, OpenCL on Qualcomm GPUs, and RVV intrinsics on RISC-V vector cores, with only lowering and measurement layers specific to each target.
  Compared with PyTorch, ModelBlaster achieves geometric-mean speedups of 1.85x, 5.58x, and 5.18x on KernelBench Levels 1, 2, and 3, and 1.69x on SOL-ExecBench Levels 1 and 2 on a B200 GPU. On Qualcomm Adreno GPUs, it achieves 5.8x over the vendor SDK and 1.7x over Apache TVM; on RISC-V vector cores, it achieves 2.7x over ExecuTorch with XNNPACK across 70 KernelBench problems.

AI.tldr: ModelBlaster 是一个记忆增强的上下文强化学习（MAIC-RL）框架，用可持久更新的知识库作为可变策略，跨异构 SIMD/SIMT 加速器优化内核与整模型代码，并在 NVIDIA B200、Qualcomm Adreno、RISC-V 向量核心上取得显著加速。
AI.motivation: 跨硬件架构优化加速器代码困难：ML 编译器只能在预定义的调度与微内核空间中搜索；LLM 引导优化虽能探索替代算法、算子分解与硬件特性，但现有 LLM 智能体通常只针对单一编程接口、工具链或加速器族，局限于内核级优化而缺少模型级变换，且经验难以跨硬件目标复用。
AI.method: 提出 ModelBlaster：以可变策略形式存在的持久知识库作为记忆，在推理时通过 Actor-Critic 文本梯度下降（AC-TGD）更新；知识库将性能状态映射到动作、结果与约束，实现跨内核、跨模型、跨硬件目标的经验复用。模型级优化器利用内核级知识指导整模型决策。统一优化循环与知识模式支持 NVIDIA GPU 上的 CUDA、Qualcomm GPU 上的 OpenCL、RISC-V 向量核心上的 RVV intrinsics，仅 lowering 与测量层与各目标相关。
AI.result: 在 B200 GPU 上，相比 PyTorch，KernelBench 1/2/3 级几何平均加速 1.85x、5.58x、5.18x，SOL-ExecBench 1/2 级达 1.69x；在 Qualcomm Adreno GPU 上比厂商 SDK 快 5.8x、比 Apache TVM 快 1.7x；在 RISC-V 向量核心上，70 个 KernelBench 问题平均比 ExecuTorch+XNNPACK 快 2.7x。
AI.conclusion: 以记忆增强的上下文强化学习结合持久知识库，可统一支撑内核级与模型级优化，并在多类异构加速器上实现可复用的经验迁移与稳定的性能提升。

title: EndoS3:Endoscopic Semantic Splatting SLAM
summary: Purpose: Despite advances in 3D surgical scene understanding, semantic simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM) remains under-explored for two key reasons. First, it requires solving three challenging tasks in parallel: camera pose tracking, high-fidelity deformable reconstruction, and semantic mapping, making progress particularly demanding. Second, the scarcity of datasets providing the necessary ground truth to evaluate all three tasks comprehensively under conditions that closely reflect real surgical procedures environments. Method: We propose EndoS3, a Gaussian Splatting-based semantic SLAM framework that uses instance masks to guide all three tasks. An instance-level motion decomposition module separates static and dynamic instances by evaluating residual flow after compensating for camera motion, accounting for flow noise and comparing motion across neighbouring instances. The camera is tracked against the static Gaussians, while an instance-aware warp field gives each dynamic instance its own control nodes and deformation network. A semantic node allocation module redistributes a fixed node budget across instances according to their size and non-rigidity. We also introduce CRCD++, an ex-vivo Cholecystectomy dataset with RGB-D frames, camera pose and instance annotations for full semantic SLAM evaluation. Results: EndoS3 surpasses all state-of-the-art general-purpose and surgical semantic SLAM methods in tracking, reconstruction and semantic mapping on the CRCD++ and SemSup datasets. Conclusion: Semantic-aware motion and deformation modelling is vital to surgical semantic SLAM. EndoS3 and CRCD++ offer a method and benchmark for improved geometric and semantic understanding in endoscopy.

AI.tldr: 提出基于高斯泼溅的语义SLAM框架EndoS3，用实例掩码统一引导跟踪、形变重建与语义建图，并发布CRCD++离体胆囊切除数据集。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜三维场景理解中，语义SLAM研究不足：一是需并行完成相机位姿跟踪、高保真可形变重建与语义建图三难任务；二是缺少能同时评估三者、且贴近真实手术流程的真值数据集。
AI.method: 1) 实例级运动分解：补偿相机运动后依据残差光流区分静态/动态实例，考虑光流噪声并比较相邻实例运动；2) 相机仅对静态高斯进行跟踪；3) 实例感知形变场为每个动态实例配置独立控制节点与形变网络；4) 语义节点分配模块按实例尺寸与非刚性程度重分配固定节点预算；5) 构建CRCD++离体胆囊切除数据集，含RGB-D帧、相机位姿与实例标注。
AI.result: 在CRCD++与SemSup数据集上，EndoS3在跟踪、重建与语义建图三方面均优于现有通用及手术场景的语义SLAM方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义感知的运动与形变建模对手术语义SLAM至关重要；EndoS3与CRCD++为内窥镜几何与语义理解提供了方法与基准。

title: The Right Source Is Not Enough: Understanding History Interference in Speech-LLM Memory
summary: Speech large language models retain audio history to support multi-turn conversations. Yet remembering an event does not ensure that its information is used only when relevant. We investigate why irrelevant historical audio changes answers even when the queried event remains represented. Controlled experiments on MOSS-Audio and MiMo-Audio show that historical values direct errors toward specific competing answers, beyond a generic effect of context length. Causal interventions distinguish two paths. In open-ended question answering, most history-value errors disappear when subsequent computation cannot directly access the irrelevant source. In multiple-choice answering, many errors persist: early historical influence is carried by question-candidate states even after direct source access is blocked. Low-dimensional interventions further separate source-role information from answer-value information. Their effects peak at different depths, and changing the source-role signal does not eliminate the causal influence of competing values. On naturally occurring errors, strengthening the queried role and counteracting the historical value each improve answers; their joint intervention gives the greatest recovery. These findings support a failure of downstream evidence use beyond source identification alone: source-role information can influence a decision without exclusively controlling which historical values affect it. Reliable conversational memory therefore requires not only retention and retrieval, but also control over how retained information enters answer computation.

AI.tldr: 语音大模型虽能保留音频历史以支持多轮对话，但"记住"不等于"恰当使用"：无关历史音频会通过两条不同路径污染答案——开放式问答中主要是直接源访问通路，多项选择中则表现为经由问题—候选状态传递的早期历史影响；源角色信息与答案价值信息在深度上可分离，且修正源角色不能消除竞争价值的因果作用。
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注语音大模型能否保留与检索历史音频，但缺乏对"保留后信息是否只在相关时被使用"的机制性检验。作者要回答：为何无关历史音频即便在被查询事件仍有表征时仍会改变答案，其影响是通过何种计算路径进入最终输出的。
AI.method: 在MOSS-Audio与MiMo-Audio上开展受控实验，操控历史取值并与上下文长度效应对照；采用因果干预区分两条通路：阻断后续计算对无关来源的直接访问，以及在多项选择下追踪早期历史影响是否经问题—候选状态传递；再用低维干预分离源角色信息与答案价值信息，考察其效应峰值深度及相互独立性；最后在自然发生的错误上分别与联合施加"强化被查询角色"和"抵消历史取值"的干预。
AI.result: 历史取值使错误定向偏向特定的竞争性答案，该效应超出上下文长度的泛化影响。开放式问答中，多数历史取值错误在阻断直接源访问后消失；多项选择中大量错误仍持续存在，说明早期历史影响已由问题—候选状态承载。源角色信息与答案价值信息的干预效应峰值出现在不同深度，改变源角色信号并不能消除竞争取值的因果影响。自然错误上，两种单独干预均带来提升，联合干预恢复效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 无关历史音频的干扰不能仅归结为源识别失败，而是下游证据使用环节的失效：源角色信息可以影响决策，却不单独决定哪些历史取值发挥作用。可靠的对话记忆不仅需要保留与检索，还需要对保留信息如何进入答案计算施加控制。

title: DoGNAVY-Exploit: Harnessing Parallel Open-Weight Agents for Stage-Aware Vulnerability Exploitation
summary: Frontier LLM agents can turn known vulnerabilities into working exploits, but are costly and often access-restricted due to their potential for malicious use. Open-weight models offer a more accessible alternative, but struggle to maintain progress across long exploitation chains. They also often fail to apply relevant security knowledge at the appropriate stage and in the right context to identify and evaluate promising attack directions. To address these limitations, we propose DoGNAVY-Exploit, a multi-agent harness built around two complementary designs: stage-aware decomposition with progressive expert knowledge disclosure, and hierarchical orchestration with parallel exploration. Specifically, DoGNAVY-Exploit uses configurable milestones to recast long-horizon exploitation as short, verifiable capability transitions and provides only the knowledge relevant to each stage. Within each milestone, a hierarchical architecture separates strategic planning from parallel execution: a planner proposes diverse attack routes, executors test them concurrently, and a controller accepts progress only when supported by runtime evidence. A shared structured memory consolidates verified facts, artifacts, replay steps, and failed routes across branches, allowing agents to build on collective progress and carry validated knowledge into subsequent milestones. In controlled benchmark environments, DoGNAVY-Exploit with GLM-5.2 achieves 97.5% Pass@1 on Cybench, and 97.5% zero-day and 100% one-day Pass@1 on CVE-Bench. On ExploitGym, it solves 79 tasks with GLM-5.2 and 157 with GLM-5.3, while the corresponding public Claude Code baselines solve 39 and 130 tasks, respectively. Ablation results further demonstrate that the stage-aware orchestration, expert knowledge, parallel exploration, and memory designs can substantially improve the exploitation capabilities of open-weight agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 DoGNAVY-Exploit，一个面向开放权重模型的多智能体框架，通过阶段感知分解、渐进式专家知识披露与分层并行编排，将长链条漏洞利用转化为短小的可验证能力跃迁，从而显著提升自动化漏洞利用成功率。
AI.motivation: 前沿 LLM 智能体虽能将已知漏洞转化为可用利用，但成本高且因滥用风险而访问受限；开放权重模型虽易获取，却难以在长利用链上保持进展，且无法在恰当时机与上下文中调用相关安全知识以判断有前景的攻击方向。
AI.method: 两项互补设计：(1) 阶段感知分解 + 渐进式专家知识披露——以可配置里程碑把长时程利用重构为短、可验证的能力转移（capability transitions），每阶段仅提供相关知识点；(2) 分层编排 + 并行探索——里程碑内 planner 提出多样化攻击路径，executors 并发测试，controller 仅在运行时证据支持下才接受进展；共享结构化记忆跨分支汇聚已验证事实、工件、复现步骤与失败路径，使各智能体在集体进展上迭代并将已验证知识带入后续里程碑。
AI.result: 受控基准环境：GLM-5.2 在 Cybench 上 Pass@1 达 97.5%，在 CVE-Bench 上零日 97.5%、一日 100%；ExploitGym 上 GLM-5.2 解出 79 个任务、GLM-5.3 解出 157 个，而对应公开 Claude Code 基线分别为 39 和 130。消融实验表明阶段感知编排、专家知识、并行探索与记忆设计均对开放权重智能体的利用能力有实质提升。
AI.conclusion: DoGNAVY-Exploit 证明：借助阶段感知编排、按需专家知识注入、并行探索与结构化共享记忆，开放权重模型可在长时程漏洞利用任务上达到甚至超越闭源前沿智能体基线，为低成本、可访问的自动化利用研究提供了可行范式。

title: Structure, Dimensionality, and Distribution Shape - What Makes Pretraining Data Transferable, and Why the Input Pipeline Decides Which
summary: What makes a pretraining corpus transferable? We describe a corpus by three properties: its structure, its dimensionality, and the distribution shape of each unit's values. We propose the Transfer-Invariance Principle: the same property can be irrelevant to transfer under one input transform and decisive under another, so the model's input transform, not the data modality, decides which properties can matter. To test it we build TransferForge, a generator that places a synthetic population at any prescribed structure, dimensionality, and distribution shape. KernelSynth, the synthetic prior of Chronos, cannot, because it draws independent series. When the model standardizes each input window (PatchTST on UCR), the distribution shape is inert and the structural setting governs. Synthetic pretraining then matches a real corpus of the same size and exceeds it once scaled. When the model encodes calcium fluorescence signals without normalization (POYO Plus), the shape becomes a governing constraint, and a shape-matched synthetic corpus replaces real pretraining with zero real neural activity. Flipping only the input normalization, with the model and data fixed, changes the effect of a shape manipulation by a factor of 5.3, so the pipeline, not the modality, sets the switch. The principle yields a recipe that chooses what to synthesize before any training. Pretraining data then becomes something to manufacture for the model, most valuably where real data is scarce, expensive, or private.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"迁移不变性原理"：语料同一属性是否影响迁移取决于模型输入变换而非数据模态，并构建TransferForge生成器据此设计合成预训练语料。
AI.motivation: 探讨何种预训练语料具备可迁移性。现有合成先验（如Chronos的KernelSynth）仅采样独立序列，无法控制结构、维度与分布形状，因而难以系统检验语料属性对迁移的作用。
AI.method: 用结构、维度与各单元取值分布形状三属性刻画语料；提出Transfer-Invariance Principle并构建TransferForge生成器，可在任意预设的结构、维度和分布形状下生成合成数据总体；在PatchTST/UCR（窗口标准化）与POYO Plus（钙荧光信号不归一化）两类设置下做对照实验，并仅切换输入归一化进行因果验证。
AI.result: 标准化输入时分布形状惰性、结构设定主导，同规模合成预训练与真实语料相当，扩大规模后超越；不归一化时分布形状成为主导约束，形状匹配的合成语料可在零真实神经活动下替代真实预训练；仅翻转输入归一化（模型与数据不变）使形状操纵效应变化5.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 决定何种语料属性可起作用的是模型输入变换而非模态，该原理给出在训练前选择"合成什么"的配方，使预训练数据成为可按模型定制制造的资源，在真实数据稀缺、昂贵或私密场景下价值最大。

title: IGSW: Multi-Weather Urban Scene Reconstruction with Intrinsic-Decoupled Gaussian Splatting
summary: High-fidelity weather editing of 4D scenes can support end-to-end training and closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving. Combining generative image editing with dynamic Gaussian representations enables multi-weather scene reconstruction, but weather-edited images often contain structural distortions. Directly fitting their appearance may propagate errors from teacher images into the reconstructed 4D scene, compromising the original scene structure and temporal continuity. To address these challenges, we propose IGSW, a two-stage framework that combines intrinsic-decoupled 4D Gaussian scene modeling with structure-preserving weather refinement. In Stage I, background Gaussian appearance is decomposed into weather-shared albedo and normals and weather-specific irradiance and residuals. Weather teacher images generated by a diffusion-based image editing model and intrinsic maps estimated by a diffusion-based inverse renderer provide feature-level soft supervision for stable structure and illumination changes. In Stage II, a structure-preservation gate combines semantic conflicts with cross-weather intrinsic discrepancies to suppress unreliable teacher regions. Per-Gaussian weather transport variables and target-weather branches then strengthen the desired weather appearance over the intrinsic-decoupled scene. Experiments on nuScenes and Waymo show that IGSW achieves the highest content similarity and semantic consistency and the lowest temporal error among the compared methods, while retaining pronounced weather-dependent illumination and atmosphere. The project page is available at https://akaxi6.github.io/IGSW/ .

AI.tldr: IGSW是一个两阶段框架，将内禀解耦的4D高斯场景建模与结构保持的天气精化相结合，实现高保真4D场景天气编辑。
AI.motivation: 4D场景天气编辑可支撑自动驾驶端到端训练与闭环仿真。已有方法（生成式图像编辑+动态高斯）的天气编辑图像常含结构畸变，直接拟合其外观会把教师图像误差传播进4D场景，破坏原场景结构与时间连续性。
AI.method: Stage I：将背景高斯外观分解为天气共享的albedo与法线、天气专属的irradiance与残差；以扩散图像编辑模型生成的天气教师图像和扩散逆向渲染器估计的内禀图为特征级软监督，稳定结构与光照。Stage II：结构保持门控结合语义冲突与跨天气内禀差异抑制不可靠教师区域；再用每高斯天气传输变量与目标天气分支强化期望天气外观。
AI.result: 在nuScenes与Waymo上，IGSW在对比方法中取得最高内容相似度与语义一致性、最低时间误差，同时保留显著的天气相关光照与大气效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过内禀解耦建模与结构保持的软监督，可有效抑制教师图像结构畸变的传播，实现结构一致、时间连续的高保真多天气4D场景重建。

title: GM League Arena: An Interactive Long-Horizon Task Benchmark Based on Professional Sports League Management
summary: Long-horizon decision-making under sustained competition requires large language models (LLMs) to balance immediate investment with future resource needs. However, local success in multi-step interactions can not adequately capture cumulative decision effects or demonstrate long-term goal achievement under resource constraints and sustained competition. To address this gap, we introduce GM Bench, a benchmark for managing professional sports teams across seasons under resource constraints and competition among teams. We build the environment simulators for four sports and add financial constraints, player demands, and market mechanisms to establish a unified task across sports. Diverse rosters of comparable strength are constructed from real-world player data, and each LLM is evaluated as a team general manager to assess its long-term management capabilities. We evaluate competitive performance, cash reserves, and cross-season improvement across four sports. Over five NBA seasons, Claude Opus 5.5 ranks first among 29 LLMs, while GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol combine strong performance with larger cash reserves.

AI.tldr: 提出GM Bench基准：基于四种职业体育队伍跨赛季经营模拟，考察LLM在资源约束与持续竞争下的长程决策能力；在五个NBA赛季中29个模型参评，Claude Opus 5.5综合第一。
AI.motivation: 多步交互中的局部成功无法充分反映累积决策效应，也难以衡量模型在资源约束与持续竞争下实现长期目标的能力，缺少面向长程决策的评测基准。
AI.method: 为四种体育运动构建环境模拟器，引入财务约束、球员需求与市场机制形成统一任务；基于真实球员数据构建实力相当且多样的阵容，令各LLM扮演球队总经理进行跨赛季管理；从竞技表现、现金储备、跨赛季改进三方面评测。
AI.result: 在五个NBA赛季的评测中，Claude Opus 5.5在29个LLM中排名第一；GPT-6 Astra与GPT-6.1 Sol在保持较强竞技表现的同时拥有更高现金储备。
AI.conclusion: GM Bench将体育队伍长期经营抽象为统一的长程决策任务，可揭示LLM在即时投入与未来资源平衡上的差异，为长程决策能力评测提供可复用的多领域框架。

title: Toward User-Centered Agentic Recommendation: When Does Platform Competition Benefit Users?
summary: Conventional recommender systems operate within platform-specific catalogs, limiting access to potentially valuable resources across platforms. We propose user-centered agentic recommendation, a paradigm in which user agents compare recommendations from competing platform agents, and formalize their interaction as a repeated game. Platforms strategically modify descriptions without changing intrinsic item value, while each user agent assesses platform credibility using feedback from consumed items only. Our analysis shows that expanded resource access need not improve user welfare: strategic misrepresentation and limited verification can offset the benefits of platform competition. We quantify when platform credibility assessment allows users to benefit from broader access despite strategic exaggeration. Our analysis identifies resource and reporting conditions that guarantee higher average welfare than the original platform with an interaction budget linear in platform count. Experiments on synthetic and Amazon-grounded markets show that credibility assessment can improve finite-horizon utility, while its benefits depend on market size and mechanism parameters.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"以用户为中心的代理式推荐"新范式：用户代理在多个平台代理之间比较推荐，并将交互建模为重复博弈，指出跨平台资源扩展未必提升用户福利，给出可信度评估有效性的充要条件与线性交互预算的可实现性。
AI.motivation: 传统推荐系统被限制在单一平台的商品目录内，用户无法获取其他平台上可能更有价值的资源。直观上跨平台竞争应使资源扩展带来福利提升，但平台可策略性地修改描述（夸大）而不改变物品内在价值，且用户只能通过已消费物品的反馈进行有限验证，因此需要澄清"更广访问是否真的对用户有利"这一问题。
AI.method: 将用户代理与多个竞争平台代理的交互形式化为重复博弈：平台在不改变物品内在价值的前提下策略性修饰描述；用户代理仅依据已消费物品的反馈评估平台可信度。在此模型下进行理论分析，刻画资源与报告条件；并在合成市场与基于Amazon数据的市场上进行实验，评估有限期效用。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，资源访问扩展并不必然改善用户福利，策略性虚假陈述与有限验证会抵消平台竞争带来的收益；进一步量化了平台可信度评估在何种条件下可使用户从更广访问中获益，并识别出能够保证平均福利高于原单平台、且交互预算随平台数线性增长的资源与报告条件。实验显示可信度评估可提升有限期效用，但收益依赖于市场规模与机制参数。
AI.conclusion: 跨平台代理式推荐的优势并非自动成立，需要可信度评估机制与相应的资源、报告条件配合；论文给出了可保证福利改进且交互成本仅为线性增长的条件，为设计用户侧推荐代理提供了理论依据与实践启示。

title: Separating Common and Unique Directions for Data-Free Model Merging
summary: Model merging combines multiple fine-tuned models without additional training, and arithmetic methods have emerged as a simple yet effective way to merge models without data. However, existing arithmetic methods treat task vectors in parameter space and apply a single element-wise rule to directions that can differ in mergeability. In a shared directional basis, we find a consistent two-regime structure: a low-dispersion common bulk shared across tasks and a high-dispersion task-dominated tail that carries disproportionate energy. These findings motivate Common--Unique Subspace Decomposition (CUSD), a data-free pre-merging method that separates task vectors into common and unique directional components, merges the common components with downstream arithmetic operator, and retains unique residuals separately. Experiments across $11$ base models, four model families, and four arithmetic-based merging operators show that CUSD improves 42 of 44 model--operator combinations and achieves up to 22.5% improvement over the corresponding baselines. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/stwang666/CUSD

AI.tldr: 提出无数据的合并前分解方法 CUSD，将任务向量拆为公共与独特方向分量，仅对公共分量施加算术合并，在 44 个模型-算子组合中 42 个优于基线，最高提升 22.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有模型算术合并方法在参数空间中用单一逐元素规则统一处理所有方向，但不同方向的"可合并性"其实不同，缺乏对任务向量方向结构的细粒度区分。
AI.method: 在共享方向基下观察到任务向量存在一致的"双区制"结构：低离散度的跨任务公共主体（common bulk）与高离散度、承载不成比例能量的任务主导尾部。据此设计 Common–Unique Subspace Decomposition（CUSD），一种无需数据的合并前处理方法，把任务向量分解为公共与独特方向分量，公共分量交由下游算术算子合并，独特残差单独保留。
AI.result: 覆盖 11 个基座模型、4 个模型族、4 种基于算术的合并算子，CUSD 在 44 个模型-算子组合中的 42 个上有提升，相对对应基线最高提升 22.5%。
AI.conclusion: 任务向量的公共/独特子空间分解是提升无数据算术合并的有效且通用前置步骤；CUSD 可即插即用地与现有算子结合，并已开源。

title: Understanding Backdoor Attacks in Scene Graph Generation via Global Context Pathway
comment: Accepted by the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
summary: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) produces structured scene representations, yet its training-time backdoor risk remains unexplored. Unlike classification, SGG exposes a pair-level attack surface that enables selective corruption of relations involving a designated object category. However, because SGG largely relies on localized evidence, globally placed triggers may face difficulty in manipulating such predictions. Recent SGG architectures increasingly incorporate global context to improve scene modeling, which may in turn facilitate such attacks. In this paper, we systematically study this backdoor risk and investigate the role of the global context pathway in backdoor behavior. Concretely, we first instantiate this attack with an effective method, and propose a three-axis evaluation protocol to characterize backdoor behavior. Experiments on Visual Genome with representative open-vocabulary and closed-set SGG models demonstrate the effectiveness of the attack. Mechanistic analyses reveal that the explicit global context pathway serves as a major carrier of the backdoor effect across the evaluated SGG models. In particular, replacing the poisoned global context representation with its clean counterpart during inference sharply suppresses the attack, yielding 100% and 97% reductions in attack success for the OvSGTR family and RelationFormer, respectively. Moreover, training-time interventions in the OvSGTR family show that suppressing trigger signals in this pathway either reduces attack success or substantially degrades utility. Together, these findings suggest that explicit global context designs may pose a backdoor risk in SGG architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究场景图生成（SGG）的训练时后门风险，揭示其"对象对级"选择性攻击面，并提出三轴评估协议；实验与机制分析表明显式全局上下文通路是后门效应的主要载体。
