AI.motivation: SGG 生成结构化场景表示，但其训练时后门风险尚未被探索。与分类任务不同，SGG 暴露对象对（pair）级攻击面，可选择性篡改涉及指定对象类别的关系；同时 SGG 主要依赖局部证据，全局放置的触发器可能难以奏效，而近期架构引入的全局上下文又可能反过来便利此类攻击。作者据此系统研究该风险及全局上下文通路的作用。
AI.method: 首先实例化一种有效的 SGG 后门攻击方法，并提出三轴评估协议刻画后门行为；在 Visual Genome 上对代表性开放词表与闭集 SGG 模型开展实验；随后进行机制分析，包括推理时将"中毒"的全局上下文表示替换为干净版本，以及在 OvSGTR 系列上施加训练期干预以抑制该通路中的触发信号。
AI.result: 攻击在开放词表与闭集 SGG 模型上均有效。机制分析显示显式全局上下文通路是后门效应的主要载体：推理时用干净全局表示替换中毒表示，OvSGTR 系列与 RelationFormer 的攻击成功率分别下降 100% 与 97%。训练期干预表明，抑制该通路中的触发信号要么降低攻击成功率，要么显著损害模型效用。
AI.conclusion: 显式全局上下文设计可能在 SGG 架构中引入后门风险；全局上下文通路是后门行为的关键载体，且难以在不损失效用的前提下被简单抑制，提示需在架构设计与训练阶段关注该安全问题。

title: When Self-Verification Hurts: Calibrated Answer Repair for Financial Question Answering
summary: Financial question answering can fail even when a model extracts a plausible number from the supplied evidence: the answer may attach it to the wrong entity, period, unit, or accounting concept. Asking the model to verify and revise its draft can help, but open-ended revision may alter content that was already correct or inspect the wrong relation and reinforce the original error. We formulate repair as a decision that balances the information it may recover against the correct content it may damage. Based on this trade-off, we introduce Calibrated Answer Repair (CAR), which first estimates whether a draft is likely to benefit from repair, then selects a targeted check, localizes the relevant evidence or draft span, and limits the permitted edit. Across FinRank, Fin-RATE, and FinQA with three open-weight models, CAR outperforms generic verification in all dataset-model settings. At the system level, it recovers 14.6% of initially missed answer requirements while damaging 2.1% of initially correct ones. Its post-draft token cost is over 30 percent lower than the iterative revision alternatives. Ablations on two dataset-model settings show that evidence localization and bounded editing are the main contributors to CAR's gains.

AI.tldr: 提出校准式答案修复（CAR）：先判断草稿是否值得修复，再做定向核查、证据定位与受限编辑，在金融问答中显著优于通用验证式改写。
AI.motivation: 金融问答中，模型即使抽取到看似合理的数字，也可能将其错配到错误的实体、期间、单位或会计概念；开放式的"验证—改写"可能破坏原本正确的内容，或核查了错误的关系而强化原有错误，因此需要在"可挽回的信息"与"可能破坏的正确内容"之间做权衡。
AI.method: 将答案修复形式化为一项权衡式决策，据此构建 Calibrated Answer Repair (CAR)：1) 先估计草稿是否可能从修复中获益；2) 选择一个有针对性的核查点；3) 定位相关证据或草稿片段（evidence localization）；4) 限制允许的编辑范围（bounded editing）。
AI.result: 在 FinRank、Fin-RATE、FinQA 三个数据集与三个开放权重模型的全部组合上，CAR 均优于通用验证方法；系统层面挽回了 14.6% 原本未满足的答案要求，同时仅破坏 2.1% 原本正确的答案；草稿生成后的 token 开销比迭代式改写方案低 30% 以上。消融实验（两组数据集-模型设置）表明证据定位与受限编辑是主要增益来源。
AI.conclusion: 以"是否值得修复"为核心的校准式、定向且受限的修复策略，能在低破坏率、低成本的前提下有效提升金融问答答案正确性；证据定位与编辑边界约束是关键设计。

title: DualWorldBench: Can Agents Plan Deliveries across Symbolic and Grounded Worlds?
summary: Recent multimodal agents have shown promising progress in embodied planning and web interaction. However, existing evaluations often rely on simplified tasks with limited combinatorial structure, leaving it unclear whether current agents can robustly integrate perception and reasoning for multi-goal planning under temporal, physical, and multimodal constraints. We introduce DualWorldBench, a unified benchmark for evaluating agent planning under controlled symbolic--temporal and grounded--topological complexity. Built around a shared pickup--delivery interface, DualWorldBench consists of three complementary components: TextWorld, which isolates symbolic planning under varying task compositions and release dynamics; SimWorld, which evaluates grounded path planning under controlled topological variation with text, image, or multimodal inputs; and DualWorld-VQA, a diagnostic suite spanning perception, scene understanding, and planning. Experiments reveal a common gap between local understanding and globally consistent planning. In TextWorld, agents struggle to derive optimal task sequences under interacting temporal constraints; in SimWorld, grounded observations are not reliably converted into feasible action sequences. DualWorld-VQA further confirms that perception and topology understanding do not necessarily translate into constrained planning. Together, these results identify the central challenge as composing symbolic or grounded evidence into globally feasible and efficient multi-goal plans. These findings establish DualWorldBench as a challenging testbed for agents with tighter perception--reasoning--planning integration. All datasets and code are publicly available at our project website https://dualworld.netlify.app/.

AI.tldr: 提出DualWorldBench统一基准，在受控的符号-时序与具身-拓扑复杂性下评测多模态智能体的多目标任务规划能力，揭示局部理解与全局一致规划之间的系统性差距。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态智能体评测多采用组合结构有限的简化任务，无法判断智能体能否在时序、物理与多模态约束下稳健地整合感知与推理完成多目标规划。
AI.method: 围绕共享的取件-投递（pickup-delivery）接口构建三个互补组件：TextWorld 隔离符号规划，变化任务组合与释放（release）动态；SimWorld 在受控拓扑变化下评测具身路径规划，支持纯文本、图像或多模态输入；DualWorld-VQA 为覆盖感知、场景理解与规划的诊断套件。
AI.result: 实验显示一致的"局部理解—全局规划"鸿沟：TextWorld 中智能体难以在交互的时序约束下推导最优任务序列；SimWorld 中具身观测无法可靠转化为可行动作序列；DualWorld-VQA 证实感知与拓扑理解并不必然转化为受约束规划能力。
AI.conclusion: 核心挑战在于将符号性或具身证据组合为全局可行且高效的多目标规划；DualWorldBench 可作为推动感知-推理-规划更紧密结合的挑战性测试平台，数据与代码已公开。

title: Decomposing Rank Reversals under Temporal Nonstationarity: Alignment, Aggressiveness, and Instability
summary: Under temporal nonstationarity, model performance rankings reverse across training horizons due to heterogeneous sensitivities to memory. While existing literature addresses adaptive lookbacks, effective model complexity, and empirical forecast evaluation in isolation, no unified framework explains the structural mechanics driving these rank reversals. We bridge this gap by deriving a model-agnostic decomposition of out-of-sample $R^2$ into target alignment, miscalibrated aggressiveness, and predictive instability. Within this framework, we mathematically characterize complexity phase boundaries, establish closed-form optimal-memory equations for ridge regression under local drift, and extend these guarantees to complex model architectures via surrogate bounds. We validate these theoretical dynamics by benchmarking 14 linear, tree-based, and neural architectures across large-scale financial panels. In doing so, our framework demonstrates that empirical model rank reversals are driven by predictable surges in miscalibrated aggressiveness, providing a rigorous mechanistic diagnosis of generalization under temporal shift.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个模型无关的样本外 R² 分解框架（目标对齐、误校准激进性、预测不稳定性），用于解释时间非平稳下模型排名随训练窗口反转的机制。
AI.motivation: 现有文献分别研究自适应回看窗口、有效模型复杂度和经验预测评估，但缺乏统一框架解释时间非平稳下模型排名反转的结构性机制。
AI.method: 将样本外 R² 模型无关地分解为目标对齐、误校准激进性与预测不稳定性三部分；据此数学刻画复杂度相变边界，推导局部漂移下岭回归的闭式最优记忆方程，并通过代理界将保证推广到复杂模型架构；在大型金融面板上对14个线性、树模型与神经网络架构进行基准验证。
AI.result: 理论与实证一致：经验上的模型排名反转由可预测的误校准激进性激增所驱动，复杂度相变与最优记忆关系得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为时间漂移下的泛化提供严格的机制性诊断，将记忆敏感度、复杂度与预测表现纳入统一解释体系。

title: StepX-OPD: Rethinking Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Diffusion Models
summary: A deployable text-to-image diffusion model must hold several capabilities at once, such as instruction following, text rendering and human preference, and must sample in a few steps. Capabilities and few-step sampling are built in separate stages: a full-step model first consolidates capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation, then serves as a fixed teacher for step distillation. Every full-step model we evaluate scores lower once compressed, and the second stage cannot begin until the first finishes. We introduce StepX-OPD, which merges the two stages: one student acquires every capability while learning to sample in a few steps, so frozen specialists supervise it on the states its own rollout visits rather than on a longer trajectory it never runs. Because a decomposition of the rollout's KL weights velocity mismatch most heavily near the clean end, we also regress the student's velocity on the low-noise part of the rollout. Separately, we find that capability integration makes models write prompt words into images on prompts that never asked for text, and we give a variant that lowers it. We evaluate on SD3.5-Medium and FLUX.1-dev across instruction following, text rendering, image quality and human preference. On both architectures, StepX-OPD attains the highest normalized average score among the four-step methods compared and exceeds the forty-step Flow-OPD model, and on SD3.5-Medium it trains with about 37% fewer GPU-hours than sequential DiffusionOPD followed by step distillation.

AI.tldr: StepX-OPD将能力整合与少步采样蒸馏合并为单阶段，学生模型边学能力边学少步采样，在SD3.5-Medium与FLUX.1-dev上取得四步方法最高归一化平均分并超过40步Flow-OPD，且训练GPU时长减少约37%。
AI.motivation: 可部署的文生图扩散模型需同时具备指令跟随、文字渲染、人类偏好等能力并支持少步采样。现有流程分两阶段（先多教师on-policy蒸馏整合能力，再以其为固定教师做步蒸馏），存在两个问题：每个全步模型压缩后分数下降；第二阶段须等第一阶段完成，无法并行。此外能力整合会导致模型在无需文字的提示中把提示词写入图像。
AI.method: 提出StepX-OPD，将两阶段合并：单一学生模型在学少步采样的同时获取全部能力，冻结的专家教师对学生自身rollout访问到的状态进行监督，而非其从未运行的长轨迹。基于rollout的KL权重分解显示速度失配在干净端最严重，故额外对学生速度在rollout低噪声段做回归。另给出一个变体以降低"把提示词写入图像"的副作用。
AI.result: 在SD3.5-Medium和FLUX.1-dev上，从指令跟随、文字渲染、图像质量和人类偏好四方面评测：两种架构上StepX-OPD在四步方法中归一化平均分最高，并超过40步的Flow-OPD；在SD3.5-Medium上训练GPU时长比"DiffusionOPD后接步蒸馏"的顺序方案少约37%。
AI.conclusion: 将能力整合与步蒸馏统一到单阶段、在对学生自身rollout状态做专家监督并补充低噪声段速度回归，可同时获得更强的少步生成质量与更高训练效率，并可通过变体缓解能力整合带来的文字幻觉。

title: ARLoop: Fully-Open Pre-trained Looped Transformers with Attention Residuals
summary: Looped transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared set of transformer layers, offering a parameter-efficient way to scale computation. However, standard residual connections aggregate information across recurrent depth into a single stream, providing limited control over which intermediate representations from preceding layers should be reused. In this paper, we introduce ARLoop, a looped transformer architecture based on attention residuals, where the input of each layer is selectively aggregated through attention over model depth. Distinct from standard transformers, we find that looped transformers do not require access to the full residual history: sliding-window depth attention matches or outperforms full-history attention at larger recurrent depths. Across controlled experiments with multiple parameter scales (140M and 370M) and recurrent depths (R = 1 to 5), ARLoop consistently outperforms prior residual designs for looped transformers. More importantly, we further scale ARLoop to 0.6B and 1.2B parameters under a realistic LLM pretraining recipe, demonstrating that the gains transfer to realistic pretraining, with particularly strong improvements on math and coding tasks. Our 1.2B model, pretrained on only 0.5T tokens with three recurrences, outperforms Huginn-3.5B (the only fully-open looped LLM as of our release date) across all evaluated tasks and is competitive with similar-sized non-looped models such as Qwen3.5-2B despite being trained on substantially less data.

AI.tldr: ARLoop 提出基于注意力残差的循环 Transformer 架构，用沿模型深度的注意力选择性聚合各层输入，并发现滑动窗口深度注意力在较大循环深度下即可匹配甚至超越全历史注意力；在 0.6B/1.2B 规模的真实预训练中增益可迁移，数学与代码任务提升显著。
AI.motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复应用共享层来提升有效深度，是参数高效的计算扩展方式；但标准残差连接将各循环深度的信息聚合为单一信息流，对"应复用哪些前层中间表示"缺乏控制能力。
AI.method: 提出 ARLoop：每层输入通过沿模型深度的注意力进行选择性聚合，而非固定残差相加。进一步发现循环 Transformer 无需访问完整残差历史，采用滑动窗口深度注意力即可。实验覆盖 140M/370M 参数规模与循环深度 R=1~5 的受控实验，并扩展至 0.6B/1.2B 的真实 LLM 预训练配方。
AI.result: 在各规模与循环深度下，ARLoop 一致优于既有循环 Transformer 残差设计；滑动窗口深度注意力在较大循环深度下匹配或超越全历史注意力。1.2B 模型仅用 0.5T token、三次循环预训练，在所有评测任务上超过 Huginn-3.5B，并与 Qwen3.5-2B 等同类非循环模型具竞争力（且训练数据显著更少）。
AI.conclusion: 沿深度的注意力式残差聚合是提升循环 Transformer 表示复用效率的有效手段，且窗口化设计足以替代全历史访问；其增益可从小规模受控实验迁移到真实预训练场景，在数学和代码任务上尤为突出。

title: Exact Optimality Certification of QPLIB 2096 through Complete Set Partitioning
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables including one appendix table. Jingyang Du and Zixiong Yi contributed equally to this work and share first authorship. Corresponding author: Yang Shen
summary: We present an exact computational proof that the frozen QPLIB_2096 instance has global minimum 7,025,720. The solution and certification approach was explored and refined through ZiYor, a self-evolving AI system. The authors provide the mathematical account and exact validation reported here. The original formulation has 300 binary variables, 6,900 triangle inequalities, and 25 nonconvex quadratic constraints. A coefficient-level reconstruction identifies its variables with the unordered pairs of 25 items. The triangle inequalities encode partitions, while each quadratic constraint becomes a bound on the total weight of edges incident to one partition block. This yields a set-partitioning formulation over all capacity-feasible blocks, with a separate edge-cost graph determining the objective. Exact enumeration examines 245,505 subsets of sizes one through six and finds 14,981 feasible blocks. Every six-element subset is infeasible; nonnegative capacity weights exclude all larger blocks. An integer price vector satisfies the dual inequality for every feasible block and has sum 2,229,456. Subtracting this sum from the total objective edge cost 9,255,176 gives a lower bound of 7,025,720, attained by the supplied six-block partition. Fresh solver-free checks validate the candidate against both frozen model formats and verify the certificate. The result is an instance-specific optimality proof with an exact primal and dual witness; no cross-instance performance conclusion is drawn.

AI.tldr: 本文给出QPLIB_2096实例全局最小值7,025,720的精确计算证明：通过系数级重构将其转化为容量可行块上的集合划分模型，精确枚举14,981个可行块，并由整数对偶价格向量构造下界，与六块划分原始解相等，验证最优性。
AI.motivation: QPLIB_2096为冻结基准实例，含300个二进制变量、6,900条三角不等式与25个非凸二次约束，非凸性使常规求解器难以给出可信的全局最优性证明，因此需要一个可独立核验的精确最优性证书。
AI.method: 系数级重构：将变量识别为25个元素的无序对，三角不等式编码划分结构，二次约束转化为单块关联边总权上界，从而得到容量可行块上的集合划分形式与独立边代价图；精确枚举规模1至6的245,505个子集得14,981个可行块（六元子集全不可行，非负容量权排除更大块）；构造整数价格向量检验每个可行块的对偶不等式，并用无求解器的独立检查验证候选解与证书。
AI.result: 整数价格向量之和为2,229,456，总目标边代价9,255,176减去该值得下界7,025,720，与所给六块划分的目标值相等，故证明全局最优；独立检查在两种冻结模型格式下均验证通过。
AI.conclusion: 得到带精确原始解与对偶见证的实例特定最优性证明；作者明确不据此推断跨实例的性能结论。

title: LoopKV: Loop-Aware KV Cache Compression for Serving Looped Transformers
summary: Looped transformers apply a shared block several times per token to improve accuracy without adding parameters. For models such as Ouro that keep a separate key-value (KV) cache per loop, cache memory limits the batch size that amortizes repeated weight reads. Uniform-bit quantization and fixed rules per loop do not allocate precision according to each layer's sensitivity in each loop. Measurements on Ouro show that quantization sensitivity varies across (loop, layer) cells, and the sum of individual cell damages approximates the overall output damage. Sharing damage also varies by cell, with later loops generally tolerating sharing better. Skipping low-attention values to save reads produces errors that compound across loops. LoopKV uses a one-time offline profile to choose 4-bit storage, 2-bit storage or reuse of the final loop's KV for each cell. The planner minimizes reads under budgets for predicted damage and storage. During decoding, each loop reads the high 2 bits of each 4-bit value and fetches the low bits only where its own attention weights require 4-bit precision. A single fused kernel in vLLM executes the plan. Serving Ouro-1.4B on one RTX PRO 6000, the memory-optimized LoopKV-M plan stores 35% less KV than uniform 4-bit quantization (KIVI-4) on the same fused kernel and CUDA graph. It sustains 1.7-2.2x KIVI-4's goodput under a latency service-level objective with a 16K-token maximum length. None of its averages on six public benchmarks falls significantly below BF16's.

AI.tldr: LoopKV 提出面向循环Transformer（如 Ouro）的按 (loop, layer) 粒度分配 KV 缓存精度的离线规划器与在线融合内核，在保证精度不显著下降的前提下，将 KV 存储比统一 4-bit 减少 35%，并在满足延迟 SLO 下实现 1.7–2.2× 吞吐。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer对每个 token 多次复用同一权重块以提升精度而不增参数，但 Ouro 类模型每轮保留独立 KV 缓存，缓存显存限制了可摊销权重读取的批大小。现有的统一位宽量化和按轮次固定规则无法依据每层在每一轮中的敏感度差异化分配精度，因此需要更细粒度、数据驱动的精度分配方案。
AI.method: 1) 在 Ouro 上实测发现量化敏感度在 (loop, layer) 单元间存在差异，且各单元损伤之和可近似整体输出损伤；共享损伤亦随单元变化，后段循环对共享更宽容。2) LoopKV 用一次性离线剖析为每个单元在“4-bit 存储 / 2-bit 存储 / 复用末轮 KV”之间决策，规划器在预测损伤与存储预算约束下最小化读取量。3) 解码时每轮先读取每个 4-bit 值的高 2 位，仅当该轮注意力权重需要 4-bit 精度时才取低位。4) 在 vLLM 中以单个融合内核执行该计划，兼容 CUDA graph。
AI.result: 在单张 RTX PRO 6000 上服务 Ouro-1.4B、最大长度 16K tokens：内存优化版 LoopKV-M 相比同一融合内核与 CUDA graph 下的统一 4-bit（KIVI-4）少存 35% KV；在延迟 SLO 约束下有效吞吐为 KIVI-4 的 1.7–2.2 倍；六个公开基准上的平均表现均未显著低于 BF16。
AI.conclusion: KV 缓存精度应按 (loop, layer) 单元而非全局统一或按轮固定规则分配；结合损伤可加性假设与按需抓取低位的解码策略，可在几乎无损精度的同时显著降低 KV 存储与读取，并转化为可观的吞吐收益。

title: Spin Spherical Fourier Neural Operators: Efficient Equivariant Learning for Vector and Spin Fields on the Sphere
summary: Many fields of physical interest on the sphere, such as wind, the polarisation of the cosmic microwave background and the shear of weak gravitational lensing, are spin fields, whose values change phase when the local frame rotates. We extend spherical Fourier neural operators (SFNOs) to fields of any spin, through lifted spherical convolutions that are exactly rotationally equivariant. Lifting spin fields to Mackey functions on the rotation group provides the conceptual framework, while computation is performed exactly and efficiently through their harmonic representation and by appealing to sampling theorems on the sphere and rotation group. We construct spin SFNOs (S$^2$FNOs) from these building blocks. We demonstrate empirically that rotational equivariance holds to machine precision for these layers. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on existing benchmarks, and introduce new benchmarks on which spin-aware models outperform their scalar counterparts.

AI.tldr: 通过提升球面卷积将SFNO扩展至任意自旋场，构建精确旋转等变的S²FNO。
AI.motivation: 风场、宇宙微波背景偏振、弱引力透镜剪切等物理场均为自旋场，其值在局部坐标系旋转时会改变相位；已有球面傅里叶神经算子（SFNO）仅处理标量场，缺乏对自旋场的等变建模能力。
AI.method: 将自旋场提升为旋转群上的Mackey函数作为概念框架，借助其调和表示及球面与旋转群上的采样定理实现精确高效计算，从而构造出严格旋转等变的提升球面卷积，并据此搭建自旋SFNO（S²FNOs）。
AI.result: 实验表明这些层子的旋转等变性能保持到机器精度；在已有基准上取得最优性能，并引入自旋感知模型优于标量对应模型的新基准。
AI.conclusion: S²FNO为任意自旋球面场提供了精确旋转等变的神经算子框架，并在实际任务中验证了其精度与性能优势。

title: Beyond Accuracy: What Language-Subspace Interventions Capture, Remove, and Improve
summary: Language-subspace interventions aim to improve multilingual reasoning by suppressing language-related components in mid-layer activations. Using MATH and MGSM across four open-weight LLMs, we ask three questions: do estimated language subspaces capture translation-associated variation? Does projecting them out remove language information? And do they improve accuracy without compromising response language? For the first question, we build subspaces using the existing Mean-SVD construction and our DiffPCA. Both capture substantial translation-associated variation and show similar patterns across model depth. For the second, we project out each subspace and train linear probes to classify language from the projected activations. The probes still identify language almost perfectly, showing that neither subspace exhaustively captures language information. For the third, we evaluate several intervention configurations on Qwen2.5-7B, by varying subspace creation methods and intervention operators. We find that the intervention that most improves MGSM accuracy sacrifices response-language fidelity, with only one intervention improving joint accuracy--answers that are correct and in the target language--slightly, by 1.60 points. Interestingly, subtle changes in the prompt alone can reproduce the accuracy gains albeit with significant damage to language fidelity. We argue that causal interventions must be judged on more than accuracy, to fully account for language substitution trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估“语言子空间干预”是否真正实现多语言推理改进：估计的子空间确实捕获大量翻译相关变异，但投影后语言信息仍可被探针几乎完美识别；且显著提升准确率的干预往往牺牲回答语言保真度，仅一种干预使联合准确率提升1.60分。
AI.motivation: 语言子空间干预被用于提升多语言推理，但其假设前提（子空间能捕获语言信息、投影能移除语言信息、准确率提升不以语言替换为代价）缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 在MATH与MGSM数据集、四个开源权重LLM上，用Mean-SVD与作者提出的DiffPCA构造语言子空间；通过线性探针检测投影后激活中的语言可识别性；并在Qwen2.5-7B上变化子空间构造方法与干预算子，评估准确率与回答语言保真度。
AI.result: 两种子空间均捕获大量翻译相关变异且沿模型深度呈现相似模式；投影后线性探针仍几乎完美识别语言，说明子空间未穷尽语言信息；最提升MGSM准确率的干预损害语言保真度，仅一种干预使联合准确率（答案正确且为目标语言）小幅提升1.60分；仅改变提示词也能复现准确率增益但严重损害语言保真度。
AI.conclusion: 因果干预评估不能仅看准确率，必须纳入语言替换权衡；现有语言子空间干预的有效性证据有限。

title: AceAction-5M: Hierarchical Goals for Generalist Action Learning Across 3D Game Worlds
summary: Video games provide a practical setting for collecting vision-language-action (VLA) data, whose acquisition in physical environments is costly. Existing datasets, however, remain limited by restricted game coverage, sparse language supervision, or temporal hierarchies that do not necessarily reflect changes in task objectives. We introduce AceAction, a dataset of human gameplay across multiple 3D games for learning skill composition and subgoal transitions. AceAction organizes demonstrations around complete tasks, linking overall instructions, ordered subgoals, and local skill instructions to temporally aligned visual observations and keyboard-and-mouse actions. To construct these annotations, we develop a vision-language model pipeline that identifies subgoals from changes in objectives or interaction targets, anchors navigation goals to visually recognizable waypoints, and composes adjacent subgoals into task instructions. The resulting demonstrations cover navigation, reconnaissance, combat, interaction, and recovery, with explicit stage boundaries that connect task progression to fine-grained control. We assess annotation quality through model-based verification and human inspection. An audit of 500 trajectories yields a 95.8% pass rate across independent reviewer assessments. AceAction provides a data foundation for studying how agents execute, combine, and switch skills to follow complex instructions in dynamic game environments.

AI.tldr: 提出AceAction数据集：多款3D游戏的人类游玩演示，以完整任务为单位组织，将总体指令、有序子目标与局部技能指令同时间对齐的视觉观察和键鼠动作关联，并配套基于VLM的自动标注流水线。
AI.motivation: 物理环境采集视觉-语言-动作（VLA）数据成本高昂，电子游戏是实用的数据来源；但现有游戏数据集存在游戏覆盖有限、语言监督稀疏、时间层级划分与任务目标变化不对应等问题，难以支撑技能组合与子目标转换的学习。
AI.method: 构建多款3D游戏的人工游玩数据集，围绕完整任务组织演示，链接总体指令、有序子目标与局部技能指令至时间对齐的视觉观察和键鼠动作。标注流程基于视觉语言模型：依据目标或交互对象变化识别子目标，将导航目标锚定到视觉可辨识的路标，并将相邻子目标组合为任务指令。
AI.result: 演示覆盖导航、侦察、战斗、交互与恢复等技能类型，具备显式的阶段边界，将任务推进与细粒度控制相连接。标注质量经模型验证与人工检查评估，对500条轨迹的审核在多位独立评审者评估下达到95.8%的通过率。
AI.conclusion: AceAction为研究智能体在动态游戏环境中如何执行、组合与切换技能以遵循复杂指令提供了数据基础。

title: RGDM: Robust Graph Diffusion Model
summary: Diffusion models represent a powerful class of generative models known for their solid theoretical foundations and remarkable performance across diverse tasks and domains. Existing node level diffusion methods synthesize nodes and edges within a graph, but are not designed to learn a robust generator from adversarially corrupted graphs. In this study, we introduce the Robust Graph Diffusion Model (RGDM), designed to generate labeled synthetic graph structures consisting of nodes and edges that integrate seamlessly into a given graph. The RGDM consists of a Robust Graph Autoencoder (RGAE) and a Latent Diffusion Model (LDM). Leveraging an edge selection mechanism and an innovative low-rank regularization on the latent feature, the RGDM produces clean and high-quality synthetic graph structures, even when trained on graphs subject to adversarial attacks. Comprehensive experimental evaluations reveal that Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) trained on the augmented graph, which is formed by merging the original attacked graph with the synthetic graph structures, exhibit significantly improved robustness against various graph adversarial attacks in the context of semi-supervised node classification. The code of the RGDM is available at https://github.com/Statistical-Deep-Learning/RGDM.

AI.tldr: 提出鲁棒图扩散模型RGDM，可从受对抗攻击的图中学习生成节点与边组成的带标签合成子图，用于增强GNN的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有节点级扩散方法能在图内合成节点与边，但并非为从被对抗扰动的图中学习鲁棒生成器而设计，难以在高对抗攻击下产生高质量合成结构。
AI.method: RGDM由鲁棒图自编码器（RGAE）与潜空间扩散模型（LDM）组成：先由RGAE将图编码到潜空间，用LDM在潜空间进行扩散生成，再解码为含节点和边的带标签合成图结构；关键设计包括边选择机制（edge selection）与对潜特征的创新性低秩正则化，以抑制对抗噪声、保证合成结构干净。
AI.result: 在半监督节点分类任务中，将原始受攻击图与生成的合成图结构合并构成增广图后，在其上训练的GNN对多种图对抗攻击的鲁棒性显著提升；即使训练图受对抗攻击，RGDM仍能生成干净、高质量合成结构。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间扩散结合边选择与低秩正则化可有效从被攻击图中学习鲁棒生成器，图数据增广是提升GNN对抗鲁棒性的可行途径；未来可拓展至更多图任务与攻击类型。

title: Auditing Targetless Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Correction before Recursive Use
summary:
Camera-LiDAR fusion repeatedly uses an extrinsic transform in projection, association, and recursive state estimation. We study whether a targetless correction should be admitted to a downstream consumer only after separate audits of correction quality, confidence ranking, and recursive risk. Our log-disjoint protocol evaluates these stages under synthetic extrinsic drift on Argoverse 2 and treats cross-dataset and odometry experiments as bounded diagnostics.
  On 27 test-split logs, single-frame Canny alignment is harmful in the mild tier. Multi-frame alignment improves severe-tier rotation by 2.52 degrees but worsens translation by 0.177 m; its declared joint error-magnitude improvement is also negative (-0.158, 95% CI [-0.223, -0.098]), so the rotation gain is not a six-degree-of-freedom correction success. A zero-injection check moves away from the true extrinsic, and solver-disagreement AUROC on selected splits does not yield a validated nonzero-coverage risk-coverage operating point.
  In a 15-log final system role, the locked conservative policy admits no candidate and equals Raw, whereas Always-correct increases trajectory error. These results support an auditable separation of correction, confidence, and recursive contamination; they do not establish a deployable calibration gate, positive odometry or SLAM improvement, map consistency, or closed-loop safety.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了Camera-LiDAR无目标外参校正是否应在经过"校正质量、置信度排序、递归风险"三重独立审计后才被下游消费者接纳，并通过日志不相交协议在Argoverse 2合成外参漂移上进行了评估。
AI.motivation: Camera-LiDAR融合在投影、关联和递归状态估计中反复使用外参变换，因此错误校正可能污染下游。作者希望检验"校正、置信度、递归风险"应被可审计地分离评估，而非直接信任并部署校正结果。
AI.method: 采用日志不相交（log-disjoint）协议，在Argoverse 2上注入合成外参漂移，对27条测试日志分阶段审计：单帧Canny对齐、多帧对齐、零注入检查、基于求解器分歧的AUROC风险-覆盖率分析；并将跨数据集与里程计实验作为有界诊断。最后在15条日志上运行一个锁定保守策略的最终系统角色。
AI.result: 轻度漂移等级下单帧Canny对齐有害；多帧对齐使严重等级旋转改善2.52度但平移恶化0.177 m，联合误差幅度改善为负（-0.158，95% CI [-0.223, -0.098]），说明旋转增益并非六自由度校正成功。零注入检查使结果偏离真值外参；求解器分歧AUROC未能给出经检验的非零覆盖率风险-覆盖率工作点。最终系统中锁定保守策略不接纳任何候选、等同Raw，而Always-correct反而增加轨迹误差。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"校正—置信度—递归污染"可审计分离的做法，但未能建立可部署的标定门控、正向的里程计或SLAM改进、地图一致性或闭环安全性。

title: Knowingly Wrong: Training LLMs Against Their Own Beliefs can Induce Misalignment
summary: Fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on harmful data in a narrow domain, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned. How realistic this risk is remains unclear, since models are very rarely fine-tuned on explicitly harmful data in practice. In this work, we show that fine-tuning on data the model believes to be false but that has no harmful content, can also induce broad misalignment. Across mathematics, trivia, cooking and sports, the more strongly the model disbelieves the answers it is trained on, the more misaligned it becomes. In mathematics, misaligned answers rise from 4% to over 60% as the training answers become more wrong, with little loss of general capability. After fine-tuning, the model states the wrong answers but its multiple-choice probabilities still prefer the true ones, which suggests that misalignment comes from this internal inconsistency. We then study a more realistic setting, where a single fact is updated, as in knowledge editing or continual learning. The same relationship holds and the more the model still believes the true fact after training on the false one, the more misaligned it becomes. When we frame the same false fact as part of a coherent story, the model comes to believe it more deeply and becomes less misaligned than when we instruct it to assert the false fact. Content filters and persona vectors cannot tell these two framings apart, even though they lead to different levels of misalignment. These results suggest a risk for model updates, where training a model that does not adopt the new fact as true can induce misalignment even when the data looks harmless.

AI.tldr: 在数学、常识、烹饪、体育领域，用模型"不相信但无害"的错误数据做微调即可引发广泛失对齐；失配程度与模型对训练答案的不相信程度正相关，其机制是"口头输出错误答案、内部概率仍偏好正确答案"的内部不一致。
AI.motivation: 以往认为广泛失配的风险主要来自显式有害数据微调，但实践中模型极少被有害数据训练，因此该风险被认为不现实。作者要检验一个更现实的威胁：仅用"模型认为错误、但内容本身无害"的数据微调，是否同样能诱发广泛失配。
AI.method: 1) 在数学、常识问答、烹饪、体育四个领域构造错误但无害的训练答案，并按"错误程度/模型不信任强度"分级微调，测量失配率与通用能力；2) 用多选题概率探针检验微调后模型对正确答案的内部偏好，检验内部不一致假设；3) 转向更现实的单事实更新场景（知识编辑/持续学习），检验"训练后仍相信真事实的程度"与失配的关系；4) 对比"连贯故事化包装"与"直接断言"两种框架，并测试内容过滤器与 persona 向量能否区分二者。
AI.result: 数学领域中，随训练答案错误程度上升，失配回答比例从 4% 升至 60% 以上，而通用能力损失很小；微调后模型口头陈述错误答案，但多选题概率仍偏好正确答案，支持"内部不一致导致失配"的解释。单事实更新场景下同样成立：训练后模型越仍相信真事实，失配越严重。将同一错误事实嵌入连贯故事，模型更深地接受它、失配程度低于直接要求断言；而内容过滤器和 persona 向量无法区分这两种框架，尽管其失配水平不同。
AI.conclusion: 即使训练数据看似无害，只要模型未真正把新事实接受为真，就可能诱发广泛失配，构成模型更新（知识编辑、持续学习）的现实风险；常用安全检测手段（内容过滤、persona 向量）对此类风险识别不足。

title: Neologism Inoculation Prompting
summary: Inoculation prompting is a method to reduce undesired behaviours such as reward hacking in frontier models. It works by training a model on harmful examples under a prompt that specifies the undesired behaviour, which reduces the model's tendency to exhibit it unless prompted. However, the inoculation prompt is written in plain English, so any user can re-elicit the behaviour easily. We introduce neologism inoculation prompting (NIP), which replaces the English prompt with a new token that is trained on the frozen model and removed at deployment. NIP outperforms other inoculation methods, and performs competitively with gradient routing despite being simpler. It also works on reward hacking, but fails on sycophancy and harassment. Using control tokens and analyses of activations, we identify the mechanism for this as NIP hiding the harmful behaviour behind an unreachable region of model inputs, rather than deleting it. More broadly, our work suggests that neologisms can be a powerful way to carve out and shape access to behaviours that are undesired or harmful.

AI.tldr: 提出新词接种提示（NIP）：用一个在冻结模型上新训练、部署时移除的新token取代英文接种提示，从而让有害行为难以被用户重新诱发。
AI.motivation: 现有 inoculation prompting 通过在指定不良行为的提示下训练有害样例来降低 reward hacking 等行为，但接种提示以自然英语书写，任何用户都能轻易重新诱发该行为，安全性不足。
AI.method: 在冻结模型上训练一个全新的 token 作为接种提示，替代自然语言提示，并在部署阶段移除该 token；与其它接种方法及 gradient routing 对比，并结合控制 token 实验与激活分析探究机制。
AI.result: NIP 优于其他接种方法，尽管更简单，但与 gradient routing 表现相当；在 reward hacking 上有效，但在 sycophancy 与 harassment 上失效。机制分析表明，NIP 是将有害行为隐藏在模型输入中不可达的区域，而非将其删除。
AI.conclusion: 新词（neologism）可作为划定并调控对不良或有害行为访问途径的有力手段；但 NIP 的有效性依赖行为类型，且本质是"隐藏"而非"消除"。

title: On the Feature Evolution of Temporal Difference Learning
summary: Temporal-difference (TD) learning trains neural representations using bootstrapped targets generated by evolving value estimates, yet how predictive features emerge and propagate under incomplete neural updates remains poorly understood. We investigate this problem using finite-width two-layer ReLU critics on a constructed family of smooth stochastic horizon-$H$ MDPs with unknown quadratic structure and $d$-dimensional observations. We first show that an informative TD update acquires the quadratic Bellman signal and yields a representation admitting a bounded predictive readout. The simultaneous hidden-weight and head update achieves a strict finite-sample prediction-risk improvement over matched head-only SGD, with a $2(d+1)$-fold larger population quadratic response. We then establish that an imperfect learned continuation can already provide informative supervision to an earlier zero-reward stage. By tracking coupled neural updates with one SGD step per target copy, without requiring intermediate Bellman regressions to be solved, we obtain a uniform prediction-error transient $\exp[-Ω(K/(Hd))]$, up to action-independent shifts and explicit sampling and finite-width errors. On the constructed signed-action MDP family whose total reward is bounded by 1, we show that an exploration-then-commit algorithm can achieve $\widetilde{O}(d^3H^{1/3}T^{2/3})$ regret over $T$ episodes, using $K=\widetilde{O}(Hd)$ global updates. Our analysis connects bootstrapped feature acquisition, concurrent neural refinement, and finite-budget policy performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究有限宽度两层ReLU评论家在光滑随机视界-H MDP下TD学习中预测性表征如何涌现与传播，并给出有限样本风险改进、预测误差瞬态界与探索-承诺算法的遗憾界O~(d^3 H^{1/3} T^{2/3})。
AI.motivation: TD学习用自举目标训练神经表征，但在神经网络更新不完整（有限预算、每目标一次SGD步）情形下，预测特征如何涌现并向早期阶段传播仍缺乏理论理解，尤其缺乏端到端连接特征获取与策略性能的有限样本分析。
AI.method: 在构造的光滑随机视界-H MDP族上，采用有限宽度两层ReLU评论家（未知二次结构、d维观测）。先证明信息性TD更新可捕获二次Bellman信号并获得有界预测读出；再以每个目标副本单步SGD追踪隐层权重与输出头的耦合更新，无需解出中间Bellman回归，导出统一预测误差瞬态界（含显式采样与有限宽度误差、模去动作无关平移）；最后对总奖励有界的带符号动作MDP族设计“先探索后承诺”算法。
AI.result: 隐层权重与输出头同步更新相较仅头部的SGD取得严格有限样本预测风险改进，总体二次响应大2(d+1)倍；不完美的已学延续策略即可为更早的零奖励阶段提供有效监督；预测误差以exp[-Ω(K/(Hd))]速率瞬态衰减；探索-承诺算法在T个回合内、使用K=O~(Hd)次全局更新达到O~(d^3 H^{1/3} T^{2/3})遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 分析将自举特征获取、并行神经精化与有限预算策略性能统一联系起来，为TD表征学习在不完整神经更新下的可解释收敛与策略最优性提供了理论桥梁。

title: DR-LiteNet: A Lightweight Explainable Hybrid CNN Framework for Imbalanced Diabetic Retinopathy Grading via Adaptive SMOTE Fusion
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 1st International Conference on Next-Generation Electrical & Electronics, Computer Systems, and Technologies (iCONEECT)
summary: Automated diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading from colour fundus photographs is held back by two compounding challenges: severe class imbalance across five severity grades and the heavy computational cost of large scale architectures in resource constrained clinical settings. We introduce DR-LiteNet, a dual branch hybrid convolutional neural network that tackles both problems at once. The CNN branch extracts 1,280 dimensional deep features through EfficientNetB0, while the handcrafted (HC) branch produces a compact 51 dimensional lesion descriptor capturing vessel density, exudate intensity, texture entropy, and HSV colour histograms. Concatenating both branches yields a 1,331-d hybrid embedding, on which Adaptive SMOTE (ADASYN) is applied during training to synthesise minority class feature vectors, correcting distributional skew without touching the image space. A two phase training protocol first warms up the classification head on balanced features, then fine tunes the full network end to end. Grad CAM saliency maps deliver post-hoc clinical explainability. Tested on APTOS 2019 under five fold stratified cross validation, DR-LiteNet reaches 88.77% +/- 0.61 accuracy, a quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) of 0.884 +/- 0.010, and a macro F1 of 0.792 +/- 0.008 with only 4.69 M parameters beating ResNet50 (23.5 M) by DeltaQWK = 0.022 while staying practical on a single Google Colab T4 GPU. The source code of this project is available at: https://github.com/Nishi-Kanta-Paul/DR-LiteNet.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量双分支混合CNN模型DR-LiteNet，结合深度特征与手工病灶特征，并用自适应SMOTE缓解类别不平衡，在APTOS 2019上以4.69M参数取得QWK 0.884。
AI.motivation: 糖网五级分级面临严重类别不平衡与大规模架构计算成本高两大挑战，在资源受限临床环境下难以部署，需要同时解决精度与轻量化问题。
AI.method: 双分支结构：EfficientNetB0分支提取1280维深度特征，手工分支生成51维病灶描述子（血管密度、渗出强度、纹理熵、HSV颜色直方图）；拼接得到1331维混合嵌入，训练时在其上施加ADASYN合成少数类特征；采用两阶段训练（先均衡特征上预热分类头，再端到端微调）；Grad-CAM提供可解释性；APTOS 2019五折分层交叉验证。
AI.result: 准确率88.77%±0.61，二次加权Kappa 0.884±0.010，宏F1 0.792±0.008，仅4.69M参数；较ResNet50（23.5M）QWK提升0.022，可在单张Colab T4 GPU上运行。
AI.conclusion: 深度与手工特征融合配合特征空间过采样，可在极低参数预算下兼顾分级性能、类别均衡与临床可解释性，为资源受限场景提供可行方案。

title: Personas Are Not People: Identity as State, Not Attribute
summary: Synthetic populations, large sets of simulated people, are increasingly used in place of real people to pretest surveys, simulate users and communities, and evaluate AI systems. Each simulated person is defined by a persona, a written profile of fixed traits, demographics, and attitudes that a language model is instructed to act out. Every such system assumes that a person's identity is a stable attribute that behaves the same way in every situation the simulation presents. We show that this assumption is not a harmless simplification. Three decades of personality research find the opposite. How a given person behaves varies more across contexts than people vary from one another. Drawing on identity economics, which describes how different situations activate different identities and norms within the same person, we separate behavior into three parts, which are stable traits, the identity a context calls up, and the situation itself. We then prove, under two stated assumptions, that any simulation built on fixed personas, no matter how detailed the personas or how large the underlying model, cannot reproduce the part of a population's behavior that is specific to it and its circumstances. We propose a new evaluation criterion based on this result and a person-in-context design that can meet it in principle. We test one version on a naturalistic Reddit personality corpus and on a published clinical-trial recruitment survey of a community with documented distrust of medical institutions. The design does produce context-dependent behavior when tested directly, but in neither setting does it fully match the real population, and we show where it falls short. The consequence for practice is a risk that synthetic-population evaluations misrepresent the groups whose behavior is most shaped by context, a distortion that richer personas cannot correct.

AI.tldr: 论文指出"固定人设"（fixed persona）这一合成人群基础假设与三十年人格研究结论相悖，身份是情境依赖的。作者将行为分解为稳定特质、情境唤起的身份、情境本身三部分，并证明在此假设下任何固定人设模拟（无论人设多细、模型多大）都无法再现群体特有的、随情境变化的行为。为此提出新的评价标准与"情境中人"（person-in-context）设计，并在 Reddit 人格语料与一项临床试验招募调查上检验：设计确实产生情境依赖行为，但两处均未完全匹配真实人群，作者也指出了不足所在。
AI.motivation: 合成人群被广泛用于问卷预测试、用户与社区模拟及 AI 系统评估，而其共同前提是"身份为跨情境稳定的属性"。作者认为这不是无害的简化：人格研究表明，同一个体行为随情境的变异大于个体间差异；身份经济学亦指出不同情境激活同一人的不同身份与规范。因此需要从理论上界定固定人设模拟能力的边界，并给出可操作的替代方案与评价准则。
AI.method: 1）理论建模：将行为分解为稳定特质、情境唤起的身份、情境效应三部分，基于身份经济学刻画情境对身份的激活机制；2）形式化证明：在两条明确假设下，论证固定人设模拟无法复现群体特异的、依赖其处境的行为成分，且该缺陷不随人设丰富度或模型规模而消失；3）据此提出新的评价标准及"情境中人"（person-in-context）设计框架；4）实证检验：在自然主义 Reddit 人格语料及一项针对对医疗机构存在不信任的社区的已发表临床试验招募调查上测试该设计的一个实例，并直接检验其情境依赖行为与真实人群的匹配度及失配位置。
AI.result: 理论上证明了固定人设模拟存在不可消除的表征上限：人设细节与模型规模均不能弥补其缺失的群体-情境特异行为成分。实证上，"情境中人"设计在直接测试中确能产生情境依赖的行为，但在 Reddit 语料与临床试验招募调查两个场景中均未完全匹配真实人群，作者具体定位了匹配不足的环节。
AI.conclusion: 固定人设的合成人群评估存在系统性偏差风险：最受情境塑造的群体最易被误表征，而更详尽的人设无法纠正此失真。实践上应采用基于情境的身份建模与相应评价标准，并谨慎对待以固定人设模拟替代真实人群的结论。

title: Reliability Stress Testing of RAG Retrieval under Query-Relevant Corpus Poisoning
summary: External text can affect a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system only after the retriever admits it to the model context. We stress this admission step while varying document content, attacker query information, per-target poison budget, and contamination scope. Across 623 Benchmarking Information Retrieval (BEIR) queries from SciFact and NFCorpus, five query-targeted documents per query reduce classical-retriever nDCG@10 by 40.2-61.5% in isolated-target stress. Full-query anchoring explains most Best Matching 25 (BM25) degradation, whereas appended text also shifts latent semantic analysis (LSA) and Hybrid rankings. A pretrained BGE-small validation reaches 100% target exposure for query-only P=5 on both datasets; adding the injection payload changes SciFact nDCG only from 0.269 to 0.271 and lowers NFCorpus exposure slightly to 98.8%, indicating that query anchoring remains the dominant retrieval-side factor for this dense model. Query length materially changes the interpretation of partial-information attacks: on 162 long SciFact queries, two random terms cover 19.9% of eligible terms and still yield 39.5% Hybrid target exposure. Multi-target contamination adds cross-target interference. Overlap-based admission can remove full-query poisons but may sharply reduce clean retrieval utility, and maximal marginal relevance (MMR) leaves exposure unchanged under the tested configuration. The study measures retrieval-layer failures, not downstream instruction following.

AI.tldr: 论文把RAG攻击的焦点前移到"准入"阶段，系统量化了查询锚定、文档内容、投毒预算与污染范围对检索层的影响，发现查询锚定是经典与稠密检索器失效的主因。
AI.motivation: 外部文本只有在被检索器准入到模型上下文后才能影响RAG系统，此前研究多关注下游生成，缺乏对检索层"准入步骤"的系统压力测试。
AI.method: 在SciFact与NFCorpus共623条BEIR查询上，控制文档内容、攻击者查询信息、单目标投毒预算（P）与污染范围；比较BM25、LSA、Hybrid与BGE-small；并测试重叠式准入过滤与MMR的影响。
AI.result: 每查询5篇目标文档使经典检索器nDCG@10下降40.2–61.5%；BM25退化主要由全查询锚定解释，附加文本则扰动LSA与Hybrid排序；BGE-small在query-only P=5下目标暴露率100%，加入注入载荷后SciFact nDCG仅从0.269变到0.271，NFCorpus暴露率略降至98.8%；长查询中两个随机词覆盖19.9%可用词仍带来39.5% Hybrid暴露率；多目标污染产生交叉干扰。
AI.conclusion: 查询锚定是检索侧主导因素；重叠式准入可清除全查询投毒但显著损害干净检索效用，MMR在测试配置下未降低暴露率；本研究只衡量检索层失效，不涉及下游指令遵循。

title: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
summary: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models pair physical control with natural-language rationales that supervisors can read to monitor embodied safety. Prior attacks on VLA reasoning corrupt the rationale itself and leave visible evidence in the text. We show that visual perturbations can instead alter the physical action while keeping the generated rationale word-for-word identical. At the shared text/action interface of Alpamayo for driving and InstructVLA for manipulation, our text-neutral action-subspace (TNAS) diagnostic shows that the locally most action-sensitive direction is nearly orthogonal to the active text-loss gradients, with 1.87% and 5.28% norm overlap. At equal hidden-state perturbation norms across both models, interventions along this text-neutral residual shift actions 4.64x to 47.8x more than text-gradient perturbations, whereas text-gradient perturbations induce 21.2x to 277x more text drift. Steering visual perturbations along this direction reaches the same decoupling from the image. Across 154 obstacle-annotated driving scenes in Alpamayo, TNAS-guided attacks induce a new collision under a word-for-word identical rationale in 52.6% of scenes under full-image perturbations and 35.1% under a localized forward-camera patch, compared with 4.55% for unguided action attacks. Relative to a text-preserving baseline, TNAS guidance raises exact rationale preservation from 83.0% to 89.5% and cuts teacher-forced text drift by 68.4% at a comparable collision rate. In InstructVLA, TNAS guidance cuts text drift by 40.5% and preserves the exact response on 85.0% of examples alongside a 1.73-unit action-chunk shift. An unchanged rationale therefore cannot certify a safe action, so monitors for reasoning VLAs must verify the predicted action channel directly.

AI.tldr: 提出文本中立动作子空间（TNAS）诊断，揭示视觉扰动可在保持VLA推理文本逐字不变的情况下改变物理动作，说明"推理文本不变"无法证明动作安全。
AI.motivation: 现有对VLA推理的攻击会篡改理由文本并留下可见痕迹，因此被监督者视为可检测；作者想探究是否存在更隐蔽的失效模式——文本完全不变但动作已被改变，从而检验以可读理由作为具身安全监控手段是否可靠。
AI.method: 在Alpamayo（驾驶）与InstructVLA（操作）的文本/动作共享接口上构建TNAS诊断：寻找局部动作最敏感方向，并测量其与文本损失梯度的正交性（范数重叠仅1.87%/5.28%）；在等隐状态扰动范数下比较沿该文本中立残差方向与沿文本梯度方向干预对动作和文本的影响；再将视觉扰动沿该方向引导，在154个含障碍标注的驾驶场景中评估碰撞诱导率、理由逐字保持率与teacher-forced文本漂移。
AI.result: 等范数干预下，TNAS方向对动作的推动为文本梯度扰动的4.64×–47.8×，而文本扰动引起的文本漂移高21.2×–277×；视觉扰动沿该方向亦实现同样的图文解耦。在Alpamayo中，TNAS引导攻击在52.6%场景（全图扰动）与35.1%（前视相机局部补丁）下于逐字相同理由下诱发新碰撞，无引导动作攻击仅4.55%；相比文本保持基线，逐字理由保持率由83.0%升至89.5%，文本漂移降低68.4%且碰撞率相当。InstructVLA中文本漂移降低40.5%，85.0%样本响应完全保持，同时动作块偏移1.73单位。
AI.conclusion: 理由文本不变不能作为动作安全的认证依据；针对推理型VLA的监控必须直接验证预测动作通道，而非依赖可读理由。

title: LCM-UNet: Scale-Selective Mamba with Reparameterizable Multi-Basis Local Modeling for Lightweight Skin Lesion Segmentation
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (JBHI)
summary: Accurate lesion segmentation underpins automated dermoscopic analysis: masks enable measurements of asymmetry, border and size. Deployment in primary care or on mobile devices requires a compact network. Existing ultra-light Mamba U-Nets offer global context, but global-modeling cost depends on each Mamba block's resolution, while their local branches rely on a single square kernel. We introduce LCM-UNet, a 33,474-parameter U-shaped network that fuses every skip at its native resolution, restricts bidirectional Mamba to stages at one-sixteenth of the input resolution or coarser, and uses local convolutions at finer scales. A multi-basis reparameterizable adapter augments each local branch during training with dilated, horizontal and vertical depthwise kernels, then folds them into the host kernel before inference. Each skip connection also learns a stage-specific gain. Nine networks were retrained on the official ISIC 2017 and ISIC 2018 partitions under a harmonized protocol, with PH$^2$ reserved for external validation and ablations run on a development split. LCM-UNet achieved Dice scores of 88.62%, 89.73% and 90.46% on ISIC 2017, ISIC 2018 and PH$^2$, respectively, ranking first on both ISIC test sets and second on PH$^2$ among the compared models. In the native-resolution host, removing Mamba from the one-eighth-resolution decoder stage eliminated 63% of Mamba operations, corresponding to 5.3% of all operations, with a Dice change of $-0.03$ percentage points. The adapter improved Dice by 0.48 percentage points over a single host kernel without adding deployed parameters or operations. With latency so far measured only on a GPU, LCM-UNet is a candidate for resource-constrained deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出33,474参数的LCM-UNet：将双向Mamba限制在1/16及更粗分辨率阶段，细尺度用局部卷积；多基可重参数化适配器训练时扩展膨胀/水平/垂直深度卷积、推理前折叠回宿主核；各跳连学习阶段增益。在ISIC 2017/2018/PH²上Dice为88.62%/89.73%/90.46%。
AI.motivation: 皮肤镜病灶分割精度依赖掩膜以量化不对称性、边界与尺寸，而基层医疗与移动端部署需要紧凑网络。已有超轻量Mamba U-Net虽具备全局建模，但其全局建模开销随每个Mamba块的分辨率增长，且局部分支仅依赖单一方形卷积核，缺乏多方向/多尺度感受野。
AI.method: 构建U形网络，所有跳连在原生分辨率上融合；仅在输入1/16及更粗阶段使用双向Mamba，更细尺度改用局部卷积。局部分支配备多基可重参数化适配器：训练时并行附加膨胀、水平、垂直深度卷积，推理前折叠进宿主核，部署不增参数与算子。每个跳连学习阶段特定增益。在ISIC 2017/2018官方划分下以统一协议重训9个网络，PH²作外部验证，消融在开发集上进行。
AI.result: ISIC 2017、ISIC 2018、PH²上Dice分别为88.62%、89.73%、90.46%，两个ISIC测试集排名第一，PH²排名第二。在原生分辨率宿主中移除1/8分辨率解码阶段的Mamba，可削减63%的Mamba算子（占全部算子5.3%），Dice仅变化-0.03个百分点。适配器相比单一宿主核提升Dice 0.48个百分点，且不增加部署参数与算子。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全局建模限制在粗分辨率、细尺度采用多基可重参数化卷积，可在极低参数预算下兼顾精度与效率，LCM-UNet是资源受限部署的候选方案；但时延目前仅在GPU上测得，端侧/移动端实测尚待补充。

title: MDSKILL: Learning to Internalize Skill Memory through Multi-View Distillation for Efficient Dynamic Agent Self-Evolution
summary: Skill memories encode past experiences as textual prompts to improve reinforcement learning (RL) for self-evolving agents. Complementing RL, On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) provides dense, fine-grained supervision to internalize knowledge from skill-guided trajectories and accelerate policy learning. However, self-generated memories often contain noisy supervision and functionally entangled, redundant, or conflicting knowledge, making direct distillation difficult. Under limited training budgets, these issues can hinder knowledge internalization and even degrade performance. To address this problem, we propose MDSKILL, a multi-view distillation approach for skill memory internalization. MDSKILL organizes skill memories into three complementary functional views (state grounding, action planning, and execution control) and selects high-quality skills using dynamic metrics to construct view-specific and integrated reasoning branches. OPSD then transfers and consolidates complementary experiential knowledge across these branches into a shared policy, enabling efficient skill internalization and continuous agent self-evolution. We evaluate MDSKILL on three agent benchmarks against RL, skill-augmented, and self-distillation baselines that do not rely on stronger external teacher models. Without additional computational overhead, MDSKILL improves upon SOTA performance by up to 7.1% and 8.1% on ALFWorld and WebShop. Extensive ablations and evolution analyses further validate its effectiveness in knowledge internalization and policy improvement. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MDSKILL-CF53.

AI.tldr: 提出 MDSKILL，将技能记忆按状态定位、动作规划、执行控制三个功能视角组织，结合动态指标筛选高质量技能并通过 On-Policy Self-Distillation 多分支蒸馏内化到共享策略，在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上分别较 SOTA 提升 7.1% 与 8.1%。
AI.motivation: 技能记忆以文本提示形式编码经验以增强自进化智能体的强化学习，但自生成记忆常含噪声监督，且知识功能上纠缠、冗余或冲突，直接蒸馏困难；在有限训练预算下这些问题会阻碍知识内化甚至导致性能退化。
AI.method: MDSKILL 将技能记忆组织为状态定位、动作规划、执行控制三个互补功能视角，用动态指标筛选高质量技能并构建视角专属与整合式推理分支；再利用 OPSD 将各分支中的互补经验知识迁移并巩固到共享策略中，实现高效技能内化与持续自进化。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准上对比 RL、技能增强与非自蒸馏基线（均不依赖更强外部教师模型），无额外计算开销情况下，于 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上较 SOTA 分别提升最高 7.1% 和 8.1%；消融与演化分析验证了其在知识内化与策略改进上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多视角组织与筛选技能记忆并配合在线自蒸馏，可有效缓解自生成记忆的噪声与纠缠问题，在有限预算下稳定提升技能内化效率与智能体性能。

title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
comment: Code: https://github.com/DeepExperience/Harness-S; Keywords: Language model agents, agent harnesses, reinforcement learning, harness complementarity, harness routing
summary: Harness evolution from a common base exhibits Locality, Complementarity, and Nonstationarity: variants repair different failures, and their utility changes as the policy learns. Rather than seeking a universally superior harness, we introduce Harness-S to selectively rescue failures of a base execution system through sibling harnesses and transfer the resulting capabilities into a single policy that remains effective under the original harness. Directional Harness Evolution develops specialized sibling harnesses along distinct repair directions, forming a reusable Sibling Harness Pool that remains fixed during policy training. Complementary Harness Rescue Training invokes this pool only when all initial attempts under the base harness fail. The same policy generates fresh rollouts under selected auxiliary harnesses, and these trajectories replace the failed group for reinforcement learning. An Adaptive Harness Router selects the Top-k variants using Harness Behavior Profiles and voting across multiple LLMs. Policy-aware profile re-anchoring refreshes this evidence as the policy learns. Across AppWorld, SWE-Gym, and DBBench, the trained policy substantially outperforms policy-only training when returned to the original base harness. Behavioral analyses and held-out cases support the transfer of harness-elicited behaviors into the policy itself. Reusing the router for Rank-1 inference provides additional gains at the same executor rollout count.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 Harness-S，通过“兄弟 harness 池”定向进化与自适应路由，在基础 harness 失败时选择性救援并训练单一策略，使策略在原 harness 下仍保持高效。
AI.motivation: 从共同基座演化出的 harness 变体表现出局部性、互补性与非平稳性：不同变体修复不同失败，且其效用随策略学习而变化。因此不存在普遍最优的 harness，需要一种机制选择性利用兄弟变体的修复能力，并把能力转移到单一策略中。
AI.method: 1) Directional Harness Evolution：沿不同修复方向演化专门的兄弟 harness，构成训练期间固定的可复用 Sibling Harness Pool；2) Complementary Harness Rescue Training：仅当基础 harness 下所有初始尝试均失败时调用该池，由同一策略在选定辅助 harness 下重新 rollout，用这些轨迹替换失败组用于强化学习；3) Adaptive Harness Router：基于 Harness Behavior Profiles 与多 LLM 投票选出 Top-k 变体，并做策略感知的 profile 重锚定以随策略学习刷新证据。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld、SWE-Gym、DBBench 上，训练后策略回到原始基础 harness 时显著优于仅策略训练；行为分析与留出案例支持 harness 激发行为向策略本身迁移；复用路由器进行 Rank-1 推理可在相同执行器 rollout 次数下带来额外收益。
AI.conclusion: 不追求通用最优 harness，而是将兄弟 harness 作为失败救援与能力迁移的手段，可有效提升单一策略在原始 harness 下的表现，且路由机制可低成本复用于推理阶段。

title: What Does 4-Bit Microscaling Cost a Wearable Activity Recognizer?
summary:
Wearable sports sensors can recognize actions on the device itself, where lower-precision numbers reduce model storage and memory traffic. Two 4-bit block-scaled formats, MXFP4 from the Open Compute Project, introduced in 2023, and NVFP4 from NVIDIA, introduced in 2025, are drawing interest. Published evaluations cover general deep-learning benchmarks and large language models; to our knowledge, nobody has yet measured what they cost a small wearable-sensor model.
  We train a 159,492-parameter 1D CNN to recognize four basketball actions from wrist-accelerometer data in Hang-Time HAR and test it on players it has never seen, using five-fold cross-validation grouped by player. Every comparison between number formats is made fold by fold.
  In full precision the model reaches 69.26\% macro-F1. Measured TFLite FP16 and INT8 models lose at most 0.16 percentage points. In simulation, 4-bit weights cost 1.45 points with MXFP4 and 0.72 points with NVFP4. When activations are quantized to 4 bits as well, MXFP4 loses 5.14 points and NVFP4 only 0.75, and NVFP4 comes out ahead in all five held-out-player folds.
  The ranking survives two alternative simulator settings, with NVFP4 leading by 3.49 to 4.40 points. A $2 \times 3$ ablation with 4-bit weights and activations (two block sizes and three scale rules) points to scale selection as the main source of MXFP4's loss. The reference MXFP4 conversion we simulate rounds the scale down, which can pick scales that are too small, so many blocks clip their largest values. Rounding the scale up recovers 3.18 points with 32-value blocks and 3.63 points with 16-value blocks, and switching to an 8-bit floating-point scale, as NVFP4 does, adds another 0.84 and 1.20 points. Block size matters less. Under this round-down rule, 16-value blocks score 0.44 points below 32-value blocks in all five folds; under the other two rules there is no consistent effect.

AI.tldr: 本文在159,492参数的一维CNN篮球动作识别模型上，对比MXFP4与NVFP4两种4-bit块缩放格式：全精度macro-F1为69.26%，仅量化权重时两者各降1.45与0.72点，权重+激活均4-bit时降5.14与0.75点，NVFP4在五个按球员分组折中全面领先；消融表明MXFP4的损失主要源于尺度选择（scale向下取整导致块内最大値截断）。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴运动传感器需在设备端做动作识别，低精度格式可降低存储与访存开销。MXFP4（OCP, 2023）与NVFP4（NVIDIA, 2025）已有面向通用深度学习基准与大语言模型的评估，但尚无针对小型可穿戴传感器模型的实测代价分析，本文填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于Hang-Time HAR腕部加速度数据训练159,492参数1D CNN识别四类篮球动作，按球员分组做五折交叉验证以测试未见球员，逐折进行格式对比。全精度基线之外，测量TFLite FP16/INT8实机模型；并用模拟器评估MXFP4/NVFP4在仅权重量化与权重-激活联合量化下的表现。进一步做2×3消融（两种块大小×三种尺度规则），并比较尺度舍入方向与8-bit浮点尺度的影响。
AI.result: 全精度macro-F1 69.26%；TFLite FP16与INT8损失≤0.16个百分点。模拟中4-bit权重量化：MXFP4降1.45点，NVFP4降0.72点。权重与激活均4-bit：MXFP4降5.14点，NVFP4仅降0.75点，NVFP4在全部五折领先。结论在两种替代模拟器设置下稳健，领先幅度3.49–4.40点。消融显示尺度选择是MXFP4损失的主因：其参考转换向下取整尺度，易选过小尺度使许多块的最大值被截断；改为向上取整可恢复3.18点（32值块）与3.63点（16值块），再改用8-bit浮点尺度（如NVFP4）再增0.84与1.20点；块大小影响较小。在向下取整规则下，16值块比32值块低0.44点且五折一致，另两种规则下无一致效应。
AI.conclusion: 对小型可穿戴传感器模型，NVFP4在权重-激活联合4-bit量化下显著优于MXFP4，差距主要来自尺度选取（舍入方向与尺度位宽）而非块大小；改进尺度规则可大幅缩小差距。这提示边缘端低精度部署应优先关注缩放因子的表示与舍入策略。

title: SphereFlow: Missing Modality Imputation via Geometric Transport on Hypersphere
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 7 figures. Code: https://github.com/WTHH031230/SphereFlow
summary: Missing modality imputation aims to synthesize unobserved modalities from observed ones. Existing methods treat each modality as living on its own latent manifold, forcing the generator to learn a long, unstructured jump between them. We present SphereFlow, which takes a fundamentally different view: by projecting all modalities into a shared hyperspherical latent space via a frozen self-supervised encoder, cross-modal imputation reduces to short-range geometric transport between nearby points on the sphere. Realizing this idea with flow matching, however, exposes two geometric conflicts: the standard Gaussian noise source is catastrophically mismatched with the unit-norm data manifold, and the linear interpolation path departs the sphere surface into a region where the decoder has no training signal. We resolve both with simple, geometry-aware modifications: replacing the noise source with the observed-modality latent so that the velocity field learns only the cross-modal displacement, and training the decoder with a time-weighted loss that extends its domain to the near-surface region traversed by the flow. We prove that this data-as-source formulation reduces the worst-case off-manifold deviation from a quantity that grows with the latent dimension to a small, dimension-independent bound governed by inter-modality similarity. Experiments on BraTS multi-modal MRI imputation and CT-MRI translation demonstrate state-of-the-art generation fidelity across all settings, while downstream brain tumor segmentation with our imputed data closes roughly eighty percent of the gap to the full-modality oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/WTHH031230/SphereFlow.

AI.tldr: SphereFlow 将所有模态经冻结自监督编码器投影到共享超球隐空间，把跨模态补全化为球面上邻近点间的短程几何输运；用观测模态隐变量替代高斯噪声作为流匹配源，并以时间加权损失扩展解码器域，实现 SOTA 生成保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有缺失模态补全方法将每个模态视为独立的隐流形，迫使生成器学习模态间"长程、无结构"的跳跃，学习困难且不稳定。若能建立共享隐表示，使跨模态映射变为局部、短程的变换，则可显著降低生成难度。
AI.method: 1）用冻结的自监督编码器把全部模态投影至共享超球隐空间（单位范数），使补全成为球面上近邻点之间的短程输运；2）采用流匹配（flow matching）实现该输运，并针对两个几何冲突做修改：以观测模态隐变量替代标准高斯噪声作为源分布，使速度场只需学习跨模态位移；3）引入时间加权解码器损失，将解码器定义域扩展到流轨迹经过的近球面区域；4）理论分析给出数据即源（data-as-source）形式下的离流形偏差最坏界。
AI.result: 理论上证明：data-as-source 形式将最坏情况离流形偏差由随隐维数增长的量，降至由模态间相似度控制的、与维数无关的小界。实验上，在 BraTS 多模态 MRI 补全与 CT-MRI 转换任务上，各设置均达到 SOTA 生成保真度；以下游脑肿瘤分割评估，使用补全数据可弥合约 80% 与全模态 oracle 之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 共享超球隐空间 + 几何一致流匹配是解决跨模态补全的有效范式：源分布与路径均与数据流形几何对齐，既带来理论上的维度无关稳定性，也在生成质量与下游任务上取得领先，说明"几何对齐"比"更强的生成器"更为关键。

title: A Circuit for In-Context Learning
comment: 38 pages, 22 figures. Code and an interactive walkthrough at https://github.com/andrewgcodes/in-context-learning-circuit
summary: In-context learning (ICL) lets a pretrained language model perform a task specified by demonstrations in its prompt, with no parameter updates. With arbitrary labels the model must acquire a mapping it cannot have memorized, so the learning happens within a single forward pass. Prior work found candidate parts but not how they compose. We give the composition for few-shot sentence classification with arbitrary labels in three 3-4B-parameter transformers. The model implements a key-value memory over label-token positions: each label token's residual stream encodes the label's identity, and middle-layer attention heads write into it the class of the preceding demonstration as its key. At the query, upper-layer heads match the query's class against the stored keys and copy out the matching labels. An early-layer signal encoding whether any label has repeated gates this readout; in its absence the readers attend to the start of the prompt and no label is favored. A separate set of heads suppresses the most recently seen label. Each step is established causally by activation patching, head ablations against random-head baselines, and steering with the model's own signals. A softmax model of the readout with two constants per head, fit on one prompt distribution, predicts another. The computation is conserved across the three models, the named heads alone reproduce the behaviour, and a transformer trained from scratch grows the same parts. The circuit transfers to semantic concepts and to labels with meaning, and the same parts, with a causal gate, appear from 0.6B to 8B in one family and survive instruction tuning. ICL in this setting is a gated associative lookup built from a few identifiable component types, traced causally from demonstrations to prediction.

AI.tldr: 该文给出了任意标签少样本句分类任务中ICL的完整电路组合：标签token残差流作为值，中层注意力头写入演示类别作为键，上层头匹配查询并复制标签，一个早期"标签是否重复"信号门控读出，另一组头抑制最近标签。
AI.motivation: 已有工作只找到ICL的候选组件，但未说明它们如何组合成一个完整计算；在任意标签设定下模型无法依赖记忆的映射，学习必须发生在单次前向传播中，因此适合解析其机制。
AI.method: 在三个3-4B参数Transformer上做机制分析：定位标签token位置的键值记忆结构；用激活修补、对随机头基线的头消融、以及用模型自身信号做steering建立各步骤的因果性；再用每头两个常数的softmax读出模型检验跨提示分布的预测能力；并检查跨模型、从头训练模型、语义概念标签、0.6B-8B同族模型及指令微调后的泛化。
AI.result: 计算在三个模型中保持一致；仅指名头即可复现行为；从头训练的Transformer自发形成相同部件；电路可迁移到语义概念和有意义的标签；相同部件加因果门控在0.6B至8B同族模型中均出现，并在指令微调后保留；softmax读出模型在一个提示分布上拟合后可预测另一分布。
AI.conclusion: 该设定下的ICL是由少数可识别组件类型构成的门控联想查找，可从演示到预测进行因果追踪。

title: Bidirectional Centered Score Matching for Discrete Diffusion Distillation
summary: Discrete diffusion models with parallel decoding are often distilled using token-wise KL objectives. Although token-wise KL exactly matches the corresponding product-form block distributions, its probability-space optimization geometry and teacher-only candidate truncation may provide insufficient supervision under aggressive few-step distillation. Concrete Score Matching (CSM) provides an alternative within-position objective by aligning relative logit geometry, but its complete pairwise form incurs $\mathcal{O}(|\mathcal{V}|^2)$ complexity. We propose Bidirectional Centered Score Matching (BCSM), an efficient within-position distillation objective that constructs an $\mathcal{O}(K)$ bidirectional active set, reduces pairwise comparisons to $\mathcal{O}(K^2)$, and factorizes them into an $\mathcal{O}(K)$ objective. We further introduce cross-timestep transition alignment. Experiments demonstrate strong quality--efficiency trade-offs, including up to $6\times$ NFE reduction with a 16.9\% relative HumanEval gain and a 15.1\% relative MMMU gain at single-step inference.

AI.tldr: 提出双向中心化得分匹配（BCSM）用于离散扩散模型的少步蒸馏，以O(K)复杂度对齐位置内相对logit几何，并结合跨时间步转移对齐，实现质量-效率更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型并行解码常用token-wise KL蒸馏，虽精确匹配乘积形式的块分布，但其概率空间优化几何不佳，且仅用教师候选截断，在激进的少步蒸馏下监督不足；Concrete Score Matching可对齐位置内相对logit几何，但完整成对形式复杂度为O(|V|²)。
AI.method: BCSM构造O(K)的双向活跃集合，将成对比较降至O(K²)，并进一步分解为O(K)目标函数；同时引入跨时间步转移对齐。
AI.result: 实验显示显著的质量-效率权衡：NFE最多降低6×，单步推理下HumanEval相对提升16.9%、MMMU相对提升15.1%。
AI.conclusion: BCSM以线性复杂度实现有效的位置内蒸馏监督，配合跨时间步对齐，可在极少步推理下大幅提升生成质量与效率。

title: Where Did the Update Go? Certifying Declared Change Envelopes for Model Updates
summary: Deployed language models are updated continually, and regulators increasingly accept changes that were declared in advance. Showing that an update changed behavior only where it was declared to is a different statistical problem from bounding how much it changed: a useful update is meant to change some decisions, so global disagreement and regression bounds cannot certify it. We formalize the problem with declared change envelopes. Before training, the developer commits to a region of inputs, and every decision that changes outside it counts as leakage. Leakage compares two models, so it can be certified from unlabeled traffic with anytime-valid tests whose sample cost we bound from above and below, and per-update certificates compose into a bound on lifetime drift outside all declared scopes. We measure leakage for LoRA and full fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, and knowledge editing on models from 1.5B to 72B parameters. Narrow updates leak widely: domain and policy LoRA updates keep only about 7-36% of the decisions they change inside the declared scope. Across 256 trained variants, leakage tracks the update's KL divergence to the incumbent on out-of-scope inputs (Spearman 0.94). None of the customary remedies we tested makes a rule-like update certifiable without giving up much of its intended change. Distilling the incumbent's decisions on unlabeled prompts in the deployment format does: anchored LoRA, GRPO, and (at a small learning rate) full fine-tuning updates certify 5% leakage from a few hundred to a few thousand unlabeled samples, and the certificates replicate on held-out traffic and on written answers. The certificates cover decision-like outputs only; on open-ended chat, re-batching alone changes 11-21% of responses and no update certifies. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/declared-change-envelopes

AI.tldr: 论文提出"声明变更包络"(declared change envelopes)：训练前由开发者声明允许变更的输入区域、区域外任何决策改变记为"泄漏"(leakage)；泄漏是两模型间可比较量，可用无标注流量上的anytime-valid检验认证，样本代价有上下界且可跨更新组合为终身漂移界；实测LoRA/全量微调/偏好优化/RL/知识编辑(1.5B–72B)泄漏广泛(仅7–36%变更留在声明域内)，泄漏与域外KL高度相关(Spearman 0.94)；仅"锚定"(在部署格式无标注提示上蒸馏现任模型决策)可使更新在数百至数千样本内认证5%泄漏，但仅对决策型输出成立。
AI.motivation: 监管者日益接受预先声明的模型变更，但"证明更新只在声明处改变行为"与"界定改变幅度"是不同统计问题：有用更新本就要改变部分决策，因此全局不一致度与回归上界无法为其背书。需要新的形式化框架来认证变更的局部性。
AI.method: 提出声明变更包络形式化：训练前承诺输入区域，域外决策变化计为泄漏；基于两模型对比，用无标注流量上的anytime-valid检验做认证，给出样本复杂度的上界与下界；单次更新证书可组合为终身域外漂移界。实验覆盖LoRA与全量微调、偏好优化、RL、知识编辑，1.5B–72B；并检验锚定式蒸馏(在部署格式的无标注提示上蒸馏现任决策)作为补救。
AI.result: 窄更新泄漏广泛：域/策略LoRA更新仅将约7–36%的变更决策留在声明域内；在256个训练变体中，泄漏与域外输入上相对现任模型的KL散度高度相关(Spearman 0.94)。所测常规补救手段均无法在不放弃大部分预期变更的前提下使规则式更新可认证；而在部署格式无标注提示上蒸馏现任决策的"锚定"方案(anchored LoRA、GRPO、小学习率全量微调)可在数百至数千样本内认证5%泄漏，且证书在留出流量与书面答案上可复现。
AI.conclusion: 只有锚定式蒸馏能使更新以可接受成本获得泄漏认证，代价是限定于决策型输出；开放域对话中仅重批处理即改变11–21%的回复，且无任何更新能通过认证。证书不适用于开放式生成。

title: Efficient and Faithful High-Resolution Image Editing with Sparse Cross-Resolution Denoising
summary: Instruction-based image editors still primarily operate at 1K, whereas practical editing increasingly requires faithful 2K/4K outputs. Dense high-resolution adaptation preserves the editing trajectory but incurs expensive target-source attention; editing at 1K followed by external refinement is cheaper but can separate detail restoration from the editing trajectory. We introduce FLASH, a native high-resolution editor based on sparse cross-resolution denoising. A frozen 1K branch provides a semantic and structural anchor, while a target-resolution branch reconstructs local detail within the same Transformer. An asymmetric topology retains full 1K attention, guides high-resolution queries with spatially aligned low-resolution noisy-target states, and confines high-resolution target-reference interaction to local Halo neighborhoods. Resolution-specific diffusion-state mapping and spatial YaRN adapt the pretrained editor to larger grids. An optional, training-free progressive path replaces early high-resolution denoising with a 1K prefix and completes refinement in the same editor. On VINS-4KEval, the direct model achieves the strongest structural fidelity among the compared methods at both 2K and 4K. A separate 4K forward benchmark with R = 1 records 4.2x faster total forward execution and 25.3x faster attention than dense target-reference attention. Progressive inference reduces end-to-end 4K latency by 30.5%, with a modest quality cost.

AI.tldr: 提出 FLASH，一种基于稀疏跨分辨率去噪的原生高分辨率指令图像编辑器，在冻结 1K 分支锚定语义结构的同时，由目标分辨率分支在同个 Transformer 内重建细节，实现高效 2K/4K 编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有指令式图像编辑器主要在 1K 分辨率工作，而实际编辑需求已转向 2K/4K。稠密高分辨率适配会带来昂贵的 target-source 注意力开销；而"1K 编辑＋外部分辨率精修"虽便宜，却使细节恢复脱离编辑轨迹。需兼顾保真度与效率。
AI.method: 核心为稀疏跨分辨率去噪的非对称拓扑：冻结 1K 分支提供语义与结构锚点；高分辨率查询由空间对齐的低分辨率噪声目标状态引导，并保留完整 1K 注意力；高分辨率 target-reference 交互限制在局部 Halo 邻域。辅以分辨率特定的扩散状态映射与 spatial YaRN 将预训练编辑器适配到更大网格；另提供无需训练的渐进式路径，用 1K 前缀替代早期高分辨率去噪。
AI.result: 在 VINS-4KEval 上，2K 与 4K 均取得对比方法中最强的结构保真度。在 R=1 的 4K 前向基准中，总前向执行快 4.2 倍，注意力快 25.3 倍（相对稠密 target-reference 注意力）。渐进推理使端到端 4K 延迟降低 30.5%，质量仅有小幅下降。
AI.conclusion: 通过稀疏跨分辨率去噪与局部化高分辨率交互，FLASH 在不牺牲编辑轨迹的前提下实现高质量原生高分辨率编辑，并显著提升计算效率；渐进式推理进一步提供效率-质量的可调权衡。

title: Suppressing Misaligned Behaviors in Language Models, Durably
summary: Undesired model behaviors can emerge or re-emerge at any stage of training. Once observed, how effectively can we suppress them? To study this question, we first construct two model organisms--language models deliberately trained to exhibit a specific misalignment--that differ in what triggers the behavior. The narrow-trigger organism misbehaves only when the prompt contains a specific cue: it cheats on multiple-choice questions by following a planted hint that points to a wrong answer, and behaves normally otherwise. The broad-trigger organism has no such cue: after fine-tuning on insecure code, it gives harmful responses across a wide range of open-ended prompts. We then formalize post-hoc behavioral suppression and evaluate methods along three criteria: immediate suppression of the target behavior, durability under further training, and preservation of general capability. We compare standard methods--SFT, GRPO, and gradient-ascent unlearning--along these dimensions. Building on prior work on alignment shallowness, we hypothesize that more durable suppression requires the ability to recover from a wider range of misalignment states. We introduce Prefix-Expanded Adversarial Reinforcement Learning (PEARL), a GRPO variant that augments rollouts with continuations from intermediate states sampled along cached organism trajectories. Across both organism settings and two model families (Qwen3-4B, GPT-OSS-20B), PEARL achieves strong immediate suppression while preserving task accuracy, and remains durable under further fine-tuning on either the organism's data or unrelated data. It obtains the greatest benefit when the undesirable behavior is broad and cannot be addressed through targeted SFT. Together, our framework and method offer a step toward more durable post-hoc removal of undesired behaviors.

AI.tldr: 论文构建窄触发与宽触发两类"模型生物"（model organisms）以研究事后行为抑制，提出三条评价标准（即时抑制、进一步训练下的持久性、通用能力保持），并据此提出PEARL（前缀扩展对抗强化学习）——一种在缓存的organism轨迹中间状态上采样续写、扩展rollout的GRPO变体，实现更强且更持久的抑制。
AI.motivation: 不良模型行为可能在训练任一阶段出现或复现；但已有对齐方法常存在"对齐浅层性"（alignment shallowness），即在进一步微调下易被削弱。作者希望在可控的实验对象上系统评估"观察到不良行为后能多有效地压制它"，并检验"能从更广范围的错位状态中恢复"是否带来更持久的抑制。
AI.method: 1) 构造两类模型生物：窄触发型（仅在提示含特定线索时于多选题中依据植入提示作弊，其余正常）与宽触发型（在不安全代码上微调后，在广泛开放式提示上给出有害回答）；2) 形式化"事后行为抑制"，按即时抑制、微调耐久性、通用能力保持三维度评测；3) 对比SFT、GRPO、梯度上升式遗忘（gradient-ascent unlearning）；4) 提出PEARL：GRPO变体，从缓存organism轨迹上采样的中间状态出发生成续写以增强rollout，训练模型从更广的错位状态恢复。
AI.result: 在两种organism设定与两个模型族（Qwen3-4B、GPT-OSS-20B）上，PEARL均实现强即时抑制并保持任务准确率，且在继续使用organism数据或不相关数据微调时仍保持耐久性；当不良行为较宽泛、无法通过定向SFT处理时收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 框架与方法为更持久的"事后"不良行为移除提供了可行路径；持久抑制的关键在于训练模型从多种错位中间状态恢复，而非仅对最终输出做定向矫正。

title: OSGR: Observation-Support Graph Reasoning for Earth Observation Question Answering
summary: Answering geographic queries over Earth observation (EO) archives requires solving a joint retrieval-and-derivation problem under strict spatiotemporal constraints. Existing LLM agents fail to ground observation items or suffer from search-space explosion. We propose OSGR, a two-stage framework that factorizes this search into offline symbolic concept deduction and online Relation-Conditioned Grounding. OSGR leverages an offline Observation-Support Graph to deduce valid target-to-result support paths at the concept level, and applies spatiotemporal compatibility kernels to instantiate grounded observation-item sets. On Earth-Bench and DisasterM3-Reason, OSGR improves GPT-4o accuracy from 49.3\% to 63.7\% while reducing the execution-step ratio from 2.9 to 2.5.

AI.tldr: 提出OSGR两阶段框架，将地球观测档案上的地理查询分解为离线符号概念推演与在线关系条件接地，提升精度并降低执行步数。
AI.motivation: 对地观测（EO）档案的地理查询需在严格时空约束下同时完成检索与推演；现有LLM智能体既无法有效接地观测条目，又面临搜索空间爆炸问题。
AI.method: OSGR将搜索分解为两阶段：离线阶段利用Observation-Support Graph在概念层面推演出合法的目标到结果支撑路径；在线阶段通过Relation-Conditioned Grounding，结合时空兼容性核（spatiotemporal compatibility kernels）实例化出已接地的观测条目集合。
AI.result: 在Earth-Bench与DisasterM3-Reason上，OSGR将GPT-4o的准确率从49.3%提升至63.7%，同时将执行步数比从2.9降至2.5。
AI.conclusion: 通过符号化离线推演与关系条件接地的分解式设计，OSGR有效缓解了接地失效与搜索空间爆炸，在精度与效率上均优于现有方案。

title: An Information Budget for Label-Noise Memorization, and What Statistical Complexity Tracks: A Study with Multilayer Perceptrons
summary: How much label noise has a network memorized, and when? We study a multilayer perceptron and what statistical complexity adds to a description of its predictions. Standard identities decompose predictive information into signal, memorization, and heterogeneity. The memorization term vanishes in the population under the stated noise-independence condition. A Fano-type bound relates it to training accuracies, but the memorized fraction M provides no upper bound. Across 89 MNIST runs with ten pre-specified hypotheses (five supported, four unsupported, one not testable), normalized memorization information rose with M on training samples, remained near zero on held-out samples with fresh noisy labels, and was close to its Fano bound. Unlike raw M, it has a zero population null under the independence condition and chance correction largely removed this difference. When every label was replaced by an incorrect class, test accuracy fell to 0.5%, yet predictions retained information about the true class. Mean statistical complexity peaked before memorization at corruption rates up to 40%. At higher rates, its peak fell within the memorization phase, near the epoch when mean training confidence reached 0.6 and the two could not be separated. As a stopping rule, it matched established rules only at low noise and detected corrupted samples less well than simple label-free scores. An exploratory extension of 280 runs covering Fashion-MNIST, pair-flip noise, and four training variants yielded similar results under uniform noise, but not pair-flip noise, where complexity peaked within two epochs. Conclusions are limited to this architecture, two small datasets, and synthetic noise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多层感知机在训练中"记住了多少标签噪声、何时记住"，用统计复杂度刻画预测信息，并检验基于记忆信息的指标与停止规则的有效性。
AI.motivation: 原始的记忆比例 M 缺乏总体零基准、也不能约束记忆比例，需要一种在噪声独立条件下具有零总体空值、可作机会校正的统计量，并厘清记忆信息与统计复杂度的时序关系。
AI.method: 将预测信息按标准恒等式分解为信号、记忆与异质性三项；在噪声独立条件下给出记忆项的总体零值，建立与训练准确率相关的 Fano 型界；在 89 次 MNIST 运行上预设十个假设（5 支持、4 不支持、1 不可检验），比较归一化记忆信息与 M，并将其作为停止规则与现有准则对比；另以 280 次运行在 Fashion-MNIST、pair-flip 噪声与四种训练变体上做探索性扩展。
AI.result: 训练样本上归一化记忆信息随 M 上升、在带新噪声标签的留出样本上接近零，并接近其 Fano 界；与原始 M 不同，它具有零总体空值，机会校正后差异基本消失。当全部标签被替换为错误类别时，测试准确率降至 0.5%，但预测仍保留真实类别信息。在 40% 以内噪声率下，平均统计复杂度峰值先于记忆阶段出现；更高噪声率下峰值落入记忆阶段，与训练置信度均值达 0.6 的轮次邻近且二者无法区分。作为停止规则，仅在低噪声下与既有规则一致，对损坏样本的检测能力弱于简单无标签分数。扩展实验中均匀噪声下结果类似，pair-flip 噪声下复杂度在两轮内即达峰。
AI.conclusion: 归一化记忆信息比原始 M 更适合作为记忆的度量；统计复杂度峰值与记忆阶段的关系随噪声率变化，作为停止规则与样本检测器作用有限；结论限于该架构、两个小数据集与合成噪声。

title: VidUEU-Agent: A Data-Curation Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Editing, and Unified Tasks
summary: The advancement of multimodal learning is heavily constrained by the scarcity and high annotation cost of high-quality instruction data. While raw videos offer an abundant and dynamic source of visual knowledge, transforming them into precise instruction data remains highly challenging. To bridge this gap, we present VidUEU-Agent, an automated pipeline that synthesizes instruction data from raw videos for multimodal understanding, editing, and unified tasks. VidUEU-Agent follows a four-stage pipeline: it performs global perception to filter low-quality shots, mines keyframes and multimodal signals, constructs metadata and routes the metadata to synthesize instruction samples. More importantly, our agent framework can autonomously iterate the data distribution based on downstream training results, thereby optimizing data quality, balance, and training effectiveness. Scaling this pipeline, we construct VidUEU-100K, a large-scale dataset of 100K training samples spanning multiple domains and tasks, providing a robust foundation for developing comprehensive multimodal capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning baseline models on VidUEU-100K yields significant and consistent performance gains across diverse representative benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of our proposed agent framework and dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自动化的 VidUEU-Agent 数据合成流水线，将原始视频转化为多模态理解、编辑与统一任务的指令数据，并构建 100K 规模的 VidUEU-100K 数据集，微调后在下游基准上取得显著且一致的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态学习受限于高质量指令数据的稀缺与高标注成本；原始视频虽蕴含丰富、动态的视觉知识，但转化为精确指令数据仍极具挑战。
AI.method: 提出四阶段流水线：全局感知过滤低质量镜头、挖掘关键帧与多模态信号、构建元数据、路由元数据以合成指令样本；智能体框架可依据下游训练结果自主迭代数据分布，优化数据质量、平衡性与训练效果。
AI.result: 基于该流水线构建跨多领域、多任务的大规模数据集 VidUEU-100K（10 万训练样本）；在多个代表性基准上微调基线模型，性能获得显著且一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的智能体式数据流水线与数据集能有效缓解多模态指令数据瓶颈，验证了自动合成数据对发展全面多模态能力的可行性与有效性。

title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
comment: 59 pages, 21 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://cognitive-symbiont.github.io
summary: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf. Yet people still forget what they once knew, miss what they are not looking at, fail to find the right words, and face hard choices without the benefit of their own history, because the machine that could help stands outside the situation. As AI moves into the physical world, attention has settled on one kind of intelligent individual, the embodied robot; we argue that the era of Physical AI holds a second kind of equal importance, the person augmented by AI. Alongside artificial general intelligence, which asks how intelligent a machine can be, stands AI-augmented human intelligence (AHI), which asks how much intelligence a machine can enable in a particular person. Realizing it calls for a new kind of system, a cognitive symbiont: a lifelong, embedded, real-time, private, low-friction, and proactive companion that senses what the person senses through external devices, keeps their context across years, models their situation and their mind, takes part in their thinking at the right moment, carries out everyday tasks with their context, and keeps learning the person as both change. We give the paradigm a conceptual core, the cognitive gap between what a person could bring to a situation and what they can hold in working memory, and organize its design space as a symbiosis loop of sensing, keeping, understanding, living alongside, acting for and thinking with the person, and growing, enclosed by a personal runtime and by trust. Because a symbiont changes what a person can do in front of others, it also raises risks of a new kind, from covert assistance in examinations to pressure on everyone to adopt it, and we treat their governance as part of the paradigm.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"AI增强人类智能"(AHI)范式,主张Physical AI时代除具身机器人外,还存在同等重要的第二类智能主体——被AI增强的人;其核心是构建"认知共生体",以"认知缺口"为概念内核、以共生循环为设计空间,并将治理纳入范式。
AI.motivation: 十年来AI进展以机器独立完成任务的多少为衡量,大模型可写代码、执行多步任务,个人智能体可代表用户行动。但人依然会遗忘、视而不见、词穷、在缺乏自身历史的情况下做艰难抉择,原因在于能帮助人的机器置身于情境之外。随着AI进入物理世界,关注点集中于具身机器人;作者认为应同等重视"被AI增强的人",并提出与AGI并列的AHI问题:机器能在特定人身上激发出多少智能。
AI.method: 概念性/立场性论文。定义"认知共生体"系统特征:终身、嵌入、实时、私密、低摩擦、主动的伙伴;通过外部设备感知人所感知的、跨年保存情境、建模其处境与心智、在恰当时刻参与其思考、以其情境执行日常任务、并随双方变化持续学习该人。以"认知缺口"(人本可带入情境的能力与其工作记忆所能承载者之差)为概念内核;将设计空间组织为"共生循环":感知、保存、理解、共处、代为行动、与人共思、成长,并由个人运行时与信任所包围。
AI.result: 给出AHI范式的概念内核与设计空间;指出共生体因改变人在他人面前可完成之事而带来新型风险(如考试中的隐蔽辅助、对普遍采用的社会压力),并将这类风险的治理视为范式组成部分。
AI.conclusion: Physical AI时代应以AHI与具身机器人为并重的两条路线;认知共生体是其实现形态,需以认知缺口为核心、以共生循环为设计框架、以个人运行时和信任为边界,并同步建立治理机制。

title: Drift No More: Spectral Locking for Long-Horizon Open-Weight Multi-Agent AI
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Long-horizon multi-agent systems suffer from three tightly coupled failures: task drift, role drift, and state staleness. We test the hypothesis that these share a common representational cause: agent hidden states move away from the directions encoding the active task, assigned role, and current shared state. A pilot study over 14,832 annotated turns supports this: drifted turns collapse near-uniformly across all three anchor subspaces (pairwise r = 0.72-0.78). Existing methods address these failures separately, operating at the surface-text level or treating control directions independently. We introduce ATLAS (Algebraic Task-role Locking with Adaptive Spectral Memory), a training-free intervention acting on hidden states before a token is generated. ATLAS builds a positive-semidefinite anchor kernel over task, role, and state subspaces and steers hidden states toward their shared high-coherence eigendirections; a low-rank Gram decomposition keeps this tractable. Across long-horizon memory, state maintenance, tool use, least-privilege coordination, and embodied stress tests, ATLAS outperforms prompting, retrieval, memory, and activation-steering baselines. Against A-MEM it improves memory macro-average accuracy by up to 5.7 points and reduces write/read failures by up to 31.7%/24.8%; against MemoryArena-Agent it gains up to 4.8 points. It gains 10.7-12.1 points under perturbation, reaches 93.5% role consistency, and transfers to a 72B backbone (macro-average 61.0 vs. 56.2). Ablating the joint task-role-state span costs 7.2 points against 0.8 for a matched-rank random span, indicating these directions are functionally implicated, not incidental; supplying them by prompt or retrieval recovers 4.3 points less. ATLAS is therefore a representation-level controller for open-weight multi-agent systems, complementary to output-level protocols for black-box agents.

AI.tldr: ATLAS：一种无需训练、在生成前于隐状态空间施加干预的"任务-角色-状态"联合代数锚定控制器，用于缓解长时程多智能体系统的任务漂移、角色漂移与状态陈旧。
AI.motivation: 长时程多智能体系统存在任务漂移、角色漂移、状态陈旧三类紧耦合失效。作者假设三者共享表征层面的共同成因：智能体隐状态偏离编码当前任务、所分配角色与共享状态的子空间方向。现有方法分别处理这些失效，且多停留在表层文本或独立处理控制方向，缺乏统一表征视角。试点研究（14,832 条标注轮次）显示漂移轮次在三类锚定子空间中近乎一致地塌缩（两两 r=0.72–0.78），支持该共享成因假设。
AI.method: ATLAS（Algebraic Task-role Locking with Adaptive Spectral Memory）为免训练干预，在生成首个 token 前作用于隐状态。构建覆盖任务、角色、状态子空间的半正定锚核，将隐状态导向它们共享的高相干特征方向；用低秩 Gram 分解保证可计算性。对照基线涵盖提示、检索、记忆与激活引导方法。
AI.result: 在长时程记忆、状态维护、工具使用、最小权限协作与具身压力测试中均优于基线。相对 A-MEM，记忆宏平均准确率最高提升 5.7 点，写/读失败率分别降低最多 31.7%/24.8%；相对 MemoryArena-Agent 最高 +4.8 点；扰动下提升 10.7–12.1 点；角色一致性达 93.5%；可迁移至 72B 基座（宏平均 61.0 vs. 56.2）。消融联合任务-角色-状态张成空间损失 7.2 点，而同秩随机张成仅损失 0.8 点，说明这些方向具有功能性作用而非偶然；以提示或检索方式提供相同信息则少恢复 4.3 点。
AI.conclusion: 三类漂移共享表征成因的假设得到支持，联合锚定优于分别控制。ATLAS 构成面向开放权重多智能体系统的表征层控制器，与面向黑盒智能体的输出层协议互补。

title: LENS: Reliability-Aware Stock Prediction via LLM-Extracted Priors and News-Driven Semantic Graphs
summary: Predicting stock returns requires modeling persistent company relations and time-varying market signals.
