Graph Neural Network (GNN) approaches combine static priors with dynamic relational graphs, but treat every extracted edge as a trustworthy binary fact, ignoring heterogeneous reliability across relational sources. We propose LENS (LLM-Extracted priors and News-driven Semantics), a static--dynamic graph framework for stock return prediction and ranking that models relational reliability as a first-class signal across the pipeline. On the static side, we extract a multi-relational company graph from a Large Language Model and aggregate it over multiple runs with confidence weighting to downweight low-consistency edges. On the dynamic side, we build a news-driven semantic graph with exponential-decay temporal aggregation to capture changing market context under uneven coverage. A context-dependent gated fusion module rebalances the two graphs at the per-stock, per-day level. On S&P 500, LENS improves AR@5 by 16.4% and SR@5 by 22.6% over the strongest baseline, and on NASDAQ 100 it achieves comparable improvements (15.5% and 20.9% respectively). Ablations isolate each component's contribution, and a human-validation study of sampled relations supports that the aggregation is grounded, providing evidence that reliability-aware LLM relations and news-based semantic graphs carry complementary information for graph-based financial prediction.

AI.tldr: LENS：借助LLM抽取带置信度的静态公司关系图，结合新闻驱动的动态语义图与门控融合，实现可靠性感知的股票收益预测与排序。
AI.motivation: 股票收益预测需同时刻画公司间持续性关系与时变市场信号。现有GNN方法将静态先验与动态关系图结合，但把每条抽出的边都视为可信的二值事实，忽略了不同关系来源间可靠性的异质性。
AI.method: 提出LENS静态—动态图框架，将关系可靠性作为贯穿流程的一等信号。静态侧：从LLM抽取多关系公司图，并在多次运行上做置信度加权聚合，降低低一致性边的权重。动态侧：构建新闻驱动语义图，采用指数衰减时间聚合以应对覆盖不均。融合侧：上下文相关的门控融合模块在每只股票、每日粒度上重平衡两图。
AI.result: 在S&P 500上，AR@5较最强基线提升16.4%、SR@5提升22.6%；在NASDAQ 100上分别提升15.5%与20.9%。消融实验分离了各组件贡献，采样关系的人工验证表明聚合结果有据可依，说明可靠性感知的LLM关系与新闻语义图在金融图预测中信息互补。
AI.conclusion: 将关系可靠性显式建模并与动态新闻语义图互补融合，可有效提升图神经网络的股票收益预测与排序性能。

title: GVT3D: Gesture-Vision-Text Token Enrichment for 3D Embodied Reference Understanding
summary: Natural human-robot interaction requires robots to interpret language and gestures within a 3D environment to support tasks such as pick-and-place and object retrieval. 3D Embodied Reference Understanding (3D-ERU) supports this by identifying the 3D location of a target object from a scene (point-cloud) containing a human pointing gesture and an accompanying language description. However, current 3D-ERU models lack alignment of cross-modal representations and incur high processing costs that increase with the point-cloud's size. To address this, we propose GVT3D, which employs an Embodied Fusion module that jointly models language, gesture, and vision inputs within a shared embedding space, promoting cross-modal alignment. We additionally introduce a foveation approach that selectively processes the point cloud within a coarse region around the estimated pointing direction to reduce computations. GVT3D achieves ~8% higher accuracy and foveation enables 2.95x faster execution while maintaining comparable accuracy, relative to prior 3D-ERU models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GVT3D，通过Embodied Fusion模块实现语言、手势与视觉的共享嵌入空间对齐，并引入foveation策略仅处理指向方向附近的粗略点云区域以降低计算量，精度提升约8%，执行速度提升2.95倍。
AI.motivation: 自然人机交互需要在3D环境中联合理解语言与手势以支持抓取放置、物体检索等任务。现有3D-ERU模型缺乏跨模态表示对齐，且计算开销随点云规模增长而急剧上升。
AI.method: 提出GVT3D：1）Embodied Fusion模块在共享嵌入空间内联合建模语言、手势与视觉输入，促进跨模态对齐；2）引入foveation（中央凹）机制，仅在估计指向方向周围的粗略区域内选择性处理点云以削减计算。
AI.result: 相比既有3D-ERU模型，GVT3D精度提升约8%；foveation在保持相当精度的同时带来2.95倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态对齐与仿生式选择性感知可同时提升3D具身指代理解的准确性与效率，为高效自然人机交互提供了可行方案。

title: Computational Phenomenology of Borderline Personality Disorder: A Comparative Evaluation of LLM-Simulated Expert Personas and Human Clinical Experts
summary: Building on a human-led thematic analysis of clinical life-story interviews (> 150,000 words) with inpatients with Borderline Personality Disorder, this study examines the capacity of large language models (OpenAI's GPT, Google's Gemini, and Anthropic's Claude) to support qualitative clinical analysis. The models' interpretative potential was evaluated using a mixed-methods approach. Study A involved blinded and non-blinded judges in phenomenology and clinical psychology. The experts assessed the validity of AI-generated content using semantic congruence, Jaccard coefficients, and multidimensional validity ratings, including credibility, coherence, the substantiveness of results, and grounding in qualitative data. In Study B, neural methods were used to embed human- and model-generated theme descriptions in a multidimensional vector space. This approach provided an objectified computational measure of the difference between human and model semantics and linguistic style. In Study C, complementary non-expert evaluations were conducted (N=115) to examine the influence of thematic verbosity on the perception of human authorship and content validity. Overall, the results of AI analysis showed a highly variable overlap (0-58%) with the human interpretation, while all models identified themes originally omitted by human researchers, proving their capacity to mitigate human bias. At the thematic level, external evaluators were unable to reliably distinguish human-authored themes from those generated by AI. In terms of content validity assessed against raw data by high-level experts in the blinded mode, the performance of Gemini 2.5 Pro was indistinguishable from that of humans. The comparison of semantic vector embeddings showed that its style was also the closest to humans.

AI.tldr: 本研究以人主导的临床生命故事访谈主题分析为基线，混合方法评估GPT、Gemini、Claude等大语言模型支持定性临床分析的能力。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型能否辅助临床质性分析，并检验其解释效度、与人类语义风格差异及对题注冗长程度的感知影响。
AI.method: 三项子研究：Study A 由现象学与临床心理学专家以盲/非盲方式，用语义一致性、Jaccard系数及可信度、连贯性、结果实质性、数据扎根等多维效度评分评估AI内容；Study B 以神经嵌入方法将人与模型生成的主题描述映射到多维向量空间，客观量化语义与语言风格差异；Study C 开展非专家评估（N=115），考察主题冗长程度对作者身份识别与内容效度感知的影响。
AI.result: AI分析与人类解读的重叠度高度可变（0–58%）；所有模型均识别出人类研究者最初遗漏的主题，显示其缓解人类偏倚的能力；外部评估者无法可靠区分人写与AI生成主题；盲评条件下Gemini 2.5 Pro的内容效度表现与人类无差别，其语义向量嵌入风格也最接近人类。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型可作为辅助定性临床分析的有力工具，具备发现被人类忽视主题并贴近人类语义风格的潜力，但重叠度波动提示其应作为补充而非替代人类解释。

title: Planning-Coding Separation in LLM-Based Code Generation: An Empirical Study
summary: Planning has been identified as an important factor for improved code generation with Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the interaction between planning capability and coding capability remains largely underexplored, especially when the two capabilities are from different LLMs. In this paper, we conduct the first comprehensive empirical study of planning-coding interaction in LLM-based code generation, where planning and coding are assigned to different LLMs (i.e., planning-coding separation). Specifically, we explore different planner-coder combinations to investigate the effectiveness for coders to utilize planning information from various planners and the impact of further training of coders on planner-coder combinations. Our results demonstrate that almost all planner-coder combinations are as competitive as using the same LLM for planning and coding, and the combination of a stronger planner and a stronger coder typically achieves improved effectiveness. Furthermore, using a large model as the planner paired with a much smaller model as the coder can sometimes be as competitive as using the large model as both the planner and the coder, and further training of the coder can typically boost various planner-coder combinations. These findings provide empirical evidence that planning and coding can be separated to a considerable extent in LLM-based code generation, which may offer a more flexible way to construct code-generation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统实证研究LLM代码生成中"规划-编码分离"的规划-编码交互：将规划与编码分配给不同LLM，考察多种planner-coder组合的有效性。
AI.motivation: 规划被证实能提升LLM代码生成效果，但规划能力与编码能力之间的交互关系（尤其是二者来自不同LLM时）尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建不同planner-coder组合进行对比实验，评估coder利用不同planner规划信息的有效性，并考察对coder进一步训练对组合效果的影响。
AI.result: 几乎所有planner-coder组合与同模型自规划效果相当；强planner+强coder通常效果更优；大模型规划+小模型编码有时可与大模型兼任规划与编码相当；对coder进一步训练通常能提升各类组合表现。
AI.conclusion: 规划与编码在LLM代码生成中可在相当程度上分离，为构建更灵活的代码生成系统提供实证依据。

title: LIRA: A More Interpretable Dynamic Loss-Informed Rank Allocation for Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large pretrained models. However, standard LoRA typically assigns a fixed rank profile despite layer- and stage-dependent adaptation needs, while recent adaptive-rank variants often rely on heuristic or first-order signals that provide only an indirect link between rank reallocation and local loss behavior. This leaves the rationale behind each rank reallocation insufficiently interpretable. Motivated by this gap, we propose LIRA (Loss-Informed Rank Allocation), a dynamic-rank LoRA method designed to make online rank reallocation more interpretable. LIRA scores each layer by the estimated magnitude of the local loss perturbation associated with its recent LoRA-factor movements under a second-order approximation, making the basis for each rank change interpretable term by term. By periodically applying DELTA (Displacement-Evaluated Loss-Trajectory Allocation), a displacement-based algorithm for LoRA rank reallocation, LIRA produces discrete effective ranks under matched budgets while remaining compatible with standard (A,B) adapters. On RoBERTa-base GLUE under the La-LoRA/LoRA protocol, LIRA outperforms the uniform-LoRA and adaptive-rank baselines reported under this protocol; Trajectory EMA attains performance competitive with Fixed-point Fisher at lower estimation cost.

AI.tldr: LIRA：以二阶近似下的局部损失扰动幅度为每层打分，周期性以DELTA做离散有效秩重分配，使动态秩LoRA的秩调整可逐项解释，并在RoBERTa-base GLUE上优于均匀LoRA与自适应秩基线。
AI.motivation: 标准LoRA固定秩配置，忽视层与训练阶段对秩的差异化需求；现有自适应秩方法多依赖启发式或一阶信号，秩重分配与局部损失行为仅间接关联，单次秩调整的依据难以解释。
AI.method: LIRA（Loss-Informed Rank Allocation）：在二阶近似下，用近期LoRA因子移动所对应的局部损失扰动估计幅度对每层打分，使秩变化的依据可逐项解释；周期性应用DELTA（Displacement-Evaluated Loss-Trajectory Allocation）这一基于位移的秩重分配算法，在匹配预算下产生离散有效秩，同时兼容标准(A,B)适配器；估计器比较Trajectory EMA与Fixed-point Fisher。
AI.result: 在RoBERTa-base GLUE、La-LoRA/LoRA协议下，LIRA优于该协议下的uniform-LoRA与自适应秩基线；Trajectory EMA以更低估计成本达到与Fixed-point Fisher相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 以损失信息驱动的秩分配可提升动态秩LoRA的可解释性与性能，位移式离散秩调整在等预算下有效，且轻量轨迹EMA估计足以替代较昂贵的Fisher类估计。

title: SWAP-INR: Implicit Neural Representation with Switchable Attention Paths for Time-varying Multivariate Scientific Data Compression
summary: Visualizing multivariate scientific simulation data is essential for understanding complex physical phenomena, yet the massive scale of such data imposes a severe storage bottleneck in high-performance computing environments. Implicit neural representations (INRs) have emerged as a promising continuous alternative to traditional lossy compressors, but existing methods struggle to explicitly capture cross-variable interactions and to adapt to the diverse spectral characteristics of physical variables. To address these limitations, we propose SWAP-INR, an architecture for high-fidelity compression of multivariate, time-varying simulation data. SWAP-INR introduces two key components: (1) The switchable attention path (SWAP) module explicitly models cross-variable interactions through a cross-variable attention layer, then routes each variable to an attention or non-attention path by a deterministic, loss-driven criterion, and prunes the inactive layers for structural compression. (2) The adaptability amplification SIREN (A2-SIREN) replaces rigid frequency scaling with channel-wise learnable modulation, adapting to heterogeneous physical features with negligible overhead. Combined with post-training 16-bit quantization, SWAP-INR achieves state-of-the-art performance on small modular reactor (SMR) datasets and remains competitive on public physics simulation datasets, while maintaining a constrained memory footprint. Our code is https://github.com/hvcl/SWAP-INR.

AI.tldr: 提出SWAP-INR，通过可切换注意力路径(SWAP)显式建模变量间交互并按损失驱动准则剪枝，以及自适应增强SIREN(A2-SIREN)实现通道级可学习频率调制，结合训练后16-bit量化，在多变量时变仿真数据压缩上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多变量科学仿真数据可视化对理解复杂物理现象至关重要，但HPC环境下数据规模庞大导致严重存储瓶颈。隐式神经表示(INR)作为传统有损压缩器的连续替代方案虽有前景，但现有方法难以显式捕捉跨变量交互，也难以适应物理变量多样的频谱特征。
AI.method: 提出SWAP-INR架构，含两个核心组件：(1) 可切换注意力路径(SWAP)模块——通过跨变量注意力层显式建模跨变量交互，再以确定性、损失驱动的准则将每个变量路由至注意力或非注意力路径，并剪枝未激活层以实现结构压缩；(2) 自适应增强SIREN(A2-SIREN)——以通道级可学习调制替代刚性频率缩放，适应异构物理特征且开销可忽略；并配合训练后16-bit量化。
AI.result: 在小模块反应堆(SMR)数据集上取得SOTA性能，在公开物理仿真数据集上保持竞争力，同时维持受限的内存占用。
AI.conclusion: SWAP-INR通过显式跨变量建模与频谱自适应机制，有效缓解了多变量仿真数据压缩中的交互建模与频谱异质性难题，在保证低内存开销的同时实现高保真压缩，并为INR压缩器的结构稀疏化提供了可行路径。

title: WMIP: A Working-Memory-Inspired Programmable Probe of Cumulative State Tracking in Large Language Models
comment: 16 pages. Code and data: https://github.com/dengzhe-hou/WMIP. Renamed from WMF-AM; v3 is a substantial revision with new experiments, which explains the low text overlap with v2
summary: Human working memory lets people maintain and update information. Large language models (LLMs) face a related demand when tracking updates within a single prompt without writing out intermediate states, yet existing tests differ in their constraints on written steps. We introduce a working-memory-inspired probe of cumulative state tracking with program-computed answers, 3 to 100 updates, and final-state, intermediate-state, or multi-target queries. It compares protocols on identical items. Across 18 LLMs, accuracy is 84.9% on single-step arithmetic but 31.7% on core items requiring one number after three to seven updates. From 50 updates on, no model exceeds 10% accuracy. Core accuracy reaches 88.0% under a larger budget and instructions to write steps and place the answer on the last line, mainly due to the instruction changes rather than the budget. Core accuracy also correlates positively with public Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard scores. These findings show that strong single-step arithmetic does not ensure reliable cumulative tracking and that output protocols substantially change measured accuracy. We release the generator, items, scoring code, and responses for reproducible comparisons across depths, query types, and protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受工作记忆启发的"累积状态追踪"探针任务（程序生成答案、3–100次更新、终态/中间态/多目标查询），在相同题目上比较不同输出协议，发现18个LLM单步算术准确率84.9%，而需3–7次更新后的核心题仅31.7%，50次更新以上无模型超过10%。
AI.motivation: LLM在单条提示内追踪状态更新时，无法像人类工作记忆那样隐式维护中间状态；而现有测试对"是否写出中间步骤"的约束不一致，导致测量结果不可比，因此需要一个可控、可复现的探针来分离"追踪能力"与"输出协议"的影响。
AI.method: 构建程序化生成并计算答案的累积状态追踪基准：更新次数3–100，查询类型含终态、中间态与多目标；在完全相同的题目上对比多种输出协议（含更大token预算、要求写出步骤并将答案置于最后一行等消融）；评测18个LLM，并与公开Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard分数做相关性分析。
AI.result: 单步算术准确率84.9%；3–7次更新的核心题仅31.7%；≥50次更新时所有模型低于10%。在更大预算+要求写步骤并末行作答的条件下核心准确率升至88.0%，提升主要来自指令变化而非预算增加。核心准确率与BFCL分数正相关。
AI.conclusion: 强单步算术能力不能保证可靠的累积状态追踪；输出协议会显著改变测得的准确率，因此跨研究的比较必须统一协议。作者开源生成器、题目、评分代码与模型响应，以支持在深度、查询类型和协议维度上的可复现比较。

title: ATC: Agent Trajectory Control for Role-Contract Enforcement in Black-Box Multi-Agent Systems
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems assign different responsibilities to different agents: one plans, another retrieves evidence, another verifies, another executes. This division of labor is only meaningful if each agent stays within the functions it is authorized to perform. Over many turns, however, an agent can produce a locally reasonable message that exercises authority belonging to another role: a verifier that begins planning, a retriever that asserts unsupported conclusions, an executor that changes state no one approved. We formalize this as role drift, a turn-level breach of an agent's role contract. We introduce Agent Trajectory Control (ATC), which makes each role's authority explicit as a contract and enforces it at the point where a message would enter the shared conversation. ATC scores a proposed output for out-of-role deviation, leakage into the functions of other roles, impermissible speech acts, and logical contract breaches, then computes a leakage-regularized target that constrains regeneration; the revised message is re-checked before admission. Enforcement acts on the message rather than the generator, so ATC governs agents whose internal representations are unavailable. Across homogeneous and heterogeneous teams, ATC improves task performance and role consistency while lowering role-drift energy relative to strong baselines spanning prompting, memory, workflow control, and activation editing, with the largest gains under explicit role-confusion stress tests and in larger, more diverse teams.

AI.tldr: 提出"角色漂移"概念（单轮内越权行事的角色契约违背），并设计 Agent Trajectory Control (ATC)，在消息进入共享对话前进行契约式越权检测与正则化重生成，从而在不访问生成器内部表示的情况下抑制漂移。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统按分工赋予各智能体不同职责（规划、检索、验证、执行），但多轮交互中智能体可能产出"局部看似合理"却越权的消息（如验证者开始规划、检索者断言无依据结论、执行者擅自改状态）。分工的有效性依赖每个智能体守住自身被授权的功能边界，因此需要显式刻画并强制角色约束。
AI.method: 1) 将上述现象形式化为角色漂移（role drift），即轮级角色契约违约；2) 提出 ATC，把每个角色的权限显式表述为契约，并在消息进入共享对话的入口处强制执行；3) 对候选输出打分四个维度：越出角色的偏离、向其他角色功能的泄漏、不允许的言语行为（speech acts）、逻辑层面的契约违背；4) 据此计算"泄漏正则化"的目标表示以约束重生成；5) 修改后的消息在准入前再次校验；6) 执行作用于消息而非生成器，故可管理内部表示不可得的智能体。
AI.result: 在同质与异构团队中，相较提示工程、记忆、工作流控制与激活编辑等强基线，ATC 提升任务表现与角色一致性，并降低角色漂移能量；在显式角色混淆压力测试下以及更大、更多样的团队中增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 角色契约可作为多智能体 LLM 协作的可执行约束层；以消息级、生成器无关的方式实施漂移控制，既能提升性能与角色一致性，又具可扩展性，团队规模与异构性越大收益越明显。

title: OmniST: Topology-Invariant Spatiotemporal Forecasting with Guaranteed-Coverage Uncertainty at Unseen Sensor Locations
comment: Code and experiments: https://github.com/Praveg432/OmniST . 9 tables, 4 figures. Baselines (E-STGCN, IGNNK) are faithful reimplementations, not the authors' original code
summary: Standard spatiotemporal graph convolutional networks need a fixed-size adjacency matrix, coupling model weights to a specific sensor count N; they cannot produce any output at a sensor absent from training. We present OmniST, a topology-invariant forecaster whose computation has zero structural dependency on the number of nodes, and which, composed with inductive split-conformal calibration, gives distribution-free, coverage-guaranteed prediction intervals at arbitrary (including never-seen) sensor locations, preserving that guarantee as sensors are added or removed. Topology invariance follows from coordinate-based tokenization, k-nearest-neighbor attention from geographic coordinates at each forward pass, and per-node temporal processing via a bidirectional GRU. On real Delhi air-quality data (37 stations, 2019-2023), OmniST attains a 30-day PM2.5 MAE of 31.0 ug/m3 and degrades at most 1.1 percent when 40 percent of stations are removed. Its inductive forecasts at unseen stations beat nearest-neighbor interpolation (about 12 percent) and a learned kriging GNN (IGNNK, about 21 percent), and, unlike either, carry a finite-sample coverage guarantee. The guarantee holds at 90 percent or above under 30-50 percent node dropout across four real datasets over three domains (Delhi and Beijing air quality, NOAA GHCN weather, Caltrans PeMSD7-M traffic), and still holds at 325 real sensors (full PeMS-BAY). We also fix a temporal-drift failure: static conformal under-covers over time (about 0.50 late), but a rolling adaptive-conformal estimator restores target coverage (0.89 overall, 0.96 late) at the cost of wider intervals.

AI.tldr: OmniST 提出一种拓扑不变的时空预测框架：计算过程与节点数量 N 零结构依赖，结合归纳式 split-conformal 校准，可在任意（含未见）传感器位置给出有限样本覆盖保证的预测区间，并在增删传感器时保持该保证。
AI.motivation: 标准时空图卷积网络（STGCN）依赖固定尺寸邻接矩阵，模型权重与传感器数量 N 耦合，无法在训练时未出现的传感器上给出输出，也难以在节点增删时迁移。作者希望构建一种与拓扑/节点数无关、可归纳泛化到新位置且具备覆盖率保证的预测器。
AI.method: 1）基于地理坐标的 tokenization，使输入表示不含节点索引结构；2）每次前向传播时依据地理坐标动态构建 k 近邻注意力；3）逐节点时间建模，使用双向 GRU；4）叠加归纳式 split-conformal 校准，输出分布无关、有限样本覆盖保证的预测区间；5）针对时间漂移，引入滚动自适应 conformal 估计器。
AI.result: 在德里真实空气质量数据（37 站，2019–2023）上，30 天 PM2.5 MAE 为 31.0 µg/m³，移除 40% 站点时性能最多下降 1.1%。未见站点上的归纳预测优于最近邻插值（约 12%）与学习式克里金 GNN（IGNNK，约 21%），且额外具备有限样本覆盖保证。在 30–50% 节点丢率下，四个真实数据集、三个领域（德里与北京空气质量、NOAA GHCN 气象、Caltrans PeMSD7-M 交通）覆盖率保持 ≥90%，并在 325 个真实传感器（完整 PeMS-BAY）上仍成立。同时修复时间漂移失效：静态 conformal 随时间欠覆盖（后期约 0.50），滚动自适应 conformal 恢复目标覆盖（整体 0.89，后期 0.96），代价是区间变宽。
AI.conclusion: OmniST 通过坐标驱动、节点数无关的架构实现拓扑不变的时空预测，并借助归纳 conformal 校准在未见位置与节点增删下提供覆盖率保证；滚动自适应校准进一步缓解时间漂移导致的欠覆盖问题，但以区间宽度为代价。

title: A Systematic Point Cloud Edge Detection Framework for Automatic Aircraft Skin Milling
summary: The edge detection technique is an essential step for aircraft skin milling in aviation manufacturing. Most of the current detection methods focus on traditionally defined edge extraction tasks but disregard the crucial systematic requirement of edge milling. In this paper, we proposed a novel edge detection framework for automatic edge milling of aircraft skins. First, an edge probability detector is proposed by the spatial tangent continuity (STC) to provide the essential reference. Second, we propose a hierarchical branch searching (HBS) method to hierarchically strip the desired milling edges from the raw point cloud, which consists of three graded progressive steps: branch backbone generation, branch extension, and branch pruning. We demonstrate the performance of the proposed method on both synthetic models and aircraft skin workpieces. The proposed method outperforms the other baselines and shows accurate edges for the edge milling task.

AI.tldr: 本文针对航空蒙皮铣削任务，提出一种由边缘概率检测器（基于空间切向连续性 STC）与分层分支搜索（HBS，含主干生成、扩展、剪枝）组成的新型边缘检测框架，在合成模型与真实蒙皮工件上取得优于基线的铣削边缘提取精度。
AI.motivation: 边缘检测是航空制造中蒙皮铣削的关键步骤，但现有方法多聚焦于传统定义下的边缘提取任务，忽视了边缘铣削这一系统性需求，导致提取结果难以直接服务于自动铣削加工。
AI.method: 提出面向蒙皮自动边缘铣削的检测框架：先利用空间切向连续性（STC）构建边缘概率检测器，为后续处理提供基础参考；再提出分层分支搜索（HBS），按三个递进步骤从原始点云中分层剥离目标铣削边缘——分支主干生成、分支延伸与分支剪枝。
AI.result: 在合成模型与航空蒙皮工件上进行了验证，所提方法性能优于其他基线方法，可为边缘铣削任务提供准确的边缘。
AI.conclusion: 将边缘检测任务重构为面向铣削的系统性边缘提取问题，STC 概率检测与 HBS 分层搜索的组合能够有效、准确地提取航空蒙皮点云中的铣削边缘，具备工程应用潜力。

title: Zero-Gated Cross-Attention
summary: Injecting non-text modalities into frozen language models often introduces early optimization instability, making it difficult to separate architectural gains from transient training dynamics. We introduce Inductively Gated Cross-Attention (IGCA), a zero-initialized cross-attention bridge that preserves pretrained model behavior at initialization while enabling gradual multimodal conditioning. Integrated across six decoder layers of frozen Falcon-40B, open_llama_30b, and Bloom-7b1 backbones (with 40,404,961,288 trainable adapter parameters used during training), IGCA acts as an exact algebraic no-op at initialization with a maximum output discrepancy of 0.00e+00. Over 59,500 training steps on Falcon-40B, the training loss decreases from 3.9403 to 0.0007 (with final ten step losses of [0.0001, 0.0003, 0.0005, 0.0002, 0.0005, 0.0011, 0.0005, 0.0006, 0.0005, 0.0007]). On held-out evaluation, the best gate-on checkpoint achieves a loss of 2.2201 compared to 4.3469 for the gate-off baseline -- a 48.9% reduction (2.1268 nats) -- while average held-out loss improves from 4.3423 to 2.2498 (1.9075 nats) with a mean gate magnitude of $\vert{}\tanh(α)\vert{} = 0.0713$.

AI.tldr: 提出零初始化门控交叉注意力桥接模块IGCA，在不破坏预训练行为的前提下实现渐进式多模态条件注入。
AI.motivation: 向冻结语言模型注入非文本模态常引发早期优化不稳定，导致难以区分架构收益与瞬态训练动态。
AI.method: 零初始化的交叉注意力桥接（IGCA），初始化时保持对预训练模型的精确恒等（no-op），随后通过门控（tanh(α)）逐步引入多模态条件；集成于Falcon-40B、open_llama_30b、Bloom-7b1的六个解码层，训练适配器可训练参数约40.4B。
AI.result: 初始化输出最大偏差0.00e+00；Falcon-40B上59,500步训练loss由3.9403降至0.0007；留出集最佳gate-on checkpoint loss 2.2201 vs gate-off 4.3469（降低48.9%，2.1268 nats），平均留出loss 4.3423→2.2498（1.9075 nats），平均门幅|tanh(α)|=0.0713。
AI.conclusion: 零初始化门控桥接可稳定早期训练、隔离架构增益，并显著提升留出集性能，门控幅度保持较小说明条件化以温和方式生效。

title: FP4Quant: Efficient 4-Bit Communication Compression for Model-Parallel LLM Training
comment: 5 figures, 3 tables, accepted by IFIP NPC 2026
summary: The rapid scaling of large language models (LLMs) has made communication overhead a critical bottleneck in distributed model-parallel training. Although existing low-precision compression methods can effectively reduce communication costs, further reducing the communication footprint to ultra-low-bit formats such as FP4 introduces new challenges, including limited numerical range, sub-byte storage overhead, and increased computational cost from fine-grained quantization. In this paper, we present \textbf{FP4Quant}, a micro-grouped FP4 compression framework for efficient model-parallel LLM training. FP4Quant integrates a micro-grouped dual-scale FP4 quantization mechanism to preserve local tensor distribution characteristics, a warp-cooperative FP4 packing scheme to enable efficient sub-byte data representation, and a hybrid two-level FWHT pipeline to mitigate quantization errors with GPU-aware execution optimization. Experiments on NVIDIA H100 GPUs with Qwen-7B demonstrate up to 1.56$\times$ end-to-end throughput improvement over BF16, revealing a trade-off between throughput and model quality.

AI.tldr: FP4Quant 是一个面向模型并行 LLM 训练的微分组 FP4 压缩框架，通过双尺度量化、warp 协同打包与两级 FWHT 流水线，在 H100 上实现相对 BF16 最高 1.56× 的端到端吞吐提升，但存在吞吐与模型质量之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM 规模快速扩张使通信开销成为分布式模型并行训练的关键瓶颈。现有低精度压缩虽能降低通信成本，但进一步压缩到 FP4 等超低位宽格式会带来数值范围受限、亚字节存储开销以及细粒度量化引发的计算开销上升等新挑战。
AI.method: 提出 FP4Quant，包含三项核心设计：(1) 微分组双尺度 FP4 量化机制，保留局部张量分布特征；(2) warp 协同的 FP4 打包方案，实现高效的亚字节数据表示；(3) 混合两级 FWHT（快速沃尔什-哈达玛变换）流水线，并结合 GPU 感知的执行优化以抑制量化误差。
AI.result: 在 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上使用 Qwen-7B 进行实验，端到端吞吐相对 BF16 最高提升 1.56×，同时暴露出吞吐与模型质量之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: FP4 级通信压缩在模型并行 LLM 训练中具备显著的吞吐收益潜力，但需在压缩位宽、量化粒度与模型质量之间进行取舍；FP4Quant 通过量化、打包与误差补偿的协同设计为该方向提供了可行方案。

title: Entropy-Gated Dynamic Rectification for Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) routinely name objects that are absent from the image. Latent steering can reduce this failure in one model forward pass, but a fixed gate treats early and late decoding steps by the same criterion. We observe that predictive entropy varies sharply within free-running generation, while states that commit to short answers occupy a narrow, confident band. We exploit this temporal mismatch by using uncertainty as a causally available, token-local control signal for an existing steering gate. We propose Entropy-Gated Dynamic Rectification (EGDR), which lowers the intervention threshold when entropy derived from the preceding step's already available logits is high and retains the calibrated operating point when it is low. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, the underlying static gate lowers CHAIR CS/CI from 53.00/15.30 to 32.00/14.30; replacing only its constant threshold with EGDR further lowers them to 29.00/13.60. At a matched 58% intervention rate, the corresponding static control obtains 30.50/14.00. The gain over the static gate holds on LLaVA-NeXT-7B and grows with the generation budget, while POPE scores and general multimodal capability remain effectively unchanged. EGDR requires no additional model forward pass and adds roughly 2% measured latency. Our code is available at https://github.com/alvi-uiu/EGDR.

AI.tldr: 提出EGDR，用前一步已可得logits的预测熵作为token级因果控制信号动态调节潜在引导门限，在无额外前向的前提下进一步降低LVLM幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）常生成图像中不存在的物体；现有潜在引导（latent steering）虽能在单次前向中抑制该失败，但其固定门限对早期与后期解码步采用同一判据，忽视了自由生成过程中预测熵的剧烈时序变化与短答案高置信窄带的差异。
AI.method: 利用预测熵的时序错配，将其作为因果可得、token局部的控制信号注入已有引导门限：提出熵门控动态校正（EGDR），当由前一步已可用logits导出的熵较高时降低干预阈值，较低时保持已校准的工作点；仅替换静态门限的常数值，不增加模型前向，额外延迟约2%。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，静态门限将CHAIR CS/CI由53.00/15.30降至32.00/14.30，仅替换常数为EGDR后进一步降至29.00/13.60；在58%相同干预率下静态对照为30.50/14.00。增益在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上保持并随生成预算增大而扩大，POPE分数与通用多模态能力基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 以熵作token级动态门控可在零额外前向、近零延迟代价下优于静态潜在引导，且增益具有跨模型与随生成长度扩展的稳健性。

title: TRIAGE: Reliability- and Load-Conditioned Escalation for Two-Tier LLM Serving with a Semantic Evidence Judge
summary: Two-tier LLM serving escalates selected requests from a small model to a large one, but prompt-based routers cannot see whether retrieved evidence supports an answer, and they treat the GPU cost of an escalation as constant. We study TRIAGE, which conditions escalation on a post-generation reliability state and on a load-dependent GPU price, and we report both what held and what did not on one A40 serving Qwen2.5-7B and 32B (AWQ) under VLLM. Escalation cost rose 21.9x from 1 to 10 requests/s but showed no monotone dependence on KV-cache headroom, and a pre-registered claim that the reliability state detects corrupted evidence (AUROC>=0.70) was falsified at 0.571, although any prompt-only router scores exactly 0.500 by construction. Post hoc, a semantic evidence judge raised detection to 0.846 (0.926 on never-served items) and predicted wrong small-model answers at AUROC 0.90-0.96 on RGB and three RouterBench model pairs; the resulting cascade stayed within about 3 pp of GPT-4 at 79.5% lower API cost for GPT-3.5->GPT-4, yet fell below random routing for open-model pairs with 2-3x price ratios. End to end, the 7B->32B pair showed only a +2.88 pp held-out gap, so the allocator rightly declined to escalate and the headline is a null that a small pre-launch gate failed to expose.

AI.tldr: 研究TRIAGE：以后生成可靠性状态与负载相关GPU价格决定是否升级的两级LLM服务路由。在A40单卡（VLLM, Qwen2.5-7B/32B AWQ）上，预注册假设部分被证伪，事后语义证据评委检测能力显著提升（AUROC 0.846），但端到端7B→32B无显著收益，主要结论为负结果。
AI.motivation: 现有两级服务（小模型升级到大模型）的提示词路由器存在两个缺陷：无法判断检索证据是否支持答案，且将升级的GPU成本视为常数。作者希望以生成后的可靠性状态和负载相关GPU价格作为升级条件，检验其是否成立。
AI.method: 在单张A40、VLLM下部署Qwen2.5-7B与32B（AWQ）进行预注册实验；测量1–10 req/s下升级成本与KV-cache余量的关系；用AUROC评估可靠性状态对损坏证据的检测；事后引入语义证据评委，并在RGB与三组RouterBench模型对上评估其对小模型错误答案的预测能力及级联成本。
AI.result: 升级成本随负载1→10 req/s上升21.9倍，但对KV-cache余量无单调依赖；预注册假设（可靠性状态检测损坏证据AUROC≥0.70）被证伪，实测0.571，而纯提示词路由器按构造恰为0.500；事后语义证据评委将检测提升至0.846（未服务样本0.926），在RGB及三组RouterBench模型对上以AUROC 0.90–0.96预测小模型错误答案；级联在GPT-3.5→GPT-4上API成本降低79.5%且与GPT-4相差约3 pp，但在价格比2–3倍的开源模型对上劣于随机路由；7B→32B端到端留出集差距仅+2.88 pp。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性驱动的升级在证据检测与错误预测上有效，但收益依赖模型对的价格结构；7B→32B场景无明显增益，分配器正确地选择不升级，核心结论是否定性的（null），且该负结果未能被上线前小规模门禁实验提前暴露。

title: CORA: Teacher-Guided Causal O-RAN Adaptation for Jamming Detection
summary: In mission-critical networks, a missed jamming event is costlier than a false alarm, so detectors should favor recall, operate causally, and work without labeled attack data. Retrospective Key Performance Indicator (KPI) detectors meet the label-free requirement but rely on future context and cannot run in streaming operation. We present CORA, a teacher-guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework that transfers the hindsight of a retrospective detector to a causal one without labels during training or deployment. Offline, a retrospective KPI detector evaluated on unlabeled historical logs defines a recall-weighted reward for a masked controller that adapts the sensitivity, persistence, and grace of a causal KPI detector. At deployment, the teacher is removed and the frozen controller acts causally, with no ground-truth labels and no target-specific calibration. The design maps onto offline training in the Non-Real-Time RIC and causal control in the Near-Real-Time RIC of an Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN). Under leave-one-out transfer across ten 5G O-RAN testbed configurations, CORA reaches recall-oriented operating points on the deployable frontier that none of the evaluated baselines covers. A Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) controller raises mean recall from 0.687 to 0.771 over a fixed default detector on all ten configurations, while a Deep Q-Network (DQN) achieves a comparable F2-score to the best teacher-selected static configuration, with 61% fewer false alarms. Removing the teacher lowers recall on every configuration.

AI.tldr: CORA 提出教师引导的强化学习框架，将回顾式 KPI 检测器的“事后视角”迁移给因果检测器，在无需标签的条件下训练与部署，实现召回优先的流式干扰检测。
AI.motivation: 任务关键网络中漏检干扰事件代价高于误报，因此检测器应偏向召回、因果（在线）运行且不依赖标注攻击数据。现有回顾式 KPI 检测器虽免标签，但依赖未来上下文，无法流式部署。
AI.method: 离线阶段：用回顾式 KPI 检测器在无标签历史日志上评估，定义召回加权奖励，训练一个掩码控制器以自适应调节因果 KPI 检测器的灵敏度、持续性与宽限参数；部署阶段移除教师，冻结的控制器以因果方式在线运行。该设计对应 O-RAN 中 Non-RT RIC 离线训练与 Near-RT RIC 因果控制的划分。
AI.result: 在 10 种 5G O-RAN 测试床配置上进行留一法迁移：CORA 达到所评估基线均未覆盖的召回导向可部署工作点。PPO 控制器在全部 10 种配置上将平均召回从固定默认检测器的 0.687 提升至 0.771；DQN 在 F2 分数上与最佳教师选择静态配置相当，且误报减少 61%。移除教师后所有配置召回均下降。
AI.conclusion: 教师引导 RL 可有效将回顾式检测器的免标签优势迁移至因果检测器，实现召回优先的流式检测，且教师对性能具有关键贡献。

title: Reciprocity Can Erase Direction:tructural Boundaries and Controlled Utility of Magnetic Graph Networks
summary: Magnetic graph networks encode direction through phase, but a learned graph can erase the intended directional mechanism before prediction. We characterize this failure for support-based magnetic Laplacians. Exact identities relate imaginary energy and distance from zero phase to amplitude-weighted reciprocity. Top-$k$ selection forces complete collapse when the observed-node count satisfies $m\leq k+1$, and dense support imposes a lower bound on reciprocal-arc fraction. We then construct paired propagation examples with identical node features and symmetric amplitudes but opposite labels, giving a provable chance-level limit for direction-erasing representations. In 72 fixed neural fits, support phase achieved test AUROC 1.0000 on a unilateral ring but 0.5000 on reciprocal ring and complete supports; continuous score phase and a real directed comparator achieved 1.0000 throughout. All models solved the direction-free control. These are oracle-direction mechanism tests, not evidence of learned clinical direction. In the preserved public DeepDRiD development study, continuous phase was active but its robustness difference from zero phase was only $+0.0036$ (descriptive 95\% interval $-0.0014$ to $+0.0095$) on validation patients used for checkpoint selection. The contribution is a structural and experimental framework for distinguishing erased direction from unestablished task utility. It provides a precise circumstance in which magnetic phase preserves useful information, without asserting universal or clinical superiority.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示基于支撑集的磁图拉普拉斯在特定条件下会"擦除"方向信息：当观测节点数m≤k+1时Top-k支撑导致完全塌缩，并构造出方向擦除表示只能达到随机水平(0.5 AUROC)的可证明极限；固定神经拟合中支撑相位在单向环上1.0、在互惠环/完全支撑上0.5，而连续相位与实数有向比较器始终为1.0。
AI.motivation: 磁图网络通过相位编码方向，但学习到的图结构可能在预测前就消除预期的方向机制；需要区分"方向被擦除"与"任务效用未建立"这两种不同情形。
AI.method: 对基于支撑集的磁拉普拉斯进行结构性刻画：建立虚部能量、零相位距离与幅度加权互惠性之间的精确恒等式；分析Top-k选择的塌缩条件与稠密支撑下互惠弧比例下界；构造节点特征相同、幅度对称但标签相反的配对传播样例；开展72次固定神经拟合的oracle方向机制测试，并在DeepDRiD公共数据开发研究中检验连续相位的稳健性差异。
AI.result: 支撑相位在单向环上测试AUROC为1.0000，但在互惠环与完全支撑上为0.5000；连续分数相位与实数有向比较器全程保持1.0000；所有模型均通过无方向对照。DeepDRiD中连续相位虽被激活，但相对零相位的稳健性差异仅+0.0036（描述性95%区间-0.0014至+0.0095）。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于区分"方向被擦除"与"任务效用未建立"的结构性与实验性框架，精确给出磁相位能保留有用信息的情形，但不主张普遍或临床上的优越性；该实验为oracle方向机制测试，而非学习到的临床方向证据。

title: DynOSeg: Dynamic Object Segmentation via Motion-Geometry Fusion
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 22 pages, including supplementary materials
summary: Moving Object Segmentation (MOS) detects and separates dynamic objects from the static background in a video, which plays a fundamental role in dynamic-scene understanding. Most MOS methods rely on pure visual motion cues alone, such as optical flow or point tracks, which is inherently ambiguous due to the compounded camera and object motions as well as motion-induced appearance changes, e.g. shadows and reflections. Naive fusion of additional information such as depth and semantics, however, cannot leverage their complementarity to the fullest extent. We therefore propose DynOSeg, a novel MOS approach that takes on a two-stage fusion structure. DynOSeg first combines a geometry-aware residual map and depth encoding into a geometric representation of motion, delineating camera motions and object dynamics. We then further incorporate semantic features to refine object understanding. We have additionally curated a diverse training corpus including CARLA-MOS, a new synthetic urban-driving dataset for MOS training. Our experiments show that DynOSeg consistently outperforms published state-of-the-art MOS methods across a diverse range of datasets. Our code and pretrained models can be found at https://github.com/ACFR-RPG/DynOSeg

AI.tldr: 提出DynOSeg，采用两阶段融合结构解决运动目标分割中视觉运动线索歧义问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MOS方法多依赖纯视觉运动线索（光流、点轨迹），由于相机运动与物体运动叠加、以及运动导致的外观变化（阴影、反射），存在固有歧义；简单拼接深度、语义等信息无法充分发挥互补性。
AI.method: 两阶段融合框架：第一阶段将几何感知残差图与深度编码融合，构建几何化运动表示以区分相机运动与物体动态；第二阶段进一步引入语义特征细化物体理解；并构建多样化训练语料，含新提出的合成城市驾驶数据集CARLA-MOS。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上一致优于已发表的SOTA MOS方法。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段、几何先导再语义细化的融合策略能更充分利用深度与语义的互补性，提升动态场景下MOS的鲁棒性与泛化性；代码与预训练模型已开源。

title: Patching the Protocol: A Taxonomy of Pre-Registration Repairs in LLM-Proposer Experiments
comment: 12 pages. Three-case study of protocol repairs in a pre-registered, LLM-proposer/verifier-gated program (production scheduling, incentive design, task assignment): each protocol needed exactly one defect-repair patch; a two-axis taxonomy and a verifiable non-impact claim for post-data repairs. Artifact archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23433826
summary: Pre-registration is increasingly proposed as a trust mechanism for machine-learning research involving LLM-generated content, but its canonical form assumes a frozen protocol can be executed unchanged. Software-intensive studies violate this assumption: the protocol is partly implemented, and implementations carry defects. We report a three-case study of protocol repairs ("patches") from a program where an LLM proposes executable rules that a programmatic verifier gates, across production scheduling, incentive design, and task assignment. Each protocol required exactly one defect-repair patch: three events in total. None modified a numbered judgment criterion, its threshold, or the scoring rule, and none altered already collected data; two changed pre-registered design parameters before any data were collected, each with a recorded rationale. We propose a two-axis taxonomy of patches (defect class: environmental / feasibility / correctness, x timing: pre-data / post-data), introduce a verifiable non-impact claim for post-data repairs, and distill a nine-item checklist; all nine items were exercised by at least one patch event -- an observation of use, not a validation of sufficiency. The credibility of verifier-bound, LLM-proposer studies depends less on whether patches occur than on whether they are auditable.

AI.tldr: 报告三个"LLM提议-程序校验"案例中各出现一次协议补丁（共3次），提出补丁分类学、可验证的"无影响声明"与九项清单，主张这类研究的可信度取决于补丁是否可审计而非是否发生。
AI.motivation: 预注册被视为涉及LLM生成内容的机器学习研究的信任机制，但其规范形式假设协议可"冻结"后原样执行；软件密集型研究不满足该假设——协议仅部分被实现，而实现本身带有缺陷，因此需要研究"协议修补"如何发生、如何被记录与审计。
AI.method: 三案例研究（生产调度、激励机制设计、任务分配），每个案例中LLM提出可执行规则、由程序化校验器把关；逐次记录补丁事件，并对补丁按两轴分类（缺陷类别：环境/可行性/正确性 × 时机：数据前/数据后），提出针对数据后修补的可验证"无影响声明"（non-impact claim），并归纳出九项检查清单。
AI.result: 每个协议恰好需要一次缺陷修复补丁，共3次事件；无任何补丁修改编号判据、其阈值或评分规则，也未改动已采集数据；其中2次在数据采集前变更了预注册设计参数，并各自记录理由。九项清单条目均至少被一次补丁事件实际触发（属使用性观察，非充分性验证）。
AI.conclusion: 对"校验器把关、LLM提议"类研究而言，预注册的可信度更多取决于补丁的可审计性（缺陷归类、时机标注、理由与无影响声明的可验证性），而非补丁是否发生；清单仅为使用证据，其充分性尚待验证。

title: What Is the Influence of Task Order in Continual Learning? An Empirical Study and Order-Aware Evaluation for Motion Forecasting
summary: Aggregate scores for continual learning algorithms rest on a distribution over task orders that is rarely stated. We formulate algorithm comparison as an expectation over a declared order distribution, which separates training variation from order variation, and apply it to motion forecasting with four road-layout tasks from the INTERACTION dataset, all 24 task orders, four algorithms, and three training replicates (288 runs). Task order accounts for 65\% to 91\% of the variation in current-task error and backward transfer, and 90\% to 99\% of this order effect comes from the identity of the starting task: the smallest task cannot be learned from a cold start. Beyond the first stage, the order effect is comparable to training variability. In most orders, the leading algorithm in current-task error and backward transfer is within one replicate standard deviation of the runner-up. Backward transfer depends on the order mainly through its reference term, which weights the first task most heavily, so relative improvement and final error identify different leading algorithms for displacement error. A transition-direction descriptor computed from task statistics tracks the position of the smallest task, and weighting orders by it leaves the algorithm ranking unchanged. These results call for benchmarks that declare their order distribution and report order-resolved, starting-task-resolved, warm-start, and final errors alongside aggregate scores. The code and data are available \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/task-order-cl-4f7b/}{here}.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出持续学习算法的聚合分数依赖未被声明的任务顺序分布，将算法比较形式化为对显式顺序分布的期望，并在INTERACTION数据集4个道路布局任务的24种全排列、4种算法、3次训练重复（288次运行）上做实证分析。
AI.motivation: 持续学习基准普遍报告聚合分数，但其隐含的任务顺序分布很少被明确声明，训练变异与顺序变异相互混杂，导致算法排名可能不可靠甚至误导。
AI.method: 把算法比较建模为对声明式任务顺序分布的期望，从而分离训练变异与顺序变异；在运动预测任务（INTERACTION数据集，4个道路布局任务）上穷举全部24种任务顺序，比较4种算法、每配置3次训练重复，共288次运行；并定义由任务统计量计算得到的"转移方向描述子"用于对顺序重新加权。
AI.result: 任务顺序解释了当前任务误差与后向迁移变异的65%–91%，其中90%–99%的顺序效应来自起始任务身份：最小任务无法从冷启动中学习；首阶段之后顺序效应与训练变异相当。多数顺序下，当前任务误差与后向迁移的领先算法与次优算法差距在一个重复标准差之内；后向迁移主要经由加权首任务最重参考项依赖顺序，导致相对改进与最终误差指向不同的领先算法。按转移方向描述子加权后算法排名不变。
AI.conclusion: 持续学习基准应声明其任务顺序分布，并在聚合分数之外报告按顺序分解、按起始任务分解、热启动以及最终误差等指标。

title: Is Forgetting Unified? Exploring Concept Unlearning in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate image generation and visual understanding, but are existing single-pathway unlearning methods sufficient to suppress target concepts across both? In this work, we study cross-pathway concept unlearning. Our goal is to prevent a model from both generating images of a target concept and identifying it in input images, while preserving other capabilities. To this end, we introduce UUBench, a diagnostic benchmark covering 30 target concepts and 60 semantically related neighboring concepts. Experiments on representative UMMs show that the evaluated single-pathway methods achieve limited joint forgetting: generation-side editors strongly suppress target generation but yield limited forgetting in visual understanding, while understanding-side baselines struggle to achieve substantial forgetting even in their own pathway. Their direct composition also yields limited joint forgetting. We therefore propose UniForget, achieving joint forgetting rates of 80.0% on BAGEL-7B-MoT and 92.7% on Janus-Pro-7B, outperforming representative baselines. Further analysis reveals trade-offs between joint forgetting and capability preservation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究统一多模态模型（UMMs）的跨通路概念遗忘问题，提出诊断基准UUBench，并证明现有单通路遗忘方法联合遗忘能力不足，进而提出UniForget实现联合遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有遗忘方法多为单通路设计，无法同时在图像生成与视觉理解两条通路上抑制目标概念；论文旨在检验单通路方法在跨通路场景下的充分性并弥补其不足。
AI.method: 构建UUBench诊断基准（30个目标概念、60个语义相关的邻近概念），系统评测代表性UMMs上的单通路方法及其直接组合；提出UniForget以实现联合遗忘。
AI.result: 生成侧编辑器能强烈抑制目标生成但理解侧遗忘有限；理解侧基线即便在自身通路也难以实现显著遗忘；两者直接组合的联合遗忘同样有限。UniForget在BAGEL-7B-MoT上达80.0%、在Janus-Pro-7B上达92.7%的联合遗忘率，优于代表性基线。
AI.conclusion: 单通路遗忘方法不足以实现跨通路概念抑制，UniForget可有效实现联合遗忘，但联合遗忘与模型能力保持之间存在权衡。

title: Beyond Fine-Tuning: Evaluating Prompt Engineering and Prompt Tuning for Roman Urdu Hate Speech Detection
summary: Low Resource Languages (LRLs) pose significant challenges for hate speech detection because of a scarcity of readily available annotated data, language variation, non-standard spelling, and context-dependent ambiguity. Beyond the problem of informal conventions of writing in Roman Urdu, there is also the issue of code-mixing. After working on the previous project about zero-shot learning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), this research systematically compares prompt engineering and prompt tuning for Roman Urdu hate speech detection. To study the effect of in-context examples, we will compare the zero-shot and few-shot prompting approaches. To understand the advantage of structured prompting and learnable prompt representations, we will conduct studies of manual vs. mixed prompt-based adaptation strategies. Experimentations are carried out on the PURUT dataset (~72,771 social media comments) with GPT-3.5, LLaMA-3, Mistral-7B, and multilingual BERT in several settings. Experimental results show that few-shot prompting always outperforms zero-shot prompting, with the Mistral-7B model scoring 0.67 F1 compared to 0.56 of the zero-shot models. Based on this observation, prompt-based adaptation is proposed to introduce additional improvements, with the proposed mixed prompt configuration able to yield a F1-score up to 0.87 which further surpasses the performance of regular manual prompts. Despite the larger size of the model, its performance trade-off between inference-based prompting, prompt optimization, and parameter-efficient model adaptation is compared to the previously reported PEFT-based F1-score, which is ~0.93.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统比较了提示工程与提示微调在罗马乌尔都语仇恨言论检测中的效果，在PURUT数据集（约72,771条）上用GPT-3.5、LLaMA-3、Mistral-7B和多语言BERT进行多设置实验：少样本提示始终优于零样本（Mistral-7B F1为0.67 vs 0.56），混合提示配置可达0.87，但仍低于此前PEFT方法的约0.93。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（LRLs）仇恨言论检测面临标注数据稀缺、语言变体、非规范拼写及上下文相关歧义等挑战；罗马乌尔都语还存在非正式书写习惯与语码混合问题。在前期零样本学习与参数高效微调（PEFT）工作基础上，作者希望系统厘清提示工程与提示微调在该任务上的相对价值。
AI.method: 在PURUT数据集（约72,771条社交媒体评论）上，使用GPT-3.5、LLaMA-3、Mistral-7B与多语言BERT开展多设置对比实验；比较零样本与少样本提示以考察上下文示例的作用；比较人工提示与混合提示（结构化提示+可学习提示表示）以考察结构化提示与可学习提示表示的优势。
AI.result: 少样本提示一致优于零样本提示，Mistral-7B取得0.67 F1，而零样本模型为0.56；混合提示配置将F1提升至最高0.87，优于常规人工提示；但整体仍不及此前报告的PEFT方法约0.93的F1。
AI.conclusion: 提示基适应（尤其是混合提示）能显著提升罗马乌尔都语仇恨言论检测性能，但更大模型在推理式提示、提示优化与参数高效模型适配之间存在性能权衡，PEFT在本任务上仍具优势；研究为低资源语言提示策略选择提供了实证依据。

title: Coarse Semantic Blocks for Efficient Training-Free Sparse Attention
summary: We introduce a training-free sparse attention method that builds a prompt-specific key index to accelerate both prefill and decoding. The method clusters the keys into large semantic blocks that group tokens from noncontiguous positions. Each query position selects blocks by scoring their centroids and attends to the original keys and values within them. Queries that select the same block are processed together, so prefill stays fast even though each query chooses its own blocks. Large blocks make centroid scoring and this grouped processing cheap, so each query can attend to more tokens in the same time. Larger blocks with a larger token budget can thus be both faster and more accurate on long-context tasks than smaller blocks with a smaller budget. We evaluate two hybrid LLMs, Qwen3.5-4B and 35B-A3B, on one NVIDIA H200. Including the cost of building and using the index, whole-model wall-clock speedups over dense attention are 2.3-2.4x for prefill and 1.7-2.0x for decoding at 512K tokens, and 2.9-3.0x for prefill at 1M. The 35B-A3B model stays close to dense attention on five RULER tasks through 1M, on LongBench-v2 overall, and on MRCR through 256K. The 4B model loses accuracy mainly on multi-key retrieval, yet outperforms dense Qwen3.5-2B, whose latency is similar at 512K, on all three benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练稀疏注意力方法，通过聚类构建提示特定的键索引，同时加速预填充与解码，并在512K–1M长上下文下取得显著加速且精度接近稠密注意力。
AI.motivation: 长上下文场景下稠密注意力的预填充与解码开销随序列长度平方级增长，需要一种无需重新训练、同时兼顾速度与精度的稀疏注意力方案。
AI.method: 将键聚类为语义大块（块内包含非连续位置的token），构建提示特定的键索引；每个查询位置对其块质心打分以选择块，再在选中块内对原始键值做注意力；选中相同块的查询被分组批量处理，从而在每查询独立选块的条件下仍保持预填充效率；大块使得质心打分与分组处理代价低廉，可在相同时耗内覆盖更多token预算。
AI.result: 在单张H200上评测Qwen3.5-4B与35B-A3B两个混合LLM：含索引构建与使用开销在内，512K下预填充加速2.3–2.4x、解码加速1.7–2.0x，1M下预填充加速2.9–3.0x；35B-A3B在1M内五项RULER任务、LongBench-v2整体及256K内MRCR上接近稠密注意力；4B模型主要在多键检索上掉点，但在三项基准上仍优于延迟相近（512K）的稠密Qwen3.5-2B。
AI.conclusion: 大块+大token预算的配置在长上下文任务上可同时比小块+小预算更快且更准确，说明块粒度与预算的联合放大是该免训练稀疏注意力取得速度-精度双赢的关键。

title: Using GeoAI and machine learning tools for consistent high-resolution land cover mapping based on time-series NAIP imagery
summary: High-resolution land-cover maps support ecological monitoring, but consistent historical time series remain scarce because aerial imagery varies across years and sensors. We developed a dual-track workflow to produce temporally coherent 1-m land-cover maps from National Agricultural Imagery Program (NAIP) imagery without historical training samples. For higher-quality imagery from 2009-2017, we used a pretrained U-Net/ResNet-34 model and refined boundaries with the Segment Anything Model (SAM). For lower-quality imagery from 2004-2008, we reconstructed land cover through an NLCD-based spatiotemporal bridging and label back-casting pipeline. Evaluation across six counties in North Carolina and Pennsylvania yielded overall accuracies of 0.887 (2014), 0.886 (2017), and 0.733 (2004). Structure, Water, Wetland, and Cropland consistently achieved high F1-scores. The workflow integrates GeoAI and multiple data sources to address temporal heterogeneity in historical aerial imagery, supporting high-resolution land-change analysis and landscape planning across the conterminous United States.

AI.tldr: 提出双轨工作流，在无历史训练样本条件下，从NAIP航拍影像生成时间一致的1米土地覆盖地图，六县总体精度达0.887（2014）、0.886（2017）、0.733（2004）。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率土地覆盖地图支持生态监测，但航拍影像在年份与传感器间存在差异，导致一致的历史时间序列稀缺；且历史时期缺乏训练样本，难以直接进行监督分类。
AI.method: 双轨流程：对2009–2017年高质量影像，使用预训练U-Net/ResNet-34模型并结合SAM细化边界；对2004–2008年低质量影像，采用基于NLCD的时空桥接与标签回溯（label back-casting）流程重建土地覆盖。
AI.result: 在北卡罗来纳州与宾夕法尼亚州六个县评估：总体精度2014年0.887、2017年0.886、2004年0.733；Structure、Water、Wetland、Cropland类别F1分数持续较高。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流融合GeoAI与多源数据，缓解历史航拍影像的时间异质性，可支撑高分辨率土地变化分析与景观规划，并具备推广至美国本土的潜力。

title: Benchmarking Unsupervised Jamming Detection in 5G Open RAN
summary: Radio Frequency (RF) jamming threatens fifth-generation (5G) networks. Open Radio Access Network (Open RAN) telemetry enables jamming detection without dedicated spectrum monitoring equipment, but labeled attack data are rarely available across deployments, motivating unsupervised detectors. Comparing such detectors across algorithmic families, however, remains difficult without ground-truth labels. This paper benchmarks statistical and reconstruction-based unsupervised jamming detectors using a symmetric evaluation interface that combines detection confidence and temporal interval coherence into a detector-independent composite score. We compare a Statistical Ensemble Method (SEM) detector against Vanilla, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Variational Autoencoder (VAE) baselines on Key Performance Indicator (KPI) telemetry from ten heterogeneous 5G environments with fixed and variable jamming bursts and dynamic jammer gains. Under leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation, SEM achieves a mean composite score of 0.906, compared with 0.688 for the best autoencoder (AE) per fold. Ground-truth validation yields a mean F1-score of 0.918 for SEM, compared with 0.521 for the best AE variant. The composite ranks SEM first in all environments, consistent with F1 rankings. However, in both within-trace and cross-trace evaluation, it fails for detectors that flag far fewer samples than the jamming prevalence, indicating that rankings are reliable only when detection rate matches the expected prevalence.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种与探测器无关的对称评估接口，将检测置信度与时间区间连贯性合成为复合分数，用于在无标签条件下公平比较统计类与重构类无监督RF干扰检测器；基于十个异构5G环境的KPI遥测数据，SEM在留一法评估中复合分数0.906、F1 0.918，均显著优于AE类基线，但该排序仅在检测率与干扰发生率匹配时可靠。
AI.motivation: RF干扰威胁5G网络，Open RAN遥测可在无需专用频谱监测设备的情况下实现干扰检测；但跨部署场景普遍缺乏标注攻击数据，因而需要无监督检测器。然而在没有真实标签的情况下，难以对不同算法族的无监督检测器进行横向比较，缺少统一、公平的评估基准。
AI.method: 以十个异构5G环境的KPI遥测为数据源，覆盖固定与可变干扰突发以及动态干扰增益；构建对称评估接口，将检测置信度与时间区间连贯性融合为不依赖具体检测器的复合分数；将统计集成方法（SEM）与Vanilla、LSTM、VAE三类重构型基线进行对比，采用留一法（LOO）、within-trace与cross-trace评估，并用真实标签做F1验证。
AI.result: LOO评估中SEM平均复合分数为0.906，而每折最优AE仅为0.688；有标签验证下SEM平均F1为0.918，最优AE变体为0.521。复合分数在所有环境中均将SEM排为第一，与F1排序一致。但在within-trace和cross-trace评估中，对于检出样本数远少于干扰发生率的检测器，该评估会失效。
AI.conclusion: 复合评估接口可在无标签条件下稳定区分检测器优劣，SEM在5G KPI遥测干扰检测中显著优于重构类方法，且排序与有监督F1一致；但该评估仅当检测率与期望干扰发生率相匹配时排序可靠，对低检出率检测器存在偏差，需结合发生率先验或检出率约束使用。

title: Anchor: Augmented Cross-Layer Recurrent State for Long-Context Retrieval in Test-Time Training
comment: 10 Pages main paper with reference and appendix
summary: Parameter-efficient linearization turns a pretrained autoregressive Transformer into an efficient model by hybridizing sliding-window attention (SWA) with a constant-size recurrent memory. But does every layer's recurrent state contribute to long-context retrieval? Investigating an SWA and Test-Time Training (TTT) hybrid, we find that retrieval is sparse across depth, concentrated in a few anchor layers, and that the remaining states hold similar information expressed through layer-specific transformations. We exploit both observations in Anchor: TTT memory placed only at the anchor layers, and a cross-layer recurrent state written once and read by many layers, each through its own learned read map that realizes a layer-specific stretch and rotation, along with demonstrated generalization to other hybrid attentions. On Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, Anchor delivers 2.3-3.1x higher recall and 6.7-8.9 points higher MMLU accuracy than LoLCATs with a 10x smaller recurrent state, retains 91-95% of the teacher's MMLU accuracy, and cuts end-to-end latency by up to 4.3x relative to softmax attention.

AI.tldr: Anchor 发现混合注意力的循环状态在深度上稀疏且冗余，仅在锚点层放置 TTT 记忆、并让多层共享一个跨层状态（各层自学习读映射），在更小循环状态下显著提升长上下文检索与效率。
AI.motivation: 研究 SWA+TTT 混合线性化模型中，各层循环状态对长上下文检索的实际贡献，检验是否每层状态都必要，从而寻找参数高效、低延迟的线性化方案。
AI.method: 对 SWA 与 Test-Time Training 混合注意力做逐层分析，得到两点观察：检索能力跨深度稀疏、集中于少数“锚点层”；其余状态信息相似、仅经层特定变换表达。据此提出 Anchor：仅在锚点层放置 TTT 记忆，并使用一个“写一次、多层共读”的跨层循环状态，每层通过各自学习的读映射实现层特定的拉伸与旋转；并验证其对其他混合注意力的可推广性。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B 与 Mistral-7B 上，相比 LoLCATs，Anchor 在循环状态小 10 倍的情况下召回率高 2.3–3.1 倍、MMLU 准确率高 6.7–8.9 分，保留教师 MMLU 准确率的 91–95%，端到端延迟相比 softmax 注意力最多降低 4.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 循环状态在层间存在显著冗余，按锚点层稀疏放置并跨层共享状态可在不牺牲（甚至提升）性能的前提下大幅压缩状态规模与延迟，为参数高效长上下文线性化提供了可推广的设计原则。

title: Beyond Token Representations: Explicit Visual Object Grounding for Video Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Video Reasoning Segmentation (VRS) aims to infer and segment target objects specified by reasoning queries in videos. Existing methods typically first infer the target and generate a few segmentation tokens for it, which are then fed into a mask decoder for mask prediction. However, such segmentation tokens tend to be both semantically monotonous and spatially ambiguous, making them largely insufficient to represent the target to guide mask prediction. In this paper, we propose an explicit visual object grounding framework for VRS. Specifically, we first propose a spatial-aware prompt generation and refinement scheme, in which we query a multimodal large language model to generate explicit spatial prompts (i.e., bounding box and point set) for the target and then refine them through multi-step dialogue. Furthermore, we introduce a query diversification and alignment module to generate auxiliary queries that describe the same target from different perspectives. We then enforce cross-query consistency between their predicted spatial prompts to alleviate the training bias caused by query limitations. Finally, we select several reliable frames using a prompt-based keyframe selection strategy to support mask decoding and propagation. Extensive experiments on eight datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/viscom-tongji/EVOG.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 EVOG，一种用于视频推理分割（VRS）的显式视觉目标定位框架：用多模态大模型生成并多轮对话精炼显式空间提示（边界框与点集），结合查询多样化与跨查询一致性约束，并基于提示选择可靠关键帧以支持掩码解码与传播。
AI.motivation: 现有 VRS 方法先推断目标并生成少量分割 token 送入掩码解码器，但这些 token 语义单调、空间定位模糊，难以充分表示目标，从而限制掩码预测质量。
AI.method: 1) 空间感知提示生成与精炼：查询 MLLM 生成显式空间提示（bbox 与点集），并通过多步对话迭代精炼；2) 查询多样化与对齐模块：生成从不同视角描述同一目标的辅助查询，并对各自预测的空间提示施加跨查询一致性约束，缓解查询局限导致的训练偏差；3) 基于提示的关键帧选择策略选取可靠帧，用于掩码解码与传播。
AI.result: 在八个数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于现有最先进方法；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 以显式空间提示替代隐式分割 token 的定位范式可有效提升 VRS 的目标表示能力与分割精度，验证了提示精炼、查询一致性约束与关键帧选择的协同有效性。

title: Embodied AI for Scientific Discovery: From Physical Action to Scientific Evidence
summary: Scientific experiments are increasingly selected, executed and interpreted by learned systems that act through physical interfaces. Robot learning builds physical competence, whereas AI for science chooses which experiment to run, each reporting different endpoints. This review treats their interface as one problem, embodied AI for science, where the experiment itself is partially observed: specimen state, apparatus state and measurement processes are latent, actions are costly and irreversible, and missingness depends on execution and outcome. We organize the literature by three closures operating at distinct levels: operational closure (the experiment realized is the one intended), epistemic closure (the result updates beliefs or selects subsequent experiments) and evidential closure (the record supports a claim). We analyze workflows through a record-linked evidence cycle - Record, Diagnose, Calibrate, Confirm - as analytic functions with feedback. A taxonomy crosses these closures with six delegated decisions and five embodiment classes. Our formulation separates commanded, realized and observed conditions and models diagnosis with explicit resource, risk and sample-change costs. We compare experiment-selection methods by terminal decision, review perception, protocol compilation, visuomotor policies, world models, recovery and transfer by evidence emission requirements, and compare chemistry, materials, biology, microscopy and field workflows by what their records establish. An appendix provides an evidence map of 28 workflows (26 physical, two software-boundary), characterizing validation pathways and claim confirmation requirements. We propose evaluation that separates actions, valid experiments, campaigns and confirmed claims, framing open challenges as controlled comparisons with measurable failure conditions.

AI.tldr: 该综述将机器人学习与AI for Science在"物理接口"处统一为"具身AI for Science"问题，提出操作闭合、认知闭合、证据闭合三层框架及RECC证据循环，给出跨六类委托决策与五类具身方式的方法学分类与评估建议。
AI.motivation: 科学实验日益由通过物理接口行动的机器学习系统来选择、执行与解释；机器人学习侧重物理能力、AI for Science侧重实验选择，二者报告不同的终点指标，缺乏统一的问题表述。同时实验本身是部分可观测的（样本、仪器、测量过程为潜变量，动作昂贵且不可逆，缺失依赖于执行与结果），需要统一框架加以刻画。
AI.method: 概念性综述与形式化：(1) 提出三层闭合框架——操作闭合（实现即意图）、认知闭合（结果更新信念或选择后续实验）、证据闭合（记录支持断言）；(2) 以记录关联的证据循环Record–Diagnose–Calibrate–Confirm刻画工作流并含反馈；(3) 构建闭合×6类委托决策×5类具身方式的分类学；(4) 区分指令条件、实现条件与观测条件，用显式资源、风险与样本改变代价建模诊断；(5) 按终端决策与证据生成要求比较方法族（实验选择、文献审视、协议编译、视觉运动策略、世界模型、恢复与迁移）；(6) 附录提供28个工作流（26个物理、2个软件边界）的证据地图。
AI.result: 形成统一的问题表述：将指令、实现与观测条件分离，并把诊断纳入带资源/风险/样本改变代价的建模；给出跨闭合层次的方法比较维度（证据生成要求）与跨领域工作流比较维度（记录所能确立的内容），覆盖化学、材料、生物、显微与野外场景；附录以28个工作流刻画验证路径与断言确认要求。
AI.conclusion: 应以分层评估替代单一指标：分别度量动作、有效实验、实验战役与已确认断言，并据此区分不同方法族的实际贡献；将开放挑战表述为具有可测量失效条件的受控比较，从而把具身实验中的闭合失败转化为可检验的科学问题。

title: Proper Agnostic Learning of Affine Halfspaces under Log-Concave Marginals
summary: We give a proper constant-factor agnostic learner for affine halfspaces under full-dimensional log-concave marginals. For arbitrary binary labels, the algorithm uses independent labeled samples and returns a single affine halfspace with error at most $C\mathrm{OPT}+\varepsilon$. Its sample and real-arithmetic complexity are polynomial in dimension, inverse accuracy, and the logarithm of the reciprocal failure probability. The mean and covariance of the marginal need not be known, and the sample complexity can be made linear in this logarithmic confidence factor. The main geometric result compares global disagreement with disagreement on a balanced restriction: for a minority halfspace of mass $p$, global disagreement is within universal constant factors of $p$ times conditional disagreement, provided the latter is sufficiently small. To construct the restriction from noisy labels, we estimate the minority cap's mean and covariance robustly, approximately minimize the classical zonoid-depth dual objective, and expand a superlevel set to a marginal quantile. The disagreement comparison cancels the noise amplification caused by conditioning and allows the learned halfspace to be used on the entire space. The analysis combines degree-four sum-of-squares moment bounds for log-concave laws with a translation-based reduction from balanced affine learning to homogeneous halfspace learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文给出了在全维对数凹边缘分布下，针对仿射半空间的常数因子不可知学习器（agnostic learner），仅用独立带标签样本即可输出单个仿射半空间，误差至多 C·OPT+ε，样本与实算术复杂度对维度、逆精度及对数置信因子均为多项式。
AI.motivation: 在不可知设定（任意二值标签）下学习仿射半空间通常受噪声放大与条件化问题困扰；本文旨在不依赖边缘分布均值/协方差已知的前提下，构造在完整空间可用、复杂度多项式的常数因子近似学习算法。
AI.method: 核心技术结果为几何比较：对质量为 p 的少数类半空间，全局不一致度与“平衡限制”上条件不一致度满足普适常数因子关系（当后者足够小时）。为从含噪标签构造该限制，鲁棒估计少数帽（minority cap）的均值与协方差，近似最小化经典 zonoid-depth 对偶目标，并将超水平集扩张至边缘分位数。分析上结合对数凹律的四次平方和矩界，以及将平衡仿射学习归约为齐次半空间学习的平移化方法。
AI.result: 算法达到误差 ≤ C·OPT+ε；样本复杂度对 log(1/δ) 可为线性；不一致度比较可抵消条件化带来的噪声放大，使学习到的半空间可在整个空间上使用。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了对数凹边际下仿射半空间的常数因子不可知可学习性，并通过全局/条件不一致度的常数因子比较与鲁棒矩估计，解决了条件化噪声放大问题，给出多项式复杂度的实用算法框架。

title: KeyWise: Efficient Video-Only Piano Transcription with a Lightweight Per-Key Architecture
summary: Audio-based piano transcription is hampered by the sustain pedal and by noisy or missing soundtracks, problems that video-only transcription avoids, since a top-view video shows directly when each key is pressed and released. Most visual transcription networks, however, describe the whole keyboard with one global feature vector and must learn where each key is. In this paper, we propose KeyWise, a lightweight per-key architecture that exploits the known geometry of the keyboard instead of learning it. The rectified keyboard is divided into 88 equal tiles that serve as regions of interest (ROIs), and one small recurrent network, shared by all keys, follows each key over time. On PianoVAM, KeyWise reaches the onset accuracy of the state-of-the-art V2N (95.0% vs. 94.7% onset F1 at 50 ms and 97.8% vs. 97.0% at 100 ms) with 1.3 M instead of 28.2 M parameters, and it runs 4.7 times faster on the same GPU. At 100 ms, it is also significantly more accurate when the key releases (97.0% vs. 95.5% F1) or the velocities (89.4% vs. 84.5% F1) must be correct as well. On PianoYT, KeyWise pre-trained on PianoVAM reaches 69.4% onset F1 at 100 ms, comparable to the best published result, although it needs fine-tuning for new recording conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出KeyWise：一种利用键盘已知几何结构的轻量级逐键视频转录架构，将校正后的键盘划分为88个等分ROI，用共享的递归网络逐键跟踪时间演化，在更少参数和更快速度下达到甚至超越SOTA精度。
AI.motivation: 音频钢琴转录受延音踏板及噪声/缺失音轨困扰，而顶视视频可直接显示按键的按下与释放，故视频转录更具优势；但现有视觉转录网络用单一全局特征描述整个键盘，必须自行学习每个键的位置，冗余且低效。
AI.method: KeyWise采用逐键（per-key）架构：将校正（rectified）后的键盘图像划分为88个等大小tile作为感兴趣区域（ROI），放弃学习键位，而是直接利用键盘的已知几何先验；对每个键使用一个小型递归网络（所有键共享权重）沿时间维度进行跟踪，从而得到各键的起音、释放与力度信息。
AI.result: 在PianoVAM上，KeyWise的起音F1达到95.0%（50 ms）与97.8%（100 ms），与SOTA的V2N（94.7%/97.0%）相当，但参数量仅1.3 M（对比28.2 M），同GPU上运行速度快4.7倍；在100 ms容差下，释放F1为97.0%（V2N 95.5%）、力度F1为89.4%（V2N 84.5%），均显著更优。在PianoYT上，经PianoVAM预训练的模型在100 ms时取得69.4%起音F1，与已发表最佳结果相当，但新录音条件仍需微调。
AI.conclusion: 将键盘几何先验以逐键ROI+共享递归网络的形式显式编码，可在显著降低参数量与计算成本的同时保持或提升转录精度，尤其利于释放与力度估计；跨数据集泛化仍需针对新录制条件进行微调。

title: Twice as Fast, Until It Isn't: Quantized Serving of Mid-Size Open LLMs
summary: A team serving a 9B-20B open-weight language model on vLLM or SGLang must choose a quantization recipe, and needs two numbers: the speedup over BF16 and the accuracy given up. We assemble every public measurement of these numbers that we could verify and find that the record supplies them only in pieces. Only two checkpoints, both INT4 builds of Gemma 3 12B, have both a vLLM timing and an accuracy score, and that score covers a single MMLU subject, one that the AWQ build was calibrated on. The batch-1 timings predate current engine releases, AMD and Intel Gaudi have no timing in this band at all, and FP4 has none against BF16. The timings that do exist follow one rule. Decoding a small batch is limited by memory bandwidth, so 4-bit weights roughly double speed (2.12x for Qwen2.5-14B on an A100), but the gain vanishes once a large batch makes the GPU compute-bound (1.02x for Gemma 3 12B at batch size 256), where FP8 is the recipe that can still help. Many published accuracy deltas, including every HumanEval delta, lie within benchmark sampling noise. We close with a seven-item reporting checklist for future measurements.

AI.tldr: 该文系统梳理了9B–20B开源权重模型在vLLM/SGLang上量化的公开实测数据，发现"相对BF16的加速比"与"精度损失"两项关键数字仅碎片化存在，并归纳出解码受带宽限制则4-bit权重约提速2倍、大batch转向计算受限后增益消失（FP8仍有效）的规律。
AI.motivation: 部署团队在选择量化方案时必须同时回答两个问题：相对BF16的加速比与可接受的精度损失。然而现有公开测量分散且不成对，缺少同时给出引擎实测时延与精度评分的证据，尤其是INT4、FP4在AMD/Intel Gaudi、大batch及批大小1以外的场景几乎空白，因此需要一次系统性的证据盘点来界定已知与未知。
AI.method: 采用证据汇总/系统性综述方式：收集并尽可能核验所有公开的加速比与精度测量，按模型（9B–20B）、量化位宽（INT4/FP4/FP8）、引擎（vLLM/SGLang）、硬件（A100、AMD、Intel Gaudi）与批大小维度对齐配对，检视哪些测量同时具备时延与精度两项数字，并将精度差值与benchmark采样噪声区间作比较。
AI.result: 仅有两个检查点（均为Gemma 3 12B的INT4构建）同时具备vLLM时延与精度分数，且该精度仅覆盖单一MMLU子科目（恰为AWQ校准所用科目）；批大小1的时延数据早于当前引擎版本；AMD与Intel Gaudi在该参数区间无任何时延数据，FP4亦无对BF16的时延。既有数据呈现规律：小batch解码受内存带宽限制，4-bit权重约提速2倍（Qwen2.5-14B在A100上为2.12×）；大batch下GPU转为计算受限，增益消失（Gemma 3 12B在batch size 256为1.02×）。多处已发表的精度差值（含全部HumanEval差值）落在benchmark采样噪声范围内。
AI.conclusion: 现有公开证据不足以支撑对9B–20B模型量化方案的可靠选型：加速比与精度损失的数据碎片化、覆盖面窄且存在版本与硬件缺口。实践建议为小batch/低并发优先INT4权重、大batch场景考虑FP8；同时提出七项报告清单（reporting checklist）以规范未来测量，使时延与精度成对、可复现、并覆盖目标硬件与批大小区间。

title: Aligning Training and Rollout Policies for End-to-End FP4 RL on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
summary: In this work, we study end-to-end FP4 reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models. Recent work on FP4 RL has introduced effective recovery recipes that restore accuracy under aggressive low-precision quantization for dense models, but we find that the same approach yields no improvement over the naive FP4 baseline in the MoE setting. We conduct an in-depth study to understand why. Our analysis identifies the root cause in the routing mechanism unique to MoE: because the router makes discrete expert-selection decisions, training-inference policy alignment becomes acutely sensitive to whether the same recovery technique is applied symmetrically on the training and inference sides. When an asymmetric recipe is used-including the dense-model approach, which corrects only the rollout-training-inference alignment deteriorates sharply, as measured by the Pearson correlation coefficient between training and inference probabilities, and router selection matching rates. Building on this finding, we propose MoeResQ, a quantization-recovery recipe for MoE RL post-training that enforces symmetry between the training- and inference-side corrections. MoeResQ restores training-inference alignment and substantially closes the accuracy gap to full precision, establishing symmetric recovery as the key principle in FP4 RL for MoE models.

AI.tldr: 针对MoE大模型端到端FP4强化学习后训练，发现dense模型有效的FP4恢复配方在MoE上失效，根因是MoE路由机制的离散专家选择使训练-推理策略对齐对恢复技术是否在训练侧与推理侧对称应用极其敏感；据此提出对称化的量化恢复方案MoeResQ。
AI.motivation: 现有FP4 RL工作为dense模型提供了有效的恢复配方，可在激进低精度量化下恢复精度，但作者发现该配方在MoE场景下相比朴素FP4基线毫无提升，需要弄清失效原因并给出可行方案。
AI.method: 开展深入分析定位根因：MoE路由器做出离散的专家选择决策，使训练-推理策略对齐对恢复技术是否在训练侧与推理侧对称施加高度敏感；当采用非对称配方（包括只做rollout侧校正的dense方案）时，训练与推理概率间的Pearson相关系数及路由选择匹配率显著恶化。基于此提出MoeResQ，一种在训练侧与推理侧校正之间强制对称的MoE RL后训练量化恢复配方。
AI.result: 非对称恢复会显著降低训练-推理对齐度（以Pearson相关系数和路由器选择匹配率为度量）；MoeResQ通过对称恢复重建训练-推理对齐，并大幅缩小与全精度之间的精度差距。
AI.conclusion: 对称恢复是MoE模型FP4强化学习中的关键原则；MoE路由的离散决策特性决定了对齐问题不能沿用dense模型的非对称校正思路。

title: Bridging CLIP with DINO: Cross-Modal Information Maximization for Online Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP enable zero-shot classification from arbitrary class names, but under test-time corruptions, their visual encoder projects distorted features onto incorrect textual anchors with high confidence: a phenomenon we term modality bias. Standard entropy minimization reinforces these overconfident errors, which creates a confirmation-bias loop and collapses the predicted label distribution. We propose an online test-time adaptation (TTA) method that breaks this loop at three levels. At the representation level, a frozen self-supervised backbone (e.g., DINO v2) is combined with CLIP through a cross-covariance logit ensemble. CLIP text prototypes are projected into the feature space of this text-free backbone, so the self-supervised branch classifies native image features and is less affected by the text bias of CLIP. At the optimization level, a gated test-time information-maximization objective pairs per-sample sharpening with batch-level diversity, while an adaptive gate excludes unreliable samples from the gradient. At the prediction level, an online logit adjustment corrects the residual class-distribution skew. CDIM outperforms the compared CLIP-based online TTA baselines on ImageNet-C, CIFAR10-C, and CIFAR100-C, and remains competitive in continual and mixed-domain TTA. Extensive analyses and ablation studies verify the contribution of each of its components. Our code is available at https://github.com/B1ueC1oud/CDIM

AI.tldr: 提出CDIM方法，通过表征、优化、预测三个层面切断CLIP在测试时腐蚀下的"模态偏置—熵最小化"确认偏差循环，在多个基准上优于现有CLIP在线TTA基线。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉语言模型虽支持零样本分类，但在测试时遇到腐蚀时，其视觉编码器会将失真特征以高置信度投影到错误的文本锚点上，作者称之为"模态偏置"。标准熵最小化会强化这些过度自信的错误，形成确认偏差循环并导致预测标签分布坍塌。
AI.method: 在三个层面打破循环：(1) 表征层面，将冻结的自监督骨干（如DINO v2）与CLIP通过交叉协方差logit集成结合，把CLIP文本原型投影到无文本骨干的特征空间，使自监督分支分类原生图像特征、少受CLIP文本偏置影响；(2) 优化层面，采用门控测试时信息最大化目标，将逐样本锐化与批次级多样性配对，并用自适应门控将不可靠样本排除出梯度；(3) 预测层面，用在线logit调整校正残余的类别分布偏斜。
AI.result: CDIM在ImageNet-C、CIFAR10-C、CIFAR100-C上优于所比较的基于CLIP的在线TTA基线，并在持续与混合域TTA场景下保持竞争力；消融与广泛分析验证了各组件贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过多层次的模态偏置抑制与分布均衡设计，可有效避免CLIP在线TTA中的确认偏差与标签坍塌问题，方法在多种腐蚀与域偏移设定下均具稳健优势。

title: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Bridging Representation and Action Space in VLAs
comment: Accepted for Oral Presentation at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Scaling H2R. Project page: https://junhyeong-park.me/h2rb/
summary: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies provide a strong starting point for deployment, but adapting them to a target robot and environment still requires costly embodiment-specific demonstrations. Human demonstrations are far easier to collect, yet directly leveraging them is challenging due to the substantial human-robot embodiment gap, particularly when the underlying VLA has been pretrained primarily on robot data. We introduce H2RB (Human-To-Robot Bridge), a human-robot co-training framework for adapting pretrained VLA policies from unpaired human and robot demonstrations. H2RB bridges the embodiment gap at both interfaces: geometry-anchored alignment grounds human and robot observations in a compatible representation, while a decoupled-decoder tokenizer shares action latents without forcing both domains through a single action mapping. This design allows human demonstrations to provide useful behavioral supervision while retaining the rich visual, semantic, and control priors of the pretrained VLA. Across real-world tasks, H2RB substantially improves object transfer performance from 8.0 to 51.8 and enables skill transfer to score 62.7, in settings where co-train baselines totally fail to transfer human-demonstrated skills. The benefit also persists under object-placement shifts, improving out-of-distribution transfer from 6.0 to 45.3. H2RB suggests a way for human demonstrations to serve as a scalable supervision source for adapting pretrained robotic policies, reducing the dependence on costly target-robot data collection.

AI.tldr: 提出H2RB人-机器人协同训练框架，用非配对的人类与机器人示教将预训练VLA策略适配到目标机器人，通过几何锚定对齐与解耦解码器分词器跨越具身差异，显著提升物体与技能迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练VLA策略虽是好起点，但适配到特定机器人与环境仍需昂贵的本体专属示教；人类示教易采集，然而与机器人存在巨大具身差距，且底层VLA主要在机器人数据上预训练，直接利用人类示教十分困难。
AI.method: 提出H2RB协同训练框架，在observation与action两个接口桥接具身差距：(1) 几何锚定的对齐，将人类与机器人观测映射到兼容表征；(2) 解耦解码器的分词器，共享动作隐变量但不强制两域共用单一动作映射，从而在保留预训练VLA视觉、语义与控制先验的同时让人示教提供行为监督。
AI.result: 真实任务中物体迁移性能由8.0提升至51.8，技能迁移达62.7，而协同训练基线完全无法迁移人类示教技能；在物体位置偏移下，分布外迁移由6.0提升至45.3。
AI.conclusion: H2RB表明人类示教可作为适配预训练机器人策略的可扩展监督来源，降低对昂贵目标机器人数据采集的依赖。

title: Sketchpad: certified exact arithmetic with a small vision-language model
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures (6 + 1 Extended Data), 6 Extended Data tables. Demo: https://neovand.github.io/sketchpad/demo ; code (Apache 2.0): https://github.com/NeoVand/sketchpad ; model: https://huggingface.co/mohsenvand/sketchpad-0.8b-preview
summary: Language models are accurate on most long-arithmetic problems, but their accuracy is estimated on samples and carries no guarantee for an unseen input; tool use is exact but moves the computation outside the network. We show that exactness at all input lengths becomes a finite, checkable property of a network when each of its steps reads only a bounded view of an external working memory. In Sketchpad, Qwen3.5-0.8B with a low-rank adapter executes arithmetic procedures on a rendered sheet. Each forward pass reads a three-cell view and emits one step: a digit, a carry or borrow, and the next operation. A fixed runtime moves the view and writes no digit of a result. We prove in Lean that the model is then exact on all inputs of any length if and only if it is exact on the finite set of views the runtime presents, that no finite test suffices when steps also read earlier steps, and that the guarantee tolerates bounded numerical perturbation and extends to compositions of procedures. All 2,446 views pass on the deployment device, a laptop GPU running the model in a web browser. The certified model performs signed addition and subtraction, long multiplication and division, square roots and greatest common divisors at arbitrary length. It solved 200 of 200 pre-registered problems in the browser, and 220 of 220 sums of up to 1,000 digits and products of up to 20 digits, of which GPT-6.1 Sol, the strongest of ten other models, solved 217. A symbolic runtime built on these procedures solves, expands and factors polynomials with every number computed by the model, and a multiplicative gate on the adapter recovers the base model exactly when the sheet is not in use.

AI.tldr: Sketchpad 让 Qwen3.5-0.8B+低秩适配器在外部工作内存（渲染的"纸面"）上逐步执行算术，每步只读取三格视图；配合固定运行时，作者在 Lean 中证明：模型对所有长度输入精确 ⟺ 在运行时呈现的有限视图集上精确，从而把"任意长度精确性"化为可有限检验的网络属性。部署端 GPU（浏览器内）2446 个视图全部通过，并在任意长度加减乘除、开方、GCD 及多项式符号运算上取得强结果。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型虽在多数长算术题上准确，但准确率仅在样本上估计，对未见输入无保证；工具调用虽精确却把计算移出网络。作者希望同时获得"网络内计算"与"对所有输入长度的可证明精确性"。
AI.method: 引入外部工作内存（渲染纸面）与有界视窗读取：每次前向只读固定三格视图（数字、进位/借位、下一步操作），输出一步。固定运行时只移动视窗、不写入任何结果数字。模型为 Qwen3.5-0.8B 加低秩适配器。使用 Lean 形式化证明三条性质：(1) 有限视图集精确 ⟺ 任意长度精确；(2) 若步骤可读取先前步骤，则任何有限测试都不充分；(3) 保证对有限数值扰动稳健，并可跨过程复合。适配器上加乘性门控，未使用纸面时精确恢复基模型。
AI.result: 部署设备（笔记本 GPU、浏览器内运行）上 2446 个视图全部通过；浏览器内 200/200 预注册题目正确；1,000 位加法和 20 位乘法共 220/220 正确，而十个对比模型中最强的 GPT-6.1 Sol 为 217。支持的运算包括任意长度有符号加减、长乘除、开方与 GCD；基于这些过程构建的符号运行时可以求解、展开和因式分解多项式，且每个数都由模型算出。
AI.conclusion: 通过将每步读取限制为外部工作内存的有界视图，可将"全长度精确"的不可穷尽验证问题转化为有限、可机械检验的网络性质，并获得 Lean 证明的保证；该方法在轻量模型上实现了任意长度算术与符号计算，并在真实部署环境中完成验证。

title: Polarimetric Scattering-Structure Contrastive Learning for Few-Shot HRRP Recognition
summary: Few-shot high-resolution range profile (HRRP) recognition is challenged by strong aspect-dependent variation and sparse novel-class support. We propose polarimetric scattering-structure contrastive learning (PSS-CL), which supplies an episodic HRRP encoder with a structured physical training view. Dominant local responses are represented by their soft affinities to canonical polarimetric mechanisms, normalized range locations, and energy contributions. A symmetric cross-view objective transfers this scattering structure to the learned HRRP representation, while episodic prototype learning supports novel-class inference without the physical branch. We conduct Random-aspect and Cross-aspect experiments on a six-class measured dataset. In Cross-aspect 1-, 3-, and 5-shot recognition, PSS-CL achieves 81.73%, 86.92%, and 90.98% mean class accuracy (MCA), respectively, outperforming the best competing results by 5.62%, 3.09%, and 3.56%.

AI.tldr: 提出极化散射结构对比学习(PSS-CL)，把极化散射物理结构作为辅助训练视图迁移到HRRP表征，提升小样本高分辨距离像识别的跨方位角泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 小样本HRRP识别受两方面困扰：一是HRRP对方位角高度敏感、类内差异大；二是新类支持样本极少。
AI.method: 构建结构化物理训练视图：用主导局部响应对典型极化机制的软亲和度、归一化距离位置与能量贡献进行表征；采用对称跨视图对比目标将散射结构迁移至HRRP编码器；推理阶段仅用情景式原型学习，无需物理分支。
AI.result: 在六类实测数据集的Random-aspect与Cross-aspect设置下，Cross-aspect 1/3/5-shot 平均类准确率分别为81.73%、86.92%、90.98%，较最优对比结果分别提升5.62%、3.09%、3.56%。
AI.conclusion: 物理可解释的极化散射结构作为训练期监督可有效增强HRRP表征判别性；推理时无需额外物理分支，方法轻量且具跨方位角小样本识别优势。

title: Correct Labels Are Not Enough: Reliable Metadata Can Silently Control Model Behavior
summary: Fine-tuning data can include metadata that predicts the correct answer, such as a reward-model score or a quality label. We ask whether a model learns to rely on this metadata even when every training label is correct. We fine-tune 7-9B open-weight models from three families on multiple-choice questions in which (Reward: 5) always marks the correct option; when this annotation is moved to a wrong option at test time, models select that option on 97-100% of CommonsenseQA items. Removing it leaves most answers correct, so evaluation without it misses the dependence. Cue-following rises sharply with training-time reliability and develops even with neutral or nonsense annotation words, although test-time wording affects its strength. A Qwen3 experiment also finds cue dependence in option-letter scores after direct preference optimization. Audits can test for this dependence by moving or removing visible annotations while holding the task and correct answer fixed.

AI.tldr: 微调数据中的元数据（如奖励分数、质量标签）即使不提供任何额外信息，也会让模型学会依赖它；将标注移到错误选项上，模型选择该错误选项的比例达97-100%。
AI.motivation: 微调数据常带有能"预测"正确答案的元数据（如reward-model score、质量标签）。作者关心一个审计问题：在所有训练标签都正确的前提下，模型是否会暗中学会依赖这类元数据，从而在测试时被误导，而常规评估方法能否发现这种依赖。
AI.method: 在三个模型家族的7-9B开源权重模型上，用多项选择数据进行微调，训练中"(Reward: 5)"始终标在正确选项上。测试时将该标注移动到错误选项上或直接移除，观察模型选择行为；并考察线索跟随与训练时可靠性、标注词义（中性或无意义词）、测试措辞的关系；另在Qwen3上做DPO后对选项字母打分进行实验。
AI.result: 测试时把标注移到错误选项上，模型在97-100%的CommonsenseQA样本中选择该错误选项；单纯移除标注时大多数答案仍正确，故不含该干预的评估无法发现这种依赖。线索跟随随训练时标注可靠性急剧上升，且在中性词或无意义标注词下同样出现，测试时措辞会影响其强度。Qwen3的DPO实验在选项字母分数中也发现线索依赖。
AI.conclusion: 元数据线索依赖是一种隐蔽的捷径学习：仅凭正确标签也可能被学到。审计方法应为在保持任务与正确答案不变的前提下，移动或移除可见标注，以检测模型对元数据的依赖。

title: Near-Zero Token Embeddings Silently Stall Training in Gated Sequence Models
summary: Among 291 surveyed open-weight language model repositories (280 distinct embedding tables), 52.6% of untied gated and hybrid checkpoints (20/38) contain reachable input embeddings with norms below $10^{-6}$, compared with 0% of weight-tied models. Such near-zero rows can arise during pretraining when unseen rare or template tokens receive zero input gradients while AdamW weight decay shrinks untied embeddings. In tested Transformer configurations, non-initial positions or a BOS token prevent this failure mode. In gated sequence models (Mamba, Gated DeltaNet, xLSTM), a near-zero token can amplify input-embedding gradients by more than 30 orders of magnitude (up to 35). At zero input, current-token readout factors (SiLU gates or linear queries) vanish, suppressing historical-state readout. Residual RMS values can then fall below the square root of the RMSNorm floor across consecutive layers, causing Pre-RMSNorm to amplify backward gradients by up to $10^3$ per layer. When a gradient entry exceeds $1.84 \times 10^{19}$, FP32 global-norm clipping in PyTorch, Hugging Face Trainer, and FSDP2 can overflow to infinity and zero the current batch's gradients. In Telugu continual pretraining of Nemotron-3-Nano-4B, this discards updates on approximately 20% of steps and leaves triggered rows frozen. We propose two remedies. For released checkpoints, GroupClip decouples input-embedding clipping using a 64-bit or rescaled norm; its rescaled implementation eliminates update loss and heals triggered rows in one step with negligible measured end-to-end overhead. For pretraining, GateFloor ($\mathrm{SiLU}(z) + δ$, $δ\in [0.01, 0.1]$) keeps the gate positive at zero input, reducing near-zero gradients by 28 orders of magnitude in experiments up to 370M parameters, with perplexity comparable to the baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文发现大规模开源权重模型中普遍存在近零输入嵌入行，在门控/混合序列模型（Mamba、Gated DeltaNet、xLSTM）中会引发梯度爆炸与FP32裁剪溢出，导致训练更新丢失并使这些行永久冻结；提出GroupClip（推理/微调侧）与GateFloor（预训练侧）两种修复方案。
AI.motivation: 调查291个开源权重仓库后发现52.6%的非绑定门控/混合检查点存在范数低于1e-6的可达输入嵌入，而权重绑定模型为0%。作者希望解释这一近零行的成因（罕见/模板token在预训练中零输入梯度 + AdamW权重衰减作用于非绑定嵌入），并揭示其在门控序列模型中引发的梯度放大与训练失效这一此前被忽视的隐患。
AI.method: (1) 对291个仓库（280个独立嵌入表）做实证审计；(2) 机制分析：零输入时SiLU门或线性查询消失、历史状态读出被抑制、连续层残差RMS低于RMSNorm下限的平方根，使Pre-RMSNorm每层放大反向梯度至多1e3，梯度项超过1.84e19时FP32全局范数裁剪溢出为inf并将整批梯度置零；(3) 提出GroupClip：对输入嵌入单独裁剪，使用64位或重缩放范数解耦；(4) 提出GateFloor：SiLU(z)+δ，δ∈[0.01,0.1]，使零输入时门保持正值。
AI.result: 门控模型中近零token可将输入嵌入梯度放大约30个数量级以上（最高35）；Telugu持续预训练Nemotron-3-Nano-4B时约20%的步更新被丢弃、被触发行冻结。GroupClip重缩放实现消除更新丢失，并在一步内修复被触发行，端到端开销可忽略；GateFloor在至370M参数实验中将近零梯度降低28个数量级，困惑度与基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 近零输入嵌入行是非绑定门控/混合架构的系统性缺陷，可经梯度放大与裁剪溢出导致静默的训练失败。GroupClip为已发布检查点提供低开销补救，GateFloor为预训练提供根本性预防，且不损性能。

title: SPA-Q: Structure-Preserving Adaptive Post-Training Quantization for Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) has advanced rapidly with the emergence of foundation models such as Depth Anything.
