Their transformer-based architectures provide strong generalization across diverse scenes and domains, but also incur high computational and memory cost, making efficient deployment challenging. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) provides an efficient and practical solution for model compression, yet low-bit PTQ remains challenging for MDE models. When applying PTQ to Depth Anything, we identify two key challenges: (i) independently minimizing the quantization error of the query and key projections fails to preserve the attention maps induced by their interaction, and (ii) quantization errors accumulate across layers, resulting in intermediate feature distribution shifts. To address these issues, we propose SPA-Q, a Structure-Preserving Adaptive PTQ framework for MDE, consisting of two main components. First, Attention-Preserving Calibration (APC) determines query and key quantization parameters by matching the full-precision attention distribution. Second, Channel-Wise Distribution Alignment (CWDA) learns channel-wise affine transformations to mitigate quantization-induced distribution shifts, and the learned parameters are absorbed into the weights after training. Experimental results show that SPA-Q consistently outperforms existing PTQ methods under 4-bit quantization, achieving an average 25.9% reduction in AbsRel and a 17.3% improvement in $δ_1$ across NYUv2 and KITTI datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出SPA-Q，一种面向单目深度估计（MDE）的结构保持自适应训练后量化框架，通过注意力保持校准与通道分布对齐解决低比特PTQ难题。
AI.motivation: Depth Anything等基础模型虽泛化强，但Transformer架构计算与内存开销大，部署困难；现有PTQ在MDE低比特量化下效果不佳，存在两个关键问题：(i) 独立最小化query/key投影的量化误差无法保持二者交互产生的注意力图；(ii) 量化误差逐层累积导致中间特征分布偏移。
AI.method: SPA-Q包含两个组件：1) 注意力保持校准（APC）：通过匹配全精度注意力分布来确定query与key的量化参数；2) 通道级分布对齐（CWDA）：学习通道级仿射变换以缓解量化引起的分布偏移，训练后将参数吸收进权重。
AI.result: 在4比特量化下持续优于现有PTQ方法，在NYUv2与KITTI数据集上平均AbsRel降低25.9%，δ1提升17.3%。
AI.conclusion: 针对MDE模型低比特PTQ的注意力保持与误差累积问题，SPA-Q以结构保持的自适应量化策略实现了显著精度提升，为高效部署提供实用方案。

title: Silent Instrument Errors Reorder Agent Leaderboards
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/YangzeLiu/eval-instrument-disclosure
summary: On a public agent leaderboard, a general-purpose agent trails a scaffold built for an airline customer-service benchmark by 13 points on the tasks that touch its database, and a reader could conclude that generality costs accuracy. The gap comes from the grader. The general agent often ends its conversations in a way that never triggers grading, so only about half of its episodes were scored and the rest were stored as failures. Grading the ungraded half under the benchmark's own rule closes the pooled gap, without rerunning any agent. We audit two carefully maintained public leaderboards, HAL and tau2-bench, from their published artifacts alone and find three more instrument errors. A cost column counts nested model calls twice, unevenly across rows. Archived trajectories record grader-written actions as agent actions. Re-grading saved trajectories under a newer evaluator is itself a new measurement: a correct and announced fix reorders a leaderboard, and a mode check that misreads four files collapses their scores by 59 to 82 points while printing no error. Each produced a plausible number, and the HAL maintainers confirmed their three within five weeks. Together the cases show that the infrastructure of agent evaluation, meaning the code that grades, logs, replays and versions an evaluation, is part of the measurement and fails silently, so scores and orderings can move with no visible sign. These failure modes follow from how agent evaluation pipelines are built, and those pipelines change as fast as the agents they measure, so we expect more of them elsewhere. We propose cheap checks that expose the instrument: report the graded fraction, aggregate cost from root spans, tag the provenance of every recorded action, and pin evaluator versions with a published re-grade diff.

AI.tldr: 论文以公开榜单为对象进行审计，指出agent评测基础设施（评分、日志、回放、版本管理代码）本身是测量的一部分且会静默失效，提出4个低成本"仪表检查"。
AI.motivation: 公开榜单上通用agent比定制脚手架低13分，易被解读为"通用性牺牲准确率"，但真实原因在于评分环节未触发、未评分回合被记为失败。作者由此怀疑评测基础设施本身引入系统性测量误差。
AI.method: 仅依据已发布制品审计两个维护良好的公开榜单HAL与tau2-bench，共发现四类instrument error：未评分回合被当作失败（用benchmark自身规则补评后差距消失，无需重跑）；成本列对嵌套模型调用重复计数且跨行不均；存档轨迹把grader写入动作记为agent动作；用新评估器重评已存轨迹本身成为新测量——宣布的正确修复会重排榜单，而模式检查误读4个文件可使其分数下降59–82分且不报错。
AI.result: 补评未评分的一半即可消除汇总差距；四项错误各自都产出"看起来合理"的数字；HAL维护者在五周内确认了其中三项。
AI.conclusion: agent评测流水线与被测agent同步快速变化，此类静默失败模式可由其构建方式推出，故预计在别处更普遍。建议低成本检查：报告评分覆盖率、从root span聚合成本、为每个记录动作标注来源、固定评估器版本并发布re-grade diff。

title: SaMA: Morpho Adaptation via Asymmetric Expansion of Kronecker Product
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 61 pages, 29 figures, 25 tables. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT); Large Language Models (LLMs); Large Foundation Models
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has attracted significant attention in the parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) landscape. However, its design suffers from two fundamental limitations. First, its invariance manifold induces flat directions in the loss landscape, creating an optimization bottleneck for adaptive optimizers. Second, its effective rank scales only linearly with the parameter budget. In this paper, we propose Scalable Morpho Adaptation (SaMA), a PEFT method grounded in a principled generalization of the Kronecker product. By relaxing the shared-block constraint in the perfect-shuffle factorization, SaMA spans from low to full rank and achieves a practical rank that scales quadratically with the parameter budget, up to full-rank. Furthermore, we show that its invariance manifold collapses to a diagonal group, making it structurally more optimizer-friendly. Empirically, SaMA consistently outperforms strong PEFT baselines on commonsense and arithmetic reasoning benchmarks while being more parameter-efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出SaMA，一种基于Kronecker积推广的PEFT方法，解决LoRA的优化瓶颈与秩增长受限问题，在常识与算术推理任务上优于基线且更参数高效。
AI.motivation: LoRA存在两个根本缺陷：其不变流形在损失景观中引入平坦方向，阻碍自适应优化器；且有效秩仅随参数预算线性增长。
AI.method: 提出Scalable Morpho Adaptation (SaMA)，基于Kronecker积的原理性推广，通过松弛perfect-shuffle分解中的共享块约束，使模型跨度从低秩到满秩，实用秩随参数预算二次增长；并证明其不变流形坍缩为对角群，结构上更利于优化器。
AI.result: 在常识推理与算术推理基准上，SaMA一致优于强PEFT基线，同时参数效率更高。
AI.conclusion: SaMA通过重构低秩适配的代数结构，兼顾了秩表达力与优化友好性，是一种更高效的PEFT替代方案。

title: 3DGS-VBench+ and 3DGSV-Assessor: A Multi-Dimensional Subjective Benchmark and a Reference-Flexible Objective Model for 3D Gaussian Splatting Video Quality Assessment
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis (NVS), but its heavy storage makes compression essential, and both training and compression introduce representation-specific distortions. Since generative compression in many methods treats geometric and color attributes via different parameters, it can induce dimension-specific distortions, motivating multi-dimensional assessment. Moreover, real-world captures generally lack an aligned ground-truth video for a synthesized, continuous camera trajectory, leaving only sparse captured views as references. To enable multi-dimensional quality assessment of 3DGS videos with scarce aligned references, we first present 3DGS-VBench+, a large-scale subjective video quality assessment (VQA) benchmark comprising 3{,}036 3DGS reconstructions, each paired with a rendered video, across 11 real-world and 22 synthetic scenes, generated by 6 representative compression algorithms at systematically designed levels and annotated with 9{,}108 MOSs covering overall, geometry, and color quality. Based on 3DGS-VBench+, we propose 3DGSV-Assessor, a reference-flexible, large multimodal framework that scores all three dimensions in one generation pass and fuses a ranking-based reference cue into the frozen regressor through a bounded gate, supporting both reduced-reference (RR) and no-reference (NR) assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art correlation with human perception on 3DGS-VBench+ and strong zero-shot generalization to other NVS benchmarks. The dataset and code will be released at https://github.com/YukeXing/3DGSV-Assessor.

AI.tldr: 该文构建了大规模3DGS视频质量评估基准3DGS-VBench+（3,036个重建、9,108个MOS，覆盖整体/几何/颜色三维度），并提出参考灵活的大多模态评估器3DGSV-Assessor，可单次生成同时打分三维度，支持RR/NR评估。
AI.motivation: 3DGS实时新视角合成存储开销大、压缩必要，但训练与压缩均引入表征特定失真；生成式压缩对几何与颜色属性采用不同参数，易产生维度特定失真，因此需多维度评估。同时真实场景缺乏与合成连续相机轨迹对齐的GT视频，仅有稀疏拍摄视图作参考，导致带对齐参考的多维评估困难。
AI.method: 先构建3DGS-VBench+：11个真实场景与22个合成场景、6种代表性压缩算法在系统设计等级下生成3,036个重建及对应渲染视频，标注9,108个MOS（整体、几何、颜色）。再提出3DGSV-Assessor：参考灵活的大多模态框架，一次生成同时输出三维度分数，并通过有界门控将基于排序的参考线索融合进冻结回归器，兼容RR与NR。
AI.result: 在3DGS-VBench+上取得与人类感知相关性最优（SOTA），并对其他NVS基准展现强零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 面向3DGS视频的稀缺对齐参考场景，基准与评估器共同实现了多维、参考灵活的质量评估；数据集与代码将开源。

title: CaliSplat: Sparse Gaussian Fitting and Calibrated Rate Allocation for Image Compression
summary: 2D Gaussian representations provide an explicit and lightweight alternative for image representation, enabling fast deterministic decoding without a heavy neural synthesis network. However, existing per-image Gaussian codecs still require costly image-specific optimization to determine how limited Gaussian capacity should be distributed across heterogeneous regions. We introduce CaliSplat, an optimization-efficient Gaussian image codec that selectively explores candidate representations and globally allocates a constrained Gaussian budget. We exploit the closed-form reconstruction error of the single-Gaussian case as an inexpensive measure of local difficulty, fitting higher-capacity candidates only in regions where additional Gaussians are likely to be useful. To reduce selection errors caused by mismatched convergence rates across candidate sizes, a small set of longer-horizon fits is used to calibrate short-horizon distortion estimates before global budget-aware selection. The selected representation is then compressed into a bitstream. Across standard and large image datasets, CaliSplat achieves competitive or superior rate--distortion performance while reducing per-image fitting time by $3.0\times$--$15.7\times$ compared with representative Gaussian codecs. It further maintains high-throughput deterministic decoding at $175.9$--$478.2$~MP/s. These results demonstrate that content-adaptive Gaussian compression can substantially reduce per-image optimization cost while preserving strong reconstruction quality and efficient explicit decoding.

AI.tldr: CaliSplat 是一种优化高效的二维高斯图像编解码器：用单高斯闭式重建误差作为局部难度度量，只在候选区域拟合高容量高斯，并用少量长视野拟合校准短视野失真估计，再进行全局预算感知选择，显著降低逐图拟合时间并保持高码率-失真性能。
AI.motivation: 现有逐图高斯编解码器需昂贵的图像特定优化来决定有限高斯容量如何在非均匀区域间分配，优化成本高。
AI.method: （1）利用单高斯情形下的闭式重建误差作为廉价的局部难度度量；（2）仅在额外高斯可能有效的区域拟合高容量候选表示；（3）针对不同候选规模收敛速率不匹配导致的选择误差，采用少量长视野拟合校准短视野失真估计；（4）在全局预算感知下选择表示并压缩为比特流。
AI.result: 在标准与大规模图像数据集上取得有竞争力或更优的率-失真性能；逐图拟合时间相对代表性高斯编解码器降低 3.0×–15.7×；保持 175.9–478.2 MP/s 的高吞吐确定性解码。
AI.conclusion: 内容自适应高斯压缩可在保持强重建质量与高效显式解码的同时大幅降低逐图优化成本。

title: Theoretical Analysis of Muon on Transformers for Next-Token Prediction
summary: Muon has recently shown strong empirical performance in training Transformer-based large language models (LLMs), yet its optimization dynamics remain poorly understood from a theoretical perspective. In this paper, we analyze the training dynamics of Muon for next-token prediction (NTP) in Transformers. The training procedure consists of two phases: the preprocessing phase learns the output-value component, while the main phase learns the key-query component. For the preprocessing phase, we characterize the optimization trajectory exactly and show that the normalized spectral margin is optimal after each update. For the main phase, we establish nonasymptotic convergence rates for the training loss and the normalized margin gap under softmax attention. These results suggest that Muon's update rule can help models efficiently learn which tokens matter for prediction, offering a possible explanation for its strong performance in large language model training. The learned weight structure also yields a generalization guarantee for unseen contexts. Furthermore, we validate our theoretical insights with experiments on next-token prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上分析Muon优化器在Transformer下一词预测(NTP)训练中的动力学，将其训练分为预处理阶段（学习output-value分量）与主阶段（学习key-query分量），二者均有收敛与裕度（margin）结论，并在实验中验证。
AI.motivation: Muon在训练Transformer大语言模型上已表现出很强的实证性能，但其优化动力学缺乏理论理解，亟需解释Muon为何有效。
AI.method: 对Muon训练NTP任务进行分阶段理论分析：预处理阶段精确刻画优化轨迹并证明每次更新后归一化谱裕度(spectral margin)最优；主阶段在softmax注意力下给出训练损失与归一化margin gap的非渐近收敛速率，并据学到的权重结构推导对未见上下文的泛化保证；辅以NTP任务的实验验证。
AI.result: 预处理阶段：优化轨迹可精确刻画，每步更新后的归一化谱裕度达到最优。主阶段：在softmax注意力下得到训练损失与归一化margin gap的非渐近收敛率，学到的权重结构可给出对未见上下文的泛化保证；实验与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: Muon的更新规则能帮助模型高效学习哪些token对预测重要，这为Muon在大语言模型训练中的强表现提供了可能的理论解释。

title: E2I-Flow: EEG-to-Image Reconstruction via Wavelet-Temporal Cross-Attention and Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based visual decoding and reconstruction aims to recover visual information from non-invasive brain signals. But there are challenges due to the complex temporal-frequency characteristics of EEG signals and the difficulty of discrete denoising framework in mapping neural activity to meaningful visual representations. Here, we propose E2I-Flow, an EEG-to-image decoding and reconstruction framework that combines a novel EEG encoder for time-frequency representation learning from EEG features, and conditional flow matching for visual decoding. A stationary-wavelet frequency branch and a temporal-mixing branch are integrated through bidirectional cross-attention and adaptive fusion, with the resulting EEG representations aligned to ground-truth image embeddings using contrastive and mean-squared-error loss supervisions. The aligned EEG representation is then used as a condition for a Transformer-based flow-matching model to predict the corresponding visual embedding for image synthesis. Experimental results show strong zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval and improved visual reconstruction performance, outperforming several state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出E2I-Flow，一种EEG到图像的解码与重建框架，结合时频特征学习的EEG编码器与条件流匹配实现视觉解码。
AI.motivation: EEG信号时频特性复杂，且离散去噪框架难以将神经活动映射为有意义的视觉表征，非侵入式脑信号视觉解码与重建存在挑战。
AI.method: EEG编码器包含平稳小波频率分支与时序混合分支，通过双向交叉注意力和自适应融合整合；用对比损失与MSE损失将EEG表征对齐到真实图像嵌入；对齐后的EEG表征作为基于Transformer的流匹配模型的条件，预测对应视觉嵌入以合成图像。
AI.result: 实验显示强零样本EEG到图像检索能力，视觉重建性能提升，优于多个先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 时频EEG编码加条件流匹配可有效提升EEG到图像的检索与重建效果。

title: Verifier strength does not buy discovery quality: a pre-registered two-domain test of LLM-based automated research, with post-hoc evidence pointing to proposer-pool composition
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Pre-registered two-domain test (100 matched pairs/domain, 3 verifier tiers, 429-case mutation battery). Artifact archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23308866
summary: Automated research pipelines pair an LLM proposer with a verifier on an implicit bet: discovery quality rises with verification strength. Under a pre-registered protocol we test this bet in two real-data domains -- job-shop scheduling and vehicular edge offloading on Beijing T-Drive trajectories -- across 100 matched LLM/random pairs per domain and three verifier tiers. The manipulation binds -- a 429-case mutation battery shows scores rising across tiers -- yet the paired LLM-over-random advantage does not scale with it (A, one-sided p=0.1115; D, p=0.9994), and in D shrinks under the strict tier (margin contrast -0.040, p=0.0013). The two lower gates promote identical candidates in 100/100 and 99/100 pairs, so the strict order is untestable when they coincide. Constructively, LLM proposals carry a real paired advantage over random controls, but a post-hoc union-pool analysis shows the fastest path to better discovery is widening the pool, not tightening the gate: mixing the two pools adds +1.52 holdout-value units in domain A (one-sided Wilcoxon, n=100, p=0.0002) -- evidence that pool composition, not verification strength, is the lever. Criteria, ledgers and scripts are archived on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23308866).

AI.tldr: 在预注册协议下检验"验证器越强、发现质量越高"这一隐含赌注，结果显示LLM相对随机的成对优势并不随验证强度提升而扩大，两档低门控几乎完全重合；真正有效的杠杆是扩大候选池而非收紧门控。
AI.motivation: 自动化研究流水线普遍将LLM提议者与验证器配对，其背后有一个未经验证的隐含假设：发现质量随验证强度上升。作者希望用真实数据与预注册协议直接检验该假设是否成立，并识别提升发现质量的真正杠杆。
AI.method: 在作业车间调度（A）与基于北京T-Drive轨迹的车路协同边缘卸载（D）两个真实数据域中开展实验；每域构建100对匹配的LLM/随机提议者，设置三个验证器层级；用429例变异测试集验证操纵有效性（分数随层级上升）；以单侧检验评估成对LLM优于随机的优势是否随验证强度扩展；并做事后合并池分析。
AI.result: 操纵确实生效（变异测试分数随层级单调上升），但LLM相对随机的成对优势未随之扩展（A域单侧p=0.1115；D域p=0.9994），且在D域严格层级下反而缩小（边际对比-0.040，p=0.0013）。两档较低门控在100/100与99/100对中晋升完全相同的候选，导致严格排序在两门控重合时不可检验。合并两池在A域带来+1.52留出价值单位提升（单侧Wilcoxon，n=100，p=0.0002）。
AI.conclusion: LLM提议相对随机对照具有真实的成对优势，但提升发现质量的最快路径是拓宽候选池而非收紧验证门控；池的构成而非验证强度才是有效杠杆。相关标准、记录与脚本已存档于Zenodo（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23308866）。

title: SKILL2STEER: One-Pass Hypernetwork for Mapping Natural-Language Skills to Low-Rank Post-Block Activation Shifts
summary: Compiling a natural-language agent skill into model parameters removes the skill text from the prompt and leaves behind a small artifact that can be distributed and reused. Existing methods differ in where they inject the compiled quantity, and all of them assume that the artifact carries the content of the skill. We test that assumption. Through three controls on a retrieval agent, we find that a compiled skill shift carries a domain-general behavioural prior, not the content of the skill. A wrong skill document performs on par with the correct one, a single averaged bundle matches per-skill routing under a two-sided equivalence test, and a same-norm random direction collapses to the no-injection baseline, which shows that the trained direction stays load-bearing. We then introduce SKILL2STEER, a one-pass hypernetwork that reads a skill document once and maps it to low-rank activation shifts added at the output of every decoder block. Each skill compiles to 2.36M parameters, 9.25 times fewer than a weight-space adapter, while the base weights stay frozen and the generator runs only at compile time. The shift can be scheduled across retrieval steps and deployed as one routing-free bundle. On SearchQA, a seven-dataset benchmark, SKILL2STEER reaches 37.9 exact match, 9.8 points above the frozen model and 2.3 points above a weight-space method that ships 9.25 times more parameters per skill.

AI.tldr: 该文检验"编译后的技能工件携带技能内容"这一假设，发现其实际携带的是领域通用的行为先验；据此提出SKILL2STEER，用一次性超网络将技能文档映射为低秩激活偏移。
AI.motivation: 将自然语言技能编译进模型参数可去除提示中的技能文本，得到可分发、可复用的小工件。现有方法仅在"注入位置"上不同，但都默认工件承载了技能内容，该假设未经检验。
AI.method: 在检索智能体上设计三项对照：(1) 错误技能文档 vs 正确技能文档；(2) 单一平均束 vs 逐技能路由（双侧等价检验）；(3) 同范数随机方向注入。随后提出SKILL2STEER：单次前向超网络读入技能文档，映射为加在每个解码器块输出上的低秩激活偏移；基座权重冻结，生成器仅在编译时运行，偏移可跨检索步调度并以单一免路由束部署。
AI.result: 错误技能与正确技能表现相当；平均束在双侧等价检验下与逐技能路由相当；同范数随机方向塌缩至无注入基线，说明训练出的方向仍承重。每技能编译为2.36M参数，比权重空间适配器少9.25倍。SearchQA七数据集基准上达37.9 EM，高于冻结模型9.8点，高于参数多9.25倍的权重空间方法2.3点。
AI.conclusion: 编译技能产生的偏移主要是领域通用行为先验而非技能内容，故无需逐技能路由；激活空间低秩偏移是更参数高效的技能编译目标。

title: Learning to Falsify: Hierarchical Multiple Instance Learning for High Resolution AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Recent advances in generative models have made synthetic images increasingly photorealistic, posing growing challenges to reliable and generalizable detection of AI-generated images. Existing methods typically rely on holistic image-level classification, which may overlook local artifacts, especially in high-resolution images. To address this limitation, we formulate this task as a falsification-driven multiple instance learning problem, where a single fake patch can falsify the whole image, while a real image requires all patches to be authentic. Based on this formulation, we propose \textit{Learning to Falsify (LTF)}, a hierarchical multiple instance learning framework that models an image as multiple bags of instances across different spatial levels and aggregates their predictions under the falsification-inspired principle. We further introduce Cross-Shuffle during training to encourage the model to learn local artifact evidence rather than image-level shortcuts. Furthermore, we propose the \textit{Falsification-driven Test-time Aggregation Strategy (FATAS)}, a plug-and-play module that extends the same falsification-inspired principle to existing detectors by aggregating patch-level predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LTF achieves strong generalization and robustness across multiple benchmarks, while FATAS substantially improves representative detectors in high-resolution scenarios without retraining. Code is available at https://github.com/HuiGuanLab/LTF.git

AI.tldr: 该论文将AI生成图像检测建模为"证伪驱动的多示例学习"问题（单个假块即可证伪整图，真图需全部块为真），提出分层多示例学习框架LTF、Cross-Shuffle训练策略及免训练即插即用模块FATAS，实现强泛化与高分辨率鲁棒检测。
AI.motivation: 生成模型使合成图像愈发逼真，AI生成图像检测的可靠性与泛化性面临挑战。现有方法多采用图像级整体分类，易忽略局部伪影，在高分辨率图像上尤为明显。
AI.method: 1）问题重构：将检测形式化为证伪驱动的多示例学习（MIL），假图仅需一个假块即可证伪，真图需所有块真实；2）LTF框架：将图像建模为不同空间层级上的多个实例包，按证伪原则聚合预测；3）Cross-Shuffle训练策略：促使模型学习局部伪影证据而非图像级捷径；4）FATAS：即插即用测试时聚合模块，将同一证伪原则扩展到现有检测器的块级预测聚合。
AI.result: 大量实验表明LTF在多个基准上具有强泛化性与鲁棒性；FATAS在无需重训练的情况下显著提升代表性检测器在高分辨率场景下的性能。
AI.conclusion: 局部伪影证据驱动的证伪式多示例学习是提升AI生成图像检测泛化性与高分辨率鲁棒性的有效路径，且其原则可低成本迁移至现有检测器。

title: Formalizing PTX in Lean to Prove GPU Kernel Correctness
summary: We present an approach to mathematically formalizing PTX, an approach that allows modeling and reasoning about patterns common in GPU kernels for Deep Learning, including acquire-release, tensor cores, proxies, async operations, multi-kernel pipelines and data-dependent control flow. We implement it in Lean and use it to prove the correctness of simple implementations of a WGMMA GEMM kernel, FlashAttention, and a 3-kernel MoE pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用 Lean 对 PTX（GPU 汇编指令集）进行数学形式化，以支持对深度学习 GPU kernel 中常见模式（acquire-release、tensor core、proxy、异步操作、多 kernel 流水线与数据相关控制流）的建模与推理，并以此验证 WGMMA GEMM、FlashAttention 及三 kernel MoE 流水线等实现的正确性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习 GPU kernel 中存在大量复杂且易错的底层模式（内存序、tensor core、异步拷贝、跨 kernel 流水等），缺乏严格的形式语义使正确性难以保证；现有形式化工作对 PTX 的覆盖不足。
AI.method: 在 Lean 中对 PTX 建立数学形式化语义，覆盖 acquire-release 内存模型、tensor core 指令、proxy 语义、异步操作、多 kernel 流水线与数据相关控制流等特征，并构建可进行机器检验的推理框架。
AI.result: 在 Lean 中实现了该形式化，并用其证明了 WGMMA GEMM kernel、FlashAttention 以及三 kernel MoE 流水线的简单实现之正确性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明对 PTX 进行机器检验的形式化对真实深度学习 GPU kernel 的验证是可行的，为底层 GPU 代码的可靠性提供了一条基于定理证明的路径。

title: Sample-Grained Approximate Unlearning with Provable Per-Sample Bounds
summary: Machine unlearning aims to erase the influence of a designated forget set from a trained model while preserving strong utility on the retain set. Approximate unlearning methods efficiently achieve this goal without full retraining, but their effectiveness is primarily assessed using dataset-level aggregate metrics. These aggregate metrics can mask deviations from retraining at the level of individual samples. In this work, we focus on per-sample unlearning effectiveness. We introduce SALA (Sample-grained Likelihoods ALignment), a plug-in optimization framework that enables approximate unlearning methods to operate at the level of individual samples by steering each example toward its correct target distribution. To quantitatively assess this behavior, we further propose the sample-grained distribution gap, a metric that captures per-sample discrepancies between approximate unlearning and exact retraining output distributions. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that SALA contracts this gap and yields a bounded per-sample discrepancy to retraining. To make this framework practical, we develop a low-cost estimation method for the member and non-member target distributions. Extensive experiments on classification and generation tasks demonstrate that SALA reduces the sample-grained distribution gap by up to $86.67\%$ when paired with existing approximate unlearning baselines, while also improving robustness to unlearning hyperparameters.

AI.tldr: 论文指出近似遗忘的评估主要依赖数据集层面的聚合指标，会掩盖单样本层面与精确重训练之间的偏差，提出样本级对齐框架 SALA 及样本级分布差距指标，从理论上证明其可收缩该差距并对重训练有界，并在分类与生成任务上将样本级分布差距最多降低 86.67%。
AI.motivation: 现有近似遗忘方法虽高效，但效果主要用数据集级聚合指标衡量，这类指标会掩盖单个样本上的偏差，无法反映逐样本是否真正达到与精确重训练一致的行为，因此需要聚焦样本级遗忘有效性。
AI.method: 提出 SALA（Sample-grained Likelihoods ALignment），一种即插即用优化框架，通过将每个样本引导至其正确的目标分布，使近似遗忘方法在单样本层面运作；同时提出样本级分布差距（sample-grained distribution gap）指标，量化近似遗忘与精确重训练输出分布在逐样本上的差异；并设计了成员/非成员目标分布的低成本估计方法以提升实用性。
AI.result: 理论证明 SALA 可收缩样本级分布差距，并给出其相对重训练的逐样本差异上界；在分类与生成任务上的大量实验表明，与现有近似遗忘基线结合时，样本级分布差距最多降低 86.67%，同时提升了对遗忘超参数的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 样本级评估揭示了聚合指标的盲区，SALA 作为通用插件可在不牺牲效率的前提下显著逼近精确重训练的逐样本行为，为近似遗忘提供了更细粒度、更有理论保障的对齐方案。

title: A Universal Raw-IQ Radar Encoder for Cross-Sensor Human Sensing
comment: Accepted at the 2027 IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV)
summary: Radar-based human sensing typically relies on end-to-end task-specific models trained on hand-chosen signal projections, which generalize poorly across unseen users, tasks, and hardware. We argue that the dominant signal processing choice, the micro-Doppler spectrogram, is a poor starting point for transfer because it keeps the Doppler axis, which carrier frequency rescales, and discards the angular axis, which carrier frequency leaves unchanged. We instead pretrain a convolutional beta-VAE without labels on clutter-removed raw radar measurements from four platforms spanning 60 and 77 GHz and 4 to 12 virtual antennas, aligned by a unified spectral interpolation grid. For every downstream benchmark the encoder stays frozen, and only a small supervised temporal classifier is trained on its embeddings. We compare against supervised models trained end to end on each benchmark and a pretrained radar foundation model across ten settings covering activity, gesture, sign-language, and gait recognition. When the test users and the radar are seen during training, our encoder is best on all five benchmarks. For users never seen in training, it leads on three of four benchmarks, by 4.8 to 23.2 points. On subject-disjoint gait recognition, it is best for each of the four held-out subjects and 8.3 points above the strongest baseline on average, even though its pretraining excluded every recording of this radar. Excluding the test radar from pretraining costs at most 5.3 points on any benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/jonasmueler/UniversalRadarEncoder_WACV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出不依赖微多普勒频谱图、直接在去杂波原始雷达数据上以卷积beta-VAE无监督预训练的通用雷达编码器，统一频谱插值网格对齐多平台数据，冻结编码器后仅训练轻量时序分类器，在多种人体感知任务上优于端到端监督模型与雷达基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有雷达人体感知依赖端到端任务专用模型，输入为人工选定的信号投影，跨用户、跨任务、跨硬件的泛化能力差。作者认为主流的微多普勒频谱图不适合迁移：它保留了会被载频重新缩放的Doppler轴，却丢弃了载频不改变的角向轴。
AI.method: 在去杂波的原始雷达测量上，用无标签卷积beta-VAE进行预训练；数据涵盖4个平台、60与77 GHz、4至12个虚拟天线，并通过统一频谱插值网格对齐。下游任务中编码器保持冻结，仅在其嵌入上训练小型监督时序分类器。对比基线为各基准端到端训练的监督模型与一个预训练雷达基础模型，共十种设置，覆盖活动、手势、手语与步态识别。
AI.result: 训练中见过测试用户与雷达时，编码器在全部五个基准上最佳；未见用户条件下在四个基准中的三个领先，提升4.8至23.2个百分点。受试者不重叠的步态识别中，对四个留出受试者均表现最佳，平均高出最强基线8.3个点，尽管预训练未使用该雷达的任何记录。将测试雷达排除出预训练最多损失5.3个点。
AI.conclusion: 以原始测量替代微多普勒频谱图、配合无监督beta-VAE预训练与冻结编码器迁移，可构建跨平台、跨用户、跨任务的通用雷达人体感知编码器；对未见雷达的鲁棒性较强，代价有限。

title: Large Language Model-Assisted Adaptive Heuristic Search for Agile Earth Observation Satellite Scheduling
summary: Agile Earth observation satellites must coordinate imaging tasks within limited observation windows, while accounting for attitude maneuvering and onboard energy constraints. Competition among observation opportunities makes scheduling performance sensitive to the heuristic rules used for task selection. This letter proposes a large language model (LLM)-assisted adaptive heuristic search method for agile Earth observation satellite scheduling. The LLM generates an initial heuristic rule according to the characteristics of the scheduling instance. During the subsequent ant colony search, search performance and scheduling information are fed back to the LLM to refine the heuristic rule. The proposed modifications are evaluated through paired solution constructions before being incorporated into the search process. A unified scheduling procedure determines task selection, satellite assignment, and observation timing under the operational constraints. Experiments on six scheduling scenarios involving 50--200 imaging tasks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves 4.3\%--9.6\% higher mean observation benefit than the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出一种LLM辅助的自适应启发式搜索方法用于敏捷对地观测卫星调度：LLM根据实例特征生成初始启发式规则，并在蚁群搜索过程中依据性能与调度信息反馈迭代精化规则，规则修改经配对解构评估后并入搜索，在6个场景（50–200任务）上平均观测收益较最强基线提升4.3%–9.6%。
AI.motivation: 敏捷卫星需在有限观测窗口内协调成像任务，同时满足姿态机动与星上能量约束；观测机会竞争使调度性能对任务选择的启发式规则高度敏感，而人工设计/固定规则难以适配不同调度实例。
AI.method: LLM辅助的自适应启发式搜索：(1) LLM依据调度实例特征生成初始启发式规则；(2) 在蚁群搜索中把搜索性能与调度信息反馈给LLM以精化规则；(3) 候选规则修改通过配对解构（paired solution construction）评估后再纳入搜索；(4) 统一调度流程在运行约束下决定任务选择、卫星分配与观测时机。
AI.result: 在涵盖50–200个成像任务的6个调度场景实验中，所提方法的平均观测收益比最强基线高4.3%–9.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM引入启发式规则的生成与在线精化，并配合配对解构验证机制，可有效缓解启发式规则敏感性带来的性能损失，提升敏捷卫星调度的观测收益。

title: Variational Learning with Lie Group Exponential Families
summary: Variational Bayesian learning for deep neural networks offers many potential benefits. The difficulty in implementation arises from constraints on the parameters of the variational distributions, as well as the need for low-variance gradient estimators. Our recent work proposes Lie group methods for multiplicative or affine groups that naturally overcome such difficulties. Lie groups are essentially parameter spaces with a binary operator such as addition or multiplication, which allows for natural updates within the parameter space. In this article, we streamline and extend our Lie group framework to any general Lie group, and give an explicit relation to standard natural-gradient variational learning methods such as the Bayesian learning rule (BLR). In particular, we prove that linear approximations of the Lie group algorithm give generalizations of the BLR. The key ingredient is the harmonic exponential family, a general class of Lie group exponential families associated to representations of Lie groups. Our work provides a systematic method to construct from such representations efficiently implementable algorithms for variational learning.

AI.tldr: 本文将 Lie 群变分贝叶斯学习框架推广至一般 Lie 群，并证明其线性近似可视为 Bayesian learning rule（BLR）的推广，核心工具为与 Lie 群表示相关联的调和指数族。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络变分贝叶斯学习虽具诸多潜在优势，但实现上的困难在于变分分布参数的约束以及需要低方差梯度估计器。已有工作针对乘性群或仿射群提出 Lie 群方法可自然克服这些困难，本文希望将其系统化并推广。
AI.method: 将 Lie 群框架从乘性/仿射群推广到任意一般 Lie 群；引入调和指数族（harmonic exponential family）——一类与 Lie 群表示相关联的 Lie 群指数族，作为构造算法的关键要素；并显式建立该框架与自然梯度变分学习方法（如 BLR）的关系，通过 Lie 群算法的线性近似进行理论分析。
AI.result: 证明了 Lie 群算法的线性近似给出 BLR 的推广，从而将 Lie 群变分学习与标准自然梯度变分学习统一起来；并给出一套从 Lie 群表示出发系统构造高效可实现变分学习算法的方法。
AI.conclusion: Lie 群框架可作为统一视角，涵盖并推广自然梯度变分学习方法，为在一般 Lie 群参数空间上设计可高效实现的变分贝叶斯学习算法提供系统化途径。

title: BtsPruner: Role-Aware Visual Token Pruning for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) often process hundreds or thousands of visual tokens, resulting in substantial computational and memory overhead during inference. Existing training-free pruning methods typically estimate token importance using language-model attention, visual attention, or feature similarity. However, these methods treat visual tokens with uniform criteria and overlook that tokens may serve different roles during visual encoding. In this work, we investigate the evolution of visual token roles in LVLMs and observe that tokens progressively transition from local detail carriers to globally referenced representatives as encoding proceeds. Based on this observation, we propose BtsPruner, a training-free role-aware visual token pruning framework that preserves complementary token roles under a fixed budget. Specifically, BtsPruner first identifies the token-role transition point based on the evolution of attention concentration. It then discovers globally referenced representatives from later encoding stages and recursively retrieves local detail tokens from earlier stages to recover complementary fine-grained evidence. Extensive experiments across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, Qwen-VL, InternVL, and CogVLM demonstrate that BtsPruner achieves superior performance retention under aggressive token reduction. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, BtsPruner preserves 91.6% of the dense model's performance using only 32 of 576 visual tokens (5.6%). In the high-resolution LLaVA-NeXT-7B setting, it achieves up to a 5.95x CUDA-latency speedup.

AI.tldr: BtsPruner：一种免训练的角色感知视觉token剪枝框架，依据视觉token从"局部细节载体"向"全局引用代表"演化的规律，在固定预算下保留互补角色的token，实现大幅降低视觉token数并保持性能。
AI.motivation: LVLMs推理时需处理数百至数千视觉token，带来显著计算与显存开销。现有免训练剪枝方法多基于语言模型注意力、视觉注意力或特征相似度，对所有视觉token采用统一重要性准则，忽略了编码过程中token可能承担不同角色这一事实。
AI.method: 首先揭示视觉token角色的演化规律：随编码推进，token从局部细节载体逐步转变为全局引用代表。基于此，BtsPruner先根据注意力集中度的演化确定token-角色转变点；随后从后期编码阶段挖掘全局引用代表token，并递归地从早期阶段检索局部细节token，以恢复互补的细粒度证据；全程无需训练，在固定token预算下保留互补角色。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、Qwen-VL、InternVL、CogVLM上验证，激进裁剪下保持更优性能：LLaVA-1.5-7B仅用576个视觉token中的32个（5.6%）即保留91.6%的稠密模型性能；高分辨率LLaVA-NeXT-7B上实现最高5.95倍CUDA延迟加速。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token在编码中具有角色演化特性，按角色互补性而非统一准则进行剪枝更有效；BtsPruner以无训练方式在极端压缩下兼顾性能与效率，具备跨多种LVLM架构的通用性。

title: Treating the Symptom, Missing the Cause: Anatomy of a Scientific Reasoning Failure
comment: 18 pages (8 pages main text, remainder appendix), 9 figures, 6 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Failure Modes of AI in Biology (ICBINB-BIO); non-archival
summary:
Scientific agents can find interventions that work without understanding why they do. We study this failure mode in controlled synthetic regulatory systems, where agents must experimentally identify a hidden fault and rescue the resulting phenotype. Across seven LLMs, every model restores the healthy phenotypes more often than it identifies the fault. Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 rescue every organism while diagnosing only 55% and 35% of them. This failure is not simply due to insufficient exploration or unavailable evidence. In most cases, the cause is experimentally identifiable, and agents encounter evidence that distinguishes competing causes in 91% of relevant sessions, and still frequently misdiagnose the system.
  Targeted probes reveal where experimental reasoning breaks down. Models reliably interpret decisive evidence and revise hypotheses when the causal comparison is explicit, and can locate that evidence within a full experimental record. However, they struggle to predict the outcome of the experiment under each competing cause, a necessary step in using the observed result to distinguish between them. Agents can therefore gather the right evidence and still infer the wrong cause. As AI systems take on a growing role in synthesising scientific evidence, these findings highlight the need to evaluate how they use evidence to reach causal conclusions, alongside whether their interventions succeed.

AI.tldr: 在多组合成调控系统中，7个大语言模型"能救活表型却不理解病因"：修复成功率显著高于诊断成功率，且失败并非源于探索不足或证据缺失，而是模型难以对每个竞争性病因预测实验结果，从而无法用观测结果做因果区分。
AI.motivation: 科学智能体可能找到有效干预却不理解其机理，这种"知其然不知其所以然"的失效模式缺乏系统刻画。作者希望在可控的合成调控系统中量化"干预成功"与"因果诊断"之间的差距，并定位实验推理失效的具体环节。
AI.method: 构建受控的合成调控系统作为测试床，智能体需通过实验识别隐藏故障并挽救异常表型。评测7个LLM，对比表型修复率与故障诊断率；进一步用针对性探针任务分解实验推理流程，分别检验：证据解释与假设修正（因果对比显式时）、在全实验记录中定位关键证据、以及对各竞争性病因预测实验结果的能力。
AI.result: 所有7个模型修复健康表型的频率均高于诊断出故障的频率；Claude Opus 4.6与Sonnet 4.6虽修复全部个体，诊断率仅分别为55%和35%。多数情形下病因可经实验辨识，91%的相关会话中智能体确实遇到了可区分竞争性病因的证据，但仍常误诊。探针显示：模型在因果对比明确时能可靠解读决定性证据并修正假设，也能在完整实验记录中定位该证据；但难以预测每个竞争性病因下的实验结果，而这是利用观测结果进行区分的关键步骤。
AI.conclusion: 实验推理的瓶颈不在探索或证据获取，而在"预测—区分"环节，导致"证据对、推断错"。评价AI科学智能体时，除干预是否成功外，还需评估其如何利用证据得出因果结论。

title: The Price of List Replicability: Tight Bounds for Bias Estimation
summary:
We study the sample complexity of list replicable algorithms for estimating the biases of $d$ coins. An algorithm is $(k,\varepsilon,δ)$-list replicable if for every bias vector $\mathbf{p}\in[0,1]^d$, there is a set of outputs $L_{\mathbf{p}}\subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ of at most $k$ elements such that every $\mathbf{y}\in L_{\mathbf{p}}$ satisfies $\lVert\mathbf{y}-\mathbf{p}\rVert_\infty\leq\varepsilon$, and the algorithm output is in $L_{\mathbf{p}}$ with probability at least $1-δ$. Prior work gave a $(d+1,\varepsilon,δ)$-list replicable algorithm with sample complexity $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{d^3}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$, but no nontrivial sample complexity lower bound was known.
  We establish the first non-trivial sample complexity lower bound for this problem and give an improved algorithm that matches it up to polylogarithmic factors. Together, these results determine the optimal sample complexity for list size $d+1$ to be $\widetildeΘ\left(\frac{d^2}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$, showing that the quadratic dependence on dimension is inherent up to polylogarithmic factors. More generally, for every $k\in[d+1,2^d]$, we establish matching upper and lower bounds of $\widetildeΘ\left(\frac{d^2}{\varepsilon^2\log k}\right)$ on the total sample complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究估计 d 枚硬币偏置的 list-replicable 算法的样本复杂度，首次给出非平凡下界，并给出与之匹配（至多对数因子）的改进算法，确定最优样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 此前已有 (d+1,ε,δ)-list replicable 算法，样本复杂度为 Õ(d^3/ε^2)，但缺乏非平凡的下界，问题的最优样本复杂度未知。
AI.method: 针对 d 枚硬币偏置估计建立首个非平凡样本复杂度下界，并构造改进的 list replicable 算法，使上下界在对数多项式因子内匹配。
AI.result: 对 list size d+1，最优样本复杂度为 Õ(d^2/ε^2)；更一般地，对每个 k∈[d+1,2^d]，总样本复杂度的匹配上下界为 Õ(d^2/(ε^2 log k))。
AI.conclusion: 维度上的二次依赖性（至多对数因子）是固有的，list size d+1 情形达到最优，且一般 k 情形上下界紧匹配。

title: Predicting Void Points in Self-Occluding Forest Volumes
summary:
Synthetic Aperture Imaging (SAI) enables drones to observe forest canopies by warping and averaging multiple displaced views at a common depth. However, occlusion is suppressed rather than eliminated, causing poorly observed regions to appear occupied and leading to systematic biomass overestimation. The Deep Forest project cannot distinguish reconstruction artifacts from real vegetation because its training data relies on measured reflectance points, excluding empty space and preventing the network from learning explicit occupancy boundaries.
  This thesis addresses the problem by modifying training labels rather than the imaging process. Each simulated scene is rendered twice: as a 9x9 grid of top-down captures for focal-stack generation and as 550 depth-clipped slabs derived from scene geometry to provide occupancy labels, explicitly representing void space as a negative class. A Gazebo pipeline generates procedural forest stands containing 80-200 trees across three species. A pretrained Pix2Pix model translates rendered RGB images into a synthetic near-infrared band, and Light Field Rendering produces aligned focal stacks of 550 planes across three channels.
  Four architectures were evaluated on a held-out scene. The plain 2D U-Net achieved an IoU of 0.6290, outperforming the volumetric 3D U-Net (0.5707). Established reconstruction methods performed substantially worse: COLMAP achieved 0.3446 and DepthAnything3 0.2959, both after their respective optimal dilation sweeps. An RGB-input variant of the volumetric architecture achieved the highest IoU of 0.6514 without dilation or per-scene calibration. These results highlight the limitations of conventional reconstruction methods, which recover visible surfaces but struggle to infer occupancy within closed canopies.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对合成孔径成像中遮挡被抑制而非消除导致的生物量高估问题，通过修改训练标签（引入显式空腔负类）而非成像流程来改进森林冠层占用重建，2D U-Net达IoU 0.6290，RGB输入的体积架构最优达0.6514，显著优于COLMAP(0.3446)与DepthAnything3(0.2959)。
AI.motivation: Deep Forest项目利用合成孔径成像对森林冠层观测，但多视角融合只是压制而非消除遮挡，导致观测不良区域被误判为有植被，系统性高估生物量。其根本原因在于训练数据仅使用实测反射点，排除了空域，网络无法学习显式的占用边界，因而无法区分重建伪影与真实植被。
AI.method: 不改动成像过程，而修改训练标签：每个仿真场景渲染两次——9x9俯视网格用于生成焦栈，以及由场景几何导出的550层深度裁剪切片提供占用标签，将空腔显式建模为负类。Gazebo流程生成含3个树种、80–200棵树的程序化林分；预训练Pix2Pix将RGB转为合成近红外波段；光场渲染生成三通道550平面配准焦栈。在留出场景上评估四种架构。
AI.result: 2D U-Net IoU为0.6290，优于3D U-Net的0.5707；COLMAP经最优膨胀扫描后为0.3446，DepthAnything3为0.2959；RGB输入的体积架构在无膨胀、无逐场景标定下取得最高IoU 0.6514。
AI.conclusion: 常规重建方法仅能恢复可见表面，难以推断封闭冠层内部的占用状态。显式空腔负类标签配合学习式体积重建可有效抑制伪影导致的生物量高估，且RGB输入变体在免标定条件下表现最佳。

title: Self-Privileged Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is a key component of language model post-training, enabling effective task adaptation and serving as an important foundation for subsequent reinforcement learning. Recent methods seek to improve SFT by introducing token-level weights into the training objective, where these weights are typically derived from a model's output distribution at each token position. To better understand how such weighting schemes affect SFT, we analyze their optimization objectives and theoretically characterize the target distributions they induce. Our analysis shows that dynamic weighting methods, such as Dynamic Fine-Tuning (DFT), induce a heavily sharpened distribution, whereas static weighting methods fit a target distribution proportional to the product of the data distribution and a frozen prior. These findings suggest that static weighting provides a more stable training target, while its effectiveness critically depends on the quality of the prior distribution. Building on this observation, we propose Self-Privileged Fine-Tuning (SPFT), which uses a frozen copy of the initial model conditioned on privileged information (such as ground truth for mathematical questions) as a prior to provide guidance for token-level weighting during fine-tuning. Through a Bayesian decomposition, we further show that SPFT reweights the standard static prior according to how informative each target token is for predicting the ground-truth outcome, thereby assigning larger weights to more predictive tokens. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that SPFT improves over standard SFT and other baselines across the main settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析SFT中token级加权的优化目标与诱导分布，指出动态加权（如DFT）导致过度尖锐化分布，静态加权则拟合数据分布与冻结先验的乘积；据此提出SPFT，用初始模型在特权信息下的冻结副本作为先验进行token加权，并在数学推理与代码生成任务上优于标准SFT及基线。
AI.motivation: 近期SFT改进方法引入token级权重，权重多源自模型在各token位置的输出分布，但其对SFT优化目标的影响缺乏理论刻画，需要厘清不同加权方式诱导的目标分布，以指导更稳定的SFT设计。
AI.method: 1）对动态加权与静态加权的优化目标进行理论分析，刻画其诱导的目标分布；2）基于静态加权依赖先验质量的结论，提出SPFT：以初始模型在特权信息（如数学题标准答案）条件下的冻结副本作为先验，为微调中的token级加权提供指导；3）通过贝叶斯分解说明SPFT按各目标token对预测真值结果的信息量对静态先验重新加权，赋予更具预测性的token更大权重。
AI.result: 理论分析表明动态加权（DFT等）诱导高度尖锐化分布，静态加权拟合与数据分布×冻结先验成比例的目标分布；SPFT在数学推理与代码生成的主要实验设置上均优于标准SFT及其他基线。
AI.conclusion: token级加权的效果取决于其所诱导的目标分布是否稳定，静态加权更稳定但受先验质量制约；以特权信息条件下的初始模型作为先验的SPFT可提供有效且信息量感知的加权，是一种有前景的SFT改进方案。

title: A Parametric Linear Conic Projection for Structured Sparse Attention
summary:
In this paper, we introduce the Cone Alignment Index (CAI), a scale-invariant sparsity measure associated with a Lorentz-cone geometry. We provide a probabilistic analysis of the distribution of the CAI score, including a general theorem and explicit corollaries for Gaussian and uniform distributions. As a consequence, we show that, in the high-sparsity regime, the probability that the samples lie within the convex cone tends to one. Building upon this formulation, we derive two complementary projections: the \emph{Parametric Linear Conic Projection} (PLCP), an efficient closed-form approximation, and the \emph{Parametric Euclidean Conic Projection} (PECP), the exact Euclidean projection onto the cone boundary.
  Our analysis establishes several fundamental theoretical properties. We prove that PLCP and PECP are collinear, differ only by a positive radial scaling factor, and induce exactly the same sparsity threshold, thereby preserving an identical active support. Furthermore, we derive a support-identification theorem showing that, for any prescribed sparsity level $l<n$, the number of coefficients discarded at each iteration is theoretically controlled.
  Building on this theoretical foundation, we develop a bilevel PLCP framework for structured matrix sparsification. The proposed method naturally generates hardware-friendly structured sparsity patterns, including row-wise, column-wise, and diagonal masks, making it particularly well suited for accelerating Transformer attention mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Cone Alignment Index（CAI）——一种与Lorentz锥几何相关的尺度不变稀疏度度量，给出其分布的概率分析，并由此推导两种互补的锥投影（PLCP闭式近似、PECP精确欧氏投影），证明二者共线、仅差正径向缩放且诱导相同稀疏阈值与支撑集；进而提出双层PLCP框架用于结构化矩阵稀疏化，生成行/列/对角等硬件友好掩码以加速Transformer注意力。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏度度量与稀疏化方法缺乏几何解释性与尺度不变性，且难以在保持支撑集一致性的同时生成硬件友好的结构化稀疏模式；作者希望以Lorentz锥几何为统一框架，建立稀疏度的概率与几何理论，并将其转化为可控制、可用于Transformer注意力的结构化稀疏算法。
AI.method: 1）定义尺度不变的CAI稀疏度指标，基于Lorentz锥几何；2）给出CAI分布的一般性定理及高斯、均匀分布的显式推论，证明高稀疏情形下样本落入凸锥的概率趋于1；3）提出Parametric Linear Conic Projection（PLCP，闭式近似）与Parametric Euclidean Conic Projection（PECP，锥边界上的精确欧氏投影）；4）证明二者共线、仅差正径向缩放因子，具有相同稀疏阈值与活跃支撑；5）给出支撑识别定理，保证给定稀疏水平l<n时每轮丢弃系数数量可控；6）构建双层PLCP框架实现结构化矩阵稀疏化。
AI.result: 理论上：得到CAI分布的普适定理与高斯/均匀推论，高稀疏极限下样本落入凸锥的概率趋于1；证明PLCP与PECP共线且稀疏阈值、活跃支撑完全一致；支撑识别定理给出每轮丢弃系数数目的可控界。方法上：双层PLCP可自然生成行向、列向、对角等硬件友好的结构化稀疏掩码，适配Transformer注意力加速。
AI.conclusion: CAI为稀疏度提供了具有Lorentz锥几何意义的尺度不变刻画，两种锥投影的等价性使高效闭式PLCP可替代精确PECP而不改变稀疏结构，支撑识别定理保障了迭代稀疏化的可控性；双层PLCP框架可将该理论落地为结构化稀疏掩码，为Transformer注意力等场景的硬件高效加速提供理论与实践基础。

title: CANDO: Conservative Action-Noise Directional Optimization for Residual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Pretrained generative policies provide strong behavior priors for robot control, but adapting them efficiently with online reinforcement learning remains difficult. A central challenge is how to improve a frozen generative policy without destroying the structure learned from offline demonstrations. Noise-space residual methods address this by modifying the policy's input noise, but existing noise-space methods typically regulate adaptation through fixed latent feasible regions, which may exclude valuable noise edits. In contrast, action-space residual methods are more sample-efficient, but their efficiency can still be further improved. We propose Conservative Noise Directional Optimization (CNDO), a noise-space residual RL method that improves a frozen generative policy by learning state- and noise-conditioned directions around Gaussian latent samples. CNDO removes predefined latent feasible regions and instead regulates noise-space adaptation through the soft conservative constraint, which consists of conservative value estimation and gated execution. We further introduce Conservative Action-Noise Directional Optimization (CANDO), which adds an action-space residual, combining structured latent-space improvement with local action correction. Experiments show that, once CNDO narrows the gap between noise-space and action-space residual learning, CANDO further improves over single-space optimization, achieving 76.1 NAUC and a 91.4% final success rate, surpassing the best single-space results by 6.6 NAUC and 4.1% success rate. More demos and info are available on https://cando-rl.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出CNDO与CANDO两种噪声空间残差强化学习方法，冻结预训练生成策略并通过学习状态-噪声条件化的方向进行适配，最终CANDO结合动作空间残差取得76.1 NAUC与91.4%成功率。
AI.motivation: 预训练生成策略虽提供强行为先验，但用在线强化学习高效适配困难：需在不破坏离线演示所学结构的前提下改进冻结策略。现有噪声空间残差方法用固定潜在可行域约束适配，可能排除有价值的噪声编辑；动作空间残差样本效率较高但仍有提升空间。
AI.method: CNDO：在冻结生成策略的输入噪声空间学习状态与噪声条件化的方向（围绕高斯潜在样本），移除预定义潜在可行域，改用软保守约束——保守价值估计与门控执行来规范噪声空间适配。CANDO：在CNDO基础上加入动作空间残差，将结构化潜在空间改进与局部动作修正相结合。
AI.result: CNDO缩小了噪声空间与动作空间残差学习的差距；CANDO在单空间优化基础上进一步提升，达到76.1 NAUC与91.4%最终成功率，较最佳单空间结果分别高出6.6 NAUC和4.1%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 以软保守约束替代固定潜在可行域可有效释放噪声空间编辑的潜力，噪声空间与动作空间残差的互补结合能显著提升冻结生成策略的在线适配性能。

title: SEEK-VAU: Towards Evidence-Faithful Video Anomaly Understanding via Agentic Search
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (main conference track). 27 pages, 5 figures
summary: Most video anomaly understanding (VAU) systems still infer anomaly judgments from evidence collected in a feed-forward way under predefined rules, typically sampled frames, or events clustered from such frames. This protocol fails when the collected evidence is incomplete under imperfect predefined rules, because once reasoning begins the model can no longer search for the missing evidence. We address this limitation with SEEK-VAU, which reframes VAU as an agentic search-and-verify interaction protocol under a bounded search budget: instead of passively reasoning over pre-collected evidence, the policy actively gathers evidence across the three stages of an anomaly event chain (precursor, trigger, and aftermath) and verifies its sufficiency before finalization, turning event-chain completeness into an explicit design rather than an outcome of predefined rules. A bounded budget caps the cost of this search, but does not by itself teach the policy where to look or when to stop. To make this behavior learnable, we introduce evidence-faithful counterfactual verification (EFCV), which rewards selected evidence that remains supportive, compact, and necessary under counterfactual verification. We further introduce SEEK-Bench, featuring video-level episodes with temporal interval annotations, semantic QA and event-chain stage labels. Together, SEEK-VAU and SEEK-Bench establish a strong foundation for evidence-faithful and actively verifiable VAU.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SEEK-VAU，将视频异常理解（VAU）重构为在有限搜索预算下的智能体式"搜索—验证"交互协议，让策略主动沿异常事件链（前兆、触发、后兆）三个阶段逐步取证并在定论前验证证据充分性；并引入证据忠实的反事实验证奖励 EFCV 与带有时间区间标注、语义问答和事件链阶段标签的 SEEK-Bench。
AI.motivation: 现有 VAU 系统多为"前馈式"取证：依赖预定义规则（如采样帧或由此聚类的事件）一次性收集证据后再推理；当规则不完善导致证据不完整时，推理一旦开始便无法回溯补搜缺失证据，从而限制了判断的可靠性。
AI.method: 1) 将 VAU 重新表述为有界搜索预算下的智能体搜索—验证交互协议，策略在异常事件链三阶段上主动取证，并在最终判定前验证证据充分性，把事件链完整性变为显式设计目标；2) 提出证据忠实反事实验证（EFCV），在反事实检验下奖励那些仍然具有支持性、紧凑且必要的所选证据；3) 构建 SEEK-Bench，提供视频级 episode、时间区间标注、语义 QA 与事件链阶段标签。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果；实验层面以 SEEK-Bench 为评测基础，用于支撑"证据忠实且可主动验证"的 VAU 设定与评估。
AI.conclusion: SEEK-VAU 与 SEEK-Bench 共同为证据忠实、可主动验证的视频异常理解奠定了坚实基础，弥补了前馈式取证在证据不完整时不可回溯的根本缺陷。

title: Where Is the Truth When AI Agents Disagree? Dependence-Aware Belief Propagation for Unsupervised Truth Discovery (Extended Version)
comment: Extended version of a short paper accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData 2026). 11 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/LaureBerti/BPTD ; code and data archive: doi:10.5281/zenodo.21294747
summary: LLM agents often give conflicting answers to the same question, and many deployed agents are variants of one base model, so their errors are correlated. We study truth discovery among such agents: inferring the true answer and each agent's reliability without labels. Classical truth-discovery and crowdsourcing estimators reward an agreeing bloc and can fall below majority vote. We propose BP-TD, which adds per-agent decorrelation weights to mean-field variational inference on a one-coin Dawid-Skene model, so that agents sharing a base model count together as about one vote. Its first iteration is exactly a weighted vote; later iterations estimate agent reliability. With 13 local agents on MMLU, BP-TD beats majority vote without any labels (0.716 vs. 0.624 on 160 questions; 0.707 vs. 0.674 on 10,000) and ranks agents by their true accuracy, which classical estimators invert. The gain depends on the pool: over 2,852 sub-pools of four benchmarks, decorrelation helps when the largest correlated bloc is weaker than the other agents and hurts when it is the strongest, and we found no label-free statistic that tells the two cases apart. Labels change the picture quickly: with 20 labelled questions, selecting the single best agent is more accurate than every aggregator we tested on MMLU, ARC and TruthfulQA.

AI.tldr: 提出 BP-TD，在 one-coin Dawid-Skene 的 mean-field 变分推断中加入 per-agent 去相关权重，使同基座模型的智能体近似计为一票，实现无标签的真值推断与可靠性排序。
AI.motivation: 多个 LLM agent 常为同一基座模型的变体，错误高度相关；经典真值发现与众包估计器会奖励"同意集团"，效果可能低于多数投票。
AI.method: 在 one-coin Dawid-Skene 模型上用 mean-field 变分推断，为每个 agent 引入去相关权重；首轮迭代等价于加权投票，后续迭代估计各 agent 可靠性。
AI.result: MMLU 上 13 个本地 agent：BP-TD 无标签优于多数投票（160 题 0.716 vs 0.624；10,000 题 0.707 vs 0.674），且按真实准确率排序 agent，而经典估计器排序颠倒。在 2,852 个子池上，当最大相关集团的弱于其他 agent 时去相关有益，最强时有害，且无无标签统计量能区分两者。仅 20 条标注时，选单个最优 agent 在 MMLU、ARC、TruthfulQA 上优于所有被测聚合器。
AI.conclusion: 去相关加权可显著提升无标签聚合，但其收益依赖池结构且不可预先判定；少量标签即可让"选最优单agent"胜过复杂聚合。

title: Goal-Driven Autonomous Optical Experimentation via a Self-Recursive Hardware-Software Harness
summary: We propose goal-driven self-recursive optical research in which agents use physical evidence to revise the hardware, software, models, and protocols used to pursue a scientific goal. The framework can be instantiated with different stimulus systems and measurement devices. We formalize its updates and derive a relation between physical attainability, command access, and model approximation error. We demonstrate the concept in an optical see-through color-matching case study using an iPad, RayNeo X3 glasses, and a TOP 300 probe coupled to a CAS140D spectroradiometer, both from Instrument Systems. A revised glasses application adds USB-controlled RGB holds and frame acknowledgements, keeping model-generated colors displayed during spectral acquisition. The interface passes 12 live control checks. Spectral feedback reduces one target color difference from 19.756 to 1.211 ΔE_76^*; all five targets improve in a separate comparison. These measurements demonstrate the concept in one configuration. The resulting software and protocols remain available for subsequent investigations.

AI.tldr: 提出"目标驱动的自递归光学研究"框架：智能体利用物理测量证据迭代修改硬件、软件、模型与协议，并在iPad+AR眼镜+光谱仪的色彩匹配案例中验证，将色差从19.756降至1.211 ΔE_76^*。
AI.motivation: 传统光学研究中，硬件、软件、模型与实验协议相对固定，模型误差与物理可实现性之间的鸿沟难以在实验过程中被系统地反馈消解；作者希望让研究流程本身具备依据物理证据自我修订的能力。
AI.method: 形式化一个目标驱动的自递归光学研究框架：智能体以物理证据为依据更新系统四要素（硬件、软件、模型、协议），推导"物理可实现性—指令可达性—模型近似误差"之间的关系，并可实例化于不同刺激系统与测量设备。案例采用iPad、RayNeo X3眼镜及Instrument Systems的TOP 300探头+CAS140D光谱辐射计；修改眼镜端应用，加入USB控制的RGB保持与帧确认，使模型生成颜色在光谱采集期间持续显示。系统通过12项实时控制检查。
AI.result: 光谱反馈使单一目标色差由19.756降至1.211 ΔE_76^*；在另一组对照中，全部5个目标均有改善。系统通过12项实时控制校验。
AI.conclusion: 该测量在一个配置下验证了概念可行性，说明物理反馈驱动的自递归修订可显著提升光学色彩匹配精度；所得软件与协议保留供后续研究复用。

title: Curriculum unlearning in humans and neural networks
summary: During learning, humans often benefit from curricula that teach simple rules before exceptions. However, we lack a computational explanation for this phenomenon. Here, using a canonical behavioural task and modelling with neural networks, we develop and test a theory for why simple-to-complex curricula succeed. We show that during learning, both humans and neural networks show simplicity biases, a tendency to learn simple rules that are underfit to the data. In neural networks this bias is accompanied by compression of neural representations. Simple-to-complex curricula help both types of learners overcome this compression, developing representations (and policy) with appropriate dimensionality for the task. We test and confirm a further prediction from this theory: learners that have been pre-exposed to simple tasks and with more compressed initial representations benefit more from curricula. These findings suggest that curricula help with ``unlearning'' of simple rules.

AI.tldr: 本文用典型行为任务与神经网络建模，提出并验证"由简到繁"课程为何有效的理论：学习者存在追求简单规则的"简单性偏置"，该偏置伴随神经表征压缩，而课程帮助其"反学习"简单规则、发展出与任务维度匹配的表征与策略。
AI.motivation: 人类学习常受益于先教简单规则、再教例外的课程，但缺乏对该现象的计算性解释；作者希望建立一个可解释并可在人类与神经网络上同时检验的理论。
AI.method: 采用典型行为任务，并结合神经网络建模，对人类被试与神经网络进行对比研究；分析学习过程中的简单性偏置、神经表征压缩，以及课程对表征维度的作用，并进一步检验理论预测的调节因素。
AI.result: 人类与神经网络在学习中均表现出简单性偏置，即倾向学习对数据欠拟合（underfit）的简单规则；神经网络中该偏置伴随神经表征的压缩。由简到繁课程能帮助两类学习者克服这种压缩，形成维度恰当的表征与策略。且验证了理论的进一步预测：预先接触简单任务、初始表征更压缩的学习者从课程中获益更大。
AI.conclusion: 课程的作用机制在于帮助学习者"反学习"（unlearning）简单规则，从而获得与任务复杂度相匹配的表征，为"由简到繁"课程的有效性提供了统一的计算解释。

title: Multi-Path Mamba Diffusion for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Scene Completion
summary: 3D semantic scene completion plays a critical role in enabling various downstream tasks within autonomous systems by estimating both missing geometric structures and semantic information in scene data. In this work, we introduce a unique neural framework that integrates state space modeling with diffusion-based generative approaches to enhance 3D point cloud semantic scene completion. We propose \textit{MPath Mamba} diffusion network, leveraging a skip-triple Mamba structure, dimensional decomposition residuals, and multi-directional dilations within multi-path data to efficiently process long-sequence data for feature extraction. The proposed method operates in the conditioned latent space of a variational autoencoder, enhanced by a state-space mechanism to improve 3D point cloud representation and reconstruction. Extensive experiments conducted on the SemanticKITTI benchmark demonstrate that our approach achieves highly competitive performance for 3D point cloud semantic scene completion.

AI.tldr: 提出MPath Mamba扩散网络，将状态空间建模与扩散生成结合，在VAE条件潜空间中提升3D点云语义场景补全。
AI.motivation: 3D语义场景补全对自动驾驶下游任务至关重要，需同时估计缺失几何结构与语义信息；现有方法在长序列点云特征提取与表示重建上存在不足。
AI.method: 集成状态空间建模与扩散生成模型，设计skip-triple Mamba结构、维度分解残差与多路径数据中的多方向空洞；在VAE的条件潜空间中运行，并用状态空间机制增强3D点云表示与重建。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI基准上取得极具竞争力的3D点云语义场景补全性能。
AI.conclusion: 状态空间建模与扩散生成在潜空间中的协同可有效提升长序列点云处理与场景补全效果。

title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
summary: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks, but their long chain-of-thought often incurs substantial inference costs by continuing to deliberate after sufficient information has been obtained. Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo detects candidate overthinking states from the model's own traces, freezes the corresponding reasoning prefixes, regenerates shorter verified continuations from the same states, and trains on the resulting state-conditioned preference pairs with DPO. This formulation teaches the model when to continue reasoning and when to conclude, rather than simply encouraging shorter trajectories overall. We construct training data entirely from self-generated mathematical traces and evaluate LoCo on five mathematical and three code generation benchmarks. LoCo reduces completion length by 41.7\%--45.4\% on mathematics and 23.4\%--36.3\% on code, while maintaining or improving accuracy and achieving the best AUC across all code benchmarks. LoCo consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off on mathematics and transfers effectively to code generation despite math-only training, demonstrating the cross-domain generality of local preference learning for reasoning compression. The code and model will be publicly released at https://github.com/MuyaoYuan/LoCo.

AI.tldr: LoCo：一种局部偏好学习方法，通过在推理轨迹的“过度思考”状态上构造状态条件偏好对并用DPO训练，教模型“何时停止思考”，实现推理压缩。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型的长链式思维（long CoT）在已获得足够信息后仍继续推理，导致推理成本高。现有推理压缩方法多在整条推理轨迹层面操作，忽略了“给定当前状态是否还需继续推理”这一局部决策。
AI.method: LoCo从模型自身轨迹中检测候选过度思考状态（candidate overthinking states），冻结对应的推理前缀，从同一状态重新生成更短且经验证的续写，构造状态条件偏好对，并用DPO训练。该形式化使模型学习“何时继续、何时结束”，而非整体鼓励更短轨迹。训练数据完全由自生成的数学轨迹构造。
AI.result: 在5个数学与3个代码生成基准上评估：数学任务完成长度减少41.7%–45.4%，代码任务减少23.4%–36.3%，同时保持或提升准确率；在所有代码基准上取得最佳AUC。仅用数学训练仍能有效迁移到代码生成。
AI.conclusion: 局部偏好学习能持续改善准确率—效率权衡，并展现跨域泛化性，证明“局部决策式”推理压缩的有效性。

title: CogniLife: Continuous Cognitive Distillation for Deployed Multi-Expert Agent Marketplaces
summary: Multi-expert agent marketplaces -- where creators publish domain-specific AI experts for end users to consult -- are an emerging deployment pattern for language technology. A published expert can receive many requests yet little evidence about its creator, who remains active elsewhere: the cold-expert problem. We frame continuous cognitive distillation as converting attributed creator observations into revisable decision rules, communication patterns, and domain procedures. CogniLife proposes a cross-expert attribution design for this problem, with Creator Profiles for transferable creator patterns and Expert Journals for listing-specific knowledge; this design is not yet implemented or evaluated. A deployed platform partially realizes the surrounding lifecycle through creator-authorized authoring, capability-owned proposal filtering, and reversible consolidation of eligible owner-scoped memory. On ProfyBench-v1, an 85-task offline benchmark built from replay seeds and controlled internal tests, the Profy Full configuration as a whole achieves a mean overall score of 4.65/5 from the primary LLM judge, compared with 4.01 for Raw LLM and 4.28 for Expert Prompt, with the largest gains in completeness, specificity, and missing-information tasks. These configuration-level scores do not test cold-expert mitigation, cross-expert transfer, or longitudinal distillation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“冷专家问题”并给出跨专家归因设计CogniLife（Creator Profiles + Expert Journals），同时报告了已部署平台的部分生命周期机制；但其基准得分来自整体配置对比，未检验冷专家缓解、跨专家迁移与纵向蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 多专家智能体市场中，已发布专家可收到大量请求，但使用者几乎无法获知创建者信息，而创建者活跃于平台其他位置，形成“冷专家问题”。现有部署缺乏将创建者观测转化为可复用专家能力的机制。
AI.method: 将连续认知蒸馏定义为把带归因的创建者观测转化为可修订的决策规则、沟通模式与领域流程。CogniLife提出跨专家归因设计：Creator Profiles承载可迁移的创建者模式，Expert Journals承载列表专属知识。已部署平台以创建者授权写作、能力归属的提案过滤、以及可逆的归属范围内记忆合并部分实现外围生命周期。评估采用ProfyBench-v1（85任务离线基准，由replay种子与受控内部测试构建），对比Profy Full、Raw LLM与Expert Prompt三种配置。
AI.result: Profy Full整体配置在主要LLM评审下取得总体平均分4.65/5，Raw LLM为4.01，Expert Prompt为4.28；提升主要体现在完整性、具体性与缺失信息类任务上。
AI.conclusion: CogniLife的跨专家归因设计尚未实现与评估，平台仅部分落地外围生命周期；现有配置级分数不能作为冷专家缓解、跨专家迁移或纵向蒸馏的证据，相关机制仍待验证。

title: Ground-Wing: A Parametric 3D Wing-in-Ground-Effect Dataset for Benchmarking Neural Surrogate Models
summary: This paper presents a CFD dataset of a highly parametrized 3D wing operating in ground effect, designed for benchmarking neural surrogate models for aerodynamic prediction, using a wing shape and flow conditions typically encountered in motorsport applications. The dataset comprises 770 RANS simulations of 194 unique wing configurations, sampled across 27 airfoil profile variants and 4 distances from the ground, spanning variations in wing sweep, chord, taper, angle of attack, and tip twist. Six neural network architectures representing distinct paradigms --- convolutional (DoMINO), graph-based (X-MeshGraphNet), transformer-based (AB-UPT, GeoTransolver, GAOT), and JEPA-based (AeroJEPA) --- are evaluated on their ability to predict surface pressure coefficient and wall shear stress distributions, from which integral drag and lift coefficients are recovered. The dataset is intended to be used as a challenging benchmark for surrogate CFD models, due to the uniqueness of the ground effect being absent from other wing and airfoil datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个面向赛车场景、高度参数化的三维地面效应机翼CFD数据集（770次RANS仿真、194种构型、27种翼型、4种离地高度），并以此评测6种神经网络代理模型预测表面压力系数与壁面剪应力的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有翼型/机翼数据集缺乏地面效应这一独特流动现象，难以作为代理CFD模型的挑战性基准；因此需要一个含地面效应的参数化三维机翼数据集来统一评测神经代理模型。
AI.method: 构建参数化三维机翼几何，采样翼型剖面（27种）、离地距离（4种）以及后掠、弦长、锥度、攻角、翼尖扭转等变量；采用RANS求解得到770个仿真样本（194个唯一构型），以表面压力系数和壁面剪应力为预测目标并积分得到升/阻力系数；评测覆盖卷积（DoMINO）、图（X-MeshGraphNet）、Transformer（AB-UPT、GeoTransolver、GAOT）与JEPA（AeroJEPA）四类共6种架构。
AI.result: 数据集包含770个RANS仿真、194个唯一构型，覆盖27种翼型与4种离地距离；6种架构在表面压力系数与壁面剪应力预测上完成对比，并由表面场积分还原整体阻力与升力系数。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集因包含其他机翼/翼型数据集所缺失的地面效应，可作为神经代理CFD模型的具有挑战性的基准，用于气动预测方法的标准评测。

title: SparseGraph-I2P: Consistency-Guided Hypothesis Selection for Efficient Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration
summary: Coarse-to-fine image-to-point-cloud (I2P) registration risks discarding correct but ambiguous patch pairs, while retaining more candidates repeats fine matching over overlapping patches. SparseGraph-I2P aims to improve registration recall by increasing the inlier ratio at the pose solver, using sensor or monocular depth. A Coarse Hypothesis Graph combines appearance with depth-derived first- and second-order compatibility to select a fixed budget of patch pairs. Sparse Fine Matching decodes each queried pixel once and skips pixel--point comparisons covered by an ancestor patch paired with the same point-cloud region. With sensor depth, depth-aware filtering ranks correspondences by SC2 spectral support for a single EPnP solve. With monocular depth, depth or inverse depth is calibrated from correspondence geometry before filtering. SparseGraph-I2P achieves the highest registration recall and lowest latency among the compared methods on RGB-D Scenes V2 and 7-Scenes with sensor depth. With predicted depth, it retains the highest recall on RGB-D Scenes V2 at an additional calibration cost. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: SparseGraph-I2P通过粗假设图和稀疏精细匹配提高图像到点云配准的内点率与召回率，降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 粗到精I2P配准存在两难：早期丢弃正确但歧义的块对会损失召回，保留过多候选则导致重叠块上重复精细匹配、计算冗余。
AI.method: 1) 粗假设图：融合外观与深度导出的一阶、二阶兼容性，选择固定预算的块对；2) 稀疏精细匹配：每个查询像素只解码一次，并跳过已被祖先块覆盖（同一块与同一局部点云区域配对）的像素-点比较；3) 传感器深度下用基于SC2谱支撑的深度感知滤波排序对应，做单次EPnP求解；4) 单目深度下先由对应几何标定深度或逆深度再滤波。
AI.result: 在RGB-D Scenes V2与7-Scenes（传感器深度）上取得对比方法中最高配准召回与最低延迟；使用预测深度时在RGB-D Scenes V2保持最高召回，代价为额外标定开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过图结构约束与稀疏化精细匹配，可有效提升姿态求解器输入的内点比例，兼顾召回与效率，并支持传感器与单目深度两种设定。

title: Feeling of Knowing in Large Language Models
summary: Post-training updates change what large language models (LLMs) can answer, but may leave their answerability judgments misaligned. We study this knowledge-judgment desynchronization through functional feeling of knowing (FoK), which supports selective generation, retrieval triggering, and model routing without implying subjective experience. We propose two trainable channels: a knowledge channel that changes answerability and a FoK channel that judges the current knowledge state. Three stages train them: on-policy supervised fine-tuning (OP-SFT) updates knowledge from corrected on-policy answers; knowledge-delta FoK training (K$Δ$-FT) adapts judgments across intermediate knowledge states; and FoK-guided policy optimization (FGPO) trains the subsequent answer or explanation. Factual-QA experiments, cross-dataset evaluation, and three sequential updates show that explicit FoK alignment improves judgment quality on updated knowledge. MMLU and ARC-Easy separately assess capability preservation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了后训练更新导致LLM"知道什么"与"知道自己知道什么"之间的错位，提出功能性"知道感"（FoK）双通道框架并给出三阶段训练方法，实现知识更新与判断的同步对齐。
AI.motivation: 后训练更新会改变LLM可回答的内容，但其"可回答性判断"未必随之更新，造成知识状态与判断的失同步，进而影响选择性生成、检索触发与模型路由等下游功能。
AI.method: 将功能性与主观体验相区分的FoK形式化，设计两个可训练通道：知识通道（改变可回答性）与FoK通道（判断当前知识状态）；三阶段训练：OP-SFT（用修正后的on-policy答案更新知识）、KΔ-FT（在中间知识状态下适配判断）、FGPO（FoK引导的策略优化，训练后续回答或解释）。
AI.result: 在事实问答实验、跨数据集评估以及三次连续更新中，显式FoK对齐提升了模型在更新知识上的判断质量；MMLU与ARC-Easy分别验证了能力保持情况。
AI.conclusion: 知识更新与知识判断需显式解耦并分别对齐，FoK通道的显式对齐可在不损害通用能力的前提下改善更新后知识上的判断质量。

title: Reconstruction-Based Diagnosis through Gödel-Regularized Virtual Observability
summary: Not every component in a technical system can be equipped with sensors. Hence, when a fault occurs, available sensors often detect it only after its effects have propagated. This makes the isolation of faults difficult. We approach this problem by introducing virtual sensors. For each combination of component and fault type, we let external knowledge describe the fault-sensitive variables. We introduce a novel neural observer that is only trained on normal data. For fault isolation, it uses available sensor measurements where it is possible and reconstructs missing variables as virtual sensors to predict normal behavior. It detects deviations between current values and nominal predictions and computes local symptoms, which are then compared by onset time. The result is a set of root causes describing the faulty behavior. We use Gödel logic to encode physical knowledge and guide training. We evaluate our approach on synthetic networks, the Tennessee Eastman Process, and datasets of two modular production plants.

AI.tldr: 提出“虚拟传感器”概念与新型神经观测器：仅用正常数据训练，在可用测点处使用实测值、缺失处重构为虚拟传感器，计算局部症状并按起始时间比较以实现故障隔离，并用Gödel逻辑编码物理知识引导训练，在合成网络、TE过程与两套模块化生产装置数据上验证。
AI.motivation: 技术系统并非所有部件都可安装传感器，故障发生后其影响往往已传播才被可用传感器察觉，导致故障隔离困难。
AI.method: 针对每个“部件–故障类型”组合，用外部知识描述故障敏感变量；构建仅基于正常数据训练的新型神经观测器，在可测处使用实测数据、在缺失处重构虚拟传感器以预测正常行为；将当前值与标称预测的偏差转化为局部症状，按起始时间比较得到根因集合；采用Gödel逻辑编码物理知识以指导训练。
AI.result: 在合成网络、Tennessee Eastman过程以及两套模块化生产装置数据集上对所提方法进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: 基于虚拟传感器的神经观测器可在测点受限条件下实现故障隔离，并输出描述故障行为的根因集合；物理知识以Gödel逻辑形式融入训练过程。

title: SCANO: Restoring Boundary-Condition Completeness in Sampled Meshes with a Sliced-Cross-Attention Neural Operator for 3D Thermal Fields
summary: Training neural operators on million-cell meshes can exceed GPU memory limits. Models are therefore trained on subsamples and deployed on whole meshes or selected regions. However, subsampling can distort boundary information, degrading accuracy. We ask when boundary conditioning under sampling stays consistent with whole-mesh training, and how to aggregate and inject boundary data. Representing the solution as an integral of boundary data against type-dependent measures, we show that subsampling distorts this conditioning in three ways: incomplete boundary coverage or a sample-dependent global state, face weighting by count rather than area, and compression of boundary inputs into a low-dimensional vector. This analysis yields four measurable consistency conditions checkable before training. We satisfy them with two backbone-agnostic modules. Boundary Quadrature Attention (BQA) aggregates all boundary faces, typed and area-weighted, into slice tokens that every query point reads at every layer. Anchored Global State (AGS) estimates the global state from anchors independent of the sampled points. Adding both to a scalable message-passing and slice-attention backbone yields SCANO. We evaluate the approach on controlled and public benchmarks and a data-centre thermal simulation dataset (DCTS) containing million-cell meshes. On both benchmarks, BQA improves every backbone, reducing whole-mesh error up to 15-fold. On all three datasets, AGS aligns regional with whole-mesh predictions, cutting regional error at least tenfold for most backbones on the public benchmark. Together, the modules nearly halve the best original backbone's whole-mesh error on both benchmarks. SCANO predicts a room-scale field in under one second, over 100 times faster than whole-room anchor self-attention.

AI.tldr: 提出边界积分视角分析子采样下的边界条件一致性，给出四条可训练前检验的一致性条件，并用BQA与AGS两个骨干无关模块（组合为SCANO）满足它们，在百万网格上大幅降低整网格与区域误差。
AI.motivation: 百万网格规模超出GPU显存，神经算子只能先子采样训练、再在整网格或局部区域部署；子采样会扭曲边界信息导致精度下降。论文要回答：子采样下的边界条件何时与整网格训练一致，以及如何聚合与注入边界数据。
AI.method: 将解表示为边界数据对类型相关测度的积分，指出子采样造成三类扭曲：边界覆盖不完整或依赖样本的全局状态、按面数而非面积加权、边界输入被压缩为低维向量；由此导出四条训练前可检验的度量型一致性条件。对应模块：BQA将所有边界面按类型、按面积加权聚合为slice token，供每个查询点在每层读取；AGS由锚点估计与采样点无关的全局状态。二者加入可扩展消息传递+slice-attention骨干得到SCANO。
AI.result: 在受控与公开基准及含百万网格的数据中心热仿真数据集DCTS上评估：BQA对每个骨干均有提升，整网格误差最多降低15倍；AGS使区域预测与整网格预测一致，在公开基准上多数骨干区域误差至少降低十倍；两模块合用使最佳原骨干的整网格误差近乎减半；SCANO一秒内预测房间尺度场，比全房间锚点自注意力快100倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 边界条件的子采样一致性可被显式刻画并预先检验；类型化面积加权的全边界聚合与锚点全局状态是两个通用、可插拔的修正手段，能在不依赖具体骨干的前提下显著改善大网格神经算子的整网格与区域精度及推理效率。

title: Gradient-Guided Orientation Learning for Weakly Supervised Oriented Object Detection
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 10 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables
summary: Weakly supervised oriented object detection (WS-OOD) aims to reduce the annotation cost of rotated bounding boxes by leveraging cheaper annotations such as horizontal boxes or points. However, these weak annotations provide no explicit orientation information, forcing existing methods to infer object angles through indirect geometric consistency or equivariant constraints. Such indirect supervision often becomes ambiguous and unstable under real-world appearance variations, including illumination changes, color shifts, shadows, and background clutter. In this paper, we present a simple yet effective gradient-guided orientation learning strategy for WS-OOD. Motivated by the observation that the input image itself contains useful orientation priors, our method extracts dominant gradient-based orientation cues from object regions and converts them into pseudo-angle labels for auxiliary supervision, enabling the detector to learn orientation-aware representations without requiring rotated bounding box annotations or extra learnable parameters. Furthermore, since AP can mask substantial angular errors when spatial IoU remains high, we introduce an orientation-aware evaluation metric that incorporates angular discrepancies into the standard AP protocol. Extensive experiments on weakly supervised oriented detection benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed pseudo-angle supervision improves both detection performance and orientation estimation quality, while the proposed metric provides a more faithful assessment of angle prediction than conventional AP alone.

AI.tldr: 提出梯度引导的朝向学习策略：从目标区域提取梯度主方向生成伪角度标签作辅助监督，并引入融合角度偏差的朝向感知评测指标。
AI.motivation: 弱监督旋转目标检测（WS-OOD）仅有水平框或点标注，缺乏显式朝向信息，现有方法依赖间接几何一致性或等变约束推断角度，在光照变化、色偏、阴影、背景杂乱等外观变化下易歧义且不稳定。
AI.method: 基于"输入图像本身蕴含朝向先验"的观察，从目标区域提取主导梯度方向线索，转化为伪角度标签用于辅助监督，使检测器获得朝向感知表征，且无需旋转框标注与额外可学习参数；同时因AP在高IoU下会掩盖显著角度误差，提出将角度差异纳入标准AP流程的朝向感知评测指标。
AI.result: 在弱监督旋转检测基准上的大量实验表明，伪角度监督同时提升检测性能与朝向估计质量；所提指标相比单一AP能更真实地反映角度预测水平。
AI.conclusion: 梯度先验可作为廉价有效的角度监督信号，弥补弱标注的朝向信息缺失；配合朝向敏感的评价协议，可更完整地衡量WS-OOD的方向预测能力。

title: Heads That Write, Not Just Point: Image Retrieval Heads in Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) can process interleaved text and multiple images in a single context, but how they internally identify the image relevant to a question remains poorly understood. We study this grounding step as in-context image retrieval and introduce ICIR-MCQ, a controlled probe for head-level analysis of image retrieval. Using each head's attention mass over image-token spans, we first identify sparse pointer heads that reliably point to the target image. These heads transfer beyond the probe: a single pointer head is competitive with external vision-language retrievers on a naturalistic multi-image retrieval benchmark, showing that LVLMs contain a strong internal image retrieval signal. Attention alone, however, shows where a head reads from, not what its output passes on to later layers, so we introduce a complementary output-side analysis. For each head, we train a lightweight image retriever on its value-weighted output and use it to identify writer heads, whose outputs contain enough information to identify the target image. Surprisingly, the pointer and writer criteria select substantially different head sets, with only 35 to 47 heads overlapping among the top-100 heads under each criterion. Targeted set-partition ablations show that the heads most important for standard multi-image inference are concentrated in this pointer-writer intersection, while heads selected by only one criterion show less consistent separation from random-head controls. The most consistent causal effects arise from heads selected by both the attention-based pointer and output-side writer criteria. Code and data: https://github.com/parkquasar/Image-Retrieval-Heads.

AI.tldr: 将LVLM多图问答中的"定位相关图像"步骤形式化为上下文图像检索，提出ICIR-MCQ探针，发现注意力层面的pointer heads与输出层面的writer heads仅部分重叠，而二者交集才是多图推理因果上最关键的头。
AI.motivation: LVLM可在单一上下文中处理交错文本与多张图像，但其内部如何识别与问题相关的图像尚不清楚，缺乏头级别的可控分析手段。
AI.method: 构建ICIR-MCQ受控探针；用各头对图像token span的注意力质量识别稀疏pointer heads；另用每个头的值加权输出训练轻量图像检索器以识别writer heads；再做定向集合划分消融（set-partition ablation）并与随机头对照。
AI.result: 单一pointer head在自然多图检索基准上与外部视觉-语言检索器相当；pointer与writer判据选出的头集差异显著，top-100中仅35–47个重叠；多图推理最重要的头集中于二者交集，仅满足单一判据的头与随机对照区分度较弱。
AI.conclusion: LVLM内部存在强图像检索信号；注意力"读哪里"与输出"传什么"是互补视角，因果效应最一致地来自pointer∩writer头，提示头级机制分析需同时考虑注意力与输出两条路径。

title: Spatial Memory for AR Glasses: Hierarchical Visual Acquisition and Source-Linked Recall
summary: We present a spatial-memory system that enables optical see-through AR glasses to recall earlier physical encounters. The dual-camera prototype combines hierarchical visual acquisition with source-linked storage and staged retrieval. Quality screen-ing, global and regional appearance novelty, and temporal support select monochrome observations for detailed RGB cap-ture. Semantic observations retain links to their source images, allowing retrieval to answer indexed historical questions direct-ly or inspect visual details omitted from scene descriptions. The architecture separates capture acceptance, interpretation out-come, and support for a particular question. This distinction motivates two core control mechanisms: bounded reassessment of familiar views when earlier processing leaves an evidence gap, and retention guided by source dependencies. In a 131.35 s egocentric replay, the implemented acquisition policy selected six RGB views from 648 monitoring observations, while feature extraction ran on 97.7% of observations. These results demon-strate selective RGB acquisition and identify frequent local inference as a remaining cost. Exposure duration and cross-view timing further constrain the evidence preserved from se-lected encounters. The system provides a practical acquisition-to-recall architecture for persistent AR assistance, with explicit boundaries between captured evidence, indexed interpretations, and supported historical claims.

AI.tldr: 提出面向光学透视AR眼镜的空间记忆系统，融合分层视觉采集、源关联存储与分阶段检索，实现选择性RGB采集与历史场景召回。
AI.motivation: 使光学透视AR眼镜能够"回忆"此前的物理遭遇，为持续性AR辅助提供从采集到召回的实用架构，并明确区分已采集证据、索引化解读与可支撑的历史主张之间的边界。
AI.method: 双摄像头原型：以质量筛选、全局与区域外观新颖性及时间支撑从单色观测中挑选候选，触发详细RGB采集；语义观测保留指向源图像的链接，检索时可直接回答带索引的历史性问题或调取场景描述中省略的视觉细节。架构上将采集接受、解读结果与对特定问题的支撑三者分离，并据此设计两项控制机制：(1) 当先前处理留下证据缺口时，对熟悉视图进行有界重新评估；(2) 由源依赖关系引导的记忆保留。
AI.result: 在131.35秒自我中心回放中，采集策略从648次监测观测中选出6个RGB视图，特征提取覆盖97.7%的观测，验证了选择性RGB采集的可行性；同时识别出高频本地推理是残留开销，曝光时长与跨视图时序进一步限制所保留的证据。
AI.conclusion: 系统为持续性AR辅助提供了可落地的"采集—召回"架构，并明确界定了采集证据、索引解读与受支撑历史陈述三者之间的边界；未来需要关注本地推理成本及采集时序对证据完整性的约束。

title: CAPSkip: Cancellation-Aware Prefix Skipping for Selective Backpropagation
summary: Per-step selective back-propagation forwards every example of a mini-batch but back-propagates only some of them. Most rules rank examples by loss or gradient magnitude, but such scalar scores ignore cancellation between per-example gradients: the gradient removed by a set can be much smaller than its individual magnitudes suggest. We introduce CAPSkip (Cancellation-Aware Prefix Skipping). Among the examples the model already classifies correctly, CAPSkip skips the longest prefix, in increasing order of last-layer gradient norm, whose vector sum stays within a relative budget $b$ of the batch's last-layer gradient. In exact arithmetic this bounds the change of the raw final-layer gradient, using rank-one contributions already available from the forward pass; the bound does not extend to deeper layers, optimizer updates, or the training trajectory. Because the cumulative distortion is not monotone in the prefix length, CAPSkip scans all prefixes; a factorised Gram matrix makes the scan cheap and keeps it on the device. With activation reuse and selected-row backward, CAPSkip fine-tunes DeiT-S on CIFAR-100 for 103 epochs in 0.576x the time of 103-epoch dense training, and is +0.25 pp [+0.08, +0.42] above an approximately time-matched 59-epoch dense run (n=3).

AI.tldr: CAPSkip（Cancellation-Aware Prefix Skipping）一种感知梯度抵消的前缀跳过规则：在已正确分类的样本中按末层梯度范数升序跳过最长前缀，使被跳过样本梯度向量和不超过批次末层梯度的相对预算 b；比基于标量分数的规则更合理。在 DeiT-S/CIFAR-100 上以 0.576x 时间完成 103 epoch 微调，并优于约等时的 59 epoch 稠密训练 +0.25 pp。
AI.motivation: 逐样本选择性反向传播通常按 loss 或梯度的标量幅值排序样本，但标量分数忽略了样本间梯度的相互抵消：一组样本的合力可能远小于各自幅值之和，导致被跳过的信息量被高估或低估，需要一种能刻画"净移除梯度"的选择准则。
AI.method: 仅考虑模型已正确分类的样本，按其末层（last-layer）梯度范数升序排列；在此顺序下扫描所有前缀，选取满足"前缀梯度向量和不超过批次末层梯度的相对预算 b"的最长前缀进行跳过。由于累积失真是前缀长度的非单调函数，不能二分截断，需枚举全部前缀；通过因子化 Gram 矩阵（利用前向传播已获得的 rank-one 贡献）使扫描代价低廉并保持在设备端完成。结合激活复用与选行反向（selected-row backward）实现加速。理论上仅在精确算术下界定了末层原始梯度的变化，该界不延伸至更深层、优化器更新或训练轨迹。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-100 上微调 DeiT-S，103 epoch 耗时约为 103 epoch 稠密训练的 0.576x；在时间大致匹配条件下，相比 59 epoch 稠密训练提升 +0.25 pp（95% CI [+0.08, +0.42]，n=3）。
AI.conclusion: 以向量和的抵消感知准则替代标量幅值排序，可在近似保持末层梯度质量的前提下显著减少反向计算量，取得实际墙钟加速与精度收益；但理论保证仅限末层原始梯度，深层与优化动态层面的影响尚无保证，属经验性验证。

title: Polyp Matching Using Deep Learning
summary: A key challenge in colon capsule endoscopy (CCE) analysis is accurately identifying whether multiple images depict the same polyp, which is critical to avoid over-counting and unnecessary clinical interventions. Additionally, this prevents prolonged follow-up colonoscopies where endoscopists search for duplicate polyps without precise localization. This study presents a novel contrastive learning-based approach to polyp matching using a Siamese neural network architecture. The model was trained on a dataset from the Danish CareForColon2015 trial. The dataset comprises 5,103 image pairs of confirmed same polyp and 5,103 pairs of different polyps, annotated by experienced clinicians. The proposed model employs ResNet variants (ResNet18, ResNet34, ResNet50), DenseNet121 and EfficientNet B0/B3 as backbones and utilizes contrastive learning with cosine vector distance metric for classification. Experimental results demonstrate high classification accuracies of up to 92% and AUC values close to 0.98.
