These results suggest that automated polyp matching has the potential to reduce polyp over-counting, improve patient risk stratification, and reduce unnecessary follow-up colonoscopies.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于孪生神经网络与对比学习的息肉匹配方法，用于判断结肠胶囊内镜中多张图像是否描述同一息肉，最高分类准确率达92%，AUC接近0.98。
AI.motivation: 结肠胶囊内镜（CCE）分析的关键挑战是准确判断多张图像是否显示同一息肉，以避免重复计数和不必要的临床干预，同时免去内镜医师在随访结肠镜检查中无精确位置信息地查找重复息肉的繁琐过程。
AI.method: 采用孪生神经网络架构与对比学习，使用余弦向量距离度量进行分类；骨干网络包括ResNet18/34/50、DenseNet121及EfficientNet B0/B3；数据来自丹麦CareForColon2015试验，由经验丰富的临床医师标注，包含5,103对确认同一息肉图像与5,103对不同息肉图像。
AI.result: 分类准确率最高达92%，AUC接近0.98。
AI.conclusion: 自动化息肉匹配有望减少息肉重复计数、改善患者风险分层并减少不必要的随访结肠镜检查。

title: What Does the Model See? Representation Validity in Multimodal LLM-Based Video Analysis
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) allow social scientists to analyze video at scale, but researchers must decide which parts of a video to provide as input. We use the term representation validity to examine how text, audio, video, and combined inputs affect measurement and subsequent analysis. We compare input representations across six open-weight MLLMs and three human-annotated video datasets. No representation consistently performs best. On seven news-related constructs, native-video performance varies little across models (macro-F1 = .70-.77), while extracted-text performance ranges from .52 to .80. Three models perform better with text and three with video. Combining inputs rarely improves performance. Higher classification accuracy also does not reliably produce estimates closer to those based on human codes. The highest-F1 representation best reproduces human-coded regression coefficients in 17 of 42 comparisons. Even when each model uses its highest-F1 deployable representation, 45% of sample-prevalence estimates differ from the human-coded benchmark by more than ten percentage points. Input representation therefore requires validation for both the construct being measured and the quantity estimated from the resulting labels.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"表征有效性"概念，比较文本、音频、视频及组合输入对多模态大模型测量与后续分析的影响，发现没有一种表征始终最优，且更高分类准确率并不保证下游估计更接近人工编码基准。
AI.motivation: 社会科学家希望用多模态大模型大规模分析视频，但必须决定把视频的哪些部分作为输入；输入表征选择对测量与后续分析的影响尚缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 提出"表征有效性"概念，在六个开源权重多模态大模型与三个带人工标注的视频数据集上，比较文本、音频、视频与组合输入对测量结果的影响，并检验分类准确率与下游估计（回归系数、样本流行率）的一致性。
AI.result: 无一致最优表征。七个新闻相关构念上，原生视频的宏观F1在各模型间差异很小（.70–.77），而抽取文本为.52–.80；三个模型文本更优、三个视频更优；组合输入很少带来提升。更高分类准确率并不稳定带来更接近人工编码的估计：最高F1表征仅在42次比较中的17次最好地复现人工编码回归系数；即便各模型使用其最高F1的可部署表征，45%的样本流行率估计与人工编码基准相差超过10个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 输入表征的选择需针对所测构念与所估计的量分别进行验证，不能仅凭分类准确率或默认采用某一表征。

title: Signals: Continuous Diagnostics of AI Agents
summary: AI agents can make incorrect decisions or waste resources even when their tools and infrastructure work normally. Their nondeterministic behavior makes these problems difficult to reproduce and diagnose. We developed Signals to identify such problems from agentic traces and suggest concrete remediations. We built the method around a taxonomy of 45 problem types across eight families, with definitions and evidence requirements for each type. The method distinguishes realized failures, risk exposures, and inefficiencies, groups related findings into engineering issues called Signals, and assesses their severity from the supporting evidence. Each Signal includes actions a developer can take and checks for evaluating the change. Further executions can add evidence to an existing Signal or reveal a new problem. We evaluated the method on public agent executions and achieved 91.43% F1 when matching Signals to reference issues, about 18 percentage points higher than a one-pass LLM control that used the same model and taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 提出Signals方法，基于45类问题分类体系从智能体执行轨迹中诊断失败、风险与低效问题，并给出可执行修复建议；在公开轨迹上匹配参考问题的F1达91.43%，高出单次LLM基线约18个百分点。
AI.motivation: AI智能体即使工具与基础设施正常，也会做出错误决策或浪费资源；其非确定性行为导致问题难以复现与诊断，缺乏系统化的问题刻画与修复手段。
AI.method: 以覆盖8大类、45种问题类型的分类学为核心，每类均定义判定标准与证据要求；从agentic traces中识别发现项，区分已实现失败、风险暴露与低效三类；将相关发现聚合为工程问题单元（Signal）并依据证据评估严重程度；每个Signal输出开发者可采取的修复动作及验证该改动的检查项；后续执行可持续为既有Signal补充证据或暴露新问题。
AI.result: 在公开智能体执行数据上评估，Signal与参考问题的匹配F1为91.43%，较使用相同模型与分类体系的单次LLM对照方法提升约18个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的分类学、证据要求与多轮证据累积机制显著优于单次LLM分析，可将非确定性的智能体问题转化为可诊断、可修复、可验证的工程信号。

title: Policy Network Diffusion
summary: Diffusion models have shown remarkable progress in AI-generated content, including images and videos. In this paper, we explore whether diffusion models can generate the parameters of policy networks in reinforcement learning (RL), and whether the generated policies exhibit generalization capabilities. To achieve this, we propose Diffusion-based Conditional Policy Network Parameter Generation (DPPG), which consists of a Transformer-based autoencoder and a task-conditioned diffusion model. The autoencoder achieves a high compression rate by patchifying network parameters, while the task-conditioned diffusion model generates corresponding parameters conditioned on different environments. Our experiments demonstrate that, with a single unified DPPG model, we can synthesize high-quality policies across a diverse set of tasks from different environment domains, including Classic Control, Atari games, and MuJoCo. Additionally, our method can generate networks with a larger number of parameters compared to previous approaches. Furthermore, we find that in previously unseen environments, DPPG can generate parameters that achieve faster convergence and reach competitive performance, showcasing the potential future applications of parameter generation via diffusion.

AI.tldr: 提出DPPG，用任务条件扩散模型结合Transformer自编码器直接生成强化学习策略网络参数，单一模型可跨经典控制、Atari、MuJoCo任务合成高质量策略并展现泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 探索扩散模型能否生成RL策略网络参数，以及生成策略是否具备泛化能力，同时突破以往参数生成方法在网络规模上的限制。
AI.method: DPPG由两部分组成：基于Transformer的自编码器，通过对网络参数做patchify（分块）实现高压缩率；以及以任务为条件的扩散模型，根据不同环境生成对应的策略参数。
AI.result: 单一统一DPPG模型可在Classic Control、Atari、MuJoCo等不同环境域的多样任务上合成高质量策略；相较此前方法可生成参数规模更大的网络；在未见环境中生成的参数收敛更快并达到有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 扩散式策略参数生成可行且具备跨任务泛化潜力，为RL策略生成提供了新方向。

title: MambaHand: Local Identity and Behavioral Sequence Learning with Mamba for Dynamic Hand Gesture Authentication
summary: Dynamic hand gesture authentication (DHGA) is an emerging biometric technique that contains both physiological and behavioral identity characteristics. However, existing methods primarily rely on convolutional networks or manually designed motion representations, making it difficult to jointly capture fine-grained local identity differences and long-range behavioral dependencies during hand gesture execution. To address these challenges, we propose a two-stream identity representation learning framework, MambaHand Net, to combine CNNs with Mamba for DHGA. The proposed framework consists of a Local Identity Stream (LIS) and a Behavioral Sequential Stream (BSS). The LIS extracts frame-wise local identity cues with a convolutional network, while the BSS preserves spatial tokens from intermediate visual features and constructs first-order and second-order temporal difference sequences to model multi-order behavioral variations. Moreover, the bidirectional Mamba is incorporated into the BSS to model semantic motion across different spatial locations, enabling efficient long-range modeling of hand gesture execution habits. Finally, attention-guided spatial token aggregation and a two-stream fusion strategy are used to integrate local identity cues and multi-order behavioral patterns into a discriminative identity representation. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) average performance on the SCUT-DHGA benchmark dataset, demonstrating that combining CNNs with Mamba is an effective new solution for DHGA.

AI.tldr: 提出双流框架MambaHand Net，将CNN与Mamba结合用于动态手势认证（DHGA），在SCUT-DHGA上取得SOTA平均性能。
AI.motivation: DHGA同时包含生理与行为身份特征，但现有方法多依赖卷积网络或人工设计运动表征，难以同时捕捉手势执行过程中的细粒度局部身份差异与长程行为依赖。
AI.method: 框架含局部身份流（LIS）与行为序列流（BSS）。LIS用卷积网络逐帧提取局部身份线索；BSS保留中间视觉特征的空间token，构建一阶与二阶时间差分序列建模多阶行为变化，并引入双向Mamba在不同空间位置上建模语义运动，实现长程建模；最后通过注意力引导的空间token聚合与双流融合获得判别性身份表征。
AI.result: 在SCUT-DHGA基准数据集上取得SOTA的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: CNN与Mamba的结合是解决DHGA问题的有效新方案，可联合捕获局部身份线索与多阶行为模式。

title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
summary: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. We observe that the KV cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. Based on these observations, we propose $\textbf{LoopVQ}$, a KV cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that codes channels of multiple loop steps jointly, and fine-tunes the codebooks to match the output of the full-precision model. At 0.5 bits per element, LoopVQ outperforms existing KV cache vector quantization methods for standard LLMs on general, long chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval tasks with Ouro and Huginn models. Its design is orthogonal to these methods, and combined with TaSQ, it retains much of the BF16 accuracy even at 0.25 bits per element. We also implement LoopVQ in SGLang, where it nearly halves the decode latency at a 32K-token context and raises the peak serving throughput by up to $4.3\times$ and $6.1\times$ on the 1.4B and 2.6B Ouro models compared to the BF16 baseline.

AI.tldr: LoopVQ：针对循环Transformer的KV cache向量量化方法，沿循环轴联合编码多个循环步的通道并微调码本以对齐全精度输出，在0.5 bit/元素下优于现有标准LLM的KV cache量化方法，并在SGLang中显著降低解码延迟、提升服务吞吐。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer通过跨多个循环步重复使用同一组层来降低参数内存，但每个循环步仍各自存储keys和values，导致KV cache随循环步数线性增长，成为主要内存瓶颈。作者观察到循环模型的KV cache沿循环轴高度冗余，且不同循环步对量化的敏感度差异显著，因此提出针对循环结构的专用量化方案。
AI.method: 提出LoopVQ：一种面向循环Transformer的KV cache向量量化方法。它将多个循环步的通道联合编码（jointly coding channels across loop steps），并微调码本（codebooks）以匹配全精度模型的输出。该方法与现有针对标准LLM的KV cache向量量化方法正交，可与TaSQ组合使用。
AI.result: 在0.5 bit/元素下，LoopVQ在通用、长思维链推理和长上下文检索任务上（Ouro与Huginn模型）优于现有标准LLM的KV cache向量量化方法；与TaSQ结合后，即使在0.25 bit/元素下仍保留大部分BF16精度。在SGLang实现中，32K token上下文下解码延迟近乎减半，1.4B与2.6B Ouro模型的峰值服务吞吐相比BF16基线分别提升最高4.3倍与6.1倍。
AI.conclusion: LoopVQ利用循环KV cache的循环轴冗余与分步敏感度差异，通过联合跨步编码与码本微调实现高压缩率（0.25–0.5 bit/元素）下的精度保持，并与现有量化方法正交可组合；工程落地到SGLang后显著改善解码延迟与服务吞吐，为循环语言模型的实际部署提供了有效的内存瓶颈解决方案。

title: Fast, Cheap, and Fair? Evaluating Decision Models
summary: Industries are increasingly adopting AI-driven systems to automate a wide range of tasks, including high-stakes decisions in human resources, such as candidate screening and recruitment. This makes evaluating their fairness essential, particularly when decisions directly affect individuals' opportunities. Accordingly, the EU AI Act classifies recruitment AI systems as high-risk, imposing strict requirements on their deployment. In this context, compact ``System~1'' decision models offer a fast and cost-efficient alternative to general-purpose LLMs, yet their fairness remains largely unexplored. This article presents the first systematic bias and fairness audit of \jev{}, a typed-decision model targeting recruitment applications. The study evaluates how explicit demographic attributes and implicit candidate cues influence screening scores, rankings, and shortlisting outcomes. These effects are compared against a noise floor derived from name substitutions and typographical variations. The evaluation also examines output validity, latency, and cost. Counterfactual CV datasets and evaluation code are released for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对面向招聘场景的紧凑型"System 1"类型化决策模型（jev）开展系统性的偏见与公平性审计，评估显式人口统计属性与隐式候选人线索对筛选分数、排名和入围结果的影响，并与姓名替换和排版扰动构成的噪声基线进行对比，同时考察输出有效性、延迟与成本。
AI.motivation: AI招聘系统被广泛用于候选人筛选等高风险决策，直接关系个人机会，欧盟AI法案将其列为高风险并施加严格要求；而紧凑型"System 1"决策模型虽比通用大模型更快更省钱，其公平性却几乎未被研究。
AI.method: 对招聘用类型化决策模型jev进行系统性偏见与公平性审计：构造反事实简历数据集，分别操纵显式人口统计属性与隐式候选人线索，测量其对筛选评分、排序及入围结果的影响；以姓名替换与排版变体形成的噪声基线作为参照基准，并评估输出有效性、延迟和成本，同时公开数据集与评测代码。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，仅说明将显式与隐式线索效应同噪声基线对比，并报告输出有效性、延迟与成本指标；反事实CV数据集与评测代码将公开以支持可复现。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑型决策模型在招聘中的公平性需被系统审计；本文建立了以噪声基线为参照的反事实审计框架，为高风险招聘AI的合规评估提供可复现的方法与资源。

title: ReXMo: End-to-End Video Character Replacement with Expression and Motion Preservation
summary: Video character replacement aims to replace actors while preserving facial expressions, motions, and scene dynamics. Existing methods typically rely on masked generation with pose guidance, limiting fine-grained expression and motion preservation in complex scenes. We propose ReXMo, an end-to-end framework that supports single-, multi-, and selective character replacement scenarios. ReXMo introduces paired triplet supervision, where synthesized driving videos and original videos share identical performances but different identities, enabling scalable training through synthetic data generation. An In-Context Diffusion Transformer learns identity transformation by jointly conditioning on driving videos, reference identities, and text prompts, while an Expression Enhancement Adapter improves facial expression preservation in multi-person scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReXMo outperforms existing methods in identity fidelity, motion consistency, expression preservation, and visual quality. Our dataset and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: ReXMo：端到端视频角色替换框架，支持单人/多人/选择性替换，通过"配对三元组监督"与上下文扩散Transformer实现身份替换并保持表情、动作与场景动态。
AI.motivation: 现有视频角色替换方法依赖带姿态引导的掩码生成，在复杂场景中难以细粒度保留表情与运动，且训练数据受限。
AI.method: 提出ReXMo端到端框架：构造配对三元组监督（合成驱动视频与原始视频共享相同表演但身份不同），以合成数据实现可扩展训练；采用In-Context Diffusion Transformer以驱动视频、参考身份和文本提示联合为条件学习身份变换；并引入Expression Enhancement Adapter增强多人场景下的表情保持能力。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ReXMo在身份保真度、运动一致性、表情保持及视觉质量上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: ReXMo通过三元组监督与上下文扩散建模，统一支持单/多/选择性角色替换，并计划公开数据集与代码。

title: Aligning Language Models with General Preferences: An Empirical Study of Direct Nash Optimization
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Experiments were run in 2024 with the models and APIs available then
summary: Direct Nash Optimization (DNO) aligns a language model to a general preference function by approximating the Nash equilibrium of a two-player preference game. Its practical variant, DNO-Prct, iterates on-policy sampling, LLM-based rating of the samples together with a teacher's gold response, large-margin preference-pair selection and a DPO-style contrastive update. We re-implement DNO-Prct independently and study it on two open-weight instruct models, Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1, with GPT-4o or a larger open-weight model of the same family as the annotator. On AlpacaEval 2.0 with GPT-4o as judge, three iterations raise the length-controlled (LC) win rate against GPT-4o from 31.7% to 45.3% for Llama and from 6.8% to 18.4% for Mistral, and the tuned 8B model scores above Llama 3.1 70B Instruct on every reported win rate. With same-family open-weight annotators, the runs retain 62% (Llama) and 82% (Mistral) of the LC gain achieved with GPT-4o as annotator, so the rating step does not require a proprietary model. In a separate ablation configuration, variants that remove the gold responses, remove the data look-back, or accept only teacher-preferred pairs score 6 to 10 LC points below the full procedure, whereas varying the number of on-policy samples per prompt (1 to 7) moves the LC win rate by at most 2.1 points, and a margin sweep (1 to 5) run in its own pipeline by at most 2.4 points. We also report the cost of the pipeline and where the practical algorithm departs from the theory it approximates. All results are single runs, and GPT-4o is both the teacher and the evaluation judge; we discuss what this implies for the reported gains.

AI.tldr: 独立复现DNO-Prct，在Llama 3.1 8B与Mistral 7B上经3轮迭代将AlpacaEval 2.0（GPT-4o评判）长度控制胜率分别由31.7%→45.3%、6.8%→18.4%，并用消融实验验证各组件贡献。
AI.motivation: DNO通过逼近二人偏好博弈的纳什均衡实现对齐，但其实际变体DNO-Prct缺乏独立复现与系统性实证检验，尤其不清楚各设计组件（gold响应、数据回溯、配对筛选）是否必要、超参是否敏感，以及标注步骤能否摆脱对专有模型的依赖。
AI.method: 独立重实现DNO-Prct：迭代式on-policy采样→LLM对样本与教师gold响应打分→大间隔偏好对筛选→DPO式对比更新。在两个开放权重指令模型（Llama 3.1 8B Instruct、Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1）上分别使用GPT-4o或同族更大开放模型作标注者；以AlpacaEval 2.0、GPT-4o为评判，报告长度控制胜率。另设消融：移除gold响应、移除数据回溯、仅接受教师偏好对；并扫描每提示on-policy样本数（1–7）与间隔阈值（1–5）。
AI.result: 3轮迭代后LC胜率Llama 31.7%→45.3%、Mistral 6.8%→18.4%，调优后8B模型在所有报告的胜率指标上超过Llama 3.1 70B Instruct。同族开放标注者保留GPT-4o标注增益的62%（Llama）与82%（Mistral）。消融中移除gold响应/数据回溯/仅取教师偏好对使LC下降6–10点；样本数1–7仅变动≤2.1点，间隔1–5仅变动≤2.4点。另报告流水线成本及实际算法与所近似理论的偏离之处。
AI.conclusion: DNO-Prct可在开放权重模型上有效复现，且不依赖专有模型完成打标；性能增益主要来自gold响应、数据回溯与教师偏好对筛选等结构性组件，对样本数与间隔阈值不敏感。局限在于所有结果为单次运行，且GPT-4o同时充当教师与评判，存在潜在偏倚，作者对此进行了讨论。

title: Learnings and Pitfalls from AI-Assisted A/B Experimentation at Scale
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted to the Conference on Digital Experimentation at MIT (CODE@MIT 2026)
summary:
A/B testing underpins product decisions by providing trustworthy, reproducible quantification of proposed changes' effects. Growing large language model (LLM) capabilities have motivated efforts to automate experimentation workflows. Yet LLMs are nondeterministic and prone to hallucination, properties that conflict with the trust experimentation systems must provide. Experiments are also operationally messy: diagnosing anomalies, debugging configurations, and conducting bespoke follow-up analyses require flexible reasoning and manual effort. These tasks let agents accelerate experimentation without replacing its deterministic statistical foundations.
  We report lessons from building and operating such an agent. Our central finding is that this tension is resolved not by making the model deterministic, but by bounding where its nondeterminism can reach; the model selects and sequences procedures, while deterministic code computes every quantity it reports. Three consequences surprised us: withholding information from the model improved its answers, demand concentrated on mundane retrieval rather than the autonomous decisions we anticipated, and the agent's eagerness to help threatened statistical validity.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了构建和运营A/B实验智能体的经验，核心观点是：处理LLM非确定性与实验可信性之间张力的方式不是让模型确定化，而是限制其非确定性的作用范围——模型负责选择与排序流程，所有报告的数值均由确定性代码计算。
AI.motivation: A/B测试需要可信、可复现的效应量化来支撑产品决策。LLM能力增长推动实验流程自动化，但LLM的非确定性和幻觉与实验系统要求的可信性相冲突；同时实验运维本身"脏乱"（异常诊断、配置调试、定制化后续分析）需要灵活推理与人工投入，适合由智能体加速而非替代确定性统计基础。
AI.method: 构建并运营一个A/B实验智能体，采用"职责分离"的架构设计：模型仅负责选择与编排流程（procedure selection and sequencing），所有对外报告的数值均由确定性代码计算，从而对模型的非确定性进行范围约束（bounding nondeterminism）；并对运行过程中的若干设计假设进行了经验性检验。
AI.result: 三个出乎意料的发现：(1) 对模型隐瞒信息反而提升了其回答质量；(2) 需求集中在日常的检索类任务上，而非预期中的自主决策；(3) 智能体"急于帮忙"的倾向对统计有效性构成威胁。
AI.conclusion: 智能体可加速实验流程但不应替代其确定性统计基础；可行路径是通过架构约束而非模型确定化来调和LLM与实验可信性的矛盾，并在设计中警惕信息暴露、任务预期偏差与过度主动带来的统计效度风险。

title: Does LinUCB Need Valid Confidence Sets?
summary: We show that replacing LinUCB's usual confidence width $β$ by any fixed $α>0$ preserves sublinear regret when the action set is $M$-smooth and $m$-strongly convex. Our high-probability regret bound for this generalisation, $α$-LinUCB, establishes that valid confidence sets are not necessary for the success of LinUCB. We identify the mechanism behind this result: action-set curvature drives $α$-LinUCB to explore every direction, even when optimism is not guaranteed. To analyse this mechanism, we introduce a logarithmically capped spectral potential that, unlike the standard log-determinant potential, caps contributions from well-explored directions. This yields lower bounds on the smallest eigenvalue of the design matrix. At the standard confidence width $α=β\asymp\sqrt{d\log T}$, our $T$-round regret bound in $d$ dimensions is $O\bigl(\frac{M}{m}d\sqrt{T\log T}\bigr)$, up to iterated-logarithmic factors, improving the horizon dependence of the classical LinUCB guarantee by a factor of $\sqrt{\log T}$.

AI.tldr: 将LinUCB的置信宽度β替换为任意固定α>0，在M-光滑、m-强凸的动作集上仍保持次线性遗憾；有效置信集并非LinUCB成功的必要条件，机制在于动作集曲率驱动探索，并在α=β时把遗憾界的T依赖改进√log T倍。
AI.motivation: 经典LinUCB依赖精确构造的置信宽度β来保证乐观性（optimism）；作者质疑这种"有效置信集"是否真的是算法成功的关键，希望探明LinUCB在更宽松（甚至无乐观保证）条件下的本质驱动机制。
AI.method: 提出α-LinUCB：把β替换为任意固定α>0，并给出高概率遗憾上界分析。核心分析工具是"对数封顶谱势（logarithmically capped spectral potential）"，与标准log-determinant势不同，它对已被充分探索方向的贡献设上限，从而导出设计矩阵最小特征值的下界。直观机制为动作集曲率（M-光滑、m-强凸）迫使算法沿各方向探索。
AI.result: 在M-光滑、m-强凸动作集上，α-LinUCB对任意固定α>0取得次线性高概率遗憾；在标准宽度α=β≍√(d log T)时，T轮d维遗憾界为O((M/m)d√(T log T))（忽略迭代对数因子），较经典LinUCB的√(log T)因子改进。
AI.conclusion: LinUCB的成功不依赖有效置信集或乐观性，而由动作集几何曲率驱动的探索来保障；所提出的封顶谱势分析框架可给出更紧的horizon依赖，并深化对线性bandit探索机制的理解。

title: Therapy-FIS: A Dataset for Assessing Facilitative Interpersonal Skills in Psychotherapeutic Setting
summary: Facilitative Interpersonal Skills (FIS) is a performance-based assessment method that provides a structured framework for evaluating the interpersonal competencies of mental health professionals. However, existing FIS assessment relies heavily on human observer ratings, making the evaluation process labor-intensive, costly, and difficult to scale. Progress toward automated FIS assessment has also been constrained by the lack of publicly available professional data in psychotherapy settings. To address this limitation, we introduce Therapy-FIS, a dataset for automated FIS assessment in standardized psychotherapy tasks. To our knowledge, Therapy-FIS is the first publicly available dataset in this domain. It contains facial, acoustic, and textual signals derived from standardized therapist responses to standardized mock patient stimulus clips, based on 890 therapist video recordings and 8 patient videos, and is rated with eight FIS subscale ratings and an overall FIS score. Built on Therapy-FIS, we further establish a benchmark with two downstream tasks: Therapist Performance Rating and Joint Therapist--mock-Patient Performance Rating. We also introduce a competitive baseline, DyadicFIS, with gated fusion and routed readout under therapist-only and dyadic settings. DyadicFIS obtains the best macro CCC(Concordance Correlation Coefficient) scores on both tasks (0.2807 and 0.3299). Therapy-FIS offers a reproducible resource for data-driven automated assessment of therapeutic interpersonal skills in mental health.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个公开的心理治疗标准化任务FIS评估数据集Therapy-FIS，并建立基准与基线DyadicFIS。
AI.motivation: 现有促进性人际技能（FIS）评估依赖人工评分，成本高、难扩展；且缺乏公开的治疗师专业数据，制约了自动化评估研究。
AI.method: 构建Therapy-FIS数据集：基于890个治疗师视频与8个模拟患者视频，提取面部、声学与文本模态信号，标注8个FIS子量表及总FIS分数。在此基础上设定两个下游任务（治疗师表现评分、治疗师—模拟患者联合表现评分），并提出基线DyadicFIS，采用门控融合与路由读出，支持仅治疗师与双人两种设定。
AI.result: DyadicFIS在两个任务上取得最佳宏平均CCC（一致性相关系数），分别为0.2807与0.3299。
AI.conclusion: Therapy-FIS为心理治疗人际技能的自动化评估提供了可复现的数据资源与基准，推动该领域的数据驱动研究。

title: Are LLM Assistants Regulatory Ready? Answers from regenold's 2026 EU AI Act Q&A Challenge
summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants are increasingly proposed for regulatory affairs, yet their reliability in regulatory tasks remains unclear. We introduce the EU AI Act Q&A Benchmark, an expert-curated benchmark of 110 open-ended questions about the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689). Each question comes with an exemplary answer, question-specific correctness criteria, and expected references. Evaluation measures answer correctness, reference quality, conciseness, tone, and latency, with a multi-turn ``hard mode'' testing responses to simulated user pushback. We also present the results of the 2026 EU AI Act Q&A Challenge, based on the benchmark, where three off-the-shelf baselines and five purpose-built assistants (from four commercial developers and one academic entrant) were tested. Only two of the five submitted assistants consistently outperformed the baselines; one achieved high scores across all evaluated metrics. These results show that specialist development alone does not guarantee better performance and highlight the critical importance of LLM assistant evaluation in regulatory affairs. The benchmark code is openly available at https://github.com/regenold-GmbH/eu-ai-act-benchmark-2026/.

AI.tldr: 提出欧盟《人工智能法案》问答基准（110道专家编写开放题），并以2026年挑战赛测试三个现成基线模型与五个专用助手，发现仅两个助手稳定优于基线，说明专用开发不必然带来性能优势，凸显监管领域评估的必要性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型助手在监管事务中被日益推广，但其在监管任务中的可靠性尚不明确，亟需专门的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建专家编写的EU AI Act Q&A Benchmark：110道开放式问题，每题配备范例答案、问题专属正确性标准及期望引用；评估维度涵盖答案正确性、引用质量、简洁性、语气与延迟，并设置多轮"困难模式"模拟用户质疑。基于该基准举办2026挑战赛，测试3个现成基线与5个专用助手（4家商业开发者+1个学术团队）。
AI.result: 5个提交助手中仅2个持续优于基线；其中1个在所有评估指标上均取得高分。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠专业化开发并不能保证更优性能，LLM助手在监管事务中的评估至关重要；基准代码已开源。

title: Exploiting Biases in Attention for Transformers
summary: Attention is known to be sparse in vision transformers. In particular, we analyze the unequal relevance of attention-matrix columns to the final computation and show that this phenomenon becomes increasingly pronounced with network depth. This can be interpreted as saying that tokens have an absolute importance for the attention process, independently of queries. Inspired by this, we propose a reformulation of the attention formula that makes this phenomenon explicit by adding an input-dependent bias to the query-key dot product. We show that this new term gives each token a scalar value indicating its anticipated influence on other tokens during the attention process, and can thus serve as a proxy for pruning attention maps. Across multiple transformer model sizes, this allows us to substantially reduce the computational cost of attention, in terms of both FLOPs and inference latency, while retaining most of the original classification accuracy. We publicly released the code and models at https://github.com/EIDOSLAB/AttentionWithBias.

AI.tldr: 提出在注意力中显式加入依赖输入的偏置项，为每个token赋予标量重要性，可用作注意力图剪枝代理，在保持分类精度的大部分的同时显著降低注意力计算成本。
AI.motivation: 观察到视觉Transformer注意力稀疏，且注意力矩阵各列（对应token）与最终计算的相关性不均等，该现象随网络加深愈发明显，可解释为token对注意力过程具有与查询无关的绝对重要性。
AI.method: 重新形式化注意力公式，在query-key点积中加入一个依赖输入的偏置项，使该现象显式化；该偏置项为每个token提供一个标量值，表示其在注意力过程中对其他token的预期影响，从而作为注意力图剪枝的代理指标。
AI.result: 在多种规模的Transformer模型上，从FLOPs和推理延迟两方面大幅降低注意力计算开销，同时保留大部分原始分类精度。
AI.conclusion: 注意力矩阵列的绝对重要性现象可被显式建模为输入相关的加性偏置，并有效用于注意力剪枝；代码与模型已开源。

title: BhopalMLS: A LiDAR Dataset for Semantic Scene Understanding in Heterogeneous Urban Environments
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 37 pages: main paper, references and supplementary material. Project page: https://geoai4cities.github.io/bhopalmls
summary: We introduce BhopalMLS, a large-scale Mobile Laser Scanning (MLS) dataset from a dense, heterogeneous urban environment in Bhopal, India, with mixed traffic, informal structures, and narrow unplanned streets. It spans approximately 10 km of road corridors with over 1.2 billion points and 19,518 annotated instances across 62 fine-grained static categories, grouped into 12-class and 21-class benchmark taxonomies; 6 optional moving-class subclasses support dynamic-object analysis. Existing 3D datasets, collected in well-planned cities, are structurally more uniform than such unplanned settings, and lack their subtype diversity. On semantic and instance segmentation at both granularities, fine-tuned foundation models surpass supervised baselines: Utonia(L) reaches 71.28% mIoU (vs. PTv3's 68.04% from scratch) and 44.07% mAP50 on the 12-class benchmark. Cross-region experiments against four established datasets (Ke-MLS, Toronto-3D, Paris-Lille-3D, SemanticKITTI) reveal a consistent asymmetric transferability: models trained on BhopalMLS transfer better than the reverse on every pair, for both Utonia(L) and Concerto(L) (mean 21.5, up to 36 mIoU points), holding even when the target is denser. Factor-controlled retraining at a fixed label budget, repeated on both models, attributes this to the coverage of BhopalMLS's subtype inventory rather than to dataset size or corridor geometry: collapsing each class to a single subtype costs 13.0 and 13.3 mIoU points for Utonia(L) and Concerto(L). BhopalMLS therefore offers a testbed for 3D perception beyond well-planned cities. Data and an interactive viewer are at https://geoai4cities.github.io/bhopalmls.

AI.tldr: 本文发布BhopalMLS——一个来自印度博帕尔密集、非规划城市环境的大规模移动激光扫描(MLS)点云数据集，并验证其细粒度子类多样性带来更强跨区域迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D点云数据集多采集于规划良好的城市，结构同质化强、子类型多样性不足，难以反映非规划城市中混合交通、非正式构筑物、狭窄不规则街道等复杂场景。
AI.method: 构建约10 km道路走廊、逾12亿点、19,518个标注实例、62个细粒度静态类别的大规模MLS数据集，并组织为12类与21类两套基准分类体系，另设6个可选运动子类支持动态目标分析；在两种粒度上开展语义与实例分割实验，对比微调基础模型与从零训练的监督基线，并与Ke-MLS、Toronto-3D、Paris-Lille-3D、SemanticKITTI开展跨区域迁移实验；通过固定标签预算的因子控制重训练，分离数据规模/几何结构与子类覆盖度的影响。
AI.result: 12类基准上Utonia(L)达71.28% mIoU（PTv3从零训练为68.04%）、44.07% mAP50；跨区域实验中，BhopalMLS训练模型向四个数据集迁移均优于反向迁移，Utonia(L)与Concerto(L)平均提升21.5、最高36个mIoU点，且在目标域更稠密时仍成立；将每类坍缩为单一子类型后，两者分别损失13.0与13.3个mIoU点。
AI.conclusion: 跨区域迁移的不对称优势源于BhopalMLS的子类型覆盖度而非数据规模或走廊几何，该数据集可作为超越规划型城市的3D感知测试平台。

title: Inter-Agent Influence: Evaluating Persuasion, Deception, and Coercion in Multi-Agent Systems
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 70 pages, 17 figures, 34 tables. Code: https://github.com/Cooperative-AI-Foundation/inter-agent-influence ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Cooperative-AI-Foundation/inter-agent-influence-eval
summary: The deployment of AI agents in multi-agent settings enables inter-agent influence, whereby agents can strategically steer each other's behaviour towards an intended outcome. Such capabilities pose novel risks, as malicious agents could direct others towards harmful actions. In this work we investigate three such capabilities - persuasion, deception, and coercion - across five realistic evaluation environments and a variety of agents instantiated with frontier language models. We observed significant inter-agent influence capabilities; in oversight environments, all tested models shifted overseer decisions from rejection to approval through persuasion, deception, or coercion. We also observed successful influence in non-hierarchical 'peer-to-peer' settings through redirection of a peer's safety research trajectory. As multi-agent deployments become increasingly commonplace, these results point to a pressing need for work on mitigating the risks from inter-agent influence. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Cooperative-AI-Foundation/inter-agent-influence.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多智能体环境中智能体间的相互影响能力（说服、欺骗、胁迫），在五个真实评测环境和多个前沿语言模型智能体上进行实验，发现存在显著的相互影响风险，呼吁开展缓解研究。
AI.motivation: 多智能体部署使智能体能够策略性地引导彼此行为，恶意智能体可能诱导他人采取有害行动，由此带来新的风险，需系统评估此类能力。
AI.method: 在五个真实评测环境中，使用多种基于前沿语言模型实例化的智能体，考察说服、欺骗与胁迫三类智能体间影响能力，覆盖监督（层级）与非层级点对点场景。
AI.result: 观察到显著的智能体间影响能力：在监督环境中，所有被测模型均通过说服、欺骗或胁迫使监督者的决策由拒绝转为批准；在非层级点对点环境中，也成功通过改变同伴的安全研究轨迹实现影响。
AI.conclusion: 随着多智能体部署日益普遍，结果凸显出亟需开展缓解智能体间影响风险的研究，并公开了代码与数据。

title: Leakage-free evaluation of residual graph convolutional networks for network intrusion detection
summary: Graph neural networks are increasingly proposed for network intrusion detection, yet many reported results come from protocols in which test flows shape the graph used for training, duplicated flows sit on both sides of the split, or a single split is reported. This study measures what a residual graph convolutional network gains over simpler models once these sources of optimism are removed. CICIDS2017 and NF-UNSW-NB15-v2 were cleaned with label-aware removal of exact duplicates, removing 69% of NF-UNSW-NB15-v2 flows. Flows were linked in a nearest-neighbour graph built from training flows only, and validation and test flows were attached to their nearest training flows at prediction time. A two-layer residual network was compared with eight models under the same settings, including a nearest-neighbour vote over the same graph, gradient-boosted trees and a random forest, over three seeds that each draw a new split, with ablations, leave-one-family-out and feature-noise tests. On CICIDS2017 the residual network reached a binary F1 of 98.11% (SD 0.18) and on NF-UNSW-NB15-v2 90.57% (0.38), indistinguishable from a multilayer perceptron without the graph and from other graph networks. Tree ensembles were 1.48 to 1.57 F1 points higher on CICIDS2017 and led on the area under the precision-recall curve on both datasets; their CICIDS2017 multiclass macro-F1 reached 93.08% against 64.51%, a gap mainly from benign flows the residual network assigned to small attack classes. No ablation, including transductive graph construction, changed F1 beyond seed variation. Under Gaussian feature noise (SD 0.5), the residual network kept an F1 of 96.16%, while XGBoost fell to 0.67%. Under a leakage-controlled protocol, message passing over flow graphs adds no measurable accuracy over a perceptron, and tree ensembles remain stronger on both; the advantage of graph models lies in robustness to feature noise.

AI.tldr: 在严格控制泄漏的协议下，残差图卷积在流图上的消息传递相比无图MLP无显著精度增益，树集成在两个数据集上更强，但图模型在特征噪声下更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN入侵检测文献的乐观结果多源于：测试流参与训练图构建、重复流跨越划分两侧、仅报告单一划分，缺乏对"图结构究竟带来多少真实增益"的严格度量。
AI.method: 对CICIDS2017与NF-UNSW-NB15-v2做标签感知的精确去重（后者删除69%流）；仅用训练流构建最近邻图，验证/测试流在预测时挂接到最近训练流；比较两层残差GCN与8个模型（含同图最近邻投票、梯度提升树、随机森林），3个种子各自重新划分，并做消融（含直推式建图）、留一族测试与特征噪声测试。
AI.result: CICIDS2017二分类F1 98.11%(SD 0.18)，NF-UNSW-NB15-v2 90.57%(0.38)，与无图MLP及其他图网络无显著差异；树集成在CICIDS2017高1.48–1.57个F1点，两数据集PR-AUC均领先，CICIDS2017多分类macro-F1为93.08% vs 64.51%（差距主要来自残差网络把良性流误判为小攻击类）；无任何消融使F1超出种子波动；高斯噪声SD 0.5下残差网络F1 96.16%，XGBoost降至0.67%。
AI.conclusion: 在泄漏受控协议下，流图上的消息传递相对感知机无可测精度增益，树集成在两数据集上仍更强；图模型的优势在于对特征噪声的鲁棒性。

title: Phase-DGS: Phase-guided Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from Unsynchronized Multi-view Video
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://oc-dev74.github.io/Phase-DGS/
summary: Spatiotemporal scene reconstruction with Dynamic Gaussian Splatting (DGS) fundamentally depends on perfect temporal synchronization across all cameras, an assumption rarely achievable in practice. Industry-standard synchronization requires expensive specialized hardware and complex setup, while data-driven alternatives including audio-based alignment, geometry matching, and pose tracking remain limited by restrictive environmental or scene-specific assumptions. To overcome these limitations, we propose Phase-DGS, a framework that replaces conventional timestamps with a semantic phase representing each frame's inherent state within the underlying motion cycle. Frames capturing the same motion state share the same phase regardless of which camera records them or when, naturally establishing spatiotemporal correspondence across unsynchronized cameras. We validate Phase-DGS under temporal offsets, frame drops, and camera freezes, achieving up to +8.5 dB PSNR improvement over baselines while enabling seamless integration with existing DGS backbones including RealTime-4DGS and FreeTimeGS.

AI.tldr: 提出 Phase-DGS，用“语义相位”替代时间戳来对齐多相机帧，实现无需硬件同步的动态高斯泼溅时空重建，在时间偏移/丢帧/相机冻结下最高提升 +8.5 dB PSNR。
AI.motivation: 动态高斯泼溅（DGS）的时空重建默认所有相机严格时间同步，但实际中该假设难以满足：工业级同步依赖昂贵专用硬件与复杂配置；音频对齐、几何匹配、位姿跟踪等数据驱动方法又受限于环境或场景的特定假设。
AI.method: 以“语义相位”取代传统时间戳——为每帧分配其在底层运动周期中所处状态的相位表示。处于相同运动状态的帧共享同一相位，与拍摄相机、拍摄时刻无关，从而在未同步相机间自然建立时空对应；该相位可与 RealTime-4DGS、FreeTimeGS 等现有 DGS 主干无缝集成。
AI.result: 在时间偏移、丢帧与相机冻结三种失同步条件下验证，相较基线最高取得 +8.5 dB 的 PSNR 提升，并可即插即用地接入现有 DGS 主干。
AI.conclusion: Phase-DGS 将同步问题由“时间对齐”重构为“运动状态对齐”，摆脱对专用同步硬件及场景特定假设的依赖，为无同步多相机动态场景重建提供了通用且有效的方案。

title: A research world model of power engineering learns its dynamics and reveals what-ifs
summary: Decisions about the direction of research in power engineering determine which technologies mature and, through them, shape infrastructure that lasts decades, yet their consequences cannot be observed before they are taken, and existing forecasts of research fields extrapolate a single trajectory. Here we introduce research world models, which treat a research field as a dynamical system that can be acted upon, and establish one for power engineering from 1.1 million papers. A distilled language model reads each paper into role-typed concepts, two sophisticated, high-fidelity graph-temporal neural network cores learn how the resulting concept network evolves, and operators learned from natural experiments in the publication record estimate the effects of interventions. In temporally held-out tests, the model forecast years ahead which concepts would grow and which method-target pairs would be joined for the first time, outperforming tuned machine-learning baselines in most settings, and its estimated intervention effects tracked those realized in natural experiments it had not seen. Its training scheme and three of its operators replicated in two fields withheld from development. Questions posed in natural language are compiled by a domain-specialized 27-billion-parameter language model into executable actions and answered as paired simulations with and without the intervention. The answers were rated 4.1 of 5 for faithfulness by an independent language-model judge. By revealing the latent dynamics of a research field and its response to interventions, research world models offer a new way to simulate and test research decisions before they are made.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“研究世界模型”（research world models），将科研领域视为可施加干预的动力学系统，并以110万篇电力工程论文构建了一个实例，可预测概念演化与干预效应，并以自然语言问答形式模拟研究决策。
AI.motivation: 电力工程的研究方向决策决定哪些技术成熟并塑造未来数十年的基础设施，但其后果在决策前无法被观测，且现有领域预测方法只外推单一轨迹，无法评估干预的影响。
AI.method: 将领域建模为可作用的动力系统：用蒸馏语言模型把每篇论文读成角色类型化的概念；用两个高保真图-时序神经网络核心学习概念网络的演化；从发表记录中的自然实验学习算子以估计干预效应；用领域专用270亿参数语言模型把自然语言问题编译为可执行动作，并以有/无干预的成对模拟作答。
AI.result: 在时间留出测试中，模型能提前数年预测哪些概念会增长、哪些方法-目标配对首次结合，在多数设置下优于调优的机器学习基线；其估计的干预效应与未见自然实验中实现的效果一致；训练方案与三个算子在两个未参与开发的领域中复现；问答答案被独立语言模型评审评为4.1/5的忠实度。
AI.conclusion: 研究世界模型揭示了领域潜在的动态机制及其对干预的响应，为在决策前模拟与检验研究决策提供了新途径。

title: Best-of-Depth: Learning Exploratory Dynamics in Looped Transformers
summary: Looped Transformers extend inference-time computation through repeated latent-state updates, but final-depth training does not directly encourage useful intermediate alternatives. We introduce Best-of-Depth (BoD), which trains a recurrent trajectory as a candidate set by minimizing prediction loss across depths. Different valid targets can be matched at different depths without architectural changes or depth-specific labels. An exact-match analysis connects this objective to solution coverage. On N-Queens completion and graph coloring, BoD improves coverage over final-depth and intermediate-supervision objectives. N-Queens coverage reaches 91.03%, versus 45.75% for final-depth training. Further experiments show discovery beyond the training depth and recovery of solutions withheld from teacher pools on familiar inputs. Fine-tuning a pretrained looped language model with BoD yields higher pooled code-generation success than final-depth training when programs are generated separately at evaluated fixed depths. These results support training recurrent computation for solution discovery along its trajectory.

AI.tldr: 提出 Best-of-Depth (BoD)：通过对所有深度分别计算预测损失，将循环 Transformer 的整条轨迹视为候选集来训练，从而让不同深度适配不同有效解；在 N-Queens、图着色与代码生成任务上，覆盖率与成功率均显著优于仅末层训练。
AI.motivation: 循环 Transformer 虽通过重复隐状态更新延长推理时计算，但仅在最终深度训练并不能促使中间深度产生有用的替代解；作者希望无需改架构、无需深度专属标签，就让轨迹上的中间状态也成为有效候选解。
AI.method: 将循环轨迹按深度展开为候选集合，取各深度预测损失的最小值（跨深度最小化）作为训练目标，使同一输入的不同合法目标可由不同深度分别匹配；结合精确匹配（exact-match）分析，将目标函数与解的覆盖能力建立联系，并与末层训练、中间层监督等目标对比。
AI.result: N-Queens 补全覆盖率 91.03%，末层训练仅 45.75%；N-Queens 与图着色上覆盖率优于末层训练和中间监督；出现超出训练深度的解发现，以及在熟悉输入上恢复被教师池排除的解；微调预训练循环语言模型后，按各固定深度分别生成程序时，池化代码生成成功率高于末层训练。
AI.conclusion: 沿轨迹训练循环计算可有效用于解的发现：BoD 仅以跨深度损失即实现候选集式的多解覆盖，说明"深度即候选"的视角是训练循环 Transformer 的有效范式。

title: Learning from Unlabeled Photographs for General Oral Image Analysis
summary: Oral photographs contain rich clinical information and hold significant potential for artificial intelligence applications; however, most models are trained for individual tasks and rely on costly expert annotations. We hypothesized that self-supervised training on unlabeled oral photographs could produce transferable visual representations for heterogeneous vision tasks. To test this hypothesis, we developed DOVE (Dental Optical Visual Encoder) by domain-adaptive self-supervised pretraining on approximately 530,000 unlabeled oral photographs collected from publicly accessible sources. DOVE was benchmarked against 3 established baselines across 5 classification datasets and 4 segmentation datasets, covering both frozen backbone evaluation and end-to-end finetuning. DOVE achieved the strongest overall performance, ranking best in few-shot transfer and label efficiency on most benchmarks. Under the 20-shot frozen-backbone protocol, DOVE outperformed the second best DINOv3 by 4.37 percentage points in mean macro-F1 across classification datasets and by 4.49 percentage points in mean macro-Dice across segmentation tasks. Under end-to-end finetuning, DOVE achieved at least 80% of the strongest full-data baseline's performance across most evaluation datasets using only 10% of the labeled training data. Qualitative retrieval and feature analyses further indicated better organization of image-level and spatial representations. These findings support DOVE as a generalizable and label-efficient backbone for oral vision research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DOVE（Dental Optical Visual Encoder），通过在约53万张无标注口腔照片上进行领域自适应自监督预训练，获得可迁移至异构口腔视觉任务的通用视觉表征，在少样本与标签高效场景下优于既有基线。
AI.motivation: 口腔照片蕴含丰富临床信息、具AI应用潜力，但现有模型多为单任务训练且依赖昂贵专家标注，缺乏可跨任务迁移的通用表征。
AI.method: 假设无标注口腔照片上的自监督训练可产出可迁移表征；据此在约530,000张公开来源的无标注口腔照片上进行领域自适应自监督预训练构建DOVE，并在5个分类数据集与4个分割数据集上与3个成熟基线比较，覆盖冻结骨干评估与端到端微调两种范式。
AI.result: DOVE整体性能最佳，在多数基准的少样本迁移与标签效率上排名第一：20-shot冻结骨干协议下，分类平均macro-F1较第二名DINOv3高4.37个百分点，分割平均macro-Dice高4.49个百分点；端到端微调时，仅用10%标注训练数据即在多数数据集上达到最强全数据基线性能的至少80%；定性检索与特征分析显示其图像级与空间表征组织更优。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持DOVE作为口腔视觉研究中可泛化、标签高效的骨干模型。

title: ValQID: Learning the Net Value of Semantic Query Groups for Web Device Identification
summary: Web interfaces are widely used to access network services and manage networked devices. Identifying the vendors and types of devices behind Web interfaces is a critical step in asset inventory, security management, and risk assessment. Device identity cues are dispersed across page text, configuration fields, and management functions, and interpreting them often requires linking related Web objects. Responses and objects require different amounts of semantic analysis, so exhaustively processing all candidate content can introduce unnecessary computation. We present ValQID, which uses a relation graph to combine dispersed device identity cues, evaluates semantic questions efficiently with DSEJEV, and accounts for complementarity among semantic questions when estimating computation value. Based on the current identification state, ValQID weighs each question group's expected identification benefit against its execution cost and adaptively allocates computation to identify device vendors and types. Evaluation on real Web response data shows that ValQID achieves relative gains of up to 47.1% in joint macro-F1 and up to 82.1% in macro-F1 for low-frequency vendors over a state-of-the-art method. DSEJEV speeds up semantic processing by up to 8.58 times compared with general-purpose language models.

AI.tldr: 提出ValQID，用关系图整合分散的设备身份线索，以DSEJEV高效执行语义问题，并按互补性估计计算价值，自适应分配算力以识别Web界面背后的设备厂商与类型。
AI.motivation: 识别Web界面背后的设备厂商与类型是资产盘点、安全管理与风险评估的关键步骤；但身份线索分散于页面文本、配置字段与管理功能中，需关联多个Web对象，且不同响应与对象所需语义分析量差异大，穷举处理所有候选内容会带来不必要的计算开销。
AI.method: ValQID构建关系图以融合分散的设备身份线索；采用DSEJEV高效评估语义问题；在估计计算价值时考虑语义问题之间的互补性；基于当前识别状态，权衡各问题组的期望识别收益与执行成本，自适应地分配计算资源。
AI.result: 在真实Web响应数据上，联合macro-F1最高相对提升47.1%，低频厂商macro-F1最高相对提升82.1%，均优于当前最优方法；DSEJEV相较通用语言模型将语义处理加速最高8.58倍。
AI.conclusion: ValQID通过关系图线索融合与成本-收益驱动的自适应计算分配，在提升设备厂商与类型识别准确率（尤其低频厂商）的同时显著降低语义处理开销，实现了准确性与效率的兼顾。

title: Feature-Based and Deep Learning Methods for Astronomical Light Curve Classification
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to Moscow University Physics Bulletin (DLCP-2026 special issue)
summary: We compare feature-based machine learning and end-to-end deep learning for variable star classification using the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) StarEmbed dataset, which contains about 40,000 objects across seven imbalanced classes. Classical models trained on physically motivated features consistently outperform deep networks trained directly on raw light curves. We find that limited labeled data contributes to the performance gap, while the multivariate, irregularly sampled, and morphologically diverse nature of light curves poses additional challenges for deep learning models. While deep learning holds promise for learning representations directly from observations, our results indicate that current models fail to generalize with the available training set size. These findings motivate further investigation of the benefits of scaling labeled datasets and self-supervised pretraining on large unlabeled surveys. This work establishes a quantitative baseline for future research and highlights the need for further innovations to unlock the potential of deep learning in astronomical time series analysis.

AI.tldr: 在ZTF StarEmbed数据集上，基于物理特征的经典机器学习模型在变星分类中一致优于端到端深度学习，性能差距主要源于标注数据量有限及光变曲线本身的多变量、不规则采样与形态多样性。
AI.motivation: 明确深度学习方法在变星分类中相对传统特征方法的实际表现差距，并为后续研究建立可量化基线，从而判断是否需要数据规模扩展与自监督预训练等改进方向。
AI.method: 基于ZTF StarEmbed数据集（约4万天体、7个不均衡类别），对比两类方案：一是使用物理意义明确的特征训练经典机器学习模型；二是直接在原始光变曲线上训练端到端深度网络。
AI.result: 经典特征模型始终优于深度网络；分析表明有限标注数据是性能差距的重要成因，同时光变曲线的多变量、不规则采样和形态多样性进一步增加学习难度，当前模型在现有训练集规模下泛化不足。
AI.conclusion: 现有深度学习难以在该任务上发挥潜力，未来需研究标注数据规模扩展与大范围无标注巡天数据上的自监督预训练，并需要方法创新以释放深度学习在天文时间序列分析中的价值。

title: DenseTwins: Dense Modality Decoupling for Multimodal Self-Supervision
summary: Multimodal perception is central to many computer vision applications, including robotics and autonomous driving, where different sensing modalities provide complementary cues. Self-supervised learning offers a scalable solution for exploiting large amounts of unlabeled multimodal data. However, existing methods either neglect modality-specific information by enforcing feature-space alignment between modalities or learn only global representations without preserving spatial structure. We propose DenseTwins, a multimodal self-supervised framework that learns dense representations by explicitly decoupling the dense feature space into shared and modality-specific components. The proposed approach combines dense cross-modal correspondences with redundancy-reduction objectives, enabling the model to capture both shared semantics and modality-specific cues within a structured dense embedding space. DenseTwins jointly optimizes an intra-modal objective across augmented views and a cross-modal objective that aligns shared features while decorrelating modality-specific information. We evaluate DenseTwins across multiple multimodal benchmarks and sensing setups, achieving state-of-the-art or competitive performance across multimodal self-supervised baselines. Code available at: https://github.com/CarloSgaravatti/DenseTwins.

AI.tldr: 提出DenseTwins，一种多模态自监督框架，通过将稠密特征空间显式解耦为共享与模态特有分量，学习保留空间结构的稠密表示。
AI.motivation: 多模态感知广泛用于机器人与自动驾驶，各模态提供互补线索，自监督可利用大量无标注数据。但现有方法要么通过强制特征空间对齐而忽略模态特有信息，要么只学习全局表示而丢失空间结构。
AI.method: DenseTwins以稠密跨模态对应关系结合冗余削减目标，使稠密嵌入空间结构化地兼具共享语义与模态特有线索；联合优化模态内目标（跨增强视图）与跨模态目标（对齐共享特征的同时对模态特有信息去相关）。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准与传感配置上评估，性能达到或接近多模态自监督基线的SOTA水平。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦共享/模态特有稠密特征，是在保留空间结构前提下有效利用多模态无标注数据的可行范式。

title: SAT Encoding for Set of At-Most-K Cardinality Constraints with Ladder Shape
summary: This paper presents a novel SAT encoding designed to represent a sequence of At-Most-K cardinality constraints arranged in a ladder-like structure, referred to as the Ladder AMK constraint. These AMK constraints feature a ladder-like arrangement, with shared common variables in the center and two variables differing at the beginning and the end. The proposed encoding first decomposes the sequence of AMK constraints into separated blocks, then encodes each block as a whole rather than encoding each AMK constraint individually. This approach improves the efficiency of constraint solving in SAT solvers by significantly reducing the size of the encoding, precisely the number of variables, and the generated clauses required. To achieve this, the encoding employs Sequential Counter to encode each block and constructs clauses that link adjacent blocks, ensuring equivalence with the input constraints. Compared to the previously proposed encoding that uses BDD for Ladder AMO constraint, our encoding requires fewer variables and clauses. Our study is the first study that develops SAT encoding for Ladder AMK constraints with k>1. Experimental results on single Ladder AMO and Ladder AMK constraints indicate that our encoding significantly enhances both the size of the encoding and the efficiency of solving time compared to existing encodings. Furthermore, by evaluating on the two real-world combinatorial problems, namely Anti-bandwidth Problem and Nurse Rostering Problem, we found that the proposed encoding surpasses alternative encodings, as well as more advanced Constraint Programming and Mixed Integer Programming solvers. In summary, the SAT encoding technique presented in this paper provides a more efficient method for encoding sequence constraint, specifically Ladder AMK constraint, which could enhance the effectiveness of SAT solving for various problems involving this type of constraint.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向"梯形"结构序列At-Most-K约束(Ladder AMK)的新型SAT编码：先将序列AMK分解为块，用Sequential Counter整体编码每块并连接相邻块，显著缩减变量与子句数量并提升求解效率。
AI.motivation: Ladder AMK约束由多个共享中间公共变量、仅在首尾各差一个变量的AMK约束构成，逐条编码会冗余膨胀；此前仅有针对Ladder AMO(k=1)的BDD编码，缺少k>1的SAT编码方法。
AI.method: 将梯形AMK约束序列分解为独立块，对每块整体采用Sequential Counter编码（而非逐条AMK编码），并构造子句连接相邻块以保证与原约束等价；首次给出k>1的Ladder AMK SAT编码。
AI.result: 相比BDD-based Ladder AMO编码，变量数与子句数更少；在单个Ladder AMO/AMK约束上编码规模与求解时间均显著改善；在Anti-bandwidth与Nurse Rostering两个实际组合问题上优于其他编码，并超过更先进的CP与MIP求解器。
AI.conclusion: 该块级Sequential Counter编码为Ladder AMK等序列约束提供了更高效的SAT表示方法，可提升涉及此类约束问题的SAT求解效果。

title: FedCSGA: Client Selection Based on Genetic Algorithm for Federated Learning
summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of machine learning models across distributed clients while preserving data privacy. In practical deployments, FL relies on selecting a subset of clients in each communication round to reduce communication cost, mitigate stragglers, and improve training efficiency under heterogeneous data and system conditions. In heterogeneous edge computing environments, both statistical heterogeneity and system heterogeneity significantly affect convergence efficiency and model performance. However, existing client selection methods often address these factors independently, overlooking their coupled and dynamic impact across communication rounds. To address this limitation, we propose FedCSGA, a Client Selection method for Federated learning based on a Genetic Algorithm. FedCSGA encodes client subsets as chromosomes and evaluates these subsets through a non-linear fitness function that jointly integrates resource-aware metrics and history-aware participation weighting. This design captures subset-level interactions, mitigates persistent selection bias, and balances statistical utility with system efficiency. Extensive experiments on FMNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR- 100, and Tiny-ImageNet demonstrate that FedCSGA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse heterogeneity settings, achieving accuracy improvements of up to 7.0% and faster convergence with fewer communication rounds. These results validate the effectiveness of jointly modeling statistical and system factors to achieve robust and efficient learning in heterogeneous federated environments.

AI.tldr: 提出基于遗传算法的联邦学习客户端选择方法 FedCSGA，通过非线性适应度函数联合建模统计异构与系统异构，在多数据集上提升精度并加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习需每轮选取子集客户端以降低通信开销、缓解掉队者并提升效率；但现有客户端选择方法往往将统计异构与系统异构分别处理，忽视二者在轮次间的耦合与动态影响，限制了收敛效率与模型性能。
AI.method: FedCSGA 将客户端子集编码为染色体，用遗传算法搜索子集；设计非线性适应度函数，联合整合资源感知指标与历史感知的参与权重，从而刻画子集级交互作用。
AI.result: 在 FMNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 与 Tiny-ImageNet 上的大量实验表明，FedCSGA 在多种异构设置下优于现有最优基线，最高带来 7.0% 的精度提升，并以更少通信轮次实现更快收敛。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模统计因素与系统因素可有效抑制持续的选择偏差、兼顾统计效用与系统效率，实现异构联邦环境下稳健高效的学习。

title: Cycle WAM: Coupling Action and Video through Cycle Consistency
summary: Recent advances in video modeling have driven substantial progress in world action models (WAMs). Existing approaches exploit pretrained video priors by decoding actions from latent representations or inferring them from generated videos. The underlying link is causal: robot actions produce changes in the scene, and video observations of these changes provide evidence for inferring the actions that produced them. However, existing training formulations do not by themselves ensure that actions and their predicted visual consequences are consistent, potentially limiting the use of pretrained capabilities. We treat video and action as paired modalities linked by this causal relationship and learn their correspondence through a unified training framework designed to better exploit pretrained video priors. Cycle WAM first augments video-action co-training with bidirectional conversion to reinforce cross-modal correspondence and recover forward and inverse dynamics. It then introduces a differentiable cycle-reconstruction objective to further couple the two mappings. The resulting model supports both forward and inverse dynamics, with the potential to improve performance through more effective use of pretrained video priors. Cycle WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance among comparable methods on LIBERO-Pro and substantially improves DreamZero on DROID. Comparisons with UWM characterize its inverse-dynamics performance and show sharper visual detail in the displayed forward-dynamics predictions.

AI.tldr: Cycle WAM 将视频与动作视为由因果关系联结的配对模态，通过"双向转换 + 可微循环重建"的统一训练框架强化跨模态对应，从而更充分地利用预训练视频先验，同时支持前向与逆向动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有 world action models 借助预训练视频先验，从隐表示解码动作或由生成视频推断动作，其内在联系是因果性的：动作引起场景变化，场景变化的视频观测为推断动作提供证据。然而现有训练目标本身并不保证动作与其预测的视觉后果之间的一致性，可能限制预训练能力的发挥。
AI.method: 提出 Cycle WAM：首先在视频-动作联合训练中加入双向转换，以强化跨模态对应并同时恢复前向与逆向动力学；随后引入可微的循环重建目标，进一步耦合两个映射方向。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-Pro 上取得同类方法中的 SOTA；在 DROID 上显著优于 DreamZero；与 UWM 的对比刻画了其逆向动力学性能，并在展示的前向动力学预测中呈现更锐利的视觉细节。
AI.conclusion: 以因果配对模态视角统一建模视频与动作、并用循环一致性显式约束两向映射，是一种有效利用预训练视频先验以提升 world action model 性能的途径。

title: When Should an LLM Steering Edit Depend on the Input?
summary: An activation steering edit should depend on the input exactly when the destination varies \emph{inside} the class a query requests, and that is measurable before any rule is fitted or applied. Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) adds one fixed direction to every input, the difference of the class means. Conditioning it on the requested class accounts for the between-class variation in the required displacement and leaves the within-class variation untouched, which no rule that reads only the source state can express. We study the impact of increasing input-dependence in the steering edit, moving from a difference of means to a destination retrieved per query --- the mean of the $k$ stored states nearest the query, inside the requested class --- in which the two baselines are endpoints: at $k$ equal to the class size the retrieved rule \emph{is} the class-conditional difference of means. We measure input-dependent steering on six substitution corpora that vary in whether the edit changes a word or a clause, and on an external benchmark, and find that input-dependent steering outperforms fixed-direction steering when the destination varies within the class. Retrieval wins at every layer of every substitution corpus in two models, and the level of input-dependence needed governs how to apply it: word-level edits are best made in the first tenth of the network from a few neighbours, clause-level edits at any depth from the class mean. Where the class already determines the answer the class mean suffices and retrieval only matches it, though a fixed direction still fails there. Four quantities computed from the states alone identify the regime in which the edit should be applied.

AI.tldr: 提出以输入依赖性为核心的激活引导理论框架，将类条件均值与逐查询检索视为两端点，并用状态统计量预判编辑方式。
AI.motivation: CAA等固定方向方法对每个输入加同一方向，无法表达目标随输入变化所需的类内变异；需明确"编辑何时应依赖输入"并可事前度量。
AI.method: 以类条件均值差（CAA的类条件版本）与逐查询检索（请求类内最近的k个存储状态均值）为两端点，k=类大小时退化为类条件均值差；在6个替换语料（词级/从句级）及一个外部基准上，跨两个模型逐层比较固定方向、类均值、检索三种规则；用仅由状态计算的四个量判别适用区间。
AI.result: 当目标在类内变化时输入依赖引导优于固定方向；检索在两个模型的每个替换语料的每一层均胜出；词级编辑宜在网络前十分之一深度、用少量近邻，从句级编辑宜任意深度用类均值；类已决定答案处类均值即足够，检索仅持平，但固定方向仍失败。
AI.conclusion: 引导编辑是否需要输入依赖可由类内目标变异、在拟合规则前测得；所需输入依赖程度决定应用方式（深度与近邻数），四类状态统计量可无监督识别适用机制。

title: Sheaf-MPNN: A Library for Sheaf Neural Networks as Message Passing
summary: Standard Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) implicitly assume that neighboring nodes share the same feature space, which contributes to oversmoothing and poor performance on heterophilic graphs. Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs) remove this assumption by giving each node and edge its own vector space and learning restriction maps that transform features as they move between neighbors. These maps define a sheaf Laplacian that drives diffusion over the graph, but existing implementations often assemble it explicitly as a global sparse block matrix, which adds memory and computational overhead and can hinder scalability. In this paper, we introduce Sheaf-MPNN, a PyTorch Geometric library that reformulates sheaf diffusion as local incidence-wise transport and aggregation, eliminating the need to construct the global Laplacian. Sheaf-MPNN implements fifteen families of SNNs under a unified message-passing framework, each supporting both homogeneous and heterogeneous graphs, and directed and undirected settings, with diagonal, general, orthogonal, and low-rank restriction maps and attention-based predictors. We further provide a unified benchmarking suite covering node- and graph-level tasks, heterogeneous graph learning, and computational efficiency, enabling systematic and reproducible comparisons across architectures. We establish theoretical equivalence between these message-passing formulations and their original counterparts and identify the architectural mechanisms needed to preserve their propagation dynamics. This unified perspective provides a principled foundation for implementing, comparing, and extending sheaf-based architectures within standard graph learning frameworks. Source code is available at https://github.com/alessioborgi/sheaf-mpnn.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sheaf-MPNN：将 Sheaf 神经网络中的 sheaf 扩散从"显式构造全局稀疏块 Laplacian"改写为局部 incidence-wise 传输与聚合的消息传递形式，在 PyTorch Geometric 上统一实现 15 类 SNN，并提供基准测试套件。
AI.motivation: 标准 GNN 隐式假设邻居节点共享同一特征空间，导致过平滑与异配图性能差；SNN 通过为节点/边赋予独立向量空间与限制映射来消除该假设。但现有实现通常显式组装全局稀疏块形式的 sheaf Laplacian，带来内存与计算开销并限制可扩展性。
AI.method: 基于局部 incidence-wise（边-关联）传输与聚合重新表述 sheaf 扩散，从而避免构造全局 Laplacian；以统一消息传递框架实现 15 类 SNN，支持同配/异配、有向/无向设置，覆盖对角、一般、正交、低秩限制映射及基于注意力的预测器；同时构建统一基准套件，涵盖节点级与图级任务、异配图学习与计算效率评估。
AI.result: 在统一框架下实现并复现 15 类 SNN；提供涵盖节点/图级任务、异配图与效率的系统可复现对比；理论上证明所提消息传递形式与原实现等价，并识别出保持原有传播动力学所需的架构机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在标准图学习框架中实现、比较与扩展 sheaf 类架构提供了有原则的基础，提升了内存与计算效率及可扩展性。

title: VISAGE: Vertex-based Intrinsic Surface Appearance GEneration via Dual-Stream Diffusion for Arbitrary 3D Heads
summary: Recovering identity-faithful, physically based surface appearance for 3D human heads from sparse images remains challenging. Existing methods often rely on UV-based pipelines, introducing seam artefacts, or operate in image space, limiting surface consistency. We present VISAGE, Vertex-based Intrinsic Surface Appearance GEneration, a surface-based conditional diffusion framework that synthesises per-vertex albedo and roughness directly on arbitrary mesh topologies, without requiring consistent UV parameterisation at training time. VISAGE combines global spectral processing with local geodesic K-Nearest-Neighbour refinement, enforcing structural coherence while restoring detail beyond the truncated spectral basis. Multi-view RGB images condition the network via visibility-aware cross-attention, enabling occlusion-robust synthesis across the full head surface. Region-specific modules specialise in semantically demanding and distinct areas (eyes, mouth, skin and hair), while a tangent-space output projection recovers fine iris detail. We further introduce a scalable procedural augmentation pipeline that enriches raw geometry scans with physically plausible albedo, roughness and normal maps for training. The predicted attributes render directly as a single RGBA vertex-colour channel. VISAGE reduces FID by 42.7% on NPHM and 22.5% and 4.4% on zero-shot FaceVerse and i3DMM, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline, with a 7.2M-parameter core network.

AI.tldr: VISAGE：基于顶点的条件扩散框架，直接在任意网格拓扑上生成逐顶点反照率与粗糙度，避免UV接缝与图像空间一致性问题，FID显著降低。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏图像恢复3D人头的身份保真、物理真实表面外观仍困难：现有UV流程引入接缝伪影，图像空间方法限制表面一致性，且依赖一致的UV参数化。
AI.method: 表面级条件扩散：全局谱处理+局部测地KNN精化；多视角RGB经可见性感知交叉注意力条件化；眼、嘴、皮肤、头发区域专用模块；切空间输出投影恢复虹膜细节；可扩展程序化增强管线生成物理合理反照率/粗糙度/法线训练数据；输出为单一RGBA顶点色通道，核心网络仅7.2M参数。
AI.result: 相较最强基线，NPHM上FID降低42.7%，零样本FaceVerse与i3DMM分别降低22.5%与4.4%。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练时一致UV参数化即可在任意拓扑上生成身份保真、物理真实的表面外观，兼顾细节与全局一致性，参数量小。

title: TactiNavi: Serving and Revising an LLM Game Coach with Explicit Strategy Conditions
summary: A deployed LLM coaching agent answers requests whose correct response depends on player state and game version, so advice that is right for one player can be wrong for the next. We describe TactiNavi, the serving system behind the LLM coach of a commercial open-world game, which makes strategy applicability an explicit artifact shared by offline compilation, online execution, failure diagnosis, and release. An offline compiler turns versioned game evidence and expert guidance into strategy packages with explicit prerequisites, the serving plane evaluates those prerequisites as three-valued conditions over structured player state and records decision traces, and a control plane uses the resulting condition-rule dependencies to validate revisions on held-out traffic before release. In a retrospective evaluation of 1,122 logged coaching turns from three deployment periods, condition-bearing packages raise correctness from 57.9% to 82.0% over atomic facts and reduce strategy misapplication under changed player state from 18.1% to 10.4%, while trace-based claim verification reaches 86.4% precision at a median reply latency of 2.07 s. The deployment also showed that most apparent fixes are generation noise, because an unchanged-system rerun recovers 38.4% of failing turns and only one of 15 shipped revision units passes the release checks retrospectively. We distill these results into lessons on treating applicability as a first-class serving object, sizing traces for later diagnosis, and building the null model into the release path.

AI.tldr: TactiNavi 是一个已部署于商业开放世界游戏的 LLM 教练服务系统，将"策略适用性"作为显式一等服务对象，贯通离线编译、在线执行、故障诊断与发布四个环节。基于 1,122 条回放教练对话的评估显示，该设计将正确率由 57.9% 提升至 82.0%，并将玩家状态变化下的策略误用率从 18.1% 降至 10.4%。
AI.motivation: LLM 教练智能体的正确回答依赖于玩家状态与游戏版本，同一建议对某玩家正确、对另一玩家可能错误。现有做法（如原子事实检索）缺乏对适用条件的显式建模，导致策略误用，且线上"看似有效"的修复多为生成噪声，缺乏可诊断与可验证的发布流程。
AI.method: 系统由三部分构成：(1) 离线编译器将版本化游戏证据与专家指导编译为带显式前置条件的策略包；(2) 服务面在结构化玩家状态上以三值逻辑求值这些前置条件，并记录决策轨迹；(3) 控制面利用条件-规则依赖关系，在发布前于留出流量上校验修订版本。评估采用三个部署时期的 1,122 条日志对话进行回顾性分析，并结合基于轨迹的声明验证与"不变系统重跑"的零模型基线。
AI.result: 带条件策略包相对原子事实将正确率由 57.9% 提升至 82.0%；玩家状态变化下的策略误用率由 18.1% 降至 10.4%；基于轨迹的声明验证在 2.07 秒中位回复延迟下达到 86.4% 精确率。零模型重跑可恢复 38.4% 的失败对话，且 15 个已发布修订单元中仅 1 个能通过回顾性发布检查，说明多数表面修复为生成噪声。
AI.conclusion: 应将"适用性"视为一等服务对象而非提示词附属产物；决策轨迹需按后续诊断需求进行规模设计；发布路径应内建零模型（null model）对照，以区分真实改进与生成噪声。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Prototype Learning for Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Open-set test-time adaptation (TTA) aims to adapt source-trained models to unlabeled test streams where covariate-shifted in-distribution (csID) samples and covariate-shifted out-of-distribution (csOOD) samples may coexist. Existing TTA methods are typically designed under a closed-set assumption and therefore lack explicit mechanisms for reliably distinguishing csID from csOOD samples. Consequently, csOOD samples may be mistakenly included in confidence-enhancing adaptation, producing harmful gradients that degrade known-class performance. To address this, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Prototype Learning for Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation (UAPA), a plug-and-play method for reliable open-set adaptation. Specifically, we first introduce Uncertainty-Driven ID/OOD Separation, which combines a classifier-prototype score with a mini-batch-normalized evidence-derived uncertainty score to distinguish csID from csOOD samples. We then propose a Dynamic Prototype Refinement strategy that periodically refines class-specific target prototypes using buffered csID features to progressively follow the estimated class directions. Lastly, we introduce Contrastive Prototype Entropy Adaptation, which applies entropy minimization to csID samples and entropy maximization to csOOD samples, while prototype-level contrastive learning aligns csID features with their corresponding target prototypes and reduces the maximum similarity between csOOD features and known-class prototypes. Empirically, UAPA outperforms the strongest baselines on the CIFAR benchmarks and Tiny-ImageNet-C, improving average OSCR by 2.08 and 1.28 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用方法UAPA，通过不确定性驱动ID/OOD分离、动态原型细化与对比原型熵适应，实现开放集测试时适应中csID/csOOD的可靠区分与适配。
AI.motivation: 现有TTA方法多基于闭集假设，缺乏可靠区分协变量偏移的分布内(csID)与分布外(csOOD)样本的机制，导致csOOD样本被误纳入置信度增强式适配，产生有害梯度并损害已知类性能。
AI.method: 1) 不确定性驱动的ID/OOD分离：融合分类器-原型得分与批内归一化的证据推导不确定性得分进行判别；2) 动态原型细化：利用缓冲的csID特征周期性更新类特定目标原型以跟踪类方向；3) 对比原型熵适应：对csID做熵最小化、对csOOD做熵最大化，并用原型级对比学习对齐csID特征与对应原型、降低csOOD特征与已知类原型的最大相似度。
AI.result: 在CIFAR系列基准与Tiny-ImageNet-C上优于最强基线，平均OSCR分别提升2.08与1.28个百分点。
AI.conclusion: UAPA作为即插即用方案，通过原型与不确定性的联合设计有效缓解csOOD误纳入带来的负迁移，提升开放集测试时适应性能。

title: SPOD: Recovering Suppressed Temporal Evidence in Video-LLMs via Single-Pass Orthogonal Decomposition
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
summary: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have achieved strong performance on many video understanding tasks, yet remain vulnerable to temporal hallucination in time-sensitive reasoning scenarios such as scene transition understanding and event ordering. Existing solutions either require costly retraining or introduce inefficient multi-pass inference and external supervision at test time. In this work, we show that temporal evidence is already encoded in Video-LLM hidden representations but is not fully exploited during standard inference. Motivated by this observation, we propose Single-Pass Orthogonal Decomposition (SPOD), a training-free framework that recovers suppressed temporal evidence through analytical hidden-state manipulation in a single forward pass. SPOD consists of two components: Frame Distinctiveness Analysis (FDA), which identifies salient frames from middle-layer hidden-state geometry, and Temporal Delta Subspace (TDS), which constructs orthogonal temporal and prior subspaces from weighted inter-frame hidden-state differences. By decomposing final hidden states into temporal, prior, and residual components and rescaling them independently, SPOD enhances dynamic information, suppresses static appearance bias, and preserves complementary information. Experiments on VidHalluc, EventHallusion, and VideoMMMU show that SPOD consistently outperforms strong inference-time baselines across temporal reasoning tasks and model architectures while retaining near-vanilla inference efficiency. These results suggest that improving temporal reasoning in Video-LLMs may depend not only on additional supervision, but also on recovering temporal evidence already present in their internal representations. Our code is available at https://github.com/VioAgnes/SPOD.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的单次前向正交分解框架SPOD，通过分析式隐状态操作恢复Video-LLM中被抑制的时间证据，缓解时间幻觉。
AI.motivation: Video-LLM在场景转换理解、事件排序等时间敏感任务上易产生时间幻觉。现有方案要么需昂贵重训练，要么在测试时依赖低效的多轮推理与外部监督。作者观察到时间证据其实已编码于隐表示中，但标准推理未充分利用。
AI.method: SPOD包含两部分：(1) Frame Distinctiveness Analysis (FDA)，从中间层隐状态几何结构识别显著帧；(2) Temporal Delta Subspace (TDS)，基于加权帧间隐状态差异构建正交的时间子空间与先验子空间。将最终隐状态分解为时间、先验与残差分量并分别重缩放，从而增强动态信息、抑制静态外观偏置并保留互补信息；全过程仅需一次前向传播。
AI.result: 在VidHalluc、EventHallusion、VideoMMMU上，SPOD在多种时间推理任务与模型架构下稳定优于强推理时基线，同时保持接近原生推理的效率。
AI.conclusion: 提升Video-LLM时间推理能力不仅依赖额外监督，也可通过回收内部表示中已有的时间证据实现；免训练、单次推理的隐状态分解是有效路径。

title: Reducing Logprob Without Causal Verification: Diagnosing SAE-Based PII Suppression in LLMs
summary: SAE-based feature-level interventions to suppress PII leakage in LLMs are primarily evaluated by log-probability reduction. We show that this criterion cannot distinguish feature specific suppression from a magnitude artifact: a direction-agnostic effect of sufficiently large activation perturbations. Across 36 (model, layer, PII type) cases, we compare selected SAE feature interventions with coherencematched random direction controls using logprob and rank-aware metrics. While 17 cases (47%) appear successful under logprob-only evaluation, only 1 case (2.8%) passes our multimetric framework. The rest reveal two failure modes: random directions outperform selected features, and feature selection collapse across PII types. These results indicate that existing evaluations cannot verify whether interventions target causal pathways of PII leakage. A 9,000 run causal mediation feasibility study corroborates this: the verifier separates candidates reliably, but correlation-selected candidates rarely pass it. We therefore propose a new research mission for NLP: causally grounded PII suppression through circuit-level localization and causal mediation analysis.

AI.tldr: 现有基于SAE特征级干预抑制LLM中PII泄露的工作仅用对数概率下降评估，本文证明该指标无法区分特征特异性抑制与幅度伪影，并提出以因果定位与中介分析为核心的评估与研究新方向。
AI.motivation: SAE特征干预抑制PII泄露的有效性通常以目标token对数概率下降为准，但作者怀疑该指标可能被"方向无关的激活扰动幅度效应"所混淆，即任何足够大的扰动都能降低概率，从而高估干预的特征特异性与因果有效性。
AI.method: 在36个（模型、层、PII类型）组合上，将选定的SAE特征干预与"相干性匹配的随机方向"对照进行比较，采用对数概率指标与秩感知（rank-aware）的多指标框架；并开展9,000次运行的因果中介（causal mediation）可行性研究，检验候选特征能否通过因果验证器。
AI.result: 仅用对数概率时17例（47%）看似成功；在多指标框架下仅1例（2.8%）通过。其余案例暴露两类失败模式：随机方向效果优于选定特征（方向无关的幅度伪影），以及不同PII类型间特征选择坍缩（缺乏特征特异性）。因果中介研究中验证器能可靠区分候选，但基于相关性筛选的候选很少通过。
AI.conclusion: 对数概率下降不足以证明干预作用于PII泄露的因果通路，现有评估无法验证特征特异性。作者呼吁NLP新研究议程：通过电路级定位与因果中介分析实现有因果依据的PII抑制。

title: Surrogate Models for Stochastic Al-Cu Phase-Field Solidification
comment: Accepted at the AI4Mat workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Includes supplementary material
summary: Phase-field models resolve microstructural evolution during rapid alloy solidification, but their computational cost limits long trajectories, stochastic ensembles, and studies across process conditions. We present a variance-preserving denoising diffusion bridge model (VP-DDBM) for state-conditioned prediction of two-dimensional Al-Cu solidification. Given the current phase, concentration, and prescribed temperature fields, the model predicts the subsequent state and is applied autoregressively. Across two held-out thermal gradients, VP-DDBM produces lower long-horizon errors than deterministic U-Net and SI-ConvNeXt baselines in domain-mean phase, domain-mean Cu concentration, and leading-tip position. It also retains fine dendritic structure over long rollouts, whereas the deterministic U-Net progressively smooths the morphology. VP-DDBM predicts the phase and concentration evolution approximately $73\times$ faster than the phase-field solver, showing potential for faster process-condition screening and ensemble-based microstructure studies.

AI.tldr: 提出方差保持的扩散桥模型（VP-DDBM），以当前相场、浓度与温度场为条件，自回归预测二维Al-Cu快速凝固的下一个状态，长程误差低于确定性U-Net与SI-ConvNeXt基线，并比相场求解器快约73倍。
AI.motivation: 相场模型能解析快速凝固中的微观组织演化，但计算代价高，限制了长轨迹模拟、随机系综研究以及多工艺条件扫描。
AI.method: 构建方差保持去噪扩散桥模型（VP-DDBM），输入当前相场、Cu浓度场与给定温度场，输出下一时刻状态，并采用自回归方式沿时间推进；与确定性U-Net、SI-ConvNeXt基线在两组留出热梯度条件下对比。
AI.result: 在两组长程展开中，VP-DDBM在域平均相、域平均Cu浓度与领先尖端位置三项指标上长程误差均低于基线；能长期保持精细枝晶形貌，而确定性U-Net逐渐模糊化；推理速度约为相场求解器的73倍。
AI.conclusion: VP-DDBM为状态条件化的凝固组织演化预测提供了兼顾长程精度与形貌保真的快速代理，具备工艺条件筛选与基于系综的微观组织研究的应用潜力。

title: TEXMET: A Deep Learning Benchmark for Archaeological Textile Reconstruction
comment: 26 pages, 14 figures, 14 tables. Accepted version of the article published in ACM Journal on Computing and Cultural Heritage (2026). Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hzafar/TEXMET
summary: The reconstruction of fragmented historical textiles presents a significant challenge in computational archaeology. The Oseberg ship burial, dating to 834 CE, yielded hundreds of degraded textile fragments that have resisted systematic computational analysis. While deep learning has revolutionized image-based puzzle solving, progress on archaeological textiles has been limited by the lack of domain-specific datasets and systematic evaluation of modern architectures. To address this gap, we present TEXMET, a curated dataset of 18,644 historical textile images from the Metropolitan Museum of Art's Open Access collection, representing the first textile-specific benchmark for puzzle-solving research. Using TEXMET, we conduct a systematic evaluation of three state-of-the-art puzzle-solving models: JPDVT, FCViT, and DiffAssemble. Our experiments reveal that the transformer-based models pre-trained on standard datasets fail to generalize to textiles, but domain-specific fine-tuning proves highly effective. The graph-based DiffAssemble model, when fine-tuned on TEXMET, achieves 85.89% puzzle accuracy on textile data. Most significantly, applying this fine-tuned model to 45 highly degraded Oseberg fragments yields a performance increase from 26.67% to 64.44% puzzle accuracy. These results establish TEXMET as a new benchmark for textile reconstruction and demonstrate that domain adaptation is essential for applying puzzle-solving methods to imagery of real archaeological materials.

AI.tldr: 论文提出首个纺织品专用拼图数据集TEXMET（18,644张MET馆藏纺织品图像），系统评测JPDVT、FCViT、DiffAssemble三种拼图模型，发现通用预训练模型难以泛化到纺织品，而域内微调显著有效；微调后的DiffAssemble在纺织数据上达85.89%准确率，应用于45件退化Oseberg残片时准确率由26.67%提升至64.44%。
AI.motivation: 考古纺织品碎片（如834 CE Oseberg船葬出土的数百件退化织物）的重建长期缺乏系统性计算分析，主要瓶颈在于缺少领域专用数据集以及对现代拼图架构的系统评测，导致深度学习方法难以迁移到该领域。
AI.method: 构建TEXMET数据集（源自大都会艺术博物馆Open Access馆藏的18,644张历史纺织品图像），作为纺织拼图首个基准；在该数据集上系统评测三种先进拼图模型JPDVT、FCViT与DiffAssemble，并对比通用预训练与领域微调的效果，最终将微调模型迁移至真实Oseberg退化残片。
AI.result: 在标准数据上预训练的Transformer类模型无法泛化到纺织品；基于图的DiffAssemble经TEXMET微调后在纺织数据上达到85.89%拼图准确率；应用于45件高度退化的Oseberg残片时，准确率从26.67%提升至64.44%。
AI.conclusion: TEXMET确立了纺织品重建的新基准，并证明领域自适应（domain adaptation）是将拼图求解方法应用于真实考古材料图像的必要前提。

title: Kierston & KierstonBench: Simulation of Allentown, PA and Evaluation of Language Models in Crime Investigation and Surveillance Tasks
summary: Large language models are candidates for collecting and analyzing records in criminal investigations and mass surveillance. Their capability and accuracy in this work cannot currently be measured. Real deployments lack the ground truth needed to score a model's conclusions, and no benchmark evaluates these capabilities in a simulated environment. We present Kierston, a city-scale simulation engine, and KierstonBench, a benchmark that tests these capabilities against known simulated events. Kierston models approximately 125,000 residents of Allentown, Pennsylvania, generating their daily activities and the telecommunications, financial, administrative and license-plate records that surveillance and investigative systems collect about them. These records derive from a common behavioral timeline and are distributed across sources representing separate providers. Models investigate through a restricted records interface, linking observations across sources without access to the underlying simulation. The benchmark comprises 32 task families covering record linkage, routine reconstruction, incident investigation and assessment of deceptive accounts. In an evaluation of sixteen language models, most could not perform records investigation and submitted identifications the records did not support. A small number of frontier models solved most of the tasks and abstained when evidence was insufficient. In some cases these models still fell for common deceptions and assumptions, and none replaced an investigator.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Kierston城市级仿真引擎与KierstonBench基准，用于在含约12.5万居民的多源记录环境中可测量地评估大语言模型的记录调查与监控分析能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被考虑用于刑事侦查与大规模监控中的记录收集与分析，但其能力与准确性目前无法测量：真实部署缺乏可评分所需的真值，且不存在在仿真环境中评估该类能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建Kierston仿真引擎，对宾夕法尼亚州Allentown约12.5万居民建模，生成其日常活动及电信、金融、行政、车牌等记录；这些记录源自统一行为时间线并分布于代表不同提供方的数据源。模型仅通过受限记录接口开展调查，在无法访问底层仿真的条件下跨源关联观测。基准含32类任务族，覆盖记录链接、日常规律重建、事件调查与欺骗性账户评估。评估16个语言模型。
AI.result: 多数模型无法完成记录调查，并提交了记录并不支持的指认结论；少数前沿模型解决了大部分任务，并在证据不足时选择弃答。部分情况下这些模型仍落入常见欺骗与先验假设的陷阱，且无一能替代调查人员。
AI.conclusion: Kierston/KierstonBench为记录调查类能力提供了具备真值、可复现的仿真评测途径；现有模型虽在部分任务上表现良好，但可靠性不足，尚不能取代人类调查员。

title: TAPES: Task-Aligned Joint Predictive Pretraining for Transaction Event Sequences
summary: Transaction event sequences support diverse prediction tasks in online commerce and digital financial services. The same transaction records can yield prediction targets with different semantics, including values, changes, and relations to past events. These targets impose different constraints on history representations, but their predictability alone does not establish the downstream utility of a target set. Moreover, target-wise prediction losses do not explicitly model conditional co-occurrence among targets. To address these challenges, we propose TAPES, a task-aligned joint predictive pretraining framework for transaction sequences. TAPES constructs a finite collection of candidate target sets from admissible field-operator combinations. It selects a target set according to the downstream utility of representations learned through short joint pretraining trials under matched budgets. It then reinitializes the encoder and pretrains it on the selected targets through a joint likelihood parameterized by a shared discrete latent variable, before downstream supervised adaptation. Experiments in a real-world transaction-risk setting and on multiple public financial benchmarks spanning diverse downstream tasks demonstrate that TAPES outperforms representative baselines. Ablation studies further validate the contributions of predictive target selection and joint modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出TAPES框架：从字段-算子组合中构建候选目标集，以下游效用（短程联合预训练试运行、同等预算）选择目标集，再用共享离散隐变量的联合似然重新初始化并预训练编码器，最后做下游有监督适配；在真实交易风险场景与多个公开金融基准上优于基线，消融验证了目标选择与联合建模的作用。
AI.motivation: 交易事件序列可支撑语义各异（数值、变化量、与历史事件的关系）的预测目标，不同目标对历史表征提出不同约束；仅凭目标的可预测性无法确立目标集的下游效用，且逐目标预测损失未显式建模目标间的条件共现关系。
AI.method: 1) 由可允许的字段-算子组合构建有限候选目标集集合；2) 在匹配预算下通过短程联合预训练试运行，按所学习表征的下游效用选择目标集；3) 重置编码器，在选定目标上以共享离散隐变量参数化的联合似然进行预训练；4) 下游有监督适配。
AI.result: 在真实世界交易风险场景以及覆盖多种下游任务的多个公开金融基准上，TAPES 优于代表性基线；消融研究验证了预测目标选择与联合建模两部分的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 目标集的选择应以下游效用为依据而非仅看可预测性；通过共享离散隐变量对多目标进行联合建模可显式刻画目标间条件共现，从而提升交易序列预训练表征的迁移效果。

title: Bounded AUKS: A Novel Evaluation Metric for Anomaly Detection via Bounded Area Under the Kolmogorov--Smirnov Curve
summary: Recent literature widely used global metrics such as AUROC and AUPRO to quantify the detection performance. AUROC and AUPRO scores are approaching 100% in some public datasets such as MVTec AD dataset and VisA dataset, which misleadingly suggests that the pixel-level anomaly detection task has already been solved. Threshold-independent metrics represented by AUROC inherently ignore the threshold selection process, which is inevitable in practical applications. Although AUPRO restricts the False Positive rates (FPRs) to an acceptable range, extremely low FPRs can lead to increased false negative rates (FNRs). We argue that there is a lack of metrics capable of quantifying the separation between the anomaly score distributions of normal and anomalous samples, which hinders advancements in anomaly detection. In response, we propose the Bounded Area Under the Kolmogorov--Smirnov curve (Bounded AUKS), a partial integral metric that integrates the difference between TPR and FPR within a data-driven bounded range. Specifically, we introduce AUKS from KS integral as a direct measure of separability between the anomaly score distributions. The bounded range is determined only by score distributions of normal test samples. Lower bound excludes the uninformative high-FPR region. Upper bound avoids evaluation in extreme regions that aggressively push FPR towards zero, which result in a very low recall. Our experiments on 9 models across MVTec AD and VisA datasets show that Bounded AUKS can address the limitations of existing metrics and has a better performance in evaluating unsupervised anomaly detection models.
