AI.tldr: 提出Bounded AUKS（有界AUKS）指标，通过在数据驱动的有界区间内积分TPR与FPR之差，量化正异常与正常样本异常分数分布的可分性，弥补AUROC/AUPRO忽略阈值选择与极低FPR导致低召回的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有AUROC、AUPRO等全局阈值无关指标在MVTec AD、VisA等数据集上已接近100%，误导出"像素级异常检测已被解决"的结论。AUROC本质上忽略实际应用中不可避免的阈值选择过程；AUPRO虽限制FPR在可接受范围，但极低FPR会推高假负率（FNR）。同时，现有指标无法量化正常与异常样本异常分数分布之间的分离程度，阻碍了领域进展。
AI.method: 由KS积分导出AUKS，作为异常分数分布可分性的直接度量；进一步提出有界版本Bounded AUKS——在数据驱动的有界区间内对TPR与FPR之差做部分积分。区间上下界仅由正常测试样本的分数分布确定：下界排除无信息的高FPR区域，上界避免在强行压低FPR至极零、导致召回极低的极端区域评估。
AI.result: 在MVTec AD与VisA数据集上对9个模型进行实验，Bounded AUKS能够克服现有指标的局限，在评估无监督异常检测模型方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: Bounded AUKS提供了对异常分数分布可分性的有界、可解释度量，规避了阈值无关指标的缺陷与极端FPR区域的失真，可作为无监督异常检测模型更合理的评价指标。

title: What Does It Mean to Remove an Edge? Intervention-Aware Fidelity for Graph Neural Network Explanations
summary: Graph neural network explanations are often evaluated via deletion fidelity, i.e., by deleting their top-ranked edges and measuring the resulting change in model output. Yet, in a message-passing GNN, "deleting an edge" does not specify a unique intervention. Structural deletion removes the edge from the graph and recomputes quantities such as degree normalization and attention, whereas message suppression leaves this structural context intact while blocking the message carried by the edge. The meaning of deletion fidelity therefore depends on what the intervention targets in the model computation. We formalize this distinction and derive sufficient conditions for exact equivalence. The two interventions coincide for additive message passing with edge-set-independent coefficients, but can diverge when aggregation depends on the presence of zero messages or when removing an edge changes the coefficients applied to surviving messages. We then construct intervention-specific edge attributions and evaluate each resulting ranking under both interventions, testing whether their relative fidelity changes with the evaluation intervention. Across nine datasets and a panel of GIN, GCN, and GATv2 models at depths 2--5, all nine GIN controls satisfy the equivalence predicted by the theory. On the target logit, the relative fidelity of the two rankings depends on the evaluation intervention in 10 of 11 reportable GCN and GATv2 cells, and in nine of them each ranking has the larger deletion area under the intervention it was built with. Deletion fidelity is thus not a property of an edge ranking alone. Evaluation protocols should explicitly report the intervention, output functional, target, and perturbation unit, and test alternative intervention semantics when the scientific question does not uniquely determine one.

AI.tldr: 该文指出GNN删除保真度依赖于"删除边"的具体干预语义（结构删除 vs. 消息抑制），形式化二者差异、给出精确等价的充分条件，并通过实证表明边排序的相对保真度会随评估干预而改变。
AI.motivation: 删除保真度被广泛用作GNN解释的评估指标，但消息传递GNN中"删除一条边"并非唯一干预：结构删除与消息抑制在计算上含义不同，导致该指标的意义含糊，缺乏对其语义依赖性的系统刻画。
AI.method: 形式化结构删除与消息抑制两类干预，推导二者精确等价的充分条件（加性消息传递且系数与边集无关时可重合；聚合对零消息敏感或存活消息系数随边删除改变时可分歧）；据此构造干预特定（intervention-specific）的边归因，并在两种干预下分别评估各排序；实验覆盖9个数据集与GIN、GCN、GATv2在2–5层的模型组合。
AI.result: 9个GIN对照全部满足理论预测的等价性；在目标logit上，11个可报告GCN/GATv2单元中有10个的相对保真度随评估干预变化，其中9个单元里每种排序在其自身构建所用干预下具有更大的删除面积。
AI.conclusion: 删除保真度并非边排序本身的属性，而是排序与干预共同决定的量。评估协议应显式报告干预方式、输出泛函、目标与扰动单元，并在科学问题不唯一确定干预时测试替代干预语义。

title: iMED: A Multi-Endoscope Dataset for Surgical 3D Perception
comment: Published at ECCV 2026. 25 pages, including supplementary material. Code and dataset: https://github.com/surgical-vision/imed
summary: We introduce iMED, the first synchronized multi-endoscope dataset for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS), designed to address a fundamental limitation in surgical vision benchmarking: the absence of independent held-out viewpoints. Existing surgical datasets capture single-trajectory sequences from a single endoscope, making it impossible to distinguish geometric generalization from photometric interpolation along a narrow forward-facing path. iMED provides 340 sequences ~170K synchronized timepoints with 4 views per timepoint) recorded simultaneously from two independent stereo endoscopes across ex vivo, postmortem, and live surgical settings, spanning 14 specimens with diverse anatomical regions and motion regimes. The dataset includes calibrated camera intrinsics, ArUco-based frame-wise pose estimates with uncertainty quantification, instrument segmentation masks, and rich clinical metadata. Using a train-on-one-endoscope, test-on-another evaluation protocol, we benchmark 23 state-of-the-art methods across rigid and deformable novel view synthesis, pose estimation, feature matching, and monocular depth estimation. Our experiments show that methods relying primarily on photometric supervision degrade substantially under this held-out-endoscope setting, while methods with explicit geometric regularization are more robust across views in our benchmark. Notably, large-scale foundation models transfer surprisingly well to surgical imagery, often outperforming domain-specific models, suggesting pitfalls in current fine-tuning protocols. iMED establishes a new evaluation protocol for geometric generalization in surgical vision.

AI.tldr: iMED是首个同步多内窥镜RAMIS数据集，提供340个序列、约17万个同步时间点（每点4视角），用"一镜训练、另一镜测试"协议评估23种方法，揭示光度监督方法在留出视角下显著退化。
AI.motivation: 现有手术视觉数据集均为单内窥镜单轨迹序列，无法区分几何泛化与沿狭窄前向路径的光度插值，缺少独立留出视角，导致基准评测存在根本性缺陷。
AI.method: 由两个独立立体内窥镜同时采集，覆盖离体、尸检与活体场景、14个样本及多种解剖区域与运动模式；提供标定内参、基于ArUco的逐帧位姿估计及不确定度、器械分割掩码与临床元数据；采用train-on-one-endoscope/test-on-another协议，在刚性与可变形新视角合成、位姿估计、特征匹配、单目深度估计四类任务上基准23种SOTA方法。
AI.result: 主要依赖光度监督的方法在留出内窥镜设定下性能显著下降；具显式几何正则的方法跨视角更鲁棒；大规模基础模型向手术图像迁移效果出奇地好，常优于领域专用模型，提示现有微调协议存在隐患。
AI.conclusion: iMED为手术视觉中的几何泛化建立了新的评测协议，弥补了独立留出视角缺失的空白，并对方法设计与微调策略提出新的评估标准。

title: RAHC: Rule-Augmented Hyper-Relational Knowledge Graph Completion for Materials Synthesis
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, including references and appendices
summary: Scientific discovery depends on reusing experimental knowledge, yet records scattered across papers and repositories are often incomplete. In materials synthesis, recovering missing conditions requires reasoning about the target material and the observed context of a specific experiment. Hyper-relational knowledge graphs (HKGs) represent this context through qualifiers, but existing completion methods leave domain knowledge and experimental regularities implicit. We propose RAHC, a rule-augmented HKG framework for single-slot and joint multi-slot synthesis-condition completion. RAHC builds a traceable rule catalog from training records and retrieved literature, retrieves rules for each query-candidate pair, and separately encodes graph structure and rule evidence. Hard rules constrain candidate validity, while soft rules guide ranking. RAHC-G aggregates rules using global reliability; RAHC-Q additionally learns query-specific relevance. Gated fusion combines structural and rule representations, while tuple-conclusion rules provide cross-condition evidence for joint completion. Experiments on five materials-synthesis datasets show improvements in single-slot and joint completion under Semi-inductive and Open-Answer Inductive settings, with Semi-inductive MRR gains of up to 15.6% over MAYPL. RAHC also improves performance on the entity-disjoint ILPC'22 Small benchmark, supporting transfer to fully inductive KG completion. These results support experimental condition selection, synthesis planning, and the reuse of scientific knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出规则增强的超关系知识图谱框架 RAHC，建模材料合成条件补全，兼顾结构信息与可追溯规则证据，在单槽与联合多槽补全任务上显著提升。
AI.motivation: 科学发现依赖实验知识复用，但论文与数据仓库中的记录常不完整。材料合成中缺失条件需要结合目标材料与具体实验观测上下文进行推理；超关系知识图谱可用 qualifiers 表示这类上下文，但现有补全方法将领域知识与实验规律隐含化，缺乏可解释、可追溯的规则支撑。
AI.method: RAHC 从训练记录与检索文献中构建可追溯规则库；对每个查询-候选对检索相关规则；分别编码图结构与规则证据。硬规则约束候选有效性，软规则用于排序。RAHC-G 以全局可靠性聚合规则，RAHC-Q 额外学习查询特定相关性；采用门控融合结构表示与规则表示；元组结论型规则为联合补全提供跨条件证据。
AI.result: 在五个材料合成数据集上，半归纳与开放答案归纳设置下单槽及联合补全都取得提升，半归纳 MRR 相较 MAYPL 最高提升 15.6%；实体不相交的 ILPC'22 Small 基准上亦有改进，表明可迁移至完全归纳式 KG 补全。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入领域规则与实验规律并与图结构融合，可有效提升超关系图谱补全性能与可解释性，支撑实验条件选择、合成规划与科学知识复用。

title: Non-Interfering Asymmetric AdamW Updates for Constrained Exploration of Equifinality in Hybrid Models
summary: Hybrid models let neural networks supply the unresolved parameters of a process-based simulator, and are fitted to observations that constrain aggregate fluxes and storages but not the internal partitioning that produces them. Such a fit is equifinal: configurations indistinguishable in the observed aggregates can disagree substantially about the unobserved internals, and therefore about the mechanism they attribute to the same data. We study evapotranspiration, whose total flux is observed while its split into transpiration and evaporation is not. A model ensemble built from random seeds alone spans only a narrow band of the partitionings the data admit. We produce the spread deliberately, training members under auxiliary repulsion on transpiration, subject to the fit to observations not degrading. Non-interference is usually arranged by making the auxiliary gradient orthogonal to the main one, but under AdamW the applied step is a preconditioned momentum direction, so orthogonality between raw gradients no longer implies it. We introduce Non-interfering Asymmetric Network Optimization (NANO), an update whose first-order effect on the main loss is exactly that of the main objective alone, whose auxiliary step is bounded, and which concentrates repulsion in the coordinates the main gradient leaves idle.

AI.tldr: 提出NANO优化算法，使混合模型中辅助梯度（排斥项）对主损失的一阶影响完全等于主目标单独更新，在AdamW下实现不干扰，从而主动生成蒸发/蒸腾分配的可容许解集合。
AI.motivation: 混合模型中神经网络提供过程模拟器的未解参数，拟合仅约束聚合通量与储量，内部划分不可观测，导致"等终性"（equifinality）：观测聚合量相同的构型在内部机制上可能差异巨大。仅靠随机种子集成的模型只能覆盖数据所允许分配方式中的很窄一段。作者希望主动、可控地产生这种分配离散度，同时不牺牲对观测的拟合。
AI.method: 以蒸散（ET）为案例：总通量可观测，蒸腾/蒸发拆分不可观测。在训练中加入针对蒸腾的辅助"排斥"项以主动拉开成员间分配。为解决不干扰问题，指出AdamW下的更新步是预条件动量方向，原始梯度正交并不保证更新正交。据此提出非干扰非对称网络优化（NANO）：其更新对主损失的一阶效应与仅用主目标时完全相同，辅助步长有界，并把排斥集中作用于主梯度留下的空闲坐标。
AI.result: 在蒸散分配任务上，NANO能在拟合观测不退化的情况下，刻意生成比随机种子集成更宽的蒸腾/蒸发分配谱，从而暴露观测数据对内部机制所容许的不确定性范围。
AI.conclusion: 等终性是混合模型拟合聚合观测的固有属性，应被显式刻画而非掩盖；需要一个在预条件优化器（AdamW）下真正非干扰的更新规则来产生可容许的内部机制集合，NANO给出了满足该性质、辅助步有界且集中于空闲坐标的构造。

title: Beyond Local Refinement: Wide-Area Precise Cross-View Localization
summary: Fine-grained cross-view localization aims to precisely localize a ground camera against geo-referenced aerial imagery, but current methods typically assume a narrow geographic prior, substantially limiting their applicability when upstream localization remains coarse. To bridge this gap, we study this task over much larger aerial regions. However, this seemingly simple extension fundamentally changes the localization problem: the growing disparity in spatial extent between ground and aerial views makes reliable cross-view matching difficult to establish directly, while the increasing number of look-alike locations in larger regions introduces substantial visual ambiguity. To address these challenges, we propose RingMatch, a search-and-verification framework for wide-area cross-view localization. RingMatch first leverages predictive uncertainty to uncover plausible locations and progressively zooms into their surroundings to obtain increasingly fine-grained evidence, yielding a compact set of promising candidates. We then introduce the depth ring, a novel geometric representation that reveals subtle variations in the spatial layout around a location and serves as a view-shared spatial signature for an LVLM verifier to resolve residual ambiguity. To benchmark this setting, we construct VIGOR-Pro by composing VIGOR aerial tiles into contiguous regions with spatial extents of up to 400 m. Experiments show that RingMatch maintains strong localization performance as the aerial region expands, consistently outperforming representative end-to-end and retrieval-based methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 RingMatch，一个"搜索-验证"框架，用于广域（大范围航拍区域）精细跨视角定位，并用 VIGOR-Pro 基准验证其在大范围下仍保持强定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度跨视角定位方法通常假设较窄的地理先验（小范围候选区域），当上游定位较粗时适用性大幅受限。将任务扩展到更大航拍区域会带来两个本质困难：地-空视角空间范围差异扩大导致直接跨视角匹配不可靠；大区域内相似/重复地标增多带来严重视觉歧义。
AI.method: RingMatch 分为两阶段：1）搜索阶段——利用预测不确定性发现可能位置，并逐步放大/缩放到其周边获取由粗到细的证据，得到紧凑的候选集合；2）验证阶段——提出"深度环（depth ring）"几何表示，刻画位置周边空间布局的细微变化，作为视角共享的空间签名，交由 LVLM 验证器消除残余歧义。同时构建 VIGOR-Pro 基准，将 VIGOR 航拍瓦片拼接成连续区域，空间范围最大达 400 m。
AI.result: 在 VIGOR-Pro 上，RingMatch 在航拍区域扩大时仍保持强定位性能，一致优于代表性的端到端方法与基于检索的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过不确定性驱动的由粗到细搜索加几何签名验证，可有效应对广域跨视角定位中的范围失配与视觉歧义问题，为大范围地理先验下的细粒度跨视角定位提供了新设定、方法与基准。

title: AgenticFinBench: Benchmarking Financial Agents on Diverse Tasks from Real-World Requests
summary: Financial agents are becoming an important class of real-world AI systems. Financial tasks vary widely in type and difficulty, and many are open-ended with no ground-truth answers. However, existing benchmarks neither capture this breadth and open-endedness nor separate grounding from correctness. To bridge this gap, we introduce $\textbf{AgenticFinBench}$, a benchmark of 230 real-world financial tasks spanning 8 categories, 2 languages, and 4 complexity levels. We also propose a reference-free evaluation framework that combines question-specific rubrics with a two-stage claim audit that detects hallucinations, defined as claims absent from the agent's trace and refuted by external evidence. This framework better matches how financial work is assessed in practice. Experiments across 18 agent configurations reveal three key findings: (1) Ignoring hallucinations can overstate agent performance: hallucination auditing lowers the baseline leader's score by 7.58 points and moves it to fourth place. (2) Harness differences explain more variation in evidence grounding than model differences (28.6% vs 8.8%). (3) Quality scores fall from 89.44 on direct retrieval to 79.18 on the most complex tasks. Case studies show that agents struggle to explain how events affect company profits or stock prices, compare financial data on a consistent basis, and justify their conclusions. By releasing AgenticFinBench, we aim to advance financial reasoning, factual verification, and agent design for more reliable responses to diverse real-world financial requests. Our project page is at $\textbf{https://nashnovaresearch.github.io/AgenticFinBench/}$.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgenticFinBench：230 个真实金融任务基准（8 类、2 语言、4 难度）及无参考答案评估框架，结合任务专属评分细则与两阶段声明审计来检测幻觉；18 种智能体配置实验表明忽略幻觉会高估性能、框架差异比模型差异更能解释证据接地差异。
AI.motivation: 现有金融智能体基准未覆盖任务的广度与开放性，且未将证据接地（grounding）与答案正确性分离评估。
AI.method: 构建 AgenticFinBench（230 个真实金融任务，覆盖 8 类、2 语言、4 复杂度层级）；提出无参考评估框架：问题专属 rubric 评分 + 两阶段声明审计，将幻觉定义为智能体轨迹中缺失且被外部证据反驳的声明；对 18 种智能体配置进行实验与案例分析。
AI.result: (1) 忽略幻觉会高估性能：加入幻觉审计后基线榜首得分下降 7.58 分并跌至第四；(2) harness（框架/执行环境）差异对证据接地的解释力（28.6%）高于模型差异（8.8%）；(3) 质量分从直接检索任务的 89.44 降至最复杂任务的 79.18。案例显示智能体难以解释事件对公司利润/股价的影响路径、难以在一致口径上比较财务数据、难以论证结论。
AI.conclusion: 发布 AgenticFinBench 以推动金融推理、事实核验与智能体设计，从而更可靠地应对多样化真实金融请求。

title: Koopman Generative Operators for Efficient Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Probabilistic time-series forecasting requires models that simultaneously capture structured temporal dynamics, expressive uncertainty, and efficient inference, yet existing approaches fall short of this goal: latent dynamical models impose structure but rely on restrictive generation mechanisms, while modern generative methods such as diffusion and flow matching achieve flexibility at the cost of iterative and computationally expensive sampling. We introduce the Koopman Generative Operator (KGO), a probabilistic forecasting method that conceptualizes prediction as the evolution of structured uncertainty. KGO integrates three core components: (1) Koopman Patch Embedding (KoPE) for temporally consistent latent trajectory extrapolation; (2) Koopman Flow Matching (KoFM), which enables fast, single-step generation through a closed-form matrix exponential in a Koopman latent space, bypassing iterative sampling; and (3) an Adaptive Uncertainty Gate (AUG), which provides probabilistic forecasts by adapting uncertainty per-variable and per-horizon, corresponding to a learned decomposition of aleatoric uncertainty without manual tuning. By unifying these components, KGO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on 13/17 ProbTS benchmarks in CRPS and 16/17 in NMAE. Further, by eliminating iterative sampling, KGO delivers at least a 25$\times$ reduction in inference time compared to iterative generative models. These results position KGO as a practical and principled framework that advances the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in probabilistic time-series forecasting, combining leading accuracy on the evaluated benchmarks with fast, single-step generation.

AI.tldr: KGO将概率时序预测建模为"结构化不确定性演化"，用Koopman Patch Embedding、Koopman Flow Matching（闭式矩阵指数单步生成）和自适应不确定性门控实现高精度、单步快速的概率预测。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以同时兼顾结构化时序动力学、表达力强的不确定性建模与高效推理：潜变量动力学模型结构清晰但生成机制受限；扩散/流匹配等生成模型灵活却需迭代采样、计算昂贵。
AI.method: 提出Koopman Generative Operator（KGO），包含三个组件：(1) Koopman Patch Embedding（KoPE）实现时间一致的潜轨迹外推；(2) Koopman Flow Matching（KoFM）在Koopman潜空间中通过闭式矩阵指数实现快速单步生成，绕开迭代采样；(3) Adaptive Uncertainty Gate（AUG）按变量与预测步长自适应建模不确定性，对应一种无需人工调参的、可学习的偶然不确定性分解。
AI.result: 在ProbTS的17个基准中，CRPS有13个、NMAE有16个达到SOTA；消除迭代采样后，相比迭代式生成模型推理时间至少降低25倍。
AI.conclusion: KGO作为实用且有理论依据的框架，改善了概率时序预测的精度—效率权衡，在评测基准上兼具领先精度与快速单步生成能力。

title: Pixel-space video generation with U-JiT
summary: Latent diffusion and flow matching models are ubiquitous in state-of-the-art generative video models. While highly effective, relying on pretrained autoencoders to compress the data into a lower-dimensional latent space also comes with drawbacks. First, training proceeds in two stages: autoencoder pretraining, with compression and reconstruction objectives, followed by latent generative model training, precluding fully end-to-end training. Second, autoencoders also lead to an inherent loss of signal, and the trade-off between reconstruction quality and generative performance in the latent space is still an active area of research. In this paper we explore the viability of generative video models directly in pixel space. We analyze recent approaches in pixel-space generative modeling of images that rely on basic transformer designs, and identify several shortcomings that limit their effectiveness for the high-dimensional pixel-space video generation. To overcome these limitations, we propose a UNet-like transformer architecture along with improvements to the training recipe and sampling strategy. We conduct controlled experiments, training latent and pixel-space models from scratch on Kinetics-600. For the standard frames-to-video task at 128 resolution, our U-JiT model improves generative FVD by 27% over prior state-of-the-art results, and by 14% against the JiT pixel-space baseline. Scaling to higher 256 resolution, we find the improvement over pixel-space and latent-based models grows as we increase the spatiotemporal compression rate up to $64 \times 64 \times 8$. Finally, we find that U-JiT improves per-frame FID by 27% over latent models and 61% over pixel-space models on class-to-video generation, with respectively 9% and 56% reduction in FVD.

AI.tldr: 提出UNet-like的Transformer架构U-JiT，配合改进的训练与采样策略，直接在像素空间生成视频，在Kinetics-600上超越隐空间扩散/流匹配模型（FVD降低27%）。
AI.motivation: 现有SOTA视频生成依赖预训练自编码器将数据压缩到隐空间，导致：(1) 两阶段训练，无法端到端；(2) 自编码器带来固有信号损失，重建质量与生成性能之间的权衡仍是开放问题。因此作者探索直接在像素空间做生成式视频建模的可行性。
AI.method: 分析近期基于基础Transformer设计的像素空间图像生成方法，指出其在高维像素空间视频生成中的不足；提出UNet-like的Transformer架构（U-JiT），并改进训练配方与采样策略；在Kinetics-600上从零训练隐空间与像素空间模型做受控对比实验。
AI.result: 128分辨率frames-to-video任务上，U-JiT的生成FVD较此前SOTA提升27%，较JiT像素空间基线提升14%；扩展到256分辨率、时空压缩率增至64×64×8时，相对像素空间与隐空间模型的优势进一步扩大；class-to-video任务上，逐帧FID较隐空间模型提升27%、较像素空间模型提升61%，FVD分别降低9%和56%。
AI.conclusion: 像素空间视频生成在架构与训练/采样策略改进后可行且优于隐空间方案，且随分辨率与压缩率提升优势更明显，为规避自编码器两阶段训练与信号损失提供了有力替代路径。

title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Submodular Trajectory Rewards
summary: We study cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning with decoupled dynamics and a monotone submodular reward function over joint trajectories. Due to the non-additive reward, an optimal policy may depend on the history of all agents. This dependence makes exact optimization exponential in the horizon and the number of agents. To overcome this challenge while retaining theoretical guarantees, we introduce pre-window curvature $c_m$, which quantifies how states visited more than $m$ steps earlier reduce current marginal gains. Using this curvature to control the error from restricting the policy of each agent to depend only on its last $m+1$ states, we propose a greedy algorithm that exploits the decoupled dynamics to optimize local policies sequentially. For fixed $m$, the algorithm achieves a $\frac{1-c_m}{2-c_m}$ approximation guarantee up to estimation error, and its computation time is polynomial in the number of agents and the horizon. We recover the known $1/2$-factor approximation for time-additive rewards and obtain an approximation factor no smaller than the known total-curvature bound for a single agent. We formulate multi-agent traffic monitoring as an example of this framework and evaluate our algorithm on it.

AI.tldr: 研究解耦动力学+单调子模奖励的多智能体强化学习，引入pre-window curvature $c_m$ 控制策略历史截断误差，提出顺序优化局部策略的贪心算法，获得 $(1-c_m)/(2-c_m)$ 近似保证且计算量为智能体数与时间跨度的多项式。
AI.motivation: 联合轨迹上的单调子模奖励不可加，最优策略可能依赖所有智能体的完整历史，精确优化复杂度对时间跨度和智能体数呈指数增长。需要一种既能降低复杂度又保留理论保证的方法。
AI.method: 定义 pre-window curvature $c_m$，度量m步之前访问的状态对当前边际增益的削弱程度；据此将每个智能体的策略限制为仅依赖最近m+1个状态，控制截断误差；利用解耦动力学提出贪心算法，依次优化各智能体的局部策略。
AI.result: 对固定m，算法达到 $\frac{1-c_m}{2-c_m}$ 的近似保证（至多存在估计误差），计算时间对智能体数和时间跨度均为多项式。时间可加奖励下恢复已知的1/2近似因子；单智能体情形下所得近似因子不小于已知的总曲率界。以多智能体交通监控为实例进行建模与实验评估。
AI.conclusion: 通过pre-window curvature对历史依赖进行受控截断，可在多项式时间内获得可解释的近似保证，并统一/推广了时间可加奖励与单智能体总曲率情形的已知结果，适用于多智能体交通监控等子模奖励任务。

title: NightIQA: A Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for MLLM-Based Nighttime Image Quality Assessment
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 25 pages including supplementary material
summary: Nighttime images are inherently susceptible to complex, compound degradations, making accurate quality assessment exceptionally challenging. Score-based IQA methods condense quality into a single number, lacking the multi-dimensional, language-grounded reasoning required for nighttime evaluation. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a more comprehensive alternative, yet remain constrained by a critical data gap: existing real-world IQA datasets are overwhelmingly daytime-centric and often built from outdated captures, while synthetic alternatives lack nighttime-specific degradation modeling, yielding artifacts far removed from authentic nighttime conditions. To bridge this gap, we present NightIQA, a dataset and benchmark suite purpose-built for MLLM-based nighttime IQA. It comprises three core components: NightIQA-Real, a real-world dataset of 1,769 high-resolution images that we captured ourselves with modern equipment, encompassing six canonical distortion types and structured multi-dimensional annotations; NightIQA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,078 visually grounded multiple-choice questions tailored to MLLM-based nighttime IQA, organized around a four-level evaluation hierarchy spanning Perception, Technical Assessment, Localization, and Reasoning; and NightIQA-Syn, an inherently scalable, scene-aware synthesis pipeline that jointly models global-level and instance-level degradations, with an initial release of 80k high-fidelity images alongside the full generation code. Fine-tuned on NightIQA with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), Qwen3-VL-8B outperforms open-source IQA methods and achieves higher overall accuracy than leading closed-source models, highlighting the value of domain-specific data and structured supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NightIQA，一个面向MLLM夜间图像质量评估的数据集与基准套件，包含真实采集数据集NightIQA-Real（1,769张高清图、6类失真、多维标注）、四层级多选题基准NightIQA-Bench（1,078题）以及场景感知合成管线NightIQA-Syn（首发8万张合成图及生成代码）。经SFT+GRPO微调的Qwen3-VL-8B在整体准确率上超过开源IQA方法并优于领先闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 夜间图像存在复杂复合退化，传统打分式IQA仅输出单一分数，缺乏多维、语言可解释的推理能力；MLLM虽更全面，却面临严重数据缺口：现有真实IQA数据集以白天为主且采集设备陈旧，而合成数据缺乏夜间特有退化建模，伪影明显、与真实夜间条件差距大。
AI.method: 构建NightIQA三位一体套件：(1) NightIQA-Real——自采1,769张高分辨率真实夜间图像，覆盖六种典型失真类型并提供结构化多维标注；(2) NightIQA-Bench——1,078道视觉接地多选题，按“感知—技术评估—定位—推理”四级评估体系组织；(3) NightIQA-Syn——可扩展的场景感知合成管线，联合建模全局级与实例级退化，并开源生成代码。训练上采用SFT与GRPO对Qwen3-VL-8B进行微调。
AI.result: 微调后的Qwen3-VL-8B在基于NightIQA的评测中优于开源IQA方法，整体准确率超过领先的闭源模型，验证了领域专用数据与结构化监督的价值。
AI.conclusion: 夜间IQA需要多维、语言接地的评估范式；高质量的真实夜间数据与可控合成管线是释放MLLM能力的核心，结构化四级监督能显著提升模型性能，NightIQA为夜间IQA研究提供了数据集、基准与可扩展生成的统一基础设施。

title: The Pen is Mightier than the Pixel: Natural Textual Unlearnable Example for Large Vision Language Models
summary: The proliferation of Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs), trained on vast and often sensitive datasets, raised concerns regarding data privacy and unauthorized usage. Unlearnable Examples (UEs), which subtly perturb training data to mislead the models, have emerged as a promising defense method. This paper presents the first exploration of UEs specifically on LVLMs, which poses unique challenges due to their inherent multimodal nature. We propose a novel text-based perturbation method, Natural Textual Unlearnable Examples (NTUE), which can effectively mislead LVLMs by subtly manipulating the image label, establishing a shortcut between an identity of interest and a separate target, without introducing factual misinformation or affecting readability. Comprehensive experiments compared with traditional UE methods demonstrate the superior performance of NTUE. Our findings show that NTUE achieves a high success rate with a poison rate as low as 5%, underscoring its potential as a practical and robust solution for protecting multimodal data in the era of LVLMs.

AI.tldr: 首次研究面向大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的不可学习样本，提出基于文本扰动的 Natural Textual Unlearnable Examples（NTUE）。
AI.motivation: LVLMs 训练数据规模庞大且常含敏感信息，引发数据隐私与未授权使用担忧；现有 UE 方法面向单模态模型，难以适配 LVLMs 固有的多模态特性。
AI.method: 在图像标签层面做细微文本扰动，在"感兴趣的实体/身份"与另一目标之间建立捷径（shortcut），从而误导 LVLMs；不引入事实性错误信息，也不影响文本可读性。
AI.result: 与传统 UE 方法对比实验显示 NTUE 性能更优；在低至 5% 的投毒率下仍取得高成功率。
AI.conclusion: NTUE 可作为 LVLMs 时代保护多模态数据的实用且鲁棒的方案。

title: Density-Aware Reward Scaling: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Reward-Proportional Sampling
summary: Reinforcement learning objectives that maximize expected return can concentrate probability mass on a small subset of high-reward outcomes, limiting diversity when multiple distinct solutions are desirable. We introduce Density-Aware Reward Scaling (DARS), a simple reward-processing mechanism that promotes reward-proportional sampling in continuous outcome spaces while retaining standard policy-gradient training. DARS estimates the local density of outcomes within each on-policy rollout group and inversely scales rewards by this density. The method requires no learned density model, auxiliary objective, critic, or modification to the underlying policy-gradient objective. In a controlled multimodal navigation task, DARS-GRPO avoids the single-mode collapse exhibited by GRPO and closely recovers the target mode allocation. Applied to text-to-image prompt adaptation, DARS-GRPO consistently improves image and prompt diversity across datasets, Policy LMs, and reward settings while maintaining good semantic alignment. These results show that density-aware reward scaling provides a lightweight way to improve coverage of diverse high-reward outcomes within existing reinforcement-learning pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出密度感知奖励缩放（DARS），按 rollout 组内结果局部密度反比缩放奖励，在不改变策略梯度目标的前提下促进奖励成比例采样、缓解多样性塌缩。
AI.motivation: 最大化期望回报的强化学习目标会把概率质量集中到少数高奖励结果上，当需要多个不同解时多样性受限。
AI.method: DARS 是一种简单的奖励处理机制：在每个 on-policy rollout 组内估计结果的局部密度，并用该密度对奖励做反比缩放；无需学习密度模型、辅助目标、critic，也不修改底层策略梯度目标，仅与 GRPO 结合使用。
AI.result: 在受控多峰导航任务中，DARS-GRPO 避免了 GRPO 的单模态塌缩，并较好恢复目标模式分配；在文本到图像提示适配中，跨数据集、Policy LM 与奖励设置一致提升图像与提示多样性，同时保持良好语义对齐。
AI.conclusion: 密度感知奖励缩放是一种轻量方法，可在现有强化学习流程内提升对多样化高奖励结果的覆盖。

title: Radial distortion homography estimation from affine-covariant or orientation-covariant features
summary: We present minimal solvers for joint homography and radial distortion estimation using affine- or orientation-covariant features. The core contribution is a set of novel constraints that exploit local feature geometry inherent to affine descriptors, enabling solvers that require fewer correspondences than point-based methods. Using modern robust estimation frameworks, we demonstrate that the proposed solvers are advantageous to the current state-of-the-art with a significant speed-up in the presence of outliers while maintaining comparable or superior estimation accuracy. The proposed solvers are tested on both synthetic and real images containing challenging fisheye distortions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用仿射/方向协变特征的联合单应性与径向畸变最小求解器，通过挖掘仿射描述子的局部特征几何构造新约束，所需对应点少于点基方法，并在鲁棒估计框架下实现更快速度与相当或更优精度。
AI.motivation: 传统点基方法在联合估计单应与径向畸变时需要较多对应点，最小解样本数大导致鲁棒估计（如RANSAC）假设生成开销高、外点下速度慢。仿射描述子携带的局部几何信息未被充分利用。
AI.method: 构建一组利用仿射描述子固有局部特征几何的新约束，据此导出联合单应与径向畸变的最小求解器；求解器基于仿射协变或方向协变特征，并嵌入现代鲁棒估计框架中进行假设生成与验证。
AI.result: 所需对应点数少于点基方法；在外点存在时相较当前最优方法显著提速，同时保持相当或更优的估计精度；在合成数据与含挑战性鱼眼畸变的真实图像上均验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 利用仿射特征的局部几何可降低最小解所需样本数，从而在鲁棒联合估计中兼顾效率与精度，适用于强鱼眼畸变场景下的单应与畸变联合标定。

title: Reconstructing Fraudulent Strategies in Online Payments via Interpretable Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Payment fraud causes financial losses and undermines users' trust in web payment services. Although fraud detection is a critical defense for payment security, complex and diverse fraudulent behaviors can still evade detection. Generating fraud samples for data augmentation can broaden detectors' coverage of different fraud patterns. However, existing methods matching the distribution of transaction attributes alone do not ensure that generated sequences preserve the sequential relationships among transaction choices, payment feedback, and subsequent behavioral adjustments. To this end, we propose PaySeqGen, an interpretable inverse reinforcement learning framework that reconstructs fraud behavior policies from fraudsters' observed payment trajectories. We design a mechanism for constructing candidate actions to support plausible payment sequence generation while enabling exploration. The framework also learns interpretable behavioral rewards that capture fraudsters' preferences across different transaction contexts. By alternating between reward learning and policy optimization, the framework reconstructs policies that generate new fraud sequences for detector augmentation and learns interpretable rewards supporting sequential fraud-pattern analysis in real trajectories. Experiments in real-world payment scenarios at Ant International, a leading global digital payment provider, show that PaySeqGen outperforms state-of-the-art generative augmentation methods. Reward-based trajectory analysis also identifies fraud patterns of practical value, helping analyst locating suspicious segments and examine multistep fraud tactics. Evaluation in the deployed system of online payment further confirms its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出PaySeqGen，一个可解释的逆强化学习框架，从欺诈者观测到的支付轨迹中重建欺诈行为策略，用于生成欺诈序列以增强检测器，并学习可解释行为奖励以支持欺诈模式分析。
AI.motivation: 支付欺诈造成经济损失并损害用户对网络支付服务的信任。现有生成式增强方法仅匹配交易属性的分布，无法保证生成序列保留"交易选择—支付反馈—后续行为调整"之间的时序依赖关系，导致多样复杂的欺诈行为仍可逃逸检测。
AI.method: 1）设计候选动作构建机制，支持生成合理的支付序列并允许探索；2）以逆强化学习从欺诈轨迹中学习可解释的行为奖励，刻画欺诈者在不同交易情境下的偏好；3）在奖励学习与策略优化间交替迭代，重建欺诈行为策略以生成新欺诈序列。
AI.result: 在Ant International真实支付场景的实验中，PaySeqGen优于当前最先进的生成式增强方法；基于奖励的轨迹分析识别出具有实用价值的欺诈模式，帮助分析师定位可疑片段并审查多步欺诈手法；线上支付系统部署评估进一步验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过逆强化学习重建欺诈策略，可在保留时序行为逻辑的前提下生成高质量欺诈样本，兼顾检测增强与可解释分析，并已在真实支付系统中验证有效。

title: Training Specialist LLMs on Your Phone: Forward-Only Optimization via Block-Spectral Coordinates
summary: Large language models (LLMs) on personal devices keep user data local, but limited memory restricts their general capability. Since most user-specific tasks do not require the breadth of frontier models, a practical solution is to adapt a shared on-device model into lightweight specialists. However, backpropagation is prohibitive in memory, and users rarely provide labeled data. We present MobileSpec, a system that trains specialists with forward passes alone and learns from automatically checked task outcomes, as in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Because forward-only updates are built from random perturbations, training is efficient only when these perturbations resemble the weight changes of RLVR, which largely preserve the singular values of pretrained weights and rotate their singular vectors. The core algorithm of MobileSpec, FuRA-S, produces such perturbations while training only the block-spectral coordinates of pretrained weights, namely the singular values of their column blocks. As we show theoretically and empirically, rescaling these blocks independently shifts their relative contributions to each weight matrix and thereby rotates its singular vectors. Since this update can be rewritten as a transformation of the layer input, FuRA-S also adapts INT4 models without modifying their weights. With specialists of only 1-5 MB that update 0.015-0.05% of the parameters, MobileSpec raises the success rate of a phone-use agent from 6-23% up to 89-100% and trains a personalized 8B model on an iPhone 16 Pro overnight. On RLVR benchmarks, FuRA-S is competitive with full-parameter evolution strategies (ES) and outperforms ES over LoRA adapters and quantized ES on INT4 models.

AI.tldr: MobileSpec 是一个在设备端仅用前向传播训练个性化“专家”轻量适配器（1–5 MB）的系统，其核心算法 FuRA-S 通过学习预训练权重的块谱坐标（列块奇异值）产生近似 RLVR 的随机扰动，可在 INT4 模型上以输入变换形式实现适配。
AI.motivation: 端侧 LLM 可保护数据隐私，但内存受限削弱通用能力；多数用户任务无需前沿模型广度，故需将共享端侧模型适配为轻量专家。然而反向传播内存开销过大，且用户难以提供标注数据。
AI.method: 采用仅前向传播、基于可自动校验任务结果的 RLVR 式训练；理论分析指出仅当前向随机扰动近似 RLVR 的权重变化（基本保持奇异值、旋转奇异向量）时训练才高效；FuRA-S 仅训练预训练权重列块的奇异值（块谱坐标），对各块独立重缩放以改变其对权重矩阵的相对贡献从而旋转奇异向量，且该更新可改写为层输入变换，从而在 INT4 模型上无需改权重即可适配。
AI.result: 专家仅 1–5 MB、更新 0.015–0.05% 参数；手机使用智能体的成功率由 6–23% 提升至 89–100%；可在 iPhone 16 Pro 上整夜训练个性化 8B 模型；RLVR 基准上与全参数 ES 相当，并优于 LoRA 适配器上的 ES 与 INT4 量化 ES。
AI.conclusion: 面向端侧个性化的前向式训练可行且高效：块谱坐标扰动是内存友好、与 RLVR 行为一致的适配路径，兼具存储极小、可量化兼容与强实证效果。

title: OCR in the Foundation Model Era: From Specialist Models to Unified Models
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is among the oldest and most widely deployed applications of artificial intelligence. This survey reviews its development, focusing on the Foundation Model Era. We define OCR through faithful transcription: within a specified visual scope, OCR should completely reconstruct the text, notation, and document structure observable in the source image, and every textual, notational, or structural element in the output must be verifiable from visual evidence in that image. We trace the development from specialist OCR models toward unified models, examining joint text detection and recognition, structured sequence generation, and the use of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). We organize contemporary OCR systems into five coexisting families: modular toolkits and task-specific models, specialized document VLMs, hybrid workflows, general-purpose VLMs, and commercial products and managed services. We compare their architectures, data, and training, examining hallucination and omission, insufficient spatial grounding, and inference cost in generative OCR. We review evaluation from character and scene text recognition to parsing individual structural elements and full-page transcription, highlighting gaps in consistent output definitions, attribution of performance to individual components, and coverage of real capture conditions and visible content and structure. Finally, we summarize the challenges facing OCR and discuss directions for future research. We continuously track related work at https://github.com/zhihengli-casia/Awesome-OCR-in-the-Foundation-Model-Era.

AI.tldr: 该综述在“基础模型时代”背景下，以“忠实转录”重新定义OCR，梳理从专用模型到统一模型的发展脉络，将当代OCR系统划分为五类共存的体系，比较其架构、数据与训练，并系统讨论生成式OCR的幻觉/遗漏、空间定位不足与推理成本等核心问题及评测缺口。
AI.motivation: OCR是人工智能最古老、应用最广的方向之一，但进入基础模型时代后，系统形态由专用模型转向统一/生成式模型，输出定义、能力边界与可靠性问题（幻觉、遗漏、空间 grounding 不足、成本）以及评测体系都亟需重新审视和梳理，因此需要一篇以基础模型为视角的系统综述。
AI.method: 采用综述性方法：1）以“忠实转录”为准则界定OCR任务——在给定视觉范围内完整重建图像中可观察的文本、符号与文档结构，且输出每一项均须由图像视觉证据可验证；2）沿“专用OCR模型→统一模型”演进的线索，考察文本检测与识别联合建模、结构化序列生成、预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）的引入；3）将现有系统归纳为五大类族并横向比较其架构、数据与训练；4）梳理评测从字符级/场景文本识别到结构元素解析与整页转录的演进。
AI.result: 形成对当代OCR的五大类族分类体系：模块化工具包与任务专用模型、专用文档VLM、混合式工作流、通用VLM、商业产品与托管服务；揭示生成式OCR的关键失效模式（幻觉与遗漏、空间定位不足、推理成本）；并指出评测层面的三类缺口：输出定义不一致、性能难以归因到单个组件、对真实拍摄条件及可见内容与结构的覆盖不足。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型时代的OCR已从专用流水线走向统一的多模态生成范式，但“忠实转录”的可验证性仍是根本标准；未来需在输出定义标准化、组件级归因评测、真实场景与版面结构覆盖，以及生成式模型的可靠性与成本控制等方向上继续研究，并持续跟踪相关进展。

title: On the Complexity of Finite-Sum Nonconvex-Strongly-Concave Minimax Optimization with Exact Proximal Oracles
comment: 50 pages, including appendices and references. Lean 4 formalization of the lower bounds in the ancillary files
summary: Finite-sum nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax problems arise in adversarial training and distributionally robust learning. Their known lower bounds cover only linear-span algorithms, zero-respecting algorithms, or a restricted proximal protocol. They leave open the power of exact component proximal steps, whose responses are global saddle points of regularized component problems and can expose directions that gradients do not reveal. We show that neither unrestricted adaptivity nor exact proximal access improves the polynomial complexity. We consider $n$ components with joint mean-squared smoothness $L$ and condition number $κ$, started from a point with primal gap at most $Δ$ and joint gradient norm at most $\sqrt{2LΔ}$. For $\varepsilon^2/(LΔ)$ below a universal constant, every randomized adaptive algorithm with exact component values, gradients, and proximal responses needs $Ω(n+\min\{\sqrt n\,κ,n^{3/4}\sqrtκ\}LΔ/\varepsilon^2)$ component queries in the worst case to find an $\varepsilon$-stationary point of the value function. A method using only component gradients attains this rate up to a factor $\log^2(2+κ)$, including initialization. Zhou (arXiv:2610.04944) concurrently proves the same rate for zero-respecting first-order methods. In our hard instances, every component admits proximal steps with the same step sizes, and a response for a component reveals hidden directions only up to the first one assigned to another component.

AI.tldr: 本文证明：对有限和、非凸-强凹极小极大问题，即使允许无限制自适应性和精确的分量近端步，随机算法的多项式复杂度下界仍为 Ω(n+min{√n·κ, n^{3/4}√κ}·LΔ/ε²) 次分量查询，且仅用梯度的算法可达到该速率（至多 log²(2+κ) 因子）。
AI.motivation: 此类问题出现在对抗训练与分布鲁棒学习中，但已有下界仅覆盖线性张成算法、zero-respecting算法或受限近端协议，未刻画精确分量近端步（可返回正则化分量问题的全局鞍点、暴露梯度无法揭示的方向）的能力，因而留下开放问题。
AI.method: 构造困难实例：n个分量、联合均方光滑常数L与条件数κ，起点满足原始间隙≤Δ且联合梯度范数≤√(2LΔ)；在该实例中所有分量可使用相同步长的近端步，而某分量的近端响应只能在有方向被分配给其他分量之前揭示隐藏方向，从而限制近端信息的作用。据此导出随机自适应算法的分量查询下界。
AI.result: 当 ε²/(LΔ) 小于某通用常数时，任何具备精确分量值、梯度与近端响应的随机自适应算法，最坏情况下需 Ω(n+min{√n·κ, n^{3/4}√κ}·LΔ/ε²) 次分量查询才能求得值函数的 ε-平稳点；仅用分量梯度的算法在含初始化在内达到该速率（差 log²(2+κ) 因子）。Zhou 同期对 zero-respecting 一阶方法证明了相同速率。
AI.conclusion: 无限制自适应性与精确近端访问均不能改善多项式复杂度；近端信息在下界意义下不提供本质加速，纯梯度方法在忽略对数因子时已最优。

title: VisSearch-Bench: Evaluating Long Horizon Visual Search in Multimodal Agents
summary: Multimodal agents use web and image tools to answer questions beyond their internal knowledge. Some search tasks use images mainly to identify an initial entity, then rely on text retrieval. These tasks offer limited insight into how agents connect information across images, objects, and search steps. We therefore focus on visual context management. This involves organizing and using visual information and linking it to other findings during search. Visually intensive tasks require agents to combine object appearance, local details, or spatial relations with external information. We introduce VisSearch-Bench, with 204 human-written tasks across 7 main domains and 25 subdomains. It covers Set-wise Visual Search, Sequential Visual Search, Hybrid Wide-Deep Search, Competitive Visual Disambiguation, and Visual-Structure-Guided Search. Each task provides a reference answer, traceable evidence, and scoring rules. Accuracy measures complete task success, while Process Score measures the correctness and completeness of individual results and subquestion answers. Across 16 multimodal models, the best system fully solves only 26.47% of tasks, even with search tools. These results highlight the challenge of linking visual evidence with search results to produce complete answers.

AI.tldr: 提出VisSearch-Bench，一个含204个人工编写任务、覆盖7大领域25个子领域的视觉密集搜索基准，用于评测多模态智能体的视觉上下文管理能力；最佳模型仅完整解决26.47%任务。
AI.motivation: 现有网页/图像工具搜索任务中，图像多仅用于识别初始实体，随后依赖文本检索，难以刻画智能体如何在图像、对象与搜索步骤之间建立跨模态信息连接，因此缺乏对"视觉上下文管理"能力的有效评测。
AI.method: 构建VisSearch-Bench：204个人工编写任务，覆盖7个主领域、25个子领域；任务类型包括集合式视觉搜索、序列式视觉搜索、混合宽深搜索、竞争性视觉消歧、视觉结构引导搜索。每个任务配参考答案、可溯源证据与评分规则；采用两项指标——Accuracy（任务整体成功率）与Process Score（单项结果及子问题答案的正确性与完整性）。在16个多模态模型上进行评测。
AI.result: 即便配备搜索工具，最佳系统也仅完整解决26.47%的任务；Process Score显示模型在单项结果与子问题层面同样存在正确性与完整性不足。
AI.conclusion: 视觉密集搜索的核心难点在于将视觉证据与检索结果有效关联并整合为完整答案，当前多模态智能体在该能力上仍显著不足；VisSearch-Bench为诊断此类能力提供了细粒度评测手段。

title: HTCE: Homeomorphism-inspired Topological Cross-Scene Experience Canonicalization and Reuse for Object Navigation
summary: As embodied agents perform object-goal navigation across residential environments, they accumulate successful experiences whose semantic structure recurs across scenes even when geometric trajectories do not. Reusing such experience is challenging because differences in region naming and observation granularity produce distinct graph representations of similar approaches, while meaningful differences in anchors, branches, and endpoints must stay distinguishable. We introduce HTCE, a homeomorphism-inspired topological framework that canonicalizes and reuses navigation experience. Feature and topology subdivisions characterize representational variations, and their semantically constrained reductions produce comparable semantic sequences and structural signatures while preserving semantic anchors, branching relations, and navigation endpoints. HTCE then retrieves historical successful approaches through subdivision-aware matching as guidance for a frozen vision-language policy. Canonicalization compresses the experience index losslessly, merging 17.7--23.6\% of distinct stored route descriptions while retaining full task performance. Under a single frozen vision-language backbone shared by all compared systems, HTCE attains the best SR and SPL in every setting---59.9\%/31.8\% on HM3D v0.1, 71.0\%/31.5\% on HM3D v0.2, and 46.6\%/16.6\% on MP3D---with SR gains of up to 4.9 points and structured retrieval contributing up to 2.8 SPL points. The code is available in https://github.com/startracker0/htce.git

AI.tldr: HTCE：一种同胚启发的拓扑框架，通过特征/拓扑细分对导航经验做规范化与无损压缩，并以细分感知匹配检索历史成功路线，为冻结的视觉-语言策略提供引导，在多数据集上取得最佳SR/SPL。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体在住宅环境中做物体目标导航时会积累成功经验，其语义结构跨场景复现，但几何轨迹不复现。重用困难在于：区域命名与观测粒度差异导致相似路线产生不同图表示，而锚点、分支、端点等有意义的差异又必须保持可区分。
AI.method: 提出HTCE框架：以特征细分与拓扑细分刻画表示层面的变异，并进行语义约束下的约简，生成可比较的语义序列与结构签名，同时保留语义锚点、分支关系和导航端点；随后通过细分感知匹配检索历史成功路线，作为冻结视觉-语言策略的引导信号。
AI.result: 规范化实现经验索引的无损压缩，合并17.7–23.6%的不同存储路线描述且任务性能不降。在统一的冻结VLM骨干下，各设置均取得最佳SR/SPL：HM3D v0.1为59.9%/31.8%，HM3D v0.2为71.0%/31.5%，MP3D为46.6%/16.6%；SR最高提升4.9点，结构化检索贡献最高2.8 SPL点。
AI.conclusion: 同胚启发的拓扑规范化可在不损失性能的前提下压缩并复用导航经验，细分感知的结构化检索对提升零样本/冻结策略的导航成功率与路径效率均有效。

title: Sleep-Disordered Breathing Detection with Quantum Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: This work investigates the application of Quantum Recurrent Neural Networks to the binary classification of sleep-disordered breathing events in time-series data, aiming to distinguish between apneic and normal breathing episodes. A variational classical--quantum architecture is proposed and evaluated against classical Recurrent Neural Network models. Experiments were conducted on multiple real-world datasets with varying levels of complexity to assess the strengths and limitations of the quantum approach. In the comparative analysis, both classical and quantum models showed comparable performance. The quantum model achieved superior performance on the smallest dataset, while yielding slightly weaker results in the most complex setting. However, the quantum approach exhibited notable strengths, such as competitive performance despite a drastically reduced parameter count and low-qubit regime, as well as good generalization capabilities. These results suggest that, despite current hardware and algorithmic limitations, variational quantum recurrent models represent a promising alternative for time-series classification as Quantum Computing technologies continue to mature.

AI.tldr: 本文将量子循环神经网络（QRNN）用于睡眠呼吸障碍事件的二分类（呼吸暂停 vs. 正常呼吸），提出变分经典—量子混合架构，并与经典RNN在多个真实数据集上对比；量子模型在最小数据集上最优、在最复杂场景略逊，但以极少的参数和少量量子比特取得可比性能且泛化良好。
AI.motivation: 评估量子循环模型在真实时序二分类任务上相对于经典RNN的实际价值与局限，探索在量子硬件与算法尚不成熟条件下其可行性与潜力。
AI.method: 构建变分经典—量子混合循环架构，在多个复杂度不同的真实数据集上进行睡眠呼吸事件二分类实验，并与经典RNN模型做对比分析（含参数量与量子比特规模的考量）。
AI.result: 经典与量子模型整体性能相当；量子模型在最小数据集上表现更优，在最复杂设置下略弱；量子方法在大幅减少参数量的低量子比特条件下仍具竞争力，且泛化能力良好。
AI.conclusion: 尽管受限于当前硬件与算法水平，变分量子循环模型是时序分类中一个有前景的替代方案，随着量子计算技术成熟有望进一步发展。

title: DGC-Net: Cross-Modal Dynamic Routing with Global-Guided Compensation in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: User-generated videos, including opinion vlogs and video reviews, provide a rich source of people's attitudes toward products, services, and social topics. Understanding the sentiment expressed by speakers is important for analyzing online opinions, as transcripts alone may not capture the attitude and intensity conveyed through vocal tone and facial expressions. Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) addresses this need by integrating textual, acoustic, and visual cues. However, these cues are often subtle, noisy, and inconsistent across modalities. Existing local affective cue modeling methods typically operate within individual modalities and overlook global contexts from other modalities. This may cause cross-modal affective cue inconsistency. Hierarchical global-local fusion methods integrate global semantics with fine-grained local affective cues. However, they commonly determine the relative contributions of the two representations implicitly, preventing the global-local contributions from adapting to the sample-dependent reliability of local cues and resulting in either insufficient use of informative local cues or excessive interference from unreliable ones. To address these issues, we propose DGC-Net, a Dynamic Gating and Global-Guided Compensation Network for MSA. DGC-Net mitigates cross-modal affective cue inconsistency through cross-modal contribution-aware dynamic expert routing. This mechanism uses auxiliary global contexts to guide local expert selection. Moreover, global-guided dynamic compensation fusion alleviates sample-dependent global-local contribution imbalance while preserving global semantic as the primary anchor and adaptively incorporating expert-refined local cues. Experiments on five multimodal benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and general applicability of DGC-Net, and ablation studies verify the contribution of each proposed component.

AI.tldr: 提出DGC-Net，通过跨模态贡献感知动态专家路由和全局引导动态补偿融合，解决多模态情感分析中跨模态情感线索不一致及全局-局部贡献失衡问题，在五个基准数据集上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 用户生成视频中说话人情感需结合文本、声学、视觉多模态线索分析；但线索微弱、含噪且跨模态不一致。现有局部情感线索建模仅在单模态内进行、忽视其他模态的全局上下文，导致跨模态情感线索不一致；层次化全局-局部融合方法又隐式决定两类表示的相对贡献，无法随样本自适应，造成局部线索利用不足或受不可靠线索过度干扰。
AI.method: DGC-Net包含两个核心机制：(1) 跨模态贡献感知动态专家路由，利用辅助全局上下文引导局部专家的选择，缓解跨模态情感线索不一致；(2) 全局引导动态补偿融合，以全局语义为主锚点，自适应引入专家精炼的局部线索，缓解样本相关的全局-局部贡献失衡。
AI.result: 在五个多模态基准数据集上实验表明DGC-Net有效且具有良好通用性；消融实验验证了各提出组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态门控与全局引导补偿，可在保持全局语义锚点的同时自适应整合可靠的局部情感线索，为跨模态情感线索一致性问题提供有效解决方案。

title: Anomaly Detection on Resource-Constrained Devices with Reservoir Computing
summary: Anomaly detection at the edge requires the deployment of models that achieve competitive performance, while minimizing computational cost and memory footprint. In this article, we investigate the suitability of the Mahalanobis Distance of Reservoir States (MDRS), an unsupervised time-series anomaly detection method, for resource-constrained devices and propose two optimizations to reduce its computational requirements. Specifically, we replace random reservoir connectivity (MDRS-Rand) with a circular shift (MDRS-Circ) and show that the anomaly score for an entire time series can be computed from the final reservoir state alone. Furthermore, we show that exploiting the reservoir's temporal memory enables more efficient input preprocessing, further reducing computational cost. We evaluate the MDRS variants on the MLPerf Tiny anomaly detection benchmark against the reference autoencoder and other anomaly detection methods, and deploy their inference kernels on a NUCLEO-F401RE microcontroller to assess latency, estimate energy consumption, and measure memory footprint. Among the evaluated methods, only MDRS and the autoencoder meet the benchmark's performance target, with MDRS requiring fewer operations and smaller models. With optimized preprocessing, MDRS achieves an ROC AUC of 0.869, a model size of 24 KB, an estimated energy consumption of 24 uJ per inference, and a latency of 0.32 ms, corresponding to a 75.9x speedup over the autoencoder with standard preprocessing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无监督时序异常检测方法MDRS（储备池状态马氏距离）在边缘资源受限设备上的适用性，提出循环移位连接（MDRS-Circ）和基于储备池时序记忆的高效预处理两项优化，并在MLPerf Tiny基准与NUCLEO-F401RE单片机上验证，MDRS以更小模型与更少运算达到基准性能目标，优化预处理后ROC AUC 0.869、模型24 KB、单次推理能耗约24 uJ、延迟0.32 ms。
AI.motivation: 边缘异常检测需在保持竞争性精度的同时最小化计算开销与内存占用，因此有必要评估并优化MDRS这类无监督时序异常检测方法在资源受限设备上的可行性。
AI.method: 将随机储备池连接（MDRS-Rand）替换为循环移位连接（MDRS-Circ），并证明整条时序的异常分数可仅由最终储备池状态计算；同时利用储备池的时间记忆特性实现更高效的输入预处理以进一步降低计算量；在MLPerf Tiny异常检测基准上与参考自编码器及其他方法对比，并在NUCLEO-F401RE单片机上部署推理内核测量延迟、能耗与内存。
AI.result: 在所评估方法中，仅MDRS与自编码器达到基准性能目标，而MDRS所需运算更少、模型更小；采用优化预处理后，MDRS取得ROC AUC 0.869、模型大小24 KB、单次推理估计能耗24 uJ、延迟0.32 ms，相较采用标准预处理的自编码器实现75.9倍加速。
AI.conclusion: MDRS经连接结构与预处理优化后，在满足MLPerf Tiny精度目标的同时显著降低计算与存储开销，适合部署于资源受限的边缘设备，是相比自编码器更轻量的异常检测方案。

title: MiCaDe: Online LiDAR-Camera Miscalibration Change Detection for Autonomous Driving
summary: Reliable multi-sensor perception in autonomous vehicles requires accurate calibration between cameras and LiDAR. However, calibration drift is often unavoidable in long-term deployments: vibrations, thermal effects, and minor mechanical shocks may alter the relative pose between sensors, leading to systematic errors in downstream fusion tasks. We propose MiCaDe (Miscalibration Change Detection), an online solution detecting when the extrinsic LiDAR-camera calibration parameters are no longer accurate by means of sequential change detection. MiCaDe requires no calibration targets, or modification of the perception stack, providing low false-alarm rates with negligible computational overhead. Our key insight is that 3D and 2D bounding boxes produced by standard object detectors should remain geometrically consistent under correct calibration. By matching cross-modal detections, we derive geometric consistency metrics that serve as sensitive indicators of extrinsic drift. These metrics are aggregated into fixed-size batches and scored against a reference distribution, producing a likelihood stream that is monitored by a Change Point Model (CPM). Crucially, the CPM accumulates statistical evidence over time, enabling detection of subtle drifts that would otherwise go unnoticed. Experiments on multiple long-sequence datasets and on a real-world dataset with physically induced miscalibration confirm reliable detection under diverse conditions. Code available at: https://github.com/CarloSgaravatti/MiCaDe.

AI.tldr: MiCaDe是一种无需标定目标、无需改动感知链路的外参漂移在线检测方法，利用跨模态检测框几何一致性指标并结合变点模型进行序贯检测。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶长期部署中，振动、热效应与轻微机械冲击会导致相机-LiDAR外参漂移，引发下游融合任务的系统性误差；现有标定校验通常依赖靶标或改动感知栈，难以在线、低开销地发现细微漂移。
AI.method: 核心假设是标定正确时2D/3D检测框应保持几何一致性。方法对跨模态检测进行匹配，提取几何一致性度量作为外参漂移的敏感指标；将指标聚合为固定大小的批次并与参考分布比较打分，生成似然流，再用变点模型（CPM）在线监测，通过累积统计证据检出细微漂移。
AI.result: 在多个长序列数据集及一个物理施加失准的真实数据集上验证，在不同条件下均能可靠检测外参失准，误报率低且计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: MiCaDe提供了一种免靶标、免改动感知栈的在线外参失准检测方案，借助序贯变点检测提升对微小漂移的灵敏度，适合长期部署的持续标定监测。

title: Amortized Nonlinear Variable Selection with Prior-Data Fitted Networks
summary: Variable selection is an important task for interpreting potentially complex systems in fields such as biology, business, and sociology. The importance of variable selection has attracted considerable attention in statistics and machine learning. In this paper, we are mainly interested in model-agnostic variable selection for identifying variables that have general nonlinear dependence on the response. We propose MambaPFN, short for Model-Agnostic Markov BlAnket selection with Prior-data Fitted Networks, which is built upon the Transformer, a building block of many popular large language models. Specifically, we consider a functional-mapping perspective on variable-selection learning, in which the Transformer is treated as a learnable mapping from a dataset to its relevant variables. To learn this mapping, MambaPFN introduces three new components: (i) a faithful, rich, and scalable scheme for generating pretraining data, (ii) an objective that targets each variable's posterior inclusion probability, and (iii) a modified Transformer architecture tailored to variable selection. Once pretrained, MambaPFN is applied to new datasets without parameter updates. Empirically, MambaPFN achieves desirable variable-selection performance in simulation studies and exhibits a scaling law---more pretraining datasets and larger models can continuously improve its performance. Applied to a Facebook comments dataset, MambaPFN selects the fewest variables and achieves the highest computational efficiency and predictive performance, improving upon the best baselines by about 20%.

AI.tldr: MambaPFN 是一种基于 Transformer 的 model-agnostic 变量选择方法，将变量选择视为从数据集到相关变量的可学习函数映射，通过先验数据拟合网络（PFN）预训练后无需参数更新即可直接应用于新数据集。
AI.motivation: 变量选择对生物学、商业、社会学等复杂系统的解释至关重要，但现有方法多依赖线性或特定模型假设，难以识别与响应变量存在一般非线性依赖的变量；作者希望实现 model-agnostic 的非线性变量选择。
AI.method: 提出 MambaPFN（Model-Agnostic Markov Blanket selection with Prior-data Fitted Networks）：以 Transformer 作为从数据集到相关变量的可学习映射，包含三个新组件：(i) 忠实、丰富且可扩展的预训练数据生成方案；(ii) 以后验包含概率（posterior inclusion probability）为目标的训练目标；(iii) 针对变量选择定制的改进 Transformer 架构。预训练完成后直接用于新数据集，无需参数更新。
AI.result: 仿真研究中变量选择表现良好，并呈现 scaling law——更多预训练数据与更大模型可持续提升性能；在 Facebook 评论数据集上，MambaPFN 选出最少变量，同时取得最高计算效率和预测性能，较最优基线提升约 20%。
AI.conclusion: MambaPFN 将 PFN 范式成功引入 model-agnostic 变量选择，兼具免微调推理、可扩展性与优越的实证表现，为非线性依赖下的变量选择提供了新思路。

title: Found by Search, Broken by a Shortcut: Transfer and Tampering of Searched Intrinsic Rewards
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/chasemetoyer/found-by-search
summary: Can a search over innate drives find intrinsic rewards that help a reinforcement-learning agent learn, transfer to a task it never saw, and resist an exploit that was absent during the search? Each candidate reward combines four generic events (a new view, a pickup, a drop and a toggle), each with a weight, a relief and a refill rate. We ran three pre-registered stages; the search protocol was locked in a public, timestamped commit before any search result existed. CMA-ES and an equal-budget random search used 1,560 PPO training runs, and the final evaluation and tamper test used 340. On the held-out task, KeyCorridorS3R2, the CMA-ES-selected reward (E) beat task-only PPO, episodic novelty and the random-search-selected reward (R) in all 3 registered comparisons, all of them meaningful by the registered size rule. Among these generic rewards E transferred best; the earlier paper's satiation reward, which on this task is given hand-wired key and locked-door events, did better (20 of 20 seeds solved against 4 of 20; descriptive). On UnlockPickup, where that reward uses generic events, E's mean area exceeded it by 0.276 (descriptive). On the training tasks there was no registered difference between E and R: both E-over-R tests missed. A free reset action, absent during the search, collapsed E's learning on DoorKey-8x8 (mean area 0.829 without it, 0.136 with it; registered) to below task-only PPO (descriptive). The searched drives helped on every task tested, but a reward given task-specific events did better on the held-out task, and selection gave E no protection against an exploit absent from the search.

AI.tldr: 该文用预注册的三阶段搜索协议（CMA-ES 与等预算随机搜索，共1560次PPO训练 + 340次评估/篡改测试）在四类通用事件构成的内在奖励空间中搜索，发现CMA-ES选出的奖励E能在未见任务KeyCorridorS3R2上优于任务-only PPO、情景新颖性与随机搜索奖励，但在训练任务上与随机搜索无显著差异、且被搜索中缺席的free reset动作击穿，也无权对任务特定事件奖励占优、无防御未搜索到的利用漏洞。
AI.motivation: 探究对"先天驱力"（innate drives）的搜索能否自动发现可迁移的内在奖励：既帮助强化学习智能体学习、迁移到训练中从未见过的任务，又能抵抗搜索阶段未曾出现的利用漏洞（exploit）。核心疑问是奖励搜索/选择是否能提供超出搜索分布的鲁棒性与泛化保证。
AI.method: 候选奖励由四种通用事件（new view、pickup、drop、toggle）线性组合，每个事件带weight、relief和refill rate三类参数。执行三项预注册实验，搜索协议在任何搜索结果出现前锁定于公开带时间戳的commit。使用CMA-ES与等预算随机搜索，共1560次PPO训练；最终评估与篡改测试用340次。对比基线：task-only PPO、episodic novelty、随机搜索奖励R，以及先前论文的satiation奖励（该奖励在本任务上被手工绑定key与locked-door事件）。篡改测试引入搜索中缺席的free reset动作，在DoorKey-8x8上检测奖励被利用的情况。
AI.result: 在留出任务KeyCorridorS3R2上，CMA-ES选出的奖励E在全部3项注册比较中均优于task-only PPO、episodic novelty与随机搜索奖励R，且按注册的效应量规则均达"有意义"。通用奖励中E迁移最佳；但先前satiation奖励（本任务上为手工绑定key与locked-door事件）表现更好：20/20种子解出 vs. 4/20（描述性）。在UnlockPickup（该奖励使用通用事件）上，E的平均面积高出0.276（描述性）。训练任务上E与R无注册差异（两项E-over-R检验均不显著）。free reset动作使E在DoorKey-8x8上的学习崩溃：无该动作时平均面积0.829，有该动作时0.136（注册），低至task-only PPO之下（描述性）。
AI.conclusion: 搜索得到的驱力在所有测试任务上均有帮助，但（1）给定任务特定事件的奖励在留出任务上表现更优，说明通用事件组合的选择会损失任务对齐性能；（2）奖励选择无法保护E免受搜索中缺席的利用漏洞，选择过程不提供对分布外漏洞的鲁棒性保证；（3）E与随机搜索在训练任务上无差异，表明CMA-ES的优势主要体现在迁移而非训练拟合。

title: EP-LVMQA: Evidence-Preserving Coarse-to-Fine Localization for Low-Quality Long Video Moment Question Answering
summary: Long instructional videos are increasingly used in medical education, industrial training, and procedural knowledge transfer, yet their evidence is often incomplete or unreliable: subtitles may be missing, ASR noisy, OCR sparse, and decisive actions briefly shown without narration. Existing VideoQA systems typically return labels or free-form text, making answer support difficult to inspect. We study Long Video Moment Question Answering (LVMQA), where a system returns timestamped answer-supporting evidence. We propose EP-LVMQA, an evidence-preserving coarse-to-fine framework comprising an Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Evidence Timeline, a Coarse Evidence Planner, and an Evidence-Conditioned Fine Localizer. An evidence card transfers planner scores, matched cues, source-confidence proxies, modality-specific evidence, neighboring context, and a temporal prior between the latter two modules. On MedVidQA, EP-LVMQA achieves 26.1 R1@0.5 and 31.8 mIoU, improving the strongest non-ours results by 6.3 and 5.1 points. It raises Suff.@2 and Ver.@2 to 25.4 and 22.6, gains of 9.5 and 8.8 points. Under matched low-quality perturbations, average relative degradation is reduced from the strongest non-ours value of 14.6% to 11.1%. On Ego4D-NLQ and QVHighlights, EP-LVMQA remains broadly comparable to established task-specific localization methods.

AI.tldr: 提出EP-LVMQA框架，针对长教学视频的"时刻问答"任务返回带时间戳的证据片段，在MedVidQA上显著超越基线并提升低质扰动鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 长教学视频（医学教育、工业培训、流程知识传递）中的证据常不完整或不可靠：字幕缺失、ASR噪声、OCR稀疏、关键动作短暂且无讲解。现有VideoQA通常只返回标签或自由文本，答案依据难以核查。
AI.method: 定义长视频时刻问答（LVMQA）任务，要求输出带时间戳的答案支撑证据。框架EP-LVMQA为证据保留的粗到细结构，含三部分：不确定性感知多模态证据时间线、粗粒度证据规划器、证据条件化的细粒度定位器；后两模块间通过"证据卡"传递规划器得分、匹配线索、源置信度代理、模态专属证据、邻域上下文和时间先验。
AI.result: MedVidQA上达26.1 R1@0.5、31.8 mIoU，较最强非本方法提升6.3和5.1点；Suff.@2与Ver.@2分别升至25.4、22.6（+9.5、+8.8）。匹配低质扰动下平均相对退化由14.6%降至11.1%。在Ego4D-NLQ与QVHighlights上与成熟的任务专用定位方法大体相当。
AI.conclusion: 证据保留的粗到细建模范式在长教学视频LVMQA上兼顾精度与鲁棒性，且具有跨数据集可比性；局限在于通用基准上未取得明显优势。

title: ScamWorld: An Interactive Environment for Evaluating Web Agents Against Online Fraud
summary: Web agents increasingly browse, shop, and manage accounts on behalf of their users. Prior work has shown that they can be misled by adversarial content, including prompt injections and deceptive interfaces. Beyond such attacks, agents operating on the open web also encounter online fraud designed to deceive humans, including fraudulent online stores, fake investment platforms, and advance-fee schemes. How web agents respond to such fraud during task execution remains underexplored, in part because scam websites are short-lived, making systematic evaluation difficult. To address this gap, we introduce ScamWorld, an interactive environment that reconstructs reported scam websites across diverse scenarios, fraud mechanisms, and languages. Each reconstructed website reproduces documented fraud mechanisms, making relevant signs of fraud observable before the agent's final action and enabling controlled, repeatable evaluation. Through an extensive study of web agents powered by six frontier LLMs, we find that baseline deception rates range from 11% to 35% across models. Agents proceed more readily with payments than with requests for credentials or wallet information. A closer analysis of agent trajectories shows that some agents acknowledge suspicious conditions yet proceed, at times treating the user's instructions as authorisation to accept additional terms imposed by the website. ScamWorld provides a reusable testbed for systematically evaluating and stress-testing web agents against real-world online fraud.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ScamWorld——一个重建真实已举报诈骗网站的可交互评测环境，用于系统测试 web agents 在任务执行中遭遇在线诈骗时的反应，发现六个前沿 LLM 驱动的 agent 受骗率为 11%–35%。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注提示注入与欺骗性界面等对抗攻击，但 agent 在开放网络上还会遇到针对人类的在线诈骗（虚假网店、假投资平台、预付费骗局）。此类研究不足的主因是诈骗网站生命周期短，难以开展系统、可重复的评测。
AI.method: 构建 ScamWorld 交互式环境，依据公开举报记录重建多场景、多诈骗机制、多语言的诈骗网站；每个重建站点复现真实诈骗机制，使诈骗线索在 agent 执行最终动作前可被观测，从而实现受控、可重复的评测。随后用六个前沿 LLM 驱动的 web agents 进行大规模实验，并对轨迹做细粒度分析。
AI.result: 基线受骗率为 11%–35%（跨模型）。agent 更容易执行付款操作，而对付凭据或钱包信息的请求更为谨慎。轨迹分析显示，部分 agent 虽识别出可疑迹象仍继续执行，有时将用户的指令误解为对网站附加条款的授权。
AI.conclusion: ScamWorld 提供了一个可复用的测试平台，可对 web agents 进行面向真实在线诈骗的系统评测与压力测试；结果揭示了"察觉可疑仍继续执行"等值得关注的失效模式。

title: DLER: Dual-Logit Experience Replay for Online Continual Learning
summary: Online continual learning aims to continuously train neural networks on a non-stationary data stream in a single pass. Rehearsal-based methods alleviate catastrophic forgetting by replaying stored samples, but the imbalance between current and previous data often leads to predictions biased toward current classes. Many approaches have been proposed to overcome the forgetting problem by correcting the bias; however, they still need to be improved in an online fashion. By decomposing the dot-product logits into an angle factor and a norm factor, our analysis reveals that the angle factor efficiently captures novel knowledge but is particularly susceptible to prediction bias, whereas the norm factor helps preserve historical knowledge. Based on these observations, we propose Dual-Logit Experience Replay (DLER), which exploits dual-logits for both model optimization and memory management. Specifically, DLER learns current samples using cosine logits and incorporates additional dot-product logits when replaying previous samples to mitigate prediction bias. To strengthen dual-logit learning under limited replay memory, an auxiliary supervised contrastive objective promotes angular compactness within each class, extending corrections learned from limited replay samples to other samples of the same class. Meanwhile, we introduce a memory update strategy that preferentially retains samples for which dot-product prediction assigns a higher probability to the correct class than cosine prediction, aligning sample selection with dual-logit training. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of DLER, particularly under limited memory budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出Dual-Logit Experience Replay (DLER)，将点积logits分解为角度因子与范数因子，用双logits同时驱动模型优化与记忆管理，缓解在线持续学习中的预测偏置。
AI.motivation: 在线持续学习单遍训练于非平稳数据流，基于回放的方法虽缓解灾难性遗忘，但当前数据与历史数据的不平衡导致预测偏向当前类；现有偏置校正方法在在线场景下仍有不足。
AI.method: 将点积logits分解为角度因子与范数因子进行分析：角度因子高效捕获新知识但易受预测偏置影响，范数因子有助于保留历史知识。据此提出DLER：学习当前样本时使用cosine logits，回放历史样本时额外引入dot-product logits以缓解偏置；在有限回放内存下引入辅助监督对比目标，增强类内角度紧致性，将有限回放样本上学到的校正推广至同类其他样本；并提出优先保留"点积预测对正确类概率高于cosine预测"样本的记忆更新策略，使样本选择与双logit训练一致。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验验证了DLER的有效性，尤其在有限内存预算下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过对logits角度/范数因子的解耦分析，双logit机制可同时用于优化与记忆管理，有效缓解在线持续学习中的预测偏置与遗忘问题。

title: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
summary: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shared multimodal foundation model that unifies image, video, audio, synchronized audio--video, and interleaved inputs, is specialized for each downstream module. Because a DiT is trained on far fewer training samples than a language model, we treat captioning as a semantic contract that maximizes description density, and extend it to reference-grounded captioning that makes reference bindings explicit. Prompt enhancement translates user intent into this caption distribution: basic PE is derived from captions of compelling videos and refined with text-level and generator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, while agentic PE refines the story and retrieves compelling examples. We show that a reliable text encoder comes from perceptual training rather than from stronger language ability, and that candidates can be screened from text alone before end-to-end training. Reward modeling pairs a general reward model for explainable, localized critiques with a decision reward model for fast multidimensional scoring, treating perceptual bandwidth as a first-class design parameter. Finally, we review task-specific automatic evaluation, focusing on protocols that expose scoring shortcuts and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for building the understanding stack behind controllable video generation.

AI.tldr: 该报告系统梳理了Kling系列模型在多模态理解方面的经验，主张生成质量是多模态理解在“数据—条件化—对齐—评估”全链路上的投影，并逐一分析各模块：统一的Kling-MLLM基座、以语义契约为核心的captioning与参考接地、提示增强、感知训练得到的文本编码器、双奖励模型以及任务级自动评测。
AI.motivation: 视频生成已从孤立片段发展到连贯的短时视听序列，瓶颈正从渲染能力转向语义控制；作者希望总结Kling多代迭代的理解经验，为可控视频生成背后的“理解栈”提供实践指引。
AI.method: 提出“生成质量=多模态理解在数据—条件化—对齐—评估全链路上的投影”这一分析框架，模块化展开：(1) 构建共享多模态基座Kling-MLLM，统一图像、视频、音频、音视频同步与交错输入，并按下游模块特化；(2) 将captioning视为语义契约，最大化描述密度，并扩展为显式参考绑定的reference-grounded captioning；(3) 提示增强：基础PE由优质视频caption导出的分布出发，结合文本级与生成器在环强化学习精炼，agentic PE负责故事精炼与优质样例检索；(4) 论证可靠文本编码器来自感知训练而非更强语言能力，并支持端到端训练前的纯文本候选筛选；(5) 奖励建模采用通用奖励模型（可解释、局部化批评）与决策奖励模型（快速多维打分）配对，并将感知带宽作为一等设计参数；(6) 任务级自动评测，强调能暴露评分捷径、可溯源上游失效的评测协议。
AI.result: 形成了一套贯穿数据、条件化、对齐与评估的理解栈方法论：以高密度语义caption作为DiT训练契约、以感知训练获得文本编码器、以文本先行方式降低端到端训练成本、以双奖励模型兼顾可解释性与效率，并可通过评测协议定位失效的上游来源。
AI.conclusion: 可控视频生成的关键在于构建与生成器协同演进的多模态理解栈；作者希望上述经验为相关系统建设提供可操作的指导。

title: Modelling lock-in of AI adoption through skill erosion
summary: Generative AI can improve immediate performance but may erode the human skills required for future work. We study a model in which individuals tend to imitate successful peers, while their independent skills grow with practice and erode with reliance on AI. Because each agent's skill reflects their history, non-users and AI users develop different skill distributions, which we derive exactly. Skill erosion can produce bistability and hysteresis between a low-adoption, high-skill state and a high-adoption, low-skill state. When agents rarely change behaviour at random, the two transitions are asymmetric. A single AI user spreads through a population of experts only if AI-assisted work earns more than expert work, whatever the timescale of skill adaptation. A single non-user, by contrast, can lead an AI-dependent population back to independent work only if they regain enough skill before returning to AI, which becomes easier the more persistent behaviours are. As AI improves, adoption can jump abruptly, and a sufficiently long increase in its benefit, such as a period of low prices, can leave a population relying on AI after the benefit has returned to its initial value. Skill erosion thus creates a history-dependent switching cost that can make widespread AI adoption difficult to reverse.

AI.tldr: 论文研究生成式AI使用与人类技能之间的反馈机制：个体模仿成功同伴的AI使用行为，而独立技能随练习增长、随依赖AI而侵蚀。技能侵蚀可在"低采纳-高技能"与"高采纳-低技能"两态之间产生双稳态与滞后效应，并导致采纳行为具有历史依赖的"切换成本"，使广泛AI采纳难以逆转。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI能提升即时绩效，但可能侵蚀未来工作所需的人类技能。现有讨论缺少对"AI采纳行为—技能积累—技能侵蚀"这一动态反馈的建模，尤其缺乏对采纳状态多重均衡与不可逆性的刻画。
AI.method: 构建基于个体模仿（imitate successful peers）的行为—技能动力学模型：个体独立技能随练习增长、随AI依赖而侵蚀；因技能反映个人历史，非使用者与AI使用者形成不同的技能分布，并给出分布的精确解析解。分析在随机行为改变（persistence）条件下两稳态间的转移条件与对称性。
AI.result: 技能侵蚀导致双稳态与滞后；当个体较少随机改变行为时，两个方向的转移呈非对称性。单个AI使用者在专家群体中扩散，当且仅当AI辅助工作的收益高于专家工作，且与技能适应的时间尺度无关；相反，单个非使用者只能在其重新回归AI之前积累足够技能时，才能带领依赖AI的群体回归独立工作，且行为越持久越容易实现。AI能力提升可引发采纳的突变式跃升，且足够长期的高收益期（如低价格）即便收益回到原值，也会使群体滞留在依赖AI的状态。
AI.conclusion: 技能侵蚀构成一种历史依赖的切换成本，使广泛的AI采纳可能难以逆转；AI采纳的动态取决于收益结构与技能恢复速度，而非单纯的技术能力提升。

title: Fault-tolerant shallow recurrent decoders for sparse sensing with missing sensor measurements
summary: Real-world sensing systems are inherently imperfect: sensors may fail, intermittently disconnect, operate with asynchronous sampling rates, and be subject to noise, leading to measurement streams that are irregular, incomplete, and heterogeneous. Nevertheless, sensing strategies for real-time state reconstruction typically assume synchronous and continuously active sensors, a constraint that substantially limits their applicability in operational environments. In this work, we introduce fault-tolerant sparse sensing strategies in the context of shallow recurrent decoders (SHRED) to enable high-dimensional state estimation from sparse, asynchronous, and missing sensor measurements. Specifically, we consider naive imputation strategies, fault-tolerant recurrent temporal encoders, and we introduce four different transformer-based masking mechanisms to make SHRED explicitly aware of sensor availability through the binary data-availability mask. Moreover, we further introduce a multi-step decoding training objective for SHRED, resulting in smoother latent trajectories and more robust predictions. Throughout a synthetic benchmark and three real-world problems in hydrodynamic and ocean modeling, we show that (i) transformer-based masking mechanisms outperform standard imputation techniques and fault-tolerant recurrent architectures, (ii) the multi-step decoding training objective enhances reconstruction fidelity and robustness in the presence of heterogeneous missing-data patterns, while (iii) the computational efficiency of SHRED is preserved, with no additional inference-time overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向浅层循环解码器（SHRED）的容错稀疏感知策略，使其能在稀疏、异步、缺失的传感器测量下进行高维状态估计：包括朴素插补、容错循环时序编码器、四种基于Transformer的掩码机制（利用二值可用性掩码显式感知传感器可用性），以及多步解码训练目标；实验表明Transformer掩码优于插补与容错循环结构，多步解码提升重建保真度与鲁棒性且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 实际传感系统存在传感器故障、间歇断连、异步采样率与噪声，导致测量流不规则、不完整、异构；而现有实时状态重建的感知策略通常假设传感器同步且持续工作，显著限制其在实际运行环境中的适用性。
AI.method: 在浅层循环解码器（SHRED）框架下引入容错稀疏感知策略：(1) 朴素插补策略；(2) 容错循环时序编码器；(3) 四种基于Transformer的掩码机制，通过二值数据可用性掩码使SHRED显式感知传感器可用性；(4) 多步解码训练目标。
AI.result: 在合成基准与三个水动力/海洋建模实际问题中验证：(i) Transformer掩码机制优于标准插补技术与容错循环架构；(ii) 多步解码训练目标在异构缺失模式下提升重建保真度与鲁棒性；(iii) 保持SHRED的计算效率，无额外推理时间开销。
AI.conclusion: 基于Transformer掩码与多步解码训练的容错SHRED可在稀疏、异步、含缺失的测量条件下实现高保真高维状态估计，且不牺牲计算效率，适用于真实运行环境中的实时状态重建。

title: VISTA: Vision-Language Integrated Semantic Triage Architecture for Online Face Clustering in Long Videos
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26). 17 pages, including 8 pages of supplementary material
summary: Clustering faces by identity in long, continuous video streams is a challenging task that serves as a building block for human-centric video analysis. The majority of existing face clustering models are offline, i.e., they assume the entire data to be available altogether. In many practical scenarios, however, the entire data is either unavailable or poses computational challenges to be processed in its entirety. A handful of online methods that exist rely on geometric visual features and simple thresholding techniques, which fail when the faces exhibit significant appearance variations in long, unconstrained videos. To this end, we present VISTA, the first vision language framework for online face clustering in long videos. VISTA leverages semantic reasoning in a controlled, uncertainty aware fashion to maintain both high cluster purity and long range identity continuity. This makes it robust to the variations in illumination, pose, and costume changes that the faces and characters exhibit in long real world videos. Extensive experiments on the VPCD benchmark dataset (with 15 full episodes from The Big Bang Theory [2007-2019], Buffy the Vampire Slayer [1997-2003], and Sherlock [2010-2017]) demonstrate that VISTA achieves a robust precision and recall balance, consistently improving over the strongest matched online unsupervised baseline (COFC) under identical detector, embeddings, and evaluation protocol. Code and supplementary material: https://github.com/SkyJiashu/VISTA.

AI.tldr: VISTA 是首个面向长视频在线人脸聚类的视觉-语言框架，通过可控、不确定性感知的语义推理，在高聚类纯度与长程身份连续性之间取得平衡，在 VPCD 基准上稳定优于最强在线无监督基线 COFC。
AI.motivation: 现有视频人脸聚类模型多为离线方法，假设全部数据一次性可得，而实际场景中数据不完整或全量处理计算代价过高。少数在线方法依赖几何视觉特征与简单阈值，在长时无约束视频中面对光照、姿态、服饰剧变时失效。
AI.method: 提出 VISTA，首个用于长视频在线人脸聚类的视觉-语言框架：以受控、不确定性感知的方式引入语义推理，用于维护聚类簇的更新与身份关联，从而增强对光照、姿态和服装变化等外观波动的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 VPCD 基准（《生活大爆炸》2007-2019、《吸血鬼猎人巴菲》1997-2003、《神探夏洛克》2010-2017 共 15 集完整剧集）上，在检测器、嵌入与评估协议均相同的条件下，VISTA 取得稳健的精确率-召回率平衡，并持续优于最强匹配的在线无监督基线 COFC。
AI.conclusion: 语义级视觉-语言推理结合不确定性控制，可有效支撑长时在线人脸聚类的纯度与身份连续性，为以人为中心的视频分析提供可行构建模块。

title: FourSight: Stable FP4 RL Post-Training via Sequence Filtering and Sparse Channel Compensation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training increasingly targets low-bit deployment, with NVFP4 weight-and activation quantization (W4A4) becoming the state-of-the-practice format. However, integrating NVFP4 into RL degrades rollout quality and amplifies cross-engine training-inference mismatch (TIM), destabilizing training. We show that these failures are concentrated rather than uniform - severely mismatched tail tokens concentrate in a few outlier sequences, while policy weights remain largely intact and quantization error concentrates in a few high-variance activation channels. Guided by this, we present FourSight, an algorithm-system co-design with two targeted solutions: TIM-aware sequence filtering that excludes drifted trajectories from policy updates, and sparse precision compensation that keeps only top-variance channels in BF16 while retaining native NVFP4 elsewhere. We further design a fused SpliceGEMM kernel with specialized prefill and decode datapaths to minimize overhead. FourSight sustains near-BF16 accuracy and strong FP4 deployment quality across models and engines, while improving step-to-accuracy by 1.76-2.60x and staying within 2.3% of FP4 step time up to 120B-scale models.

AI.tldr: FourSight 是面向强化学习后训练的低比特（NVFP4 W4A4）部署算法-系统协同设计：通过 TIM 感知的序列过滤与稀疏高方差通道 BF16 补偿，并配套 SpliceGEMM 融合核，在近 BF16 精度下实现 1.76–2.60x 的 step-to-accuracy 提升。
AI.motivation: RL 后训练日益追求低比特部署，NVFP4（W4A4）已成为事实标准格式。但直接引入 NVFP4 会损害 rollout 质量，并放大跨引擎的训练-推理不一致（TIM），导致训练不稳定。作者指出这些失效是"集中式"而非均匀分布的，从而为定向干预提供了空间。
AI.method: 先做失效定位分析：严重 TIM 的尾部 token 集中在少数离群序列中；策略权重基本保持完好；量化误差集中在少数高方差激活通道。据此提出两个定向方案：(1) TIM 感知的序列过滤，将漂移轨迹排除出策略更新；(2) 稀疏精度补偿，仅将 top-variance 通道保持 BF16，其余维持原生 NVFP4。系统层设计 fused SpliceGEMM 核，为 prefill 与 decode 提供专用数据通路以压低开销。
AI.result: 在多模型、多引擎上维持接近 BF16 的精度与强 FP4 部署质量；step-to-accuracy 提升 1.76–2.60x；在最高 120B 规模模型上，步时开销控制在 FP4 步时的 2.3% 以内。
AI.conclusion: 量化误差与 TIM 的集中性使"选择性、细粒度"补偿优于全局高精度回退，算法层过滤加通道级稀疏精度补偿、配合专用融合核，可在几乎不牺牲吞吐的前提下把 NVFP4 RL 后训练拉回近 BF16 稳定性，具备大规模可扩展性。

title: Attending to Memory Writes Reduces Seed Variability in Recurrent Length Generalization
summary: Recurrent memory requires learning useful updates, but attention added to assist learning can also compromise length generalization. We study bounded delta attention: causal attention over uncorrected update proposals whose bounded correction enters the recurrent update. Its implementation in TraceRelay combines additive phase recurrence with attention computed before a parallel scan. On prefix-supervised modulo-5, trained at lengths 1--40, three findings characterize its behavior at length 80. First, upper delta attention attains $70.81\pm8.26$% accuracy across seven seeds, versus $69.21\pm22.42$% for the local-attention recurrent baseline (mean $\pm$ sample SD): a 63.2% reduction in SD with a similar mean. Upper state attention also reduces variation, reaching $74.75\pm6.24$%, so this benefit is not unique to update-level attention. Disabling the upper delta correction retains $70.62\pm8.60$%. Second, blocking gradients at the delta-attention inputs changes accuracy to $65.25\pm12.40$% in the matched seven-seed comparison, increasing SD by 50.2%. It also delays a 99% validation threshold on average among the same six seeds that reach it; the 95% threshold is reached earlier on average with input-gradient blocking across all seven seeds. Third, lower delta attention exhibits substantially less extrapolation degradation than lower state attention: 62.60% versus 19.40%, against a 71.06% baseline. Removing its correction reduces accuracy to 22.56%; its advantage over lower state attention also persists under input-gradient blocking. These observations motivate bounded update-level attention as a recurrent learning scaffold, combining reduced seed variation with less severe degradation in a placement where state attention fails.

AI.tldr: 本文研究“有界 delta 注意力”（bounded delta attention）：对未校正的更新提案做因果注意力，其有界校正进入循环更新；在 TraceRelay 中以“加性相位递推 + 并行扫描前的注意力”实现。实验显示：上层 delta 注意力在长度 80 外推时显著降低种子间方差（SD 降 63.2%）且均值相当；下层 delta 注意力外推退化远轻于下层状态注意力（62.60% vs 19.40%）。
AI.motivation: 循环记忆需要学习有效的更新，但为辅助学习而加入的注意力可能损害长度泛化。作者希望厘清“注意力作用在何处、以何种方式校正”对长度外推与训练稳定性的影响，从而为循环记忆中的注意力放置提供指导。
AI.method: 提出有界 delta 注意力：对未校正的更新提案施加因果注意力，仅将有界校正注入循环更新；在 TraceRelay 中结合加性相位递推与并行扫描前计算的注意力实现。在 prefix-supervised modulo-5 任务上（训练长度 1–40，测试长度 80），用七个种子做对照：上/下层 delta 注意力 vs 上/下层状态注意力、启用/禁用 delta 校正、以及阻断 delta 注意力输入梯度等消融。
AI.result: 长度 80 上：上层 delta 注意力达 70.81±8.26%，基线 69.21±22.42%（均值相近，SD 降 63.2%）；上层状态注意力亦降方差（74.75±6.24%），说明收益非更新级注意力独有；禁用上层 delta 校正仍保留 70.62±8.60%。阻断输入梯度使准确率变为 65.25±12.40%，SD 升 50.2%，并平均延迟 99% 验证阈值（95% 阈值反而更早达到）。下层 delta 注意力外推退化远小于下层状态注意力（62.60% vs 19.40%，基线 71.06%）；移除其校正降至 22.56%，且该优势在梯度阻断下依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 有界更新级注意力可作为循环学习的“脚手架”：在状态注意力失效的放置位置上，它同时带来更小的种子间方差和更轻的外推退化。方差降低并非更新级注意力独有，而外推优势则特定于下层 delta 注意力的放置与校正结构。

title: Robustness Verification against Patch Attacks via Group-Lasso Semidefinite Relaxation
summary:
Robustness verification is essential for ensuring the safety and security of neural networks, but current methods focus heavily on
  norm-ball attacks, which do not adequately model typical real-world threats that present physical perturbations, known as patch attacks. A naive approach requires computationally prohibitive enumeration of all possible patch positions. To address the challenge, we propose a novel neural network verification method specialized to the patch-attack threat. Instead of enumerating patch locations, we first model the patch attack with group-wise sparsity and formulate its verification methods as a mixed-integer semidefinite program (MISDP) by applying SDP relaxation to the neural network. We then propose three relaxations, including Group-Lasso relaxation, that remove the integer variables while preserving the sparse, group-wise structure of the original attack, enabling substantially efficient verification. Our empirical analysis demonstrates that the proposed relaxations require less than 3% of the computation time of the original MISDP, while the Group-Lasso relaxation incurs only a 0.34\% average increase in the objective value over the original formulation. Furthermore, Group-Lasso achieves a verified rate of 91%, compared with under 70% for prior methods.

AI.tldr: 提出针对补丁攻击的神经网络鲁棒性验证方法：用组稀疏建模补丁攻击，化为混合整数半定规划(MISDP)，并用三种松弛(含Group-Lasso松弛)消除整数变量，效率提升显著且核验率从<70%提升到91%。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒性验证方法主要针对范数球攻击，无法充分刻画带有物理扰动的真实威胁(补丁攻击)；而直接枚举所有补丁位置的朴素方法计算代价过高，难以实用。
