Top solutions proposed in this challenge are able to enhance Full HD resolution RGB images on both platforms under 300 milliseconds. A comprehensive description of the models developed in the challenge is provided in this paper.

AI.tldr: 本文是Mobile AI挑战赛报告，面向移动端RGB照片增强，号召参赛者在Qualcomm与Arm GPU上设计高性价比深度学习模型，最优方案可在不足300ms内增强Full HD图像。
AI.motivation: 移动端RGB照片增强需求旺盛（提升手机拍摄质量、其他来源图像修饰），但需兼顾性能与受限移动硬件的可部署性，因此需要高效的轻量深度学习模型。
AI.method: 举办Mobile AI挑战赛：基于大规模DPED数据集（iPhone 3GS与Canon 70D拍摄的RGB图像对）训练；运行时间在Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5（Adreno GPU）与Dimensity 9500（Mali GPU）上评测。
AI.result: 顶尖方案在两平台上均可在300毫秒以内完成Full HD分辨率RGB图像增强；论文给出了各参赛模型的完整描述。
AI.conclusion: 赛道验证了在主流智能手机GPU上实现实时（<300ms/FHD）综合RGB照片增强的可行性，并汇总了参赛模型的系统化设计经验。

title: The Geometry of Ignorance: Detecting Suppressed Knowledge in LLMs through Activation Fragmentation
summary: Evaluating whether a large language model (LLM) genuinely knows a concept remains a fundamental problem, since behavioral metrics can be fooled by suppression: a model that refuses to answer may still harbor recoverable knowledge. The framework measures the geometric coherence of \textit{anon-vectors}, the differences in hidden states between a concept-specific query and its anonymized paraphrase, and shows that genuine knowledge forms a tight, low-entropy cluster while ignorance forces geometric fragmentation. Across ten instruction-tuned LLMs from three model families, all fragmentation metrics reliably separate known from unknown concepts, and post-unlearning, fragmentation geometry correlates with adversarial recovery across four attack types and five unlearning algorithms, though the direction of that relationship is shown to depend on attack methodology. Furthermore, a layer-resolved analysis reveals that different adversarial mechanisms exploit this geometry at varying depths, with high attack-specific correlations that are invisible to behavioral evaluation. Together, these results constitute a single-phase, attack-free proxy for unlearning robustness that captures aspects of parametric knowledge inaccessible to output-level metrics. A reference implementation is available at https://github.com/AdarPeleg/geometry-of-ignorance

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用"anon-vectors"（概念特定查询与其匿名化改写之间的隐藏状态差异）的几何一致性来判定LLM是否真正知晓某概念：真知形成紧致低熵簇，无知则几何碎裂。跨越三个模型家族十个指令微调LLM，碎裂度指标可靠区分已知/未知概念，并与遗忘后四类攻击、五种遗忘算法的对抗恢复性相关（方向依赖攻击方法），且层级分析揭示行为评估不可见的攻击特有关联。最终构成单阶段、免攻击的遗忘鲁棒性代理指标。
AI.motivation: 行为指标可被"抑制"欺骗：模型拒答并不等于不掌握知识，可能存在可恢复的知识。因此需要一种不依赖输出行为、能反映参数化知识真实状态的度量，来评估模型是否"真正知道"某概念以及遗忘是否稳健。
AI.method: 构造anon-vector：计算概念特定查询与其匿名化改写之间隐藏状态的差值，并度量其几何相干性（紧致度/低熵 vs. 碎裂）。在十个指令微调LLM（三个模型家族）上，用多种碎裂度指标区分已知与未知概念；在遗忘后，将碎裂几何与四类对抗攻击、五种遗忘算法的恢复效果做相关分析；并进行逐层解析，考察不同对抗机制在不同深度利用该几何结构的情况。
AI.result: 所有碎裂度指标均能可靠区分已知与未知概念；遗忘后碎裂几何与对抗恢复存在相关性，但关系方向取决于攻击方法；逐层分析显示不同对抗机制在不同深度利用该几何，攻击特有关系高度显著，且这些关联在行为评估中完全不可见。
AI.conclusion: anon-vector几何碎裂度可作为单阶段、无需攻击的遗忘鲁棒性代理指标，捕捉输出层面指标无法触及的述评性知识特性。代码已开源。

title: Effects of Parton Pair Correlations on Direct-Photon Yields and Elliptic Flow in Heavy-Ion Collisions
summary: Direct photons escape heavy-ion collisions with little rescattering, carrying information from the full emission history. Yet describing the measured direct-photon yield and the sizable elliptic flow $v_2$ together remains a long-standing challenge. Here we explore how correlations between emitting partons may affect both observables. The local $2\to2$ photon rate depends on the joint distribution of incoming partons, so a connected correlation between them can change photon emission without changing the one-particle distribution of medium particles. Once folded over the evolving medium in Au+Au and Pb+Pb collisions, the correlation raises the photon yield toward the fitted PHENIX and ALICE data and increases $v_2$ mainly at intermediate $p_T$. The fitted temperature dependence accounts for most of the net flow increase in this region, suggesting that the correlation changes the relative contributions between hotter and cooler regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，部分子间的关联（connected correlation）可在不改变单粒子分布的前提下改变局部2→2光子产生率，从而同时提升直接光子产额与椭圆流v2，缓解长期存在的"光子谜题"。
AI.motivation: 直接光子几乎不发生重散射，携带整个发射历史的信息；但现有模型难以同时描述测得的直接光子产额与可观的椭圆流v2，这是长期未解的难题。作者希望考察发射部分子之间的关联是否能同时影响这两个观测量。
AI.method: 从局部2→2光子产生率出发，指出该速率依赖于入射部分子的联合分布，因此部分子间的connected correlation可在不改变介质单粒子分布的情况下改变光子发射；再将此关联在Au+Au与Pb+Pb碰撞中演化介质的时空上做折积计算。
AI.result: 引入关联后，光子产额上升并趋近PHENIX与ALICE的拟合数据；v2主要在中级横动量（intermediate pT）区域增大。拟合得到的温度依赖可解释该区域净流增量的大部分。
AI.conclusion: 部分子关联通过改变较热与较冷区域之间的相对贡献来增强光子产额与v2，为同时解释直接光子产额和椭圆流提供了一条不依赖单粒子分布的途径。

title: You don't need long context
summary: Later tokens are costlier to generate than earlier tokens. On frontier open weight models, the disparity in cost may rise to as much as 7x. Through frequent compaction, we show across a broad range of long-horizon and long-input tasks that frontier language models sacrifice little to no task accuracy when maintaining short contexts. We further demonstrate that LLM performance does not collapse on long-horizon software engineering tasks even when taking at most one action per context, and based on that we outline the concept of semantic state space models (SSSMs). Our findings question the need for long-context language models.

AI.tldr: 后续token的生成成本高于前序token，在前沿开放权重模型上差距可达7倍；通过频繁压缩维持短上下文，模型在长程与长输入任务上几乎不损失准确率，且在长程软件工程任务中每次上下文仅执行一个动作也不出现性能崩溃，据此提出语义状态空间模型（SSSMs）概念，质疑对长上下文模型的必要性。
AI.motivation: 长上下文语言模型被广泛采用，但其计算成本随序列长度急剧上升：越靠后的token生成开销越高，在前沿开放权重模型上这一差距最高可达约7倍。作者由此质疑"是否真的需要长上下文模型"，并探索以短上下文替代长上下文的可能性。
AI.method: 在广泛的长期程（long-horizon）与长输入（long-input）任务上，采用频繁上下文压缩（frequent compaction）的策略，使模型始终在较短上下文中运行；进一步测试在长期程软件工程任务中每次上下文仅允许执行至多一个动作的极端设定，并在此基础上提出语义状态空间模型（SSSMs）的概念框架。
AI.result: （1）频繁压缩下，前沿模型在各类任务上几乎不损失甚至完全不损失准确率；（2）在长期程软件工程任务中，即使每次上下文仅执行至多一个动作，LLM性能也未出现崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 以频繁压缩维持短上下文可有效替代长上下文，且不显著损害任务表现；该结果挑战了长上下文语言模型的必要性假设，并引出语义状态空间模型（SSSMs）作为潜在方向。

title: Dual-VaDE: Efficient and Robust Prototype Learning via Variational Dual-Domain Mixture Priors
summary: In this paper, we propose Dual-VaDE, an unsupervised generative framework for learning interpretable anatomical prototypes from unlabeled medical images. In contrast to previous variational methods that rely on a single spatial latent code, which often entangles global geometry with local textures and fails to capture their cross-domain dependencies, Dual-VaDE introduces a dual-domain Gaussian mixture prior that explicitly couples spatial anatomy with phase-preserving Fourier spectral representations. We derive an exact, closed-form variational lower bound that fuses this joint prior into the decoder and optimizes the entire network end-to-end via an alternating EM formulation, avoiding heuristic two-stage clustering while ensuring superior training stability and robustness. Evaluated on OASIS-3 brain MRI, Dual-VaDE delivers substantially sharper and more plausible prototypes, achieves superior cluster separation with improvements of up to 94% over spatial-only baselines, exhibits markedly reduced variance across random seeds, and incurs negligible inference overhead (0.28 ms per image).

AI.tldr: 提出Dual-VaDE——一种无监督生成框架，通过双域高斯混合先验将空间解剖结构与保相傅里叶频谱表示显式耦合，从无标注医学图像中学习可解释的解剖原型。
AI.motivation: 以往变分方法仅依赖单一空间隐码，易将全局几何与局部纹理纠缠，且无法刻画二者的跨域依赖关系；同时常用两阶段聚类等启发式做法，训练稳定性与鲁棒性欠佳。
AI.method: 设计双域高斯混合先验，将空间解剖与保相傅里叶频谱表示联合建模；推导精确闭式变分下界，将该联合先验融入解码器；采用交替EM形式端到端优化整个网络，避免启发式两阶段聚类。
AI.result: 在OASIS-3脑MRI上生成的原型更清晰、更合理；聚类分离度较仅空间基线最高提升94%；跨随机种子方差显著降低；推理开销可忽略（每张图像0.28 ms），训练稳定性与鲁棒性更优。
AI.conclusion: 双域先验耦合空间与频谱信息可有效提升可解释解剖原型学习质量、稳定性与聚类性能，且计算代价极低，具备实际应用潜力。

title: FloMo: 3D Scene Flow as a World Action Model Intermediate for Learning from Human Video
summary: Pretrained video generation models distill internet-scale motion priors into robot policies, but full video is a redundant signal for action prediction. We argue that dense 3D motion is the medium through which video pretraining best transfers to robot actions, and that predicting motion rather than video affords better sample-efficiency for action prediction. FloMo is a 5B video-generation model fine-tuned to predict 3D scene-flow and action tokens. Rendering scene flow as RGB and encoding it into the same latent space as video enables a pretrained video generation backbone to efficiently adapt to predict 3D scene flow. Co-trained on action-free human video and action-labeled robot teleoperation data, our model benefits from human-video pretraining and generalizes to unseen objects, motion primitives, and tasks. Replacing motion prediction with a video prediction objective degrades out-of-distribution generalization, while adding a video prediction target alongside motion lowers policy success rather than improving it. When motion, video, and action are predicted jointly, action tokens attend far more to motion than to video, suggesting that predicting video wastes model capacity. Together, these results indicate that motion effectively mediates the transfer from video pretraining to action. More information can be found at flomo-wam.github.io.

AI.tldr: FloMo 将 5B 视频生成模型微调为预测 3D 场景流与动作 token，证明稠密 3D 运动而非视频本身才是视频预训练迁移到机器人动作的最佳中介，且更具样本效率。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频生成模型可将互联网级运动先验蒸馏进机器人策略，但完整视频对动作预测是冗余信号；作者主张稠密 3D 运动才是视频预训练向机器人动作迁移的媒介，预测运动比预测视频在动作预测上更样本高效。
AI.method: FloMo 为 5B 视频生成模型，微调后同时预测 3D 场景流与动作 token；将场景流渲染为 RGB 并编码进与视频相同的潜空间，使预训练视频骨干网络高效适配到 3D 场景流预测。模型在无动作人类视频与带动作标注的机器人遥操作数据上联合训练。
AI.result: 模型受益于人类视频预训练，并泛化到未见物体、运动基元与任务。消融显示：以视频预测目标替代运动预测会降低分布外泛化；在运动目标之外加入视频预测目标反而降低策略成功率；三者联合预测时，动作 token 对运动的注意力远高于对视频的注意力，表明预测视频浪费模型容量。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明运动是视频预训练向动作迁移的有效中介，视频对动作预测冗余。

title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
summary: Speculative decoding has been treated purely as a systems optimization that speeds up large language model decoding without changing the model behavior. Under this view, the growing effort to train better draft models has been focused solely on acceptance rate. We argue that this view does not hold true for long-horizon agent reasoning. Measuring frontier open-weight models on complex agentic tasks with different speculative decoding approaches, we found that numerical noise grows within verification windows, and the draft acceptance results of the thinking process can change the output distribution of the model after 30 steps, thus noticeably influencing the reasoning accuracy of long-horizon agents in random directions. In this work, we improve the reasoning capability of target models by controlling such noise. While we cannot change the overall token distribution verified by the target model, we can encode critical reasoning with highest precision by training the draft model to be rejected. We identify these points in agent traces and train the draft model to favor adversarial preference. At inference the trained draft and the target part ways precisely at these decision points, verification restarts, so that critical thinking tokens are sampled from the target model and encoded under its least noisy conditions. This approach makes critical reasoning better indexed and more durable over a long horizon. On complex agentic coding benchmarks, our approach raises end-to-end success rate with no change to the target model or its output distribution. Our results recast the speculative decoding mechanism from a pure accelerator into an active allocator for context precision that improves the accuracy of long-horizon agents by training 0.06% to 0.28% of hosted parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战"投机解码不改变模型行为"的传统观点，指出在长程智能体推理中，验证窗口内数值噪声会改变输出分布；通过训练草稿模型在关键推理点被拒绝，使关键思考 token 由目标模型在最精确条件下采样，从而提升长程智能体推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 投机解码通常被视为纯系统级加速优化，训练草稿模型只关注接受率。但在长程智能体推理中，验证窗口内的数值噪声会累积，导致思考过程的接受结果在约30步后改变模型输出分布，以随机方向影响推理准确率。作者希望利用并控制这一现象来提升推理能力。
AI.method: 在复杂智能体任务上测量不同投机解码方式的前沿开源模型，确认验证窗口内数值噪声的影响；在智能体轨迹中识别关键推理点，训练草稿模型采用对抗性偏好（adversarial preference）使其在这些决策点主动被拒绝；推理时草稿与目标模型恰在关键点分叉、重新启动验证，使关键思考 token 由目标模型在其噪声最小条件下采样编码。仅训练托管参数的 0.06%–0.28%。
AI.result: 在复杂智能体编程基准上，端到端成功率提升，且不改变目标模型及其输出分布。
AI.conclusion: 投机解码可从纯加速器重新定位为上下文精度的主动分配器（active allocator for context precision），以极小参数量训练显著提升长程智能体准确性。

title: Molecular Prior Networks
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery: Bridging the Translation Gap
summary: Predicting affinity between small molecules and their protein targets remains one of the central problems in drug discovery. Due to the substantial cost of wet-lab experiments, machine learning models of drug-target affinity are usually trained on relatively small datasets, ranging from tens to hundreds of molecules. Given the inherent difficulty of generalization between different targets and chemical series, existing datasets of protein-ligand affinities are typically not used for new projects. At the same time, tabular foundation models, including Prior-data Fitted Networks, have recently shown how transformers can be used to solve machine learning problems in a single forward pass of the network, after being trained over a large corpus of, typically, synthetic datasets. Inspired by that line of work, we propose a novel affinity modelling approach, in which the labels of the query molecules are predicted from the labelled support molecules in a single forward pass of a transformer model. The model is trained on thousands of existing affinity datasets, enabling it to capture the general patterns of molecular activity across different targets, chemical series and dataset sizes. For the smallest support sets, our model matches the state of the art on the regression variant of the FS-Mol benchmark, while being faster than existing methods, thanks to the lack of task-specific training. A comparison against a reduced variant of our architecture, which amounts to kernel regression in a meta-learned feature space, shows that the predictive performance of the transformer model is only partially explained by simple molecular similarity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于先验数据拟合网络（PFN）思想的单次前向传播药物-靶标亲和力预测方法：以带标签的小分子作为支持集，一次前向即可预测查询分子亲和力，在FS-Mol回归基准的小支持集设定下达到SOTA且更快。
AI.motivation: 药物-靶标亲和力数据规模小（数十至数百分子）、跨靶标与化学系列泛化困难，导致已有亲和力数据集难以迁移到新项目；同时任务特定训练成本高，因此希望借助表格基础模型（PFN）式元学习实现无需任务特训的快速适应。
AI.method: 采用Transformer在大量现有亲和力数据集（数千个）上以（支持集, 查询集）形式进行元训练；推理时将带标签的支持分子与查询分子一并输入，单次前向传播直接输出查询分子亲和力（in-context回归）。并与一个退化为元学习特征空间中核回归的简化架构对比，以剥离简单分子相似性带来的性能贡献。
AI.result: 在最小支持集设定下，模型在FS-Mol回归基准上达到当前最优水平；由于无需任务特定训练，速度优于现有方法；与核回归式简化架构的对比表明，Transformer的性能仅部分可由分子相似性解释。
AI.conclusion: 将亲和力预测重构为单次前向的in-context回归，可有效利用海量异构亲和力数据集获得跨靶标、跨化学系列与跨数据规模的泛化能力，是一种无需逐任务训练且高效的小样本亲和力建模范式。

title: VIGOR: Visual Gain Ordering for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: Multimodal discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate responses through iterative mask prediction and offer a promising alternative to autoregressive large vision-language models. However, they still suffer from hallucination, producing outputs that are plausible under language priors but insufficiently grounded in the image. We argue that hallucination in multimodal dLLMs is not only a token prediction problem, but also a premature commitment problem: during iterative denoising, some masked positions are unmasked too early because their confidence is driven more by language priors than by visual evidence, and these early commitments can bias later generation. To address this issue, we propose Visual Gain Ordering (VIGOR), a training-free and plug-and-play inference strategy that reorders masked positions according to counterfactual visual evidence. At each denoising step, VIGOR compares the confidence of each candidate token under the original image-conditioned pass and an additional visual-ablation pass, and prioritizes positions whose predictions are more strongly supported by the image. Experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO show that VIGOR consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning performance across benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/THU-BPM/Vigor.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、即插即用的推理策略 VIGOR，通过反事实视觉证据重排掩码位置，缓解多模态离散扩散语言模型中的早期承诺型幻觉。
AI.motivation: 多模态离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）通过迭代掩码预测生成，虽具潜力但仍存在幻觉：输出符合语言先验却缺乏图像依据。作者指出该幻觉不仅是token预测问题，更是"过早承诺"问题——部分掩码位置因置信度更多由语言先验而非视觉证据驱动而被过早解掩，进而偏置后续生成。
AI.method: VIGOR（Visual Gain Ordering）：在每个去噪步骤，对每个候选token分别计算原始图像条件下与视觉消融（visual-ablation）条件下的置信度，以两者差值作为反事实视觉增益，据此重排待解掩位置，优先解掩那些预测更受图像支持的位置。方法无需训练、可即插即用。
AI.result: 在 LLaDA-V 与 Lumina-DiMOO 上，VIGOR 在多个基准上一致降低幻觉并提升多模态推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 将多模态dLLM幻觉归因于迭代去噪中的过早承诺，并用反事实视觉增益引导解掩顺序是一种有效且低成本的推理期干预；VIGOR 作为通用即插即用策略可一致改善现有模型。

title: Contextual Linear Activation Steering of Language Models
summary: Linear activation steering is a powerful approach for controlling and specializing large language models by adding linear representations of concepts to their activations at inference. While effective, existing methods often steer with a fixed strength, independent of how much steering any given input requires. In this work, we introduce Contextual Linear Activation Steering (CLAS), which decomposes activation steering into a fixed steering direction and a context-dependent steering coefficient. This decomposition preserves the interpretability of the steering direction while enabling the steering strength to vary with context. It also enables CLAS to perform selective steering: steering multiple behaviors across different portions of a single generation, which cannot be achieved using a fixed steering strength. In addition, across a wide range of steering benchmarks and language models, CLAS consistently outperforms standard linear activation steering and matches or exceeds ReFT and LoRA in settings with limited labeled data. Notably, CLAS achieves this using directions that also serve as reliable concept monitors, a property that directions learned via fine-tuning lack. We therefore propose CLAS as an interpretable and accurate method for controlling and specializing large language models.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文线性激活引导（CLAS），将激活引导分解为固定引导方向与上下文相关的引导系数，实现强度随输入自适应的选择性引导。
AI.motivation: 现有线性激活引导方法以固定强度施加引导，不随输入对引导需求的程度变化，限制了对模型行为的精细控制。
AI.method: 将激活引导解耦为固定的引导方向与依赖上下文的引导系数；方向保持可解释性，系数由上下文决定，从而支持在单次生成的不同片段对多种行为进行选择性引导。
AI.result: 在多种引导基准与语言模型上稳定优于标准线性激活引导；在标注数据有限时与ReFT、LoRA持平或更优；且所用方向可作为可靠的概念监测器，而微调所得方向缺乏该性质。
AI.conclusion: CLAS是一种兼具可解释性与准确性的控制与特化大语言模型的方法。

title: Beyond Multi-Index Models: Learning Intersections of Degree-2 PTFs
summary:
We give an algorithm for PAC learning intersections of $k$ degree-2 polynomial threshold functions over $R^d$ under a Gaussian distribution. Our algorithm achieves classification error $ε$ using $d^{O(k)}2^{O_k(\log^3(1/ε))}$ time and samples, improving over the $d^{O(k^2/ε^2)}$ running time of the polynomial regression approach. To our knowledge, our result is the first to obtain a dimension exponent independent of the accuracy parameter, even for $k=2$. We complement our algorithmic result with an SQ lower bound showing that the complexity dependence of $d^{Ω(k)}$ is unavoidable.
  Lifting the input to polynomial features turns the target into an intersection of $k$ halfspaces. This suggests using the first two labeled moments for subspace recovery. In the lifted space, however, these moments can reveal nothing. Our starting point is a Gaussian comparison theorem showing that, for sufficiently regular defining quadratics, the labeled moments needed for subspace recovery are approximately preserved. To handle arbitrary defining quadratics, we establish a new structural result showing that every direction with significant resampling influence can be detected through degree-$O(k)$ moments. These results yield an initial $d^{O(k)}2^{\mathrm{poly}_k(1/ε)}$-time learner using adaptive restrictions.
  To improve the exponential dependence on $1/ε$, we develop a two-stage dimension-reduction approach that avoids the costly adaptive partitioning. After identifying a subspace containing all directions with large influence, we use generalized regularity and Gaussian comparison to recover the remaining relevant quadratic features through a new derivative-based moment operator. The recovered features support an intersection close to the target. Combining them with robust hinge-loss minimization gives our quasipolynomial-time learner.

AI.tldr: 论文给出在 Gaussian 分布下 PAC 学习 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上 $k$ 个二次多项式阈值函数交集（degree-2 PTF 交集）的算法，时间与样本复杂度为 $d^{O(k)}2^{O_k(\log^3(1/\varepsilon))}$，首次实现维度指数与精度参数 $\varepsilon$ 无关（即使 $k=2$）；并给出 SQ 下界证明 $d^{\Omega(k)}$ 的依赖不可避免。
AI.motivation: 多项式回归方法需 $d^{O(k^2/\varepsilon^2)}$ 时间，维度指数随 $1/\varepsilon$ 增长，效率差。作者希望获得维度指数与精度无关的算法，并厘清该问题在 SQ 模型下的固有复杂度下界。
AI.method: 将输入提升到多项式特征空间，把目标转化为 $k$ 个半空间的交集，从而可用前两阶带标签矩做子空间恢复；但提升空间中这些矩失效。为此：(1) 建立 Gaussian 比较定理，说明对足够正则的定义二次型，子空间恢复所需标签矩近似保持；(2) 给出结构结果：任何具有显著重采样影响的方向都可由 $O(k)$ 阶矩检测，得到初始 $d^{O(k)}2^{\mathrm{poly}_k(1/\varepsilon)}$ 学习器（基于自适应限制）；(3) 为去掉对 $1/\varepsilon$ 的指数依赖，设计两阶段降维：先定位包含所有高影响方向的子空间，再借广义正则性与 Gaussian 比较，用新的基于导数的矩算子恢复剩余相关二次特征，最后结合鲁棒 hinge-loss 最小化。
AI.result: 在 Gaussian 分布下达到分类误差 $\varepsilon$，时间与样本为 $d^{O(k)}2^{O_k(\log^3(1/\varepsilon))}$，显著优于 $d^{O(k^2/\varepsilon^2)}$ 的多项式回归；维度指数与 $\varepsilon$ 无关，$k=2$ 亦为首例。同时给出 SQ 下界，表明 $d^{\Omega(k)}$ 的复杂度依赖不可消除。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了二次 PTF 交集学习的准多项式时间算法，实现了维度对精度的解耦，并通过 SQ 下界证明了算法在 $d$ 的指数依赖上已达本质最优，刻画了该问题的统计—计算权衡。

title: Manifold Embedding of Deep Image Features for Image Matching via Neural Adjoint Maps
summary: Estimating semantic correspondences between different object instances of similar categories in real-world images is a fundamental challenge in computer vision. While the recent progress in foundation models has significantly advanced solutions for such difficult image correspondence problems, respective methods are often insufficiently regularised. For example, common nearest-neighbour matching with foundation model features often results in noisy correspondences, which is particularly prominent when solving for dense correspondences. In this work, we tackle image matching via functional maps, which have been popularised for 3D shape matching due to their powerful spectral formalism utilising an efficient low-dimensional linear representation. However, functional maps require that domains (in our cases the rectangular image grids) are equipped with an informative and non-trivial geometry. To define a meaningful manifold structure for images, we use Galerkin's method from finite elements to derive a discrete Laplace-Beltrami operator (LBO) based on a manifold embedding of deep image features. Further, we leverage a neural adjoint map that allows to represent non-linear mappings. We demonstrate that our method sets the new state of the art among zero-shot image correspondence methods on multiple dense correspondence benchmarks of real-world images. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/NafieAmrani/NAMI

AI.tldr: 提出NAMI方法，将函数映射（functional maps）引入图像对应问题：用Galerkin有限元法在深度特征流形嵌入上推导离散Laplace-Beltrami算子，并结合神经伴随映射表示非线性映射，在多个稠密对应基准上取得零样本SOTA。
AI.motivation: 基础模型特征上的最近邻匹配缺乏正则化，易产生噪声对应，在稠密对应场景尤为明显；而函数映射虽具强大谱形式与低维线性表示优势，却要求域（如矩形图像网格）具备有信息量且非平凡的几何结构。
AI.method: 1) 将图像域视为流形，基于深度特征的流形嵌入定义有意义的流形结构；2) 采用有限元中的Galerkin方法推导离散Laplace-Beltrami算子（LBO）；3) 在此几何基础上使用函数映射框架进行匹配，并引入神经伴随映射（neural adjoint map）以表示非线性映射。
AI.result: 在多个真实图像稠密对应基准上，该方法在零样本图像对应方法中取得新的最优性能（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: 通过为图像网格赋予由深度特征诱导的流形几何，函数映射可有效用于图像语义对应，兼具正则化能力与表达力；代码已开源。

title: rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment
comment: 27 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste
summary: Do research agents have taste, the judgment of which experiments are worth running before their outcomes are known? We give six frontier models seven recent NLP papers. Each model, working as a research agent alone or as a team, proposes minimum viable experiments (MVEs), forecasts whether each will pass a threshold it sets and ranks them. A separate executor then attempts every MVE, including those ranked last, and three model auditors judge the results. Of 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new, but fewer than half of these (73) are also judged beyond the seed paper and non obvious. The agents' first choices match the auditors' most valued experiment more often than a random pick, but are not shown to improve on choosing the experiment written first. Their forecasts beat a base rate but are not measurably more accurate than those of a fresh instance of the same model given only the paper and registrations. Teams cost more without a clear overall improvement in proposal quality. The agents produce many worthwhile experiments, but the evidence that their rankings improve the choice of which to run remains limited. The evaluation harness and a dataset of all 415 MVEs, with their forecasts and audited outcomes, are available at https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste.

AI.tldr: 研究测试前沿模型作为研究智能体是否具备"品味"（在结果未知前判断实验价值），通过7篇NLP论文生成并预测最小可行实验（MVE），结论是模型能产出大量有价值的实验，但其排序相对基线并未显示可测量的改进。
AI.motivation: 探究研究智能体是否具备"品味"，即在实验结果的不可知的情况下判断哪些实验值得运行的能力。
AI.method: 给六个前沿模型七篇近期NLP论文，模型以单独或团队形式提出MVE，并为每个实验设定阈值、预测是否通过并进行排序；独立执行器尝试全部MVE（含排名最后的），再由三名模型审计员评审结果。共收集415个MVE，评价其是否sound、valuable、new，以及是否超出种子论文且非显而易见。
AI.result: 415个MVE中194个被评为合理、有价值且新颖，但其中仅73个同时被评为超出种子论文且非显而易见。智能体的首选比随机选择更常匹配审计员最看重的实验，但相较"直接选论文中先写出的实验"未显示改进；其预测优于基率，但与仅提供论文和注册信息的同模型新实例相比无明显更准；团队模式成本更高但提案质量整体无明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 智能体能产出许多值得做的实验，但其排序能改进"该跑哪个实验"选择决策的证据仍然有限；作者开源了评估框架及415个MVE的预测与审计结果数据集。

title: Towards an Optimal Control Foundation of Early Exits - Turnpikes and ResNets
summary: The feed-forward propagation through neural networks is crucial for training and inference. To trade off efficiency and accuracy, it has been proposed to consider intermediate outputs of hidden states as data-dependent regularization during training and, ultimately, as early-exits during inference. In this work, we analyze the joint optimization of loss functions computed for the output layer and intermediate layers using optimal control theory. We prove that ResNets trained in this joint fashion exhibit the so-called turnpike phenomenon, this implies that the number of layers required to reach a prescribed loss level is bounded from above independently of the overall network depth. This induces a similarity property across the internal representations of early-exiting networks of varying depths. We connect the turnpike to the overthinking phenomenon, and provide theoretical insights into the success of early-exit criteria derived from softmax probabilities, specifically entropy and max-probability. In a range of experiments, we demonstrate the existence and effect of turnpikes and the resulting similarity in the early-exit performance for ResNets of varying depths.

AI.tldr: 本文用最优控制理论分析输出层与中间层损失的联合优化，证明联合训练的ResNet具有"turnpike"（高速公路）现象，从而为早退机制的有效性（含基于软熵/最大概率的准则）提供理论解释，并通过实验验证。
AI.motivation: 为兼顾效率与精度，已有工作将隐藏层中间输出视为训练时的数据依赖正则、推理时的早退（early-exit）。但缺乏对"联合优化输出层与中间层损失"这一做法的理论理解，尤其是为何浅层中间表示能支撑早退决策。
AI.method: 以最优控制理论为工具，把ResNet的前向传播视为受控动力系统、逐层损失为运行代价，分析输出层与中间层损失的联合优化问题；证明相应的turnpike性质，并将其与overthinking现象、softmax熵与最大概率型早退准则建立联系；辅以多组实验。
AI.result: 证明联合训练的ResNet呈现turnpike现象：达到给定损失水平所需层数有与总深度无关的上界；由此得到不同深度早退网络内部表示之间的相似性；将turnpike与overthinking联系起来，并理论上解释基于熵/最大概率的早退准则为何有效；实验表明不同深度ResNet均存在turnpike、表示相似性及相应的早退性能一致性。
AI.conclusion: 联合训练中间层损失可诱导turnpike结构，使所需深度与网络总深度解耦，为早退机制及其准则提供理论支撑，并解释深层网络的"过度思考"。

title: Sparse Anchors for Visual Multi-Session Registration in Changing Environments
summary: Repeated robotic monitoring requires localization across visits to the same environment, even if the environment changes. Such changes can substantially reduce persistent visual content, and repetitive structures can lead to incorrect cross-session correspondences. In this paper, we address visual multi-session registration of a new data recording (the query session) to a previously reconstructed reference map. Under substantial visual and structural changes, cross-session localization may be possible only for parts of the trajectory. In our approach, we therefore rely on a sparse set of reliable absolute pose constraints and combine them with within-session relative-pose information to register the complete trajectory to the reference map. We first estimate absolute alignment hypotheses through visual place recognition, local feature matching, and geometric verification. We then use sequence consensus to reject hypotheses that are inconsistent with a common query-to-reference alignment and retain the remaining poses as absolute anchors. These anchors are refined through featuremetric alignment against a Gaussian feature field and combined with within-session relative-pose constraints in a robust pose-graph optimization. We evaluate our approach on 15 cross-session experiments from the challenging HILTI26 construction-site dataset, covering substantial scene changes and difficult-to-match environments. Our method achieves 94.4% recall within 1m and 100.0% within 5m, outperforming independent image localization, which peaks at 65.3% and 70.7%, respectively, as well as direct registration of independently reconstructed Structure-from-Motion geometry. Our results show that sparse, reliable absolute anchors can provide accurate and complete trajectory registration even when reliable cross-session correspondences are available only for part of the query session.

AI.tldr: 提出基于稀疏可靠绝对位姿锚点+会话内相对位姿约束的鲁棒位姿图优化方法，实现跨会话视觉定位，在HILTI26数据集15组实验中达到1m内94.4%、5m内100.0%的召回率。
AI.motivation: 重复性机器人监测需在同一环境多次访问间实现定位，但环境变化会大幅减少持久视觉内容，重复结构易导致跨会话错误对应；且在大幅视觉与结构变化下，可靠的跨会话对应往往仅存在于轨迹局部，需在部分可靠条件下完成整条轨迹的配准。
AI.method: 将新采集的查询会话配准到已重建的参考地图。先通过视觉地点识别、局部特征匹配与几何验证生成绝对对齐假设；利用序列一致性剔除与共同查询-参考对齐不一致的假设，保留余下位姿作为绝对锚点；锚点通过针对高斯特征场的featuremetric对齐进行精化；最后将精化锚点与会话内相对位姿约束结合，进行鲁棒位姿图优化。
AI.result: 在HILTI26建筑工地数据集的15组跨会话实验中（含显著场景变化与难匹配环境），方法取得1m内94.4%、5m内100.0%的召回率；对比独立图像定位（峰值分别为65.3%与70.7%）及独立重建SfM几何的直接配准，均显著更优，能实现准确且完整的轨迹配准。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏但可靠的绝对锚点结合会话内相对位姿约束，可在仅有部分查询会话具备可靠跨会话对应时，仍实现准确、完整的轨迹级跨会话配准，验证了"局部绝对约束+全局相对约束"融合范式的有效性。

title: PAC Learning with Multiple Correct Answers
summary:
We study PAC learning when each example comes with a set of at most $\ell$ correct labels and a prediction is correct if it belongs to this set. Training may reveal the full set, only whether a proposed label is correct (bandit feedback), or one correct label chosen by a demonstrator (emonstrations).
  Our main finding is that demonstrations can be much harder than full sets, and even than bandit feedback, both in which classes can be learned and in how many examples are needed. For finite label spaces, a generalized Natarajan dimension characterizes learnability from full sets and from bandit feedback, in both the realizable and the agnostic setting. From demonstrations, however, a class is realizably learnable if and only if the intersections of at most $\ell+1$ of its hypotheses are learnable from full sets. Already with three labels, this condition can fail for a class learnable from a single full-set example or even a single bandit answer. When the condition holds, we show that $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-\ell})$ demonstrations suffice, and the exponent $\ell$ cannot be improved in general, even for classes learnable from $\widetilde O(1/\varepsilon)$ full sets or bandit answers.
  For countable label spaces and $\ell \geq 2$, our packed dimension, which asks for many disjoint groups of at most $\ell+1$ hypotheses with no common label, characterizes full-set learnability, and demonstrations still reduce to intersections. Agnostic learning from demonstrations, already for finite label spaces, is not determined by the dimensions of the intersection class that characterize realizable learning.
  Finally, we show that the uniform bound $\ell$ on the number of correct labels is essential. Without this bound, it is impossible to characterize learnability by any dimension determined by finite subclasses.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究多标签（每个样本至多 ℓ 个正确标签）PAC 学习在三种反馈模型（完整标签集、bandit 反馈、演示）下的可学习性差异，提出广义 Natarajan 维与 packed 维刻画，并证明演示反馈显著难于其他两种反馈。
AI.motivation: 现实中学习者的信息获取方式不同：可获完整正确标签集、只能得到"某标签是否正确"的 bandit 反馈，或仅观察到示范者给出的一个正确标签。作者希望弄清这三种反馈在可学习类与样本复杂度上是否存在本质差异，并给出理论刻画。
AI.method: 对有限标签空间，用广义 Natarajan 维刻画完整集与 bandit 反馈在可实现与不可知两种设定下的可学习性；对演示反馈，给出可实现可学习性等价于"任意至多 ℓ+1 个假设的交类可由完整集学习"的判据。对可数标签空间（ℓ≥2），提出 packed 维（寻找多组互不相交、每组至多 ℓ+1 个无公共标签的假设）刻画完整集可学习性。同时给出上界样本复杂度与下界构造，并研究无一致 ℓ 界时的可刻画性。
AI.result: 演示反馈在可学习类范围与样本量两方面都可能严格难于完整集甚至 bandit 反馈：三个标签时已存在可由单个完整集样本或单次 bandit 回答学习、但演示不可学习的类。条件成立时演示需 Õ(ε^{-ℓ}) 个样本，指数 ℓ 一般不可改进，即便该类可由 Õ(1/ε) 个完整集样本或 bandit 回答学习。可数标签空间下 packed 维刻画完整集可学习性，演示仍归结为交类。演示的不可知学习不能由刻画可实现学习的交类维度确定。此外，若去掉 ℓ 的一致上界，则不存在由有限子类决定的维度刻画可学习性。
AI.conclusion: 反馈的信息形式对 PAC 学习有本质影响，演示反馈带来的样本复杂度代价随 ℓ 呈指数增长且一般不可改进；完整集与 bandit 反馈共享同一维度刻画，而演示需借助交类条件；一致标签数上界是可刻画性的关键前提。

title: High-fidelity training-free photovoltaic module mapping from multi-view UAV imagery
summary: High-fidelity photovoltaic (PV) module mapping requires complete instance recovery and accurate delineation. Vision foundation models offer zero-shot segmentation, but converting incomplete and inconsistent predictions across views into a complete, geometrically accurate map of individual modules remains challenging. We propose the Multi-View PV Module Mapper (MV-PVMapper), a training-free framework coupling vision foundation models with unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry. First, Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) generates candidates from original images using text prompts. Their contours are then transferred into object space through per-module slope correction to limit distortion from surface-model noise, and verified against representative module dimensions to guide cross-view instance selection. Finally, accepted instances return to all covering images as box prompts for SAM~3, supplementing text prompts with spatial cues for iterative segmentation, verification and fusion. On five-direction surveys of three operational rooftop PV plants at approximately 1 cm nadir ground sampling distance, two feedback iterations recover 7,710 of 7,711 reference modules with no false positives at an intersection-over-union (IoU) matching threshold of 0.5. Macro-averaged area precision and recall reach 99.00 % and 98.52 %, respectively. Averaged across sites, the aggregated Jaccard index reaches 97.55 %, compared with 60.73 % and 41.24 % for orthomosaic segmentation and multi-view pixel-voting baselines, respectively; average precision at the stricter IoU threshold of 0.95 reaches 95.67 %. Ablation studies show that module-size constraints are critical for instance separation, while slope correction and feedback to all covering views improve boundary accuracy. These results are achieved without task-specific image annotation or segmentation-model weight updates.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的MV-PVMapper框架，将视觉基础模型与无人机摄影测量耦合，实现光伏组件高保真实例制图。
AI.motivation: 高保真光伏组件制图需要完整实例恢复与精确边界，但视觉基础模型的零样本分割跨视图预测不完整且不一致，难以转为完整、几何准确的单体组件图。
AI.method: MV-PVMapper为无需训练的框架：先用SAM 3基于文本提示在原始影像上生成候选；经逐组件坡度校正将轮廓传递至物方以抑制表面模型噪声，并用代表性组件尺寸校验以指导跨视图实例选择；最后将接受的实例回投至所有覆盖影像作为框提示，与文本提示共同驱动SAM 3迭代分割、验证与融合（两次反馈迭代）。
AI.result: 在约1 cm下视地面采样距离的三个在运屋顶电站五方向航测中，两次反馈迭代在IoU=0.5下恢复7,710/7,711个参考组件且无假阳性；宏平均面积精确率与召回率为99.00%和98.52%；聚合Jaccard指数平均达97.55%（正射影像分割为60.73%、多视图像素投票为41.24%），IoU=0.95下平均精度达95.67%。消融显示组件尺寸约束对实例分离关键，坡度校正与全视图反馈提升边界精度。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需任务特定图像标注或分割模型权重更新，即可实现高完整度、高几何精度的光伏组件制图。

title: Beyond Foundation Models: PFN Priors Improve Tabular Hyperparameter Optimization
summary: Synthetic priors have so far served one purpose: pretraining tabular foundation models. We ask whether the same priors can improve conventional tabular models, which are trained from scratch on each dataset. We propose PriorTune, a method that meta-tunes hyperparameter configurations on synthetic tasks alone. Offline, for a given model, we fit a pool of configurations on datasets sampled from a published PFN prior and greedily select the subset with the highest winrate over the random baseline. Online, a new dataset fits only the selected configurations, so the gain comes at no extra cost. Empirically, we observe that scaling both the number of configurations and synthetic datasets has an equal scaling effect on the performance of the final subset of configurations, which we also explain theoretically. On the full BeyondArena benchmark, LightGBM with TabPrep features with our configurations ranks above TabPFN-3 and RealMLP, while being much more efficient at inference. Overall, our results establish existing PFN priors as a scalable source of meta-training data for hyperparameter selection for non-foundational tabular models.

AI.tldr: 提出 PriorTune：仅在合成任务上元调优超参数配置，离线贪心筛选高胜率配置，在线无需额外成本即可提升传统表格模型；配置数与合成数据集数具等效的缩放效应，LightGBM+TabPrep 在 BeyondArena 上优于 TabPFN-3 与 RealMLP 且推理更高效。
AI.motivation: 合成先验（synthetic priors）此前只用于预训练表格基础模型（PFN）。作者质疑：同样的先验能否也惠及需要在每个数据集上从头训练的传统表格模型，从而把 PFN 先验当作可扩展的超参数元训练数据来源。
AI.method: PriorTune 采用离线-在线两阶段。离线：对给定模型，从已发表的 PFN 先验中采样数据集，拟合一个配置池，并以相对随机基线的胜率（winrate）贪心选择最优子集。在线：新数据集只拟合被选中的少量配置，因此不增加额外成本。此外对配置数与合成数据集数的缩放效应给出理论解释。
AI.result: 实验发现同时扩大配置数量与合成数据集数量对最终配置子集性能具有等效的缩放效应，并有理论支撑。在完整 BeyondArena 基准上，使用 TabPrep 特征的 LightGBM 配合所选配置，排名高于 TabPFN-3 与 RealMLP，且推理效率显著更高。
AI.conclusion: 现有 PFN 先验可作为面向非基础型表格模型的超参数选择的、可扩展的元训练数据来源；合成先验的用途由“预训练”扩展至“超参数元调优”。

title: When Cell Crops Share a Parent: Measuring and Isolating Acquisition Leakage in Cervical Cytology Benchmarks
summary: Public cervical cytology benchmarks release many cell crops cut from far fewer microscope fields or slides and are often split at the crop level, so test cells share acquisition parents with training cells. In a preregistered study, crop-level splitting raised SIPaKMeD accuracy by 0.97 percentage points across twelve architectures and twenty seeds (95% CI 0.59-1.39), and CRIC accuracy by 12.08 points (11.16-12.99). On SIPaKMeD, a factorial that fixes training crop and parent counts attributes the gain to sibling exposure (1.73 points, 0.95-2.51), not to the extra parent diversity of crop-level splits (0.00). Parent identity is decodable at about 100 times chance, yet erasing 82% of its above-floor linear recoverability left the gap unchanged, and Grad-CAM did not distinguish leaking from clean models; matching test cells' color statistics to an unseen same-class field removed most of the advantage. Decodability and saliency cannot substitute for a parent-disjoint split.

AI.tldr: 公共宫颈细胞学基准以“细胞裁剪块（crop）”为单位划分数据集，导致测试细胞与训练细胞共享采集母体（同一视野/同一玻片），存在数据泄漏；本研究量化了该泄漏带来的准确率虚高，并证明仅靠可解码性或显著性图无法检测泄漏，必须采用母体不相交（parent-disjoint）划分。
AI.motivation: 现有宫颈细胞学基准（如SIPaKMeD、CRIC）发布的裁剪块远多于其来源显微视野/玻片数量，且通常在裁剪块层面做训练/测试划分，使测试细胞与训练细胞共享采集母体。这种“兄弟暴露”（sibling exposure）造成的乐观偏差此前缺乏系统、预注册的量化，也缺乏对泄漏成因（母体多样性 vs 兄弟重叠）的因果拆解，以及对常用泄漏检测手段（表征可解码性、Grad-CAM）有效性的检验。
AI.method: 预注册研究。方法包括：(1) 在12种架构×20个随机种子上对比裁剪级划分与母体不相交划分，报告准确率差的95%置信区间；(2) 在SIPaKMeD上设计析因实验，固定训练裁剪块数与母体数，分离“兄弟暴露”与“母体多样性”两种效应；(3) 探针实验：线性探测母体身份的可解码性，并擦除82%高于随机水平的线性可恢复信息后重测性能差距；(4) 用Grad-CAM比较泄漏模型与干净模型；(5) 将测试细胞的颜色统计匹配到一个未见过的同类视野，检验外观捷径的贡献。
AI.result: 裁剪级划分使SIPaKMeD准确率提升0.97个百分点（95% CI 0.59–1.39），CRIC提升12.08个百分点（11.16–12.99）。析因实验表明增益来自兄弟暴露（+1.73，0.95–2.51），而非裁剪级划分带来的额外母体多样性（0.00）。母体身份的可解码性约为随机水平的100倍，但擦除82%的超出随机水平的线性可恢复信息后性能差距不变；Grad-CAM无法区分泄漏模型与干净模型；将测试细胞颜色统计匹配到未见同类视野可消除大部分优势。
AI.conclusion: 裁剪级划分造成的性能虚高主要源于同母体兄弟样本暴露，且该泄漏在很大程度上通过颜色/外观统计捷径被利用。母体身份的高可解码性与显著性图（Grad-CAM）均不能作为泄漏的可靠代理指标。因此，细胞学基准应采用母体不相交的划分，而不能用可解码性或显著性替代。

title: Macrocanonical Generator Networks: Data-Efficient Neural Surrogates for Amortized Physics Simulation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages total (inc. appendices), 4 figures
summary: Many scientific simulations are computationally expensive, limiting their use in simulation-based inference, uncertainty quantification, and decision making. We introduce macrocanonical generator networks, a framework for learning fast, data-efficient neural surrogates for amortized simulation of stationary physical processes by matching multiscale statistics of a target process. Inspired by microcanonical maximum-entropy synthesis, which matches feature statistics per sample by inner-loop optimization, our approach instead trains a neural generator to satisfy the same constraints in expectation, preserving physically realistic sample-to-sample fluctuations. We prove that gradient-descent training induces preconditioned gradient-descent dynamics in sample space that inherit the symmetry-preservation properties of the microcanonical gradient descent of Bruna and Mallat, amortizing its per-sample inner-loop optimization into a single training run after which every sample is generated in one forward pass. We further show that residual generator parameterizations initialized near the identity, trained with a small learning rate, preserve entropy locally during early optimization and mitigate mode collapse. Experiments on cosmology and fluid simulations show that macrocanonical generators recover realistic samples from extremely small training sets, in some cases a single training example, while generating new realizations more than $10^6$ times faster per sample than the reference simulator and more than $10^3$ times faster than microcanonical gradient descent. The trained generators can be reused for downstream pretraining, including simulation-based inference, providing a data-efficient route to multi-fidelity scientific machine learning workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出宏正则生成网络（macrocanonical generator networks），通过学习目标过程的跨尺度统计量，训练快速、数据高效的神经代理模型，用于平稳物理过程的摊还仿真；在极小训练集下生成真实样本，比参考模拟器快10^6倍以上、比微正则梯度下降快10^3倍以上。
AI.motivation: 科学仿真计算代价高昂，限制了其在基于仿真的推断、不确定性量化和决策中的应用；需要快速、数据高效的仿真代理。
AI.method: 受微正则最大熵合成（逐样本内循环优化匹配特征统计量）启发，改为训练神经生成器在期望意义上满足相同的多尺度统计量约束；理论分析表明梯度下降训练在样本空间诱导预条件梯度下降动力学，继承Bruna与Mallat微正则梯度下降的对称性保持性质，将逐样本内循环优化摊还为单次训练、推理时一次前向；并证明近恒等初始化的残差生成器参数化配合小学习率可在早期优化中局部保持熵、缓解模式坍塌。
AI.result: 在宇宙学和流体仿真实验中，方法可从极小训练集（有时仅单个样本）恢复真实样本；每样本生成速度比参考模拟器快逾10^6倍，比微正则梯度下降快逾10^3倍；训练后的生成器可复用下游预训练（如基于仿真的推断）。
AI.conclusion: 宏正则生成网络提供了一条数据高效的多保真科学机器学习工作流路径，兼顾真实涨落统计、极端样本效率与推理速度，并可作为下游任务的可复用代理。

title: Perturb, Repair, Verify: Self-Play Vision-Language Verifiers for Compositional Understanding
summary: Vision-language verifiers judge whether an image faithfully matches a textual description, yet existing training pipelines typically rely on static supervision from stronger external judges or curated hard-negative data. Such supervision requires external generation or annotation, is teacher-bounded, and is difficult to adapt as model failures evolve. We introduce PROVE (Perturb-and-Repair Optimization for Vision-Language Evaluation), a self-play framework that trains verifiers through a closed perturb-verify-repair-verify loop. Starting from a known-correct image-caption pair, a Mutator introduces a typed perturbation over objects, attributes, counts, or relations. The verifier then judges the perturbed caption and provides textual feedback, which a Repairer uses to recover a faithful caption for re-verification. These two verification rounds produce structured rewards for informative mismatches and visually grounded repairs. Since perturbation, verification, and repair are role-conditioned behaviors of the same evolving multimodal backbone, updating the shared parameters also improves the verifier itself. Experiments show that PROVE improves fine-grained compositional verification across model scales and families and strengthens visual-detail robustness on the reference backbone, with limited, benchmark-dependent changes on broader multimodal tasks.

AI.tldr: PROVE 提出一种自博弈框架，通过"扰动-验证-修复-再验证"闭环训练视觉语言验证器，摆脱对外部强教师判断或人工硬负样本的静态监督依赖，在细粒度组合式验证任务上稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言验证器依赖来自更强外部裁判的静态监督或人工整理的硬负样本数据。这类监督需额外生成或标注，性能受教师上限约束（teacher-bounded），且难以随模型失败模式的演化而自适应调整。
AI.method: 从已知正确的图文对出发：(1) Mutator 引入带类型标注的扰动（对象、属性、计数、关系）；(2) Verifier 判定被扰动 caption 是否忠实并给出文本反馈；(3) Repairer 依据反馈修复出忠实 caption 并再次验证。两轮验证产生结构化奖励，分别奖励有信息量的错误匹配与视觉有据的修复。扰动、验证、修复均为同一多模态骨干模型的角色条件化行为，共享参数更新使验证器自身同步受益。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模与模型族上，PROVE 均提升细粒度组合式验证能力；在参考骨干上增强了对视觉细节的鲁棒性；在更广泛的多模态任务上变化有限且依赖具体基准。
AI.conclusion: 以自博弈闭环替代静态外部监督，可有效训练视觉语言验证器并随模型演化自适应；主要收益集中于组合式细粒度验证与视觉细节鲁棒性，泛化到其他多模态任务时收益不稳定。

title: Basin2Vec: Learning Basin-Centric Embeddings for Scalable Hydrological Modeling
summary: Reliable streamflow prediction across time and in ungauged basins requires representations that capture hydrologically relevant basin characteristics. Existing methods rely on either fixed handcrafted attributes or general-purpose Earth observation embeddings not tailored to basin structure. We introduce \textbf{Basin2Vec}, a self-supervised framework that learns compact basin representations from hydroclimatic and physiographic data without observed streamflow. Basin2Vec organizes representation learning around basin scale and relationships across space and time. Across multiple forecasting architectures, it consistently outperforms predefined attributes and general-purpose geospatial embeddings in temporal generalization and zero-shot spatial transfer. Basin2Vec provides average relative gains of up to 8.3% temporally and achieves 3.5x the median predictive performance of the strongest baselines on unseen basins. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of basin-centric pretraining for transferable hydrologic prediction. Code is available at https://github.com/Muhammad-Talha-MT/basin2vec

AI.tldr: Basin2Vec：无需径流观测，从水文气象与地形地貌数据中自监督学习紧凑的流域表征，显著提升径流预测的时序泛化与无资料流域零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 跨时间、跨流域的可靠径流预测需要能刻画水文相关流域特征的表示。现有方法要么依赖固定的手工属性，要么使用面向通用地球观测嵌入、未针对流域结构定制，因而迁移性受限。
AI.method: 提出自监督框架Basin2Vec，在不使用实测径流的前提下，从水文气象与自然地理数据中学习流域表征；表征学习围绕流域尺度及空间、时间上的流域间关系进行组织，并嵌入多种预测架构中进行下游径流预测。
AI.result: 在多种预报架构下，Basin2Vec在时序泛化与零样本空间迁移上一致优于预定义属性和通用地理空间嵌入；时序上平均相对增益最高达8.3%，在未见流域上的中位预测性能为最强基线的3.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 以流域为中心的自监督预训练可有效支撑可迁移的水文预测，为无资料流域径流估计提供了新范式。

title: PadLoc: Training-Free Floor-Plan Localization by Sparse Geometric Matching
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027 (Algorithms track). 22 pages: main paper (10 pages incl. references) and supplementary material (12 pages). Code: https://github.com/mbookhahn/padloc
summary: We propose PadLoc, a training-free localization back-end that places a moving sensor within a known floor plan. Floor plans are cheap, persistent, and robust to appearance change, but recent learned-depth methods localize against them by filtering per-frame depth through dense $(x,y,θ)$ pose grids. PadLoc keeps the swappable depth front-end and replaces the dense grid back-end with sparse geometric matching: dominant wall orientations define a small pose-candidate set, masked normalized cross-correlation scores observed free space against the plan, and a moving-pose Gaussian-mixture Bayes filter plus consensus readout decodes the trajectory. Holding each competitor's depth fixed, PadLoc matches or beats UnLoc's forward filter and the F3Loc filter at every Gibson trajectory length, and UnLoc's offline refinement from $T=35$ on; it exceeds Z-FLoc's published results with a shared MapAnything front-end. On Bonn LiLocBench, PadLoc improves pooled SR@1m over UnLoc by 23-32 pp under wheel odometry and 35-43 pp with ground-truth motion; with full-FOV LiDAR plus wheel odometry the same readout reaches 100% SR@1m at 9-10 cm median error on the static sequence. On the Hilti-Trimble Localization Challenge PadLoc localizes a camera-only fisheye rig on construction floors hundreds of metres across at 0.90-0.98 online SR@2m on three of five sessions; adding learned wall isolation, applied to every session, covers all five at 0.67-0.92 with the localizer unchanged throughout. PadLoc thus matches or outperforms dense grid back-ends while preserving sensor modularity and a compact state that does not grow with trajectory length.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练定位后端PadLoc，用稀疏几何匹配替代稠密位姿网格，在已知平面图中定位移动传感器，精度匹配或超越稠密网格后端且状态紧凑。
AI.motivation: 平面图廉价、持久且对外观变化鲁棒，但近期学习深度方法依赖逐帧深度在稠密(x,y,θ)位姿网格上滤波，计算与状态开销大。作者希望保留可替换的深度前端，构建更稀疏、紧凑的后端。
AI.method: PadLoc为免训练后端：用主墙体朝向定义小型候选位姿集；以掩膜归一化互相关将观测自由空间与平面图打分；再用移动位姿高斯混合贝叶斯滤波与一致性读出解码轨迹。深度前端可替换，并可选增加学习式墙体隔离模块。
AI.result: 固定同一深度前端时，在各Gibson轨迹长度上匹配或超越UnLoc前向滤波与F3Loc，并从T=35起优于UnLoc离线精化；共享MapAnything前端时超过Z-FLoc已发表结果。Bonn LiLocBench上，SR@1m较UnLoc提升23–32 pp（轮式里程计）与35–43 pp（真值运动）；全视场LiDAR加轮式里程计时静态序列达100% SR@1m、中位误差9–10 cm。Hilti-Trimble挑战中，纯相机鱼眼在三/五会话达0.90–0.98在线SR@2m，加入墙体隔离后五会话全部覆盖，达0.67–0.92。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏几何匹配后端可在保持传感器模块化与紧凑状态（不随轨迹长度增长）的前提下匹配或超越稠密网格后端，并在多数据集与挑战赛场景中验证有效。

title: Provably Learning Mixtures of Linear Experts
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are widely deployed in modern machine learning. However, few convergence guarantees exist for gradient-based training of MoEs: the objective is nonconvex, and even simple mixtures trap first-order methods in spurious local optima. We analyze a canonical gated mixture featuring linear experts and a gate induced by Gaussian clusters in the input space, and give, to our knowledge, the first global convergence guarantee for jointly training the gate and the experts of such a model by gradient EM on its likelihood. Given a logarithmic overparameterization relative to the true number of experts $m$, gradient EM converges from randomly initialized gates and least-squares-initialized experts to any prescribed accuracy in polynomially many iterations, under a separation condition on the gate centers. Our analysis establishes a gradient-dominance inequality for the coupled dynamics by decoupling the loss into per-cluster subproblems. Empirical results validate the predicted $m\log m$ phase transition and suggest that the least-squares warm start required by our analysis is not needed in practice: randomly initialized experts perform nearly as well. We also find that leaving the mixing weights unconstrained concentrates routing onto the true number of experts, whereas load-balancing penalties spread it, so that the fitted model can be pruned to a fraction of its width without loss of accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次为门控MoE（线性专家+高斯簇诱导门）的联合训练给出全局收敛保证：在相对真实专家数m的对数级过参数化下，梯度EM从随机初始化门和最小二乘初始化专家出发，多项式次迭代内收敛到任意精度。
AI.motivation: MoE在现代机器学习中广泛部署，但基于梯度的训练缺乏收敛保证：目标非凸，且即使是简单混合模型也会使一阶方法陷入虚假局部最优。作者希望为门与专家联合训练的梯度EM建立可证明的全局收敛性。
AI.method: 分析一个典型门控混合模型：线性专家，门由输入空间中的高斯簇诱导。通过对似然做梯度EM进行门与专家的联合训练。将损失解耦为逐簇子问题，进而为耦合动力学建立梯度支配（gradient-dominance）不等式；分析假设门中心满足分离条件，并采用对数级过参数化（相对真实专家数m）、随机初始化门与最小二乘初始化专家。
AI.result: 证明从随机初始化门和最小二乘初始化专家出发，梯度EM在多项式次迭代内以任意精度全局收敛；给出预测的m log m相变，实验予以验证；实验表明分析所需的最小二乘热启动在实践中并非必要，随机初始化专家表现几乎同样好；无约束混合权重会使路由集中到真实专家数，而负载均衡惩罚会分散路由，使模型可剪枝至原宽度的一小部分而不损失精度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为MoE联合训练提供了首个全局收敛理论保证，揭示了过参数化与门中心分离条件下的收敛机制，并从理论与实验上说明混合权重约束与负载均衡惩罚对路由集中度及可剪枝性的影响。

title: Stepsize modulation for cross entropy from local quadratic optimization
summary:
Two methods are presented that perturb a given learning rate schedule in stochastic gradient descent with cross entropy loss.
  Both methods use an extra forward pass to estimate various derivatives of the minibatch loss.
  The first method selects a value $η$ by linearising the softmax values and minimizing the squared error $\tfrac 1 2 ||y - q - ηq'||_F^2$, where $q$ is the matrix representing the softmax values of the minibatch and $y$ is the matrix with one-hot encodings of the labels. The second method considers a quadratic Taylor approximation of the minibatch loss under the outer approximation of the Hessian. Thus, it minimizes $L(0) + ηL'(0) + \tfrac 1 2 η^2 L''(0)$. Here, the derivatives $L'$ and $L''$ are computed from the derivatives of the logits (using the outer approximation of the Hessian of the loss).
  We observe that both methods give very similar values of $η$.
  Finally, these estimated $η$ are used to slightly increase or decrease the learning rate of an existing schedule. The method is evaluated on Cifar10 and Cifar100 datasets for training Resnets, where they decrease the loss faster than the schedule that is perturbed and increase monotonicity. For Cifar10 it also leads to a small improvement of test accuracy, but in Cifar100 test accuracy remains the same.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种利用额外前向传播估计小批量损失导数、从而对已有学习率调度进行扰动的SGD方法，两者给出的步长η高度一致，可在ResNet训练中加速损失下降并提升单调性，Cifar10上略有精度增益，Cifar100精度不变。
AI.motivation: 现有学习率调度（schedule）多为预设的固定曲线，未根据训练过程中小批量损失的局部曲率信息自适应调整，因而可能无法快速、单调地降低损失。作者希望在保留原调度框架的前提下，用廉价的导数估计对学习率做小幅修正。
AI.method: 在交叉熵损失下用一次额外前向传播估计小批量损失的各阶导数。方法一：对softmax值线性化，最小化 ½‖y − q − ηq′‖_F² 来选取η；方法二：在外近似Hessian下对小批量损失作二次Taylor展开，最小化 L(0)+ηL′(0)+½η²L″(0)，其中L′与L″由logits导数结合损失Hessian的外近似得到。随后用所得η对现有调度中的学习率做小幅增减。
AI.result: 两种方法估计出的η值非常接近。在Cifar10与Cifar100上训练ResNet：相比被扰动的基线调度，损失下降更快且单调性更好；Cifar10测试精度有小幅提升，Cifar100测试精度持平。
AI.conclusion: 基于单次前向传播的导数估计即可对学习率调度进行有效的在线微调，两种不同的建模方式（softmax线性化与二次Taylor外近似）得到一致步长，说明该扰动信号稳健；但其收益主要体现在优化过程（收敛速度与单调性），泛化精度提升有限。

title: From Natural Images to Medical Scans: Transferability of Diffusion Models for Medical Image Generation
summary: Transfer learning from natural images is standard in supervised and increasingly adopted in self-supervised medical image analysis, but its role in generative modelling, and in particular diffusion denoisers, remains underexplored. Medical diffusion models typically train the denoiser from scratch, with no systematic evaluation of natural-image transfer. We analyse this across latent and pixel paradigms, model sizes (131M-952M) and two radiology datasets (RadImageNet, BraTS), and ask which aspects of transfer support generation. We find that: i) Natural-image initialisation consistently improves generation, by 21-34% relative gFID in pixel space against 14% in latent space, where the tokeniser supplies much of the prior. gFID gains mirror downstream pathology classification and radiomic-feature FD, both proxies for clinical fidelity. ii) Benefits reflect spatial structure, not semantics: semantic probing does not predict generation quality, whereas a spatial-structure metric adapted to internal denoiser representations tracks gFID at $|r|=0.85$, positioning spatial organisation as a channel through which pretraining manifests. iii) Mixed-domain denoiser training shows that natural and medical images share similar layer-wise representations up to the late blocks, and mixing natural images into medical training improves fidelity. iv) Transfer benefit is tied to natural image initialisation, outperforming in-domain medical pretraining and several reinitialisation schemes. Overall, natural image denoisers transfer positively to medical ones in our setup. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIROLab-Bern/rad-dit

AI.tldr: 自然图像预训练的扩散去噪器可正向迁移到医学图像生成，主要收益来自空间结构而非语义。
AI.motivation: 医学扩散模型通常从头训练去噪器，自然图像迁移在监督与自监督医学分析中已成熟，但在生成建模（尤其扩散去噪器）中缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 在潜空间与像素两种范式、131M–952M 多模型规模、RadImageNet 与 BraTS 两个影像数据集上对比自然图像初始化与从头训练、域内医学预训练及重初始化方案；用语义探测与适配去噪器内部表示的空间结构度量做分析；并进行自然/医学混合域训练观察逐层表示相似性与生成质量。
AI.result: 自然图像初始化稳定提升生成质量：像素空间 gFID 相对改善 21–34%，潜空间约 14%（tokeniser 已提供较多先验）；gFID 增益与下游病理分类、影像组学特征 FD 一致。语义探测不能预测生成质量，而空间结构度量与 gFID 相关性达 |r|=0.85。自然与医学图像在晚期块之前的逐层表示相似，混合训练提升保真度。自然图像初始化优于域内医学预训练与多种重初始化方案。
AI.conclusion: 在该设定下自然图像去噪器向医学去噪器迁移为正收益，机制主要是空间组织而非语义，像素空间收益大于潜空间；代码已开源。

title: Ensembles of Random Partition-Based Models under Covariate Shift
summary: Distribution shifts, including covariate shifts, are ubiquitous in real-world applications of machine learning. Empirical evidence suggests that, across a variety of models with and without downstream adaptation, ensembles tend to be more robust to covariate shift than single models. We extend the theory of covariate shift severity from single models to ensembles, providing theoretical justification for the empirical trends. We introduce new discrepancy measures of covariate shift severity to control the risk of partition-based kernel estimators. We then show that with sufficient ensemble size, these models can achieve minimax-optimal risk convergence rates under covariate shift. Our results suggest that modelers can expect to need larger ensemble sizes for more severe covariate shifts.

AI.tldr: 该论文将协变量偏移严重性理论从单模型推广到集成模型，提出新的偏移严重性差异度量，并证明足够大的集成规模可在协变量偏移下达到极小极大最优的收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 经验证据表明，无论是否进行下游适配，集成模型对协变量偏移的鲁棒性通常优于单一模型，但缺乏理论解释；作者希望为这一经验趋势提供理论依据。
AI.method: 将单模型的协变量偏移严重性理论扩展到集成模型，引入新的差异度量刻画协变量偏移严重性，用于控制基于划分的核估计器的风险，并分析集成规模与偏移严重性之间的关系。
AI.result: 在集成规模足够大时，基于划分的核估计器可在协变量偏移下达到极小极大最优的风险收敛速率；且偏移越严重，所需集成规模越大。
AI.conclusion: 理论结果解释了集成模型对协变量偏移更鲁棒的经验现象，并为建模者提供了集成规模选择的指导：更严重的协变量偏移需要更大的集成规模。

title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introduce Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed), which decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings. Rather than directly projecting the composed query into a single embedding without internal reasoning, FactEmbed employs a set of factorized latents that simulate the intended visual modifications via an intermediate target imagination objective. This process encourages the latents to ground into target semantics before forming discriminative representations for retrieval. Subsequently, to propagate these factorized representations throughout the model for retrieval, we optimize a factor-level contrastive loss while distilling the decomposed representations into a deeper attention layer of the MLLM. Finally, for efficient inference, we retain the [EOS] token to establish a global-level embedding on top of these factorized latents, while we exploit the mean-pooled factorized latents to rerank a short candidate list at negligible cost, as both are produced by the same forward pass. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FactEmbed outperforms prior works across CIR benchmarks.

AI.tldr: FactEmbed将MLLM的组合查询理解与判别性嵌入构建解耦，用一组分解潜在变量通过中间"目标想象"目标模拟预期视觉修改，再以因子级对比损失并将分解表示蒸馏到深层注意力层，推理时用[EOS]全局嵌入召回、均值池化潜在变量重排，在CIR基准上超越既有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM的CIR方法仅用对比监督把组合查询直接映射为单一检索嵌入，未显式解析文本所指的视觉修改，导致MLLM的组合理解能力未被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出FactEmbed：1) 引入一组因子化潜在变量，通过中间"目标想象"(target imagination)目标使其在形成判别表示前先落地为目标语义；2) 设计因子级对比损失，并将分解表示蒸馏进MLLM更深层注意力层，以将因子化表示传播至全模型；3) 推理时保留[EOS] token构建全局嵌入，复用同一前向的均值池化因子化潜在表示对短候选列表低成本重排。
AI.result: 大量实验表明FactEmbed在多个CIR基准上优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 将组合理解与嵌入构建显式解耦、以因子化潜在表示承载视觉修改语义，是提升MLLM组合图像检索性能的有效途径，且可通过单次前向实现高效的两阶段检索。

title: Empirical Bayes Flow Matching for Continuous Cryo-EM Heterogeneity
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://daiyral.github.io/Empirical-Bayes-Flow-Matching-for-Continuous-Cryo-EM-Heterogeneity/
summary: We address the problem of learning generative priors over high-dimensional latent variables from indirect, noisy observations, with a focus on continuous heterogeneity in cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM). In this setting, 3D atomic structures $x \in \mathbb{R}^{3N_a}$ are never directly observed and must be inferred from 2D projection images $y$ generated by a complex, non-linear forward operator. We propose Empirical Bayes Flow Matching (EB-FM), a method that learns a flow matching prior $p_θ(x)$ directly from observations using a Monte Carlo stochastic approximation Expectation-Maximization framework. EB-FM alternates between an E-step that performs approximate posterior sampling from $p_θ(x \mid y)$ via guided flow-based generation while maintaining persistent latent estimates through stochastic approximation, and an M-step that updates the flow model using these stabilized latent variables as training targets. This approach eliminates the need for pretraining on clean data and naturally accommodates non-linear forward models. We validate our method on controlled inverse problems using two-moons and MNIST data, and demonstrate its effectiveness on simulated cryo-EM data with known poses, showing that EB-FM can recover continuous distributions of protein conformations directly in atomic-coordinate space.

AI.tldr: 提出 Empirical Bayes Flow Matching (EB-FM)，在仅能获得间接含噪观测（cryo-EM 2D 投影图像）且前向算子非线性复杂的情况下，直接学习高维隐变量（3D 原子结构）的生成先验，无需干净数据预训练。
AI.motivation: cryo-EM 中的连续异质性要求在原子坐标空间刻画蛋白质构象的连续分布，但 3D 结构 x 从不被直接观测，必须由复杂的非线性前向算子产生的 2D 投影 y 推断；传统做法依赖于干净数据上的预训练先验，难以适配非线性前向模型与间接观测。
AI.method: 在 Monte Carlo 随机近似 EM 框架下学习 flow matching 先验 p_θ(x)：E 步通过引导式 flow 生成从 p_θ(x|y) 做近似后验采样，并借助随机近似维护持久隐变量估计；M 步以这些稳定化的隐变量为训练目标更新 flow 模型。两个步骤交替进行。
AI.result: 在 two-moons 与 MNIST 的受控逆问题上验证；在给定已知位姿的模拟 cryo-EM 数据上有效，能够直接在原子坐标空间恢复蛋白质构象的连续分布。
AI.conclusion: EB-FM 消除了对干净数据的预训练依赖，天然适用于非线性前向模型，为 cryo-EM 连续异质性建模提供了直接从间接噪声观测学习生成先验的可行途径。

title: Robust Reconstruction of Power Lines from Incomplete Mobile and Aerial LiDAR Data
summary: Accurate vegetation-encroachment assessment and risk mitigation require electric utilities to accurately locate and characterize distribution-network assets, including poles and power lines, and distinguish among medium-voltage, low-voltage, neutral, and telecommunication lines. Mobile and aerial Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) point clouds provide detailed 3D representations of these assets and their surroundings. However, power-line detection and reconstruction remain challenging because conductor returns are often sparse, incomplete, noisy, or occluded by vegetation. These challenges are especially significant in distribution networks, where lower pole heights and complex line configurations place conductors close to trees. In addition, mobile and aerial LiDAR datasets differ substantially in point density, viewing geometry, spatial coverage, and occlusion patterns. We propose a robust and automated reconstruction method combining scaled density-based clustering, robust polynomial fitting, and iterative fragment merging to recover individual conductors under severe data incompleteness and occlusion. Following semantic classification, the same reconstruction pipeline processes both mobile and aerial LiDAR data without modality-specific code or parameter tuning. The method is evaluated through degradation experiments, benchmarking, parameter sensitivity analysis, and large-scale validation. On the aerial dataset, it achieves 96.87% precision, 96.66% recall, a 96.76% F$_1$-score, and a geometric RMSE of 0.127 m. On the mobile dataset, where conductor-level reference annotations were unavailable, it achieves a point-to-model RMSE of 0.045 m and a reconstruction coverage of 95.27%. Source code, documentation, and evaluation data are publicly available at https://github.com/varen-project.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合尺度化密度聚类、鲁棒多项式拟合与迭代碎片合并的配电线路导线自动重建方法，对机载与移动LiDAR数据使用同一流程，在机载数据上F1达96.76%、RMSE 0.127 m，在移动数据上RMSE 0.045 m、覆盖率95.27%。
AI.motivation: 电力公司需准确识别配电网络资产（电杆、导线）并区分中压、低压、中性线与通信线，以支撑植被侵占评估与风险缓解。移动/机载LiDAR点云可提供三维表征，但导线回波稀疏、不完整、含噪且常被植被遮挡；配电网杆塔较低、线型复杂使导线紧邻树木，问题更突出；且两种平台在点密度、视角几何、覆盖范围与遮挡模式上差异显著，现有方法难以通用。
AI.method: 先进行语义分类，随后采用统一重建管线：尺度化密度聚类（scaled DBSCAN类）生成导线候选片段，鲁棒多项式拟合恢复曲线几何，迭代碎片合并将断裂片段拼接为单根导线；两平台无需模态专用代码或参数调优。评估包括退化实验、基准对比、参数敏感性分析与大规模验证。
AI.result: 机载数据集：精度96.87%、召回96.66%、F1 96.76%、几何RMSE 0.127 m；移动数据集（无导线级参考标注）：点-模型RMSE 0.045 m，重建覆盖率95.27%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在严重数据不完整与遮挡条件下鲁棒恢复单根导线，且具备跨平台通用性；代码、文档与评测数据已公开。

title: Multi-Objective Generative Optimization via Expected Hypervolume Fine-Tuning
summary: Scientific discovery requires plausible designs spanning useful trade-offs among competing properties: a molecule with strong binding affinity, for example, may be difficult to synthesize. Pretrained generative models, e.g., flow and diffusion generators, provide a foundation for proposing such designs, but steering them toward high-quality, complementary trade-offs remains challenging. Inference-time search incurs high per-sample costs, while fine-tuning typically relies on fixed per-candidate rewards that do not capture how designs complement one another. We introduce Hypervolume Fine-Tuning (HVFT), which adapts a single pretrained generator to maximize the expected hypervolume of its samples while controlling departure from the pretrained distribution. Expected hypervolume jointly rewards candidate quality and collective trade-off coverage. Nonetheless, we show that it cannot be expressed as the expectation of a fixed per-candidate reward and therefore cannot be optimized directly with standard techniques. A key observation of this work is that its first variation corresponds to the expected marginal hypervolume contribution of a candidate, which yields a tractable adaptive reward via an unbiased estimator based on model samples. HVFT uses this reward to decompose the objective into a sequence of KL-proximal scalar-reward subproblems. We establish concavity, relative smoothness, and convergence guarantees for the resulting distributional procedure. Across therapeutic-peptide and molecular design tasks spanning discrete diffusion and continuous flow-matching models, HVFT achieves state-of-the-art expected hypervolume and trade-off coverage.

AI.tldr: HVFT将单个预训练生成器微调为最大化样本期望超体积，通过把超体积目标的变分转化为可估计的边际超体积贡献作为自适应奖励，并用KL近端标量奖励子问题序列优化，在肽与分子设计上取得最优的期望超体积与权衡覆盖。
AI.motivation: 科学发现需要兼顾多个相互冲突属性的设计（如结合亲和力与可合成性）。预训练生成模型（flow/diffusion）能提供候选，但引导其产生高质量且互相补足的权衡设计仍困难：推理时搜索单样本成本高；常规微调依赖固定的逐候选奖励，无法刻画设计之间的互补性。
AI.method: 提出超体积微调（HVFT）：目标为最大化样本的期望超体积，同时约束相对预训练分布的偏离（KL）。指出期望超体积不能写成固定逐候选奖励的期望，故不能直接用标准方法优化；关键观察是其第一变分等于候选的期望边际超体积贡献，从而借助基于模型样本的无偏估计构造可处理的自适应奖励。将该奖励用于把目标分解为一系列KL近端标量奖励子问题，并给出凹性、相对光滑性与收敛性保证。
AI.result: 在跨离散扩散与连续flow-matching模型的治疗性肽设计与分子设计任务上，HVFT取得最优的期望超体积与权衡覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 基于边际超体积贡献的自适应奖励可把集合级、非可分的超体积目标转化为可优化的KL近端标量奖励序列，为预训练生成器提供高效的多目标权衡微调范式。

title: TAQ-MOTR: Tracking-Aware Detection Query Formation for End-to-End Multiple Object Tracking
summary: Tracking-by-propagation (TBP) methods perform end-to-end multi-object tracking by propagating track queries across frames, jointly handling detection and identity association without heuristic post-processing while naturally modeling temporal information. However, as detection and association are tightly coupled, detection queries in TBP are expected to discover currently untracked objects and provide complementary current-frame evidence for challenging tracks whose queries and identities are retained. Existing methods largely inherit detection-query formation from single-frame detection and construct such queries before the decoder with little awareness of trajectory states. Consequently, currently untracked objects may be missed, while challenging tracked objects with reduced visibility under occlusion may lack complementary evidence, causing association failures or duplicate responses. To address these issues, we propose TAQ-MOTR, a tracking-aware detection query formation framework that employs a pre-decoder Hybrid Query Generator (HQG) to fuse current-frame image features, track memory, and learnable memory. By conditioning detection queries on trajectory states, TAQ-MOTR adapts them to \rev{the discovery of currently untracked objects and tracked-object complementation We further introduce a training-only auxiliary detection branch whose one-to-one label assignment is decoupled from that of the main tracking branch, providing additional detection supervision to strengthen the shared HQG and decoder for the discovery of currently untracked objects. TAQ-MOTR improves performance on DanceTrack, SportsMOT, and BFT, achieving 72.0 HOTA, 63.1 AssA, and 76.6 IDF1 on the DanceTrack test set. Code is available at https://github.com/Magicmiya/TAQ-MOTR

AI.tldr: 提出 TAQ-MOTR，通过预解码器混合查询生成器使检测查询感知轨迹状态，并引入训练期辅助检测分支，提升跟踪传播框架的检测与关联能力。
AI.motivation: TBP 方法中检测与关联紧耦合，检测查询需兼顾"发现未跟踪目标"与"为困难跟踪目标提供补充证据"。但现有方法沿用单帧检测的查询构造方式，在解码器之前生成查询且几乎不感知轨迹状态，导致未跟踪目标漏检、遮挡下低可见性目标缺乏补充证据，进而引发关联失败或重复响应。
AI.method: 提出 tracking-aware 检测查询形成框架：1）预解码器混合查询生成器（HQG），融合当前帧图像特征、轨迹记忆与可学习记忆，以轨迹状态为条件生成检测查询，使其自适应于未跟踪目标发现与已跟踪目标补充；2）训练期辅助检测分支，采用与主跟踪分支解耦的一对一标签分配，为共享的 HQG 与解码器提供额外检测监督。
AI.result: 在 DanceTrack 测试集上取得 72.0 HOTA、63.1 AssA、76.6 IDF1；在 DanceTrack、SportsMOT 和 BFT 上均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 以轨迹状态条件化检测查询并辅以解耦的检测监督，可有效缓解 TBP 中漏检与关联失败问题，验证了跟踪感知查询生成的有效性。

title: Privacy for Free in Efficient Agnostic Halfspace Learning
summary: We provide the first computationally efficient, differentially private algorithms for agnostically learning halfspaces. In particular, we study three different settings of agnostic learning: improper learning under Gaussian and log-concave marginals; proper learning under Gaussian marginals; and semi-agnostic learning under Gaussian marginals. In all three aforementioned settings, the added cost in the sample complexity due to privacy matches the respective non-private sample complexity, implying that we get privacy for free.

AI.tldr: 首次给出计算高效且差分隐私的不可知半空间学习算法，覆盖三种设定，隐私带来的样本复杂度代价与非隐私最优相匹配，实现"免费隐私"。
AI.motivation: 不可知半空间学习是学习理论中的核心问题，而差分隐私约束通常会显著增加样本与计算开销；此前缺少在该问题上同时兼顾计算效率与隐私的算法，作者由此探究隐私代价能否被消除。
AI.method: 针对三种不可知学习设定分别设计差分隐私算法：(1) Gaussian 与对数凹边缘分布下的非真学习（improper learning）；(2) Gaussian 边缘分布下的真学习（proper learning）；(3) Gaussian 边缘分布下的半不可知学习（semi-agnostic learning）。方法上以计算高效的隐私机制结合已有的非隐私不可知学习技术，使样本复杂度中的额外隐私开销与各自的非隐私界对齐。
AI.result: 在上述三种设定中，隐私引入的额外样本复杂度均与非隐私情形的最优样本复杂度同阶，即隐私未带来额外样本代价；算法同时保持计算高效性。
AI.conclusion: 差分隐私在不可知半空间学习中可以"零成本"获得；该结果为隐私学习理论提供了首个高效且最优的建模范式，并给出 improper、proper 与 semi-agnostic 三类学习在隐私约束下的可比基准。

title: Diffusion Plug-in Priors for Self-Supervised Ultrasound Video Restoration
summary: \textit{Objective:} Ultrasound videos are limited by hardware-constrained spatial resolution and signal-dependent speckle, while paired low- and high-resolution acquisitions for supervised restoration are rarely available. We aim to jointly super-resolve and despeckle ultrasound videos without paired training data or network retraining. \textit{Methods:} We propose UltraDiff, which uses a frozen pre-trained diffusion model (DM) as a plug-in prior and restores each frame by optimizing the latent seed of the DM sampler under a range-constrained maximum a posteriori formulation. We derive a speckle-aware data-fidelity term from a Rayleigh scale-family model and characterize its relative-residual and variance-adaptive weighting properties. We further introduce a stabilized fidelity that is bounded below and strictly convex in log intensity for positive observations in its unclamped form. A total-variation regularizer complements the DM prior, and a temporal seed update warm-starts each frame from the optimized seed of its predecessor. \textit{Results:} On EchoNet-LVH videos with simulated speckle and additive noise, UltraDiff with a natural-image prior improves PSNR by 1.24\,dB over the strongest baseline, and ultrasound-related priors improve it further. On real clinical echocardiography videos, UltraDiff reduces the mean absolute error of zero-shot ejection fraction (EF) prediction from 7.31 to 6.37 EF points relative to DUP, the strongest baseline. \textit{Conclusion:} Combining a speckle-aware fidelity with frozen diffusion priors enables ground-truth-free ultrasound video restoration that benefits downstream measurement. \textit{Significance:} UltraDiff needs neither paired data nor retraining and is not tied to a specific diffusion checkpoint. Code associated with this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: UltraDiff：以冻结预训练扩散模型为插件先验，通过优化采样器潜变量种子实现无配对数据、无需重训的超声视频联合超分与去斑。
AI.motivation: 超声视频受硬件限制空间分辨率低、具信号相关散斑，且难以获取配对的低/高分辨率数据，监督式复原不可行。
AI.method: 将冻结扩散模型作为插件先验，在范围约束MAP框架下优化DM采样器的潜种子以逐帧复原；由Rayleigh尺度族推导散斑感知数据保真项，分析其相对残差与方差自适应加权特性，并提出在非截断形式下对正观测在对数强度上严格凸且有下界的稳定化保真项；辅以全变分正则，并用前一帧优化种子热启动当前帧（时间种子更新）。
AI.result: EchoNet-LVH仿真散斑与加性噪声下，自然图像先验版PSNR较最强基线提升1.24 dB，超声相关先验进一步提升；真实临床超声心动图视频上，零样本EF预测MAE由DUP的7.31降至6.37 EF点。
AI.conclusion: 散斑感知保真项与冻结扩散先验结合，可实现无真值超声视频复原并惠及下游测量；方法无需配对数据与重训，且不绑定特定扩散权重。

title: Fusing Earth observation embeddings and spaceborne terrain with meteorological forcing for flood peak depth prediction from high-water marks
summary: Flood peak depth on normally dry land governs damage and risk to life, but is observed only sparsely, by post-event high-water mark (HWM) surveys, and depth derived from satellite flood extent is produced after the event and inherits the vertical error of the digital elevation model (DEM) it is computed from. Deep-learning flood models have in turn been trained on hydrodynamic simulations rather than on observed depths. We ask whether flood peak depth can be learned from field observations and predicted before the peak from spaceborne terrain, geospatial foundation-model embeddings and antecedent meteorological forcing. We assembled 5689 USGS HWM surveys from 39 events (2011-2025) in 24 U.S. states and Puerto Rico, assigned each a peak time from nearby sensors, paired each with a rain-free window at the same site, and linked them to Copernicus GLO-30 terrain, AlphaEarth embeddings and 144 h of hourly forcing masked to the lead time. A cross-modal fusion network trained on these observations predicts depth at the surveyed marks with a mean absolute error of 0.39 m 6 h ahead of the peak. Supervision by surveyed depth corrects the DEM error implicitly: differencing the measured peak water level with the same DEM gives 0.93 m at the same marks, 2.4 times larger, although it uses the measured water level and the model does not. Forcing accounts for 77% of the attributed reduction in depth error; terrain and the embeddings are statistically equivalent to each other and contribute the remaining 23%. On eleven held-out events the model still separates flooded from rain-free conditions but no longer resolves depth at the marks (R2 = 0.03), so the skill reported here is confined to the events and regions sampled. Field-surveyed depths can thus supervise flood depth prediction and correct terrain error that extent-based estimation cannot, while transfer to unseen storms remains the open problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以实测高水位痕迹（HWM）调查的峰值水深为监督信号，结合GLO-30地形、AlphaEarth地理空间基础模型嵌入与前期气象强迫，用跨模态融合网络在峰值前6小时预测洪水峰值水深，平均绝对误差0.39 m。
AI.motivation: 洪水峰值水深决定损失与生命风险，但观测稀疏（仅灾后HWM调查），卫星淹没范围反演水深为灾后产品且继承DEM垂直误差；深度学习洪水模型多基于水动力模拟而非实测水深训练，缺乏实测监督。
AI.method: 构建5689个USGS HWM调查样本（2011–2025年，39场事件，24州及波多黎各）；由邻近传感器赋予峰值时刻，为每个点位配对同址无雨窗口，关联Copernicus GLO-30地形、AlphaEarth嵌入及掩膜至预报时效的144小时逐小时气象强迫；训练跨模态融合网络直接预测测点处水深。
AI.result: 峰值前6小时水深预测MAE为0.39 m；与"实测水位减DEM"的0.93 m相比误差降低2.4倍，表明实测水深监督隐式校正了DEM误差。误差归因中气象强迫占77%，地形与嵌入统计等价，合计贡献剩余23%。在11场留出事件上模型仍能区分淹没与无雨条件，但无法在测点分辨水深（R²=0.03）。
AI.conclusion: 实测水深可作为洪水深度预测的监督并校正基于淹没范围方法无法消除的地形误差；但对未见风暴的迁移泛化仍是待解问题，当前技巧限于所采样的事件与区域。

title: PLANTEUR: A Crop-Type Segmentation Benchmark for Tropical Regions
summary: We introduce PLANTEUR, a benchmark for crop-type mapping from satellite images in the French overseas territories. Building on the PASTIS design, PLANTEUR provides georeferenced and aligned Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Landsat-8 sequences with parcel-derived labels spanning six tropical regions and an 8-class label space. We define both a standard test split and a leave-one-island-out protocol to measure cross-territory generalization, and evaluate fully supervised models, linear probes, and fine-tuned foundation models. The benchmark code and data are open source and available on GitHub and Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: PLANTEUR是一个面向法国海外省热带地区作物类型制图的卫星图像基准数据集，包含配准的Sentinel-2/1与Landsat-8时序及地块级标签，覆盖6个热带区域、8类作物，并设置标准测试划分与留一岛协议以评估跨地域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有作物类型制图基准（如PASTIS）主要面向温带欧洲农业，缺乏热带地区多源遥感时序与跨地域泛化评测，作者据此构建面向法国海外领地的基准以填补空白。
AI.method: 沿用PASTIS设计范式，构建地理参考且时空对齐的Sentinel-2、Sentinel-1和Landsat-8序列，标签由地块边界派生；采用8类标签体系覆盖6个热带区域，定义标准测试划分与leave-one-island-out（留一岛）协议，并评测全监督模型、线性探针及微调的基础模型。
AI.result: 形成可公开获取的基准代码与数据（GitHub与Hugging Face），并提供上述多类别模型在标准划分与跨岛泛化协议下的对比评测结果。
AI.conclusion: PLANTEUR为热带多源遥感作物制图及跨地域泛化研究提供了标准化、开放可复现的评测平台。

title: Fairness Metrics based on the AUC in Clinical Predictive AI
summary: Fairness evaluation of clinical prediction models for binary outcomes often involves fairness metrics that compare the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC, or c-statistic) across subgroups. However, the AUC has been shown to be a non-collapsible metric, meaning that its subgroup specific and overall values are not directly comparable as often implicitly assumed. This raises important questions about how existing AUC-based fairness metrics should be used and interpreted. We examine eight AUC-based fairness metrics proposed in the literature, including: within-group AUC parity; cross-group AUC (xAUC) parity; gap-to-overall AUC; equity-scaled AUC; minimum-based metrics; $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$; $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$; and $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ or $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ parity. We characterise their estimands, relate them to the decomposition of overall AUC (into within- and cross-group components), and critically appraise them. We then illustrate their behaviour using simulations based on the EuroSCORE II, a clinical prediction model for in-hospital mortality. We recommend reporting an AUC matrix, containing the overall AUC and all within- and cross-group AUC components, alongside population characteristics. When fairness metrics are needed, we recommend reporting the within-group AUC parity, with cross-group AUC parity providing supplementary information but requiring caution due to its potential conflict with calibration. Metrics involving $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ and $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ have merit, summarising within- and cross-group AUCs into single values, but their interpretation is non-trivial, and they should be used with caution. Gap-to-overall AUC, equity-scaled AUC, and minimum-based metrics compare quantities that should not be compared and it is unclear how to operationalise them, making them not fit for purpose and generally not recommended.

AI.tldr: 本文系统批判性地考察了基于AUC的八个亚组公平性指标，指出AUC的不可折叠性使得亚组值与整体值不可直接比较，据此给出各指标的估计量刻画、模拟实证与方法学推荐。
AI.motivation: 临床预测模型（二分类结局）的公平性评价普遍采用跨亚组AUC/c统计量比较，但AUC是不可折叠（non-collapsible）指标，亚组特异值与整体值并不具备通常隐含假设下的直接可比性。这使既有AUC型公平性指标的使用与解释存在根本疑问，亟需厘清其估计量含义并给出可操作的报告建议。
AI.method: 考察文献中八种AUC型公平性指标：组内AUC一致性（within-group AUC parity）、跨组AUC（xAUC）一致性、gap-to-overall AUC、equity-scaled AUC、基于最小值的指标、xAUC¹、xAUC⁰、以及xAUC¹或xAUC⁰一致性。刻画各自的估计量（estimand），将其与整体AUC分解为组内与跨组分量相联系，并进行批判性评价；进而基于EuroSCORE II（院内死亡风险预测模型）构建模拟，展示各指标的行为。
AI.result: 分析表明，AUC的整体值可分解为组内与跨组分量，而多数AUC型公平性指标实际比较的是不可直接比较的量。模拟（基于EuroSCORE II）显示各指标在组间患病率/方差差异下的行为差异明显：gap-to-overall AUC、equity-scaled AUC与最小值类指标比较了本不应比较的量，且缺乏清晰的可操作化路径；xAUC¹与xAUC⁰虽能将组内、跨组AUC汇总为单值，但解释较为复杂；跨组AUC一致性可能与校准性产生冲突。
AI.conclusion: 建议报告AUC矩阵，即同时给出整体AUC及全部组内与跨组AUC分量，并结合人群特征。必须使用公平性指标时，首选组内AUC一致性，跨组AUC一致性可作为补充但需谨慎（可能同校准目标冲突）。xAUC¹/xAUC⁰相关指标有一定价值但解释困难，应谨慎使用。gap-to-overall AUC、equity-scaled AUC与最小值类指标不适用于其预期目的，一般不予推荐。

title: Diagnosis by Composition: Detecting and Localizing Unseen Diseases by Composing Learned Radiological Findings
summary: Deep models for radiological diagnosis are typically trained to predict disease labels directly from images, which limits them to diseases seen during training and makes their decisions hard to interpret in radiologists' terms. Radiology, however, proceeds from visual findings to disease through published guidelines that make this decision rule explicit, interpretable, and reproducible. We introduce diagnosis by composition (DbC), a representation learning framework that encodes this findings-first logic. DbC learns a vocabulary of radiological findings by aligning image features with the text embeddings of the findings, each finding represented as a dense map over the scan. A disease is defined by a set of required findings derived from its guidelines, and its diagnosis map is a fixed, parameter-free composition of the corresponding finding maps. Because the finding-to-disease mapping is derived from guidelines rather than learned, DbC is interpretable and auditable by design, can extend to new diseases by specifying their findings without retraining, and can diagnose unseen diseases by composing their findings. On multi-phase liver CT, DbC detects and localizes unseen diseases, rare diseases from a different institution, and an external cohort significantly better than all comparators, including models that align images with disease names. DbC also improves detection and localization in the fully supervised setting and remains superior across training-set sizes. Although demonstrated on liver CT, DbC applies wherever radiological guidelines define diseases through findings.

AI.tldr: 提出"基于组合的诊断"(DbC)表示学习框架，将影像特征与影像学征象的文本嵌入对齐，学习征象词表，并按指南将疾病定义为所需征象的固定、无参数组合，从而实现可解释、可审计、可零样本扩展的放射学诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有放射学深度诊断模型直接从图像预测疾病标签，只能覆盖训练中见过的疾病，且决策难以用放射科医生的术语解释。而真实放射学流程是"先看征象、再依指南推疾病"，该决策规则显式、可解释、可复现，因此希望把这种"征象优先"的逻辑编码进表示学习。
